༄༅/ /dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rtogs pa brjod pa ngo mtsha

tei:bibl.tei:idno: GuruLamaWorks/Precious-and-Rare-Disk-01-20130424/rtfs/4_AMAI/AMAI299_ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rtogs brjod/.rtf

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rtogs pa brjod pa ngo mtshar yon tan rin po che 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhiṃ/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rtogs pa brjod pa ngo mtshar yon tan rin po che 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa chen po'i zhabs la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su gzung du gsol/ /rigs sngags rin chen bla gos mdzes 'chang man ngag nor bu dbang gi tog /'gro kun dga' mdzad bsod nams mi nub rdo rje'i yu ba rab tu brtan/ /rab snyan grags pa'i gzi byin stong 'bar mi mthun bdud las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /dge mtshan mngon mtho dpal yon bzang pos 'gro 'dir phan bde'i dga' ston stsol/ /gsang sngags zab don nor bu blo gros gtsug na 'bar/ /rab mdzes mtshan dang dpe byad rin chen rgyan 'phrul 'chang / /skal bzang lag 'gro yongs kyi rtsa lag bla ma rje/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku mnga' klu dbang de la 'dud/ /lung rtogs yid bzhin du ma'i dpal mnga' zhing / /mdo rgyud man ngag phye ba'i rgyal srid la/ /gsung dbyangs gser gyi 'khor los dbang sgyur ba'i/ /thub gsung gsang mdzod 'dzin par gus phyag 'tshal/ /mkhyen yangs kun gsal khyon 'jal 'jam mgon ye shes dpe/ /thugs rjes kun la mar gzigs lag na pad+mor 'gong / /nus mthus kun byang chub mdzad gsang bdag mthu dpal 'phrog /rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ngo bor bstod/ /'gro ba'i bung ba dga' bzhi'i zab lam mchog /sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyis dga' bder nyer 'tsho ba/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dga' chen he ru ka

/bde gshegs thugs kyi ngo bor gus pas 'dud/ /skye dgu'i bsod nams min pa'i nyes brgya'i dmag /mthar byed bsod nams mi zad 'od 'phreng 'bum/ /mi nub bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis kyi/ /snang ba rab 'byams bdag po bla ma rgyal/ /snyan 'gyur grags pa 'bum ldan gsung gi dbyangs/ /rab snyan grags pa lha yi rnga bo ches/ /'gro kun bag med bdud las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /dge mtshan srid rtser gsal khyod 'dir phyag yin/ /rmad byung 'phrin las 'od brgya'i dpal yon gyis/ /thub bstan 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i 'dzum 'phreng las/ /legs bshad sbrang rtsi 'dzag pa'i dga' bde yis/ /bzang po'i skal can bung ba tshim mdzad bsngags/ /gang khyod sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /'jam pa'i mgon dang gnyis su ma mchis kyang / /lnga dang gcig gi zur phud rnam 'phrul tshul/ /tha dad rgyal ba'i sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar/ /sna tshogs gdul bya'i chu mtsho ji snyed par/ /mtshan mo'i mgon gcig snang brnyan de snyed du/ /'gog med 'char gang 'gro ba'i las mthu dang / /rgyal ba'i smon lam stobs yin ngo mtshar rmad/ /de phyir 'jam dpal rdo rje'i rol rtsed las/ /mkhas dang grub brnyes 'bum gyi rnam 'phrul mkhan/ /sngags 'chang bla ma'i 'das dang da ltar gyi/ /grangs med mdzad pa'i ngo mtshar rtsed 'jo'i tshul/ /la la'i nyung ngur bkod pa 'ga' snang mod/ /dam pa'i yon tan rgya cher bsngags 'os zhes/ /rgyal kun dbyangs dang dgongs pa gcig gis gsungs/ /de phyir spros pa'i tshul la nongs pa ci/ /de bas sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen/ /gang gi ngo mtshar mdzad pa'i gtam/ /gleng ba mkhas na don ldan pas/ /bdag kyang cha tsam brjod pa la/ /gcig tu spro dang dad pa'i blo/ /yar ngo'i bsil zer byed pa'i dpal/ /nyin re bzhin yang 'phel ba'i mthus/ /rtogs brjod chu gter 'di spel lo/ ༈ /de la 'dir gleng bar bya ba ni/ gang gi sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i gnas las rjes su bsgrags pa'i ngo mtshar gyi gtam mthong thos kyi legs byas tsam gyis kyang rgyal ba thams cad kyi ye shes gzigs pa'i rgyun yid la 'jug par mdzad pa po ni mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon nyid yin la/

de lta bu'i yon tan gyi cha shas tsam bsngags pas kyang / grangs med pa'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs 'phel bar 'gyur bas na/ rang nyid dam pa'i rjes su 'jug pa'i spobs pa dge ba khyad par can thob pa'i ched dang / rje bla ma gang gi gzhal du med pa'i bka' drin dran pa'i dbang byas/ dad pa dang blo gros can gzhan dag kyang rmad du byung ba'i mdzad 'phrin gyi rjes su gzhug pa'i lhag bsam zla ba tshes pa lta bus nye bar bskul te/ thos pa don dang ldan pa rang blos ji ltar nus pa tsam zhig brjod pa 'di yang / rdo rje slob dpon sogs dam pa rnams kyi yon tan bsngags dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / rgyu mtshan can gyi dam pa'i rtogs brjod dngos la 'jug pa gnyis kyi sgo nas bsnyad par bya ba las/ dang po ni mdo las/ 'di ltar 'jig rten na rigs thams cad kyi bla mar gyur pa shākya rnams kyi skyes pa'i rabs bzung zhing kun byang chub par byas nas gzhan la yang rgya cher bsnyad na chos dang mthun pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med pa 'byung la/ yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phel bar byed pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu dang / rgyud las kyang / slob dpon yon tan gleng bya yi/ /skyon rnams nam yang ma yin no/ /zhes dang / skyon brjod pas ni dngos grub med/ /chu las 'o ma rang bzhugs pa/ /de bton nas ni ngang pas 'thung / /de ltar bla ma'i yon tan bzung / /til dang sog ma 'dres pa las/ /sog ma dag la bro med dang / /til bsdus nas ni khu byug za/ /de ltar bla ma'i yon tan bzung / /ji ltar gar mkhan mkhas pa yis/ /til sogs mar khu 'jur ba bzhin/ /bla ma'i yon tan gzhung la bzung / /skyar mos mtsho la nya len bzhin/ /bla ma'i yon tan rnam thar bzung / /zhes dang / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed la/ bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du bsnyen bkur ba bas ni/

rdo rje slob dpon gyi ba spu'i bu ga gcig la til mar gyis byugs pa ches khyad par du 'phags so/ /zhes dang / lha sku bye ba stong bsgoms pas/ /bla ma dran pa bsod nams che/ /zhes pa dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi rim pa lnga pa las/ mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni/ /bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsams/ /de brnyes pas ni kun mkhyen pa'i/ /ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa mdo rgyud bstan bcos mang po nas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan brjod pa bas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi yon tan gyi cha shas tsam brjod pa bsod nams ches che bar gsungs pa yin la/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang / ba tshwa can chu klung gi mdo las/ lnga brgya tha mar gyur pa na/ /nga nyid slob dpon gzugs 'dzin te/ /nga yin snyam du yid byos la/ /de tshe de la gus pa bskyed/ /ces pa dang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ rdo rje sems dpa' lta bu yi/ /de ltar slob dpon gzugs 'dzin te/ /sems can rjes su bzung dmigs nas/ /phal pa'i gzugs su gnas pa'o/ /zhes dang / slob dpon ston par gyur pa ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis phyag mdzad pa/ /bdag cag rnams kyi pha dang ma/ /'di nyid yid la bsam par bya/ /zhes pa dang / gang phyir ye shes rdo rje ni/ /mnyes par myur du thob par 'gyur/ /de phyir slob dpon drung gshegs te/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams phyag mdzad do/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa ltar/ thar 'dod rnams la ma nor ba'i lam tshul bzhin du 'doms par mdzad pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa zab mo'i smin grol gyi bka' drin stsol bar mdzad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon dag ni/ ji ltar na mtha' klas pa'i nam mkha'i khyon gyis gzhal ba'i skye dgu rnams kyi nyer 'tsho'i dbang por gyur pa gting dpag dka' ba'i thugs bskyed dang smon lam gyi chu mtsho las legs par 'ongs shing /

tshogs gnyis rlabs po che'i dri bzhon gyis nye bar drangs te/ sgrib gnyis chu ldan gyis dben pa'i chos sku bde ba chen po'i mkha' dbyings su legs par son nas/ gzugs sku rnam gnyis kyi rol rtsed nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor rmad du byung ba las/ ris med pa'i 'phrin las kyi 'od zer grangs med pa dus rtag tu 'phro ba'i ngang tshul can gyi bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi ye shes kyi zlos gar las gzhan du med pa'am/ yang na rgyal ba nyid kyang rdo rje slob dpon chen po dag gi rnam par rol pa las ma 'das pa nyid yin la/ de lta bu'i rgyal ba'i dbang po rnams ni nam yang zab mo chos kyi sku nyid las g.yo ba med bzhin du ji ltar yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po dang dpag bsam gyi ljon shing las 'dod dgu mtha' dag 'byung ba'am/ nor bu chu shel dri ma med pa tshon sna tshogs pa dang 'phrad na de dang de'i kha dog mdzes pa 'dzin pa ji lta ba bzhin gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa dang dbang po'i rim pa dang mthun par sprul pa'i gzugs kyi rnam rol bgrang bar dka' ba ji snyed pa dag tu ston pa ste/ ji skad du mdo las/ rgyal pos 'dul ba la rgyal por/ dge sbyong gis 'dul ba dge sbyong / bram zes 'dul ba la bram ze/ dri zas 'dul ba la dri za rgan po'i gzugs su sprul to/ /zhes pa dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ res 'ga' zhi la res 'ga' khro/ /res 'ga' bgegs chen don mdzad cing / /skye dang ri bo thams cad do/ /zhes dang / rdo rje gur las/ gang du snang nas kyang sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /seng ger snang nas kyang sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /chang 'tshong ma dang smad 'tshong mar snang nas kyang sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /zhes dang / ye shes thig le las/ la la he ru ka yi gzugs/ /la la bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs/ /la lar rgyud dang bstan bcos ni/ /mdzad dang la la tu ni 'dzin/

/zhes dang / zla bzang thig le las/ nga yang 'dod dang gzugs mchog tu/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byin gyis brlabs/ /ngas kyang chos kyi sku mchog tu/ /sangs rgyas thams cad byin gyis brlabs/ /zhes dang / sam+bu ṭi las/ kha cig tu ni byang chub chen po'i lam/ /kha cig tu ni byang chub spyod rjes 'brangs/ /kha cig tu ni byang chub mngon byang chub/ /ces dang / brtag gnyis las/ 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga / /rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa nga / /zhes sogs mang du gsungs pa ltar/ zhing khams la lar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i snang brnyan dang / la lar mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston pa'i sangs rgyas dang / gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / mkhas pa'i skye bo dang / grub pa'i gang zag dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la gnas pa dang / a wa dhu ti dang / bhu su ku dang / ku sā li dang / 'khor los bsgyur ba la sogs pa rgyal po dang / khams kyi rgyal phran dang / blon po dang / bram ze dang / dge sbyong dang / khyim bdag dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / gru gzings dang / zam pa dang / sman dang / zas dang / gos dang / ri bo dang / bya dang / ri dwags la sogs pa mdor na snod bcud kyi rnam pa thams cad pa 'dod dgur sgyur ba'i gzugs kyi rnam rol du mas 'gro ba rnams rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i spyod pa dang gtam gyis mtshams sbyar te/ mthar nges par zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i sar bkri bar mdzad pa kho na las mi 'da' ba nyid yin pas so/ /de ltar mchog gi rdo rje slob dpon dag gi yon tan brjod pa nyid las gzhal bar dka' ba'i bsod nams kyi tshogs thob par 'gyur ba de'i phyir na rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid gos dkar lcang los mdzes pa'i rigs sngags 'chang ba'i gar gyi rnam par rol pa'i rnam 'dren dam pa/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi chu klung ma lus pa gcig tu 'dus pa'i spos chu'i rgya mtsho chen po/

rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i theg pa gsum gyi char zim phyogs brgyar 'bab pa'i rdzogs ldan gyi sprin sngon gsar pa/ mthu stobs nus pa'i mche sder rnam par g.yo ba'i bdud rigs glang po'i klad pa 'gems par nus pa'i seng ge mkhas grub klu dbang bye bas yongs su bsten zhing blo gsal ngang pa 'du ba'i pad rdzing chen po/ snyan brgyud zab mo'i bcud len skal bzang rna ba'i dpal du ster ba'i 'chi med kyi rnga bo che/ 'phags pa'i nor bdun la rang dbang du spyod cing bstan 'dzin bye ba phrag brgya'i 'khor 'bangs la mkhas pa dang grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba/ lha dang bcas pa'i skye dgu thams cad kyi gtsug gi cod can la zhabs sen pad mo'i lan tshwar bkod pa'i 'gro ba'i mgon po rje btsun sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes snyan pa'i dri bzhon khor yug ri bo'i khongs su'ang rgyu zhing / nam mkha'i mtha' yang gzhal ba lta bur gyur pa gang gi ngo mtshar ba'i rtogs pa'i cha shas tsam yang brjod par rigs pa nyid las/ mi rigs pa'i klan ka'i go skabs cung zad kyang med do/ /de ltar na yang dam pa 'di nyid ni rigs thams cad kyi bdag po/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso bo/ drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyi ngo bo dang dbyer mi phyed par bzhugs pas/ gang gi rnam par thar pa mtha' dag ni rab 'byams zhing gi rdul snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i bde bar gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa de snyed kyis bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bar du brjod kyang rdzogs par mi 'gyur na/ bdag lta bu'i byis pa blo gros gzhon nu mar gyur pa so so skye bo dag gis lta ga la zhig 'on kyang ma la ya'i rlung gi cha shas tsam reg pas kyang skye dgu'i tsha gdung sel ba ltar/ rje btsun 'di'i phul du byung ba'i mdzad pa dag gi cha tsam bsnyad pas kyang dad can gyi sems kyi gdung ba sel bar 'gyur ba ni gdon mi za ba nyid kyi phyir na/

sngon gyi tshe mkhas grub mang por sku'i snang brnyan ji ltar shar ba'i tshul dang / dus 'dir gangs ri'i ljongs su skal ba dang mnyam pa'i gang zag dag la ji ltar snang ba dag las brtsams te cung zad tsam gleng bar bya ba yang don chen po dang ldan par shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa rgyu mtshan can gyi dam pa'i rtogs brjod dngos la 'jug pa la don gyi gtso bo gnyis te/ sngon gyi 'khrungs rabs 'ga' zhig mdor bsdus te bstan pa dang / da lta'i rnam par thar pa'i tshogs rgyas par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sngon gyi dus su bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin gyis sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur cing / rgyud yongs su smin cing grol bar mdzad pa dang / slad nas kyang grub pa'i slob dpon chen po pad+ma ka ras dbang bskur nas gsang mtshan kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal zhes btags te/ dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po sogs bho ṭa'i ljongs kyi gnas khyad par can mang po bdag gir mdzad nas bstan pa'i skyed tshal bstan 'dzin gyi rkang 'thung dang bcas pa srung zhing skyong ba'i dam ldan chen po ma rung log 'dren gyi snying khrag hub kyis gsol ba'i drag shul can gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po tse'u dmar po zhes yongs su grags pa gang gis/ dam pa 'dis sngon gyi mkhas grub kyi skyes bu mang por sprul pa'i zlos gar bsgyur pa'i tshul zol med du stsal pa ni 'di ltar/ sa dkar po'i yul na rig 'dzin brgyud pa spel ba'i pho brang dam pa der/ rgya nag po'i yul gyi rtse lnga nas/ /smra ba'i seng ge'i ming du btags/ /'ja' tshugs su ldan pa'i rta pho de la bzhon/ /gu ru pad+ma'i dus zhi ba 'tsho dang bstun/ /mkhas pa shrī singha'i ming du btags/ /bkod pa yar la gcig byas na/ /ston pa shākya'i dus mau 'gal gyi bu/ /rim par brgyud pa'i gnam ri srong btsan/ /de la gces pa mgar ba'i ming /

/nye bar brgyud pa'i chos ni dar ba'i dus/ /sgra sgyur rnams kyi gral la 'khod/ /bar ma do'i 'ga' shas su/ /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du sprul pa byung / /rgya gar yul nas tshur la log bod yul sa dkar kun dga'i ming can de la bzlo ba/ /zhes 'byung ba 'di nyid de/ don 'di la gzhan dag yid gnyis spang ba'i phyir gnod sbyin chen po 'di nyid kyi lo rgyus cung zad tsam zhig klad du bsnyad nas/ gzod don dngos bstan par bya'o/ /de yang spyir gnod sbyin 'di ston byed kyi gzhung la/ rnying ma ba rang la rgyud du grags shing / don la rgyud dang khyad par cher med pa slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi gsung 'khrul med gter ston tshad ldan dag gis gter nas spyan drangs te dar rgyas su mdzad pa'i gnod sbyin spu gri dmar po'i snying gi rgyud dang / rgyal po shel phreng dkar po'i rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / man ngag gi bshad rgyud de rtsa ba lta bu gsum dang / de dag la brten pa'i las tshogs sogs gnod sbyin 'di nyid dang / 'di'i gtso bo'am rgyal po lta bu lha'i dge bsnyen chen po dang bcas pa'i las tshogs man ngag gi yi ge rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can sogs gter ston 'khrul med mang pos gter nas spyan drangs pa'i gter yig shog ser ma 'khrul med mang po zhig bzhugs pa las/ dang po gnod sbyin 'di nyid kyi sgos rgyud spu gri dmar po'i snying rgyud du grags pa/ de'i gleng gzhi'i le'u las/ zhu ba po/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ /gdul bya 'og min cho 'phrul bstan pa'i zhing khams na/ /dmar zhe sdang gdug pa me phung 'bar ba'i klong / /rak+ta chags pa rba klong 'khrugs pa'i dkyil/ /dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi dkyil 'khor na/ /bcom ldan rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po nyid/ /khams gsum dbang bsdud ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs so/

/de'i tshe de'i dus na dug lnga chos nyid ngang la rol ba'i 'khor dregs pa can gyi 'khor ni/ bdud dang / dmu dang / rje legs pa/ btsan dang / yan pa skya bdun/ rgyal po dang / ki sngas pa/ gying dang / gnod sbyin gdug pa can bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor te bzhugs pa las/ de rnams kyi gdug rtsub kha rlangs las nad rnams byung ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams rnams brlag la khad pa las/ 'khor gyi nang nas mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje bde ma zhes bya ba yis rang gi stan las langs nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /e ma ho bcom ldan dbang chen rgyal/ /gdug sems dregs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /srid pa gsum po brlag byed na/ /thugs rje'i bdag pos bka' non mdzod/ /ces bskul bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jig rten dregs pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /rang rig ye shes ma shar bas/ /ma rig nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i rgyud/ /sa bon rtsub mo'i sems kyis 'phangs/ /'jig rten dregs pa'i gdug sems can/ /drag po sngags kyis bdag dbang bsdud/ /hrīḥpad+ma tsaṇ+ḍa mahā kro dha ha ya gṛ ba hū lu hū lu hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pas dregs pa thams cad dred cing dngangs te/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ thog mar bdud dang / dmu dang / btsan dang / rgyal po dang / gying dang / gnod sbyin la sogs pa gdug pa can mang pos bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin la rang rang gi srog gi snying po phul/ de nas rta mgrin gyis ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur cing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos pa bzhin dregs byed rnams kyis khas blangs shing dam bcas/ de'i tshe gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po tse'u dmar po zhes bya ba 'di'i rgyud spu gri dmar po'i snying gi rgyud ces grags pa'i le'u bdun pa'i bdag nyid can de nyid kyang gsungs pa yin par bshad la/ de nas rgyud chung de nyid bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin gyi 'khor gyi nang nas mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo rdo rje bde ma'am pad+mar yang grags pa des bka' bsdu mdzad de/

'phrul gyi yi ger btab nas rgyud kyi glegs bam de nyid rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi dur khrod me 'bar gyi gnya' ri dmar nag zur gsum gyi mdun/ brag dmar srin po langs pa 'dra ba'i brag la gter du sba bar mdzad do/ /de nas re zhig na slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis gnas der sgrub gnas mdzad nas gsang sngags zab mo'i rnal 'byor rtse gcig tu dgongs pa la bzhugs pa las/ dus gcig gi tshe nam gyi srod kyi cha la babs pa na gnod sbyin tse'u dmar gyi sprul pa spyang ki chen po khrag gi ral pa can bdun byung ste/ de dag ngu zhing slob dpon la bar du gcod pa'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs pa dag byed pa na/ slob dpon chen pos dpal rta mgrin gyi bskyed rim gyi ting nge 'dzin bstan pa'i sgo nas/ phyag g.yas kyis rdo rje phyar zhing bsdigs par mdzad pas/ sngar gyi spyang ki bdun po de rta pa bdun du gyur nas/ slob dpon la phyag 'tshal zhing bzod gsol 'bul bar byed do/ /de nas slob dpon chen pos/ khyod ji skad bya ba yin gsungs pas/ bdag ni sngon bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin gyis dbang bskur cing dam tshig phog nas bstan pa'i srung mar khas blangs pa'i dam ldan gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po tse'u dmar po zhes rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul na grags shing / bod kyi yul du mthu ldan lha btsan zhes su 'bod pa de lags zer bas/ yang slob dpon gyis khyod kyi gnas gang na yod/ pha ma dang srog gi snying po rnams ji ltar yin gsungs pa na/ de na re/ bdag gi gnas ni rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul 'di nyid dang / rtsang gas kyi bsad phug bya ba de yang lags shing / pha ni dmu'i rje legs pa zhes pa dang / ma ni btsan rje zla ba thod dkar gyi bu mo gnod sbyin bzang 'dren ma bya ba lags/ srog gi snying po sngon bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin gyis gsungs pa'i gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po spu gri dmar po'i snying gi rgyud ces bya ba de'i nang na yod la/

rgyud de sngon bse'i ga'u sen gang pa gcig gi nang du bcug nas/ brag ri dmar po srin po langs pa 'dra ba 'di'i nang na gter du sba bar mdzad yod pas/ rgyud de yang slob dpon chen pos gter nas bzhes la/ de nas bshad pa'i man ngag rnams longs spyod par mdzod cig bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i srung ma bgyid do/ /zhes khas blangs shing dam bcas pa na/ slob dpon yang thugs dgyes te/ sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur nas gsang mtshan kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal zhes btags/ de nas slob dpon chen pos spu gri dmar po'i snying gi rgyud du grags pa yang gter nas bzhes te gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po 'di nyid kyang bstan pa'i srung mar mnga' gsol mdzad pa yin par rgyud chung de nyid las bshad la/ yang gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po 'di nyid kyi gtso bo rgyal po shing bya can nam/ lha'i dge bsnyen chen po dang / rgyal po shel 'phreng can dang / dpe dkar rgyal po la sogs pa mtshan gyi rnam grangs mang po dang ldan pa de nyid 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi spyi'i rgyud dam/ gtso bor rgyal po shel 'phreng can nyid ston pas na/ shel phreng dkar po'i rgyud du grags pa de nyid las/ rgya gar skad du/ ru tra rā dza bha bhi tan+t+ra gu h+ya na maḥ bod skad du/ bdud rgyal shel phreng gsang ba'i rgyud ces bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das 'jigs byed khrag 'thung gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das pad+ma khrag 'thung 'jigs su rung ba gtum rngam drag po 'bar ba'i skur ston pa/ nga rgyal gyis bdud dpung zil gyis gnon pa/ ha ha dang hi hi'i gad rgyangs sgrogs pa/ sku la dur khrod chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ bskal pa'i me phung 'bar ba'i nang na bzhugs pa/ dur khrod chen po rab 'jigs pa/ /rtsi shing nags tshal tsher ma'i shing / /me tog nag po dug shing sogs/

/gcan gzan tshogs ni rab tu 'khrugs/ /dur bya'i tshogs ni rab tu sgrog /dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang / /khrag gi rba klong rab tu 'khrugs/ /de lta bu yi gnas dag tu/ /bcom ldan pad+ma he ru ka /mi mthun sna tshogs 'dul don du/ /cho 'phrul chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje dang / /sprul pa'i khro tshogs nam mkha' bkang / /gsang ba'i bdag po la yang bskul/ /ha ha hi hi a la la/ /tsham rngam dpa' gtum 'jig rten g.yo/ /dregs pa can rnams rab tu brgyal/ /kha nas khrag skyug zil gyis gnon/ /pad+ma khrag 'thung chen po yis/ /dbugs dbyung ting nge 'dzin la zhugs/ /dregs pa can rnams brgyal sad do/ /skad ngan 'don pas skyabs 'chol lo/ /bdag cag dpal gyi bka' stsal nyan/ /ci bgyi zhes ni bka' stsal mdzod/ /gsang ba'i bdag pos bka' stsal pa/ /nyon cig dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /dpal gyi bka' bzhin byed pa na/ /rang rang lugs ni ji ltar bsgrub/ /srog gi snying po gang nas drang / /mthun pa'i dam rdzas gang la dgyes/ /dkyil 'khor bca' gzhi ji ltar bya/ /rang rang las rnams gang la dga'/ /bka' bzhin byed na tshur smros shig /dregs pa can gyi tshogs nang nas/ /lha yi dge bsnyen chen po yis/ /bcom ldan pad+ma khros pa dang / /'khor gyi gsang bdag chen po la/ /bdag cag dregs pa'i tshogs rnams ni/ /skye ba snga ma'i las dbang gis/ /ma sgrub srog gcod las su skyes/ /de rnams nang nas bdag lus ni/ /ri rab ri yi rtse mo nas/ /dpag bsam shing gi rtsa ba na/ /bdud mkhar rtse dgu'i nang shed na/ /mi ro rta ro'i khri steng na/ /bdud kyi rgyal po rā dza rgyal ba bzhugs/ /ri rab byang shar zom shed na/ /dpag bsam shing gi rtsa ba na/ /ma dros mtsho yi nang shed na/ /klu mo dkar mo mgo lcog can/ /klu chen brgyad kyi lcam gcig ma/ /sa bdag gnyan gyi phyi mo mdzad/ /lus la 'dod chags chu ltar khol/

/srid pa gsum na khyo ma rnyed/ /yid kyis gdung ste gnas pa la/ /yab gcig bdud kyi rgyal po yis/ /bdud nag po 'dzum med la 'phrin brdzangs nas/ klu mo la srid pa'i mdza' nang byas na mi rung ngam/ klu mo'i zhal nas/ srid pa'i mdza' nang bya bar nga yang dga' ste/ nga 'dod chags che/ khyod zhe sdang che/ chags sdang tshogs pa las/ 'jig rten gyi khams stong bar byed pa'i gnod sbyin mang po 'ongs na ji tsug byed ces pa'i 'phrin brdzangs so/ /yang bdud kyi zhal nas/ 'jig rten stong par nga 'dod de/ de stong pa nga yi las yin zer nas/ bdud klu mo gnyis ri rab kyi zom rtse la 'dus pa las/ zla ba lnga na sgo nga bcu gsum skyes/ sgo nga mgul 'degs me ru 'bar ba las/ 'jig rten gyi khams su sgra dang mun nag 'thibs/ yum klu mo rngam ste/ sgo nga rnams mid de/ mid ma khad la rang gi lus la me 'bar/ kha nas khrag byung / sna nas glog 'khyug mig nas mchi ma khrag gi char du bab/ lus yang 'jig pa snyam byed pa/ ri rab kyi rtse mo tshangs pa lha'i gnas su bdud thod phreng can gyi spyan sngar phyin te/ sgo nga de dag skyugs nas dpal phyag na rdo rje la phul te/ sgo nga 'di rnams kyi nang nas gnod sbyin gdug pa ma rung ba yong bas/ byin gyis brlabs shing 'du bar gsol bas/ phyag na rdo rjes sgo nga de rnams khyer nas tshangs pa lha'i gnas su rdo a mo li ka'i steng du bzhag ste/ rdo re re 'phangs shing brdol ba las/ sgo nga dang po nas bdud kyi rgyal po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug byung / sgo nga de'i 'og ma brdol ba las gza' bdud ra hu la byung / de'i 'og ma brdol ba las mgon po mu kha'i gdong pa can byung / de'i 'og ma nas shar phyogs shel gying dkar po byung / de'i 'og ma nas dregs pa dgu dbang che byung / de'i 'og ma nas pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug byung / de'i 'og ma nas tshangs pa dung gi khong seng can byung /

de'i 'og ma nas sog po lcags kyi sma ra can byung / de'i 'og ma nas ye kha 'phrul gyi rgyal po byung / de'i 'og ma nas srid pa gzhi 'dzin nor gyi bdag po byung / de'i 'og ma nas yams shud dmar po byung ngo / /bdun tshigs pa de gnam du yar ba las/ dpal phyag na rdo rje thugs khros te ded pas zin pa na/ sa la lan gsum brdabs nas phyag brgyab pas/ sgo nga gas pa'i nang nas bdud kyi bu mi 'dra ba lha'i sras 'dra ba gcig byung ste/ sku gzugs ni dkar la che ba/ dbu la gling bzhi ri rab kyi dpe 'dra bas brgyan pa/ lus la rgyal rtags bcu gsum tshang ba/ ngo mtshar ba gcig byung nas ya mtshan skyes te mtshan yang dpe dkar rgyal po btags so/ /de ma thag lus po mi la mgo bo bya khyung gi mgo bor byung bas/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ lha'i dge bsnyen khyung chen klu 'brug 'dul du btags/ lha ma yin la dmag 'dren pa'i dus su chibs su seng ge dkar po chibs pa/ sku la dar dkar gyi ral kha gsol zhing / dbu la gling zhu sngon po gsol ba/ phyag mtshan spu gri bskor zhing phyin pa'i dus lha ma yin gyi dmag bcom pas lha'i dge bsnyen chen por grags/ lha'i yul du bzhugs pa'i dus su lha'i bsam gtan bsrung du bcug pas/ bsam gtan gyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ de'i tshe dge bsnyen nag po dun ting har du btags so/ /de lta bu'i dus su mtshan mang po lags te/ gang nas bos kyang lha'i dge bsnyen bdag lags so/ /bdag gi yab ni bdud/ yum ni klu bdud gza' smin dkar mo lags so/ /'khor ni stong dpon chen po dang / dmag dpon chen po dang / srog bdag nag po dang / ral pa nag po dang / dar nag chen po lags so/ /phyi'i blon po ha ra lang tra dang / nang gi blon po pu tra rdo rje dbang / khol po 'dzin pa dang / sdom po dang / g.yas kyi mda' ra ba dpa' bo stag chas brgya/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren la nyan thos dgra bcom brgya/

sngon gyi shul sel ba bud med nag mo brgya/ slad kyi rjes nyul ba ban de nag po brgya/ phyag brnyan bzung ba la wa khyung spun bzhi dang / 'di rnams skyes pa'i lus dang / sprul pa'i ming ni de lags so/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams bka' bzhin bgyid do/ /zhes shel 'phreng dkar po'i rtsa ba'i rgyud las 'byung ba dang / yang rgyal po shel 'phreng dkar po'i man ngag gi rgyud du grags pa las/ ༈ /dpal mi zad he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bka'i bstan pa gnyan po srung bar byed pa dang / bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phyir/ skye med thugs chud slob dpon pad+ma yis/ gnod sbyin dam la ma btags gang med na'ang / yab bdud rje btsan po dang / yum klu bza' smin dkar la srid pa'i sras mched lnga byung ba'i lnga tshigs te/ gnam gyi yab lha na/ lha bran khol du khol/ skar phran zas su za/ nyi zla thod du bcing / dge bsnyen chen po de/ gnam gyi yab lha gung gi yang steng na bzhugs pa la/ sus kyang dam la ma thogs dbang du ma 'dus pa la/ gnam nas yab babs kyi byis pa lo brgyad pa gcig gi tshul du byung ba/ bha ta hor gyi yul bsam 'grub shel gyi brag phug na slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa chos nyid skye ba med pa'i don rtogs shing bzhugs pa la/ ting nge 'dzin le lor gyur pa gcig gi dus/ gnod sbyin chen po de seng ge dkar mo gcig tu byas nas/ slob dpon la nyams blangs te/ dkyil 'khor thog tu khyi mo tshugs byas nas/ kha ni gdangs/ rna ba ni dkrong / mig ni bgrad nas slob dpon la zings kyis mchong la khad pa la/ slob dpon mngon par shes pa dang ldan pas gnod sbyin gyi bu yin par mkhyen nas/ dbang chen gyi ting nge 'dzin du zhugs te kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya bcas nas brgyab pas/ seng ge dkar mo gnam du bros te song ba ban+dhe nag po gcig tu byas nas/ gnam rdo dkar po lug tsam gcig thog gi tshul du phab pa/

slob dpon gyi spyi gtsug tu brgyab pas/ der slob dpon yang cung zad brgyal/ dkyil 'khor gyi rdzas yang 'khrugs par gyur to/ /brgyal ba sangs pa na su yang mi 'dug pas/ slar yang slob dpon gyis dbang chen gyi ting nge 'dzin du zhugs nas lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas bkug pas/ dge bsnyen gzhon nu'i tshul du byas pa/ lag na shel 'phreng brgya rtsa brgyad thogs pa gcig slob dpon gyi mdun du byung ba na/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ gnod sbyin gyi bu la dge bsnyen gyi tshul ston pa khyed su yin gsungs pas/ de na re/ bdag bdud kyi bu la klu'i tsha ste/ bdud kyi bu la dam tshig bsre nus sam zer bas/ slob dpon gyis dam tshig bsres na/ bka'i bstan pa ma nub kyi bar du bsrung nus sam gsungs pas/ de na re/ dam tshig bsres na bdag gis bstan pa ma nub kyi bar du bsrung nus so zer ba na/ slob dpon gyis khyung gshog gi phyag rgyas dbang du bsdus pas/ dge bsnyen chen po des/ oṃ badz+ra raka sha rā dza tsit+ta bzung / kha rag rma sha rbad rbad/ 'khu na dum bu shig 'das na raka sha tsit+ta phyung rbad/ ldog na raka sha myogs rbad rbad tri gtum/ zhes pa'i srog snying slob dpon la phul/ slob dpon gyis thugs kyi nying khu nas gsang ba'i bcud brtol te/ lag tu rdo rje gtad/ lce la a mṛ ta bzhag nas/ gsang ba'i dam la ni btags/ mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni byin/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi dbang rnam pa lnga yang bskur bas/ de nas dge bsnyen des gdung ba'i dbyangs dang bcas/ chos kyi dbyings dang sbyor ba'i shel 'phreng dkar po 'di/ /bdud kyi bur skyes dge sdig don ma rtogs/ /dge sdig don rtogs lha dang bla ma la/ /rig pa'i me tog 'di 'bul bzhes su gsol/ /zhes brjod cing 'phreng ba'i me tog phul lo/ /slob dpon gyis rigs dang sbyar te gsang mtshan rdo rje khyung chen klu 'brug 'dul du btags so/

/zhes shel 'phreng dkar po'i rgyud las bshad cing / de nas slob dpon gyis/ dge bsnyen chen po de la/ phyag rgya rnam drug gi dbang dang / phyag mtshan lnga'i dbang rnams rim pa bzhin bskur te slob dpon dang gnod sbyin gnyis slob dpon dang slob mar gyur par bshad rgyud du grags pa de las bshad pa yin la/ de bzhin du rgyal po shel 'phreng can gtso 'khor gyi las tshogs man ngag gi rigs kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis gter du sba bar mdzad pa'i rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis spyan drangs pa'i yig rigs 'khrul med rnams las tshul de dag gsal bar bshad cing / man ngag de dag ni rnying ma ba rnams la da lta yang brgyud pa'i 'phreng ba ma chad par bzhugs pa yin no/ /de ltar rgyal po shel 'phreng can nam/ dpe dkar rgyal po'am/ lha'i dge bsnyen chen po sogs mtshan thun mong ba du ma dang ldan zhing / slob dpon chen po pad+mas 'di rang gi rigs dang sbyar te btags pa'i gsang mtshan ltar na rdo rje khyung chen klu 'brug 'dul zhes grags pa 'di nyid/ dang por bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin nyid kyis dbang bskur cing dam la bzhag nas bstan pa'i srung mar bka' bsgos/ bar du slob dpon chen po pad+ma saṃ bha was dbang bskur cing dam tshig phog nas/ li yul lcang ra smug po'am/ bha ta hor gyi sgom grwa'i bstan srung du mnga' gsol mdzad rjes/ slar yang slob dpon chen po de nyid kyis bod yul gyi gnas khyad par can dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi srung mar bka' bsgo bar mdzad pa yin te/ de yang bod kyi chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' khri srong lde'u btsan gyis dpal bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang chen po bzhengs pa'i dus su/ slob dpon chen po la/ e ma ho/ slob dpon chen po bka' drin can/ /lnga brgya'i tha ma phyi phugs su/

/bdag 'dra rgyal po chos rgyal mi 'byung zhing / /blon po sdug cing 'bangs rnams sil bur 'gro/ /dbus gtsang ru bzhi mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi/ /gtsug lag khang gi srung ma gang gis bgyi/ /bstan srung thog dang ser ba gtad la sogs/ /sngags kyi bstan pa bsrung ba gang la bgyi/ /slob dpon thugs rjes bzung nas gnang bar zhu/ /zhes zhus pas/ slob dpon chen pos/ e ma ho/ dus kyang je ngan je ngan 'gro/ /rje yi thugs dam bsam yas kyang / /rgyal po'i snying du 'gong po 'jug /'bangs rnams nang 'thab dme 'khrug byed/ /gtsug lag khang la 'thab khang 'cha'/ /mgyogs dang me dngos 'jigs pa 'ongs/ /dbus dang mtha' 'dul skor rnams ni/ /mi nag rnams kyi spyod par 'gyur/ /chos 'khor mda' phug dod par byed/ /sngags pa gri ru gsod par byed/ /rgyal po'i shul gyi lam mi thub/ /chos gos 'og tu gri thung 'dzugs/ /che btsan dug gis gsod par byed/ /skye bo nang 'thab mtshon gyis gsod/ /sngags pa nang rgyas mthu 'gran byed/ /gong ga tsher dam byed pa dang / /gso kha phyi sgo bsrung ba dang / /pha phad nang dme byed pa dang / /mtshon gyi bskal pa dar bar 'ong / /chos byed btsun par mi dad cing / /zog po bslu khrid mkhan la rtsi/ /gos ngan khyi yi thul ba gyon/ /zhwa ngan rtsid pa'i 'be zhu gyon/ /mtshon ngan dbyug pa khyer ba dang / /chos ngan chad lta'i stong nyid ston/ /bstan pa 'jig pa'i ltas ngan yin/ /de tshe gtsug lag dkor bsrung pa/ /dkor bdag rgyal po dpe dkar dgos/ /bha ta hor gyi sgom grwa nas/ /ka ca'i phyir ni 'phreng nas 'ongs/ /de tshe nga yis dkor srung bcol/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas re zhig na rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sras mu khri btsan pos/ zhang blon chen po zhang lha bzang klu dpal gyis gtsos pa'i 'khor dmag dpung gi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas byang phyogs su g.yul bshams nas/

gru gu dang / rgya nag gi rgyal khams thams cad bcom zhing / hor gyi sgom grwa bar pa yang bcom ste/ de na yod pa'i ba sa'i lha khang dang / shing dung dkar po rgyang grags dang / cha lang dang / dre rngog la sogs pa'i dkor chas thams cad khyer/ rgyal po dpe dkar gyi sku dang / shel gyi seng ge dang / sbal pa la sogs pa rin po che'i spyad pa rgyal po chags pa'i rten rnams dang / 'cham sku bse 'bag dmar po spyan drangs te/ rgyal bu dmag tshogs dang bcas pa bod du 'byor ba'i dus su ka cha rnams la 'phreng ba'i tshul gyis dpe dkar rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa bha ta hor gyi yul nas bsam yas su byon pa yin la/ de nas slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha was dpe dkar dkor mdzod gling du rten btsugs te dam la btags nas/ dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang spyi dang / gzhan yang mtha' 'dul dang yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang thams cad kyi dkor srung du bka' bsgos shing dam la bzhag pa bzhin/ dpe dkar rgyal po 'di nyid 'khor dang bcas pas kyang zhal gyis bzhes shing yid kyis dam bcas te da lta'i bar du bzhugs pa yin no/ /rgyu mtshan des na gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po tse'u dmar po'am/ gsang ba'i mtshan ltar na kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal zhes yongs su grags pa 'di nyid ni/ dang por bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin gyis gnod sbyin 'di rang gi gtso bo rgyal po shel 'phreng can 'khor dang bcas pa la dbang bskur ba'i dus su yang dam la bzhag cing bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos shing / skabs gzhan du gnod sbyin de nyid rang la logs su dbang dang dam tshig byin te/ tshul de bzhin du slar yang nges don du sangs rgyas dang gnyis su med pa'i grub pa'i slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis rgyal po shel 'phreng can bha ta hor gyi yul du dam la btags dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ 'di la yang dam bzhag mdzad cing /

gnas skabs gzhan du yang dbang bskur cing gsang mtshan yang gsol te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung zhing skyong bar bka' bsgos pa bzhin zhal gyis bzhes nas dam bcas pa'i dam ldan mthu rtsal can/ ngo bo sa la gnas pa'i byang sems chen po/ rnam pa gnod sbyin mthu bo che'i tshul bzung ba lta bu zhig yin par gong du bkod pa'i yi ge de dag las gsal zhing / yig rigs de dag ni/ gsang sngags rnying ma ba rang lugs la rgyud du yang grags shing / don la rgyud min na'ang / slob dpon pad+ma'i gsung 'khrul med du snang bas/ rgyal ba'i bka' dang khyad par med pa nyid du gzung rigs te/ mgon po byams pas/ gang zhig rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig gi /dbang byas rnam g.yengs med yid can gyis bshad/ /thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes mthun pa/ /de yang drang srong gsung bzhin spyi bos blangs/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /rnam pa gcig tu na rgyal ba rigs lnga khros pa ni rgyal po sku lngar grags pa yin zhing / rgyal po shel 'phreng can 'di ni de lnga'i nang tshan gcig yin par gsang sngags rnying ma ba'i gsung rgyun tshad ldan dag las grags la/ de nyid kyi las mkhan la gong du bkod pa'i shel 'phreng dkar po'i bshad rgyud du grags pa slob dpon pad+ma'i gsung 'khrul med de las phyi'i blon po ha ra lang ṭa/ nang gi blon po pu tra rdo rje dbang zhes gnyis su bshad pa'i phyi ma de dang / gnod sbyin chen po 'di gcig par snang bas/ rgyal po sku lnga'i nang tshan dpe dkar rgyal po'i las mkhan gyi gtso bo yang 'di nyid yin pa ni gdon mi za zhing / des na gnod sbyin 'di ni rgyal ba rigs lnga khros pa'i nang tshan dpe dkar rgyal po dang gtso 'khor du snang ba ma gtogs/ yang dag par na de nyid dang khyad par med pa nyid yin te/ rgyal po shel 'phreng dkar po'i rtsa rgyud du grags pa de las/ sku dang gnyis su med par 'phrin las mdzad pa ni/

/gnyis med thugs las sprul pa'i pu tra rdo rje dbang / /rdzu 'phrul glog ltar 'gyu bas dgra bgegs rdul du rlog /ces 'byung ba dang / gzhan yang gsang sngags gsar ma'i lugs la/ gnod sbyin yab yum dang / pu tra lcam sring gsum/ ber nag dang gcer bu gnyis sogs gur gyi mgon po nyid kyi sprul pa tsam las ngo bo dbyer med pa dang / las kyi gshin rje nag po yang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi thugs kyi sprul pa las ma 'das pa dang / rdo rje shugs kyang dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnam 'phrul las gzhan du med pa dag dang tshul mtshungs pa'o/ /de bas na gnod sbyin chen po 'di ni rgyal ba rigs lnga gang yang rung ba zhig gdul bya gdug pa can zhi ba'i rnam 'phrul gyis 'dul mi 'os pa dag drag gtum gyi tshul gyis 'dul bar bya ba'i phyir/ rgyal po shel 'phreng can gyi skur bstan pa de'i 'khor gnod sbyin gyi tshul bzung ba tsam las/ nges pa'i don du rgyal ba rigs lnga'i ye shes kyi rnam par rol pa las gzhan du med par shes par bya'o/ /rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir na gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po 'di nyid kyis/ bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa chen po 'di'i sngon gyi 'khrungs rabs mdo tsam zhig gsungs pa 'di ni/ dpyod ldan gzur gnas dad gus can dag gis shin tu yid ches shing ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su gzung rigs pa yin no/ /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ e ma gdug can 'dul phyir rgyal kun gyi/ /mthu stobs gcig tu spungs pa khro bo'i sku/ /myur 'gro mgrin can 'jigs pa'i sgra dbyangs 'tsher/ /pad+ma dbang chen grags pa snyan ldan des/ /'jig rten nyams ngar byed pa'i dregs pa can/ /rab mang nor 'dzin rdul rnyed dag gi ni/ /khengs pa'i dpal 'phrog rgyud 'jam des pa yi/ /ngang tshul la bkod gsang chen dbang gi chu/ /ngoms par blud de dam tshig sa'i zla ba'i/

/cod pan yid kyi gtsug tu dam bcings te/ /rgyal bstan bsrung ba'i mel tshe gyis shig ces/ /ji ltar bsgos las nam yang mi 'da' ba'i/ /dam ldan rā dza shel gyi 'phreng ba can/ /gang de dregs pa 'bum sde'i 'khor tshogs dang / /las byed gtso bo pu tra rdo rje dbang / /ming gzhan gnod sbyin tse'u dmar 'bod pa des/ /bstan pa'i skyed tshal bstan 'dzin rkang 'thung bcas/ /bsrung zhing skyong ba'i mdzad 'phrin chu bo'i rgyun/ /srid mthar chad pa med pas skye dgu la/ /sa 'dir dge legs 'bras bus rdzogs ldan bzhin/ /yang ni brtul zhugs grub dbang a tsar+ya/ /pad+ma 'byung ba'i gnas zhes mtshan gyi ni/ /dge legs dbyangs su len pa tsam gyis kyang / /dregs ldan bye ba'i snying rtsa 'dar byed des/ /rab snyan lha yi dge bsnyen du 'bod dang / /rab gtum 'phrin las byed po tse'u dmar/ /rab gsal sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du bcug nas/ /rab zab dbang gi bdud rtsis rgyud bum bkang / /rab brjid snyan pa'i gsang mtshan snyan pa'i sgras/ /rab drag bos tshe snyan bsrings mi mnga' bar/ /rab mgyogs skad cig dgug nus mtshan stsal te/ /rab 'byams bstan srung chen por mnga' gsol mdzad/ /de phyir mthu ldan gnod sbyin yongs kyi gtso/ /rnam 'phrul snang bas srid gsum kun tu khyab/ /bka' yi rdo rje drag po stsal tsam gyis/ /snang srid lha srin dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs/ /dbang du byed des mgon 'di ngag dbang lha'i/ /gzugs las gzhan du sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar/ /mang du bsgyur nas sna tshogs gdul bya'i don/ /mdzad ces 'dom la su zhig nem nur byed/ /de ltar dpal 'phrin las kyi mgon po gnod sbyin tse'u dmar pos gsal bar bstan pa'i sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa chen po gang gi sngon gyi 'khrungs rabs shin tu ngo mtshar zhing yid ches pa'i gnas su grub pa dag so so'i rnam thar lo rgyus dang sbyar te bshad par bya ba yang 'di ltar thos te/

de yang spyir dam pa 'di ni nges don du bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi mkhyen rab kyi ngo bo gzugs kyi sku'i rnam par rol pa rje btsun ut+pal sngo ldan nyid las gzhan du med mod/ 'on kyang kun rdzob tsam du gdul bya rnams kyi las dbang dang mthun par gang la ci 'tshams kyi rnam 'phrul mi 'dra ba dri ma med pa'i chu shel kha dog sna tshogs pa'i tshon gyis bsgyur pa ltar cir yang snang ba bzhin/ gang zag skal pa dang ldan mi ldan gyi bye brag gi snang tshul gyi rim pa yang ci rigs pa 'byung ba las/ re zhig gong du ji skad smos pa ltar gnod sbyin chen po des/ bkod pa yar la gcig byas na/ ston pa shākya'i dus/ mau 'gal gyi bu/ zhes thog mar rang cag gi ston pa shākya'i rgyal po des/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i chos tshul rgya chen pos mtha' yas pa'i skye bo'i gdung ba sel bar mdzad pa'i dus su/ de nyid kyi 'khor thos sgrogs kyi mtshan 'chang ba mang po'i nang nas mthu dang rdzu 'phrul can gyi mchog tu ston pa nyid kyis bsngags shing thams cad du snyan par grags pa mau 'gal gyi bu zhes rtag par dge ba'i mtshan/ sa gsum gyi skye dgu'i rna ba'i bdud rtsir 'bab pa gang gi sku'i snang brnyan ji ltar shar ba'i tshul rjes su brjod pa ni 'di lta ste/ sngon ston pa rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan ta ka gnas pa na/ 'khor dgra bcom pa'i dge slong dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun khri phrag dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po na kun tu rgyu ko'u ni n+ya dang / mau 'gal gnyis la bu zhig pang nas btses pas pang nas skyes zhes bya ba dang / bram ze dkar rgyal dang / sha ri ka gnyis la bu zhig byung ba'i ming nye rgyal te/ gnyis ka'ang blo gsal zhing rig gnas bco brgyad la mkhas pa/ 'khor lnga brgya re yod pa gnyis phan tshun yid mthun pas/

bdag cag gnyis bdud rtsi sngon la thob pa des cig shos la 'gran no zhes dam tshig byas 'khod pa las/ ji zhig na 'phags pa rta thul grong der bsod snyoms kyi phyir gshegs pa nye rgyal gyis mthong ste/ 'di lta bu'i spyod lam mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba bdag gis sngon chad ma mthong na/ 'di ci zhig gam brtag go snyam ste rta thul ga la bar dong ste/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod kyi ston pa su/ gang las rab tu byung / ci'i chos la dga' dris pas rta thul gyis/ shākya'i rgyal po brtul zhugs dka' thub chen po kun gyi dam pa dbang ldan pa/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin cing grol la de bzhin 'gro ba sgrol mdzad pa/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya sar mdzad mi mnyam sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem de da lta 'di na yod/ /dri ma med pa de yi skyabs su nga song nga ni de yi chos la dga'/ /zhes gsungs/ yang nye rgyal gyis/ khyed kyi ston pa ji skad gsungs dris pa/ rta thul gyis/ ji ltar 'jig rten las dang nyon mongs rgyur bcas byed rgyu ldan 'byung dang / /las dang nyon mongs pa dag ldog rgyu de yang 'dren pas rab tu gsungs/ /gang na skye dang rga dang rgud pa'i sdug bsngal nye bar mi gnas pa/ /thar pa mchog de smra ba'i khyu mchog de yis rang gis mkhyen te gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pas/ nye rgyal gyis rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu thob nas/ sangs rgyas kyis ni shin tu rnyed dka' thos gter bdud rtsi'i chos bshad pa/ /'di ni rtag tu skye ba'i 'bab chu skem pa bden par khong du chud/ /'di ni 'gro ba rnams kyi sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ba ste/ /lam ni dam pa shes rab chos rnams bsgom pa mi nyams byed pa yin/ /zhes pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa de da lta gang na bzhugs dris pas/ rta thul gyis/ rgyal po'i khab bya ka lan dha ka gnas pa na bzhugs so zer bas/ nye rgyal gyis bdag cag grogs po'i mchog dang bcas bcom ldan 'das de'i drung du rab tu byung ngo /

/zhes smras te/ rta thul la phyag dang skor ba byas te/ pang nas skyes ga na bar song bas/ nye rgyal 'ongs pa mthong nas/ khyod kyi dbang po rnams ni dwangs/ bzhin gyi kha dog ni dag lpags pa'i mdog kyang dkar na/ khyod kyis bdud rtsi rnyed dam smras pas/ nye rgyal gyis de de bzhin te/ kho bos bdud rtsi rnyed pa'i tshul khyod la bshad do zer bas/ pang nas skyes stan las langs/ bla gos gzar/ pus mo btsugs/ thal mo sbyar te/ gang gis srid gsum rgya mtsho myur brgal zhing / /phung po dgra chen rnam par gzhig bya ba/ /mya ngan med pa'i lam de shod cig dang / /yang 'byung med pa'i sa der 'jug par bya/ /zhes smras te nyan pa na/ nye rgyal gyis/ ji ltar 'jig rten las dang nyon mongs rgyur bcas byed rgyu ldan 'byung dang / /zhes sogs rta thul ji skad gsungs pa de smras pas/ yang pang nas skyes kyis/ sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar bya phyir dri ma med pa'i zhi ba'i chos/ /nyon mongs lta ngan nyams pa thams cad zhi byed mi shes gcod pa dang / /'di na 'dus byas gsog gsob de phyir stong pa bslu bar thub pas gsungs/ /de thos zhi ba reg 'gyur dri ma med pa'i tshig de zlos te gsungs/ /zhes smras pa na/ slar yang sngar gyi tshigs bcad de bsnyad pas/ spang nas skyes kyis kyang rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob ste/ yang dag spyod pa 'di ni chu bo sgrol ba zhi ba mgyogs pa'i gzings/ /ye shes mchog 'di sdug bsngal gsum po zhi byed 'khor ba'i pha rol 'gro/ /'di ni yongs su shes na nyon mongs phung po 'joms shing bdud 'dul 'gyur/ /thar pa 'di ni dgra dang 'thab mo gsal zhing sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem/ /zhes smras te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de da lta gang na bzhugs dris pa/ kho bos de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal po'i khab bya ka lan dha ka gnas pa na bzhugs pa thos pas/ bdag cag gnyis der rab tu 'byung ngam zer ba na/

pang nas skyes kyis/ de ltar bya'o smras te/ gnyis ka blo mthun pa na/ de'i tshe bdud sdig can gyis thos nas/ de gnyis rab tu byung na nga'i yul stong par byed kyi/ de las zlog ste rang gi lta ba 'dzin du gzhug snyam nas/ rta thul gyi cha lugs su bsgyur te/ skyes bu dam pa gnyis po 'gro ba'i lam du 'dug nas/ kho bos sngar smra rgyu dang byed rgyu de ni log pa ste/ khyed gnyis yid kyi spyod pa ci la nges par gdam par bya ba'i phyir/ /smras pa de dag thams cad don yod ma yin 'di la rgyu yang med/ /dge dang mi dge las de'i 'bras bu thob pa 'di ni ga la yod/ /myur du khyed gnyis 'dod pa'i yon tan dag la rab spyod rtsed mo byos/ /skye rga na 'chi med cing sdug bsngal med de 'jig rten pha rol med/ /bsod nams bsod nams ma yin las skyes 'bras med rgyu dang byed pa med/ /rnyed phyir 'di ni shākya'i bu yis smras kyi dad pas ma 'gro zhig ces smras pa na/ khong gnyis rab tu byung las zlog pa'i phyir bdud kyis 'ongs so snyam nas/ nye rgyal gyis rang gi 'khor la/ bram ze khye'u nyon cig 'khor ba'i skyon/ /dran par gyis la 'jig rten rga ba yis/ /gzir zhing 'chi bdag gis ni rab bskor ba/ /de nyid spang phyir rab byung legs par bzung / /zhes smras/ pang nas skyes kyis bdud la/ mkhas pa'i blo 'chang sdug bsngal gsum mthar phyin mchog chos rnams kun shes kyi/ /rnam pa kun tu bdag blo 'di las bskyod nus su yang med/ /srid pa rab zhi bya phyir bdag cag brtan pa'i yid kyis rtag tu 'bad/ /seng ge'i gzugs can wa yi tshig gis nged kyi blo gros ma sgyur cig /ces smras pa na/ bden pa mthong ba'i lha nam mkha' na gnas pa rnams kyis/ skyes bu dam pa khyed dag legs so legs so/ /rab tu byung ba ni 'jig rten thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa dang / sdug bsngal ma lus pa zhi bar byed pa/

sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyod yul la 'jug pa/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsngags pa'i lam mo/ /zhes pa'i legs so byin/ de nas kyang bdud kyi sems mya ngan gyis non bzhin du khong rnams ston pa'i drung du 'gro ba dgag pa'i phyir/ grong khyer chen po'i phyi rol tu g.yang sa chen po dpag tshad brgya yod pa yang sprul/ gzhan yang ri chen po sra zhing brtan pa 'phangs su dpag tshad brgya yod pa dang / seng ge chen po gtum zhing 'jigs pa'i sgra skad 'byin pa stong la sogs pa sprul yang / bcom ldan 'das kyi mthus khong gnyis kyis g.yang sa la sogs pa gtan mi snang bar/ lam bde bar bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der la gor yong bas/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis khong rnams rgyang ring po nas 'ongs pa gzigs pas/ dge slong dag khyed kyis skyes bu gnyis yong ba mthong ngam/ 'di gnyis g.yog dang bcas pa nga'i drung du byung nas/ gcig ni nga'i nyan thos rnams kyi nang nas shes rab che ba'i mchog tu 'gyur/ gcig ni rdzu 'phrul che ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /zhes bka' stsal to/ /de nas skyes bu dam pa de gnyis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing skor ba byas te spyan sngar 'khod nas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gnyis la rab tu byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po stsal du gsol/ /zhes zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen bzhin du rigs kyi bu khyed gnyis kyi pha ma su/ ming ci zhes bka' stsal pa na/ nye rgyal gyis/ bdag gi pha ni bram ze dkar rgyal bya ba ste/ de'i bu nye rgyal zhes pa dang / ma ni shā ri ka ste/ de las skyes pas shā ri'i bu zhes btags/ bdag rab tu 'byung bar pha mas kyang gnang ba lags/ zhes gsol/ de bzhin du pang nas skyes kyis/ bdag gi pha'i ming ko'u 'di n+ya/ ma'i ming mau 'gal te/ de las skyes pas mau 'gal gyi bu zhes ming du chags/ bdag rab tu 'byung bar pha mas kyang gnang ba lags zhes zhus pas/

bcom ldan 'das kyis/ shā ri'i bu dang mau 'gal gyi bu g.yog dang bcas pa nga'i thad du tshangs par spyod cig ces bka' stsal pa na/ de nyid kyi mod la de gnyis g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa rnams rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po mchog dang ldan par gyur to/ /zhes 'dus pa rin po che rtog gi gzungs las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gyi snying po bsdus pa yin la/ gzhan rgya nag nas 'gyur ba'i mdo drin lan gsab pa zhes pa'i nang du mau 'gal gyi bu'i lo rgyus shin tu rgyas pa zhig 'byung yang / spyir rgya nag nas 'gyur ba'i mdo rnams lhag chad che bar mkhas pa rnams bzhed cing / khyad par de nas 'byung ba dang rtog gzung gnyis mau 'gal gyi bu'i yab yum gnyis mi mthun pas lo rgyus tshad mar dka' bas 'dir ma bkod la/ de ltar mau 'gal gyi bu nyid ston pa'i nyan thos rdzu 'phrul can gyi mchog tu rgyal ba nyid kyis lung bstan pa ltar/ sngon gyi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la brten nas gsung dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su dag par bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs ston par mdzad pa'i tshe/ mau 'gal gyi bu chen pos/ bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung gi tshad dpag par bya'o snyam ste/ rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la song ste ri rab kyi rtser 'dug nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung nyan pa na/ sngar drung na yod pa'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin du thos pas/ yang rdzu 'phrul gyis 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed kyi gling bzhi ri rab 'khor yug dang bcas pa las 'das nas nub phyogs su phyin te/ nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams dang / mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams gnyis kyi bar gyi zom la gnas te nyan pas sngar bzhin thos/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis mau 'gal gyi bu nga'i sgra skad dpag par 'dod kyi 'di la rdzu 'phrul zhig bstan dgongs te/

mau 'gal gyi bu ston pa'i mthu dang / rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis nub phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i bye ma snyed 'das pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'od zer gyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya bar sangs rgyas 'od kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs pa'i zhing khams su son par gyur nas nyan pa na/ dper na 'dom gang gi sa na yod pa'i mi gcig gi sgra skad cig shos kyis thos pa bzhin du mau 'gal gyi bus ston pa'i gsung zhing khams der yang gsal bar thos so/ /de'i tshe sangs rgyas 'od kyi rgyal po'i 'khor byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ mau 'gal gyi bu mthong nas/ rang gi ston pa la 'di ci 'dra zhig lags zhus pas/ ston pa des khyed dag 'di la brnyas pa'i sems ma skyed cig 'di ni bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i nyan thos rdzu 'phrul can gyi mchog mau 'gal gyi bu bya ba yin gsungs shing / mau 'gal gyi bu la/ rigs kyi bu khyod la byang sems 'di dag khyad du gsod par 'gyur gyi/ de bas na khyod nyid la bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas byin gyis brlabs pas rdzu 'phrul ston cig gsungs pas/ mau 'gal gyi bus sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal skor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das gling 'di skyil mo krung gcig gis khyab par bgyi'o gsol pas/ de ltar gyis shig gsungs pa bzhin mau 'gal gyi bus nam mkhar shing rta la bdun srid tsam 'phags te/ rin po che'i gling de skyil krung gcig gis khyab par byas/ skyil krung de las mu tig gi rgyan 'phreng dpag tu med pa 'phyang ba de dag las kyang 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phro ba/ 'od zer rnams kyi rtse las pad+ma mang po byung ste/ pad+ma rnams kyi snying po la bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa ci 'dra ba'i gzugs kyi sku mang du bzhugs shing / sangs rgyas kyi gzugs de dag kyang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i gsung dbyangs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs las brtsams te bsngags pa brjod pa dag sprul te/

yang bcom ldan 'das gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di skyil krung gcig gis khyab par bgyi'o/ /zhus te de ltar byas nas/ de bzhin du stong dang po dang / gnyis pa dang / gsum pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams khyab par bgyi'o gsol te/ snga ma bzhin gyis khyab par byas nas/ slar rdzu 'phrul bsdus pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag ngo mtshar skyes te/ rang gi ston pa la/ 'di ci'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir 'ongs pa lags zhus pas/ 'di bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i gsung dbyangs kyi mtha' dpag par 'dod nas 'dir 'ongs so gsungs/ de nas sangs rgyas des mau 'gal gyi bu la rigs kyi bu/ khyod de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung gi tshad dpag 'dod kyi blo ma skyed cig de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi gsung dbyangs kyi tshad ni ma mchis pas/ ji ltar byas kyang khyod kyis de rtogs par mi nus so gsungs/ de nas mau 'gal gyi bus bcom ldan 'das de la phyag dang skor ba byas te/ bdag 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed der 'gro bar 'dod na ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das des/ da khyod 'jig rten gyi khams der song ste rang gi ston pa mthong bar 'dod na/ ston pa la phyag tshol la gsol ba thob cig gsungs pa na/ mau 'gal gyi bus rang gi ston pa la phyag 'tshal te/ mthu chen mnga' ba lha dang mis mchod pa/ /ye shes mtha' yas mtha' yas gsung ldan zhing / /rkang gnyis rnams kyi dam pa dgongs su gsol/ /slar yang zhing der rab tu mchi bar bgyi/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa bya rgod phung po'i ri la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ 'khor dag gis kyang thos te/ kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la/ 'di ltar gsol ba 'debs pa 'di su zhig lags zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'di ni nub phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅga'i klung dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i bye ma snyed 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'od zer gyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba yod pa de nas mau 'gal gyi bu 'dir 'ong bar 'dod nas gsol ba 'debs pa'o gsungs/

de nas kun dga' bo sogs bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor rnams 'jig rten gyi khams de dang / de na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa dang / mau 'gal gyi bu mthong bar 'dod pa na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi smin mtshams nas 'od zer bkye ste 'jig rten gyi khams 'od zer gyi rgyal mtshan de snang bar gyur nas/ zhing de'i sangs rgyas 'khor bcas mau 'gal rnams mthong bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mau 'gal gyi bu la/ khyod 'od zer gyi dkyil 'khor 'di'i rjes su 'brangs te shog shig gsungs pa bzhin/ des kyang 'ongs pa na/ skad cig la bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du son par gyur to/ /gzhan yang 'dis rdzu 'phrul mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ sngon gyi dus bcom ldan 'das mtsho ma dros par sngon gyi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan par bzhed pa'i tshe/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' gnyis kyis mtsho ma dros pa'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma gser dang / sdong po rin po che dang / ge sar rdo rje las byas pa/ pad+ma stong phrag du mas bskor ba zhig sprul pa na/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa pad+ma de dag la 'khod de bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe shā ri'i bu bya rgod phung po'i ri la snam sbyar drub zhing gnas pa na/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis mau 'gal gyi bu la/ khyod song la rab byung zla bo khrid la shog gsungs pas/ des bya rgod phung po'i ri la shā ri'i bu gnas pa'i mdun du song ste/ shā ri'i bu bcom ldan 'das mtsho ma dros par sngon gyi las kyi rgyu ba lung ston par bzhed nas/ khyod kyang bos shig gsungs pas/ 'dongs smras pas/ shā ri'i bu na re/ re zhig snam sbyar drub bo/ /de nas phyis 'gro zer ba na/ mau 'gal gyi bus/ 'o na grogs bya'o smras te/ sor mo lnga car gyis drub par brtsams pa na/ shā ri'i bus de ltar na drub zin du zad mod zer bas/ mau 'gal gyi bus/ khyod mi 'gro na rdzu 'phrul gyis bskur bar bya'o smras pas/

shā ri'i bus ske rags rgya cang phrol nas/ khyod bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul can rnams kyi mchog tu bstan na/ re zhig 'di khyer zhig phyis nas kho bo khyer zhig gsungs nas ske rags rang la btags nas gtad pas/ mau 'gal gyi bus drangs pa na/ shā ri'i bus bsam pa/ 'di rdzu 'phrul che bas 'khyer bar nus snyam nas bya rgod phung po'i ri la btags pas/ mau 'gal gyi bus de yang drangs pas/ bya rgod phung po'i ri yang 'gul lo/ /yang shā ri'i bus bsam pa/ 'dis bya rgod phung po'i ri yang 'khyer bar nus kyi/ ri rab la 'dog go snyam nas de la btags pas/ de yang drangs pa na/ ri rab kyang 'gul/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' yang g.yos/ mtsho ma dros pa yang 'khrugs/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor gnas brtan pad+ma'i snying po la gnas pa rnams kyang ldog par gyur pa na/ gnas brtan rnams kyis/ klu'i rgyal po 'di dag g.yo ba ci lags zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ klu'i rgyal po gnyis g.yos pa ma yin gyi/ 'on kyang nyan thos chen po gnyis kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul lo gsungs/ de nas shā ri'i bus bsam pa/ 'dis ri rab kyang 'khyer bar 'gyur gyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyi pad+ma la gdags snyam nas de la btags pas 'gul bar ma nus so/ /de nas shā ri'i bu la khyod kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rtses zin pa byas zin gyi/ da ni 'dong ngo smras te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du song nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis so so'i sngon gyi rgyu ba dag bka' stsal to/ /de bas na mau 'gal gyi bu chen po ni bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos rdzu 'phrul can rnams kyi nang nas mchog dang / rab dang / phul du byung ba yin zhing ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar gyi tshogs kyang mdo sde dag las rgyas par 'byung yang 'dir ni mtshon pa tsam mo/ /de'i rjes su gnod sbyin chen po'i gsung las/ gu ru pad+ma'i dus su zhi ba 'tsho dang bstun/

/mkhas pa shrī singha'i ming tu btags/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar/ bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa 'dis sngon gyi dus su mkhas pa shrī singhar sku'i bkod pa bstan nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ ston pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan nas lo brgya phrag brgyad ma lon tsam gyi skabs su byon nas/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma ka ra dang / bi ma la mi tra/ dz+nyā na pu tra dang / bai ro tsa na sogs paṇ+ḍi ta dang / lo tsā ba 'jig rten gyi mig tu gyur pa mang po dag gi thugs kyi bum bzang rdzogs pa chen po rgyu 'bras la bzla ba'i man ngag sogs dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis yongs su bkang ste/ gang gi rgyun bzang yongs su ma nyams pas 'phags yul bho ṭa'i ljongs dang bcas pa'i skal ba bzang po'i gdul bya rnams kyi blo gros kyi yol gor legs par 'khyil ba'i cha shas da lta'i bar du yang legs par spyad du yod pa'i rtag par dge ba'i 'phrin las can paṇa grub chen po shrī singha ste/ bod skad na dpal seng ge zhes snyan par grags pa 'di nyid ni/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i rgyud thal 'gyur du grags pa las/ nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /nub phyogs u rgyan dag gi yul/ /dha na ko sha'i lha lcam la/ /pha med bu ste badz+ra he/ /'dis ni dam pa'i bstan pa 'dzin/ /zhes lung bstan pa ltar/ ston pa 'das nas lo sum brgya dang drug cu tsam gyi tshe rgyal po su pa rā dza dang btsun mo 'od ldan ma'i sras gzhon nu ma zhig la lhas dbang bskur ba las/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sprul pa lha'i bu kun dga' snying po nyid gzhon nu ma de'i lhums su zhugs pa rtsib ma'i go bar nas 'khrungs pa na/ lha dang mkha' 'gros bstod pas dga' rab rdo rjer grags pa/ sde snod dang rdzogs pa chen po 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi thugs la mnga' zhing rdo rje sems dpa'i gnang ba thob nas mkha' 'gro ma'i dbang mo gnyis dang bcas pas rdzogs pa chen po glegs bam du 'god par mdzad pa po de'i slob mar gyur pa ji skad du/

de yi rjes 'dzin nub kyi phyogs/ /bram ze'i phru gu skal ldan pa/ /mañju shrī pa ti zhes/ /lo ni bdun cu rtsa lngar 'dzin/ /zhes lung bstan pa bzhin bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs shing / rig gnas lnga la mkhas pa/ rdo rje rnon pos lung bstan ltar dga' rab rdo rje'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi rdzogs par gsol te de nyid dang rtogs pa mnyam pa rdzogs chen 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi sems sde klong sde man ngag gi sde gsum du bsdus/ gnad zab snying thig gi skor la/ bshad rgyud dang rnal 'byor rgyud gnyis su phye nas/ snga ma gter du sbas/ phyi ma la mchan btab ste gsal bar mdzad pa po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen du grags pa de'i thugs sras kyi gtso bo yang / ji skad du/ de yi rjes su dpal ldan pa/ /so sha gling zhes bya ba ru/ /khyim bdag rigs skyes shrī singha/ /zhes bya ba yis 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zhes lung bstan gyi bdud rtsi brnyes pa zhig yin te/ de yang slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen rdo rje gdan gyi dur khrod so so'i gling na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rgya nag gi yul du khyim bdag gcig la bu zhig skyes pa chung ngu nas rig gnas la mkhas par gyur te gnas pa las/ re zhig na spyan ras gzigs kyis/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi drung du song zhig par lung bstan/ des kyang zab mo'i don myur du rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ gsang sngags mtha' dag la legs par sbyangs shing rab tu byung ba na/ slar yang thugs rje chen pos bskul te/ tshe'i rig 'dzin dang rdzu 'phrul bsgrubs nas song bas/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang mjal te lo nyer lnga bsten nas/ slob dpon dang rtogs pa khyad par med par gyur/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen 'das pa'i 'og tu paṇa chen 'dis man ngag gi dpe phyung nas thig le'i skor la phyi skor/ nang skor/ gsang skor/ gsang ba bla na med pa'i skor te bzhir phye nas snga ma gsum gter du sbas/

phyi ma ni nyid kyi thugs la gab pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa las/ slar mkha' 'gros lung bstan te gter du sba bar mdzad nas sil sbyin gyi dur khrod du bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe rgya gar nub phyogs su khyim bdag gi bu rab tu byung ba bi ma la mi tra dang / shar phyogs su gdol pa'i rigs las rab tu byung ba dz+nyā na sū tra zhes bya ba mkhas pa mthar phyin par gyur pa gnyis rdo rje gdan na paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya'i gtso bor gyur cing gnas pa las/ lan cig skyo sangs la byon pa'i sar nam mkhar rdo rje sems dpa' byon te/ khyod gnyis skye ba lnga brgyar paṇ+ḍi tar gyur nas chos spyad kyang ci yang ma thob kyi tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya bar 'dod na/ rgya nag byang chub shing drung gi lha khang du song zhig par bskul ba na/ bi ma la brtson 'grus che bas de ma thag song ste/ rna rgyud dang phyi nang gsang gsum gyi man ngag mnyan nas tshims te/ rgya gar du log pa na dz+nyā na sū tra dang mjal bas lung bstan dran te sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa de da lta bzhugs sam dris pas bzhugs zer bas/ de ma thag byon pas/ shrī singha'i byin rlabs kyis nyin gcig la zla ba dgu'i lam bgrod de slebs pa na/ bud med mdzes ma chu'i bum pa khur ba zhig gis bkra shis khri sgor song zhig pa'i lung bstan/ der phyin pa na mkha' 'gros dur khrod sil sbyin du song zhig par lung bstan de song ba na/ shrī singha thod pa'i khang brtsegs kyi nang nas khyab 'jug gi stan las bzhengs te/ phyag gi sor mo gsum gyen la 'phyar ba na/ lo gsum na gnang bar go ste/ de'i bar bla ma'i khol po mtha' dag byas te/ de nas lo dgu'i ring la rna rgyud dang phyi nang gsang gsum gnang ste/ 'di la dpe zhig yod thang snyam pa na dpe rnams byung ste gnang / de dag gis thugs tshims nas 'gro bar chas pa na/ tshim mam gsungs pas/ tshims lags zhus pas/ gtad sa med gsungs pa na/

gdams pa khyad par can yod par shes nas slar yang gsol ba btab pas/ spros bcas kyi dbang rdzogs par bskur nas lo gsum gyi ring la gsang ba bla med kyi gdams pa ma lus pa stsal te/ 'di rnams kyi glegs bam ni dus la babs pa'i tshe khyod nyid la gnang bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan/ gdams ngag zab mo thob pas/ da ni nyams su len bzhin du bla ma'i zhabs tog bya'o snyam pa na/ spros med kyi dbang bskur te/ lo gcig tu 'khor 'das ru shan 'byed pa'i spyod pa thar phyin/ shin tu spros med kyi dbang bskur bas nges shes khyad par can skyes/ rab tu spros med kyi dbang rdzogs pa na brtan pa thob/ lo bcu drug tu bla ma'i mdzad spyod lta zhing nyams su blangs/ de'i tshe shrī singha nyid brtul zhugs rlung 'dzin gyi spyod pa dang / khro bo dang he ru ka'i cha byad kyis dur khrod nyul ba dang / 'byung bzhi'i rten 'brel sogs ma nges pa'i spyod pa mdzad do/ /de nas rgyal po dpal byin gyis spyan drangs nas/ seng ge dkar mo yan lag drug ldan la chibs te gshegs/ zhag bdun na sa g.yo ba dang / sgra dang 'od byung ste mya ngan las 'das par shes nas/ gsol ba btab pas/ zhal chems gzer bu bdun pa dz+nyā na sū tra'i phyag tu babs te/ gsang ba'i man ngag rnams bkra shis khri sgo'i ka ba'i khong nas longs la dur khrod ba sing gi nags la song zhig par lung bstan thob ste/ glegs bam rnams phyung ste rdo rje gdan gyi shar phyogs thag ring po'i dur khrod ba sing bya bar byon to/ /de nas slar bi ma la mi tra la zab pa'i gdams pa gsang ba snying thig gi skor sogs yongs su rdzogs pa stsal to/ /de lta bu'i paṇa chen shrī singhar grags pa des ni slob dpon pad+ma la rdzogs chen sogs gsang sngags zab mo'i gdams pa mang du stsal pa yin te/ de yang slob dpon chen po pad+mas rig 'dzin chen po shrī singha la/ e ma ho gu ru chen po lags/

sangs rgyas kyi don gang lags/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtshams gang lags/ sems dang rig pa'i so mtshams gang lags/ de'i don gang zag gcig gi rgyud du 'gel na ji ltar lags zhus pas/ shrī singha'i zhal nas/ e ma ho/ sangs rgyas zhes bya ba ni ma rig pa sangs nas ye shes mtha' rgyas pa la zer ba yin no/ /de rang gi rgyud la 'gel bar 'dod na/ rang gi sems nyid la bltas pas/ sems ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub/ stong pa/ gsal ba/ rnam rtog ci shar ba rang snang yin par rig cing rtogs na sems sangs rgyas su ngo 'phrod pa yin no/ /'khor ba zhes bya ba ni/ las ngan pa'i rjes su 'brang nas rigs drug gcig nas gcig tu 'khor ba yin/ mya ngan las 'das pa ni/ sems kyi rang bzhin rang ngo shes pas 'khor ba'i gdos thag chod pa'o/ /de rgyud la 'gel bar 'dod na/ rang gi sems 'di gzhi la dngos po'i skyon gyis ma gos par skye med du mthong / 'khor 'das gnas dag pa la mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /ma rig pa zhes bya ba sems kyi don ma shes pa'o/ /rig pa zhes bya ba rang byung gi ye shes rig pa'o/ /de rang gi rgyud la 'gel ba'i dus na/ sems la gtad de sems btsal zhing / bltas pas blta ru ma rnyed de de ka'i ngang la gsal le/ lhan ne/ lhang nge ba de la bltas pas/ de mthong kho na ma rig pa rang sar dag pa'i gnad ces bya'o/ /sems zhes bya ba ni mngon par 'du byed cing dran pa/ sems nyid ces bya ba ni/ dran pa med cing yid la mi byed pa'o/ /de rang gi rgyud la 'gel ba'i dus su sems rtog pas mi 'gyur ba gcig la ma bcos pa rang bzhin du bzhag pas gang yang yid la mi byed par lhan ne/ lhang nge ba de la sems nyid rang sar dag pa'i gnad ces bya ba'o zhes gsungs shing / de bzhin du gzhan yang kun gzhi'i sa mtshams pha rol tshur rol/ gti mug dang ye shes/ sdug bsngal ba dang bde ba'i sa mtshams dang / de dag rgyud la 'gel lugs sogs dri ba'i rigs rab tu mang po zhig zhus te/

rig 'dzin chen pos so so'i don dang / de nyams su len tshul sogs snga ma ltar zhib cing mtha' chod la 'dril ba re re stsal te/ slob dpon chen po pad+mas kyang / de lta bu'i gnad tig gi zhal gdams de yi ger bkod de gter du sba bar mdzad pa yin te/ de lta bu'i yi ge de nyid rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis gter nas spyan drangs pa las/ e ma ho/ bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /kun bzang thugs las sprul pa'i sku/ /shrī singha'i spyan sngar phyin/ /gus pas gsol 'debs smon lam btab/ /ngo sprod gnad tig zhal gdams zhus/ /phyi rab don du yi ger bkod/ /bse sgrom smug po'i nang du sbas/ /phyis rabs las can pad+ma'i sras/ /drag po gru gsum sme ba can/ /las can de dang 'phrad par shog /ces 'byung ba yin pas so/ /gzhan yang gu ru pad+mas lha srin sde brgyad bran du 'khol ba sogs rmad du byung ba'i mthu rtsal dag kyang / shrī singhas rdzogs chen gyi gdams pa zab mo 'di stsal te nyams su bstar ba las byung ba yin par snang ste/ sngon shrī singha la/ slob dpon chen pos rdzogs chen gsan pa'i tshe/ yul snang la rig pa'i brda sprod kyi gdams pa stsal ba'i dus su shrī singhas/ nyams kyi snang ba gzhi la chog shes su bzung ba ni byas pa'i blta ba yin no/ /snang ba dang stong pa dbyer med du 'jug snyam na/ snang ba 'di la ma chags pa zhig dgos te khyod la 'dug gam/ sangs rgyas dang sems can dbyer med snyam na/ sems can la bkur bsti sangs rgyas dang mnyam pa byed dgos te nus sam/ mi dge ba bcu spyad kyang 'bras bu mi 'ongs snyam na/ bdag la gzhan gyis gsod pa/ 'tshang tshig la sogs byed pa byung dus bzod dgos te bzod dam/ dge ba bcu spyad kyang 'bras bu mi 'ongs snyam na/ bdag la srog skyobs pa la sogs pa phan pa byed pa la dga' bar mi 'dzin pa gcig dgos te/ 'dug gam gsungs/

de nas slob dpon pad+mas don de dag bsgoms pas/ gsal nyams/ stong nyams/ bde nyams sogs nyams khyad par can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs te/ bdag gis go ba bzhin sems can kun gyis go na snyam nas bla ma la zhus pas/ shrī singhas/ rdzogs chen la lhun grub/ bsam mi khyab/ bde chen gyi dus dang gsum yod pa'i/ pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi nyams 'di lhun grub kyi dus yin/ 'di las phyi ma 'byung / nyams la ma zhen par rgya skyed gsungs pa la/ pad+mas bdag gis blo ji ltar bskyed zhus pas/ nam mkha' lta bur mtha' dbus med par ngo sprad de/ pad+mas kyang dben par bsgoms pas nyams khyad par can sngar bas kyang gong 'phel du gyur pa na/ slar yang bogs 'don mang du gsungs pa'i mthar/ da khyod dang nga mi 'phrad do gsungs pa la/ pad+mas da dung mjal gdams pa zhu gsol bas/ da dung mjal na dga' la/ ma mjal na mi dga' 'am gsungs pa na/ de ltar lags zhus pas/ mi dga' skyes na re ba yod pa yin/ dga' ba yod na dogs pa yod pa yin pas/ de ltar med par gyis shig par bsgos te/ nga la ye ma blta bar songs shig gsungs pa bzhin/ pad+mas u rgyan gyi yul du bsgom du byon te gnas pa na re zhig na shrī singha byon te/ rigs kyi bu rtogs pa phul cig gsungs pa na/ rtogs pa 'bul rgyu skra rtse tsam yang ma mchis tshul zhus pa na/ rtogs pa de dang ma bral ba gang dgar song zhig spyod pa sde snod ltar gyis/ sgom pa sngags ltar gyis/ lta ba rdzogs chen ltar gyis/ sems gyi don nor bu ltar gyis/ skal ldan gyi slob ma skyongs/ bla ma mkha' 'gro rtag tu mchod cig lha srin sde brgyad bran bzhin 'khol ba zhig 'byung ngo gsungs nas gshegs so/ /de nas pad+mas chos thams cad sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bu sems nyid skye shi med par rtogs/ sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs zhal mthong / lha srin sde brgyad bran bzhin bkol/ 'gro don rgya gar yul du mdzad/

gzhan yang bod du rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dgongs pa'i don yang dpyis phyin par bsgrubs par mdzad do/ /des na bod kha ba can pa la bka' drin mchog tu che ba slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis bod yul gyi lha srin gdug pa can mtha' dag dam la btags/ rgyal blon 'bangs dang bcas pa'i skal ldan mang po sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi sgo nas smin cing grol ba'i lam la bkod/ sku gsung thugs kyi gter mang po phyi rabs kyi gdul bya'i don du sba bar mdzad pa sogs mdor na/ bod kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir bde skyid rdzogs ldan gyi dpal bzhin du gyur par mdzad pa de yang / slob dpon chen po shrī singhar grags pa'i mkhas grub chen po de nyid kyi mthu las byung bar snang ba'i phyir na/ chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku ring la kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa sogs kyang / bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa sngags 'chang bla ma 'di nyid kyi bka' drin du shes par bya'o/ /yang paṇa chen de la rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kyi sprul pa lo tsā ba chen po bai ro tsa nas rdzogs pa chen po'i gdams pa yongs su tshang bar gsan nas bod yul 'dir dar rgyas su mdzad pa yin te/ de'i tshul yang chos skyong ba'i mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyis mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan dang / rang nyid kyi sngon gyi bag chags kyi mthus rgya gar na rtsol med kyi theg pa yod par rtogs te/ len par bzhed nas chab 'bangs dag la 'phags yul du 'gro bar spro ba dris pa na/ gzhan ma rnyed par/ pā kor he 'dod kyi bu bai ro tsa na bya ba mkhyen pa yangs shing rdzu 'phrul che ba de dang / gtsang the len+d+ra'i bu legs grub tu grags pa gnyis kyis khas blangs te/ ar+ya pā lo'i gling du gnas sbags pas/ /de'i nub mo bai ro la/ rang rgyud sgrib pa dag pa dang /

mkhas pa nyer gcig gi dgongs pa lon pa/ rnam smin gyi lus 'dag pa/ man ngag gi chos lon pa/ legs grub la bar chad 'byung ba/ rang nyid kyang tsha ba rong du spyugs pa/ slar bod la phan thogs par 'gyur ba sogs mtshon byed rmi ltas ya mtshan can du ma byung bas thugs spro nas phyin pas rgya gar du brtol te gser rnams bskungs/ tshong 'dus sogs mang po'i 'dun sa dag tu 'grims nas/ da lta chos su mkhas/ gdams pa su zab/ nus pa su che sogs dri zhing brtags pas/ slob dpon chen po shrī singha bya ba rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta nyer lnga'i thugs sras/ paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya'i bla mar gyur pa/ yi dam gyi lha 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis zhal gzigs shing / tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa zhig yod pa de ngo mtshar che bar kun mthun par gleng bas/ de gang na bzhugs dris pas/ dha na ko sha'i gnas seng ldeng sil byed kyi tshal/ tsan+da dri zhim gyi nags rin chen za ma tog spungs pa'i khab bya bar bzhugs zer nas btsal bas/ rgyal po zhig gis gnas de 'di yin te/ 'di na khang brtsegs dgu las mtho ba na dga' rab rdo rje dgongs rgyud rnam par dag pa'i mkhas pa bcu drug dang bcas te smra bsam tshig las 'das par bzhugs/ tshig la chags pa'i mkhas pa bdun gnyis pa na bzhugs/ gsum pa na bi ma la la sogs bzhugs shing / de na bram ze ma zhig yod pas zhib par de la dris shig zer/ de la dris pas rgan mo des pra se nas mi rtogs pa'i thabs byas te/ man ngag bod du 'khyer ba'i ltas su paṇa chen brgyad kyi mtshan ltas log pa dag bshad de/ man ngag lon par 'gyur bar lung bstan/ bram ze mo chu lon ma la 'phrin srings shig zer ba bzhin/ 'phrin lan grangs du ma bsrings kyang ma 'phrod nas/ lan gcig bai ros sgyu ma'i sbyor sngags kyis sa dang bum pa sbyar bas/ 'khur ma nus te/ khyod kyang rdzu 'phrul che ste/ kho mo la yang 'di ltar ro zer/

rang gi byang khog phye nas rdor dbyings lha so bdun bkra lam me bstan/ de nas bram ze mos 'phrin byas te mjal ba na gser dpag med phul/ rtsol med kyi theg pa ston par zhus pas/ do nub mtshan ma brtag go gsungs/ nangs par mtshan ma bzang / bod la phan che nges/ bka' rgyas pa nas 'byung ba'i lung bstan ltar na dus la yang bab pas man ngag sbyin no/ /'on kyang sbyin thabs ma legs na/ rang re gsum ka'i srog la nyen pa 'ongs/ 'di rang na yang rang dgar spyad du med/ rgyal pos tshor na man ngag rang yang med par byed pas/ khyed gnyis chos gzhan nyan pa ltar gyis gsungs pa bzhin byas te/ de nas pra se nas mi mthong ba'i thabs byas te/ mtshan mo res nags tshal gyi dbus/ res ri bo'i rtse/ res rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha'i dbyings/ res rgya mtsho'i nang sogs nges med du bshad de/ sems sde bco brgyad po tshang bar stsal bas/ legs grub tshim ste bod du log pas lam du 'das/ bai ro tsa nas slar yang nan gyis zhus pas/ shrī singhas bai ro tsa na la rgyud sde drug cu/ man ngag gi gnad/ khyad par du 'bras bu rang chas su ston pa rgya mtsho'i klong bstan pas/ bai ro nyid rtogs pa mthar phyin yang / sgro 'dogs gcad pa'i phyir slar yang zhus pas/ gdams pa lhag med par dbu bsnyung bzhes te/ gdams pa bca' lugs gsum dang / sbyin lugs bzhi la sogs pa gsungs nas/ bod kyi rgyal po la ston cig par rjes su gnang zhing / dga' rab rdo rje dang yang mjal bar lung bstan pa bzhin mjal/ de nas shrī singhas bai ro tsa na la/ rang sems ye shes rdo rje 'di/ /yod med dbus su'ang mi dmigs shing / /rtag chad mtha' la mi gnas pa/ /sgro skur med pa'i chos nyid la/ /blang dor med par blo bzhag ste/ /'di zhes sgom pa'i 'du shes bral/ /de ni dgongs pa'i mthar thug go /zhes sogs gnad kyi zhal chems thugs kyi mdzod brtol te/ rlung gis kyang thos su mi rung ba byas nas gdams te slob dpon 'od du yal/

bai ros bod du byon nas mnga' bdag rgyal po la yang yongs su rdzogs par stsal cing / gzhan yang rgyal po g.yu sgra snying po sogs mang po la gdams te/ de nyid nas brgyud pa'i rdzogs chen gyi man ngag zab mo da lta'i bar du rgyun ma chad par bzhugs pa 'di yin la/ rgyu mtshan des na deng sang gsang sngags rnying ma'i zhal 'dzin rnams dam chos rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag khyad par can gyi dga' ston la ci rigs par spyad du yod pa 'di yang bdag cag gi yongs su 'dzin pa chen po 'di nyid kyis bka' drin las byung ba nyid du yang dag par rtogs par bya'o/ /yang dam pa 'dis phyag rdor gyi sprul pa blon po mgar ba stong btsan du sku'i bkod pa bstan pa'i tshul ni/ gnod sbyin chen po'i gsung las/ gnam ri srong btsan/ de la gces pa mgar ba'i ming / /zhes 'byung ba ltar/ bod khams kyi skye bu yongs kyi rtsa lag dam par gyur zhing / thugs rje'i dbang phyug phyag na pad+mo'i rnam par sprul pa gangs ri can gyi sa chos bzhin du skyong ba'i rgyal po chen po srong btsan sgam po zhes yongs su grags pa de'i kha lo bsgyur ba rnams kyi gtso bo zhig tu sku'i snang brnyan shar nas gzhal bar dka' ba'i mthu dang rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam rol mtha' yas pas 'gro ba dag gi don dpag tu med pa mdzad pa'i tshul ni 'di ltar thos te/ spyir chos rgyal de la bka'i blon po phyi nang gsang gsum gyis bsdus pa brgya phrag gsum yod pa las/ ming che bar grags pa bcu drug ste/ khyung po spun bzung btsan/ yar stod pa lam khri bde lhag khri btsan/ 'phan yul ba mu khri rdo rje rnam btsan/ mjed pa mthing gi byang chub mchog btsan/ 'phyong rgyas pa thar pa klu'i dpal btsan/ yar lung pa rong po 'phrul gyi lde btsan te phyi blon btsan po drug 'phrul gyi rna chen rigs bzang / zhang po rgyal gyi khrom bzang / cog ro rig pa'i kong bzang /

lhar gzigs shog po ston bzang / bka'i rnyag ston 'phel bzang / sbas lung dpal gyi legs bzang ste nang blon bzang po drug thon mi sam+bho ṭa/ mgar stong btsan yul bzung / 'bri bse ru gung ston/ nyan khri bzang ste bka' 'phrul gyi blon po bzhi rnams so/ /de dag las thon mi dang mgar gnyis ni gtso bo lta bu yin te/ snga mas ni 'phags yul du byon nas sgra la sogs pa phyi nang gi rig gnas mang du lob/ bod na yi ge med pa la yi ge 'chos te/ rgyal po sogs la legs par bslabs/ chos mang du bsgyur pas bod du lo tsā ba la snga zhing / 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin par grags so/ /mgar ba stong btsan du grags pa'i blon po chen po 'dis ni/ bal yul nas rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i lha lcam rje btsun khro gnyer can gyi sprul pa bal mo bza' khri btsun gdan 'dren par mdzad cing / de dang mnyam du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje/ byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo sogs spyan drangs te/ slar yang rgya nag gi yul nas 'phags ma sgrol ma/ mtshan gzhan rgya mo bza' kong jor 'bod pa de nyid/ ngo mtshar ba'i rig pa'i 'phrul thabs lnga phrag gcig tu gnyis kyis lhag pa dag ston par mdzad pa'i sgo nas rgyal po'i dgongs bzhed dang mthun par gdan drangs/ de dang dus gcig par ston pa dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad du/ sbyin bdag lha dbang brgya byin gyis mdzad de/ bi shwa kārmas bskrun pa la/ ston pa nyid kyis byin rlabs kyi me tog 'thor bar mdzad pa jo bo shākya mu ner grags pa 'di nyid bod khams kyi skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi mgron du spyan 'dren par mdzad/ de ltar 'phags ma gnyis las/ bal bza' khri btsun gyis/ bod khams 'di srin mo gan rkyal du gnas pa lta bur yod pa'i srin mo'i snying gi khrag gi tshul du chags pa lha sa'i 'o thang gi mtsho bsubs te/
