de'i ngang nyid nas mgon med pa'i sems can nyam thag pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba dag tshad med pa'i byams pa dang / thugs rje chen pos nye bar skyong ba sa la gnas pa'i rgyal ba'i sras po mchog gi ngang tshul bzung ba zhig ni sku na phra mo'i dus nyid nas yod par mngon no/ /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ re re'ang legs par byas pa brgya phrag gis/ /nye bar bskrun pa'i mtshan dpes mdzes sku ni/ /rab dkar kha ba'i dum 'khrigs sa 'dzin la/ /zla dbang zhun mas lan brgyar byugs pa snyam/ /mdzes sdug zhal dkyil chu skyes dpal la 'gran/ /'jam mnyen phyag zhabs pad+ma'i 'dab mar 'gong / /rnam bkra'i spyan zung ut+pal 'gog pa 'dis/ /don grub skyengs nas nges 'byung yin gyi dogs/ /gang gsung chos kyi zer 'bum gzugs sku'i dkyil/ /mngal gyi shar ri'i phrag nas thon tsam gyis/ /kun tu 'phro 'di stobs bcu'i rta ljang rtser/ /spangs rtogs zhabs zung bkod pa'i mtshan mar nges/ /mnal gyi zol tshe'ang pha rol bya byed sogs/ /bskal don sna tshogs ye shes spyan sngar gsal/ /'bad med ting 'dzin ngang du rtag rol ba/ /bsam yas yon tan nor gyi dbang phyug 'dra/ /e ma thar 'dod dad pa'i nor can dag /mgon 'di'i yon tan kun lta gzhon nu yi/ /mdzad pa cha shas tsam gyis gtan gyi skyabs/ /bslu med nyid du nges pa rnyed min nam/ /de nas yon tan thams cad kyi phyi mo 'bri klog la sogs pa ni gzigs pa tsam gyis phyin ci ma log par thogs med du mkhyen cing / rim gyis gtso bor yab rje chos kyi rgyal po nyid kyi drung dang / rje 'di sku mched gsum gyi gnas kyi slob dpon tshul du yab rje nyid kyis bsko bar mdzad pa/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i ban gtsang dbu byed chen mo bsod nams lha dbang las/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos yang phur rnam gnyis/ bde kye gsang gsum/ yo ga bya spyod rdo rje chos skyong rnams dang bcas pa'i dbang byin rlabs/

rjes gnang / gtor bzlog sogs kyi chog bsgrigs/ dbyangs rol/ gar 'chams/ bris thig la sogs pa phyag len phra mo tshun chad kun la byang chub par mdzad cing / khyad par sku'i skye ba mang por goms pa lhur mdzad pa'i bag chags bzang po sad pas/ rgya dpe dang sngags klog nyid gzhan klog pa las chod che zhing ring thung dang gcod mtshams dod la/ dag gsal snyan pa'i gsung gis gzhan gyi rna ba bdud rtsir khol nus pa zhig yin la/ yi ge'i rigs kyang bod yig mi the ba'i 'phags yul gyi yig rigs du ma dang / hor yig gsar pa la sogs pa spyan ras kyi yul du lhung ba tsam gyis phyin ci ma log par dgongs nas/ 'bri ba dang klog tshul sogs gang la yang thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab phul du byung ba zhig yin te/ nyid kyi thugs dam rten yi dam chos skyong gi bris thang 'ga' zhig dang / rigs sras dam pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug mtshan can dang / nyid kyi zhabs 'bring pa chen po dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rab 'byams smra ba pu ṇ+ya rasmi ba dang / kho bo cag sogs kyis rje 'di'i bris sku bzhengs pa kha cig la rgyab gzungs su lañca/ wartu sogs phyag bris mdzad pa rnams kyang gzhan gyis lo brgyar 'bad nas sbyangs pa las brda dag cing yig gzugs legs par snang ba 'di dag gis mtshon nus so/ /de ltar dgung lo lnga bzhes tshun chad du yab yum gnyis dang 'bral med du bzhugs te/ yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas grags pa'i mtshan can gang gi drung du/ grub chen dze ta ri dgra las rnam rgyal gyis legs par bkral ba/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la bka' babs pa'i mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zab mo dang / bcom ldan 'das rdo rje phur pa'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du smin byed kyi dbang sogs zab chos 'ga' zhig gsan te/ rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi sgo thog mar phye ba'i bka' drin nod par mdzad/

gzhan yang de dus yab rje chos kyi rgyal pos ngor e wam̐ chos ldan nas/ rgyal ba'i lung bstan gyi bdud rtsi brnyes shing / dpal sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gdan seng ge'i khri la zhabs zung dbang gi rgyal po mngon par rtsen pa/ mkhyen rab dang thugs rje'i dbang phyug chos kyi rje nam mkha' dpal bzang pa spyan drangs te/ zab mo sngags kyi theg pa gtso bor gyur pa'i chos tshul mtha' yas pa zhig gsan par mdzad pa'i tshe/ dam pa 'dis rje btsun yab dang / rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum sogs dang lhan cig tu tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang / kun rig sa lugs kyi dbang sbyong rgyud nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi nang nas dkyil 'khor lnga tsam zhig gi dbang dang / de'i yig skor dkyil 'khor/ phyi ma bcu gcig gi bdag mdun sgrub tshul/ dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang bskur ba'i phyag len/ de'i ston gyi zur 'debs rnams 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i lung dang bcas pa gsan cing / gzhan yang lung gi skor la/ rje btsun chen pos/ snying po don gyi kyai rdor ni/ /bir+wa'i rjes 'brangs ḍom+bhi'i skor/ /yan lag med rjes pad+ma'i skor/ /dam tshig rdo rje nag po'i skor/ /gtso che'i chos sna sum cu dgu/ /lam skor dgu ni khyad par ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rje btsun sa skya pa la kyai rdo rje'i chos skor gzhung 'grel la brten pa gsum dang / man ngag lugs te bka' bab bzhi bzhugs pa'i chos sna gtso che ba 'phags yul gyi gzhung 'grel bcu phrag gsum dang dgu tsam zhig yod pa rnams la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu dgur grags pa rnams kyi lung / lce sgom kha skyong grags pas mdzad pa'i gtam rgyud rin spungs dang / de'i 'grel pa/ gzhan yang dpe chos rin spungs/ man ngag rin spungs te rin spungs skor gsum gyi lung / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi lung rnams gsan no/

/de nas dgung lo lngar phebs pa 'phar ba zhes pa lcags mo glang gi lo sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis bzhengs pa'i lha khang rtse'i lam 'bras brgyud pa shin tu ngo mtshar zhing byin rlabs kyi gzi byin 'bar ba dag bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid mjal bar phebs pa'i tshe/ sku 'khor ba rnams la/ ngas khyed rang dag la rten bshad byed kyi/ khyed kyi pang par nga theg cig gsungs pa na/ ji ltar bka' stsal pa bzhin rje 'di'i sku gzhon nu'i phyag phyi rgyun zhu ba/ rjes su nyid kyi gcen 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug gi mgron gnyer lnga 'dzom du bod pas sku btegs nas/ da rten bshad mdzad par zhu zhus pas/ bla ma brgyud pa'i sku brnyan so so phyag mdzub kyi brda' sbyor mdzad nas/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ bi rū pa zhes sogs sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i sku brnyan gyi bar re re nas so so'i mtshan rnams thol byung du snyan pa'i gsung gis 'dom par mdzad pa na/ der yod thams cad ngo mtshar zhing ha las te/ rmad byung gi gtam de gcig nas gnyis su brgyud de mang po'i rna bar son pa na/ sku na phra mo 'di lta bu la gsung ngag bla ma brgyud pa thams cad rang byung du ngo 'phrod cing thogs med du bka' stsal pa 'di bzhin sngon nas thugs la rang 'khrungs su yod pa ma gtogs/ sngar ni gtsug lag khang der phebs myong ba yang med/ des na nges par sa skya pa rang gi bla ma gong ma gcig gam/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan bi rū pa'i rnam par sprul pa yin nges/ yang na ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i zlos gar las gzhan gyi go skabs ga la mchis zhes dpyod ldan kun mgrin pa gcig car du 'gul ba zhig byung / zhes kyang thos la/ yang de dag gi sngon rol tsam zhig la chos rje sa paṇa gyi rnam thar thang ka rnying ma zhig la yang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ga' zhig zhabs drung du lhags pa na/

nged kyis sa paṇa gyi rnam thar bshad kyi nyon cig gsungs/ chos rgyal ma zhal 'don gnang ba dang bstun/ rnam thar bris thang la phyag mdzub gtad nas ngos 'dzin brda' sbyor ma 'khrugs pa gnang byung ba na/ bshes gnyen de dag kun ha las par gyur te/ dus phyis kyang mang po 'dus pa'i dbus su ngo mtshar ba'i gtam de yang yang sgrog par byed pa las brgyud de thos so/ /de ltar sku'i lang tsho shin tu gzhon nur gyur kyang / gnyis med thugs kyi gsang ba ni shin tu zab cing sgam pa dang / zhi zhing dul ba lugs zung gi bya ba kun la na tshod rgan po dag las mkhas par snang yang / 'phral gyi mdzad spyod dang / gsung dbyangs zab mo'i gsang ba mi stob cing / dal bu'i ngang gis stsol ba sogs nar phyin pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa kho na sku nyams su bstar bas/ dpyod ldan kun mgrin gcig pas skyes bu dam pa 'di ni 'jig rten gyi a mes chen po zhig go zhes phyogs kun tu grags pas/ mes po'i mtshan gyi dge legs ni mchog dman kun gyi dbyangs gcig pas/ sku chung ngu nyid nas bla dwags su chags skad do/ /yang 'di ltar du yang grags te/ sngon rje 'di sku mched gsum sogs la/ 'jam mgon grub brnyes yongs kyi dpa' bo bsod nams dbang pos yang dben grub pa'i gnas mchog byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong du/ mdo rgyud ma lus pa'i nyams len gyi snying po'i bcud phyung ba gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa zab mo gtso bor gyur pa'i chos tshul mtha' yas pa'i bka' drin stsal pa'i dus su/ rje btsun 'di nyid kyi yab rje rgyal ba'i sras po dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang mi gnyis pa'i thugs mnga' ba grags pa blo gros zhes mtshan gyi dbyar rnga grags pa tsam gyis skal ldan gtsug phud can mang po'i yid la sim pa 'bad med du 'jo nus pa des rang gi gcen grub pa'i dbang phyug pu ṇ+ya in+d+ra'i zhal las/

rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dbang bskur gsan pa'i ston gyi nub mo mnal lam du/ yab rje nyid kyi yum bkra shis dpal gyi bu khrid de nyid zhabs stegs mi 'jigs pa'i khri mthon po zhig la bzhugs pa'i drung du/ yab rje nyid la sogs pa skal ldan gyi slob tshogs mang po 'dus nas 'dug pa la/ rgyal ba bskrun pa'i yum des dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo yun ring du bskor ba'i gsal snang shin tu ngo mtshar ba zhig byung nas/ de'i nangs par rje 'dis yab rje dam pa de nyid kyi zhabs drung ga la ba der phebs ma thag thugs dgyes shing spro ba'i zhal gyi chu skyes ches cher 'dzum zhing tshems kyi ze'u 'bru mchog tu rgod pas ljags kyi yal 'dab bskyod pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi 'di ltar stsal te/ nged la mdang nub rmi lam ya mtshan can 'di bzhin byung bas/ sngags 'chang bde bar gshegs pa de nyid kyai rdo rje dngos dang / nged rang gi yum de bdag med ma dngos yin bya ba'i rtags su 'dug gsungs pa dang / yang khyed nged kyi yum de nyid kyi sku skye yin pa'i lugs yin pas/ des na mdang nub khyod la nged kyis chos zhus so/ /zhes gsungs pa byung 'dug pa 'di lta bu ni 'jigs bral rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa la rdo rje bdag med mas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur cing byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshul dang khyad par cung zad kyang ma mchis pas/ gzhan las rmad du byung ba'i rnam par thar pa yin par dam pa nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyi rnam par thar pa byin rlabs char 'bebs zhes bya ba las 'byung bas na/ rang cag gi rnam 'dren mtshungs med 'di nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum sde'i gtso mo rdo rje bdag med ma'i ngo bor bzhugs kyang / rigs sngags 'chang ba'i rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mchog gi zol 'dzin pa ni/ gdul bya gang la gang 'dul du de dang de'i snang brnyan ston par mdzad pa nyid las gzhan du lta ga la zhig go

/des na dam pa 'di la chung ngu'i dus nas mes po'i mtshan gyi grags snyan gsal ba yang / tshul de las rjes su bsgrags pa yin zhes gtam du byed pa yang yongs su 'khums so/ /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ gang tshe bltams nas ring min zab lam gyi/ /rin chen brgyud pa'i 'phreng ba snyan pa'i gsung / /baiḍūr srad bus brgyus des nye ba yi/ /rim gro pa dag zhal sgo rgyan 'od kyis/ /mang po'i rna ba'i chu gter khol ba las/ /'di ni nges par stobs kyi mgon po sogs/ /'khrul zad gong ma'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'am/ /rdo rje rnon po'i 'phrul las gzhan ci zhig /dpyod ldan 'bum gyi mgrin pa'i chu skyes rgod/ /na tshod phra yang lugs zung bya ba la/ /bsgam po'i thugs dkyil sngon goms yon tan gyi/ /ri dwags mtshan mas mdzes spud mdzad pa'i zer/ /bsil ldan mes po'i zla dbang mtshan gyi rnga/ /ma brdungs na yang chos kyi 'khor lo kun/ /yongs su khyab pa'i dbyangs 'di su mi nyan/ /gtam 'di srid pa gsum na e ma ho/ /de nas bdag cag gi yongs 'dzin bslu med dam pa 'di nyid dgung gi 'jal byed drug tu phebs pa'i dge byed ces pa chu pho stag gi lo gsar du bzhad pa'i tshe/ rje btsun ut+pal sngo ldan nyid gzhan ngor gsum ldan dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba dpal sa skya pa chen po byams pa dpal ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho nyid slar yang kha ba can gyi 'gro ba mtha' dag gi bsod nams kyi mgron du mngon par mtho ba'i ris kyi them skas las nye bar bsus te/ ke la sha'i mdangs ltar rab tu dkar ba'i na bza' dang / bung ba ltar gnag pa'i dbu skyes lcang los mdzes par spud pa sngags 'chang mtshungs med grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa ste nyi zla lta bu'i sku mched zhal rnam pa gnyis legs par mthun pa'i bka' mchid mol te/

bdag cag gi phul du byung ba'i skyabs mgon bslu ba med pa gang gi sku mched rnam pa gsum/ 'jam mgon mched kyi rgyal tshab mchog tu mnga' gsol zhing / dpal sa skya'i chos kyi khrir che 'don gyi bkra shis pa'i me tog 'thor bar bzhed de/ sngon du dbus gtsang mnga' ris dang bcas pa sogs yangs pa'i sa chen por 'khod pa'i sa skya pa'i bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas par sri zhu'i bgyi ba lhur byed cing stobs kyi dbang phyug gi sa skyong ba dang de las cig shos su gyur pa rje rigs dang / dmangs rigs su gyur kyang rang dbang gi bdog pa'i dngos po phun sum tshogs shing / dad pa chen po'i yon gnas su gyur pa dag gi zhabs pad bla nar 'degs pa'i khur chen po bzod pa'i/ snying stobs dang ldan pa mang po dag gi rgyud la legs byas kyi sa bon ma skyes pa gsar du bskrun pa dang / skyes pa gong nas gong du spel ba'i phyir de dag so so ba rnams la 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam thar sprul pa gdung sras rnam pa gsum khri 'don mdzad pa'i dga' ston gyi skabs/ so so nas rang gi 'byor dngos bsam pa dang bstun pa'i skyes kyi me tog ched du dngar ba stobs pa dang / chos kyi bdud rtsi nod pa'i phyir lhags bzhed pa dag yid dang mthun pa gyis shig pa'i bka'i glegs bu so sor stsal cing / bca' sgrigs kyi dril bsgrags te/ lo de nyid kyi bstan pa'i spyi rim dus mdos chen mo rgyal gyi zla bar 'gyangs nas/ zla ba de ka'i nyer drug la 'chams mgon spyan 'dren sogs shin tu zab spros che ba dang bcas dus rim tshugs par mdzad de/ nyer brgyad la 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched gong ma gnyis zhabs 'bring pa'i tshogs mang po dang bcas pas/ shrī rdo rje gdan pa chen po kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi gzigs snang du ji ltar shar ba bzhin phyag len du mdzad pa gur gyi mgon po'i las mkhan lnga/

sgo skyong bzhi/ ru 'dren dang bcas pa'i gar 'chams rgyas par mdzad nas/ nyer dgu la gtor zor 'phen pa dang / gnam stong gi nyin chos skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang ba brgya tshar du grags pa mdzad/ mchu zla ba'i tshes gcig la bstan srung rgya mtshor gtang rag gi mnga' gsol dang / yos lo gsar du tshes pa'i lo gsar gyi dga' ston shin tu zab pa mdzad pa yin zhes thos la/ dus mdos sogs 'di rnams ni gdung brgyud che 'don dang dus mtshungs pa nges pa mi dgos kyang / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi dgongs pas dus mdos sogs khri 'don dang nye bar mdzad pa ni/ gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi zhabs 'degs dang / khyad par sa skya pa'i bstan skyong gi sbyin bdag sde dpon ris mtho dman/ dgon gnas che phran sogs mang pos/ khri ston thog 'bul nod stob mi bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'byor pa rnams dang / gzhan yang skabs der yul phyogs gzhan dag nas 'jam dbyangs bla ma mched gsum gyi zhal gyi dkyil 'khor lta ba dang / gsung gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba'i phyir skye bo skya ser gyi tshogs grangs med pa zhig 'dus pa rnams la mig gang gi ltad mo/ kha gang gi zas zhes pa 'jig rten lugs dang mthun zhing / chos dang mi 'gal ba'i lugs zung gi mig rkyen bla na med pa la dgongs pa yin par sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i deb chen ngo mtshar can las 'byung ba yin la/ de tsam du ma zad tshul 'di la ni dgos pa khyad par can gzhan yang snang ste/ 'jam mgon bla ma sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i rol mo'i bstan bcos las/ gang na thod dang skra gsar dang / /gar dang rol mo'i sgra yod pa/ /de na mya ngan yod min pas/ /des na rol mo bsngags pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i sras btsas pa dang / rgyal rigs su dbang bskur ba la sogs pa'i dga' ston gyi tshe/

glu gar dang rol mo sna tshogs kyi sgra grags par byed pa ni/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel gyi tshogs gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i ched dang / de ltar byas pas tshul de nyid pha rol po gzhan dag gis mthong ba dang thos par 'gyur zhing / de la brten nas de dag la yang dga' spro dang / dang 'dod kyi dad pa skye bas rten 'brel rmad du byung ba dang / dge legs brgyud mar 'phel bar 'gyur ba zhig yin par grags na/ rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gsang ba ngo mtshar gzugs sku'i rnam rol du shar ba 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po dang rnam dbyer ma mchis pa'i skye 'gro'i skyabs mgon bslu med dam pa mched gsum po 'di dag yongs rdzogs kyi bstan pa rin po che'i rgyal srid la dbang bsgyur ba'i chos kyi dbang phyug chen por bkra shis pa'i mnga' gsol gyi tshe/ lta smos kyang ci dgos dgongs pa ste/ dkon mchog mchod phyir 'dus pa dang / /mang po blta phyir 'dus pa dang / /phun sum tshogs pa mthong ba'i phyir/ /mkhas pas rol mo brtsams par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs par yang snang bas na/ sngags 'chang 'jig rten gyi mig tu gyur pa de nyid kyis rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung rgyud khri 'don gyi sngon 'gro'i dga' ston du dus mdos zab spros mdzad pa 'di ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos dang mthun pa'i phyag len du snang ngo / /de nas cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes gnyis nas/ bcu gnyis kyi bar la yul phyogs gzhan nas lhags pa'i khri ston gyi mchod pa'i skyes 'bul mi rnams dang / nye ba'i zhabs 'bring pa ci rigs pa dag dang bcas par gzhi len gyi tshul du rnyed pa dang bkur bsti gya nom pas tshim zhing yid rangs par mdzad/ de nas khri ston gyi dngos gzhi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad pa ste/ de yang gang gi sgra dbyangs rgyang grags kyi sa'i 'khor yug na gnas pa dag gi rna bar thos nus shing /

gang dag gi rna bar lhung ba tsam gyis yid la sim pa 'bad med du 'jo nus pa sogs dbyangs kyi mtshan ma las ming du chags pa dkar po rgyang grags zhes/ gnyis med gsung ba zas gtsang sras kyi chos kyi dung 'khrul pa med pa 'di nyid 'dus pa'i brdar bskul ma thag gdan sa chen po 'di nyid na gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis thog drangs/ gdan sa chen po dang thag ha cang mi ring ba'i dgon gnas rnams nas gtso bor 'dus shing shul ring po bgrod nas 'ongs pa dag kyang ste/ gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun gyi tshogs khri phrag tu longs pa dag chos khrims kyi las byed rnams kyis bslabs pa'i rgan rim bzhin/ 'jam mgon sa paṇ+ḍi ta sogs mkhas grub kyi bla ma gong ma mang pos chos 'khor bskor ba'i rin po che'i khri chen po'i mdun ngos kyi tshogs chen mo kun dga' rwa ba yangs par/ gral gyi 'phreng ba mtshar du dngar zin pa na/ 'dus pa'i dbu byed dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rigs pa'i seng ge zhes bya bas/ rje btsun chen po'i bstod tshig me tog gi 'phreng ba/ 'jam dbyangs sku mched bzhugs khrir ma phebs kyi bar la zhal 'don ci 'gro mdzad pa'i ring la/ bgrang yas kyi skye 'gro'i tshogs rnams 'dus te/ tshogs chen mo'i nang dge 'dun 'dus tshogs kyi mtha'i 'khor lo thams cad khrig khengs pa dang bstun/ tshogs kyi chos khrims las 'dzin rnams 'jam mgon mched gsum ga la ba der spyan 'dren par brtol te/ de dag gis sna drangs/ de nas chen po rnams kyi bran du 'os pa las 'dzin gsum gyis lhag pa'i bcu phrag gcig gi nang nas/ skya ho rnams gral gyi 'phreng ba bsgrigs rjes/ rgya'i gling bu mkhan gnyis/ bdug spos kyi sna 'dren mi gsum ste/ de yang 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug gi spos sna ba rab 'byams smra ba kha'u pa/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal gyi spos sna ka bcu smra ba tshul khrims/

sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa de nyid kyi spos sna 'dren mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam chos lhun grub rnams dang / khri ston zhu ba po su yin gyi spos sna 'dren mkhan dang / 'jam mgon mched gsum gyi bzhugs gdengs 'khyer mi re re/ gzhan yang mdo sdud pa'i dpe dang / spos glang ring bu dang bcas pa/ maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma bkod pa rnams 'khyer mi rab tu byung ba re re rnams rim pa bzhin gral gyi bar thag snyoms par bsgrigs nas byon pa'i rjes su/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mthu stobs dang nus pa'i ngo bo gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje dang gnyis su med pa grub mchog mthu stobs dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i phyag 'degs kyi phyag phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen gnyis/ de nyid kyi phyis su rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i ngo bo 'phags pa phyag na pad+mo dang tha mi dad pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i phyag 'degs zhu mi gnyis dang bcas pa'i rjes thogs su/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa ma lus pa'i mkhyen rab kyi ngo bo rgyal sras gzhon nu'i snang brnyan du shar pa rje btsun phyag na ral gri dang rnam dbyer med pa/ bdag cag gi rnam 'dren bla na med pa/ tshad med pa'i mkhyen rab dang / dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje zla med pa sogs zag med kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag gis thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gang ba dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa chen po 'di nyid kyi phyag 'degs su gzhung lugs mang po'i mgrin ring gdan sa chen po'i rgya tsho dpon dge 'dun 'od zer ba dang / grub mchog bsod nams dbang po'i zhabs 'bring pa dge slong rin chen rnam rgyal gnyis kyis zhus te/ dam pa mched gsum ka yang sku'i cha byad yab rje chos kyi rgyal po dang mtshungs par/ ke la sha'i phung po la co 'dri ba'i rab dkar na bza' mdzes pa bklubs shing /

dbu skyes lcang lo yid du 'ongs pas spud pa'i dbu la paṇa zhwa dang / chos gos me long sogs mdzes par gsol te/ mthong ba tsam gyis kun gyi mig dang yid la sim pa 'jo nus pa de dag gi zhabs phyir/ gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi chos grwa chen po gnyis kyi khri thog mkhan chen/ brgya dpon dang / chos las pa sogs bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang zhing / chos kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams dang / gzhan yang sku 'khor ban gtsang pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshogs mang po dang / skye bo 'jam des kyi blo can gos dar gyi lhab lhub g.yo ba rin chen sna tshogs pa'i rgyan 'phrul 'phyang ba sogs phun sum tshogs pa'i 'khor tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor te/ bzhi thog bla brang chen po nas rim pas phebs te/ tshogs chen mo'i shar sgor rnam 'dren gsum phebs mtshams/ zhal ngo'i bla dung du grags pa chos dung dkar po rgyang grags kyi sgra dbyangs thengs bcu gsum snyan brjid che bar bsgrags/ de nas mthar gyis tshogs la g.yas bskor ngos khri chung lho ma'i mdun ngos su tshogs phyag mdzad nas bzhugs khri chen mo'i steng du phebs pa na dpon slob gtso 'khor so so'i gdan la 'khod/ de nas chos khrims pa rnams kyis brda' byas te/ tshogs pa rnams kyis chos zhu ba'i yon du gus pas phyag phul zin pa na/ tshogs pa khri'i steng shod thams cad kyis rgyal ba'i bka' dri ma med pa sher phyin bsdus pa sogs klog pa mdzad pa'i sngon du 'jam pa'i dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug gis/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung rab dri ma med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bka'i gnang bas byang drangs nas/ thams cad kyi gsung rab yun mi ring tsam zhig bklags pa mdzad rjes/ ban gtsang dbu byed kun dga' bsod nams ring mo bar grags pas mdo tshar gsum bdud bzlog dang bcas pa bskul nas tshogs pa yongs kyis zhal 'don mdzad pa'i rjes der/

ban gtsang pa'i byang 'dren pa dang / mchod dpon sogs ngur smrig 'dzin pa gsum tsam zhig 'grengs te/ mchod dpon gyis maṇ+ḍal so bdun bkod pa'i me long btegs/ dbu byed kyis spos reng bu thogs nas dbus kyi ri rab sogs so bdun po thams cad so sor gtad nas ston pa'i ram bu tshogs pa rnams kyis kyang btegs te/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma gdangs dang bcas pas phul zhing / gang gi mchod rdzas ma shar ma mdzad zin pa dang / phyag btsal nas mchod dpon sogs so so'i gdan la rtsen par gyur to/ /de nas grub mchog mthu stobs dbang phyug gis 'khor 'dus pa'i tshogs thams cad la theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed gsal 'debs par mdzad rjes/ bdag nyid chen po sa paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i sku gsung thugs kyi che ba'i yon tan che long tsam zhig sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas rgyal sras lam bzang du grags pa thub pa'i dgongs pa gsal ba'i bstan bcos kyi mtshan don nas brtsams te/ phar phyin drug legs par bshad pa'i mtshams yan chad/ glo bo mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i 'bru 'grel dang bcas pa dag gsal snyan pa'i gsung gis 'doms par mdzad pa na/ 'dus pa kun gyi yid 'phrog par gyur cing / de nas 'dus tshogs rnams rgya ja'i btung ba mchog la rol pa'i ring la/ gsung chos 'phro cung zad bcad de khri ston gyi 'bul nod rnams rim gyis phul te/ de yang de lo sde dpon che phran dgon gnas sogs kyi 'bul ba'i skyes zhu mi shin tu stobs che bas/ gsung chos kyi nyin gsum ga la mi rdzogs pa lta bu byung ba rnams nangs so chen mor 'jam mgon bsod nams dbang po phebs nas/ nyid kyi zhabs 'bring chen po chos rje kun dga' bkra shis te dpon slob gnyis kyis zhal bkod yang dag pa mdzad de/ 'bul ba'i dngos po rnams lag khyer ba rnams kyis khyer te/

bzhi thog gi mdun ngos kyi sde yangs dang seng ge sgo brgyud de/ tshogs chen mo'i shar sgo nas zhugs/ dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs mtha' bskor nas bzhugs khri chen mo'i steng rje 'di nyid sku mched bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar 'bul nod rnams rim 'byor bstun/ sngags 'chang chen mo'i ban gtsang dbu byed/ rje 'di nyid sku mched gsum gyi gnas kyi slob dpon dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa bsod nams lha dbang dang / sngags 'chang 'gro ba'i bla ma rgyal ba'i yab gcig grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs 'bring pa chen po sngags 'chang gnyan ston chos rje bsod nams dpal 'byor gnyis kyis bzhes pa nyi ma gsum ga'i bka' chos kyi bar thams cad la mdzad kyang / khri ston gyi 'bul ba'i 'phreng ba mi rdzogs pa lta bu byung pas/ sa skya pa'i gdung rgyud khri ston gyi 'bul ba'i rnam grangs shig la/ de dus las bzang zhing rgya dpang che ba rgan rabs sus kyang mi dran zhes sa skya na gnas pa'i skya ser kun mgrin gcig tu gleng bgros byed pa byung zhes kyang thos la/ de nas 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug zhabs kyis sngar gyi gsung chos kyi 'phro cung zad stsal te/ nyi ma dang po phyed yol ba tsam na grol bar mdzad/ de nas nyi ma gnyis pa tshes bcu bzhi la yang sngar ltar mdzad de/ gsung chos rgyal sras lam bzang gi sngar gyi 'phros phar phyin drug gi grangs nges bshad pa nas brtsams/ sems brtse ma'i kha skong bdud bzhi bcom pa'i sgo nas bstod pa'i skabs yan chad legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston stsal te/ slar yang nyin gsum pa tshes bco lnga la yang chos kyi dung brda sogs sngar bzhin bca' bsgrigs legs par mdzad de phebs pa'i gtso bor 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo pad+ma ka ra'i rnam par sprul pa bsod nams dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa nyid sku'i snang brnyan nyin byed 'bum gyi gzi 'od ltar rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas phebs te/

de ltar 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched gsum ni 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po'i tshul dang / 'jam dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can ni rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po ste/ mi 'jigs pa seng chen brgyad kyis mtho ba'i chos kyi khri gcig la sku lham me/ gsung lhang nge / thugs lhan ne bar bzhugs pa der 'dus kyi skye bo bgrang ba las 'das pa dag gi mig gi bdud rtsir gyur pa nyid nas/ grub mchog mthu stobs mtshan can gyis sems bskyed gsal 'debs pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ gsung chos dngos gzhi'i thub pa'i dgongs pa gsal ba'i thub pa'i dbang po la bdud bzhi bcom pa'i sgo nas bstod pa'i mtshams sngar gyi 'phros nas bzung / mjug gi sbyar byang gi bar du tshang la ma nor ba zlos skyon med par yongs su rdzogs par stsal pas/ 'jam mgon dbang po'i mtshan can nyid thugs shin tu dgyes shing / dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs dang skye bo dpyod ldan thams cad kyang shin tu ngo mtshar nas/ yid rab tu dang ba'i dad pa cher g.yos te dam pa gsum gyi grags snyan sgrog pa la gcig tu 'grus pa lta bur gyur to/ /de nas sngar bzhin 'bul nod rnams bzhes grub rjes/ tshogs chen dbu byed kyis byang drangs nas gong ma lnga'i bstod pa sogs chos spyod 'gro gang che mdzad pa'i bar la/ gdan sa chen po'i gtsug lag khang khyad par can rnams su snyan dar dkar me zhal zas sogs mchod pa'i bye brag bgrang ba las 'das pa dang / der 'dus kyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po/ mkhan chen/ brgya dpon/ chos las pa sogs kyis thog drangs zur 'bul 'os pa rnams la so sor tshan grangs rgya dpang che ba dang / dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs sogs skya ser bgrang ba las 'das pa rnams la gdan non gyi rnyed bkur gya nom pa mdzad pa'i steng gser dngul zangs lcags gos dar la sogs pa'i zang zing gi sbyin gtong blos dpag par dka' ba zhig stsol bar mdzad de/

de dag kyang sngon gyi phyag srol dang mthun par gdan sa chen po'i dpon yig mkhan gyis snyan dar sogs so so'i tho byang rnams bklags te brda 'phrod par mdzad zin pa na/ de nas kha ba can gyi sdom brtson ngur smrig 'chang ba yongs kyi gtsug gi cod pan dam pa rgyal ba'i sras po dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho nyid slar yang bstan 'gro'i dpal du shar ba dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang gnyis su med cing gnyis su byar med pa'i thugs mnga' ba sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes mtshan gyi dbyar rnga skal bzang mdongs ldan mang po'i rna ba'i dpyid du gyur pa de nyid kyis rang gi rigs sras rgyal tshab dam pa gsum gyi rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo thog mar bskor bar mdzad pa las byung ba'i legs byas bla na med pa dag dang / gzhan yang tshad ldan gyi gzhung las/ de yi khyad par sbyin bdag dang / /dngos dang zhing gi khyad par las/ /zhes khyad par gsum ldan gyi chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po ji snyed bskrun par mdzad pa rnams/ dam pa gsum gyis bsod nams bsags/ /zung 'jug bsngo bas rgyas 'debs bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sbyin bdag khyad par du 'phags pa dad pa dang / dman pa la snying rje dang ldan pa/ sbyin pa'i dngos po khyad par 'phags pa/ kha dog yid du 'ongs pa dang ldan pa'am/ min kyang shin tu gya nom pa phun sum tshogs pa/ sbyin pa'i yul lam zhing khyad par du 'phags pa/ sdug bsngal can gyi 'gro ba dang / pha ma dang / yon tan gyi zhing bla ma dkon mchog ste khyad par 'phags gsum dang ldan pa'i sbyin pa la sogs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su bsngo ba ni/ rgyal ba'i sras po rnams kyi blo sbyong ba'i lam mchog yin par dgongs nas zung 'jug gi bsngo bas rgyas 'debs pa'i phyir/

de ltar zhu ba'i rten du zang zing gi dngos po'i 'bul nod bzang zhing / tshan grangs shin tu mang ba rnams 'bul bar mdzad mtshams/ grub thob kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i zhal snga nas/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can/ /de yi byed pa mchog yin no/ /de ni dmigs med rnam pa can/ /zhes pa ltar 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i shes rab khyad par can gyis zin cing gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba'i thugs bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas gsung dbyangs mi zad pa tshangs pa'i nga ro lta bus bdag gzhan gyis dus gsum du nye bar bsags pa'i dge ba'i dngos po ji snyed mchis pa rnams bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por yongs su bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi tshogs rgya chen po mdzad cing / mjug tu bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol rgyas par stsal te/ bho ṭa'i ljongs kyi rdo rje gdan dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa gdung rigs dang bcas pa ji srid 'khor ba 'di mi dmigs par gyur gyi bar de srid du mi nub cing / yar ngo'i bsil zer byed pa'i cha shas ltar 'phel rgyas su 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa de tsam nas sgrig par mdzad pa de nyid 'bad med lhun grub tu gyur te/ deng sang gi dus kyang skye bo kun la mngon du gyur pa 'di yin par snang ngo / /de'i tshe nam mkha' shin tu dwangs pa la 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang rnam par bkra ba mang du 'khrigs shing / dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha rnams kyis me tog sil ma'i char kha ba babs pa ltar phyogs kun tu 'thor ba/ der yod kyi skye bo kun gyi mig gi spyod yul du gyur pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i dge mtshan mang du byung zhes kyang thos la/ de nas dge 'dun 'dus tshogs skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad yid rangs shing / dga' ba dang dad pa'i thal mo snying nas sbyor zhing / 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched gsum gyi yon tan sgrog pa la brel bar gyur to/

/de ltar khri 'don chos 'khor gyi nyi ma gsum gyi ring la bdag cag gi rnam 'dren bla na med pa 'di nyid sku na shin tu phra yang / gsung chos rnams ni rje btsun gcen gyis gsungs pa dang mnyam du yid kyis 'dom zhing lhag par de dus nyin cig tab tobs su zhal nas/ a ne a ne zhes gsungs shing spyan chab kyang mang du mdzad pa zhig byung 'dug pa/ rjes su brtags pas/ mnga' ris su 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can gyi lcam sring mo rin chen bu khrid ces bya ba sku gshegs pa'i dus kyang de nyin rang du 'dug nas mnga' ris rdzong khar khri lcam rin chen bu khrid ces bya ba rje 'di'i a ne drung sku gshegs pa bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid kyi 'od gsal gyi snang bas gsal bar sgrib med du gzigs par kun yid ches nas/ thams cad kyis sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud sku gzhon pa 'di la thugs mkhyen thogs med mnga' bar gdon mi za zhes mgrin dbyangs gcig tu sgrog pa yang byung zhes 'khums so/ /de ltar bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa mched gsum po 'di 'dzam bu'i sgra ldan gyi gling mchog 'di nyid kyi lte ba ma ga dha rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs gangs ri can gyi ljongs na mngon par mtho ba'i gnas dam pa dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i 'jam mgon bla ma sa paṇ+ḍi ta chen po khu dbon brgyud pa'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pa'i zhabs stegs mi 'jigs pa'i khri chen po ga la ba der/ sngags 'chang bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen yab sras gsum gyi rgyal tshab dam par mnga' gsol bar mdzad de/ 'dzam gling byang phyogs kyi rgyud na gnas pa'i skye dgu rnams kyi skyabs mgon bla na med par gyur pas/ kun la dga' ba dang / phan bde rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dus ston la rol zhing / nor 'dzin gyi khyon 'di yang snum zhing mdzes la mchog tu 'od chags 'bar bar gyur cing /

dus de tsam nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs mched gsum gyi grags snyan lha'i rnga chen nam mkha'i khyon yangs las 'gongs par gyur pas/ sngon bsags legs byas kyi mthu brtas pa'i skal ldan blo gros chen po'i zhal sgor/ gzur gnas kyi ro 'dzin bde ba mang po dag bdag nyid chen po 'di gsum gyi yon tan sgrog pas brel zhing / 'jam mgon sa skya pa'i chos srid kyi bka' bab tu rtog pa dag ni/ char 'dod kyi byi'u dbyar skyes kyi sgra thos pa ltar dga' zhing mgu la gus pa'i rnam 'gyur ci yang 'dzin par gyur to/ /zhes kyang thos so/ /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ dhiḥyig 'od 'bar 'jam pa'i rdo rje dngos/ /sa lo'i 'jigs med seng chen khri 'phang du/ /mgon khyod zung gi gcen dang lhan cig par/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol tshe/ /sa chen 'di la dbang ba'i mi yi bdag /rigs dang dbang phyug gis mtho bgrang yas dang / /blo gsal khu byug gnyen gyur chos kyi tshal/ /rnam gsum bstan pa'i bgyi bas skyong mkhas pa'i/ /bshes gnyen mang thos ngur smrig 'dzin pa dang / /byang sems khyim pa'i lus can dad pa'i bzhin/ /mdzes pa mang pos sna tshogs bdog pa yi/ /'bul snod rnam sras rdzas la'ang co 'dri byas/ /gzhan yang dkar po'i las kyi sa bon can/ /bgrang yas skye bo'i tshogs rnams khyod kyi sku/ /blta 'dod gsung gi bcud 'thung phyir lhags pas/ /'dzin ma'i khyon la ngal ba dus der phyin/ /mdzes sku'i snang brnyan mig gi chu nang du/ /shar ba tsam gyis rmongs mun mthar byed na/ /gsung dbyangs bdud rtsi thigs 'phreng rnar lhung tshe/ /thog med nyon mongs tsha gdung mi sel gang / /shugs ring yul gyis bskal yang ye shes kyis/ /gnyen 'dun lha sras dus kyi kha sgo ru/ /tshud pa'i snang tshul sgrib med gzigs pa'i mod/ /brtse ba'i nyi mas spyan gyi gangs ri bzhus/ /'di ko rgyal ba'i sras kyi mthu phun tshogs/

/rang gir mdzad las gzhan du ga na zhes/ /dpyod ldan gsong po 'bum lce ring du skyong / /de tshe bstan la dga' ba'i lha mang pos/ /mkha' la sil ma'i me tog char sim 'thor/ /phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /dgongs pa gcig pa'i dbyangs kyis legs so byin/ /'dzin ma'i pad tshal gnas pa'i skye dgu rkang drug tshogs/ /phan dang bde ba sbrang rtsis myos pa'i mgrin pa nas/ /rnam gsum 'dren pa bsngags pa'i rab snyan glu dbyangs 'tsher/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dus ston 'di na 'jo zhes bzlo/ /deng 'dir rigs gsum rgyal ba yi/ /mdzes sku mngon gyur gsal po gleng / /gsung dbyangs thos pa mngon sum zer/ /dga' dang dad pa'i ca co snyan/ /de ltar lhar bcas 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs dang dpung gnyen bla na med pa 'di nyid bstan pa'i zla dbang yab rje chos kyi rgyal po sogs kyi rgyal tshab dam par mnga' gsol te/ nyid kyi dgung lo drug bzhes pa nas brtsams te lo gnyis kyi bar la/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs mched la gsan pa ci rigs pa mdzad cing / dges pa rdo rje'i rgyud gsum dang / bde mchog rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa sogs rgyud gzhung mang po thugs 'dzin dang / rdo rje phur pa'i gar 'cham dang gsung dbyangs sogs bris thig rol rtsis sogs cho ga'i khrigs mang po'i phyag len la shin tu byang chub par mdzad de/ dgung lo brgyad du phebs pa khro bo zhes pa shing pho 'brug gi lo snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi dus dran gyi mchod 'bul rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub mchod la/ rje btsun mthu stobs dbang phyug dang / sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal te/ gcen gnyis dang bcas sku mched gsum char phebs pa'i cho ga'i zhal 'don/ gar 'chams/ dbyangs rol sogs thams cad la mkhyen rab phul du byung ba'i stobs kyis shin tu byang chub pa skye bo yid 'phrog par mdzad pas/

yab rje nyid kyang thugs cher rangs par gyur nas/ dges spro'i gsung yang mang du 'dom par mdzad ces kyang thos la/ de nas nyid kyi rab bgrangs dgu dang bcu pa ste lo gnyis kyi bar la gdan sa chen po 'di nyid na bla ma gong ma ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnams kyi dus kyi mchod par sa lo thams cad mkhyen pas bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa/ bde mchog nag po lugs kyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod/ dges pa rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs mi bskyod pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod sogs bla med gtso bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga'i khrigs rim mang du yod pa rnams dang / gzhan yang kun rigs sa lugs/ tshe dpag med dze ta ri lugs sogs rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor gyi chog rigs mang po/ bod yul gyi bstan pa rin po che spyi'i rim gro gur gyi mgon po'i man ngag dus mdos chen mo/ yang gur gyi mgon po'i gtor ma la brten nas dgra bsad pa'i man ngag gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog rdo rje phur pa'i smad las drag po sgrol ba'i man ngag phur bzlog tu grags pa sogs gtor bzlog gi chog sgrigs sogs bstan pa rin po che mdzad 'phrin lo ltar gyi rgyun ma chad par mdzad dgos kyi rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod pa rnams kyi cho ga so so'i tshig don ma lus pa thugs su tshud par mdzad cing / gzhan yang bde dgyes gsang gsum/ rdo rje phur pa/ gur drag sogs kyi dbang chog gi rigs mang po yang thugs la byang chub par mdzad ces thos so/ /de dag gi skabs shig rje 'di sku khams cung zad ma snyoms pa zhig byung ba'i nub cig mtshan lam du bud med dmar smug shin tu 'jigs su rung ba/ lag pa'i sor mo rnams lcags las byas pa zhig gis/ rje nyid ded pa'i snang ba zhig byung nas/

cung zad bzhad nyams kyi ring tshul du 'gros par brtsams te/ nye skor na skas shig 'dug pa de la 'dzegs nas phebs bzhed pa na/ bud med des zin la nye bar byung / lcags kyi sder mo bsnun nam dgongs tsam na/ skas mgo nas mi bong che ba zhig gis rje 'di'i phyag nas 'then te skas kyi mgor yer kyis phebs pa na mnal sad/ de las rjes su dpags te sku khams cung zad ma bde ba yang / sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can khros pa dmag zor rgyal mor bod pa de'i cho 'phrul yin par dgongs shing / der phan thabs kyi rigs gang yang ma mdzad par sku khams gzhi med la dwangs pa byung / skas 'go nas gzhan gyis drangs pa de khams bde ru 'gro ba la lta ba 'dra gsungs/ de nas re zhig nas yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs 'bring zhus/ bsam gling du lha mo mchod par phebs te yab sras lhan cig pas lha mor bskang gso rgyas pa zhig mdzad pas/ de dus yab rje chos kyi rgyal po nyid kyi gzim khyi bdud 'joms zer ba'i shin tu 'jigs pa zhig yod pa de btags pa las grol na mi dang dud 'gro ci yin kyang lus bsha' ba ltar rmug pa'i ma rung ba zhig yod pa de la yab rje nyid kyi thugs rtsis shin tu che ba bsam gling dang / sked lhas sogs su zla dus kyi bskang gso la phebs dus kyang / chos skyong dges rdzas su dgongs 'khrid par mdzad pa zhig yin 'dug pas/ bsam gling du phebs pa de dus khyi de shor te/ 'gris pa khyi rdzi gcig dang / yab rje nyid ma gtogs gzhan med pas kun 'jigs shing skrag ste thams cad ga shed du byer nas/ rje nyid gcig pur bzhugs pa'i mdun du khyi de slebs pas/ thugs shin tu bzhad par gyur kyang / khyi de ni dam pa 'di'i sku la dri mnom zhing mjug ma ril bskyod byed pa sogs sngar nas 'dres nyams kyi dga' ba'i tshul kho na ma gtogs khros tshul cung zad kyang med pa'i ring na/

khyi rdzi dang phyag phyi ba rnams kyang rtab rtab tu slebs pas/ khyi des phyag phyi ba rnams mthong ba na khro 'dzum bstan kyang khyi rdzis zin pas skyon par ma gyur/ de nas khong rnams kyis tshul de yab rje nyid la zhus ma spobs par/ sku 'khor ba gzhan dag la zlos pa na/ thams cad ngo mtshar zhing ha las par gyur pa de mthar gyis yab rje'i snyan du gsan pa na/ ya mtshan che bar dgongs pas rje 'di la bstod bsngags mdzad pa yang byung 'dug cing / 'di lta bu ni dam pa 'di la chos skyong rnams thugs shin tu dgyes pa'i mtshan ma mngon gyur ba ste/ sngon du bud med cig gis ded pa'i snang ba de dmag zor ma 'phral la cung zad ma dgyes pa'i tshul du snang yang / rjes su bsam gling du bskang gsor phebs dus gzim khyi bdud 'joms kyis sngar 'dris ltar gus tshul de lta bu ni/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo dam pa 'di la shin tu 'ches shing 'phrin las sgrub pa la dus nam yang g.yel ba mi mnga' ba'i dge mtshan du gsal ba'i shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar du snang zhing / de bzhin du skas mgo nas gzhan gyis phyag 'then zhus pa de yang chos skyong gzhan gyis rje 'di la bsrung zhing skyong ba'i ltas su gor ma chag go /de nas rje 'di dgung lo bcu bzhes pa'i tshe 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dbang po'i mtshan can de nyid rang gi dben gnas dam pa phur ri glang brag gi ri khrod na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ sngags 'chang 'gro ba'i mgon po grags pa'i mtshan can gyis rang nyid kyis sngar ma gsan pa'i zab chos 'ga' zhig gsan pa dang / khyad par rang nyid kyi rigs kyi sras mchog dam pa 'jam dbyangs mched gsum gsung ngag gtso bor gyur pa'i yab chos rnams gsan par bzhed nas/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po phur ri nas gdan sa chen por spyan drangs te lo de'i dus rim mgon po drug cu pa dang / lo phyi ma'i phur bzlog gi zor las gnyis ka mdzad rjes/

sa skya'i bla brang shar du rgyun ring bzhugs pa'i drung du/ sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can/ rje dam pa 'di sku mched gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i chos sde lho byang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rags bsdus mang po dang bcas pas/ sgrub thabs kun las btus pa brgya rtsa/ ba ri lo tsā ba dang paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rjes bsgyur pa dang / rgya mtshor grags pa lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur pa'i rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs/ sngags 'chang chen po'i bka' 'bum phal cher gyi lung / 'jam mgon bsod nams dbang po nyid kyi bka' 'bum dang / kyai rdo rje'i rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa 'phags mchan dang bcas pa'i lung sogs chos tshul mtha' yas pa zhig gsan/ de ltar dgung lo bcu gcig du ma phebs tsam gyi bar du gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi rgyun gyi mdzad 'phrin sgrub mchod kyi chog rigs sogs kun la byang chub pa'i ngos 'jam dbyangs sku mched la gsan pa yang ci rigs pa dang / gtso bor rang gi gcen gnyis dang bcas cho ga'i grwar phebs nas bla ma gong ma ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnams kyi dgongs dbyings rdzogs pa'i thabs la sku gsung thugs gsum gcig tu 'grus par mdzad ces grags la/ de nas bdag cag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa 'di dgung gi rab bgrangs bcu gcig tu phebs pa spre'u zhes pa me mo lug gi lo/ rgyal ba'i bka' mdo rgyud thams cad kyi snying po'i bcud phyung ba bdag med mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs ma nyams par rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan bi rū pas legs par gsol te thugs nyams su bstar ba/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba rin po che'i 'byung khungs/ brtson pas bsgrubs na/ skye ba'i sgo lam 'di nyid la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gnas su brtol nus pa'i lam mchog thun mong ma yin pa/

zab yangs rgyud sde ma lus pa'i gces pa'i gnad mang po gcig tu bsdus pa gsung ngag rin po che'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i smin grol gyi gdams pa zab mo gsan par bzhed de/ gdan sa chen po'i shar ngos 'khrul zad grags pa'i zhabs sogs dam pa mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing bdag gir mdzad pa'i bsti gnas byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong gi yang dben na/ grub pa mchog gi ded dpon dpal sa skya pa chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs byams pa dpal ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bzhugs pa'i drung ga la ba der cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes bcu bzhi mchog tu shis pa'i gza' skar bzang po 'dzoms pa'i nyin dam pa 'di nyid kyi yab rje grags pa'i mtshan can dang / gcen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched gnyis te yab sras rnam pa bzhi zhabs 'bring pa'i tshogs du ma dang bcas gdan btegs te/ rim gyi byas 'gyur dang nye bar phebs pa na/ rje grub pa'i dbang phyug dpon slob nyung bsdus shig yod pa rnams kyis/ rje yab sras rnams la phebs bsu ser 'phreng gi zhal bkod gya nom pa mdzad de/ de yang byas 'gyur gyi gzim khang gi steng thams cad bzang po'i gos dar las grub pa'i gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i rdzas kyi dngos po yid du yong ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnam par bkra ba khra lam me ba/ mthong ba tsam gyis yid rang dbang med par 'phrog nus pa dang / de mtshungs 'jam mgon grub pa'i dbang phyug nyid kyis rol dpon mdzad de khang steng du bzhugs/ gzhan sku 'khor ba rnams kyis sil snyan dang / dung gling bu/ rnga la sogs pa snyan cing brjid pa'i rol mo'i rigs sna tshogs pa dang bcas bde yangs nas bzung / sgyu ma lam gyi bar la mtshar du dngar bas phebs bsu zab par mdzad de/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched gong ma gnyis dang / dam pa 'di nyid mched gsum ste de ltar yab sras khu dbon thams cad zhal 'dzoms pa'i dus der/

chos dang mthun zhing phan tshun thugs yid gcig 'dres kyi dgyes spro'i gsung gleng ci yang zhig mdzad ces rje nyid kyi gsung las dngos su thos shing / de nas rgyal sras sbas pa'i sangs rgyas grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid kyi thugs sras mched gsum ste/ yab sras mtshungs med bzhi/ gzhan yang 'jam mgon dbang po'i mtshan can nyid kyi zhabs 'bring pa dge slong rin chen rnam rgyal sogs dpon slob nyung shas shig la/ grub dbang puṇ+ye in+d+ras rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos thun mong ma yin pa gsung ngag rin po che'i gdams pa zab mo stsol bar mdzad pa yin te/ de yang thog mar lo de'i zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin/ kun gsal gyi khyon yangs par lha rnams kyis me tog gi dga' char chen po 'bebs pa dang / rnam bkra'i 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang 'khyil ba'i nang du 'ja' dkar zlum bu gsum gyi dbus su rje btsun dkar po rnam gsum bzhugs pa/ thog mar sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can nyid kyis gzigs pa ji lta ba bzhin rjes su rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid sogs kyis kyang gsal bar gzigs shing / gzhan yang snang gsum khrid kyi skabs su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po rnams kyi rnam thar gsung dus dang / sems bskyed chen mo gnang ba'i nyin sogs kyang nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od dang / me tog gi char zim/ lha'i rol mo'i sgra sogs kun gyis mthong zhing thos pa shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang du byung zhes thos shing / de dus gsung chos kyi tshe phyag dbang zhu ba'i skabs sogs mjal re bzhin/ grub mchog dbang po'i mtshan can de nyid kyis/ rje 'di'i dbu sku phang du 'dzin par mdzad pa la/ phyag gnyis kyis mnyed pa sogs dgyes pa'i thugs kyi sku rtse ba kho na mdzad pa dang / de mthun gsung gleng gi 'phros phal cher la yang /

rje 'di la gzigs nas gdan sa chen por yab rje rgyan drung gi phyag phyi la khong khri thog pa rgan 'bring gnyis kyis ma chog pa mi 'dug pas/ khyed rang nged kyi phyi la phyin/ dbus gtsang gi sa skya pa'i dgon che chung rnams dang / sbyin bdag sde dpon che phran kun la nged kyis ngo sprod byas/ ma 'ongs pa na dbus gtsang gi bla gcig ma byed pa yin mod/ ces yang yang gsungs shing / gzhan yang gsung chos kyi skabs der rje btsun rin po che'i zan 'bum dang / sa lo'i phyi rten gnyis la/ 'jam mgon grub pa'i dbang phyug de nyid zhabs skor la rgyun du phebs pa zhig yod 'dug pas/ de'i phyag phyir rje 'di sku mched gsum 'byon pa'i skabs/ zhabs bcags grub nas yar lam sku ngal cung zad mdzad pa dang bstun/ bdag nyid chen po de'i dbu zhwa dang / dbu dom rje 'di la gnang ba zhig yod pas/ de'i tshe dbu zhwa dang dbu dom la sku rngul cung zad yod pa la/ rje 'di'i shangs kyis mnos par mdzad pa na/ lha dang mi'i dri bzang khyad par can gang gis kyang mtshon par mi nus pa'i tshul khrims kyi dri bsung khyad par can thul thul 'byung ba de lan gcig ma yin par yang yang myangs pas/ thugs rig dwangs shing bde ba zhig yong gin yod ces rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid kyi gsung las yang yang thos pas/ 'jam mgon dbang po'i mtshan can de nyid kyis spyan gyi 'bras bu ltar 'tsho ba zhig de dus nas yod par snang la/ de ltar zla ba gsum tsam gyi bar la gsung ngag rin po che legs par gsan par mdzad pa'i thog mar/ sngon 'gro snang ba gsum gyi khrid dang rjes su 'brel bar bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar rnams gsan pa'i rnam grangs la/ rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i bla ma rgya bod kyi lo rgyus/ bod kyi lo rgyus rgyas pa dmar gyis mdzad pa'i zhib mo rnam 'thag sa skya pa chen po'i rnam thar dang / rje rtse mo'i rnam thar tshangs spyod ma dang /

khyod nyid ma mchan ma rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ rje btsun gyi rnam thar mnal lam ma ne tshe sbal ston gyis mdzad pa dang / chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa gnyis/ chos rje sa paṇa gyi rnam thar 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa dang / lho pa rin chen dpal gyis mdzad pa gnyis/ 'phags pa'i rnam thar shar ba ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa dang / byang gzhon bo ti ku ma ras mdzad pa/ tshogs sgom pa dang nyan chen pa'i rnam thar gnyis bar ston gyis mdzad pa'i lo rgyus bsdus pa/ nyan chen pa'i rnam thar dkar po brag pas mdzad pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal ba'i rnam thar dpal ldan pas mdzad pa/ brag phug pa'i rnam thar ri khrod pas mdzad pa/ bla ma dam pa'i rnam thar dpal ldan pas mdzad pa dang / karma byams chos pas mdzad pa kha skong dang bcas pa/ ri khrod pa'i rnam thar dpal ldan pas mdzad pa/ dkar po brag pa'i rnam thar rang nyid kyis mdzad pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims pa'i rnam thar sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa/ grub chen bud+dha shrī'i rnam thar ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ shar chen ye rgyal gyi rnam thar rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ rdo rje 'chang gi rnam thar kha skong dang bcas pa mus chen sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa/ mus chen gyi rnam thar kha skong dang bcas pa rtsa 'grel kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa/ kun mkhyen gyi rnam thar sangs rin pas mdzad pa/ rje dkon mchog 'phel gyi rnam thar mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen dang / rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa gnyis/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen gyi rnam thar kha skong dang bcas pa sa los mdzad pa/ sa lo chen po'i rnam thar ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi rnam thar dkon mchog dpal ldan pas mdzad pa/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar rgyas pa ljags steng nas gnang ba dang / bla ma bstan pa'i thabs sh+lau ka lnga bcu pa rje btsun chen po'i dka' 'grel dang bcas pa/

rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i snang gsum mdzes rgyan gyi lung rnams dang / brgyud pa'i khyad par gnyis dang ldan pa'i dbang gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga rnams legs par gsan/ de nas lam gyi dngos gzhi rgyud gsum gyi sgo nas bkri ba la/ thog mar yab kyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa bdun ldan gyi sgo nas rgyu dus kyi dbang bskur ba zab mo aṣ+ṭi'i bzlas lung dang bcas pa dang / lus dkyil gyi khrid kyi sngon 'gror thabs rgyud kyi gtso bo lam dus kyi dbang bskur ba yi ge brgya pa'i bzlas lung dang bcas pa/ gsang dbang gi lam gyi sngon 'gror rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor dang / bla ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams par bskur ba lam dus kyi dbang dang bcas pa/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang byin rlabs dang / phyi'i bar chad bsrung thabs rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bsrung ba thun mong ma yin pa rnams gsan nas/ de rnams kyi rgyab brten tshad ma bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yig sna rnams kyi lung gsan pa la/ thog mar bstan bcos tshad ma'i skor la rdo rje'i tshig rkang / de'i rnam 'grel rje sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa bcu gcig gi nang nas tshig nyung la don rgyas pa gnyag ma yig chung dang bcas pa la deng sang lam 'bras glegs bam du grags pa'i nang du bzhugs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs sdom du mdzad pa ni/ rdo rje'i tshig gi rnam 'grel gnyag ma dang / /gsal byed kun gzhi rgyu rgyud gdan sogs dang / /lus dkyil 'chi bslu bum dbang 'da' kha ma/ /thig le'i rnal 'byor phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid dang / /bzhi pa'i 'da' kha bar do'i gdams ngag dang / /lam dbang tshad ma bzhi dang gdams ngag drug /rten 'brel lnga dang grib sel yig chung gnyis/ /thig le bsrung ba yig brgya'i 'don thabs dang /

/rlung sbyor bha ga'i yi ge 'khor bzhi brgya/ /dbang phyug don brgyad sa phyed mngon rtogs dang / /don bsdus ma ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ /bstan bcos nyid kyi steng du bshad bya'o/ /de dag las 'phros gud du gsungs pa'i chos/ /'khor 'das dbyer med dbang bzhi'i man ngag gnad/ /mchog dbang bskur tshul bskyed rim bsdus pa dang / /ril bu'i sgrub thabs yum gyi byin rlabs dang / /gegs sel bzhi dang dbang chu sgrub thabs gsum/ /rtsa ltung 'khrul spong tshogs 'khor sbyin sreg ste/ /rtsa ba las 'phros chos sna bcu bdun las/ /phyi ma bdun po logs su bzhugs kyang rung / /'bring bsdus lam gnyis gzhung shing chen po bzhi/ /rtogs bskyed chos lnga lam zab bla ma rnams/ /nyams myong tshad ma'i chos sna nyer dgu yin/ /lung gi tshad ma lung sbyor rnam pa bzhi/ /bla ma tshad ma rgya bod rnam thar gnyis/ /man ngag phra mor bcas pa drug bcu'o/ /zhes pa ltar glegs bam dkar chag tu gsal ba'i chos sna drug cu las/ glegs bam 'dir cis kyang bzhugs dgos pa'i chos sna dgus lhag pa'i bcu phrag bzhi/ las dang po dang thun mong du logs su bzhugs kyang rung ba'i chos sna bdun dang bcas pa legs par gsan cing / man ngag phra mo rkang grangs logs su mngar ba mtshan pu ti dmar chung du grags pa'i nang na gsal ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug pas mdzad pa'i dkar chag nang bzhin ma lus pa'i lung dang / gzhan yang kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i kyai rdor sgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa man ngag rnam bshad/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan gyi lung ste/ mdor na gsung ngag rin po che dang rjes su 'brel ba'i dbang byin rlabs/ lung man ngag nyams len gyi gnad thun mong du grags pa dang ma grags pa yongs su rdzogs pa gsan ces thos la/ de ltar gsung ngag rin po che legs par gsan nas/

slar yab sras rnams gdan sar phebs pa'i skabs/ 'jam mgon dbang po'i mtshan can gyi gsung gis/ rje btsun dam pa 'di la khyed kyi ma lha sras 'di bu dung che ba dang / byang pa sogs bsgul nas ma btang dogs pa/ da lam khyed rang yab sras lhan cig tu gdan sar byon/ slar nged dang nye bcar bsdad pa'i dge sding dang / rten mchod cha/ phyag dpe/ zang zing gi dngos po rnams dang / nged rang gis phyogs kun tu nyul nas bla ma mang po'i zhal las rnyed pa'i chos rnams kyi bdag po re ba yin no/ /zhes thugs kyi sras mchog gcig pu lta bur mchog tu brtse ba'i gsung yang stsol bar mdzad pa yin no/ /zhes kyang thos la/ de ltar gong du bkod pa'i grub mchog dbang po'i gsung de rnams ni/ ma 'ongs pa na dam pa 'di gangs ljongs bstan 'dzin yongs kyi gtsug rgyan dang / skye 'gro ma lus pa'i skyabs gcig pur 'gyur bar lung bstan pa'i gsung yin pa la ni nem nur mi dgos par/ snyigs ma las kyang ches snyigs ma'i dus 'dir kun la mngon du gyur pa 'di nyid de don 'di la/ rje 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa'i 'khrul zad dbang po'i mtshan can gyi rnam thar las/ sngar gyi gsung de bkod pa'i rjes su/ zhes gsungs pa sogs ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i lung bstan sgrib med du stsal bar 'dug kyang de dus ni kun gyi srol du snang ba bzhin/ bla ma zhal bzhugs dus yin pas sems la nges shes ha cang che ba zhig ma byung 'dug mod/ da ni gsung gi zur re dran pas kyang 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched 'di gnyis kyis dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa'i lung bstan rnams la nges shes mi skye dbang med du 'dug pas snying nas yid ches dad pas gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mi mngon zhi ba'i dbyings nas byin gyis rlobs shig ces pa'i gsol 'debs rang byung du smras pa lags/

zhes kyang gsungs shing / gzhan yang phyis dus bdag sogs zhabs drung nye gnas pa mang po la rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched kyis/ nged la ma 'ongs lung bstan pa'i gsung 'di dang 'di byung ba ji lta ba bzhin thog tu khel byung bas/ dam pa de rnams 'khrul pa mi mnga' bar 'dug gsungs phyag thal mo dpral bar sbyor bar mdzad/ spyan chab rang dbang med pa nyid du 'chor ba zhig yang yang mdzad pa mthong zhing thos la/ de ltar gsung ngag rdzogs nas yab sras lhan cig tu gdan sa chen por phebs te/ chos dang srid kyis bsdus pa'i mdzad 'phrin zla med pas bstan pa rin po che 'phel rgyas kyi bgyi ba kho na la gzhol zhing / 'jam mgon dbang po'i mtshan can nyid re zhig byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong nyid du gnad chags te rim gnyis kyi zab bzhes la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pa mdzad ces 'khum la/ de lta'i skabs nas rje 'di dgung lo bcu gnyis su phebs pa phur bu zhes pa sa pho spre'u lo slar yang byas 'gyur du 'jam dpal dbang po'i mtshan can bzhugs pa'i drung du rje yab sras bzhi kas phebs te/ rnam 'dren dam pa 'di nyid kyi rang gi gcen gnyis dang bcas pas sprel lo zla ba bcu pa nas bzung / rje 'di nyid kyi dgung gi bgrangs gzhi bcu gsum du phebs pa zhi ba zhes pa sa mo byi lo'i nag pa zla ba yan gyi zla ba drug gi bar la sku mtshams dam par mdzad de/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku skye gong ma gnyis char bsnyen rgyas kyi tshul du bzhugs te/ kyai rdo rje'i gzhi'i bsnyen pa kha skyong gi sbyin sreg dang bcas pa shin tu smin par mdzad de/ de dus nub gcig rje 'di'i mtshan ltas su byas 'gyur gyi gzim khang gi ngos la 'ja' 'dra ba'i kha dog khra chab se ba yid du 'ong ba'i gseb na/ yi dam kyi rigs mang po zhig gi sku brnyan gsal rgyu rang med pa dang / rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma shin tu gsal ba zhig gzigs la/

de ni bde bar gshegs pa khri chen de nyid kyi dus mchod la bdag med ma'i sgrub mchod gsar du tshugs pa 'di la lta ba 'dra zhes rje nyid kyi gsung las dngos su thos mod/ de tsam du ga la zad de/ spyir bsnyen pa la grangs kyi bsnyen pa/ dus kyi bsnyen pa/ mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa gsum gsungs pa'i grangs dang mtshan ma ni rin chen 'bar ba las/ 'khor lo can gyi sngags 'bum bzlas/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha yi 'bum/ /gzhan rnams kyi ni khri nyid de/ /dngos grub mtshan ma mchog thob nas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rab gtso bo la 'bum/ 'khor la khri bzla bar gsungs pa'i/ rtsod dus la bzhi 'gyur dang / dus bsnyen rab lo drug 'bring zla ba drug tha ma zhag drug sogs ji lta ba bzhin sngon du ma song kyang / mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa rab bla ma dang yi dam lhas dngos su gnang ba thob pa/ 'bring rmi lam/ tha ma nyams snang du bla mas gnang ba byin pa ci rigs pa thob na dbang bskur ba sogs la mchog tu gsungs pa'i mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa dang po der snang ngo / /gzhan yang gsung bsnyen gyi dus der shin tu ngo mtshar ba 'di ltar byung snang ste/ sngon gyi dus byas 'gyur gyi rdzu 'phrul phug gi thod de na rbab lam rgyun par byang pa'i nyin re bzhin rbab yong ba zhig yod pa la 'jam mgon bsod nams dbang pos sgrub sde 'di la nyams gso mdzad pa'i dus su pu tra la rbab srung gi bka' bsgo mdzad nas rbab de re zhig chad 'dug kyang / de dus rje 'di'i che ba dbyung ba'i phyir nyid kyi gzim chung theg mchog yang rtser mdzad yod pa'i steng du rbab mi tshad tsam pa zhig glo bur byung ba na/ 'ur sgra chen po byung ba yab rje chos kyi rgyal po sogs kyis gsan pas/ thugs shin tu zhed nas rtab rtab tu rje 'di bzhugs sar phebs pas/ rje nyid kyi gzim chung gi lcam rnams ma chag par/ lcam gyi 'og gi g.yam gdung shin tu bzang ba zhig yod pa chag grum che ba byung yang /

gzim chung gi thog byin la yang skyon chen po ma dmigs na/ sku la lta smros kyang ci dgos/ de dus rje nyid thugs g.yo med du bzhugs 'dug pa gzigs pa na/ yab rje grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid kyang 'di 'dra ngo mtshar che gsungs shing thugs shin tu dges pa zhig byung zhes mang po'i ngag las thos la/ 'di lta bu ni dam pa 'di'i sku tshe 'phreng ba mang por goms pa lhur mdzad pa'i stobs kyis sku tshe 'dir 'bad med du gzhung nas bshad pa'i nyams dang drod rtags kyi rim pa thams cad thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pas yi dam gyi byin gyis brlabs shing bar chad kyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i mtshan ma yang dag pa'o/ /de nas re zhig na gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtser sde srid mthu stobs drung sku ma bde bar/ de'i srung 'khor du 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po nyid spyan drangs nas der phebs rjes/ yab rje dam pa de nyid kyis rang gi rigs sras gsum gyi bsnyen rgyab mdzad de/ 'jam dbyangs mched gsum gyi grangs dus mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa thams cad mthar phyin par zin nas/ thugs spro ba mchog dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gdan sa mchog 'di nyid du phebs te/ bstan pa rin po che'i bgyi ba rnams la g.yel ba med par mdzad ces thos so/ /don de dag la 'di skad smras te/ dri bsung gis bos sbrang rtsi 'dzin pa'i tshogs/ /yid 'ong pad tshal ring nas bsnyegs pa ltar/ /grub brnyes rdo rje'i gling du gsung ngag gi /yid bzhin nor bu 'tshol 'dod rings par chas/ /bcu gcig lang 'tsho bdo pa'i ut+pa la/ /grub dbang nyin mor byed pa'i zhal dkyil las/ /yongs rdzogs gdams pa 'bum gyi zer 'thung bas/ /rnam dpyod ze'u 'bru gsar pa 'dzum zhing rgod/ /legs bshad sbrang rtsis skal bzang bung ba'i tshogs/ /dga' bde'i dpyid du gyur ba'i mtshan ma ni/ /'dzam gling khyon 'dir ma shongs dag pa'i zhing / /bde ba can dang 'chi med grong du'ang gsal/

/tshul des dkar po'i gos can rje btsun gsum/ /rmad byung gzigs mo'i mgron du bos pa snyam/ /skabs gsum gzhon nu dad pa'i sprin 'phreng las/ /mkha' la me tog sil ma'i dga' char 'bebs/ /de tshe grub dbang dges pa'i zhal/ /ma 'ongs bstan dang 'gro ba yi/ /dpal du khyod gcig mtho bo zhes/ /lung bstan rnga dbyangs dal bus 'jo/ /ring nas ji bzhin mngon gyur pa'i/ /ngo mtshar ltad mo'i ri mo ni/ /da lta bho ṭa'i ljongs na gsal/ /ltos shig dad pa'i mig ldan dag /grub gnyis myur 'jo zhi dang khro bo'i lha'i/ /rtsa ba snying po nye snying las sngags sogs/ /grangs dang dus kyi zab bzlas mthar phyin nas/ /rmi nyams ya mtshan de la ngo mtshar ci/ /rab 'byams mdo rgyud bcud phyung mngar mo'i ro/ /rnam dpyod ljags myong nyams rtogs sa 'dzin cher/ /bdud rigs ngan g.yo'i rdo yi 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /bsdigs kyang cung zad brdzi ba med de mtshar/ /zung 'jug rdo rje can dang gnyis med gar/ /rol rtsed bdag med mkha' 'gro'i snang brnyan gyi/ /ri mo ma bris gsal ba'i gzigs mo ni/ /zag med bdud rtsis myos pa'i spyan ras 'phrul/ /spyi don gnyis pa bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs te yab chos sogs la gsan sbyong ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ de nas bdag cag rnams kyi mtshungs pa med pa'i skyabs mgon/ zag pa'i tshogs ma lus pa rgyang ring du spangs shing / zag med kyi yon tan ma lus pa 'dus pa'i chos kyi gter chen 'di nyid gdul bya gzhan snang tsam du yang / gzhon nu khyim pa'i cha lugs 'chang ba nyid nas rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba med pa'i tshangs spyod gtsang ma'i tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs pa yin na yang / slad nas ston pa la phyag bya ba dang / bstan pa la phan pa'i bdag po'i rkyen nye bar sgrub cing / dam pa gong ma dag gis mdzad pa'i rgyun lam yongs su bsrings nas/ mdo las/ khyim pa rnams ni me 'ob na gnas pa lta bu'o/

/rab tu byung ba rnams ni bsil khang na gnas pa lta bu'o zhes dang / khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'khor ba'i khyim thab ni 'jigs shing nyam nga ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad kyi rtsa ba dang / mtho ris dang byang chub sgrub pa'i lam thams cad kyi gzhi chen po ni lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi bslab pa kho na'o/ /zhes gzhan dag la yang go bar bya ba'i phyir/ bdag nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i sgor yang dag par 'jug pa'i ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i tshul ston par bzhed nas/ dgung lo bcu bzhir phebs pa thun mong zhes pa lcags pho khyi'i lo gsar du tshes pa'i skabs/ thog mar ji ltar bzhed pa'i don de myur du 'grub pa'i ched du 'jam mgon sa paṇ+ḍi ta chen po la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa dngos grub mchog stsol 'dod don kun 'grub ces bya ba'i mjug tu/ de ltar rje btsun 'jam dbyangs chos rje la/ /snying nas thal sbyar gus pas gsol btab pas/ /bdag gi smon pa'i bsam pa 'di dag kun/ /khyed kyi thugs rjes legs par 'grub par shog /bdag ni rje btsun khyed kyi thugs rje yis/ /myur du ngur smrig gos kyis mdzes byas shing / /bslab gsum 'dul khrims yon tan gyis brgyan nas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin ltar 'byed par shog /khyad par rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dri med la/ /thos pa legs spyad de don rtogs pa dang / /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum kun la thogs med par/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar kun la rgyas par shog /bdag ni rab tu byung ba nas brtsams te/ /ji srid tshe 'di'i snang ba ma nub bar/ /khrims la gnas shing thos bsam sgom la sogs/ /rtag tu mi nyams gong nas gong 'phel shog /bdag ni skye ba kun tu dal 'byor gyi/ /lus 'di blang zhing chos dang mjal ba dang / /khyad par ngur smrig gos kyis mdzes byas shing /

/bslab gsum 'dul khrims yon tan gyis brgyan shog /bdag gis gtso byas 'gro drug sems can rnams/ /srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral bar ma gyur pa/ /rje btsun khyod kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis/ /myur du srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /bdag gis snying nas dad pas gsol btab pas/ /tshe 'dir las ngan sdig sgrib kun sbyangs nas/ /phyi ma sangs rgyas 'bras bu thob par shog /ces pa'i smon lam tshigs bcad dang / sbyar byang du yang ces pa 'di ni 'khon gyi rigs 'chang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang lo bcu bzhi'i thog 'jig rten la snying po med par nges shing rab byung yang myur du sgrub par 'dod pa dang / sdom gsum 'dzin bar la/ tshig don rnam dbye sogs nges shing mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob ste legs par sbyar ba'o/ /zhes pa'i sbyar byang dang bcas pa'i gsung rtsom kun gyi thog ma de nyid mdzad de/ thugs rgyud la rab tu 'byung bar bzhed pa'i lhag bsam ri gzar po'i 'bab chu'i rgyun ltar drag la rgyun mi chad pa rtag par yod pa bzhin/ 'jam mgon sa paṇ+ḍi ta chen por gsol 'debs rtse gcig pa'i mthu dang / 'jam dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can nyid kyi thugs rje chen po'i stobs kyis bzhed don lhun gyis grub ste/ lo de nyid kyi zla ba gsum pa'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi gza' skar bzang po 'dzoms pa'i nyin dpal sa skya'i dbu rtse rnying ma'i gtsug lag khang chen po'i sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen gyi sku gdung hril po bzhugs pa'i dngul gdung gi drung / sngon bdag nyid chen po sa paṇ+ḍi tas dbu lo'i phud dbul ba'i yul khyad par can thub pa'i dbang po'i sku brnyan rdo rje gdan chung mar grags pa mchod pa'i sprin phung dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar/ grub brnyes bde 'byung yongs kyi gtsug gi cod pan du zhabs zung zla ba'i rdul 'phreng rnyog pa med pa rab tu rtsen pa/

'jam pa'i dbyangs byams pa dpal ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po zhes grags dkar bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i dri ma ma lus pa bkru nus pa de nyid las so so thar pa'i dge bsnyen dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa rnam par dag pa/ nges par 'byung ba thugs kyi lhag bsam zla ba ltar dkar zhing dri ma med pas kun nas blangs te nye bar nod par mdzad de/ khyim pa'i rtags cha lugs thams cad gzhi mdo'i rtswa bzhin du 'dor bar mdzad nas/ ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan rmad du byung ba chu lha'i gos la co 'dri bar mdzad de/ de nyin 'jam mgon bsod nams dbang po thugs shin tu dges pa'i legs so'i gnang skyes zang zing gi dngos po stobs che ba dang / lhag par sku'i rten du thub dbang gi sku brnyan li ma byon gtsang ba/ gsung gi rten du lam 'bras glegs bam/ sdom gsum rang mchan dang bcas pa'i dpe/ thugs kyi rten lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa dngos gtsang ba gcig dang / yon tan 'phrin las kyi rten byed gsungs nas/ bka' gdams rkong bu kha dog gser mdangs can zhig mar dkar bzhus sa bkang nas sgron me sbar te grub mchog nyid kyi phyag nas gzhan gyi sug pa ma brgyud par rje 'di'i phyag tu stsal cing / dung dkar po yid du 'ongs pa zhig gnang nas 'di bus gsungs pa bzhin 'bud pa mdzad pas skad kyang shin tu che bar byung / dung de rjes su thub bstan lha chen gyi tshogs dung la rje 'dis 'bul ba mdzad nas da lta yang yod pa 'di yin zhes gsungs shing / de dus sgron me gnang ba ma zad kyi bar du gsal por 'bar ba dang / dung skad kyang bzang 'tsher byung ba de ni dus phyis rje 'dis grub mchog dbang po'i mtshan can nyid la gsan pa'i chos skor rnams cher spel bar mdzad pas/ grub dbang nyid kyi 'phrin las rgyun rma med pas bstan pa dang 'gro ba la phan bde bla na med pa bskrun par mdzad pa 'di'i rten 'brel dang /

sngags 'chang chen po'i sku gdung gi drung du rab byung gnang ba ni/ rje 'di ma 'ongs pa'i dus na sngags 'chang de nyid kyi mdzad pa bzhin rab byung gi bslab pa rnams phul te/ yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zol gyis dpal sa skya'i sde bstan pa gdung rgyud dang bcas pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i sgo nas snyigs ma las kyang cher snyigs ma'i dus 'dir/ kha ba can gyi skye 'gro ma lus pa'i mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen gcig pu lta bur gyur pa 'di'i rten 'brel la dgongs par kho bos sems so/ /zhes rje nyid gsungs so/ /de ltar rje nyid kyi bka' drin mtshungs bral gyi bla ma rnam pa gsum gyi grub mchog dbang po'i zhabs las legs spyad thams cad kyi rtsa ba so sor thar pa dge bsnyen dang dge tshul gyi bka' drin thob nas/ gzhan yang dam pa de nyid kyi drung du gsung ngag sogs gong du smos pa'i chos tshul rnams las gzhan pa'i snga phyir gsan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ slob dpon dze ta ri'i thugs bcud kyi nying khu rje btsun sa skya pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa zab mo/ /sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yan chad snyan brgyud kho nar bzhugs pa/ sngags 'chang de nyid kyis grub rgya gling pa pad rgyal gyi don du yi ger 'god par mdzad pa'i tshe sgrub kyi man ngag zab mo'i sgom lung / paṇ+ḍi ta nags kyi rin chen gyis slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la dngos su gsan pa'i tshe sgrub zab mo'i sgom lung / de'i yi ge grub mchog nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lung dang bcas pa/ paṇa chen nags rin nas brgyud pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi tshe sgrub/ de'i yi ge 'jam mgon nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lung dang bcas pa dang / tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang / ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo lugs kyi tshe dpag med kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba lan grangs mang po dang /

chos skyong gi skor la dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral gyi lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang / dpal stobs 'phrog nag po chen po tsa turmu kha sgrub dus thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang / gur gyi mgon po'i gsang ba'i las mkhan pu tra ming sring gsum gyi rjes gnang sogs dang / lung gi skor la/ kyai rdo rje'i bstod pa nyi shu pa slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ bstod pa daṇ+ḍa ka rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa/ rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i kun rig gi cho ga gzhan phan mtha' yas dang / cha gsum gtor ma'i cho ga gur drag gi 'phrin las gzhung rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i kyai rdo rje'i mngon rtogs/ lus dkyil/ dbang chu rnams kyi mdzes rgyan/ gur gyi mgon po'i bskang gso nag po mchod rten dam pa kun dga' grags kyis mdzad pa/ lha mo'i spyan 'dren de wi ko ṭa ma bdag chen blo gros pas mdzad pa/ bskang gso chos nyid ma dam pas mdzad pa/ sku dang gsung thugs ma bla ma mal gyis mdzad pa/ gtum chen ma sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa/ gdong bzhi pa'i bskang gso lha mchog ma bla ma gnyan lo tsā bas mdzad pa/ zhal gyi bskang gso stobs 'phrog ma dang / las mkhan gyi bskang gso bdag chen rgya gar bas mdzad pa/ lha mo'i bskang gso chung ba gzhan yang ma dang / las mkhan gyi bskang gso chung ba dam pas mdos bskang nas btus pa/ dkar bdud kyi bskang gso che ba bdag chen rgya gar bas mdzad pa dang / chung ba sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa/ bdud rtsi lnga mchod 'phags pas mdzad pa/ chos skyong gi dpang gzugs rgya gar gyi slob dpon bram ze nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa rnams dang / chos skyong gi bstod pa'i skor la/ mgon po'i bstod pa srin gzugs ma bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ lha mo'i bstod pa gang sku ma 'phags pas mdzad pa/

zhal gyi bstod pa dpal ldan dbang ldan ma chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ mgon po'i bstod pa sngon tshe ma/ lha mo'i bstod pa til mar ma/ zhal gyi bstod pa rdo rje 'chang dbang ma gnam kha'u pas mdzad pa/ mgon po'i bstod pa gang thugs ma 'phags pas mdzad pa/ lha mo'i bstod pa mi pham ma/ zhal gyi bstod pa pam̐ pad ma gnyan los mdzad pa/ mgon po'i bka' nyan nag po gnod sbyin sogs las mkhan lnga sgo ma bzhi dang bcas pa'i bstod pa rgyas pa mal los mdzad pa/ mgon po'i bstod pa hūm̐ yig ma/ lha mo'i bstod pa rgya klong ma/ zhal gyi bstod pa/ las mkhan gyi bstod pa dang bcas pa/ chos skyong 'khor bcas kyi bstod pa nag rngam ma theg chen rin po ches mdzad pa/ rab 'bar ma kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa/ mkha' 'gro spyi bstod/ zhal gyi bstod pa stong nyid ma bla ma dam pas mdzad pa/ mgon po'i drag bskul dus gsum rgyal ba ma 'phags pas mdzad pa/ lha mo'i drag bskul gson cig ma bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i lha mo'i bskang gso nas phyung ba/ las mkhan gyi bskul dam can mon bu ma bdag chen rgya gar bas mdzad pa/ rdo rje phur pa'i bzlog pa 'khor lo rtsibs bcu par grags pa/ ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i bzlog pa bdag chen rgya gar bas mdzad pa/ phur bsrung dam can bcu gnyis kyi bskul slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i lung rnams gsan zhing / gzhan yang sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ sngags 'chang chen po/ rje grub mchog nyid kyi bka' 'bum rnams gsan mod kyang / chos sna'i grangs rnams ni dam pa 'di nyid kyi gsan yig tu gsal ba ltar ro/ /de nas lo de nyid la gcen gnyis dang bcas te rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan bsod nams rtse mo sogs rje btsun gong ma sangs rgyas dang gnyis su ma mchis pa mang po'i byin gyis brlabs shing nye bar bsti ba'i gnas mchog chu mig bla brang ngam/ bde mchog pho brang du 'jam mgon 'khon rigs zla ba'i thig le 'dzin par byon pa rnams kyis thugs nyams su bstar ba'i yab chos 'phrin las kyi lha phur pa'i gsung bsnyen mthar phyin par mdzad cing /

de'i dus su rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid kyi mtshan ltas su/ rje nyid chos grwa chen po lha chen gyi lcags ri la zhabs skor mdzad pa'i lho lcog gi thad mdun na phebs skabs lha khang bla brang gi ngos la 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i dbus su gtso bo thub pa'i dbang po la 'khor gnas brtan bcu drug gnas g.yog gnyis/ chos skyong ba'i rgyal po chen po bzhi dang bcas pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can shin tu gsal ba gzigs te/ tshul de ni bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid kyi sku ring la chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha khang chen mo 'di nyid dar zhing rgyas pa'i rten 'brel dge mtshan du snang zhes nyid kyi gsung las dngos su thos la/ de lta'i skabs nas sngon sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen zhal bzhugs pa'i dus sa dkar 'dab 'dob nas/ gdan sa chen po'i gdung rgyud gcig sa dkar 'dab 'dob kyi 'dzin skyong sogs la phebs dgos pa'i snyan gsol phul kyang phebs thub pa zhig ma byung bar/ slar sngags 'chang 'gro ba'i mgon po grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i drung du snga sor gyi zhu gsol rgyun mthud de spyan 'dren gyi pho nya mngags pa'i ngor/ rje grags pa'i mtshan can des kyang khams phyogs kyi sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i gzhi che sa rang du dgongs nas/ rje 'di'i gcen 'jam pa'i dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug nyid mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi drung du rab tu byung ste/ khams phyogs la rdzong rta gnang ba bzhin zhabs 'bring pa'i tshogs mang po dang bcas chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur bar mdzad de/ gdan sa chen po'i sgrub mchod sogs 'phral gyi mdzad 'phrin rlabs po che rnams gcen sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal dang mched gnyis kyis phyin ci ma log par mdzad pa'i ring la mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen mang po klog pa thos bsam dang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched gnyis la yab chos mang du nod par mdzad de/

de yang 'jam mgon dbang po'i mtshan can nyid la gsan pa'i rnam grangs che long tsam zhig gong du bkod pa ltar yin zhing / yab rje chos kyi rgyal por snga phyir gsan pa mdzad pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ thog mar grub chen dze ta ri dgra las rnam rgyal gyi lugs kyi mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zab mo/ tshe dpag med kyi sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog bstod pa rnams slob dpon dze tā ris mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang bod kyi lo tsā ba lce dga' ba'i dpal gyis bsgyur pa rnams dang / sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i dkyil chog gi lung dang bcas pa/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo lugs kyi tshe dpag med kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i smin byed kyi thog ma bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor chen por stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i dbang bskur ba lan mang po dang / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du brgyud pa'i bka' bab bdun dang ldan pa'i dbang rnams dang / rjes gnang gi skor la/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang lan grangs mang po/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang gnyis kyi yi ge sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i lung dang bcas pa/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud nas bshad pa'i 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes gnang / sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi yi ge rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i lung dang bcas pa/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang sgo rum bse 'bag nag po 'phur shes dang / rdo mgon yid bzhin nor bu'i drung sogs su lan gsum/ gur gyi mgon po lcam dral gyi rjes gnang / gur gyi mgon po'i srung 'khor mdun gang ma dang / ser ba srung ba mdun gang 'phags pa'i srung 'khor gyi zhal shes rnams dang /

mgon dkar gyi tshe khrid zab mo'i yig cha'i lung / sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i gur gyi mgon po khro bcu'i srung 'khor bar chad kun sel gyi lung dang / de'i sgom don rnams ljags steng nas shin tu zhib pa dang / yang dpal gur gyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa mkha' 'gro sbags sgrub kyi tshul du sgrub pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi man ngag nang khrid du grags pa 'jam sgrub/ rtsub sgrub/ zhar byung gi man ngag dang bcas pa'i khrid yig sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i gzhan phan rgyas byed kyi lung khrid/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa bsnyen dus kyi rjes gnang / sgrub thabs rgya gzhung gi lung dang / gur mgon lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang dang / zhal bzhi pa bsnyen dus kyi rjes gnang gi yi ge sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i lung dang bcas pa/ 'phrin las rab tu myur ba'i dam can pu tra chen po'i rjes gnang zur bka'/ pu tra'i rjes gnang zur bka' rgyas bsdus byed tshul sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i lung dang bcas pa/ bran bdud gshin rje nag po yab yum gyi rjes gnang / de'i yig cha sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i lung dang bcas pa/ dpal nor skyong gi dbang po dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi rjes gnang / rjes gnang gi yi ge sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa dang / sgrub thabs sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ sgrub skor yar lung pas mdzad pa/ rjes gnang gtor chog chom rkun bsrung ba'i las tshogs dang bcas pa rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i lung dang bcas pa/ sa skya pa'i yab chos yang phur gnyis kyi srung ma dkar bdud lcam dral gyi rjes gnang / rjes gnang gi yi ge sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa dang / bskang gso che chung gi lung dang bcas pa/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i rjes gnang / rjes gnang gi yi ge mchod gtor 'bul tshul/ bskang gso rgyas bsdus rnams sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i lung dang bcas pa dang /

gzhan yang dpal mo lugs kyi bsnyung gnas kyi cho ga 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gzhung bzhi nyams su len tshul kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa dang / bya btang kun dga' mchog ldan gyis mdzad pa'i bsnyung gnas kyi chog sgrigs kyi lung / gdon sgrol gyi man ngag zab mo'i cho ga gnod sgrol gyi cho ga rin chen 'phreng mdzes thar pa rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang pas mdzad pa'i lung / slob dpon chen po a bh+ya ka ras mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'phreng bar gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi sgrub thabs rnal 'byor rdzogs 'phreng / dkyil chog rdo rje 'phreng ba/ sbyin sreg 'od kyi snye ma ste rgya gzhung 'phreng ba skor gsum gyi lung / rje thar rtse nas nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'phreng ba'i sgrub dkyil rdor 'phreng mdzes rgyan gyi lung / 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang pos mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs bya tshul gsang ba yid bzhin nor bu'i lung / 'jam dpal nag po'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa/ gu ge paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i 'jam dpal nag po'i sgrub thabs kyi lung / bslab bsdus nas gsungs pa'i lus bsrung ba'i rig sngags sgra mi snyan pa'i rang bsrung du grags pa/ 'di'i yig cha dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i lung dang bcas pa/ bde mchog dkar po'i tshe sgrub zab mo'i khrid lung dang bcas pa/ de'i yig cha 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mdzad pa dang / jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti sha'i thugs dam chos chung brgya rtsar grags pa chos sna brgya dang gsum gyi lung rnams dang / gso spyad kyi skor la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u drug bshad pa'i rgyud le'u sum cu so gcig man ngag gi rgyud le'u dgu bcu go gnyis/ phyi ma rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga mjug don yongs su gtad pa le'u gnyis te/ yongs dril le'u brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa drug yod pa rgyud bzhir grags pa'i lung /
