sgrub thabs kun las btus pa rgya mtshor grags pa lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur pa'i rgya gzhung yongs rdzogs kyi lung / rje thar rtse nas nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams kyi mngon rtogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i yi ge 'dod dgu'i ljon shing rin po che'i snye ma zhes bya ba'i lung dang / gzhan yang rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i sgrub skor logs na bzhugs pa gser pod du grags pa dkar chag nang bzhin yongs rdzogs kyi lung / sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid kyi gsung rab dri ma med pa rnams rje nyid kyis phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs par mdzad pa bzhin bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung rnams gsan par mdzad ces thos la/ de nas rje 'di dgung gi grangs gzhi bco lngar phebs pa 'gal byed ces pa lcags mo phag gi lo/ nyid kyi gcen grub mchog mthu stobs dbang phyug khams phyogs la chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur ba na/ dam pa de rje 'di la lhag par brtse ba zhig yod par brten/ rje 'di thugs shin tu 'phreng nas/ de dus gdung sel gyi tshigs su bcad pa zhig kyang mdzad gnang zhing / nyid kyi dgung lo bcu drug pa yongs 'dzin zhes pa chu pho byi ba dang / bcu bdun pa bag yod ces pa chu mo glang gi lo shar ba na/ dbus gtsang gi sde 'khrugs chen pos chos rgyal chen po g.yas ru byang pa dang / shar kha ba/ rin spungs pa/ rtse chen pa sogs dang / dbus nas yar rgyab dpon chen/ mnga' ris nas gung thang rgyal po/ de dag gi chab 'bangs su gtogs pa'i rgyal phran mang po dang bcas pa yul don phud/ chab 'bangs 'phrog phri sogs dbus gtsang gi ljongs 'dir dus min mtshon gyi bskal pa gsar du shar ba'i tshe/ dam pa 'dis spyir 'jig rten gyi khams kun bde ba'i thugs bskyed dang / khyad par bstan pa spyi sger gyi bstan skyong rnams chab srid dar zhing rgyas pa sogs kyi smon lam/

chos skyong la 'phrin 'chol sogs bstan 'gro la phan pa'i mdzad 'phrin bla na med pa kho na la gzhol bar mdzad pa'i mthus/ chos rgyal so so yang ha cang rgya khyon mi che yang thugs zos bde ba'i ngos/ skyong mi dka' ba'i chab 'bangs ji ltar 'tshams pa re dang bcas bde 'jags su bzhugs chog pa'i legs byas kyi dge mtshan gsal bar gyur pa dang / de lta'i skabs shig bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid/ gcen sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal dang mched gnyis kyis/ gan par bdag po dgra 'dul drung gis spyan 'dren gyi ngor phebs te/ der sde srid zhal ngo rnams la bka' chos kyi rigs mang po snga dro gcen gyis stsal cing / phyi dro bdag cag gi rnam 'dren bslu ba med pa'i skyabs mgon dam pa 'di nyid kyis gnang bar mdzad cing / de dus dbang mo che zhig gi skabs sngon ma rlung 'tshub shin tu che ba byung bar/ nyid kyi bka' sgrub zin 'phral/ byams pa'i dpal mnga' ma zhal 'don mang du mdzad nas grub mchog dbang po'i mtshan can la gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs par mdzad pas rlung rnams nyal gyis zhi zhing / bka' dbang grol nas rlung chen po langs pa na/ der yod thams cad kyis ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa yang byung zhes thos so/ /de nas 'gro ba kun gyi 'dren mchog mtshungs pa med pa'i nor bu 'di nyid dgung lo bco brgyad du phebs pa kun dga' zhes pa chu pho stag gi lo 'di ltar/ sngon gyi mdza' bshes mjal 'dod mes/ /thugs kyi chu gter khol ba'i tshe/ /yongs 'dzin zla ba'i 'phrin yig gi /bdud rtsi me de gzhom phyir zags/ /ring nas bcings pa'i las 'brel gyis/ /dam po'i mdud de ma grol lam/ /yang na bka' gdams yab dang sras/ /nam yang 'bral ba med pa'i dpe/ /rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs bang mdzod sgo/ /lhag bsam lde mig gis phye ste/ /dgos dgu 'byung ba bsnyen rdzogs kyi/ /bslab khrims yid bzhin mdo sngags kyi/

/zab dgu gdams pa'i nor mang dang / /bcas te len 'dod de nas song / /zhes bdag cag gi rnam 'dren bslu ba med pa 'di nyid sku gzhon nu nyid nas bu mo mu tig gi 'khri shing can gyis/ sangs rgyas zhes pa'i snyan pa'i glu dbyangs thos pa ltar/ 'khor lo sdom pa ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi mtshan thos pa tsam na/ zhal gyi chu skyes blta 'dod dang / gsung gi bdud rtsi gsol bar bzhed pa'i dad 'dun bla lhag tu yod pa dang / slar yang rje de'i rnam par thar pa 'ga' zhig gsan pa'i rkyen byas zhal dkyil gzigs pa snga phyi la rgyas pa lta bur yod pa'i tshe/ nyid kyi gcen bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug nyid khams nas gdan sa chen por phebs te/ de'i gnas tshul dang / lhag par mthu stobs dbang phyug nyid rje mus pa chen po mjal bar bzhed pa'i snga 'gros 'bul ba'i rkang mgyogs la/ dpal sa skya nas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i thugs dam gsung shog gnang ba'i lan du/ rje mus chen bud+dha'i mtshan can de nyid kyis/ yab rje grags pa'i mtshan mnga' ba der/ rang gi bzhed don 'grub par zhu gsol gyi gsung 'phrin 'di ltar stsal bar mdzad de/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rin po che'i zhabs kyi pad+mo dam pa'i drung du/ zhu ba/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum mngon par mtho zhing rnam dkar gyi mdzad 'phrin gong 'phel du bzhugs pa'i skabs nas gsung shog dam rdzas gnang sbyin/ zhabs drung sgar chen 'di phyogs su phebs pa'i bslab ston dang bcas pa spyi bor phebs pas bka' drin che lags/ phul don/ bdag khyer 'khos chung pa dang / 'di phyogs mtha' 'khob tu song bas/ zhabs drung sgar chen dpon slob nyung shas gcig gi zhal bkod gnang nas zla ba 'di dang bcu pa'i bar tsam la 'dir phebs pa tsam byung na legs pa gda'/

ched gtad phul don/ bdag na so mthar phyin pa dang / snga mo nas 'dun pa yod pa dang / gling kha gdan sa yang lo mang rab song ba nas/ cis kyang khams kyis ma lcogs pa lags pas/ 'di kha'i mkhan po'i 'os rigs zhabs drung sku gzhon pa 'os su shar ba lags pas/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa sku mched kyis kyang nā len+d+ra la sogs pa'i zhal bdag mdzad nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sems can gyi bde skyid la shin tu phan pa byung 'dug pa ltar/ dpal sa skya pa yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa yi dam chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi dam tshig la dgongs nas 'di kha'i mkhan po la zhabs drung sgar chen dang stabs gcig tu gnang ba thugs rje che ba mkhyain lags/ bdag rang gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i zhal ngo gong ma thams cad kyi zhabs tog tu 'gyur ram snyam pa'i 'dod 'dun rtse gcig pa lags pas/ dgongs pa mi 'gal ba'i ngos nas cis kyang gnang ba thugs rje che ba mkhyain lags/ 'di'i rtsis bzhes gnang nas/ gdan sar phebs dgos shar kyang thag ring mi 'dug pas phar byon tshur byon mdzad pas 'thus pa 'dug pa/ gang spyi'i bslab ston mig phye ba 'dra ba zhig thugs tsha la sbyar ba dang bcas gnang ba mkhyain lags/ gtsang par dpon drung mkhyud nas bkod yig zhu mkhan bdag tsho rang gis brdzangs yod pas/ zhabs drung rin po che de kar dbu bsnyung mdzad dka' log blta la sogs pa gtan nas yong ba med mchis pas dgongs pa rin po cher bzhugs pa zhu zhu lags/ zhu yig spyan zur g.yo rten gser zho do la rgya ldan phul/ ces bla ma gong ma'i zhabs 'degs dang / bstan 'gro la dgongs pa'i thugs bskyed rlabs po ches nye bar drangs shing / dus gsum sgrib med du gsal bar gzigs pa'i ngang tshul can gyi sgo nas sngags 'chang 'gro ba'i mgon po gang der zhu 'phrin nan bskyed de bzhin 'bul bar mdzad pa dang dus mnyam du/ bdag cag gi skyobs pa mtshungs pa med pa 'di nyid la yang gsung shog 'di ltar stsal pa yin te/

'jam dbyangs rin po che'i drung du/ zhu ba/ da lam phul don/ bdag na so rgas pa dang / khams kyis cis kyang ma lcogs par brten/ khyod gling kha bde ba can gyi mkhan po la 'os rigs su shar ba lags pas/ sngon yang sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa sku mched/ bdag chen kun bkras pa rnams kyis nā len+d+ra dang gling kha la sogs pa'i zhal bdag mdzad nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sems can gyi bde skyid la shin tu phan pa byung 'dug pa ltar/ khyed kyis kyang dpal sa skya pa yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa/ yi dam bka' srung rnams kyi dam tshig la dgongs 'di kha'i mkhan por/ zhabs drung sgar chen dang lhan cig mdzad nas zla ba bcu pa'i tshes brgyad mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i dus chen lags pas/ 'di thog phebs thub pa zhig cis kyang mkhyain lags/ yab rin po cher yang rgyu mtshan nan che ba rang phul yod lags shing / gtsang par bkod yig zhu mkhan yang 'di kha nas btang yod pas dgongs bzhugs mkhyain/ 'dir 'byon gong sngags 'chang chen po'i dngul gdung la snyan dar dang / sgo rum bskyed lhas su bskang gso brgya tshar zhig cis kyang mdzad nas phebs pa zhu/ zhu yig gzigs rten bkra shis pa'i kha btags la rgya mdzes phul/ zhes pa'i thugs dam gsung shog phebs pa na/ char 'dod kyi byi'u dbyar skyes kyi sgra thos pa ltar thugs dgyes spro'i mchog dang ldan par gyur cing / de ltar rje btsun mus pa chen po des bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa 'di la/ bstan pa rin po che spyi sger gyi khur chen 'degs bzod pa'i bstan 'dzin gnyis 'thung dbang por dgongs pas rang nyid la ji ltar mnga' ba'i chos dang / bdag gir mdzad pa'i dgon gnas dang bcas pa bstan pa gtad pas/ snyigs dus su dge legs phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar ye shes kyi gzigs pa dri ma med pas ji ltar gsal ba ltar/ bdag nyid chen po yab sras rnam pa gnyis la zhu 'phrin phul bas mtshams sbyar zhing /

gzhan yang dam pa 'di dang rje mus pa chen po de nyid ni sku'i skye ba du mar dpon slob tu 'brel pas/ slar yang bstan 'gro'i don la bsam bzhin pas dpon slob nyi zla'i snang brnyan du shar te/ de'i tshul yang bdag cag gi skyabs mgon bslu ba med pa 'di nyid sku gzhon nu'i dus/ grub brnyes gong ma'i rnam thar gyi dpe la gzigs rtog mdzad pa'i rkyen byas/ nam 'chi cha med kyi tshe thung 'di la/ tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa gcig bya dgongs pa dang / yang na 'chad nyan dang thugs dam spel mar mdzad de/ mi tshe stong zad du ma song ba zhig cis kyang bya dgongs shing / de dag gang byed kyang bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gcig dang ma mjal ba'i thabs mi 'dug dgongs pa sogs chos dang mthun pa'i thugs kyi lhag bsam zla ba tshes pa ltar bzo med du 'khrungs pa zhig yod 'dug cing / khyad par mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par thar pa cung zad tsam thos pa'i mod la/ mjal 'dod kyi thugs 'dun zhe nas dung dung pa yang yang thugs rgyud la 'khrungs shing / rje de la chos thos pa dang / sku drung nas 'ongs pa yin zer ba'i grwa pa sogs dang mjal ba na yang / khyed rnams re dga'/ bla ma sangs rgyas de lta bu mjal 'dug dgongs pa dang / de dang mtshungs par snga gong 'jam pa'i dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug rje mus chen drung du rab tu byung dang / dbang rjes gnang sogs gsung chos mang po gsan nas phebs skabs/ rje mus pa'i rnam par thar pa 'dra gsungs pa na/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis/ bdag kyang rje de dang mjal nas chos thob pa zhig byung na dga' ba la zhu ba mdzad pa dang / thugs la yang mjal 'dod je 'phel du song ba zhig byung gsungs shing / yang lan cig rje btsun mus pa chen po bud+dha dh+wa dza de nyid kyis ngam ring chos kyi rgyal khab tu sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis kyi dbang gnang ba grub 'phral/ dpon gtsang rtsa brgyad nas lha 'byor drung gdan sa chen por byon pa'i tshe/

khong gi phyag la dpung skud cig 'dug pa rje 'dis gzigs nas khyed kyis nye stabs dbang su la zhus gsungs pas/ rje mus chen la sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis kyi dbang thob pa lags zer ba dang / rje mus pa'i rnam thar gyi gsung gleng cung zad tsam byung ba'i tshe yang / nged kyang bla ma sangs rgyas de dang mjal nas chos thob pa'i dus shig e yong na zhes kyang gsungs shing thugs la yang de bzhin 'khrungs par snang la/ de nas skabs shig rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo de nyid ngam ring du mi dbang chen po mjal ba la phebs 'dug dus/ rje mus chen nyid kyang ngam ring na gdan chags pa'i skabs yin pa nas/ de dus rje 'di'i thugs la/ da lta gangs can gyi khrod na dge ba'i bshes gnyen thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin nas mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan ma lus pa'i mnga' bdag tu gyur cing / lhag par dad ldan gyi slob bu la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu stsol nus pa/ mngon par mkhyen pa thogs med du mnga' ba'i skyes bu rje mus chen las gzhan med do zhes dpyod ldan gzur gnas mang po'i ngag las thos pa ltar/ rang nyid kyang snying nas yid ches thob pa la brten/ da ni kho bo cag 'di phyi bar do gsum gyi skyabs gnas dang 'dren pa zhu ba'i blo rtse'i gtad mtshams kyi yul 'jam dbyangs sku mched zhal rnam pa gnyis dang / rje 'di kho na las gzhan med par dgongs te/ nyid kyi yum rin mo che brgyud pa'i rje mus chen du zhu 'phrin 'di ltar 'bul bar mdzad de/ bdag tshe ha cang mi ring ba zhig byung na thos bsam rgya cher byas pa la don mi 'dug pas/ tshe ring thung 'ong dang / thog mar mdo sngags gang la sbyang na legs dang / dbu zhwa sogs sku drag phog nges pa'i na bza' zhig byin rlabs rten du gnang ba dang / sems la phan pa'i bslab ston zhig gnang dgos zhu ba mdzad 'dug par/

de'i lan du rje mus chen nas/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs drung du/ zhu ba/ sku gsung thugs rab tu dwangs shing rnam dkar gyi dge ba la brtson par bzhugs skabs nas/ bka' shog dam rdzas kyi gnang sbyin dang bcas spyi bor phebs pas bka' drin che lags/ sku cha btab pas sku tshe ring po yong ba gda'/ thugs sbyong sngon ma gang la mdzad pa dga' btab pas/ mdo mdzad pa dga' bar gda'/ thugs sbyong gnang gong mi g.yo ba dkar po'i bsnyen pa zhig mdzad na legs pa gda' lags/ thugs dam slob gnyer la sogs pa gang mdzad na'ang thugs rtse dkon mchog la gtad/ nges 'byung drag po'i sgo nas rgyud bskul/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi bsam pas mdzad dgos te/ sa paṇa gyis/ mdor na chos kyis ci byed soms/ /sangs rgyas byed na chos bzhin gyis/ /zhes dang / mus chen sems dpa' chen pos/ nyams su len pa'i chos la/ /blo snying brang gsum gtad nas/ /sems snang chos su sres shig /'di phyi bar do gsum du/ /'di yis bslu ba med pas/ /ma nor lam la 'bungs shig /ces gsungs pa sogs mang dag gda' na'ang yi ge mang dogs ma bris lags/ mdor na snga mu ltar thugs dam thugs sbyong ris med bstan pa dgongs nas mkhyen/ zhu yig gzigs rten tshe mdud la rgya mdzes phul/ zhwa mo sogs bdag gi dri phog pas 'bul ma nus/ zhes pa'i gsung phebs 'dug pa de'i nang du/ mi g.yo ba dkar po'i bsnyen pa mdzad dgos par gsungs pas de ni/ sngon gyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyis slob ma 'ga' zhig la rten 'brel sgrig par mdzad pa'i tshe yang / mi g.yo ba dkar po'i rjes gnang sogs gnang 'dug pa dang mtshungs par/ rnam 'dren dam pa 'di la yang rje btsun mus pa chen po de'i gsung gi bdud rtsis thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gtams shing thugs yid gcig tu 'dres nas gtan du legs pa'i 'dun ma zin pa'i rten 'brel gyi thog ma de dus nas sgrig par mdzad pa la the tshom cung zad kyang dgos pa ma yin no/

/zhes rje nyid gsungs shing / de dang tshul mtshungs par rje 'di dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi gzim chung mkha' spyod du bzhugs pa'i dus shig tho rangs kyi tshe mnal lam du/ byas 'gyur dgon pa'i bla brang nub kyi rje btsun gyi chos khri na rje bla ma mus pa chen po 'di yin zer ba'i bla ma bag dro ba gzi brjid can zhig 'dug pa la/ phyag na mi rkang gi gling bu zhig bsnams nas 'bud bzhin pa dang bcas/ 'di bus pas mgon po mthong yong gi gda' zer ba la/ rje 'dis rkang gling de bzhes nas 'bud par mdzad pa na/ skad kyang ha cang che ba ma byung zhing / chos skyong yang gzigs rgyu ma byung ba'i mod/ de ma thag bla ma de'i sku drung nas chu chen po zhig thol gyis brdol byung bas/ rje nyid kyis sa skyor sogs thabs mkhas kyis bskyil bas rdzing bu che ba'i tshad tsam zhig byung ba snyam mdzad cing / de 'phral nyi ma yang zer gyis bzhud song ba 'dra ba zhig byung ba dang mnal sad/ de dus nyi ma bzhud pa'i rnam pa de lta bu sogs legs pa'i ltas rang ci 'dra yin nam snyam pa'i thugs thing nge ba zhig byung snang yang / dus phyis mtshan ltas kyi don la brtags pas/ nyi ma nub pa de rgyal yum de nyid sku ma gshegs gong rje mus chen dang mi mjal ba'i ltas dang / rje rang gis rkang gling 'bud pa mdzad par sgra ha cang che rgyu ma byung ba sogs ni/ rje btsun mus chen de nyid chos skyong gi mnga' bdag tu bzhugs kyang rje 'di nyid kyis bla ma de las rjes gnang khrid dang man ngag gi dpe chung gis mtshon pa'i chos skyong gi chos skor rags pa tsam zhig ma gtogs/ dpe lung sogs zhib tu mi gsan pa'i brda' dang / sku drung nas chu brdol ba rdzing bur bskyil ba de ni gzhan bde kye gsang gsum/ yo ga sogs gtso bor gyur pa'i sa skya pa'i yab chos mu mtha' med pa zhig gsan pa'i rtags yin pa 'dug ces dam pa 'di nyid kyi zhal las dngos su thos pa lags/

des na dam pa 'di dang rje mus chen bud+dha'i mtshan can de nyid zhal dngos su ma mjal gong du yang mtshan lam sogs su gsal por byon nas ma 'ongs pa 'byung 'gyur lung ston par mdzad pas na/ sku tshe'i 'phreng ba dpag tu med pa nas dpon slob tu 'brel ba'i dge mtshan yang dag pa ste/ don de dag la ni nyid kyi gsung las/ thog med 'khor bar yang yang 'khyams pa'i tshe/ /rgyun chad med par thugs rjes skyong mdzad pa'i/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin khyod kyi/ /mtshan gyi yi ge rna bar lhung tsam gyis/ /rab dga'i sa thob pas kyang mi 'gran pa'i/ /dga' spro'i ting 'dzin brtan pos bdag rgyud gtams/ /mthong ba med kyang rnam pa blo yul du/ /wal wal dran pa nyin mo'i cha kun dang / /mtshan dus rmi lam du yang brjed ma gyur/ /e ma dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa yi/ /'jigs rung srid mtsho sgrol ba'i ded dpon de'i/ /zhal mthong gsung gi bdud rtsi thob pa zhig /nam zhig 'byung snyam sems pa kho na las/ /yid la bya ba'i skabs gzhan 'phrogs gyur te/ /mgo la me shor bzlog lta'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /de don sgrub pa'i thabs la rab brtson pas/ /shul ring lam gyi ngal ba ji snyed pa/ /ji mi snyam pa'i dga' spro'i ngang du gnas/ /de nyid tshe na rten 'brel gzhan dbang 'gas/ /lus ni dpal ldan sa skyar gnas gyur kyang / /sems ni rigs kyi bdag po mus pa rje'i/ /phyogs su yang yang rgyug la ngal ba med/ /de 'dra'i ngang tshul nyid la re zhig gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /de ltar rje btsun bslu med dam pa 'di dang / rgyal dbang bud+dha'i mtshan can de nyid sku tshe mang po'i sngon rol nas yang dag pa'i dpon slob tu 'ching byed legs pa'i smon lam gser gyi skud pas dam por bcings pas/ rkyen gzhan gang gis 'grol mi nus pa nyid kyi phyir nam yang 'bral ba med pa nyams dang /

mtshan lam tshun chad zhal gyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba zhig yin yang / gzhan ngor rje btsun sa bcu'i dbang phyug bud+dha rat+na dang gnyis su med pa 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi zhal gyi chu skyes dkar po mjal thabs la kun tu 'grus pa sbrang rtsi don du gnyer ba rkang drug pa'i tshogs bzhin te/ de yang bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa 'dis dkar shākya grags kyis bzhengs pa'i rje btsun rin po che'i sku brnyan mdze thod mar grags pa byin rlabs kyi dpal 'bad med du 'jo ba la rje btsun dngos dang khyad par ma mchis pa 'di'i drung du mchod pa'i 'phreng ba dpag tu med pa dang bcas gsol ba btab nas dgongs pa'i bzhed don gtso che ba 'ga' zhig lung bstan zhu ba mdzad pa'i rnam grangs la/ 'brel tshad don ldan gyi bla ma rje mus chen nyid dang mjal ba zhig ji ltar yong dang / tshe 'di blos btang gi sgrub pa zhig byas na bar snang la 'phur nus pa'i grub thob cig gi las skal yod med/ yang tshe 'dir bshad sgrub spel mar byas na bar dor 'bras bu 'grub pa zhig ci 'dra yong rnams zhu ba mdzad pa sogs mdor na thabs 'phrul sna tshogs pa zhig gi sgo nas rje btsun mus pa chen po dang mjal zhing / gsung gi bdud rtsi gsol ba'i phyir du 'bad rtsol cher mdzad de/ bzhed don de nyid ji bzhin du 'grub par mngon du phyogs pa la nye ba na/ 'jam mgon bla ma 'di nyid kyi rgyal yum dam pa lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo zhes bya ba rje nyid la mchog tu thugs brtse zhing bka' drin can de nyid glang lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nub mo zhi bar gshegs te/ bzod thabs med pa'i thugs las drag pos kun tu gzir zhing / gang la yang snying po med par rtogs pa'i nges 'byung chen pos sku tshe blos btang gi sgrub pa kho na la thugs phyogs par gyur pa'i ring nas/ rgyal yum dam par thugs brtse ba chen po'i dbang las yum de nyid dag pa'i zhing du skye ba'i smon lam yang dag pa rang nyid kyis kyang mdzad cing /

khyad par du rje mus pa chen por lam ston byang bu zhu ba'i gsung chog zhu ba dang mnyam du/ sngar rje btsun gyi sku 'dra'i drung du lung bstan zhus pa'i bzhed don gyi rnam grangs rnams dang / lhag par bka' drin can gyi yum de gang du 'khrungs yod rnams la lung bstan gsal ba zhig dgos tshul zhu ba gnang 'dug pa'i lan du/ rje btsun mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa gang des gsung shog 'di ltar stsal te/ 'jam dbyangs rin po che'i zhabs drung du/ zhu ba/ sku'i dkyil 'khor mngon par mtho zhing thos bsam sgom gsum la thugs brtson par bzhugs skabs nas gsung shog gos gser ma dang bcas gnang ba thugs la btags/ yum rin mo che cho 'phrul gyi tshes bco lnga la sku tshe'i tshad rdzogs pa ltar mdzad nas gshegs pa de/ bya ba khams chen byung 'dug lags kyang / 'di ltar skyes pa thams cad kyi/ /mdun na gnas pa 'chi ba yin/ /zhes dang / mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi/ /rdo rje'i sku yang mi rtag na/ /chu shing snying po med 'dra ba'i/ /chu sbur lus la smos ci dgos/ /zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa ltar 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag par gda' ba/ yin lugs kyang kun rdzob tu chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu dang / don dam par spros bral yin par thugs la bzhugs par zhu lags/ lung bstan byed pa la sa dang po chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong dgos mod/ bdag lta bu la de'i cha dang po tsam gyi yon tan med pas lung bstan gang la yong lags/ yum de mkha' 'gro'i mtshan rtags tshang ba dang / grongs rkyen dang / grongs dus zhal ngo rnams kyi byin rlabs la brten/ gnas mthon por 'khrungs pa gzhir bcas su 'dug lags/ zhabs drung rin po che rang la bshad sgrub gnyis ka la mo bzang ba rang 'dug lags/ rang re mjal ba yong zer ba babs lags/ da phyin thugs dam dang thugs gnyer spel bar gnang mdzod la/ nyams len gang mdzad dang bya ba gang mdzad thams cad dkon mchog gsum la mgo bcad pang skyur gyi tshul du thog khel gyis rtse gcig tu gtod par zhu lags/

slar sku tshe ring zhing bkra shis la thugs bsam chos bzhin du 'grub par smon lags/ sku rim srung 'khor yang ched gtad sgrub lags pas/ bde kye yo ga gsum gyi rgyud man ngag gzhung phran dang bcas pa rnams gzigs rtogs phul phyin rang sa ngor gnyis kyi bstan pa thugs la bzhag pa mkhyen/ cis kyang dgos gsungs pa nas zhu yig spyan zur g.yo rten bo dhi tsit+ta'i 'phreng ba la rgya mdzes phul/ zhes pa'i gsung 'phrin gnang ba gzigs pa na/ thugs dga' ba dang spro ba tshad las 'das pas nye bar myos pa'i gsung las kyang / nem nem dam po'i lag gi khyogs su blangs/ /reg reg lus kyi phyag rgyas dam mdud bkrol/ /zim zim mig gis yig gzugs mthong ba'i don/ /sim sim snying gi khang bur brtan par bzhugs/ /zhes kyang gsungs shing / de ltar rgyal ba bskrun pa'i yum de nyid zhing gshegs nas ha cang mi ring ba'i tho rangs kyi cha zhig na rje'i mtshan ltas su rgyal yum de nyid gsal bar byon pa la/ zhing brjes pa'i snang ba ma 'gags bzhin du/ deng sang a ma lags mngal sgo mi rnyed pa'i 'o brgyal chen po mi 'dug lags sam/ zhes gsungs pa la/ yum gyi gsung las/ de tsam gyi sdug bsngal rang mi 'dug cing / khyad par de la 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyis lung bstan byung nas/ byang khog tu mi'i skye ba zhig len rgyu yin/ de'i nang nas kyang bla ma gcig yong rgyu yin gsungs byung ba na/ rje 'dis de ma thag yum bka' drin can khyed rang gi chos gzhis rnams kyang bdag gis ma 'thor ba byed gsungs pa snyam mdzad pa'i mod la mnal sad pa na/ thugs dga' ba dang skyo ba zung 'brel du gyur pa zhig byung gsungs shing / de ni rje mus chen la lam ston zhu ba mdzad skabs/ rgyal yum nyid la spyir mi lus thob pa dang / khyad par bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen du 'gyur ba'i tshul gyi lung bstan 'byung ba'i rtags yin pa 'dug ces rje nyid kyi gsung las thos la/

de dang mtshungs par 'jam mgon grub pa'i dbang po dge sding na bzhugs pa'i drung du yang thugs dam gsal 'debs 'bul bar mdzad pa na/ de'i lan du grub mchog dbang po'i zhabs kyis zhal gdams bka' shog 'di ltar gnang ste/ oṃ swa sti/ bslu med lam ston sngags 'chang chen po la/ /sgo gsum gus pas rtse gcig gsol btab nas/ /dam tshig ldan pa kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /rab dga'i sar gnas byang chub sems dpa' che/ /bsod nams bye ba'i dbus su cher grags pa/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan g.yo med 'dzin pa yi/ /dpal ldan skal ba bzang po gang de la/ /yon tan kun bral bya btang rgan po yis/ /snying gtam dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba/ /tshig gsum 'bul lo yengs med gsan par zhu/ /thog med dus nas legs bskyangs drin can gyi/ /ma de gum pa shin tu ma legs mod/ /'on kyang rang re thams cad de ka'i rgyu/ /yin par ma zad sems can thams cad kyang / /pha ma yin mnyam khyad par med pa la/ /la la shi na mi dga' la la dga'/ /shi ba la ni dga' rgyu ga la yod/ /des na thams cad de las ma 'das phyir/ /'di phyi kun tu phan nges dam chos yin/ /de phyir chos la 'bad 'bungs bskyed par zhu/ /de yang chos kyi rtsa ba tshul khrims nyid/ /nges par yin pas mig 'bras bzhin du srungs/ /de yi bsrung tshul bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / /rtsa bzhi chang dang lnga po 'di dag rnams/ /srog dang bsdos la bsrung sdom nan tan mdzod/ /de 'dra'i spang blang tshul bzhin shes 'dod na/ /thos pa med pas mi 'grub thos pa la/ /nyin mtshan kun tu g.yel ba med pa 'tshal/ /thos pa'ang tshig rkyang kho na ma yin par/ /de yi don la legs par bsam byas te/ /yin min legs nyes the tshom dra ba kun/ /legs par bcad de tshig don zab mo la/ /tshe 'di'i rnam g.yengs 'du 'dzi log pa yi/ /zas dang gnyid kyi 'du shes rab spangs nas/ /rtse gcig sgoms la skyo ngal med par 'tshal/

/de yi rgyu mtshan zla ba grags pa yis/ /skye bo tshul khrims rkang pa chag gyur na/ /sbyin pas longs spyod ldan yang 'gro ngan ltung / /zhes sogs gsungs shing / gzhan yang de nyid las/ tshul khrims 'chal bas ngan 'gror de 'gro ste/ de la thos pa mang pos skyob mi nus/ /zhes gsungs thos bsam sgom gsum dgos par yang / mkhyen pa'i mnga' bdag dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ /rgya chen gzhung la thos pas mi ngoms shing / /de don bsam pas sgro 'dogs legs bcad de/ /ji bzhin bsgom pa'i ye shes nyi ma yis/ /bdag med rtogs pa'i pad tshal rgyas par shog /ces sogs mdo rgyud bstan bcos du ma nas/ /legs par gsungs tshul ji snyed yod na yang / /thams cad 'di ru 'bri bar ga la nus/ /thos bsam sgom pas rang rgyud smin pa'i rjes/ /zab mo'i lam gyis gzhan rgyud kun grol te/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka bslu med sar 'khrid pa'i/ /don gnyis bsgrub la brtson 'grus bskyed par mdzod/ /de rnams snying gtam mdor bsdus tsam zhig yin/ /zhib par ngos kyis gleng ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /'di ltar rgan po'i lhag bsam dag pa dang / /dam tshig can gyi sems bskyed zab mo yis/ /snying nas sngags 'chang chen por gsol 'debs na/ /ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di ni rang gi tsha bo kun dga' bsod nams kyi ma 'das dus sems ngal dub spangs pa'i phyir/ sngags 'chang chen po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos gus pas blangs pa bya btang rgyal khams pa 'khrul zhig dbang pos myur bar bris te phul bas bsam pa yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig ces pa'i zhal gdams kyang gnang ste/ de'i rkyen gyis rgyal yum dam pa gshegs pa'i thugs las kyang cung zad zhi zhing / grub dbang de nyid la thugs dad kyang je 'phel du song ba zhig byung zhes kyang gsungs so/ /don 'di dag la 'di skad smra ste/ yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten tshul khrims zhes/

/bde gshegs gsung gi chu brgya snyan gyi mtshor/ /'khyil pas 'dus byas mtha' bzhi'i ngang tshul la/ /nges 'byung byang chub sems kyi wu 'phreng 'phyur/ /chos 'dul rdzing bur dad ldan ngang pa'i bu/ /bsti 'dod dad pas myos pa'i glu dbyangs dpyid/ /'jam pa'i mgon der gsol 'debs dril bu'i sgra/ /snyan por gsil ba'i mgrin pa'i rnam 'gyur brel/ /srid pa'i gdung sel grub dbang ma la ya'i/ /'khri shing mkhyen brtse'i 'dab brgya bzhad pa las/ /dri bsung 'thul ba'i tshul khrims dngar ba'i bcud/ /khyod thugs dri med shel gyi yol gor 'khyil/ /'jam mgon nam mkha'i nor bu'i zhal dkyil las/ /mdo sngags chos tshul 'od 'phreng 'bum 'thungs pas/ /rnam dpyod chu skyes rgod pa'i bdud rtsi'i ro/ /don gnyer bung ba'i gnyen du mngon par phyogs/ /brtse ldan kirti ma ti'i thugs kyi bcud/ /bsil ldan dbang dang lam gyi 'od ris brgya/ /gang thugs 'dzin mar gsal 'di gzhan gyis min/ /khyod kyi don gnyer mes po'i pir gyis bris/ /'jam mgon zung gi gdams pa'i chu rgyun 'bum/ /rnam dpyod snyim pas gsol yang ma ngoms par/ /mtha' yas chos mtsho mus pa'i thugs 'jings nas/ /zab yangs hub kyis gsol la rings par chas/ /khyod ni nor bzang rgyal sras rtag tu ngu / /chos dang bshes gnyen 'tshol la 'grus pa bzhin/ /dad ldan mig gi bdud rtsir 'gran 'dod kyi/ /dad dang brtson pa'i lang tsho ngom pa'am/ /yang na tshe rabs sngon gyi mdza' ba'i bshes/ /mus pa'i zla dbang dag snang kun gsal du/ /mngon sum gsal yang mjal thabs zla ba'i gzugs/ /chu brgya'i 'phrul 'di gzhan dag drang phyir mdzad/ /e ma bshes gnyen btsal ba'i phyir/ /mdzad pa'i 'phrul thabs bye bas ci/ /rgyal kun yab gcig 'jam pa'i dpal/ /gang de khyod dang dbyer yod dam/ /'khor lo sdom pa ngur smrig gos kyis lo mdzes zab don man ngag g.yur du za/

/snyan pa'i gsung dbyangs dngar ba'i dri bsung phyogs brgyar 'thul ba ljon pa'i dbang po der/ /mkhyen dang brtse ba'i 'dab brgya rab dmar mthu stobs ze'u 'bru rgod pa las/ /skal bzang bung ba yongs kyi rtsa lag pad dkar 'jam dpal 'dud 'di gzigs mor che// ༈ //gsum pa rnam 'dren dam pas rjes su bzung zhing gang gi rgyal tshab tu mnga' ji ltar gsol ba'i tshul ni/ de nas bdag cag gi gtan gyi dpung gnyen bla na ma mchis pa 'di nyid dgung gi lo bco brgyad du phebs pa kun dga' zhes pa shing pho stag lo'i mjug srin po zhes pa shing mo yos kyi lo gsar du tshes pa la nye ba'i stag lo'i zla ba bcu pa'i tshe/ rje btsun chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes mtshan gyi rnga dbyangs rna bar lhung ba tsam gyis kyang / dad ldan gyi snying gi chu skyes bzhad par nus pa de nyid kyis slar yang sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por rting bskul gyi zhu yig rgyas pa dang / bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid la yang / 'jam dbyangs rin po che'i zhabs drung du/ zhu ba/ sku'i dkyil 'khor mngon par mtho zhing thos bsam la mi g.yel ba bka' drin bskyangs pa'i skabs nas phyag dam gong snam gyi rten dang bcas gnang ba thugs la btags/ snga mor zhabs drung yab rin po cher rgyu mtshan phul ba ltar/ da lan bskyar bskul nan zhus rang phul lags pa/ zhabs drung sgar chen phebs na de mthun dang / mi phebs na yang hor zla bcu gcig bcu gnyis khongs su phebs thub pa zhig cis kyang mkhyen/ sku zhang rin po che la zhal ngo bgres gzhon tshang mas bka' drin bskyangs pa thugs rjes bzung lags shing / da dung yang snga mu ltar mkhyain/ sa skya pa'i bstan pa spyi sgos dang / sems can gyi bde skyid la dgongs nas sngar gyi dus steng tsam du phebs pa zhig mkhyain/ zhu yig spyan 'bebs rten bkra shis pa'i kha btags la rgya mdzes su phul ba'i zhu yig

ces pa'i thugs dam gsung shog dang bcas dpon chen rin po che klu dbang dpon g.yog mang po rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid spyan 'dren ched gnyer du mngags pa bzhin/ gong bzhugs 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched gnyis kyis kyang de mthun gyi phebs sgo stsal pa ltar/ rje 'dis thog mar byas 'gyur du grub pa'i dbang phyug puṇ+ye in+d+ra bzhugs pa'i drung du byin rlabs bka' bsgo bslab ston sogs zhu bar phebs pa'i nangs par de nyid bzhi thog bla brang du yab rje chos kyi rgyal po la gang spyi'i bslab ston mtha' dag zhib zhus dang / byin rlabs zhabs dbang sogs thugs tshim par zhu ba mdzad cing / de mthun sprul pa'i skyes mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched gnyis kas zang zing gi gnang skyes rgya dpang chen po dang / lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya du ma zhig bka' stsal te/ de nas bdag nyid chen po'i gcen 'jam pa'i dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug dang / sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal mched kyis kyang gnang skyes bzang po dang / thugs 'phreng ba'i gsung yang du ma byon 'dug pa la/ rnam 'dren dam pa 'dis myur du zhabs drung du 'byor 'ongs pa'i zhal len yang zhus te/ lo de'i zla ba dgu pa'i mjug tsam la gdan sa chen po nas gdan btegs te/ rim gyis gdong ga bkra shis rtse/ dpal ldan lha rtse/ gtsang 'chos ma/ mdog lo rnams brgyud de mus gnas gsar du phebs pa'i tshe/ de dus sde gzar gyi 'phros kyis yar rgyab dpon chen rjes 'brang gi dpon chung rags bsdus dang bcas pa phyogs der byon yod pas/ khong rnams kyis thog mar chibs bsu zab ma mdzad cing / de nas pho brang gi rtser spyan drangs te/ bsnyen pa dang bkur bsti'i zhabs tog rgya chen po dang / zang zing gi 'bul nod kyang dpe bral lta bu phul zhing / rje 'dis zhal ngo rnams dang / zhabs 'bring drung 'khor sogs skal ldan mang po dang bcas pa la tshe dbang /

rjes gnang sogs 'dod chos du ma stsal pas/ rje 'di'i sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bla na med pa'i rnam par thar pa cha shas tsam mig sngar gsal zhing rna bar lhung bas/ sde bdag chen po de yang thugs phrogs shing dad pa'i gsung gis/ rang re mchod yon mjal ba 'gyangs pa'i skyon byung / bdag tsho dbus phyogs na yod dus phebs pa zhig shar na/ sa skya pa'i bstan pa la phan nges pa zhig bya nus pa yod mod/ 'on kyang da lam zhal dkyil mjal bas blo bde/ slar yang mchod yon thugs dag pa'i ngos/ thugs brtse ba chen pos bzung ba zhig mdzad dgos zhes zhu zhing / dag snang dang dad gus 'gran pa bzhin du gyur pa'i bag phebs kyi rnam pa gang yang zhig mdzad kyi 'dug pa na/ rje btsun gang gi thugs dgongs la/ dus ngan gyi 'gyur ba 'di tsam shar/ thugs la bzod bka' ba'i sbyong spyod sna tshogs pa zhig byung snang yang / sde srid chen po'i spyan ltos kyi lugs gnyis gang la yang mkhyen pa yangs shing / duḥkha la ji mi snyam pa'i thugs zab pa dang / sa skya pa'i bstan pa la dad zhen/ rang la yang dpe bral gyi dag snang 'di bzhin mdzad pa rjes su yi rang pa'i dga' spro dang / dus 'gyur gyi snang tshul la brtag pas thugs skyo ba zung 'brel du byung gsungs shing / de nas ya ma sogs brgyud de sang nyin rje bla ma mus pa chen po dang mjal rgyu'i nangs par snga char/ nyid kyi zhabs 'bring pa rab 'byams chos rje pa sogs 'ga' zhig sngon du mngags te/ zhu gsol gyi don la/ rje rin po che khyed bdag rang gi skye ba mang po'i bla ma yin snyam pa'i nges shes lhang lhang de ka yod pa dang / 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug gi dbu bla yin pa sogs gang sa nas bdag tsho bsu ba la phebs pa dang / phyag lan mdzad pa gtan nas mi gnang ba dgos tshul zhu ba mdzad 'dug pa bzhin khong rnams kyis rje'i snyan dbang du lhon par gsol bas/ rje mus chen gyi gsung las/

a pha de 'dra ci gsungs pa yin/ kar 'brug dge ldan pa sogs kyi grwa slob bu chen rnams ni/ khong rang tsho'i sprul sku'i mtshan gsol re byon pa la/ la lung mang po brgal nas mjal du 'gro zhing / lag na yod pa'i dngos po gang yod 'bul thub pa la dga' spro chen po byed pa'i srol bzang po zhig 'dug kyang / rang re sa skya pa'i grwa bu slob rnams dad gus dag snang pho rus sogs shin tu chung bar brten/ skyes bu dam pa gser gyi pha bong sgo 'gril gyi tshul du byung yang ji snyam du yang mi sems pa zhig 'dug mod/ gang ltar sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa byon pa la/ rang re rnams kyis phyag mi 'tshal na gzhan su la 'tshal ba yin/ phyag ma byas pas mi 'thus shing / sngar gyi bsam pa la nga rgas kyang gru gu 'phrang du phebs bsur yong bsam yod kyang / zhabs drung gi dgongs pa la gtan med phyin/ da cha bla brang gi nub kyi 'jam dbyangs sangs rin gyi chos khri chos rwa dang bcas pa yod pa der phebs bsu la yong ba yod zhus shig ces gsungs shing / yang de ma thag gsung las/ de ring gza' skar bzang ngan ci yod kyang de la ltos pa med/ mdang nub mo nged rang sa skya zhabs drung dang gnyid dang 'od gsal 'dres pa'i ngang nas gsal bar mjal byung ste/ sku'i bong che chung ran pa/ zhal dkyil zlum zhing dkar la dmar shas che ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ spyan gnyis zlum zhing che ba/ shang gzengs mtho zhing mchu sgros legs pa/ zhal sma ra dang zhal rgyan 'khyug ge yod pa/ sku gzan smug cing sku chos ser ba bzhes pa zhig gsal bar mthong byung bas/ de nas slar yang gzhis nas lta snyam pa la gti mug tu song nas ma byung zhes gsungs pa sogs de dus rje 'di'i sku'i dbyibs bzhin ras na bza'i kha dog tshun chad ji ltar yod pa ji bzhin du 'od gsal gyis gzigs pa zhal gyis 'ches 'dug cing / gzhan yang rje de'i gsung las/

sa skya pa'i mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams sngar las kyang rgyan cha lugs zab cing gzi brjid che ba dang bcas bla ma na rim gyi gzim mal gyi thad kyi nam mkha' la byon 'dug gsungs pa sogs dges spro'i gsung du ma stsal par mdzad 'dug cing / de nas rje 'di dpon slob gling kha dgon pa'i shar phyogs kyi zhing steng tsam du phebs pa na/ der bzhugs kyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs dang bcas pas ser 'phreng mtshar du dngar bas phebs bsu zab par zhus te/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi chos grwar phebs pa'i tshe/ bla brang gi sgo ru rje mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa de sku gzengs mtho zhing khyon che ba/ zhal dkyil pad+ma rwa ga ltar dmar zhing rgyas pa/ gzi byin 'bar ba/ spyan ras nyi zla zung ltar gyur pa/ rje 'di la gzigs shing dpon slob zhal 'dzoms ma thag rje 'di'i thugs la 'dir snang gi rtog pa phra rags thams cad 'gags nas lhan skyes spros bral gyi ye shes 'khrungs te/ de'i ngang du cung zad cig had de lus pa na/ sku 'khor rnams kyis snyan 'bul zhus pas sad de/ thog mar rje mus chen gyis phyag mdzad byung ba'i phyag gsum gyi ring la/ rje 'dis rtab rtab tu phyag dgu bstud du mdzad pas/ rje mus chen gyi phyag nas bkras btags shig gnang byung ba bzhes nas/ nyid kyi mjal dar du bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas gangs ri'i mdog can zung 'brel zhig phul te byin rlabs zhu dus dbu mnyam du rtse sprod mdzad par dgongs kyang / rje 'dis rang nyid kyi dbu rje mus pa chen pa'i dbu 'og tu chug pa mdzad pas thugs tshim par gyur/ de nas bla brang gi dbang khang du dpon slob nyung bsdus shig la bzhugs gral du rgyun mi thung tsam zhig mdzad pa'i ring la/ 'jam mgon bla ma 'di dpon slob rnams gdan sa chen po nas ji tsam la phebs dang / lam bar gyi gnas tshul sogs dri ba dang /

lan gyi gsung gleng ci rigs pa mdzad rjes/ bdag cag gi 'dren pa mtshungs med 'dis/ bdag snga mor lo gzhon nu nas rje rin po che'i rnam thar thos pa'i rkyen byas mjal 'dod dang chos thob 'dod bcos ma ma yin pa yod pa'i steng / da lo tsho zhabs drung 'di kha nas/ yab rje chos kyi rgyal por zhu yig dang / bdag rang la thugs dam bka' shog yang yang gnang bas gling kha dgon pa'i gdan sa la yong dgos tshul phebs byung ba bzhin/ rang ngos la lugs gnyis kyi shes sgo med pas/ bla ma gong ma'i dgon gnas kyi 'dzin skyong yong ba dka' ba 'dug kyang / rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa 'grig byung snyam dga' spro chen po dang bcas rje'i zhabs drung du 'ong ba lags pas sa skya pa'i yab chos 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum nā ro mkha' spyod dang bcas pa'i chos skor sogs chos mang po zhu dgos yod pa rnams thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhes zhu ba mdzad 'dug pa na/ rje mus pa'i gsung las/ de bzhin ngo mtshar che/ rang re'i gling kha bde ba can gyi dgon pa ma bu 'di rnams sngon mus chen sems dpa' chen pos/ 'di phyogs kyi bya ri dwags/ nya sgo nga sogs sems can mgon med pa rnams kyi mgon dang / skyabs med pa rnams kyi skyabs su dmigs te 'debs par mdzad pa nas bzung / da lta'i bar du yang sa skya pa'i sngags phyogs kyi bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa'i rgyun gzhan las khyad par 'phags ngos shes pa ma nyams pa gong 'phel du yod pa 'di lags shing / da ni nged kha rgas lus gog pa la brten 'dzin bkod de 'dra thub pa'i re ba mi 'dug pas/ dgon gnas 'di rnams khyed sa skya pa'i phyag tu ma 'phrod na/ dus kyi dbang gis gzhan su yin gyis 'di zin pa med pas/ des na zhabs drung nas sa skya pa'i bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la khur chen po bzhes te/ dgon ma bu 'di rnams kyi zhal bdag gnang ngos lugs gnyis kyi skyongs dar tshul bzhin du mdzad na bla ma gong ma'i dgongs pa yang de khas rdzogs/

khyed rang gi 'di phyi'i don yang de kas 'grub/ nged rgan po'i bsam pa yang de kas rdzogs shing / 'dod chos 'dra dgos gsungs pa/ spyir yang chos don du gnyer mkhan byung na rang gi gang yong byed pa'i lugs de ka yod cing / khyad par khyed dgung lo bco brgyad pa sku na phra mo 'di lta bu la/ nged rgan po bsams nas 'di phyogs phebs pa bka' drin tshad med pa bskyangs pas/ chos nged rang la yod pa rnams 'bul gang thub rang cis kyang zhu lags/ zhes gsungs shing / gsung chos gnang ba'i skabs de dag tu yang / mtshams mtshams su spyan ras shangs kyi rtse mor zim bur gzigs shing / thugs dam ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun la yug re 'byams 'gro ba gzigs pas/ rje 'di'i dgongs pa la snyan grags dang mthun pa'i bla ma dam pa 'di lta bu dang mjal ba re legs dgongs pa'i thugs la dga' ba dang spro ba dung dung pa phan tshun 'gran pa ltar yang yang 'khrungs par gyur to/ /de dag kyang nyid kyi gsung las/ byang phyogs rdo rje theg pa'i shing rta che/ /sems dpa' chen po'i chos kyi mdun sa cher/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan kun ldan pa'i/ /rang gi tshe rabs mang po'i dge ba'i bshes/ /khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po mus pa rje'i/ /zhal mthong gsung gi gsang ba thos pa'i tshe/ /'di ci rmi lam yin nam mngon sum ci/ /dga' spro'i ngang nas yid gnyis khyogs la 'phyang / /dpon slob ltar snang dad 'dun bral ba dag /dag snang gsal ba'i mig dang mi ldan tshe/ /tshe rabs du ma'i rjes 'brel ji ltar rtogs/ /rtogs pa'i tshul rnams ngo mtshar gnas min nam/ /e ma mthu chen stobs kyi mgon po dang / /sa skya'i bla chen gnyis kyis mngon sum du/ /rjes su bzung ba'i mus chen sems dpa' che'i/ /dgon gnas che 'di 'phags yul rdo rje'i gdan/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug sprul pas sprul pa'i sku/ /dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pas gzigs pa mchog

/gang la mnga' ba'i 'dren mchog 'dren pa de/ /bdag gi mgon du rnyed 'di rnyed pa'i mchog /brtse bas pha mas bu tsha bzhin/ /yid bzhin yid kyi re ba bkang / /bka' drin mnyam med bla ma rje'i/ /rnam thar bsam bzhin dad pa 'phel/ /rnyed dka'i lus rten thob dus 'dir/ /yongs 'dzin bla ma 'di mjal bas/ /dal 'byor don med ma gyur snyam/ /dga' spro yid bde'i ting 'dzin thob/ /ces gsungs pa ltar gyi don no/ /de nas lo de'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum/ sngon paṇa chen nam mkha' dbang phyug nyid zab mo chos dbyings su mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul ba'i nyin/ dkar po nam gru'i 'grub sbyor 'dzoms pa'i gza' skar bzang po'i tshe/ gling kha bde ba can gyi gtsug lag khang chen po'i rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen gyi zhabs stegs mi 'jigs pa seng ge'i khri la yongs 'dzin 'brel tshad don ldan 'di nyid 'khrul zad gong ma'i rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol mdzad pa'i phyir/ der bzhugs kyi 'dus pa'i tshogs la bla brang nyid nas rgya ja'i mchod sprin zung 'brel gnang ste/ snga ma'i steng du rje btsun mus pa chen po bud+dha'i mtshan can nyid tshogs dbur phebs pa'i drung du/ bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid kyis gsung bsngo zhu ba'i rten zang zing gi 'bul nod rgya chen po dang / dge 'dun 'dus tshogs la yang 'bul 'gyed gya nom pa/ dam rdzas 'chi med ril bu'i gral 'gyed dang bcas pa stsol bar mdzad rjes/ mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa de nyid kyis rang gzhan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rang ba sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i mkhyen rab kyis zin pa'i gsung bsngo bla na med pa'i bka' drin bstsal pa'i mthar/ dge 'dun tshogs pa rnams la lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya zhib rgyas dang / gang ltar rang re'i gling ga dgon ma bu 'di rnams sa skya zhabs drung gi phyag tu ma 'phrod na/

da dus ngan gyi 'gyur ba'i dbang gis gzhan sus kyang zin pa med pas/ na ning dgun hril po nged kyis sems dpa' chen po la gsol ba btab/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong la 'phrin las bcol ba la brten/ sa skya nas zhabs drung gdung brgyud sku gzhon pa 'di gling ga'i gdan sa la spyan 'drongs pa yin pas/ mus nang gi lha sde mi sde kun la nged drin che ba yod cing / da ni/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas bzhugs bzhin du/ /ston pa gzhan la gus byed pa/ /yan lag brgyad ldan chu 'gram du/ /ba tshwa'i khron pa rko ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ nyi ma de ring nas bzung khyed lha mi kun gyis phyag dang mchod pa 'bul ba/ lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya zhu sa sogs sa skya zhabs drung kho na la gyis shig ces sogs dgyes spro'i bslab bya mtha' yas pa zhig stsal cing / de nas mang ja rjes ma'i tshe/ bdag cag gi skyobs pa bla na med pa 'di nyid 'du khang gi bzhugs khri'i steng du phebs pa la/ rje btsun mus chen nyid kyang tshogs su phebs te/ gnang skyes kyi thog mar bkra shis pa'i dar dngul dkar gyi kha dog la co 'dri ba zhig dang / rje 'di sku tshe'i sa 'dzin yun ring du brtan pa'i rten 'brel du rgyal dbang tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan legs pa phra rgyan gyis spras pa gcig dang gnyis po rje mus chen nyid kyi phyag nas/ gzhan gyi sug pa ma brgyud par bdag nyid chen po khri steng du bzhugs pa'i phyag tu gtod par mdzad cing gzhan yang gos yug dar yug bla bre/ dbu zhwa/ gos bems/ pang khebs/ rgya dril/ gos phrug gi bzhugs gdings/ gser/ dngul/ khro/ zangs/ nas khal sum brgya/ dkar yol dang rag 'gag bcu khres 'ga' re/ chib chib srol/ dre'u/ 'bri g.yag stobs che ba sogs mkho dgu'i gnang skyes bsam gyis mi khyab pa pha nor bu la 'phrod pa ltar/ thugs dgyes spro chen po dang bcas stsol bar mdzad nas/ bkra shis pa'i me tog 'thor zhing mnga' gsol shis brjod kyi sgra dbyangs ches cher sgrogs par mdzad rjes/

dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis kyang 'bul ba'i dngos po rgya chen po so so nas phul/ de nas rnam 'dren dam pa 'di nyid kyis bdag dang gzhan gyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i legs byas kyi dge rtsa thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub chen po'i rgyur mi zad cing spel ba'i phyir bsngo ba rin po ches rgyas 'debs bla na med pa mdzad de/ de yang phyir bsngo ba la/ bsngo ba de yang mdor bsdus na/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa gnyis/ /gnas kyi bsngo ba 'grub par 'gyur/ /gnas min dngos kyang 'grub mi 'gyur/ /'di dag gnyis ka mdo las gsungs/ /zhes 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos ji ltar bsngos pa bzhin gyi 'bras bu de nyid/ 'grub tu rung ba gnas kyi bsngo ba dang / de ltar mi rung ba gnas min gyi bsngo ba gnyis su bshad cing / de la bu ston rin po ches gnas dang gnas min gyi bsngo ba'i tha snyad mdo las ma bshad gsungs pa'i brgal ba yod kyang / de gnyis gsungs pa'i khungs rnam dag gi mdo rnams dang sbyar te bu ston gyi rtsod lan du 'gyur nges pa'i legs bshad du ma dang / gzhan yang phyis su sa skya pa rang gi mdo phyogs kyi bstan 'dzin mchog tu gyur pa paṇa chen mkhas pa'i dbang phyug dpal shākya mchog ldan gyis/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa yi/ /smon lam dbye ba rnam pa gnyis/ /zhes gsungs nas smon lam la de gnyis su 'byed rigs kyi/ bsngo ba la mi rung ba gsungs pa dang / yang / gang gis bsngo dang gang du dang / /ji ltar bsngo ba gsum bshad bya/ /dang po dge rtsa byed po nyid/ /yin gyi gzhan pas de mi bsngo/ /des de 'grub na 'bad med du/ /grol bar 'gyur dang rang nyid kyis/ /ma bsngos nyes pa kun grol 'gyur/ /zhes bshad nas/ bsngo rgyu'i dge rtsa la bsngo ba po rang gis byas pa cig nges par dgos kyi/ gzhan dag gis byas pa'i dge rtsa gzhan gyis bsngor mi rung gsung ba sogs sdom gsum rab dbye nas bshad pa dang mthun mi mthun ci rigs yod pa rnams la yang /

lung rigs kyi 'thad pa mang du bkod pa gang zag rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa thams cad rang nyid kyis bsngor rung ba dang / rang gis byas pa'i dge rtsa yang gzhan dag bsngor 'jug pa da lta'i bar du kun gyi phyag len yod pa bzhin 'thad pa'i legs bshad rma med pa zhib cing mtha' chod pa mkhas pa rnams kyi yid la 'bab cing / tshig 'bru rna bar snyan pa'i bsngo ba'i yon bshad rgyas pa dang / gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang bcas bsngo rgyu'i dge rtsa dang / bsngo ba'i yul dang / bsngo ba byed po sogs don dam du mi dmigs shing / kun rdzob tu snang cha rgya chen po dang bcas pa ste mdor na bka' bstan bcos tshad ldan rnams nas bshad pa dang mthun pa'i gsung bsngo yang dag pa mdzad pa na/ der 'dus kyi tshogs pa kun shin tu ngo mtshar te/ sku'i lang tsho gzhon nu 'di lta bu la rang gzhan gyi grub mtha'i gnad rig pa'i yongs bsngo lta bu la yang dgag sgrub kyi spros pa dang bcas legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston 'di bzhin stsal pas/ gzhan sa skya pa rang gi yab chos bde kye sogs la thugs kyi spobs pa thogs med mnga' ba la the tshom mi dgos pas/ nges par 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin yang dag go /zhes zer zhing bstod bsngags kyi bsil zer phyogs brgyar 'phro zhing / dad gus kyi zla dbang gsar du tshes par gyur pa zhig byung zhes thos la/ de nas rje nyid kyis tshogs pa rnams la 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi rjes su gnang ba'i bka' 'brel zhig gnang nas/ de 'phral rje btsun mus pa'i zhabs drung du phebs pa na/ zhal gyi ku mud cher 'dzum pa las gsung gi bdud rtsi 'di ltar 'jo ste/ gling kha dgon pa'i gdan sa sa skya bdag chen la 'bul thub pas da nga blo bde ba yin/ da re khyed sku tshe ring ba'i rten 'brel zhig yod pas bla ma gong ma na rim gyi gzim mal der bzhugs/ nged gdan srab pa 'di la sdod pa yin gsungs pa na/

rje 'di thugs shin tu mdzangs pas bzhugs ma nus pa'i tshe/ rje mus chen nyid kyi phyag gis bzung nas skyel bar mdzad cing / de nas gsol ja gnyis tsam gyi bar la dad ldan gyi bu slob gzhan mang po dang bcas shin tu dgyes pa'i gsung gleng rgyun mi thung tsam mdzad pa'i ring nas/ rje btsun mus pa chen po des/ bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa 'di la spyan cher gzigs nas/ zhabs drung khyed rang gling ga'i gdan sa 'di mdzad pas sku tshe ring zhing thugs bsam chos bzhin du 'grub la 'phrin las dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas pa sogs 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba yin/ rje sems dpa' chen po'i 'phrin las kyi rgyun dang / sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin gzhan gyi 'phrin las kyi rgyun bzang lod mi 'dra/ sa skya pa'i 'phrin las kyi khyab tshad du sems dpa' chen po'i 'phrin las kyis kyang khyab pa lta bu yin/ de 'ongs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang sngon rje rdo rje 'chang gi mnal lam du rje mus chen gyi dbu thog na gdugs chen po gcig 'khor gyin 'dug pa/ de las de 'dra ba mang du mched de dbus gtsang khams gsum thams cad khyab pa'i mtshan ltas byung ba dang / rje sems dpa' chen po rang gi mnal lam du yang / rje rang nyid sa skya'i lung pa yin snyam pa zhig na bzhugs 'dug pa la/ de'i bar snang nas bzung ste mtha' chod rgyu med pa lta bu'i nam mkha'i khyon thams cad bla bre legs po gcig gis khyab nas 'dug pa la/ 'di'i 'og thams cad nga dbang ba yin snyam pa thugs la 'khrungs 'dug pa de dag gi rten 'brel gyi gnad las byung ba yin zhes sogs ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i lung bstan gyi tshogs mang po zhig stsol bar mdzad 'dug cing / de nas gdugs gsum gyi ring la bla brang gi phyi nang gi phyag rdzas rnams rtsis bzhes gnang / de mtshams rje mus chen nyid dpon slob nyung bsdus shig sems dpa' chen po'i chos rwa zur du kun spang gi tshul du bzhugs te/

der skabs rje mus chen zhabs drung du zhal slob 'ga' zhig gis mjal bar phyin pa na/ rje nyid shin tu dgyes pa'i gsung gis/ dang po legs pa thos bsam byas/ /bar du legs par 'chad nyan byas/ /tha mar legs pa gdan sa 'phrod/ /ces paṇa chen legs pa'i blo gros kyi gsung nas dgyes dgyes dpag med mdzad 'dug pa de/ da ni nged la yang sgra ji bzhin du byung ba 'di bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rje yin snyam pa yod/ sa skyar rin chen klu dbang zhabs drung spyan 'dren la btang dus/ gdan sa'i skya ser bsam blo che ba rnams mgrin gcig pas/ da ni yab rgyan mchog rin po che 'di sku na ha cang bgres pa ma yin yang / gdan sa'i thugs 'gan 'di lci drags pas/ bgres nyams chen por song 'dug cing / gdung brgyud sku mched gsum gyi gzhon pa 'di rang thugs kyi gdod dang 'phral gyi mdzad spyod/ lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen rab sogs gang sa nas nged gdan sa pa rnams re che ba zhig yod pa yin te/ 'di ni khyed mus pa tshos brkus ma btab su spyan 'dren gyur 'dug 'on kyang bla ma de yag po zhig yod pas phebs sa ma nor snyam pa yod/ gang ltar phar phebs tshur phebs mdzad pa zhig ma byung na/ khyed rnams thugs rje chung bar yang 'gro bas/ de bzhin dpon slob rnams kyi thugs la 'jog dgos so zhes yang yang zer ba zhig yod 'dug pa/ don la yang khong tsho zer ba bzhin bden gyi yod 'dug pas rang re rnams kyis thob pa 'di skal ba bzang por shes pa dang / nged la yang drin chen por go dgos rgyur gda' ste/ de 'dra rtogs mkhan re re tsam las yod pa dka'/ 'on kyang phugs su thams cad kyis go ba zhig yong bar nges zhes sogs pa ma 'ongs pa gzigs pa'i bka' stsal mang du mdzad 'dug pa bzhin/ bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa 'di mus phyogs su phebs pa'i lo der/ 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug khams nas phebs pa'i dga' ston du dus mdos zab mo zhig gnang skabs/

chos sde lho byang gi grwa pa thugs bsam dag cing blo gros che ba 'ga' shas kyi gleng rigs/ da lo zhabs drung sgar chen khams nas phebs/ khri chen bsod nams dbang po yang byas 'gyur na bzhugs pas/ rang re gdan sa pa rang gi zhal ngo thams cad 'dzoms pa'i skabs yin 'dug pas re dga'/ 'on kyang gdung brgyud sku gzhon pa de nyid ma bzhugs pas mnga' grang ba tsam 'dug pas/ da lam gyi dus mdos skabs kyi sku 'chams la yang gdung brgyud sku gzhon pa de nyid kyang phebs yod pa shin tu bag dro ba yong 'dug cing / spyir yang zhabs drung de nyid sku na phra mo la lugs gnyis ka la mkhyen pa yangs shing / 'phral gyi mdzad spyod kyang legs la thugs sgam pa sogs gang sa nas/ mus chen du bka' chos tsam gsan du phebs pa la ni 'gal ba mi 'dug rgyun bzhugs lta bu gnang na rang re gdan sa pa rang la khag che rgyu yin 'dug pas/ gong bzhugs rnams kyis de bzhin gyi gnas tshul mi dgongs pa ni ga la srid/ gsung chos 'dra gsan/ slar 'di ka rang du phebs nas bcar bzhugs gnang ba yong las che zer ba sogs rje 'di mus phyogs su phebs pa la 'phreng cha byed pa mang po 'dug pa ni/ kho bo cag ban chung gzhon nu'i skabs mang du mthong zhing thos la/ de ltar rje 'di mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa nyid kyi rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol mdzad zin pa nas mi ring par rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid kyis gling ga bde ba can gyi dge 'dun tshogs pa rnams la/ rdo rje phur pa stod las kyi dbang dang / tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang cha lan grangs mang po dang / sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang / rgya bod kyi yig cha'i lung dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang dges rdor rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa sogs rgyud dang / bstan bcos 'ga' zhig gi lung sogs dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin mang po zhig stsal cing / de dus rje nyid kyis mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi drung du dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin gsan pa'i rnam grangs la/

slob dpon mi tra dzo gi nas brgyud pa'i tshe 'phel dkar po'i rjes gnang sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par rgyal ma/ rdo rje rnam 'joms/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal/ yang thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa/ seng ge sgra/ khyung nag seng gdong ma/ phyag na rdo rje u tsar+ya/ yang u tsa me dbang ma/ gur gyi mgon po lcam dral lha brgyad/ gur mgon khro bcu/ 'khor rkyang pu tra ming sring / dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa/ rta mgrin lcags ral can/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po la sogs pa mtshon pa'i lhag pa'i lha zhi khro du ma'i rjes gnang zur bka' dkon zhing zab pa'i rigs du ma dang / de dag gi rgya bod kyi yi ge man ngag gi rigs mang po dang / gur gyi mgon po dang / zhal bzhi pa/ dbyug gu ma mched gsum sogs kyi tshe sgrub dang nor sgrub kyi man ngag gi rigs du ma/ rje sa chen gyi bka' 'bum po ti gcig lhag tsam gyi lung dang / gzhan yang rgyal sras thogs med bzang po dpal dang / rje sems dpa' chen po'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs sogs bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab kyi tshogs mang po'i lung / gzhan yang bzang spyod mtshan brjod sogs bka' dang bstan bcos bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig gi lung rnams gsan cing / de nas sa skya pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral gyi khrid dang / de'i yig cha gsar rnying rnams kyi lung / 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi dbang / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs rnams dang / bde mchog nag po lugs kyi bskyed rim gyi bshad khrid rje bzang po dpal bas mdzad pa'i rnam bshad chen mo'i steng nas rgyas shing zhib la mtha' chod pa dang / de dang 'brel ba rdzogs rim gyi khrid la dpyid kyi thig le dang / rim bzhi gnyis ka gsan nas thams cad kyi rgyab brten du nag po gzhung drug rje sa skya pa chen po'i nag 'bum rim bzhi lam slong /

rje btsun gyi nag po dkyil chog nag po bshad sbyar gyi lung la sogs pa mang du gsan cing / bde mchog lū hi pa'i bskyed rim gyi bshad khrid/ rdzogs rim bsdu ba gsum pa/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i lugs kyi bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim zab mo'i rim pa lnga'i khrid/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor bcu gcig rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma yum la sbyar ba'i khrid rnams kun mkhyen chen po dang rje bzang po dpal ba sogs bla ma gong ma'i yig cha'i steng nas shin tu smin pa dang / de dag dang 'brel ba'i lung gi skor la/ rgya gzhung lū hi pa'i smad lnga/ dril bu skor gsum sogs dang / rje btsun sku mched dang / rjes 'brang gis mdzad pa'i 'di skor gyi pod gzhung mang po'i lung / de thams cad kyi rgyab brten du bde mchog rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa/ 'grel pa mu tig gi 'phreng ba gnyan phul byung bas mdzad pa dang bcas pa/ bshad rgyud rnal 'byor ma kun spyod rje btsun gyi 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i steng nas lung bshad zhib tu gsan cing / bde mchog gi chos skor rnams gsan pa'i skabs su rje mus chen gyis rje 'di la bka' nan chen po phebs pa la brten/ rje 'dis kyang gsung chos gang gnang thams cad zin thun skyor chos kho na rgyun du mdzad pas/ thos blo tsam ma yin pa'i slar 'chad sgom gang gnang yang the tshom gyi sgro 'dogs chod de thogs med kyi spobs pa mnga' ba 'di byung ba yin 'dug cing / de dus mu tig 'phreng ba gnang ba'i tshe rje mus chen gyi gsung las/ 'di'i skabs su dgos pa'i sngags btu'i byin rlabs sogs kyi rgyun sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa dang / paṇa chen nam mkha' dbang phyug pa nas brgyud pa de deng sang bzhugs pa chos rje sman gur ba kho na las med pas/ khyed rang don gnyer chen po 'dug pas chos rje khong la byin rlabs rnams bzhes thub pa mdzod la/

phug bde mchog gi rgyud bshad 'di ma chad pa zhig cis kyang mdzad dgos so/ /zhes pa'i gsung gi yid bzhin gyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun dag 'jam mgon bla ma 'di'i thugs mtsho'i klong du 'khyil ba'i dbang las/ dus phyis thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas byin rlabs kyi rgyun de rnams spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub kyis bzhes thub pa bzhin rje nyid kyis de'i drung du gsan par mdzad pa yin no/ /de dus lan gcig rje 'di'i mtshan lam du nyid kyi yab rje chos kyi rgyal po sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyis sgo rum ye shes mgon po'i snyan dar rnams rje nyid la rtsis sprod gnang ba zhig byung ba/ nangs par rje mus chen la zhu ba mdzad 'dug pa na/ rje de'i gsung las/ rmi lam shin tu bzang / rigs kyi bu la brgyud kyi lha 'go zer ba de gda'/ byed pa mis byed kyang / mdun ma lhas bsgyur ba zhig dgos pa yin/ khyed rang bsod nams che bas thams cad dbang du 'du zhing / dpal 'byor longs spyod kyang blos mi 'khyud pa tsam dang / sa skya pa kun gyis re ltos 'chol ba zhig 'ong bas/ de dus 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud 'di rnams gsang sngags bde chen gling du rgyud 'don thabs rgyas pa re rtsom las 'dzugs thub pa mdzod/ ces gsungs te/ rje nyid ma 'ongs pa na gdan sa chen po'i lugs zung gi khur mi zad pa 'degs bzod pa'i gnyis 'thung sa srung gi bu lta bur 'gyur ba'i lung bstan gyi bdud rtsi dam pa brnyes par gyur to/ /de nas bde mchog gi chos skor rnams grol nas/ rje nyid don gnyer rags bsdus dang bcas pas sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ de'i chog khrigs gzhan phan mtha' yas la/ rnam bshad dpag bsam ljon pa'i steng nas gsung bshad shin tu rgyas pa dka' gnas kyi dogs dpyod legs bshad du mas brgyan pa dang /

phyag rgya bca' lugs kyi brda' sprod tshun chad 'phrod par gsan rjes/ sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang dang / de dag gi cho ga thun mong ba rnams mi 'gal zhing / thun mong ma yin pa rnams ma 'dres pa'i tshul las brtsams te/ rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' dag la dgag sgrub kyi rnam par dbye ba ci yang zhig gsan par mdzad nas/ de thams cad kyi rgyab brten du ngan song sbyong rgyud mchan bu dang bcas pa/ rje btsun gyi gzhan phan skor gsum/ kun mkhyen gyi gzhan phan rnam gnyis/ gzhan yang 'di skor gyi mkhas pa du ma'i gsung rab dang bcas pa la legs par bshad pa'i bka' drin rma med pa gsan te/ rnal 'byor yo ga'i bstan pa la rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros kyi snang ba cher rgyas pa mdzad ces thos la/ de lo dbus gtsang gi ljongs kun tu 'brum bu'i nad cher mched pa zhig yod pa bzhin/ gling ga phyogs su yang shin tu thu ba'i 'brum nad byung tshad 'chi ba lta bus dgon par yang grwa pa mang po 'das grongs byung bar brten/ rje mus chen gyi gsung las/ da lam gyi 'brum bu 'di re lod rang 'dug pas zhabs drung nas grwa pa tshor sna tshogs yum sogs kyi rjes gnang zhig gnang na legs pa 'dug pas gnang dgos tshul stsal pa bzhin/ rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid kyis gling ga tshogs chen la/ gur mgon dpa' gcig sna tshogs yum/ ri khrod ma gsum gyi rjes gnang dang / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i na bza' dang bcas tshogs pa thams cad la sbyin pa mdzad pas dgon pa'i 'brum nad sba chad cing / der skabs bsnyung ba rnams kyang srog rkyen med par 'brum bu las thar par gyur pas/ slar chos gzhis rta mo lung pa dang / skyer pa sogs su spyan 'dren zhus pa ltar phebs nas khrom dbang mdzad pa tsam gyis 'brum nad sngar thebs pa rnams gegs med du thar/ phyin chad gtan nas mched par ma gyur te/ kun kyang mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtas par gyur/

de nas rje mus pa chen po'i drung du phebs pas/ gsung las/ da lo'i 'brum nag 'di 'dra la khyed sa skya zhabs drung gi bka' chos rnams kyang byin rlabs rtags mtshan can byung bas bka' drin che zhing / nged kyis kyang bir+wa pa bsgoms nas nad bdag rnams rgya mtsho'i 'gram du bskrad pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa de yang mdzad 'dug cing / gang ltar de dus mus nang gi 'brum pa myur du chad cing re re tsam phyir mched byung ba la yang nyes skyon cung zad tsam yang med pa'i byin rlabs kyi bdud rtsi'i dga' ston bla na med pa ni rje 'di'i thugs rje'i bum bzang las byung bar kun sgrogs pa zhig kyang byung 'dug go /de lta'i skabs shig na rje nyid kyi rgyal yum dam pa'i sku gdung byin rnams la sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyis phyag tsha gnang zin pa'i lhag ma/ gdung rus btul ma tshon tsam zhig rje 'di'i phyag na yod pa de/ 'jim pa bung che ba gcig la bsres nas/ rje mus pa chen po la phyag tsha gnang dgos tshul zhus pas/ rje des phyag tsha mchod dgu ma brgyad las ma gnang ba na/ rje 'di'i thugs la phyag tsha grangs mang tsam zhig gnang na dgongs pa'i tshe/ rje'i gsung las/ tsha tsha mang nyung 'di ka 'tshams pa 'ongs/ da lta kho bos rab gnas shig byed/ de nas bla brang gi mchod khang gang rigs gcig tu sgrig par zhu gsungs 'dug pa bzhin/ re zhig bla brang gi lha khang bar mar bzhugs su gsol nas/ dus phyis dpal sa skyar 'jam dbyangs sku mched kyi nang rten dngul gdung gnyis bzhengs pa dang stabs cig yum rin mo che la yang nang rten dngul gdung zhig bskrun par mdzad pa'i nang bzhugs la phul bas gzungs rnams dang / sngar yab rje chos kyi rgyal pos phyag tsha rnams phul rjes phyag tsha brgyad po 'bul bar mdzad pas/ gdung tsha gcig gis mang na mi bshong zhing nyung na mi khengs pa'i skyon 'byung ba mngon du gyur pa na/ phyag tsha brgyad las mi gnang ba de yang rje mus pa chen pos ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i rtags su 'dug dgongs pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas su yid ches kyi chu mtsho las dad pa'i rba rlabs ches cher g.yos par gyur to/

/de nas yun mi ring bar byang nas chos rgyal chen po slar ngam ring du phebs pa'i legs byas rmad du byung ba la brten nas mi dbang chen po des/ rje mus chen bud+dha'i mtshan can dang / bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa 'di yab sras lhan cig par ngam ring phyogs su phebs dgos pa'i snyan gsol yang yang byung pa na/ rje mus chen gyi gsung las/ kho bo ni tshe mjug 'dir sgrub pa rtse gcig tu byed pa 'di bzhag nas/ rgyal po rnam thos sras kyis spyan 'dren byung yang mi 'gro ba'i blo thag bcad pa yin pas/ da ni sde srid kyi dgongs pa bzhin sa skya zhabs drung dpon slob rnams ngam ring du chibs kha bsgyur ba'i bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po mdzad dgos so/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin rje nyid dpon slob rnams ngam ring la phebs par mngon du phyogs pa na/ rje mus chen zhabs drung du phyi phyag zhu bar chos ra zur du phebs pas/ chos grwa de'i sems dpa' chen po'i chos khri'i steng nas khro bo rme brtsegs kyi rjes gnang khrus gsol rgyas pa zhig gnang rjes/ ling ser po la rdo rje'i mdud pa sogs byin rlabs 'ga' zhig stsal nas/ slar gzim chung du phebs te yun ring po'i bar du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len gyi snying po mtha' dag la dri ba dris lan gyi tshul du gsung gi bdud rtsi mtha' yas pa zhig gsol te/ mthar rje mus pa'i gsung las/ 'o de lta bu'i nyams len gyis 'chi khar mtshams sbyor thub pa'am/ de min yang da lta rmi lam zin pa zhig byung na de'i gnad kas bar do'i snang ba shar ba'i tshe/ de nyams len dang bsre thub pa zhig byung du nye/ de byung na/ de phyin chad mgo la thod pa len pa mi dgos rgyu der gda'/ yang bar do da lta'i rmi lam bzhin du 'khrul 'jams su song nas/ 'khor ba 'dir yang yang du khyi ri ri/ khor ro ro bzhugs chog pa las ma 'das pas/

da lta yar 'gro mar 'gro'i gyes mtshams 'di la bag chags brtan po 'jog thub pa'i nyams len la brtson par mdzad dgos so zhes gsungs pa na/ rje btsun dam pa 'di'i thugs la/ e ma mi lus lan cig tsam thob pa'i nam 'chi cha med 'di la/ dgos med kyi tshe 'di'i bya ba rnams rgyab tu bskyur nas nam mkha' la 'phur ba sogs grub rtags ston nus pa zhig ma byung bar bug sgo nas mi 'da' ba'i dam bca' lta bu byas nas/ rje bla ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsi la nyams len chig bsgril du bya dgos rgyur 'dug pa de las gal che ba'i bsgrub rgyu'i don gzhan ci yang mi 'dug dgongs pa thugs la dung dung pa 'khrungs 'dug cing / de nas rje btsun mus pa chen pos dam pa 'di la bla ma brgyud pa mang po'i mtshan nas brjod cing / chos skyong rnams la bka' bsgo rgyas pa dang / gzhan yang bslab bya'i tshogs du ma bstsal te/ dpon slob thugs yid gcig 'dres kyis 'bral mi phod pa lta bu'i ngang nas bdag nyid chen po dpon slob rnams gdan btegs te/ rim gyis ya ma bde ldan dang / rdzong dga' ldan rtse gnyis su zhag gnyis gsum re bzhugs pa'i so so'i dge 'dun rnams la 'dod chos mang du stsal cing / mus gnas gsar du yar rgyab dpon chen dang / mdog lhun sdings su sku zhang gdong ga pas spyan 'dren zhus pa'i ngor so sor phebs te/ tshe dbang rjes gnang sogs rkyen sel gyi chos kyi bka' 'brel khong rang tsho'i 'dod pa dang mthun pa stsal/ khong rnams kyis kyang rnyed bkur zhabs tog 'bul nod sogs rgya chen po zhus/ de nas mdog gzhung gi sa skya pa'i dgon gnas lo phu dge bcu/ zhe dgon/ ya ga chos sdings rnams su rim gyis phebs te/ so so nas ser 'phreng rgyas pa/ zang zing gi 'bul nod rnyed bskur sogs bzang 'gran lta bu gya nom pa rang sgrub 'dug pa bzhin/ rje nyid kyis dgon pa gzhan rnams su bzhugs zhag re dang /

zhe dgon du bcags mal zhig bzhugs te/ dgon so sor bla ma grwa rigs sogs kyi 'dod pa dang mthun pa'i dbang bka' dang / rjes gnang zur bka'i rigs mang po rgyab chos lung gi tshogs dang bcas pa/ chos kyi sbyin pa zang zing med pas so so'i re 'dod kyi ra ba yongs su 'gengs par mdzad nas/ rim gyis dpal ngam ring gi rgyal khab chen por phebs pa'i tshe/ de dus chos rgyal chen po sku 'brum la 'dzem pa'i stabs sku 'bum na bsti ba'i skabs yin 'dug pas/ rje 'dis ngam ring rtser bags gsang gi tshul du zhag bzhi lnga bzhugs te/ de'i ring la rje btsun ngag dbang chos 'dzom dpon g.yog sogs der gnas dad ldan mang po la chos kyi bdud rtsi ci rigs pa stsal rjes skya bo kha gdengs su phebs te mi dbang chos kyi dbang phyug de nyid thugs dgyes spro tshad med pa'i phebs bsu rnyed bkur phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas zla ba gnyis tsam gyi ring gdan chags pa'i bar la tshe dbang rigs mi gcig pa mang po brgya tshar du ma dang / rjes gnang zur bka' bcu phrag lhag pa'i bka' drin stsol bar mdzad rjes/ sku 'bum gyi shar phyogs na 'jam mgon sa paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i bzhugs khri zhig yod pa de'i steng nas/ rgyal sras lam bzang dang / rje sems dpa' chen po'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung sogs zab rgyas kyi chos tshul dri ma med pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis mi'i dbang po gang gi thugs kyi chu gter yongs su gang bar mdzad pas/ sngon nas kyang chos rgyal 'di 'jam mgon gang la thugs lhag par dad pa'i gting zab par yod pa'i khar/ de dus mchog tu dgyes pa'i gsung gi rlabs 'phreng 'di ltar g.yos par gyur te/ sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rnams grub tshul ston pa zam ma chad pa zhig byung 'dug kyang / mkhas tshul gtso bor gyur pa'i sgo nas bstan pa gsal byed du gyur pa gong ma lnga/ bla ma dam pa sku mched/

theg chen rin po che/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa sogs thor tsam las ma byung 'dug pas/ rje nyid kyang mkhyen rab dang / thos bsam la thugs kyi 'jug pa mtshungs pa ma mchis shing / bstan pa'i khur chen 'degs bzod pa'i snying stobs sogs gzhan las phul du byung nges su snang bas bka' drin che/ da ni mdo sngags dang sgra snyan sogs rig gnas mtha' dag la gsan sbyong mthar phyin gnang ba dang / mus chen dang / sa skya nas khri chen sku mched sogs bla ma mang po la gsan pa rgya chen po zhig mdzad nas/ bdag kyang phugs yul bla ma mang po 'tshol mi dgos pa zhig dang / khyad par da lta'ang rang gi lag na rdzong gzhis dgon gnas sogs rgya dpang mi chung tsam yod pas/ rgyal brgyud yong ba ni dka' ba 'dug 'di rnams kyi zhal bdag kyang phugs yul khyed kyis mdzad pa zhig byung na/ byang khog 'di sa skya pa'i bstan pa dar sa yin pas bla ma gong ma'i zhabs tog dang / bstan pa la yang phan slebs shin tu che zhing bdag gi bsam pa yang de kas rdzogs rgyu yin pas/ de ltar thugs la bzhag nas thos bsam dang chos gsan pa sogs la thugs rtsol gyis brgyan pa mdzad dgos so zhes zhus nas/ zang zing gi 'bul ba'i skyes kyang tshan grangs mang po mngar ba'i mdzes lam lta bu tsam ma yin par/ mdo rgyud gzhung 'grel dang bcas pa'i dpe khyad par can mang po dang / sku rten dbang chas sogs skabs su babs pa'i mkho dgu bsgrigs pa dus gcig ma yin par rim gyis phul ba'i rgya dpang shin tu che ba 'bul bar mdzad pa sogs rje 'di kho na la dad gus rtse gcig pa'i rgyun gzhan las ches che ba zhig yin par 'dug go /de ltar mi dbang chen po'i thugs kyi bum bzang legs par bshad pa'i bcud kyis 'gengs par mdzad nas/ ring por mi thogs par rang nyid kyi bsti gnas dam pa bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skyar chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur de gdan sa chen por phebs 'byor gyi snga char phebs lam du yab rje chos kyi rgyal po sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyi thugs kyi chu skyes bzhad pa'i gsung shog bdud rtsi'i thigs phreng zhig stsal pa'i nang na/

da lam khyed rang phyogs su 'gro don mdzad nas byon pa'i thog ma yin pas rten 'brel la bsam/ ser 'phreng / rta bsu sogs rgyas pa'i grabs bshoms byas yod cing / ser bya yang 'di nas snga mor sbyar zin pas/ de mthun gyi phebs lugs dgos tshul gnang 'dug pa gzigs pa'i tshe/ thugs spro ba mchog tu 'phel ba'i ngang nas phebs pa na/ thog mar gong bzhugs zhabs drung sgar chen nas zhabs 'bring pa rags bsdus shig gis chibs bsu dang / de nas gdan sa gzhung gi chibs bsu ba/ lho byang gi dge 'dun rnams kyi ser phreng mtshar du dngar ba dang bcas pas mdun nas bsu ba'i bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa bshams te/ rje nyid bzhi thog bla brang du phebs pa'i tshoms dmar gyi 'gag der/ rje 'di'i gcen 'jam pa'i dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug dang / sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal mched gnyis dang mjal bas sku mched phan tshun sngar bas kyang thugs yid 'dres pa'i legs byas kyi dge mtshan gsal bar gyur/ de nas gzim chung rab gsal du snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon po sngags 'chang mtshungs med grags pa'i mtshan can dang mjal ba na/ rje 'dis gnas lnga sa la phab pa'i phyag gi 'od 'phreng gis/ yab rje mtshungs med de nyid kyi zhal gyi pad dkar bzhad pa'i tshems kyi ze'u 'bru dgod pa'i mtshan mas nye bar bsus te/ byin rlabs sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston la rol bar brtsams pa na/ phyag gnyis dgyes pa'i rol rtsed kyis rje btsun gang gi dbu la 'khyud cing / dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs mi zad pa dang bcas thugs rangs pa'i rnam 'phrul ci yang zhig mdzad pa gzigs pa'i mod la/ thugs kyi rkang drug dga' ba dang spro ba 'gran pa ltar du gyur cing / de'i rjes thogs su gsol ja gnyis tsam gyi ring la yab sras bzhi lhan cig tu mus phyogs kyi skor sogs gsung gleng rgyun mi thung ba'i ngang nas/ yab rje nyid kyi gsung las/ da lam khyed rang phyogs su bstan 'gro'i don phyir phebs 'grul thog ma la gzhi byes gang du yang nyes pa med par bde bar 'byor pa 'di legs tshogs che/

zhes sogs gsungs te shin tu dgyes pa'i gsung mang du 'jo bar mdzad cing / de'i nangs par rje nyid la byang phyogs su 'bul mi byung ba'i phyag rdzas kyi dngos po rnams yab rje chos kyi rgyal po nyid la phul te/ re zhig gi bar du bzhi thog bla brang gi gzim chung mkha' spyod nyid du thos bsam dang / zab bzhes sogs bstan pa rin po che'i bgyi ba kho na la gcig tu 'grus par mdzad do/ /zhes thos la/ de lta'i skabs nas rje nyid dgung lo nyi shur phebs pa/ me zhes pa me pho 'brug gi lo sngags 'chang 'gro ba'i bla ma grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid phyi nang gi snang tshul sna tshogs pa zhig la thugs lhag par 'byung ba'i rkyen byas/ lan gcig gi tshe rje 'di la yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung gis/ do nub lab rgyu khag che ba zhig yod pas/ nged kyi rtsar kha ton grub mtshams khor tsam zhig yong lugs gyis shig phebs 'dug pa bzhin/ rje 'di'i yab rje'i zhabs drung du phebs pa na/ yab rje'i phyag nas bkra shis pa'i lha dar zung 'brel/ gos lu haṃ sprin chen gyi ri mo can yug tshangs gcig kar yug legs pa gcig rnams stsal nas/ gsung las/ 'o da lam gleng rgyu'i snying po/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa la/ gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi 'dzin skyong las khag che ba mi 'dug 'di'i 'dzin skyong yang zhal ngo na rim bzhin gyi gzhon pa la bka' babs pa zhig yod pa dang / lhag par bsam yas chos skyong chen pos kyang / rdo rje gdan gyi 'dzin skyong rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul gyi gzhon pa de la bka' babs yod zer ba thengs gnyis rang nged la yi ge byung ba sogs gang nas bsams kyang / khyed kyis gdan sa'i 'dzin skyong spel gsum byas pa'i rab byung gi brtul zhugs 'di dor nas/ nged rang bzhin bgyis na/ nga yang bsam pa de kas rdzogs shing / nged rang gis gzugs po'i nam lcogs bar khur yang len pa dang /

de ltar byas na rang re la dgra gnyen grogs gsum sus kyang bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyis mi tshugs shing / nged kyis kyang sngags 'chang chen po'i bka' chems snying la bcangs nas/ gdan sa'i 'dzin skyong gi ched du phyi nang gsang gsum nas yid chad gtong ba mang po byung yang bzod rang bsam bsran bskyed pas sa skya ming ma stong tsam byung ba yin/ da cha khyed kyis nged la mi nyan par 'dzin skyong spel gsum mi byed na nga yang su la bsam nas sdod du 'dug gang na'ang nged kyis sngags 'chang chen po'i bka' chems blos ma thongs pa bzhin/ nged kyi ngag kyang khyed kyis mi gcog par byed dgos/ de bzhin ma byas na gong ma ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnams kyang thugs khrel 'gro/ da lta blo thag chod chod ltar byas gdung spel ma byas kyang / nga yang gzugs shis ngan pa dang yun ring e sdod mi shes pas/ bzhi thog bla brang gi gtsug lag khang dang / rten gsar bzhengs nged kyi blo la ji ltar yod pa 'di rnams kyi mjug khyed la bsgril dgos pa yong zhes sogs gsungs pa byung 'dug pa na/ rnam 'dren dam pa 'di'i thugs la bcos ma ma yin pa'i yid 'byung drag po zhig 'khrungs pa'i dbang gis dar tsam zhig zhu gang yang ma spobs 'dug cing / de nas spyan chab kyis gang zhing gsung 'dar bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ bdag gi sa nas gong bzhugs zhabs drung gi bka' gang phebs zhu ba las ma 'das 'dug kyang / spyir 'jig rten dang 'brel ba'i 'dzin skyong sogs bdag gis mi shes shing / lhag par khyim thab dang lhan cig tu gnas pa bdag gi blo la zhe thag pa nas med nges yin pa sngar dgongs par mnga' ba ltar yin pas/ bdag rang gi cha nas chos mthun gyi kha ton gang 'phel dang / ci nus kyis chos 'chad nyan bgyi pa sogs kyi sgo nas zhabs tog sgrub chog pa dgongs pa yangs pa dang / deng sang zhal bkod gnang ba'i bzhi thog gi lha khang rten bzhengs rnams kyang mthar phyin pa zhig los yong du 'dug pa/

gong bzhugs rang da dung lo brgyar spyi sgos kyi bstan pa dang / sems can gyi don la zhabs pad brtan pa'i thugs 'dun sogs gnang dgos pa'i tshul rgyas par zhu ba mdzad 'dug cing / de nas yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' stsal bzhin/ lo de'i hor zla drug pa dang bdun pa'i gdan sa chen po'i kyai rdor dang rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub mchod kyi chog dpon la rje 'di phebs te/ so so'i dbang bskur zab mos dad ldan mang po smin cing grol bar mdzad/ de dus rdo rje phur pa'i dbang yon du rgyal ba byams pa'i sku brnyan li ma byon gtsang ba zhig 'bul mi byung ba/ yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i spyan sngar gzigs phul ba na/ yab rje nyid kyi gsung las/ 'di rten 'brel legs/ byams pa'i bstan pa ma shar bar gdung spel byas nas sdod zer ba'i rten 'brel yin gsungs pa sogs dgyes pa'i gsung gis ma 'ongs lung bstan gi tshogs kyang mang du mdzad 'dug go /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ rgyud dang man ngag gsung dbyangs yan lag mchog /bcu phrag drug ldan rdo rje'i glu dbyangs kyi/ /rol rtsed bsgyur ba gling ga bde can zhes/ /mkha' spyod do zlar 'os pa'i chos kyi grwa /gang der bgrang yas bskal pa'i sngon rol tu/ /rje dang slob mar 'ching byed legs smon gyi/ /gser gyi skud pas bcings las mus pa rje'i/ /zhal gyi ku mu da dang gsung gi bcud/ /rnam dpyod lce yis myong phyir rkang drug pa/ /blo gros che de snying stobs brtson pa yi/ /mdzes pa'i gshog yangs bskyod de la gor song / /mgon de'i zhal dkyil spyan sgor snang tsam na/ /sngar 'dris mdza' bshes rang ngo 'phrod pa yi/ /rnam 'phrul brel yang zag med ye shes cher/ /'bad pa med par bde bar 'byams pa'i tshul/ /'di ko rgyal ba rnams la co 'drir zad/ /de tshe sa bcu'i sems dpa' rin chen mtshan/ /gang de'i 'jigs med seng ge'i khri 'phang du/

/bud+dha rat+na gnyis las mgon po khyod/ /rgyal tshab chen por shis pa'i me tog gtor/ /mkho dgu'i zang zing rdzas kyi 'bul nod skyes/ /rnam thos bu yi dpal la phrag dog cing / /lag 'gro dbang po'i mdzod la'ang co 'dri bar/ /bzhed nas sna tshogs phung por byas pa snyam/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan bsngo ba'i mdo don bcud/ /dus gsum dge rtsas rang gzhan byang chub che'i/ /grong du bskyod pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i rlung / /gnas dang gnas min rgyal sras lam gyi dpyid/ /rnam dpyod lus stobs brtas pa'i legs bshad kyi/ /lung rigs mche ba gzengs nas thos mang ros/ /rab myos phas rgol glang chen klad 'gems pa'i/ /'jigs pa'i gad rgyangs dbyangs su gang tshe blangs/ /e ma lang tsho'i ngang tshul phra na yang / /rang gzhan grub mtha'i gnad la rgan po'i blos/ /dgag sgrub dril bu gsil 'di ngag dbang lha/ /mgrin mtshor 'khyil las gzhan du ci zhes gleng / /dus der gsum ldan dge slong rdo rje 'dzin/ /'khor lo sdom pa bud+dha'i mkhyen bzang gi /zla zer 'od kyis lugs gsum bde ba'i mchog /dkyil 'khor ku mud tshal brgya bzhad pa las/ /rab zab dbang bskur sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston dpyid/ /zab yang rgyud bshad dngar ba'i dri bsung dang / /rnam mang lung gi bdud rtsi'i zegs mar bcas/ /rnam dpyod dad dang brtson pa'i snyim pas gsol/ /rdo rje'i rigs ldan sprul pa'i grong khyer mchog /ka lā pa yi 'gran zla byang phyogs pa/ /chos kyis skyong ba ngam ring dga' ldan gling / /sa yi 'chi med grong de'i shar ri'i rtser/ /'dzin ma'i dbang phyug dad pa'i rta ljang gis/ /'jam mgon nyin mo'i dbang phyug mdzad pa yi/ /'od 'phreng 'bum dang 'grogs te phan bde yi/ /pad tshal rgyas pa'i dpyid du de nas bos/ /mkhyen pa'i mdzod nas brtse ba yi/ /phyag gis blangs nas chos kyi tshul/ /rnam mang longs spyod bcud bda' mos/ /mi dbang re ba'i yol go bkang /

/byin rlabs ro brgyas myos pa yi/ /mi bdag gnyis 'thung dbang po de/ /mgon khyod mkhas pa'i gzugs mdzes zhes/ /bstod bsngags sna zhags ring du skyong / /de nas rang nyid bsti ba'i chu skyes mtshor/ /byams brtse'i 'dab brgya bzhad la yab dang gcen/ /zung gi rnam bkra'i ku mud rgod pa der/ /blo bzang ngang pa'i bu de gshog yangs brel/ /bde bar brtol las tshad med bka' drin gyis/ /yun du skyong mdzad grags pa'i gdugs dkar po/ /g.yas su 'khor ba dgyes pa'i grib bsil gyis/ /slar yang sim par 'tsho ba'i legs byas mtho/ /sa 'dzin bzhin du gcig tu brtan pa dang / /chu gter bzhin du dpag dka' zab pa'i thugs/ /mnga' yang phyi nang rkyen mang rlung gi shugs/ /drag pos grags pa'i ye shes ba dan che/ /g.yos pa'i nges 'byung lhab sgra snyan pa'i dbyangs/ /dar gos ka shi'i ras kyi gnang skyes dang / /lhan cig khyod kyi snyan gyi lam yangs por/ /son pa'i mod la zhu gsol spobs pa phrogs/ /slad nas gdung shugs 'od kyis spyan ras kyi/ /gangs ri bzhus shing gsung dbyangs goms pa'i tshugs/ /'dar yang snyan pa'i rgyud mang dad gus kyi/ /sor mos bskul ba'i sgra de rna ba'i bcud/ /gsang chen chos kyi rgya mtsho mus pa las/ /dgyes mdzad rgyud gsum man ngag dbang gi rgyal/ /phan bde'i dga' ston 'jo phyir snying stobs can/ /ded dpon gang khyod len par slar yang chas/ /de nas bdag cag gi skyabs mgon mtshungs pa ma mchis pa 'di nyid slar yang lo de nyid kyi ston gling ga bde ba can gyi dus chos 'chad pa dang / lhag par rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa sogs bzhed chos mang po zhig yod pa rnams zhu ba'i slad du byang phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur te/ sngon du yab rje chos kyi rgyal por phyi phyag zhu ba dang bstun 'phral yun gyi bslab bya mtha' dag zhu bar mdzad nas rim gyis phebs pas/ lha rtser 'byor pa'i tshe/
