ngam ring nas mi dbang chen pos spyan 'dren gyi pho nya mngags pa bzhin/ ngam ring rigs ldan gyi sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po rim par byon pa'i bsti gnas pho brang chen po ngam ring du phebs te/ der chos rgyal chen po lcam sring dang / gzhan yang ngam ring chos rje chen po'i bla ma slob dpon rags bsdus/ drung 'khor rnam dpyod kyi bzhin ras mdzes pa mang po dang bcas pa la so so'i dgongs bzhed dang mthun pa'i dbang bka' rjes gnang / lung gi skor sogs gang la ji 'tshams kyi chos kyi bka' drin zla med pa stsal te/ thams cad kyang dad cing gus pa'i lang tsho brtas par mdzad ces thos la/ de'i tshe dpal sa skya nas nyid kyi yab rje chos kyi rgyal po sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyi thugs dam phyag bris ma zhag gnang byung ba'i nang na/ nged ni nyer dgu'i zla bar 'dug bstan pa la gdan sa'i 'dzin skyong las khag che ba mi 'dug pa sogs zhib cha mtha' dag ngos kyis gleng ba ltar yin pas/ sa skya zer ba'i ming yong mong la rgyas byung bas/ 'dzin skyong spel gsum la blo khur bskyed pa rang gal che che gsungs pa 'dug pa gzigs pa'i rkyen byas/ ngam ring phyogs kyi bstan 'gro'i mdzad 'phrin rnams myur chod mdzad nas mus phyogs su 'phral du phebs te/ gling ga chos kyi skyed tshal du dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis ser 'phreng dang bcas pas bsu ba zhus nas phebs pa'i nangs par/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rje mus pa chen po de nyid chos grwa zur na bzhugs pa'i drung du dgyes bzhin du mjal te phar dad gus dang / tshur byams brtse ste phan tshun thugs yid gcig 'dres kyi ngang nas gdan sa chen po dang / phebs lam sogs kyi gsung 'phros mang du mdzad pa'i rjes su/ rje 'dis bdag gis sngar grub mchog bsod nams dbang po'i drung du lam 'bras cha lag rags rim dang bcas pa lan gcig thob kyang /

da dung gsung ngag cha lag yongs rdzogs kyis brgyan pa zhig rje rin po che'i drung du zhu 'dod pa lags pas bka' drin skyong dgos tshul zhu ba gnang 'dug pa na/ rje mus pa'i gsung las/ gser kha bdag po'i dper 'dug pas/ lam 'bras cha lag dang bcas pa cis kyang 'bul spro zhing / de gong du zhabs drung nas tshogs chen la bka' chos shig gnang dgos zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rje btsun mtshungs med 'di nyid kyis gling ga'i dge 'dun gang yod kyi steng du/ dgon gzhan nas lhags pa'i don gnyer mang po dang bcas pa'i skal ldan du ma zhig la tshe 'phel dkar po/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po/ mi g.yo ba dkar po sogs kyis mtshon pa'i rjes gnang zur bka' bcu phrag gsum lhag tsam so so'i yig lung dang bcas pa dang / rje sems dpa' chen po dang sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung / rdo rje phur pa'i stod las kyi dbang tshar du ma dang / sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung rab phal cher gyi lung rnams bka' drin stsal cing / de nas rje 'di dang gzhis byes kyi don gnyer rags bsdus shig la/ rje mus pa chen po des gsung ngag rin po che cha lag dang bcas pa shin tu smin pa stsal te/ de yang snang gsum gyi khrid kyi bar la bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar gyi lung dang / gsung ngag byung tshul spyi bshad rnams gsungs shing / lta ba'i skabs su dam tshig dang lam gyi khog phub/ phyi bskyed rim la rnal 'byor bcu'i bshad pa rgyas pa/ nang bskyed rim gyi skabs su lus dkyil gyi zab bshad rnams kha bskangs te/ khrid kyi dngos gzhi snang gsum mdzes rgyan dang / rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan gyi tshig don ji lta ba bzhin la gsal byed kyi tshogs du ma dang bcas te zhib tu gsungs pa rnams tshig dang don du bcas pa thams cad thugs su tshud par mdzad cing / de dag gi skabs su thugs dam gyi sgrigs rim bya tshul/ lus kyi 'dug stangs/

ngag 'don dal brel/ tshig gi khyad par gcod mtshams la sogs pa dang / lus sbyong / rlung 'bud tshul/ 'khrul 'khor sogs kyang rje de nyid kyis dngos su ston par mdzad pa dang / dmigs khrid rnams ston pa'i dus/ khrid dmigs rang rang gi rtags dang yon tan la sogs pa'i skabs su/ nyams su longs dang 'di bzhin yong nges zhes yang yang 'dom par mdzad pas/ byin rlabs kyi drod rtags la mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thul le ba yin nges par 'dug dgongs pa'i nges shes khyad par can thugs la 'khrungs shing / de dus lam zab phyi nang / bir bsrung phyi nang / bla ma rin 'byung / lam sbas bshad/ rnam 'joms bir lugs/ tshar gsum khug pa/ brda' don gsal ba/ brda' chig brgyud/ sgrub pa lung 'byin/ mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang gi bar gyi gsung ngag dang 'brel ba'i dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa lag len dang bcas pa/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ gdams ngag gis sarga ma log pa lung sbyin dang bcas pa/ mos gus kyi bsam pa tshim pa drod tshad dang bcas pa zhus shing mngon du mdzad/ gzhan yang de dang 'brel ba'i man ngag phra mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ de re re la yang yan lag du ma dang bcas pa thugs su tshud par mdzad de/ mdor na gsung ngag rin po che cha lag dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa cha lag dang bcas pa ma tshang ba med pa bum pa gcig nas gcig tu 'jo ba lta bu'i tshul du gsan te/ de yang rje btsun rin po che'i dkar chag tu thebs pa'i yig sna drug cu/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i dkar chag nang ltar man ngag phra mo mtha' dag bsdus pa dmar chung du grags pa dang / gzhung bshad dmar ma gsal byed kyi yig chung bdun dang bcas pa/ gzhan rje rdo rje 'chang / sems dpa' chen po sogs bla ma brgyud pa dag gis mdzad pa'i yig cha'i rnam grangs mtha' yas pa gsan pa rnams ni nyid kyi gsan yig na gsal zhing /

'og tu yang 'chad pa las kyang shes par bya'o/ /de dag gi gnas skabs su gsung chos gang yin de gsan pa dang / de nyid kyi phyag len sogs ni zhar byung du dgongs pa zhig byung bar brten/ gsung ngag dang de'i cha lag sogs de dus gsan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs thams cad la/ rje bla ma ji ltar mdzad pa'i phyag bzhes rnams shin tu go bde zhing phyag len gtsang ba tshigs bcad du mdzad nas gsan yig chen mo'i nang du 'khod pa ltar/ don du gnyer ba dag la gsal byed kyi mig tu snang ba zhig go /'on kyang brda chig brgyud thun mong ma yin pa ni slar bsam gtan phug tu rje 'di kho na la gnang ba yin zhes nyid kyi gsung las thos so/ /de ltar gsung ngag grol nas sgrub pa lung sbyin gyi tshe/ rje mus pa'i gsung las/ sngon dpal ldan sa skyar rje ngor chen dang sems dpa' chen po mjal dus/ chos rje rdo rje 'chang la mnal ltas khyad par can byung ba la brten nas snga rting du chos thams cad gang 'phrod 'phrod du gnang ba dang / sgom sde'i ka bcu pa chen po khra ral pa'i rmi lam du/ rje ngor pas bdud rtsi ka pā la gang khong la gnang ba/ rje 'dis blangs nas gsol bar rmis pa la/ khong gis 'khon 'dzin par 'dug zer/ khong khams su 'gro don che yang sku tshe thung bar byung / bdud rtsi rje 'dis thob pa de bla ma'i gdams ngag gi bcud 'dzin pa'i rtags su 'dug cing / sa skyar sgrub pa lung sbyin gnang dus rje ngor pa'i zhal nas/ gzhan mtshan ltas ma byung / rje 'gos la rgyud kyi bka' chen tshugs pa brgyad/ gdams ngag gi gdung chen theg pa'i slob ma bzhi/ las tshogs dang 'phrin las la mkhas pa/ lcam dang dral ma gshibs pa tsam byung zhes pa'i rnam pa tsho yid la gsal ba rang cig byung gsungs te/ rje dpon slob la yang gsung ngag sogs kyi brgyud 'dzin de tsam 'phel zhes pa'i lung bstan du gdon mi za zhing / yang rje ngor pa'i mnal lam du rje nyid kyi dbang gi chu bo yin zer ba'i chu mig gcig 'dug pa'i nye 'khor na/

slob dpon dkon rgyal ba la sogs pa nged rang gi grwa pa mang po 'dug pa na/ dkon rgyal ba'i chos gos kyis ling ste chu mig de la bkab nas/ 'di ni bdag gi 'o zhes bdag tu bzung ba rmis pas/ nged rang gi dbang gi chu bo'i bka' bab slob dpon dkon rgyal ba la yong ba yin tshod du 'dug gsungs pa/ ka bcu pa gsang grub kyis gsan par grags pa dang / rje sems dpa' chen po rang ngor du bzhugs pa'i dus shig mnal lam du/ gling ga'i rgyab ri nas paṇa chen ga ya dha ra'i bum chu yin zer ba'i chu dkar po chen po zhig brdol byung bas/ de je che la song ba'i mthar rgyal khams thams cad khyab pa'i mtshan ltas byung ba sogs kyi rten 'brel gyis/ sa skya pa'i lam 'bras kyi chos rgyun la sems dpa' chen po nas brgyud pa 'di las 'gro phan dang 'phrin las che ba med pas/ da res kyang mgron gyi gtso bo a pho mthu chen gyi dpes/ khyed sa skya zhabs drung gi gtsos pa'i lam 'bras pa rnams kyis gsung ngag gi bshad sgrub la 'bad pa thon la/ lam 'bras nya dar chu dar du yong ba zhig cis kyang mdzod cig gsungs 'dug pa na/ rnam 'dren dam pa 'di'i thugs la sngon ngor pa rdo rje 'chang gis gsung ngag tshar brgyad cu gya gsum tsam gnang 'dug pa dang / de bzhin du rje sems dpa' chen pos kyang tshar nyi shu rtsa drug lhag tsam dang / 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyis tshar lnga bcu rtsa gcig gnang 'dug pa sogs sprul pa'i sku'i mdzad pa de lta bu'i ni ci la yong du 'dug 'on kyang rje bla ma 'di bzhugs pa'i ring la gsung ngag lan grangs gcig gnyis shig ci la thug kyang 'chad thub pa mdzad dgongs pa'i thugs la go cha lhang lhang du 'khrungs pa byung 'dug cing / de nas slar yang grub chen shangs pa nas brgyud pa'i nai gu skor gyi chos bka' rdzogs pa zhig gnang dgos pa'i gsol ba 'debs par mdzad pa na/ rje mus chen gyi gsung las/

nai gu'i khrid rgyas par 'chad na/ sngar smin bka' thob zin la sgyu lus dbang mo che sngon la btang nas de nas chos drug so so rnams so so'i sgos bka' sngon la btang nas khrid rnams 'chad pa yin/ 'bring du 'chad na dbang gis smin zin la sgyu lus dbang mo che sngon la btang nas/ de nas chos drug gi khrid rnams sgos bka' so so bzhag nas 'chad/ bsdus par 'chad na bde mchog dang / de ma byung na yang kye rdor/ gsang 'dus/ mahā ma ya/ 'jigs byed de/ rgyud sde lnga gang rung gi dbang thob pa'i slob ma la chos drug gi khrid rkyang du 'chad pa yin pas/ khyed rang chos thob che ba zhig thugs 'dun la 'dug pa bzhin/ slar nai gu'i chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa zhig mdzad na/ dbang byin rlabs khrid bka' dpe lung sogs tshang ba zhig rje 'gyur med bde chen sogs shangs chos bzhugs che ba gcig la gsan pa'i thugs 'dun mdzad pa zhu zhing / da lam 'di skor gyi zab chos snying por dril ba tsam zhig 'bul dgos par gda'o gsungs nas/ 'jag bsam gnyis kyi nai gu chos drug gi khrid rigs so so'i lung khrid shin tu smin pa zhig gnang nas/ de'i rgyab rten du bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar/ gser chos rnams kyi rtsa 'grel so so/ de dag las 'phros pa'i man ngag gi yi ge gsar rnying du ma dang bcas pa'i nai gu'i chos skor po ti gcig tsam gyi lung gi bka' drin nod par mdzad cing / de nas dpal sa skya nas nyid kyi yab rje chos kyi rgyal pos rje nyid la rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub mchod thog tu phebs dgos pa'i thugs dam phebs par brten/ 'phral du gdan sa chen por chibs kha bsgyur bar nye ba'i tshe/ rje mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa'i gsung las/ da lo nged lo don gsum yin zhing / de bar nyes skyon mi yong ba'i lung bstan gdengs khel zhig yod kyang / da dung lo re lo gnyis ma shi na khyed rang la chos 'phro 'di rnams 'bul thub pa zhig byung na snyam pa yin/

sa skya'i mgon khang gong 'og rnams su zhabs drung rang byon nas/ thugs bsam chos bzhin du 'grub pa'i 'phrin 'chol rgyas pa re mdzad pa zhu/ zhes gsungs 'dug pa na rje 'di thugs cung zad ma bde nas/ bdag sogs ltos bcas dang bstan 'gro'i don du zhabs pad lo brgyar brtan par bzhugs dgos pa'i snyan gsol dang / bzhugs gdan legs pa/ zang zing gi 'bul nod rgya chen po dang bcas brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs kyi tshigs bcad cig kyang mdzad do/ /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ mi pham byams pa'i mkhyen brtse mtshan mo'i mgon/ /skal bzang mig sgor gsal byed dga' ldan grong / /sa la 'phos 'dra ngam ring chos kyi mtshor/ /rigs ldan sprul pa'i dpyid kyi thig le'i rigs/ /sa bdag 'dus pa'i tshogs bcas sgo gsum dri/ /dag byed khrus kyi cho ga gsar pa'i skyes/ /khyod thugs bdud rtsi'i bum bzang nas blangs te/ /'dzum zhal ku sha'i chun pos slar yang gtor/ /de tshe yab rje nyin mo'i mgon po yis/ /nor 'dzin skya bo'i bstan pa'i khur lci yang / /khyod kyi snying stobs phrag par len rigs zhes/ /bka' mchid 'od stong spyan sgo'i mkha' la 'bar/ /'dab bzang gang de byang phyogs chos kyi tshal/ /zab don glu ru len mkhas sbrang rtsi can/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bye ba'i bsti gnas der/ /gsung ngag nyan bshad rol rtsed bsgyur phyir song / /chos kyi grwa der chos la dad pa'i bzhin/ /zab yangs rgyud kyi zab don rin chen rgyan/ /rab mdzes sngags 'chang rab tu mang po'i tshogs/ /chos tshul du mas chos kyi dpal la bkod/ dpal ldan ngan pas bdag med lha mo'i zhal/ /'dzum 'phreng gzigs las gsang chen lam gyi bcud/ /rnam dpyod ljags kyis myangs pas sa drug ro/ /zag med bde bas myos pa'i rdo rje'i glu/ /gsung ngag lam dang 'bras bu rgyur bcas pa'i/ /rab zab gdams pa dbang gi chu bo che/ /rmad byung lag len dang bcas byin rlabs kyi/

/brgyud pa ma nyams ngo sprod bcas pa'i chos/ /go rim ma log gdams ngag gzhan don du/ /sgrub pa'i zab lung sbyin pa dang bcas pa/ /bsam pa tshim pa'i mos gus drod tshad dang / /bcas pa'i snyan brgyud bzhi yi rig byed gtam/ /mus chen tshangs pa'i zhal gyi sgo bzhi nas/ /gang gi sgra 'dzin lam du rdzogs par sim/ /gzhan yang man ngag phra mo'i chu rgyun brgya/ /zab yangs lung gi rlabs 'phreng dang 'grogs te/ /bum bzang gcig gi chu rgyun gcig shos su/ /zegs med ldug pa'i lag pa'i 'khrul 'khor bzhin/ /khyod kyi thugs mtshor 'bab pa'i rab dga'i dpyid/ /wu 'phreng do shal rgod pa'i dge mtshan gsal/ /mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud tam bu ra/ /lhag bsam brtson pa'i sor 'phreng gis/ /lan mang skul ces yongs 'dzin gyi/ /gsung gi 'od 'phreng snyan gyi mtshor/ /lhung bas thugs kyi chu skyes dkar/ /lan brgyar bzhad de e wam̐ pa'i/ /gsung ngag 'dom pa'i grangs kyi mtha'/ /'gog pa min yang zab lam 'di/ /nyung min spel ba'i rwa ba las/ /mi 'da'i g.yar dam lcags kyi phur/ /khyod thugs spang ri'i ngos la btab/ /dgyes mdzad rgyud gsum man ngag chu klung brgyas/ /ma ngom ye shes mkha' 'gro nai gu ma'i/ /rtsa ba sdong bu 'dab ma me tog 'phreng / /'bras bu g.yur za snying gtam bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /shangs pa'i gser chos bcu phyed chu gter che/ /snying stobs hub kyis 'dren la rings pa'i tshe/ /khyung po'i zab bcud sbas pa'i rin chen mdzod/ /mus pa'i zhal bzang gter kha bye ba las/ /chos drug yid bzhin tho tsam khyod kyis longs/ /slar yang man ngag mkho dgu'i nor kun gyis/ /thugs rgyud phyug pa'i bshes shig bstan cig gsungs/ /dga' spro'i dpal la rol tshe rgyal ba'i yab/ /gsung 'phrin dri bzhon dal bus 'jam pa'i dpal/ /zhabs sen rim par bkod pa'i nor 'dzin mdangs/ /rab dkar 'khon gyi sa 'dzin che ru bos/

/de nas rim gyis gdan btegs te gdan sa chen por yab rje chos kyi rgyal po yab sras rnams kyi zhabs drung du phebs nas re zhig gi bar la gdan sa chen po nyid du gdan chags te/ bzhi thog bla brang dang phun tshogs gling sogs su bde kye gsang gsum yo ga bya spyod dang bcas pa'i rgyud man ngag mtha' dag gi tshig don la klog pa thos bsam la gtso bor gzhol ba'i ring nas don du gnyer ba mang po la chos kyi bka' drin kyang mang du stsol bar mdzad de/ de dus skabs shig shar kha chos kyi rgyal po'i gdung rigs zla ba'i thig le 'dzin pa drung mi pham bdud 'joms dpa' bo zhes mtshan gyi dge legs 'chang zhing / sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde'i tshig don la mkhyen rab kyi gzigs pa mkha' ltar yangs pa de nyid rang gi gcen chos rgyal mthu stobs dbang phyug gan pa lhun grub stag rtser dus 'gyur gyi dbang gis phebs dgos shar ba'i tshe/ de dang dus mtshungs par phu dmar du phebs pa'i skabs yin pas/ lan gcig phu dmar nas rje'i drung bsnyun gzhi dang / rkyen gzhan dbang gis lam dus kyi nyams bzhes chag pa zhig byung ba/ slar dbang gi chu rgyun 'thud pa'i phyir dam pa 'di'i drung du kye rdor rgyu lam gyi dbang gsan par phebs pa'i tshe/ rje de nyid dpon slob rnams kyi kha skong du nyid kyi zhabs 'bring pa 'dra 'dri bla ma tshul bzang ba/ byams bzang ba sogs dang / de steng du chos sde lho nas mdo phyogs kyi slob gnyer ba rnams grangs bcad cig phyin chog pa byung ba bzhin/ slob gnyer ba gzhon thog rnams rde'u byas pas/ bdag sogs kha cig gis rde'u thob nas dbang gi grwar yod pas/ de dus rje 'dis dbang bshad kyi tshe/ spyir gyi gsung bshad shin tu rgyas shing 'jebs pa mang po dang / khyad par dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa'i chos skor la/ kyai rdo rje'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa'i rgyud kyi rnam grangs bzhugs tshul/

rgyud de dag la brten nas rgya bod du kye rdo rje'i lam srol byung lugs dang / so so'i yig cha'i rnam grangs de rnams kyi nang nas khyad par 'phags pa sa lugs nyid la da lta rgyud bshad kyi bka' ma nub par bzhugs pa rnams kyi ngos 'dzin/ de dag 'chad byed kyi yig sna tshad ma rnams kyi grangs/ de dag gi kye rdor rtsa bshad kyi rgyud rnams ji ltar 'chad tshul rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rnam gzhag sogs zhib cing mtha' chod pa dang / man ngag la lam 'bras glegs bam gtso bor gyur pa'i yi ge rags pa'i grangs dang / man ngag phra mo'i yig skor bzhugs tshul/ de dag la phyis kyi khrid yig sogs yig cha so so la brten nas gsung ngag rin po che cha lag dang bcas pa 'chad cing nyams su len tshul/ de thams cad kyi rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang nyid la rje sa skya pa chen pos zhu ba po bcu gcig gi ngor rnam 'grel yang de snyed mdzad pa rnams la sa lugs kyi bstan 'dzin rnams ngos 'dzin mi mthun pa phra mo yod lugs/ gzhung bshad rnams kyi nang nas gnyag ma 'di tshig nyung la don rgyas pa/ bla ma dag 'di la thugs rtsis che bas 'di nyid gsal byed kyi yig chung rnams dang bcas pas rdo rje'i tshig rkang nyid ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul sogs mdor na dgyes mdzad rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa'i chos skor gyi khog phub pa'i gsung bshad kyi bka' drin bla na med pa ci yang stsol bar mdzad pas/ phu dmar nas rje rin po che yang ha las te sku na phra mo 'di lta bu la rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i zab don thugs kyi bum par tshud pa'i spobs pa dge ba'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa'i legs par bshad pa'i bdud rtsi'i dga' ston rma med pa 'di ltar 'jo nus pa shin tu ngo mtshar che zhes gsungs shing / gus pa'i thal mo spyi bo'i gtsug tu lan gcig min par yang yang sbyor ba dang / de nas bzung ste rje rdo rje bdud 'joms nyid kyang /

'jam mgon bla ma 'di la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob cing gsung gi bdud rtsi yang mang du nos nas blo gros kyi lang tsho mchog tu brtas pa zhig byung ba yin la/ gzhan yang dus der rje 'di la bdud las kyis mi 'phrog pa'i dad mos kyi rna rgyan 'phyang ba/ gdong ga ba'i phyis 'brangs rogs tsho ma tshe sgron bya ba lan gcig gdan sa chen po'i chos grwa lho byang gi dge 'dun rnams la rgya ja'i rnyed bkur gya nom pa zhus pa'i tshogs dbur rje nyid spyan drangs te/ zang zing gi 'bul ba'i skyes bzang po dang bcas gsung bsngo rgyas 'debs gnang ba'i tshe yang / spyir rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che rnams kyi ngo bo dang / grangs dang / dbye bsdu la sogs pa theg pa chen po'i sde snod kyi brjod don gyi bcud phyung ba'i gsung bshad sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas theg pa che chung gi bsngo ba'i rnam gzhag dang / de las theg chen gyi bsngo ba spros bral gyi shes rab kyis zin pa 'di byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi blo sbyong gi mchog zab lam khyad par ba zhig yin tshul sogs bka' dang bstan bcos kyi lung mang po dang sbyar te/ bsngo ba byas pa'i phan yon/ ma byas pa'i nyes dmigs/ skyon can gyi bsngo ba/ rang gi ngo bo sogs las brtsams te yongs bsngo'i yon bshad mkhas pa rnams kyi yid 'phrog pa zhig kyang mdzad pa thos shing / 'dus pa'i tshogs thams cad kyang dus de tsam nas rje 'di'i mkhyen rab la sus kyang 'gran mi bzod pa'i nges shes khyad par can rnyed par gyur te/ dad mos kyi dbang po dang / dga' spro'i lus zung 'gran pa bzhin du brtas par gyur pa zhig byung ba yin no/ /de nas rje btsun bslu ba med pa'i skyabs mgon dam pa 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig tu phebs pa/ dmar ser can zhes pa me mo sbrul gyi lo'i zla ba brgyad pa 'bras bu can gyi tshe slar yang mus phyogs su phebs te/

de dus rje mus pa chen po de nyid gling kha bde ba can gyi yang dben bsam gtan phug na bzhugs pa'i skabs yin pas/ der nangs par mjal bar phebs pa na/ spyir shin tu dgyes pa'i gsung du ma dang / lhag par gsung ngag lam 'bras las brtsams te khrid dang gzhung bshad/ phyi nang gi bskyed rim man ngag gi phyag len gyi gnad mang po/ ngor rdzong gi grub mtha'i rnam dbye sogs la dri ba'i bka' mchid mang du gnang 'dug pa na/ spyir yang rje 'di rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag tu gyur pa dang / lhag par de dus thugs la snang gsum rgyud gsum gnyis kyi khrid yig mdzes rgyan gnyis dang / gzhung bshad dmar ma gsung ngag glegs bam gyi gnyag ma gsal byed dang bcas pa/ yab kyi bskyed rim yan lag drug pa dang / lus dkyil gyi bshad pa/ cha lag rnams kyi phyag len/ ngor rdzong gi grub mtha'i skyong lugs sogs la 'phral 'phral du thugs rtog mdzad pas/ so so'i brjod don rnams gnad 'gag zhib mo dang bcas pa thugs kyi me long na gsal la ma 'dres par yod 'dug pa bzhin/ rje bla ma'i dri ba'i gsung lan rnams tsham tshom med par 'bul bar mdzad 'dug pa na/ rje mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa nyid mchog tu dgyes pa'i gsung gis/ a la la/ sa skya pa'i yab chos gsung ngag lam 'bras kyi khrid/ gzhung bshad/ man ngag gi gnad zab mo rnams dang / phyag len phra mo tshun chad khyed kyi thugs la spar btab pa bzhin byung 'dug pa shin tu ngo mtshar che/ na ning nged kyis chos rwa zur du lam 'bras cha lag dang bcas pa phul ba'i dus nas brtsams te ka lag len gyi gnad phra mo tshun la zin bris gnang ba sogs thugs kyi don gnyer de lta bu la/ nged btsun rgan yang bsam pa tshim par byung / khyed lta bu'i dbang po rnon po rnams kyis chos la 'dun pa mdzad na/ rta bzang po rtswa za ba'i tshe/ rtswa gcod pa/ ldad pa/ mid pa gsum dus mnyam la 'byung ba bzhin/

bla ma la chos thob pa/ rang gis don go ba/ nyams su long ba gsum lhan cig la 'ong ba yin/ shes rab med pa'i dbang brtul rnams kyis chos brgya thob kyang / ko skam gyi steng du thigs pa phog pa'i sgra lta bu zhig las gzhan 'ong rgyu med tshod du gda'/ zhes sogs nyams ldan gyi gsung mang po dang bcas bstod bsngags gang yang mdzad 'dug cing / de ltar rje dpon slob gnyis thugs yid gcig 'dres kyi gsung gleng gyi ngang du yun ring song ba na/ rje 'di'i thugs la gsung gleng mang bas rje bla ma sku khams log dogs 'khrungs nas/ rje rin po che rgyun par mi su dang mi mjal ba la/ de ring bdag dpon slob mang zhing gsung gleng yun ring bas sku khams log pa sogs mi 'byung lags sam zhes zhu ba mdzad 'dug pa na/ rje 'di'i gsung las/ de 'dra mi 'ongs/ de ring rang re dpon slob mjal ba 'di/ sngon ngor pa rdo rje 'chang dbus kyi gnas mjal 'khor nas zhe dgon du grub chen bud+dha shrī dang mjal 'dug pa de dang 'dra ba yin te/ de yang sngon rje ngor pas/ rje bud+dha ba la/ rta lo zhig shar pa'i tshe bdag gis lo gcig tsam zhig dbus la phyin na mchis sam zhus par/ khyed na ning yang / yang yang 'gro zer gyin 'dug kyang / nged la chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims pas gnang ba'i gdams ngag 'di rnams khyed la rdzogs pa zhig 'phrod na snyam pa de sngar ma tshar ba dang / chos rje sa bzang 'phags pa'i sku tshe ji ltar yong mi shes pa 'dug pas sdod byas pa yin/ da lan song / dbus su lo bzhi 'gor bar 'dug kyang / rten 'brel dga' mo gcig byung bas bar chad mi 'ongs/ nga yang ma shi tsam dang 'phrad par 'dug gsungs nas/ sku mtshams sngar bas dam du btang / thugs dam la dril bas rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa thugs rgyud la 'khrungs/ bya lo zla ba lnga pa la rje ngor pas sa skyar phebs dus/ rje bud+dha ba sku khams bsnyel po yod zer ba gsan nas/

de 'phral mjal du byon pas/ dgon pa'i rtsa bar phebs pa dang nye ba na/ nye gnas nam mgon bsu ba la byung bas/ rje ngor chen gyis nga 'ong ba su las tshor gsungs pa na/ gzhan su la yang ma tshor/ kha sang zla ba snga ma nas bla ma pas sa skyar slebs yod grab kyis yang yang gsungs/ khyad par kha sang da rang gnyis bya ra gyis gsungs nas bya ra byas pa lags zer/ phebs 'phral sku mdun du mjal bar byon pas/ sku bsnyel bo 'dug kyang shin tu mnyes/ gsol ja mang du gsol/ gsung gleng mang du mdzad/ sang tsha ba'i dus kha sang zla ba lnga pa'i tshes lnga'i nub rmi lam zar zir gcig la 'gro mgon chos rje byon nas/ khyed rang gi slob ma de tshes brgyad la yong ba yod/ khos gsol ba btab na da dung lo bzhi mi 'chi gsungs pa zhig byung / de don gyis khyed sleb bam snyam pa dang slebs pa de legs/ do nub tshes brgyad yin pa 'dra bas/ khyed kyis mgon po gdong bzhi pa la bskang gso zhig gyis/ zhing skyong 'dis na ning nas nga'i lam grub pa'i grogs khyad 'phags shig byas gsungs/ spyir phyi nang gi rten 'brel 'di ngo mtshar che ba zhig 'dug kha sang ja 'thung ba dang lab mang pas khams ldog snyam pa byung / nam mgon yang de skad zer gyin 'dug kyang da nga ni phan 'dug gsungs nas/ de nyin yang ja dang gsung gleng mang du mdzad gsungs pa bud+dha pa'i rnam thar ngor chen gyis mdzad pa na 'dug pa dang khyad par med pa'i steng ngos rang ni da lo tsho khams kyang shin tu bzang ba yod pas/ de ring rang re gsung gleng mang tsam gyis khams ldog dogs mdzad mi dgos zhes gsungs 'dug pa na/ rje 'di yang thugs shin tu bde bar gyur cing / de nas rje mus pa chen po'i gsung las/ khyed kyis sa skyar bzhugs pa'i ring la gsung ngag skor la thos bsam ni mthar phyin pa mdzad 'dug da ni nga rang mi rgan yod thog 'dir gling ga tshogs chen la sa skya zhabs drung gis lam 'bras gnang ba zhig byung na de las ngo mtshar ba gzhan 'ong rgyu med pa lta bu yin pas/

da ni 'phral rang dge 'dun rnams la chos rim du mang ja nas kyi bre 'gyed cig sngon du 'gro bas/ gza' skar bzang ba zhig la gsung ngag tshugs pa cis kyang mdzad dgos zhes gsungs 'dug pa bzhin rje 'dis mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa'i drung der nyams bzhes kyi kha gso dgos pa rnams zhus te/ gling ga bde ba can na gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge 'dun rnams dang / mus nang gi dgon so so sogs gzhan nas gsar du lhags par bcas pa'i chos nyan don gnyer can brgya phrag du mar longs pa la/ gsung ngag rin po che'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa zab mo'i dga' ston rma med pa rgyas shing smin pa zla ba kha shas kyi bar du stsol bar mdzad pa na/ de dus rje 'dis ngor chen mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i mdzes rgyan rnam pa gnyis la gtso bor brten nas/ khrid rim dngos kyi sbyor dngos rjes gsum gang la yang thun tshags bsdus pa dang / gong 'og go rim log pa lta bu'i skyon gyi rnam pa cung zad kyang med par man ngag gi 'chad tshul/ rgyud sde dang 'brel tshul phyin ci ma log pa'i sgo nas/ dbang byin rlabs phyag len phra mo tshun la lhag chad nor ba'i skyon gyi dri tsam yang ma mchis par sngon 'gro'i khrid nas brtsams te/ mjug gi bar la bla chen gong ma'i bzhed srol rnams kyi 'brel tshul 'di dang 'di'o zhes sogs bshad pa'i na yams dang / snying po'i sgom don sems thog tu 'bab nges pa dag gsal snyan pa'i gsung gis 'doms par mdzad pa na/ der 'dus kun gyi dad pa dang blo gros kyi dbang po rgyas par gyur cing / rje bla ma mus pa chen po yang thugs gcig tu dgyes pa'i zhal las/ chos nyan pa tshor/ gsung ngag 'chad lugs ji ltar 'dug ces yang yang dri rtog mdzad pa la/ tshul rnams gzhan dag gis zhus par/ pha la bu skyes 'dug ge yong ba yod gsungs pa sogs rje nyid la bstod bkur bsngags gsum mang du mdzad pa dang /

gsung ngag grol nas bsam gtan phur rje bla ma de mjal bar phebs pa'i tshe/ sngon rje nyid kyis nan zhus mdzad pa ltar/ rgyun du mjal ba'i skabs bzhengs pa sogs mi mdzad par/ rje 'dis phyag mdzad pa'i ring la/ phyag thal mo sbyar nas spyan lta stangs kyi ngang la bzhugs pa zhig yod 'dug pa la/ de dus ci zhus kyang ma gsan par bzhugs gdan steng bzhengs nas phyag len gyi tshul mdzad cing / phyag nas gser zho gsum la dar sna lnga kha mang po sbrel ba zhig rje 'di la stsal nas/ 'di khyed kyis gsung ngag gegs med du grol ba'i sgom chen gyis gtang rag brda mtshon lags so zhes gsungs/ slar bzhugs gdan la bzhugs nas/ nged kyis snga mo nas bsam pa la/ mus nang gi dgon ma bu 'di rnams sa skya pa'i phyag tu 'phrod cing / gling gar sa skya bdag chen gyis lam 'bras 'chad pa zhig byung na snyam pa yod pa/ rmi lam la bsgugs pa mngon sum gyi dpe de da lo byung bas/ nged kyang bsam pa de kas rdzogs shing / der ma zad sems dpa' chen po dpon slob nas bzung khyed rang gi yab mes sa skya pa chen po'i bar sogs kyi rje btsun gong ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa thams cad kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs yod pas/ khyed rang yang las 'phro dang skal ba shin tu bzang ba yin/ lhag par da res lam 'bras thog mar gnang ba de la bar chad ma byung bas/ da lam 'bras gang 'chad kyang bar chad mi 'ong / de nged kyis lung bstan yang yin zhes kyang gsungs zhes thos la/ de'i skabs shig snga mo nas dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas nan tan du gsol ba btab pa de nyid thugs la bcags pas rje 'di zhabs drung na bzhugs pa zhig la/ rje de nyid dar cig dgongs pa la bzhugs te/ de nas spyan cher gzigs te/ rang re dpon slob byang chub bar du mi 'bral lo mi 'bral lo/ /khyed 'jam dbyangs kyi gdung brgyud yin pas sngon la sangs rgyas na nged drongs shig ces bka' stsal pa na/

rje btsun dam pa 'di'i thugs la rdo rje 'chang mi gzugs can 'di lta bu dang byang chub bar du mi 'bral ba'i zhal bzhes rjen par gnang ba 'di 'dra rmi lam yin nam mngon sum yin dgongs pa'i thugs la dga' bde tshad med pa dang / sku lus kyang 'tsho mi thub pa lta bu byung snang ba dang / rjes su sku zhabs na yod pa'i grogs dag la yang de dus rje 'di ltar gsung gi e snang zhes brtag dpyad kyang mdzad 'dug par/ de bzhin byung tshul zhus pas thugs la dgyes spro bla lhag tu 'phel ba zhig byung gsungs shing / tshul 'di la dgongs nas rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rgyal ba mus pa chen po de nyid kyi rnam thar bstod tshig tu/ de ltar bla ma'i yon tan cha shas tsam/ /brjod pa'i dge bas yongs 'dzin dam pa dang / /byang chub bar du 'bral ba med do zhes/ /zhal bzhes ji bzhin gegs med don ldan shog /ces kyang gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rje btsun mus pa chen po'i rnam thar chen mor yang / 'brel tshad don ldan nyid dang slob bu bdag /byang chub bar du 'bral ba med pa'i tshul/ /zhal bzhes thos tshe ngo mtshar gnas 'di 'dra/ /bden nam brdzun snyam yid gnyis khyogs la 'phyang / /zhes 'byung ba yin la/ de nas mi ring bar bsam gtan phug tu rje dpon slob gnyis po rang chabs cig tu gdan chags shing thugs 'gol ba zhig na/ bdag cag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa 'di gling gar phebs dus nyid kyi yab rje grags pa'i mtshan can gang gis/ rje 'di la gdan sa chen po'i 'dzin skyong gi khur bzhes dang / gdung spel mdzad dgos pa'i phebs sgo nan chen byung tshul gong du bkod pa de nyid zhus te/ bdag ni de 'dra'i zhe 'dod gtan nas med pa dang / bka' nan lhug stsol lci bas lus sbrid nas 'tsho mi thub pa lta bu dang / sems kyang skyo la dga' ches pa'i rnam pas mid pa 'khyil bas gong sa'i gsung rnams la lan yang zhu ma thub pa zhig byung lags pa don la ji ltar byas na legs pa 'ongs legs sam zhes zhu ba mdzad 'dug par/

rje mus pa chen po'i gsung las/ yab sras gnyis ka thugs bden pa'i rang bzhin du ni gda'/ zhabs drung rin po che'i gsung de rnams la zhu rgyu gtan nas mi 'dug cing / 'on kyang sku mched mang pas khong rnam pas yab kyi zhal la 'khri ba tsam byung na/ khyed da lta'i rten 'di kha'i steng nas gzhan don mdzad na zhal ngo gong ma rnams kyi zhabs tog tu de ka 'gyur che zhing / bstan pa dang sems can la yang phan slebs de ka che ba yong snyam pa ni 'dug 'on kyang rim gyis dbyibs tshul la gzigs kyin dgag dgos rtsis pa'i gnang lugs gnang ba zab pas/ de bzhin thugs la zhog mdzod ces lung bstan khyad par can de dus kyang byung bar snang ngo / /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ thos dang bsam pa'i bdud rtsi mngar ba'i ros/ /phyur bur gtams pa'i tshul khrims ga bur dri'i/ /za ma tog des bstan 'gro'i dbul gso zhes/ /blo gros can de klog la gcig tu gzhol/ /de lta na yang rigs kyis mkhar 'gran zhing / /bslab sbyangs nor gyis klu dbang bang mdzod 'gog /srid zhu'i brtan pa lhun por 'gong nus pa'i/ /shar kha gdung skyes rdo rje bdud 'joms sogs/ /skal ldan mang po'i gzhir gnas dbyig 'dzin mar/ /sku bzhi'i sa bon smin byed zab mo'i dbang / /ljags kyi klong 'phreng legs par sprin gyi rnga/ /rnam dpyod chu 'dzin stug pos dal bur 'bebs/ /dad pa'i gzugs brtas gtong phod bzhin bzang ma/ /tshe sgron rnam dkar gyis mtshon rang gzhan gyi/ /byas dang byed 'gyur byed pa'i legs byas kun/ /byang chub chen por yongs bsngo'i bka' drin stsal/ /gsang chen chos kyi zab bcud bde ba'i mchog /lū dril nag po'i bskyed rdzogs sbrang rtsi'i ros/ /myos pa'i rin chen bzhi bzlas mgrin snyan can/ /rdor 'dzin rkang drug lding khang bsam gtan phug /der ni 'khor lo sdom pa ngur smrig can/ /mus pa'i zhal dkyil slar yang gzigs pa'i mod/

/dgyes mdzad rgyud gsum man ngag chos tshul la/ /rtog dpyod dri ba'i rnga dbyangs ci yang brel/ /de tshe bi rū'i rdo rje'i tshig gi mdud/ /rnam 'grel bcu dang gcig gis bkrol ba'i gnad/ /zab khrid phyi nang bskyed rim lag len dang / /ngor rdzong bzhed pa'i nyi zla'i 'od phreng zung / /tsha bsil nus pas gdul bya'i blo yi rigs/ /'dab brgya ku mud bzhad pa'i khyad par las/ /mi shes mun pa'i gnyen por mnyam tshul sogs/ /dka' ba'i 'phrang kun bkral ba'i lan gyi skyes/ /'khyog po'i lam gyi ri mo ma bris par/ /rnam dpyod pho nyas ro 'dzin 'gros bsgyur te/ /yongs 'dzin snyan dbang sug par gsol ba na/ /dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal rgyud mang las/ /legs so dri za'i glu dbyangs 'tsher/ /bag phebs 'dzum gyi me tog lhod/ /bstod bsngags dri bsung ljags rtse brel/ /da ni gsung ngag lam gyi bcud/ /skal ldan rin chen snod mang la/ /mkhyen bzang bdud rtsi'i bum pa nas/ /lhugs par 'os pa'i dus yin gsungs/ /dus der khyed thugs tshangs pa'i ral pa nas/ /snyan brgyud gdams pa skabs gsum bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /lhag bsam skal ldan shing rtas 'khor ba'i rgyun/ /dug can bu rnams dri ma dag byed du/ /'jam snyan ro 'dzin bde mo'i dri bzhon gyis/ /gling ga 'dzam gling dbyig 'dzin mar phab pas/ /mus yul chos kyi mtsho chen ma dros las/ /gsang chen chu rgyun 'bab pa'i dge mtshan spel/ /rgyu'o rgyud dang man ngag gi /mkha' la mkhyen brtse nyi zla zung / /legs bshad zer 'phreng 'bum dang bcas/ /gsung 'dzin rgyu skar bye ba yang / /gar byed zhal sgo ne tsu lar/ /chos glu yang len mgrin sngon ljags/ /thub gsung gces pa'i gsang gtam la/ /dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur ci yang brel/ /dman rigs mchog tu 'gyur byed de/ /ma smin pa yang smin par 'gyur/ /nus med sa bon nus ldan du/ /'gyur byed gsung ngag 'dom pa'i tshe/

/e ma ring nas bzhed pa'i don/ /rmi lam re ba mngon sum pa/ /gang 'di 'jam mgon gong ma'i tshogs/ /kun kyang dgyes pa bskrun pa'i rgyu/ /nged kyi re ba'i yol go yang / /yongs su 'gengs pa'i bcud kyi phul/ /da de gsung ngag lam gyi dga' ston che/ /ji tsam 'jo yang bar du gcod pa yi/ /bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal rnga gzengs mthor brdungs/ /grags dkar ba dan srid rtse'i bar du bsgrengs/ /ji srid spangs rtogs rtse mo byang chub grong / /nyams dga'i sa de mngon du ma gyur bar/ /de srid 'bral ba med ces mus pa'i gsung / /rab snyan nyin mor byed pa'i zer 'phreng gis/ /gang gi snyan gyi bdud rtsi khol ba na/ /theg mchog dang po'i sa brnyes sems dpa'i yid/ /bde chen 'gog pa'i dga' spro 'gran pa bzhin/ /chabs cig thob pa'i mod la mdzes pa'i sku/ /spu long ku sha'i myu gu g.yo ba yang / /rma bya'i mjug sgro rlung gis bskyod la 'gran/ /khyod nyid rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig pur/ /bdud las rgyal ba yongs kyis dbyangs gcig gis/ /gsungs pas rgyal ba 'jam pa'i dpal min nam/ /yin na rgyal ba mus pa'ang khyod kyi sras/ /de bas de dang 'bral med gtam/ /'khum pa de la dgyes yin na/ /mgon po de dang khyed gnyis yab/ /sras tshul de nyid bden min nam/ /de nas lo de'i zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes ma thag pa'i skabs der thub bstan rnam rgyal nas mkhan chen bzod pa rgya mtsho ba dang / rdzong dga' ldan rtse nas chos kyi rje 'jam dbyangs chos bzang rnams rje mus chen mjal ba dang 'dod chos zhu ba la 'dzoms 'dug par brten/ rje mus chen gyi gsung gis/ mus phyogs 'dir bsnyen rdzogs kyi las gral ma byung ba yun ring tsam song 'dug da lam phyogs nas dge bshes du ma 'dus pa'i skabs 'dir las gral zhig bsgrigs na bstan pa'i rgyud la phan chen po 'ong ba 'dug gsungs pa bzhin/ bdag cag gi rnam 'dren mtshungs pa ma mchis pa 'di nyid kyang /

tshul khrims ldan pa'i dge slong 'od dang ldan/ /tshul khrims ldan pa grags 'gyur bde ba thob/ /tshul khrims ldan pa 'jig rten kun gyis bstod/ /tshul khrims kyis ni 'gro ba dam pa thob/ /ces dang / rten ni gsum las dge slong mchog /'bring ni dge tshul yin par 'dod/ /khyim na gnas pa tha ma'o/ /zhes dang / dge slong zhes bya chos kyi rgyal mtshan te/ /dge slong zhes bya rdo rje'i srog shing yin/ /zhes sogs mdo rgyud bstan bcos dang bcas pa du ma nas lan gcig ma yin par phan yon dang bsngags brjod rgya cher gsungs pa rnams kyis thugs phrogs shing / gang yang thub pa'i dbang po'i bstan pa rin po che'i rgyal tshab dam par mnga' gsol ba'i brten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i legs byas kyi bgyi ba spel ba la/ bstan pa'i sgor zhugs la rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po nyid du gyur pa zhig dgos par dgongs nas/ hor lugs zla ba gnyis pa'i yar tshes bzang po la rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal rtse ba chen po dang rnam dbyer ma mchis pa bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sogs rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung rigs 'dzin pa du mas byin gyis brlabs shing / mus chen 'gro ba'i bla ma sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sogs mkhas grub mang po'i zhabs kyis bcags shing bdag gir mdzad pa'i gnas mchog gling ga bde ba can gyi bya 'dabs/ grub pa'i yang dben bsam gtan phu'i sems dpa' chen po'i gzim phug gi steng / grub chen dkon mchog blo gros kyi gzim khang zhal ser ma'i mdo/ 'jam mgon sa paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis pa sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa zab bzhes kyi bcad rgya lo gsum du gdan chags pa'i bsti gnas dam pa gang der/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa nyid ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gar gyi rnam par rol pa yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan nyid kyis mkhan po dang /

legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba sogs gzhung lugs mang pos mgrin pa mdzes shing / dngos stobs kyi rigs pa smra ba'i khyu mchog thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi mkhan po bzod pa rgya mtsho bas las kyi slob dpon/ mdo sngags kyi ring lugs mtha' dag la mkhyen rab kyi gzigs pa mkha' ltar yangs pa thub bstan yangs can mkhan po 'jam dbyangs chos bzang pas gsang ston/ nyes ltung gi dri ma dang bral zhing gsang chen zab mo'i nyams len gyis thugs rgyud gtams pa gling ga zur 'chad chos skyong rdo rje bas grib tshod pa/ chos shes nas nyams su bstar ba la mkhas shing grub pa'i 'dul 'dzin chen po chos rje kun dga' lhun grub pas grogs dan te/ dad pa'i dge 'dun 'khor 'dul ba 'dzin pa du ma dang bcas pa'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po mngon du mdzad de/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs shing yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgo nas/ ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu lta bur gyur cing / de'i tshe mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las ji ltar gsungs pa ltar bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha rnams kyis lha rdzas kyi me tog gi char 'beb/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i mkhas pa'i skye bo rnams dang / de dag la mngon par dga' ba'i 'chi med gzhon nu'i tshogs dag gis dga' zhing spro ba'i glu dbyangs dal gyis len/ 'dod pa'i dbang phyug 'khor du bcas pa dang / de'i phyogs su gyur pa nag po'i rigs su gyur pa rnams ni yid mug cing / nyams mi dga' ba'i ca co'i sgra kun tu grags par byed/ snyan pa'i grags pa sa bla'i lha rnams kyi gnas nas 'og min gyi bar du bsgrags te/ nor 'dzin ma'i steng thams cad khyab par gyur to/ /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ wa ra na si zhes bya dang po yi/ /chos kyi tshal der lnga sde'i dri ma'i tshogs/ /khrus kyi cho gar sde bzhi'i chu klung che/

/go tam lha des phab pa'i dus ston bzhin/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i sa la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /mus chen ngur smrig 'chang ba kun gyi rje/ /phun tshogs 'khor du 'dul 'dzin 'bum gyis bskor/ /legs gsung 'dul khrims kha lo bsgyur ba gzigs/ /gang tshe nyid kyi thugs mtsho las/ /dad pa'i wu 'phreng gyen du 'phyur/ /bsnyen rdzogs yid bzhin nor bus gtams/ /mdzes sku rin chen ngur smrig bklubs/ /gang gsung legs bshad phuṭa sgra 'jo/ /sngon med 'dul 'dzin klu dbang po/ /gling ga chos kyi chu gter che/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan du khyod gcig mtho/ /de tshe bstan la dga' ba'i lha yi tshogs/ /shis pa'i sgra ldan me tog char gyis brel/ /nyag phran bdag po'i snying la zug rngu sbyin/ /yid mug ca co'i sgra dbyangs de na 'phel/ /grags dkar ba dan sa 'dir ma shongs zhes/ /sa bla'i 'chi med gzhon nus dbyangs zlos pas/ /gsum rtsen 'og min brgal te dbyig 'dzin gyi/ /khyon kun dog por gyur 'di e ma mtshar/ /dus de nyid nas bzung ste ltung ba sde lnga char gtogs dang bcas pa'i dri ma mtha' dag dang bral zhing / gnyen po'i khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum char gtogs dang bcas pa bsrung ba la g.yel ba med par mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas rje btsun mus pa chen po de nyid la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rim lnga'i khrid la sogs chos tshul mtha' yas pa zhig gsan par mdzad pa'i tshe/ thog mar bskyed rim gyi bshad pa paṇa chen gung ru/ rje nyi zla seng ge sogs kyi rnam bshad kyi steng nas rgyas shing mtha' chod pa dang / rje rdo rje 'chang dang kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa'i rim lnga'i yi ge rje blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi zin bris dang bcas pa la/ gzhan mkhas pa mang po'i gsung gi legs bshad kyis brgyan pa'i rim lnga'i khrid shin tu smin pa nyams khrid du gsan nas/ de dag gi rgyab chos su rgya bod kyi gzhung mang po'i lung bshad rgyas par nod par mdzad cing /

de dus rje mus chen gyi gsung las/ gsang 'dus 'phags skor gyi rgya gzhung 'di rnams gang zag gcig gis nyams su len na/ gzhung so so'i brjod bya'i don rnams lam rim du sgrig tshul 'di ltar shes dgos pa yin te/ de yang thog mar rgyud ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i rgyu dbang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du bskur tshul klu byang gis mdzad pa'i cho ga nyi shu pa pa tshab nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur/ smin nas rgyu dbang lam du byed par ras bris la brten nas bskur tshul sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i zung 'jug gsal ba sa paṇa gyi 'gyur te dran pa gcig pa bsgom pa'i sngon 'gro'o/ /dran pa gcig pa sgom tshul la gnyis/ dran pa gcig pa bsgom pa dngos dang / de'i cha lag go /dang po la 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i mdor byas lo chen gyi 'gyur/ de nyid rtsa rgyud kyi lung dang sbyar ba mdo dang bsre ba lo chen gyi 'gyur/ /mdor byas kyi skabs skabs su mi gsal ba gsal byed kyi kha skong klu byang gi rnam gzhag rim pa lo chen gyi 'gyur/ gnyis pa de'i cha lag la/ mdor byas kyi sngon 'gro tshogs bsags ston pa rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog nag po dam tshig gi rdo rjes mdzad pa 'gos 'gyur/ sgrub dkyil thams cad kyi kha skong mngon shes can gyis mdzad pa'i gtor chog 'gyur byang med pa/ rab 'jigs rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg lo chen gyi 'gyur/ zla grags gnyis pas mdzad pa'i rdor sems 'gyur byang med pa/ 'di sgron gsal mdzad mkhan dang mi mthun te/ mdor byas mdo bsre rnam gzhag rim pa sgron gsal rnams dang 'gal ba du ma snang bas so/ /rdzogs rim la 'phags pas mdzad pa'i rim lnga lo chen gyi 'gyur/ 'di'i rim pa gnyis pa'i 'khor ba'i gzeb las rnam par grol/ /zhes pa yan chad kyi sems dben sgom pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa yar bcad 'phags pa'i gsung yin la/

de las 'phros pa'i gsung 'phros mang po byung ba shākya bshes gnyen gyi chad dogs dang 'phags pa'i gsung rab la 'thud nas bris pa ni/ shes rab ngo bo nyid 'di ni/ /zhes pa man chad do/ /'di'i sems dben gyi kha skong du ar+ya de was sems kyi sgrib sbyong mdzad pa nag tsho tshul rgyal gyi 'gyur/ klu byang gis las mtha' rnam 'byed mdzad pa chag lo chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ sgyu lus kyi kha skong du ar+ya de wa'i bdag byin gyis rlabs pa 'gos 'gyur/ 'od gsal gyi chos can bde ba chen po'i kha skong du ar+ya de bas mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ chos nyid spros bral du ston pa'i kha skong 'phags pas mdzad pa'i byang chub sems 'grel lo chen gyi 'gyur/ rim lnga'i rim pa re re la yang rim pa lnga re tshang bar bstan pa klu byang gis mdzad pa'i rim pa khong du bsdu ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur/ de rnams kyi rim pa lnga rgyas par bstan pa'i don sgom pas nyams myong skyes pa ngo sprod pa ar+ya de was mdzad pa'i spyod bsdus sgron me lo chen gyi 'gyur las 'gos gyis bcos pa/ rim lnga sbyor ba yan lag drug tu sbyar ba'i sbyor drug sgra dbyangs bcu gcig pas mdzad pa lo chen gyi 'gyur/ 'gos kyis mdzad pa'i shog ril gsum/ nyi ma seng ges mdzad pa'i btsun mo can gyi shog ril gyi 'grel pa sogs kyang de dag gi zhabs 'degs su sbyar nas 'chad cing nyams su len pa'i gnad shes dgos pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / gzhan yang rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsang 'dus kyi chos skor 'chad pa'i skabs kyi gsung bgros khyad par can sred pa kun blo'i zin bris las 'byung ba bzhin rgyas par gsungs dag kyang rje 'dis zin bris su bkod pa mdzad cing / de ltar gsang 'dus 'phags skor gyi chos tshul rnams zla ba phyed gnyis tsam gyi bar du smin rgyas su gsan nas/

slar yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' gdams pa nas brgyud pa'i blo sbyong gi chos skor sogs cha tshang ba zhig gsan par mdzad pa'i thog mar bka' gdams lha bzhir grags pa'i thub pa'i lha khrid/ seng ldeng nags sgrol rjes dran gyi khrid/ mi g.yo ba chos drug gi khrid/ thugs rje chen po skyer sgang lugs kyi khrid rnams dang / de nas blo sbyong don bdun ma nyams khrid du gsan pa'i rgyab brten du jo bo yab sras kyi rnam thar che chung / blo sbyong legs bshad kun 'dus dkon mchog 'bangs kyis mdzad pa/ rgyal sras thogs med/ 'gro mgon dpal ye/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig rgyas bsdus sogs smin rgyas su stsol bar mdzad pa bzhin gsan nas thugs su tshud par mdzad de/ de dus rje mus pa chen po'i gsung gis/ jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti shas rab tu byung zhing / byang chub kyi sems btsal ba'i rnam par thar pa dang / gser gling chos kyi grags pas mtha' bral dbu ma'i lta ba bsdus tshul/ bod yul du byon pa'i rnam thar/ mya ngan las 'das byung gi rnam thar sogs rgyas par gsungs pa rnams dang / jo bo'i rnam thar rgyas par gsungs pa'i rjes thogs su/ bka' gdams pa'i man ngag gi khog sgrigs mdor bsdus stsal pa dag rje bla ma'i gsung bzhin/ dam pa 'di nyid kyis zin bris kyang mdzad par snang la/ de nas gzhan yang dus der sum pa lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i mkha' 'gro ma'i snyan brgyud kyi man ngag gi khrid dang / kha che paṇa chen nas khro phu lo tsā ba la brgyud pa'i skyid sdug lam 'khyer gyi khrid sogs gsan cing / de dag gi bar gseng la rnam 'dren dam pa 'dis thub bstan mkhan chen dang / chos rje 'jam dbyangs chos bzang pas gtsos pa'i gling ga tshogs chen la gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dbang lan mang po dang / rags bsdus shig la mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i bka' 'bum gyi lung gi bka' drin stsol bar mdzad ces thos la/

de nas gdan sa chen por nyid kyi yab rje chos kyi rgyal po chab gzhi la brten pa'i sku bsnyel po yod pa'i gtam gsan nas/ 'phral du chibs kha gdan sa phyogs su bsgyur ba'i sgo dod pa na/ ngam rim nas chos rgyal chen pos spyan 'dren nan zhus byung bar brten/ khor tsam zhig phebs rtsis kyi tshe/ rje bla ma'i gsung las/ sa skyar zhabs drung yab rin po che sku khams ma bde ba de shin tu ma legs/ kha sang nas nged kyi rmi lam du/ zhabs drung rang gi rgyun bzhes kyi dbu zhwa de/ yang yang nged kyi lag tu gnang ba zhig byung ba de/ khyed rang la mi lta/ zhal ngo che mes shig la sku dogs yod pa'i ltas su 'dug pas/ da res ngam ring phyogs su phebs 'gor gang chung mdzad nas gdan sar gang myur du 'byor pa mdzad dgos so/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ ngam ring chos kyi rgyal khab chen por phebs te/ thog mar theg mchog yangs rtse'i klu sding gsar pa der mi dbang chen po gtso bor gyur pa'i skya ser gyi tshogs stong phrag lhag tsam la brgyud pa'i khyad par gnyis ldan gyi cho ga'i sgo nas theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed kyi bka' drin bla na med pa stsal cing / de nas ngam ring rtse'i rigs ldan pho brang du zhag shas bzhugs nas/ de'i ring la sde srid lcam sring dang / ngam ring chos sde chen po'i che bgres dpon slob rags rim gyis thog drang / lo phu dgon pa'i dge 'dun grwa mang dang bcas pa rnams la gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dbang cha lan kha yar dang / mi dbang dpon g.yog rags bsdus shig la tshe bka' rjes gnang sogs ci rigs pa zhig gnang nas/ 'phral du gdan sa chen po'i phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur ba'i shad rtsol gyis phebs pa na/ nyid kyi yab rje chos kyi rgyal po sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid lo de'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad la dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim nas/ bcu dgu'i nyin thugs dam grol ba na rje nyid gdan sa chen por phebs pa tsam las/

sku gshegs kar yab rje'i zhal dngos su ma mjal bar brten shin tu thugs las che ba'i thugs yed yed po dang / sku lus kyang sbrid pa'i tshe mi thub pa ltar gyur pa zhig byung gsungs shing / de nas sku gdung rin po che mjal bar phebs nas phyag dang skor ba mang du mdzad cing / sku gdung la dbu btsugs nas smon lam dang gsol 'debs kyi tshogs thugs tshim par mdzad ces gsungs/ de nas grub pa'i dbang phyug bsod nams dbang po dang / nyid kyi gcen sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal te khu dbon gnyis dang bcas pas/ yab rje de nyid kyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub mchod kyi thugs dam gsol 'debs yun ring du 'bul ba/ sku gdung gi bzhu 'bul/ gdung tsha 'debs pa/ mchod 'bul dngos gzhi rgya dpang shin tu che ba sgrub pa mdzad rjes/ nang rten du dbu rtse'i lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gser sku gsar bzhengs dang / lo dang zla ba'i dus dran gyi mchod 'bul du bla ma mchod chog rgyud sde zab mo'i zhal 'don/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod sogs rgyas par 'dzugs par mdzad pa'i rgyun da lta yang ma chag par rgyun chags su mdzad pa 'dir snang zhing / slar rje nyid kyis sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid kyi dgongs dbyings rdzogs thabs su dngul gdung rin po che rgyu dang bzo khyad gzhan las phul du byung ba bzhi thog bla brang gi rig 'dzin bla ma brgyud pa'i gtsug lag khang du bzhugs pa dang / gzhan yang rgyu tshogs rmad du byung ba las grub pa'i bris thang gtso bsdus chen mo/ sngags thang thog tshad ma gras gcig mang ba/ rdo rje 'phreng ba sbyong dkyil sogs kyis mtshon pa'i dkyil thang grab mang po/ sngags 'chang de nyid kyi gsung 'bum sogs sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang po gsar du bzhengs pa dang / rnying pa mang po'i nyams gso/ yab rje de nyid kyi dus dran gyi mchod 'bul gyis thog drangs/

gdan sa chen po'i dge rgyun mtha' dag yar ldan du spar ba sogs/ mdor na sku gsung thugs kyi rnam dkar gyi las ci mdzad pa thams cad sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid dgongs dbyings zab mo rdzogs thabs 'ba' zhig tu mdzad snang ngo / /don de la 'di skad smra ste/ yan lag bdun ldan kha sbyor sku mnga' ba'i/ /ston pa che des bla na med pa'i rgyud/ /pha ma gnyis su med pa'i dga' ston che/ /skal bzang lha mir stsal las pha bla med/ /gsang ba 'dus dang sgyu drwa gshin rje'i gshed/ /sde gsum ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /dug gsum me lce rab bsil 'dus pa'i srol/ /klu sgrub bud+dha dz+nyā nas phye ba zung / /gang gis snying po'i bcud phyung rim pa lnga/ /nyams su bstar ba smar khrid lam gyi dpyid/ /mdor byas mdo bsre zab rgyas gzhung gi tshogs/ /grangs med lung gi bka' drin dang bcas pa/ /don gnyer snyim pas gsol yang rnam dpyod che/ /ma tshim pha rol phyin gsung nying khu'i ro/ /bka' gdams gzhung dang gdams pa'i chu bo brgya/ /gcig 'dres mus chen ma dros mtsho chen las/ /legs babs lha bzhi'i zab khrid chu klung bzhi/ /khyod thugs rin chen 'byung gnas klong du babs/ /ngo mtshar rab dga'i wu 'phreng gyen du 'phyur/ /bka' gdams chos mtsho gsar pa 'di na 'khyil/ /blo sbyong bka' bab gsum las a ti shas/ /gser gling chos kyi gter nas zab mo'i khrid/ /rin chen don bdun rnyed pa 'chad dka' ba'i/ /rdo rje'i tshig mdud bzang dpal sems dpa' che/ /gzhon nu'i legs bshad kyis bkrol gnad kyi sman/ /ngar 'dzin nad kyi rang mtshang brtol mkhas pa/ /mus chen lha yi sman pa'i zhal bum las/ /blangs nas nyon mongs nad gdon khyod kyis bcom/ /di paṃ ka ra'i rtogs brjod mu tig 'phreng / /rje btsun bud+dha'i gsung gi srad bu la/ /brgyus nas mgon po khyod kyi blo gros che'i/

/mgul pa mdzes pa'i rgyan du de tshe thob/ /dpal mchog rdo rjer zung gi ḍā ki mas/ /snying gtam zur gyis gdams pa'i snyan brgyud khrid/ /kha che'i mkhas pas khro phu skad gnyis par/ /sbyin pa'i skyid sdug mnyam pa'i bcud kyang gsol/ /de tshe dus kyis yab rje mtho ris sde'i/ /mdzes pa'i skas las dag pa'i zhing song ste/ /mdzes sku dngos su gzigs pas bskal ba na/ /skyo shas ser bus nyid thugs yed yed g.yos/ /'dren byed gangs ri gdung ba'i mes bzhus pas/ /bzhin ras 'dab brgya spyan chu'i thigs pa yis/ /bran kyang mi phyed dad pa'i gsol 'debs dbyangs/ /rgyud mang bskul ba'i rnam 'phrul kun tu brel/ /rnam gsum dus kyis bsdus pa'i legs byas tshogs/ /sgo gsum phra rags bgyis dang bgyid stsal sogs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yab gcig grags pa'i mtshan/ /srid gsum skye dgu'i mgon der dbul la brtson/ /slar yang rgyal kun spro bsdu'i byed pa por/ /nam yang yid gnyis spangs te de las gzhan/ /gang yang skyabs su mi 'dzin mus pa rjer/ /gzhan yang zab bcud gsol phyir de nas song / /de nas rje nyid dgung lo nyer gnyis su phebs pa kā la du ti ste dus kyi pho nya zhes pa sa pho rta'i lo'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin gdan btegs te/ slar yang mus pa chen po bsam gtan phug na bzhugs pa'i drung du phebs nas/ rje de nyid kyi gzim phug dang nye bar bsam gtan phu'i bla brang du bzhugs te/ rje bla ma'i thugs dam gyi thun mtshams la yang yang mjal nas/ sngar ma gsan pa'i zab chos gur gyi mgon po'i nang khrid 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi yig cha'i steng nas smin cing rgyas pa dang / gzhan yang srung 'khor rdo rje'i brag rdzong ma'i khrid rgyab chos kyi yi ge mang po'i lung dang bcas pa gsan/ de nas gcod kyi skor la/ man ngag gi yig cha rje sems dpa' chen po dang / dol pa legs shes kyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig che chung rnams dang /

rje mus pa chen po nyid kyi yig sna'i steng nas lung khrid shin tu rgyas pa zhig gsan par mdzad/ de nas lan gcig rje 'dis ched du gsol 'debs ma mdzad kyang / rje btsun mus chen bud+dha'i mtshan can de nyid thugs dgyes pa'i nyams chen po dang bcas gsung las/ gdams ngag 'dis rje btsun sa skya pa rang gi bla ma brgyud pa mang po zhig dag pa mkha' spyod du gshegs nges pa'i gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i gsang ba'i nye lam yin gsungs nas/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag de dang / mkha' spyod ma'i 'pho ba chig brgyud ma gnyis dgyes bzhin du stsal pa gsan cing / gzhan yang rjes gnang zur bka' rigs 'ga' zhig dang / khyad par zhal gzigs kyi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes gnang sngon du 'gro bas thugs rje chen po tshem bu lugs kyi smar khrid/ de'i rgyab chos kyi lung dang bcas pa sogs chos 'phro rnams zhu bar mdzad/ de dus skabs shig gsung gleng gi 'phros shig la/ rje mus chen gyi gsung las/ kha sang nas gtsang pa'i mus kyi mi dpon de byung nas nged la cis kyang 'phrad dgos zer ba la/ lo gsum su dang yang mi 'phrad pa'i dam bca' byas yod/ de nas 'phrad do byas pas bden par bzung nas khong log tsam byung / zhes gsungs pa zhig byung 'dug pa na/ rje 'di thugs shin tu ma bde zhing 'jigs pa zhig 'khrungs nas/ lo gsum las mi dpon dang yang los mjal/ bdag sogs ltos bcas la dgongs nas yun ring du zhabs pad brtan par bzhugs dgos zhu ba mdzad 'dug par rje mus pa nyid ci yang mi gsung bar yun ring du bzhad kyin 'dug pas/ thugs cher ma bde nas/ de'i nangs par brtan bzhugs kyi 'bul nod gya nom pa dang bcas brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs mdzad pas/ glo bur du nam mkha' la 'ja' sna tshogs pa'i ri mo ngo mtshar can du mas rje mus chen gyi gzim phug gi thad kyi nam mkha' sogs bsam gtan phu'i nye skor thams cad khrig gis khengs byung bas/

rje 'di'i thugs dgongs la/ brtan bzhugs 'bul ba la nam mkha' la 'ja' sprin 'di yang legs rgyu med dam dgongs pa 'khrungs 'dug cing / de nas rje nyid sa skyar phebs kar rje mus chen gyi drung du gang spyi'i bslab bya mtha' dag zhu ba mdzad dus 'di phyir phan pa'i gsung mang du stsal cing / de'i mod la rje mus chen de nyid kyi sku bems sbub nas sku stod gzengs mdzad rje 'di la cher gzigs te/ 'o tshe 'di glog dang 'dra/ khyem tsam gcig ka yin pas gzhi sdom gsum rnam par dag pa la gnas nas/ thos bsam sgom gsum la 'bad rtsol mdzad de/ ci mdzad bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don du 'gyur ba zhig cis kyang gnang dgos so/ /'di nas sa skyar phebs 'phral bde mchog gi bsnyen pa zla ba drug pa zhig gnang ba dang / bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin pa'i sde srid g.yas ru byang pa ni 'di bzhin du gyur song / dgon pa 'di la thugs kyis btang na mi 'gab/ gzhan sus gang byas kyang rang re dpon slob la dam sel gtan nas mi yong / gtan nas mi yong zhes nyis btud du gsungs byung ba na/ rje 'di thugs dga' spror gyur cing / de nas yongs 'dzin dam pa 'dis rje mus chen la bdag byang chub bar du thugs rje'i skyabs 'og tu chug pa zhig dgos tshul zhus pas/ a ci gsung ba yin/ nged la sde pa byang pa dang / zhabs drung gnyis las gces pa med/ de'i nang nas kyang khyed kho na gces pas/ snying kha'i nang skor du zhabs drung rang sgom/ de'i mtha' skor du sde pa byang pa sogs sgom gyin bdog ces sogs thugs gting nas brtse ba'i gsung du ma zhig stsol bar mdzad 'dug cing / de nas bdag cag gi yongs su 'dzin pa chen po 'dis rim gyis chibs kyi kha lo gdan sa chen por bsgyur te/ dpal sa skya'i chu mig rdzing kha'i bde mchog pho brang du 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i gsung bsnyen la bzhugs nas rgyang tsam song ba'i zla ba lnga pa'i tshes lnga drug tsam gyi mtshan lam du rje mus chen nyid gsal por byon nas/

lam dbang gi bla ma brgyud rim gyi byin rlabs 'dra ba zhig gnang byung ba'i tshe/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha dang / mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ spyan snga rin po che dkon mchog rgya mtsho rnams kyi mtshan gsal bar gsan pa'i mod la mnal sad pa na/ thugs la dgyes spro dpag tu med pa 'khrungs/ yang snga dro zhig cung zad mnal ba'i tshe/ rje mus pa'i sku ma gzigs pa la/ gsung sbom la zil che ba de sgra lhang pa dang bcas thugs khar thugs rdo rje ma zhes tshig gsal du 'jug dgos lags zhes gsungs byung bas/ mnal sad ma thag rje mus pa 'di nyid na bzhugs yod do snyam pa'i 'jigs pa dang dga' spro zung 'brel du byung gsungs shing / de nas rgyun mi ring par rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan de nyid gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim ste/ sku gdung zhugs la phul ba'i tshe/ phal cher ring bsrel dang gdung log tu gyur te/ dbu thod kyi dum bu mi chung tsam zhig rje 'di'i phyag tu phul ba la mchod 'bul rgya chen po dang gsol 'debs mang du mdzad/ de dang dus mtshungs par rje 'dis dge 'dun rags bsdus kyi 'khor dang bcas pas dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang / bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zla ba lhag tsam smin rgyas dang / gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi tshogs chen la mang ja'i thog 'bul 'gyed rgya che ba sogs dgongs rdzogs bla na med pa sgrub par mdzad cing / gzhan yang bla ma yongs bzung gi rgyud las/ bla ma 'das pa'i lo zla tshes grangs dag /nges par bzung ste mchod pa byas gyur na/ /bskal pa bye bar bsags pa'i sdig bcom nas/ /shin tu mi zad gshin rje'i grong las thar/ /zhes pa dang / gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol mo 'phan la sogs/ /dung dang rnga chen rol mo sogs kyis mchod/ /mchod pa bcu dang bkra shis tshig bsgrags na/ /bskal pa ther 'bum bsags pa'i las dag nas/ /zag med chos sku thob ste gzugs sku yi/

/snang ba skyes nas srid gsum sdug bsngal sgrol/ /zhes dang / sngar bshad phyag 'tshal la sogs bcu byas na/ /de dang mtshungs pa'i dge ba 'ga' mi bskyed/ /mchod na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i sa thob nas/ /skye bo mang po thar pa'i lam la 'god/ /ces dang / de tshe bla ma'i yon tan dran pa dang / /bka' drin dran dang rnam thar byin rlabs dang / /rnam pa cha lugs rjes su dran byas nas/ /dad mos gus shing shin tu gdung ba yi/ /thun mong mchog gi dngos grub 'dod pa'i blos/ /yang dang yang du gsol ba drag tu gdab/ /de ni ma 'ongs 'khor gyi gtso bor 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / gzhan yang / bla ma dam pa mnyes par bya/ /bla ma'i drin gyis thob pa yi/ /rgyud lung man ngag sbyin par bya/ /chos 'chad ma gtogs sems can la/ /phan thogs mchog gyur gang yang med/ /ji ltar 'khor los bsgyur ba la/ /rgyal sras brgya stong yod mod kyang / /mtshan dang mi ldan rgyal po yi/ /gdung rgyud gsob par mi nus na/ /sras kyi 'du shes ga la 'byung / /mtshan ldan gdung gsob nus pa la/ /yi rangs shin tu dgyes pa ltar/ /slob mas sems can don sgrub na/ /bla ma'i bzhed pa cis mi 'grub/ /bla ma mnyes par byed 'dod na/ /sems can don la rab brtson bya/ /de phyir gcig tu sems can gyi/ /don sgrub bya'o mi bdag kye/ /zhes dang / bla ma nyin gcig mnyes byas na/ /bskal pa bye ba ther 'bum du/ /byas dang byed bcug yid rang ba'i/ /sdig can bcom nas sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /zhes dang / grub pa brgya dang 'phrin las bzhi/ /mngon shes spyan dang rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /gzhan don 'phrin las byed pa yang / /bla ma'i bzhed pa bsgrubs las byung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de nas brtsams te lo dus zla dus kyi dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul bar kye rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag gnyis kyi rgyud 'don dang / bla ma mchod chog sogs 'chag med du 'dzugs pa mdzad cing /

khyad par bho ṭa'i ljongs kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por/ rgyal ba mus pa chen po de nyid kyi nang rten/ nyid kyi yab rje chos kyi rgyal po dang thun mong ba'i dngul gdung yid bzhin gyi nor bu ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba dang / gzhan yang mus chen de nyid kyi sku brnyan sku tshad ma dngos dang khyad par med pa lta bu'i byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ de nyid kyi dngul sku khru gang tsam sogs 'bur sku du ma dang / sku brnyan brgya tshar ma sogs bris sku'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsar bzhengs gnang zhing / dus phyis lo dus kyi mchod 'bul du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub mchod gsar 'dzugs sogs dang / gzhan yang bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum dang / bye brag tu mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad pa sogs mdor na sku gsung thugs gsum gyi sgo nas dus gsum du nye bar bsags pa'i legs mdzad thams cad rje btsun bla ma mus pa chen po de nyid kyi dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs pa'i thabs kho na las/ gzhan du dgongs pa cung zad kyang med pa 'dir snang ngo / /de nas bde mchog gsung bsnyen kha skong gi sbyin sreg dang bcas pa mthar phyin te/ ljags bsnyen grol 'phral der bzhugs rnams la 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang la sogs pa chos kyi bka' drin mang du stsol bar mdzad pa yin no/ /zhes kyang thos so/ /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ 'jigs rung gaṇ+ḍi 'dzin pa mus pa las/ /bstan srung gtso bo gur gyi mgon po yi/ /nang khrid brag rdzong rdo rje'i zab khrid gnyis/ /gsar rnying yig mang lung bcas nyer nos shing / /phar phyin gzhung gi sprin 'phreng zab gnad kyi/ /glog 'phreng 'khyug dang legs bshad 'brug rgod pas/ /zab lam nying khu'i chu thigs zags mkhas pa/ /lab sgron gcod kyi glu de'ang snyan gyi bcud/

/duḥkha'i sgra yang mi grags mkha' spyod cher/ /sdug bsngal phra mo mi bzod bsran chung yang / /grangs med yon tan khur gyis ngal bzod pa'i/ /skal bzang bye ba la gor phyin pa'i lam/ /thun mong min pa'i rnal 'byor bsam mi khyab/ /zab mo'i yangs rtse 'di las gzhan mi dmigs/ /bde chen grong du skad cig 'pho ba'i gnad/ /gcig tu brgyud 'di'ang gzhan la dkon pa'i nor/ /yin zhes yongs 'dzin dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal las/ /rnyed pa'i gtam bzang bdud rtsi khol ba na/ /gang thugs 'chi med bde bar rtag rol zhing / /dga' dang spro bas mdzes pa'i gar stabs bsgyur/ /gang tshe mgon de zhing gzhan phebs bzhed pa'i/ /snyan min gsung zhig snyan sgor lhung ba na/ /khyed thugs chu gter khol nas brgya phrag lor/ /sku yi rgyal mtshan mi nub brtan par gsol/ /tshe 'di glog 'dra tshul gnas thos sgom la/ /'bad don ci byas bstan 'gro'i don 'gyur mdzod/ /ring min bde mchog bsnyen pa rnam gsum la/ /gzhol bar mdzod ces zhal gdams bdud rtsi stsal/ /bka' mchid nor bu'i cod pan thod bcings te/ /zab bzlas bcud dbyung sbyin sreg dang bcas pa/ /mthar phyin bsnyen pa'i ro bcud mngar ba'i rtsis/ /nyid thugs ro 'dzin tshim pa'i dge mtshan mtho/ /dus der yongs 'dzin nam mkha'i nor bu de/ /mkha' spyod chu ldan mar gzims de lta na'ang / /dag snang thun gsum dbang mor rje yi gsung / /zil ldan zla thigs khyed kyi snyan sgor lhung / /gu ru'i yon tan yongs bzung rgyud don bzhin/ /bgrang gzhi 'jal byed mchod 'bul 'bab ldan ma/ /mi nyams gzhan yang dus gsum legs byas kyis/ /kun nas kun tu mgon de mchod 'di mtshar/ /de nas mtshungs pa med pa'i 'dren mchog dam pa 'di dgung lo nyer gsum du phebs pa don grub ces pa sa mo lug gi lo la/ dbus ru byang phyogs kyi sa chen po chos bzhin du skyong ba'i mi dbang yar rgyab dpon gyi btsun mo dpal 'byor longs spyod shin tu che bas nam mkha' mdzod mar yang grags shing /

lang 'tsho rmad du byung bas dpon sa brgya dga' zhes snyan par 'bod pa/ spyir rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung rigs yin no cog la gus zhen shin tu che zhing / khyad par rje 'di nyid la sngon gyi las 'brel bzang po'i bag chags sad pa nas/ dam pa 'di'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis dad pa'i dbang po mchog tu brtas par gyur pa zhig yod 'dug par brten/ dpal 'byor rab brtan du spyan 'dren gyi pho nya yang yang mngags pa zhig byung ba'i snga ma rnams la phebs thub pa zhig ma byung na'ang / de dus rje 'di'i dgongs pa la/ sngon sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras kyis dbus phyogs su phebs nas 'gro don mdzad dus skyabs 'og tu chug pa dang / lhag par sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis/ spyir sa skya pa'i bstan pa dbus phyogs su yang shin tu dar rgyas che bar mdzad pa'i legs lam las/ sngags 'chang nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad ldan bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod 'dug pa'i nang nas/ yar rgyab dpon sa brgya dgar grags pa 'di thugs rje'i spyan ras kyis 'tsho nges pa'i las can ma zhig yin 'dug pas/ 'di'i blo 'dod dang mthun pa zhig ma byas na/ sngags 'chang chen po'i thugs dgongs rdzogs par yang mi 'gyur dgongs pa dang / khyad par rje nyid lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ner grags pa rgyal ba nyid kyi phyag nas 'phrul med bzhugs pa de nyid dang / jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje bya ba rgyal po kri kris bzhengs pa la/ sangs rgyas 'od srung gis phyag nas mdzad pa ste/ gnyis po de nyid gtso bor gyur pa'i rten khyad par can rnams dang / gzhan yang jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti shas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas snye thang / byang sems chen po zhi ba 'tsho dang / grub dbang pad+ma sam+bha was byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog de nyid dang /

yang dben 'chim phu'i brag rdzong rnams kyi rten dang / gnas khyad par can rnams mjal bzhed kyi thugs 'dun yang che ba nas dbus phyogs la phebs par zhal gyis bzhes te/ de dang sgo mtshungs par yangs pa'i sa chen po bdag gir mdzad pa'i stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba karma phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis kyang dbus la phebs bstun/ mar lam bsam grub rtser phebs pa zhig cis kyang dgos zhes nan zhus byung 'dug par brten/ lo de'i zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bzang ba la chibs thog byon par mdzad nas rim gyis gzhis ka chen po bsam grub rtser phebs te/ der mi dbang chen po de nyid sras yum blon 'bangs dang bcas pa rnams la tshe bka' sogs dbang byin rlabs/ rjes gnang gi rigs du ma dang bcas pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi mang du stsal nas thugs yid tshim par mdzad pas/ mi dbang karma phun tshogs rnam rgyal de nyid rje 'di la sngar nas kyang sku na phra mo la lugs gnyis gang la yang mkhyen rab yangs po/ sku gzi brjid che ba 'di bzhin ngo mtshar che dgongs pa'i dad pa dang thugs mthong shin tu che ba zhig yod 'dug pa dang / lhag par de dus chos 'brel yang mang du nos pa'i stobs kyis mi phyed pa'i dad pa bla lhag tu 'phel te/ zang zing gi 'bul nod kyang rgya dpang shin tu che ba mkho dgu dang bcas pa 'bul bar mdzad cing / phebs lam yang rgyal rtse brgyud nas phebs pa legs tshul zhus pa bzhin/ rje 'dis kyang bsam grub rtse nas chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur te/ mthar gyis shar kha chos rgyal chen po rim par byon pa'i bsti gnas rgyal mkhar rtser phebs/ dpal 'khor bde chen mkhas pa'i chos grwa chen po der gdan chags par bzhed pa'i sngon du dge 'dun rnams kyis phebs bsu ser 'phreng zab par zhus/ sku 'bum mthong grol chen mo sogs rten grags che ba rnams mjal ba mdzad pas/ sku 'bum chen po sogs rgyal rtse ba'i chos rgyal gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i phyag rjes la thugs rjes su yi rangs pa'i dga' spro dang /

der skabs rgyal rtse ba rang gi zhal ngo rnams de phyogs mi bzhugs pas/ dus 'gyur gyi snang tshul la cung zad thugs nges par 'byung ba'i skyo shas res 'jog tu 'khrungs pa yang byung snang la/ de lta'i skabs nas chos sde chen po'i bla ma slob dpon/ sgrub sde'i drung chen/ gser lcog drung chen/ sman bla drung chen sogs chos rgyal gong ma rnams kyis bstan pa rin po che'i zhabs tog kho na'i phyir/ chos gzhis rgya chen so sor sbyor 'jags mdzad pa dag gi do dam du bkod bzhag mdzad pa'i chen po de dag dang / gzhan yang chos sde de nyid kyi grwa rigs dang 'dun can mang po dang bcas pa rnams la/ dbang rjes gnang sogs chos tshul du ma stsal nas so so'i yid tshim par mdzad/ de lo char shin tu dkon pa zhig yin 'dug kyang / rje 'dis gdan sa nas phebs pa nas brtsams lam bar rnams la yang char shin tu che ba babs pas/ de'i snyan pa rgyal rtser yang grags te/ rang re sa lugs kyi grwa rigs sogs phal cher gyis/ rje 'di phebs phyin chad sngar yang char chen po bab pa byung 'dug pas/ da lo yang yong zer spro seg ge ba byed/ cung grub mtha'i zhal 'dzin mi mthun pa 'ga' re mtha' gcig tu ma nges zer cung zad the tshom byed pa la/ rje 'di rgyal rtser phebs pa'i nub mo nas bzung nyin zhag mang po sbrel nas char bab pa zhig byung bas/ der gnas skya ser kun sa skya bdag chen phebs pa'i byin rlabs kyi char par 'dug go /ngo mtshar che zer zhing / sngar cung zad tsam yid ma dad pa rnams kyang shin tu yid ches rnyed de/ rje 'di phebs pa'i lam bar sogs su phyag dbang zhu mi yang shin tu mang ba rgyal rtser phebs 'phral las nyin re bzhin je mang du song ba zhig kyang byung zhes thos la/ de nas rim gyis gdan btegs te/ sna dkar rtse dpal sde sogs su phebs zhag re mdzad de/ so so'i zhal ngo sogs la 'dod chos ci rigs pa stsal te/

de nas nyid kyi sngon gyi sku'i skye ba zhang sna nams rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi rnam par sprul pa rje btsun rdo rje gdan pa chen po kun dga' rnam rgyal grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos 'debs par mdzad pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa bye ba'i bsti gnas gong dkar chos sde rdo rje gdan du grags pa der phebs nas/ der bzhugs kyi dge 'dun rnams kyis bsu ba ser 'phreng shin tu zab pa zhus/ gnas der zhag kha shas bzhugs/ chos grwa chen po de nyid grwa tshang bzhi po'i slob dpon so so dang / zur chos 'chad pa po chos rje thod dkar ba dang / dbu chos sogs gzhan yang grwa rigs mang po dang bcas pa rnams la dbang byin rlabs sogs chos kyi dga' ston ci yang zhig stsal cing / chos sde chen po de'i rten gyi gtso bo mkhyen brtse chen mo'i phyag bzo thub chen 'khor bcas/ de'i steng na yo ga'i lha khang / de'i steng na rdo rje gdan pa chen po'i sku gdung hril po bzhugs pa'i dngul gdung gi mtha' skor du lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba'i bla ma lha khang 'du khang chen mo'i g.yas g.yon steng 'og na kye rdor lha khang dang / mgon khang / lam 'bras lha khang dang 'jigs byed lha khang sogs la rten mjal legs par mdzad/ 'du khang chen mo'i ldebs ris la dpag bsam 'khri shing nas 'byung ba'i rgyal ba'i skyes rabs shin tu legs pa bris nas yod pa rnams la thugs rtog zhib dpyod mdzad de/ phyis su yang gong dkar chos sde'i ldebs ris la yod pa'i 'khrungs rabs kyi bkod pa de gzhan las rmad du byung ba zhig yod ces yang yang gsungs shing / de dus 'khrungs rabs so so'i zhal byang ldebs ris la yod pa de zhal bshus mdzad/ rdo rje gdan pa chen po'i gsang ba'i mgon khang shin tu gnyan pa zhig yod pa de na rje btsun kun dga' rnam rgyal nyid kyi gar chas/ dbang dril rigs lnga so so'i phyag mtshan gyis yu ba byas pa shin tu ngo mtshar ba rnams dang /

gzhan yang 'phags pa rin po che'i thugs dam ma'i mgon po'i gos thang bkra thags las grub pa thog tshad ma dang / bla ma dam pa'i thugs dam rten gyi mgon po'i gos thang sogs nang mjal gyi rigs rnams kyang shin tu zhib par mjal/ chos sde der bzhugs rnams la rgya ja'i btung ba mchog gi thog zang zing gi dngos po'i gral 'gyed gya nom pa stsal te/ mdor na lugs gnyis kyi sgos so so'i re 'dod yongs su gang bar mdzad de/ der yod kun kyang mi phyed pa'i dad pa la bkod ces thos la/ de nas lha sar phebs bzhed de/ thog mar snye thang phyogs su phebs nas/ der snye thang bkra shis sgang / chos rdzong / snye thang 'or rnams na bzhugs pa'i jo bo'i sku 'dra phyag nas ma ngo mtshar can dang / gzhan yang bla ma dam pa'i thugs dam ma'i mgon khang sogs rten khyad par can thams cad mjal/ smon lam rgya chen po mdzad cing / de dus jo bo yab sras sam dngos slob chen po zhig gi sku'i sprul pa yin pa yang thugs la dran pa snang ste/ phyis su gsung las/ nged snye thang du slebs dus sngon jo bo rje snye thang du phebs pa'i tshe lha sa'i thad kyi nam mkha' la lha'i bu dang bu mo mang pos mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs pa'i bkod pa yid du 'ong ba nyin re bzhin yong ba zhig 'dug pa gzigs nas/ pha gir ci yod gsungs/ lha sa yod zhus pas/ jo bo la shin tu gus pa'i tshul gyi phyag thal mo spyi bor sbyor bar mdzad/ ces grags pa de yang dran nas jo bo yab sras sogs la dad pa chen po byung / snye thang gi gnas de rnams sngar 'gro myong ba 'dra ba'i shin tu bag phebs la blo bde ba zhig byung bas/ nged jo bo'i skabs der yod pa zhig yin pa 'dra gsungs pa ni rje nyid yang yang gsungs pa las dngos su thos so/ /de ltar snye thang gi rten mjal legs par grub nas/ slar chos 'khor lha sar phebs te/ jo bo shākya mu ne dang / rang byon bcu gcig zhal/

ra mo che na bzhugs pa'i jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i lha sa'i rten khyad par can thams cad mjal te/ so so la snyan dar dkar me sogs mchod pa'i sprin phung zla med pa dang / khyad par gser zho phyed do tsam zhig gi zhal gser phul bas/ rten thams cad la gser chab shin tu 'thug pa rang byung bas/ sku gnyer sogs rgyus yod rnams/ da lam gser 'di tsam gyis gzhan yin na jo bo rin po che tsam las gzhan rnams mi khyed na'ang / da lam kun la zhal gser lugs mthun rang 'bul rgyu byung song ba 'di/ sa skya bdag chen rang gi grub rtags su 'dug pas shin tu ngo mtshar che zhes gleng ba yang byung 'dug cing / de gong lha sa'i phyogs su bod sog 'khrugs rtsod shin tu che ba'i skabs jo bo'i nye skor der mi mang po zhig gron chen du song bar brten/ jo bo la yang sku grib phog pa'i nyams bag tsam 'dug pa dgongs nas/ rje 'dis khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa'i bum chu sgrub pa'i cho ga mdzad de jo bo sogs la khrus gsol phul bas/ sku grib sangs pa'i rtags kyang shin tu gsal ba byung 'dug cing / de nas bstan pa rin po che spyi dang bye brag gis bsdus pa rnams phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur ba dang / bod khams gtso bor gyur pa'i skye dgu rnams bde ba'i smon lam rgya chen po 'debs par mdzad/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i pho brang dmar po ri dang lcags po ri gnyis dang / lha sa'i yer pa'i brag phug tu grags pa slob dpon rin po che'i sgrub gnas khyad par can gyi 'khon ston klu'i dbang po srung bas grub pa'i sa brnyes pa'i rtags mtshan mngon sum du bstan nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sa/ phyis su jo bo yab sras kyis kyang chos kyi 'khor lo mang du bskor ba'i gnas khyad par can de nyid mjal ba la yang phebs te/ lha sa bud tsam gyi yer pa'i ri'i rtsa ba na yod pa'i grong khyim de'i ltag gi lam nas yar yer pa'i phyogs la gzigs pas/

dgon khrod na mchod rten dkar po jo bo rje'i phyag nas ma yin pa zhig yod pa de'i ngos la spyan ras gzigs khar+sa pa ṇi'i sku brnyan mtshar po zhig yod pa gsal bar gzigs nas/ slar yer pa rang du phebs tsam na mchod rten gyi ngos la yod pa'i sku brnyan de spyan ras gzigs khar+sa pa ṇi ka yin nam ci yin dgongs pa na/ sngar gyi de mi snang ba zhig byung gsungs/ der phebs 'phral grub thob brgyad cu'i tshogs khang yin zer ba'i brag phug chen po de dang / jo bo lha cig gis bka' gdams pha chos bu chos stsal pa'i gnas sogs mjal ba mdzad/ der yang sngar bzhugs bzhin pa'i gnas su phebs pa 'dra ba'i shin tu thugs spro ba rang byung gsungs shing / de nub yar rgyab pa'i lcam zhig gi 'dug gnas yin pa'i gzim khang spro mo zhig 'dug pa der bzhugs yul mdzad pa'i mtshan lam du/ bud med mdzes ma bzhis phyogs bzhi nas dar thag re bskyangs pa'i dbus na bzhugs gdan zhig kyang 'dug pa'i khar bzhugs dgos zhu ba la/ rje 'dis kyang der bzhugs pa'i bzhugs snang shin tu gsal yang / steng la 'degs pa sogs ma byung / de nas nangs par rang nyid kyi zhabs 'bring pa chen po rab 'byams smra ba bsod nams 'od zer la 'di ltar byung gsungs pas/ tshul de bzhin mkha' 'gro'i spyan 'dren gyi rnam pa 'dra ba nas/ legs rgyu ci ltar yod lags sam zhus 'dug par/ rje'i gsung las/ gdan gyi steng na bsdad pa'i snang ba byung yang / dar thag sogs 'degs pa dang 'khyer ba'i rnam pa ma byung bas skyon med/ gnas bzang bas de'i byin rlabs su 'dug gsung ba mdzad 'dug pa 'di ni/ sngon rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan cha lung rdo rje'i brag rdzong du bud med mang pos rdo leb dkar 'jam yid du 'ong ba chen po zhig la 'dir bzhugs na mkha' spyod du da lta spyan 'dren zhu ba la/ nged la ltos bcas mang du yod pas re zhig mi 'gro gsungs ma phebs pa'i tshul rje btsun gyi rnam thar du 'byung ba de dang mtshungs pas shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar du shes par bya'o/

/de nas bsam yas phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur te/ bsam yas kyi phu rgod rgal la brgyud nas dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por phebs pa'i nyin/ rab byung la sogs bsam yas tshogs pa phyi nang gi dge 'dun rnams kyis ser 'phreng gi bkod pa zab pa dang bcas pas phebs bsu legs par zhus te/ pho brang gong du bzhugs yul gnang zhing / de nas dpal bsam yas kyi gnas bdag chen po rgyal po sku lnga'i nang tshan dpe dkar rgyal po'am rgyal po shel 'phreng dkar po dang / rgyal po shing bya can sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs du ma dang ldan pa de nyid kyi thugs las sprul pa'i las byed kyi gtso bo gnod sbyin tse'u dmar po/ rgyal po shel 'phreng dkar po nyid dang bcas pa gnas pa'i dpe dkar dkor mdzod gling gi lcog tu grags pa der phebs pas/ gnod sbyin chen po yang dam pa 'di dang mjal ba la shin tu rings pa'i tshul gyis sku phebs 'phral du byung pa na/ de dus rje 'di chos skyong chen po la thugs dag snang chen po rang mdzad pa zhig med tshod du 'dug kyang / gnod sbyin chen po de nyid ni rje 'di la mchog tu gus pa'i gsung mang du stsol bar mdzad cing / lhag par dam pa 'di la gdan sa chen po'i khur bzhes 'di bzhin mdzad dgos pa'i lung bstan zhus gsol mang du mdzad pa dang / lhag par rten 'brel gyi khyad par zhig yod pa yin pas/ dge bshes kyi gdug 'dre la lha rta zhig dgos/ de yang dge bshes gdung spel byas/ sa dkar po'i gdan gnon na rta bang ma 'jug ma 'job be ba cig khyer shog rab byung gtsang ma byed na gsar ma yid 'dzin pa zhig khyer dgos so gsungs pa la/ rje 'di gdung spel thugs bzhed la gtan med pa nas/ lha rta yang gtsug rgyan zer ba'i gsar ma sil po rang zhig yod pa de 'bul ba mdzad de/ rje btsun bla ma 'dis chos skyong chen po la/ nged ni snga mo nas blo yul na/

rab tu byung nas klog pa thos bsam dang / bla ma rnams la chos thob rgya ma chung ba tsam byas/ 'chad nyan gtso bor byed bsam pa kho na yod pa bzhin/ da cha yang gdung spel sogs blo la med/ mthun rkyen 'dzom zhing don gnyer mang sar sa skya pa rang gi yab chos bde kye sogs kyi rgyud man ngag gis gtsos pa'i rang gis gang thob rnams 'chad ci thub dang / slar sgrub pa rtse gcig byed bsam pa yod pas/ chos skyong chen po khyed kyis kyang de bzhin gyi 'phrin las sgrub dgos gsungs pas/ chos skyong chen po dgongs pa cung zad ma khengs pa'i rnam pas/ g.ya' sa dkar po'i rus pa 'di ma chad tsam zhig byed na/ rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam sprul gyi/ dge bshes gzhon pa rang bsam pa rgya che dgos pa yod do/ /zhes gsungs pa byung 'dug cing / de rjes rje 'di la chos skyong chen pos rdo skas kyi mgor phebs skyel mdzad nas/ gsung las/ dge bshes kyi ring la sa dkar po'i mdangs thon pa'i phyir zab yangs mthil gyi lha mi rnams kyis lha rgyal thengs gsum bos gsungs nas/ phyag g.yas kyis ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar thengs gsum mdzad byung ba dang bstun/ der 'tshogs skya ser gyi khrom chen po dmar smug tu 'khyil ba rnams kyis sgra chen po 'ur chil ba lan gsum bsgrags 'dug pa 'di yang dus ngan snyigs ma'i mthar thug pa 'di lta bu la/ bdag cag gi rnam 'dren 'dis gdan sa chen po'i khur bzhes pa nas bzung / lugs gnyis kyi 'phrin las dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas te/ chos rgyal 'phags pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su rje 'di'i sku ring las dpal ldan sa skya pa dar rgyas che la gdung rigs gzhan la ma byung bar yongs la grags shing grub pa'i dge mtshan gyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa 'di bzhin byung ba de dus nas chos skyong chen pos rten 'brel bsgrigs shing / lung bstan mdzad pa 'di dag rmad du byung ba'i rnam thar du snang la/
