de nas bsam yas kyi dbu rtse chen mo dang / jo mo gling gsum/ gling bzhi gling phran bcu gnyis/ nyi zla lha khang gnyis sogs gtsug lag khang ma lus pa mjal ba mdzad/ dkar me snyan dar mang du phul/ chos skyong chen po la sa skya pa'i bstan pa yun du gnas shing 'phel ba'i bka' bsgo dang / lha khang so sor smon lam shin tu smin pa 'debs par mdzad de/ de nas bsam yas mchims phur grags pa sngon slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis rje 'bangs nyer lnga la sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zab mo sogs chos kyi bdud rtsi mang du stsol bar mdzad pa'i sgrub gnas khyad par can mchims phu brag dmar skye tshang du grags pa der phebs/ mchims phu nas bsam yas su nam phebs bar la nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od sna tshogs pa 'khrigs pa zhig nyin re bzhin byung ba dang / khyad par gnas de'i gur dkar phug tu phebs pa'i nyin/ nyi ma snga phyed nas/ nyi phyed kyi bar du me tog gi char rgyun chad med par kha ba ltar babs pa dang / sngon slob dpon chen pos sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor bsdu ba mdzad pa'i brag phug gi thod kyi dkyil 'khor de las tshe chu mang du babs pa dpon slob thams cad la gsol rgyu byung ba dang / gzhan yang brag phug de'i logs la rnam rgyal mchod rten zhig sngar med gsar du rang byon du byung ba thog mar rje nyid kyis gzigs te/ 'di bzhin ci yin zhes sku gnyer la 'dri ba gnang ba na/ de dus nas bzung mchims phu'i gnas bdag karma pas mdzad pa zhig yod pa bzhin/ sku gnyer de yang kar lugs kyi grwa pa zhig yin 'dug kyang / grwa pa de yang ngo mtshar skyes te/ 'di bzhin sngar nas med lags/ da lam skyes bu dam pa phebs pas gnas sgo gsar du bye bar 'dug pas shin tu ya mtshan che zer zhing kun la sgrogs par byed/ de nas rje nyid kyi zhabs 'bring pa rnams kyis kyang mchod rten de gsal bar mthong ba yin no/

/zhes de dus phyag phyi la yod pa du ma'i ngag las kyang thos shing / rjes su rje nyid kyi gsung las kyang / de dus mchod rten zhig mthong nges yin/ sku gnyer kho rang yang 'di sngar med/ gnas sgo bye bar gor ma chag zer ba zhig ni byung / nged rang de dus mchims phu de yang sngar sdod myong gi gnas 'dra ba'i blo phebs po zhig dang / slob dpon rje 'bangs dang bcas pa rnams la dad mos kyang shin tu che ba zhig ni byung zhes kyang phebs pa zhig byung bas/ 'dis ni dam pa 'di zhang sna nams rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi skye sprul yin pa dang / bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su lo tsā ba mang por sku skye ba bzhes pa yin tshul gong du bkod pa de dag kyang gsal bar nus te/ sngon slob dpon rin po che'i zhal las/ mchims phu'i brag dmar du yang gdams pa mang po nod par mdzad pa'i sngon gyi gnas de rjes su dran pa nyid du snang bas so/ /de ltar bsam yas phu mda'i gnas ma lus pa zhib tu mjal ba mdzad nas/ bsam yas rab byung pa dpon slob gtso bor gyur pa'i bsam yas skya ser dad 'dun can mang po la dbang byin rlabs rjes gnang la sogs pa'i chos kyi bka' drin yang ci rigs pa stsol bar mdzad de/ de nas dpal 'byor rab brtan nas sngon goms legs byas kyi lang tsho gsar pa dad gus rin chen 'phreng bas mdzes par spud cing / rnam mang gtong phod mu tig gi do shal 'phyang 'phrul can/ lhag bsam dar gyi stod g.yog lhab lhub tu g.yo ba rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag gi nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor yun du mi nub cing gnas pa'i dbyings su 'degs pa'i snying stobs shing rta mdzes pa'i bzhin bzang ma/ mi'i dbang mo nam mkha' mdzod mar grags pa des/ slar yang spyan 'dren rting bskul gyi bya ma rta ched du mngags pa na/ der chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur te yar lam grwa pa mngon shes can gyis btab pa'i gtsug lag khang /

phyis su zhwa lu lo tsā ba sogs dam pa mang po'i bsti gnas grwa thang gi chos grwa na bzhugs pa'i zhwa lu lo chen gyi gser gdung / de nyid kyi thugs dam ma'i dus 'khor gyi sku brnyan sogs der yod kyi rten thams cad dang / paṇa chen byams pa gling pa'am mtshan dngos bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa chen po'i khu bor gyur pa des zla ba bco brgyad kyi ring la grub par mdzad ces grags pa'i mchod rten chen po byams pa'i sku dang bcas pa mjal te/ dpal rab nas phebs bsu'i bkod pa zab pa dang bcas te der phebs/ dpon sa nyid gtso bor gyur pa'i dad pa can mang po la chos kyi bka' drin bsam gyis mi khyab pa stsal/ lhag par dpon sa nyid yum sras sogs la tshe bka' brgya tshar/ chos skyong gi rjes gnang sogs rjes gnang zur bka' zab pa mang po yang gnang zhing / de dus gnyan mgon zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang mdzad pa'i tshe/ dpal rab ma'i sras mo chos mdzad ma zhig yod pa de/ a tsa ra lag na rkyal pa khyer pa/ sma ra ring po byas pa zhig dang dngos su 'phrad de/ dpal mgon zhal nyid dam/ de'i sprul pa zhig tu 'dug pas shin tu ngo mtshar che zer zhing / bdag nyid chen po 'di ni chos skyong bran du 'khol nus nges su 'dug go zhes rje 'di'i snyan grags kun la sgrogs pa la brel bar gyur pa zhig byung zhes thos shing / de skabs dpal rab tu rgyang tsam bzhugs dus kyi gzim chung sngon sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po dpal rab tu phebs pa'i tshe/ dpal rab kyi gzim chung gcig la gza'i rgyu lam 'dug zer ba zhig yod pa la/ sngags 'chang chen pos dpon sa la/ nged kyis gza' bzung nas khyed rang la ston no gsungs/ lan gcig sngags 'chang chen pos gza' bzung nas/ dpon sa la da lta shog gsung byon pas/ gza' dngos su ni ma mthong / gzim chung gi zhal ba'i ngos lcam gyi rtsa ba la nye ba der me 'od khyem pa zhig 'dug pa mthong nas/

de yang rim gyis yal song ba zhig byung zhes grags pa'i gzim khang de'i nye logs kyi gzim chung zhig tu mdzad de/ dpal rab kyi steng gi mgon khang bsil ba'i tshal du grags pa der nyin re bzhin thugs dam bskang gso dang / 'phrin 'chol rgyas pa re dang / sngon sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa bzhin/ zhal gyi rten rdo gcig gi steng du nas nag gi tshom bu lnga bkod de/ de la zhal gyi man ngag nas 'byung ba bzhin yab yum lnga bskyed de bstims pa sogs mdzad cing / bstan 'gro spyi dang khyad par rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa phyogs mtha' dag tu dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur ba'i bka' bsgo dang 'phrin 'chol zla med pa mdzad pas/ phyis su 'jam pa'i dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug gi phyag tu mi dbang karma bstan skyong dbang pos/ dpal rab chos gzhis su phul te bdag gir mdzad pas/ bstan 'gro la phan pa'i rgyu chen por gyur pa de yang sngon sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos 'phrin 'chol mdzad pa'i rgyun rje btsun dam pa 'dis 'thud nas mdzad pa'i nus mthu yin par gor ma chag go /de ltar dpal rab tu zhag 'ga' bzhugs ring la nam mkhar 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang / lha'i rol mo'i sgra/ me tog gi char 'bab pa sogs rgyun ldan du byung bar snang zhing / skabs la lar dri bzang po rang dgar 'phro ba sogs ngo mtshar ba du ma byung bas/ dpon sa 'khor bcas rje 'di la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob ste/ 'bul nod kyi dngos po yang / ja gos dar/ gser dngul/ g.yu byu ru/ na bza' skor cha tshang dngos gtsang ba/ rta dre'u la sogs pa rgya dpang shin tu nas che ba rang phul ba yin no zhes thos la/ de nas yar gyi phebs lam rong chen brgyud nas zla ba dgu nang du gdan sa chen por phebs 'byor mdzad nas/ zla ba bcu pa dang bcu gcig pa'i mjug tu lo ltar gyis gnang ba'i dus rim gyi gtor bzlog rnams smin rgyas mdzad nas/

dgung lo nyer bzhir phebs pa drag po zhes pa lcags pho spre'u lo mus phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur te/ rje btsun mus pa chen po bud+dha dh+wa dza'i nang rten phyi rten rnams mjal/ dkar me snyan dar sogs mchod pa rgya chen po phul te bstan 'gro la phan pa'i smon lam gsol 'debs shin tu smin pa mdzad/ gling ga bde ba can gyi dge 'dun rnams la mang ja'i thog gral 'gyed kyi gnang skyes zab pa dang / dgon der bzhugs kyi grwa rigs sogs tshogs pa rnams la rjes gnang zur bka' bcu phrag lhag tsam sogs chos kyi bka' drin kyang mang du stsal/ de dus lan gcig rta mo bde legs su phebs nas rta mo shar phyogs kyi ser ba srung khongs la ser ba mi 'byung ba'i spyan dmigs srung 'khor tsam mdzad pas/ de snga ser ba'i gnod pa sdang po byas pa zhig yod 'dug kyang / de nas bzung lo gsum gyi bar la ser ba gtan nas ma byung zhes rgyus can gyi ngag las dngos su thos shing / mdor na lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas gling ga bde ba can gyi dgon chos gzhis dang bcas pa thams cad dus de tsam nas bzung da lta'i bar du thugs rje chen pos g.yel ba med par brtse gcig tu skyong bar mdzad pa 'di yin par snang ngo / /de nas smon gro nas bdag po byang pa'i lha lcam ye shes kyi mtshan can ma des smon gror phebs dgos pa'i zhu gsol byung nas/ der phebs pa'i sgo dod de ya ma bde ldan dang / rdzong dga' ldan rtse sogs su zhag re tsam bzhugs nas/ der yod kyi grwa pa rnams la rgya ja'i gnang skyes dang / dbang rjes gnang sogs chos kyi bka' drin ci rigs pa stsol bar mdzad cing / de nas rim gyis smon gror phebs te lha lcam 'khor bcas la khong rang tsho'i dgongs bzhed dang mthun pa'i tshe bka' brgya tshar sogs dbang rjes gnang mang du stsal te/ de dus lha lcam 'di la bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sku'i skye ba'i zlos gar yin pa'i mtshan ltas shin tu gsal ba byung tshul gong du bkod pa de nyid kyang byung bar snang zhing /

bdag mos zang zing gi 'bul spyad kyang rnam grangs mang zhing zab pa rang phul te/ rje 'dis kyang 'khor gsum yongs dag gi bsngo ba rin po che'i rgyas 'debs bla na med pa mdzad pa yin zhes kyang 'khums so/ /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ mi zad nam mkha' mdzod la dbang 'byor zhing / /dri med gdung skyes yongs la sri zhu can/ /tha mal bud med brgya phrag las dga' bas/ /mgon khyod gtan gyi dpung du ring nas bkug /de tshe go tam lha de byang phyogs kyi/ /'gro 'di'i bsod nams mgron du nyer son pa/ /rin chen jo bo'i zhal dkyil gzigs bzhed pa'i/ /lhag bsam bzhon pa brtson pa'i lcag gis bskul/ /shrī singha zlos pa zhang sna nams dang / /rdo rje bdud 'joms gnyis pa kun dga'i mtshan/ /gang gi bsti gnas dbus ru rdo rje'i gnas/ /der ni 'dus tshogs yang dag lam bkod de/ /gangs ljongs 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig a ti sha /sras dang slob mar bcas pas sngon med kyi/ /ngo mtshar chos kyi dga' ston 'jo ba'i sa/ /snye thang lha yi grong du yud kyis son/ /'jig rten dbang phyug srong btsan sgam po yi/ /byin rlabs 'phrul snang dri yi gtsang khang der/ /thub dbang zhal dkyil rang byon jo bor bcas/ /rin chen gser chab gos gyis bklubs mdzad tshe/ /phra yang kun la khyab pa'i legs byas las/ /khyod nyid grub pa'i dbang por nyer mtshon pa'i/ /rtags kyi ri mo ma bris gsal ba'i gtam/ /phyogs kyi rna ba'i rgyan de sa yis 'phrog /'khon ston nā gas grub brnyes mtshan ma'i gzugs/ /skal bzang mig sgor bstan pa yer pa'i phug /gang der phyag na pad+mo 'dzum zhal gyis/ /'jam pa'i mgon khyod ring nas dgyes pas bsus/ /'chi med dpal mo'i mkha' spyod dga' tshul du/ /spyan 'dren pho nya rings par chas na yang / /ma dag 'gro 'di'i don du lo brgya'i bar/ /'gyur med brtan pa'i thugs bskyed e ma mtshar/ /rdo rje rnon po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/

/bod yul mchod pa'i zhing du nyer bskrun pa/ /lhun grub mi 'gyur dpal gyi bsam yas de/ /bsrung ba'i mel tshe mthu ldan tse'u dmar/ /gang gis mgon khyod ma 'ongs sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa'i byed por 'gyur zhes mdong gsol gtam/ /skal ldan sgra 'dzin bdud rtsir khol ba de/ /rna ba'i bcud du mi len yid can su/ /pad+ma ka ras smin byed bdud rtsi'i skyes/ /bcu phrag gnyis dang lnga yi rje 'bangs la/ /legs par stsal pa'i gnas chen mchims phu'i brag /dmar po'i yang dben gur dkar phug ces par/ /'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu/ /chad pa med pa'i bcud gda' mo/ /'bad rtsol med par legs 'bab pa/ /ngom pa med pa'i tshul du gsol/ /ngo mtshar chos sku'i rten mdzes pa/ /rang byung sngar med gnas kyi sgo/ /gsar pa 'byed pa'i lde mig can/ /dam pa khyod nyid yin no lo/ /dpal dang phun tshogs kun gyis 'byor zhing rab tu brtan pa'i sa/ /ngo mtshar 'chi med dbang po'i bang mdzod 'dzin mar 'phos 'dra dga' ba'i grong / /srong btsan zhal dkyil mngon shes can gyi bsti gnas grwa thang zhes/ /sa yi thig le srin po'i phyogs su rgyang grags son pa'i pho brang der/ /thugs bskyed shing rta'i kha lo/ /brtse ba'i 'phangs los bskul nas/ /mthar gyir brtol te de'i tshe/ /dbang lung zab mo'i nying khu/ /mang po'i nam mkha' mdzod ma/ /'khor dang gnyen 'dun bcas pa'i/ /re ba'i yol go bkang pas/ /dga' spro chabs cig rab 'phel/ /slar yang 'jam mgon zhabs zung zla ba'i zer/ /rim par bkod pa'i rang gnas 'khon gyi ri/ /nor 'dzin skya bo bho ṭa'i rdo rje gdan/ /gang der rings par chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag mus chen 'gro ba'i mgon/ /bud+dha dh+wa dza phyi nang mchod pa'i rten/ /gus pas mchod dang mi zad chos sbyin phyir/ /byang phyogs chos kyi tshal du slar yang brtol/ /kun kyang smon cing bag gro'i grong brdal der/

/ye shes mtshan 'chang lha lcam rmi lam du/ /khyod ni 'khrul zhig grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi/ /skye ba'i gar du snang ba'i mtshan ma bstan// ༈ //spyi don bzhi pa mchog gi 'dren pa gsum sogs dam pa mang po las sna tshogs pa'i chos tshul gsan te mdo rgyud kun la dbang ji ltar 'byor ba'i tshul ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsdud pa tshigs su bcad pa las/ sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes la brten to zhes/ /yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal bas de skad gsungs/ /ci phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshogs gnyis rin po che'i rang bzhin las grub pa'i spangs rtogs lhun po'i spor son pa'i lha'i 'dod yon zag pa med pa'i longs la rang dbang du spyod pa ni/ yongs 'dzin lung dang man ngag gi chos spyan stong ldan dag las gzhan du med pas/ thar 'dod 'chi med gzhon nu dag gis rnam 'dren skabs gsum dbang po rnams 'bad pas bsten dgos par dgongs nas/ rje btsun dam pa 'dis kyang mtshungs pa med pa'i 'dren pa rnam gsum sogs yongs 'dzin du ma zhig gus pa chen pos bsten nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i chos tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsan par mdzad pa las/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched las gsan tshul rags pa tsam gong du bkod pa ltar dang / zhib par dam pa 'di nyid kyi gsan yig nas rtogs par bya zhing / dad sgrol bud+dha'i zhal las rnyed tshul che long tsam sngar bshad pa ltar yin kyang / gong du ma 'khod pa 'ga' zhig dang / gzhan yang mi pham mgon pos/ thos pas mi ngoms nyid dang ni/ /zhes pa dang / de'i 'grel par/ seng ge bzang pos/ dam pa'i chos mnyan pas ngoms mi shes pa dang / zhes chos kyi bdud rtsi ci tsam gsol yang ngoms pa med pa rgyal ba'i sras po sa gsum pa 'od byed pa la gnas pa rnams kyi yongs sbyong du bshad pa dang mtshungs par/ mkhas shing grub brnyes kyi bla ma'i tshogs gzhan dag las gsan pa rgya cher mdzad pa'i tshul rnams sa bcad sarga mi 'khrugs shing brjod bde ba'i phyir 'dir phyogs gcig tu brjod na/

de yang yongs 'dzin dam pa rje mus pa chen po de nyid la gong du bkod pa de dag las gzhan yang mang du gsan te/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo nas brgyud pa'i byin rlabs sam tshe sgrub zab mo dang / rong ston chen po nas brgyud pa'i tshe sgrub kyi man ngag zab mo zhag bdun mar grags pa/ man ngag gi yi ge 'jam dbyangs sangs rin pas mdzad pa dang / tshe sgrub brgyud 'debs tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i lung dang bcas pa/ skye med do pa chos shes nas brgyud pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i nyams len/ gcod skor gsum gyi khrid/ gcod kyi po ti'i lung dang bcas pa/ grub thob g.ya' bzang pa nas brgyud pa'i gza' bsrung thob pa don ldan gyi man ngag zab mo/ grub thob de la ra hu las dngos su phul ba'i drang srong gi gnod pa bsrung thabs dgu sogs man ngag 'di nyid kyi yig rnying yongs rdzogs kyi lung dang bcas pa/ chos rje sa paṇa nas brgyud pa'i snang ba mtha' yas la brten pa'i 'pho ba'i man ngag gi bsgom don rnams dang / yang rjes gnang zur dka'i rigs kyang gong du bkod pa las/ gzhan yang 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang / rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa rgyud gsum 'khor lo/ de'i 'grel pa/ sgrub thabs bstod pa rnams sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ rjes gnang gi yi ge rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa rnams kyi lung dang bcas pa/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i rjes gnang / sgrub thabs dang / bstod pa ma tis mdzad pa/ khro los mdzad pa'i lo rgyus rjes gnang / sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa rgya ston gyis mdzad pa'i lung bcas/ mi g.yo ba dkar po'i rjes gnang / de'i rgya gzhung mkhas pa yon tan khris mdzad pa'i yig rnying ma lus pa/ de'i zhal shes kyi yi ge gsum yar lung pas mdzad pa/ mkhan chen g.yag pas mdzad pa'i sgrub skor mi zad pa'i gter mdzod kyi lung bcas/ mi g.yo ba sngon po'i rjes gnang chu bsrung dang bcas pa dang /

'di'i rgya gzhung dang / gsal byed kyi yi ge rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i yi ge dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa rnams kyi lung / dzam ser nag gnyis kyi rjes gnang / so so'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang gi yi ge dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i lung bcas/ grub chen mi tra dzo gi nas brgyud pa'i tshe dpag med dkar po'i rjes gnang / sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi yi ge dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i lung bcas/ sme brtsegs dud kha'i bsgom lung / sgrub thabs/ las tshogs chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i lung bcas/ sme brtsegs ljang sngon jo bo nas brgyud pa'i rjes gnang / yig rnying gi lung bcas/ thugs rje chen po skyer sgang lugs kyi rigs gtad/ sgrub thabs dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa/ rigs gtad kyi cho ga skyer sgang pas zhal gzigs dus mdzad pa'i bstod pa/ sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rnams kyi lung bcas/ dpal mo lugs kyi bsnyung gnas kyi cho ga'i lung / gur gyi mgon po lcam dral lha gsum gyi rjes gnang / gung chen nas brgyud pa'i gur gyi mgon po'i gtor dbang / pu tra'i rjes gnang zur bka'/ dur khrod bdag po'i rgyud gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo dang / 'di'i man ngag gi yig skor yongs rdzogs kyi lung dang / gzhan yang lung gi skor la/ sa skya pa'i yab chos sgrub thabs brgya rtsar grags pa sgrub thabs dgu bcu rtsa drug paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur pa'i rgya gzhung gi lung / 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi bka' 'bum gyi lung / byams pa'i smon lam gyi lung la sogs pa lung gi rigs grangs med gsan cing / rgyas par ni rje nyid kyi gsan yig na gsal ba ltar yin no/ /yang bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa 'dis chos kyi spyan ldan lo nas spyan snga rin po che kun dga' don grub kyi zhal snga nas la snga phyir dam pa'i chos gsan pa'i rnam grangs la/

tshe dpag med 'chi med rnga sgra'i dbang / rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dbang / phyag rdor 'chi 'joms kyi dbang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhal bcu gcig pa lha so bdun klu sgrub lugs kyi dbang / mnga' bdag nyang ral lugs kyi gu ru drag dmar gyi dbang / 'jigs byed rwa lugs ro langs brgyad bskor gyi dbang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i rdul tshon du dbang bskur ba/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun gyi dbang / 'khor lo bde mchog dril bu pa brgyud pa'i bka' bab gnyis ldan gyi dbang / bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang / shangs pa bka' brgyud lugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i ku ru kul+le'i dbang / pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i dbang / gu ru thugs sgrub kyi byin rlabs thugs rje'i dbang / gu ru zhi bar grags pa bla ma dgongs 'dus chos dbang lugs kyi dbang / gu ru nyang lugs gtor ma la brten pa'i dbang / pad+ma gling pas gter nas spyan drangs pa'i gur drag gi dbang / thugs rje chen po 'gro 'dul gyi dbang / kye rdo rje lam dus kyi dbang / gur mgon lha lnga snyan brgyud lugs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i dbang / lha gri gug lnga/ lha brgya/ lha bcu gnyis ma rnams kyi dbang ras bris la brten pa rgya gzhung lugs/ mgon po lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo ra 'bro sa gsum gyi brgyud pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa'i byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun gong ma dang bcas pa rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang / dus 'khor sdom chen gyi dbang la sogs pa bya spyod bla med sogs ci rigs pa ste gsang sngags gsar snying gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i dbang gi rigs bcu phrag gnyis dang bdun la sogs pa smin par byed pa dbang dang / gzhan yang dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po nas brgyud pa'i tshe sgrub 'chi med dpal ster dbang gi skabs su thob pa gong 'phel du bya ba'i thabs grol byed lam gyi rnam gzhag la dbang las gzhan pa'i byin rlabs ni/

brda don gsal ba'i byin rlabs/ zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs/ bir bsrung gi byin rlabs/ rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs/ tshar gsum khug pa'i byin rlabs/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sin d+dhu ra'i byin rlabs/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud 'chad dus mdzad pa'i rin chen bzhi'i sngags btu dang / zhal bzhi pa'i sngags btu'i byin rlabs/ go cha'i dpa' bo drug dang dpa' mo drug gi byin rlabs/ ku ru kul+le'i gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs/ gcod nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi byin rlabs sogs byin rlabs kyi rigs kyang bcu phrag lhag tsam dang / grol byed lam gyi zab khrid kyi skor la/ sgrol dkar gyi lha khrid/ gsung ngag slob bshad zab mo'i khrid/ lam sbas bshad kyi thugs rdo rje'i khrid/ gur gyi mgon po'i man ngag rdo rje'i brag rdzong ma'i phyi khrid/ nang khrid/ thun mong ma yin pa'am gsang khrid/ zhal bzhi pa'i gsang khrid zab mo/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug pa rwa lugs/ 'bro lugs/ dpe med mtsho nas brgyud pa ste brgyud pa'i khyad par gsum dang ldan pa'i khrid/ grub thob man lung pa nas brgyud pa'i dus 'khor snyan brgyud kyi khrid/ grub thob u rgyan pa nas brgyud pa'i bsnyen sgrub zab mo'i nyams khrid/ tsha chung snyan brgyud du grags pa'i khrid/ phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa'i khrid/ nā ro chos drug gi khrid/ dzam bhi ra'i rlung khrid zab mo/ ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po nas brgyud pa'i gtum mo zhag bdun ma'i khrid/ grub chen nā ro pa nas brgyud pa'i ro snyoms skor drug gi khrid/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim rwa rtse sems 'dzin/ mtshan mo rgyu ba mtshan ma gyen bsgreng rnams kyi khrid/ rdo rje 'jigs byed rnal 'byor bzhi'i khrid/ thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid tshems bu lugs/ 'ba' rwa lugs kyi tshe khrid/

shangs pa bka' brgyud pa nas 'ongs pa phyag chen ga'u ma'i khrid/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi khrid/ su kha chos drug gi khrid/ lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi khrid dang / khrid brgyar mi the ba'i zab cing dkon pa'i khrid zab mo bcu phrag gnyis lhag pa dang / khrid brgya sogs dang bsdoms pa'i khrid brgya dang bcu phrag gsum lhag tsam dang / yang rjes gnang gi skor la/ sgrol dkar spyan bdun ma'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang / mgon po khro bcu'i rjes gnang / gur mgon lha brgyad sbrags sgrub kyi rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa/ lha mgon bcu gnyis ma'i rjes gnang / gur mgon lha dgu'i rjes gnang / gur gyi mgon po'i phyi nang gi las mkhan ber gcer gnyis kyi rjes gnang / ru mtshon gyi las mkhan bran bdud gshin rje nag po'i rjes gnang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ ngor lugs kyi gur mgon lha bcu gnyis ma'i rjes gnang / gsang ba'i las mkhan pu tra lcam sring gi rjes gnang zur bka'/ sgrub dus kyi mgon po zhal khra can thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang / zhal bzhi pa bsnyen dus kyi mgon por grags pa'i rjes gnang / sgrub dus thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang / bram ze mngal gtad kyi rjes gnang / dpal mgon gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang / dpal mgon khyung zhal can gyi rjes gnang / dpal mgon gdong gnyan can gyi rjes gnang / dpal mgon brtsegs zhal can gyi rjes gnang / dpal mgon dkar po tshe 'phel/ ser po bsod nams sgrub/ dmar po dbang bsdud/ sngon po bgegs 'joms rnams kyi rjes gnang / gnad dbab kyi mgon po gshin rje ltar sgrub kyi rjes gnang / bram nag bshan pa drug bskor nag po dom mchong gi rjes gnang / zhang blon gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang / sangs rgyas klu dbang rgyal po'i rjes gnang / sman bla mched bdun gyi rjes gnang /

dzaṃ bha la dkar po 'brug bzhon gyi rjes gnang / mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang / dmar po skor gsum gyi rjes gnang / dmar chung ma skor gsum gyi rjes gnang / tshogs bdag dmar chen phyag bcu gnyis pa'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa/ tshogs bdag dkar po'i rjes gnang / ga ya dha ra nas brgyud pa'i dzaṃ dmar drag sgrub kyi rjes gnang / grwa pa mngon shes can nas brgyud pa'i dzaṃ dmar zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang / dzaṃ ser nag gnyis kyi rjes gnang / 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang / ri khrod ma ser mo'i rjes gnang / phyag rdor gos sngon can gyi rjes gnang / rnam sras ser chen rta bdag brgyad kyi rjes gnang / seng gdong ma lha dgu'i rjes gnang / grub chen brgyad cu'i rjes gnang / lha mo nam mkha'i gos can gyi rjes gnang / 'jam dpal na ga rak+ṣa'i rjes gnang / gza' bdud ra hu la'i rjes gnang / rta mgrin jo lugs kyi rjes gnang / rta mgrin jo lugs sho na bzhis bskor gyi rjes gnang / rta mgrin grub rgyal lugs kyi rjes gnang / rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi rjes gnang / myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa 'khor bcas kyi rjes gnang / mgon po beng chen dmar po'i rjes gnang / dud gsol lha mo'i rjes gnang / mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang / beg gdong lcam dral gyi rjes gnang / phyag rdor khyung khra'i rjes gnang / tshe ring ma mched lnga'i rjes gnang / sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang nyer gcig ste/ rjes gnang zur bka' brgya phrag la nye ba tsam gsan cing / lung gi skor la/ dbang byin rlabs/ khrid rjes gnang la sogs pa gong gi de dag gi rgyab chos rgyud rgya gzhung / bod gzhung sogs yi ge gsar rnying phal che ba'i lung dang / khyad par du sgrol dkar gyi yig skor gtsang pa blo bzang pas phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa yongs rdzogs/ gter ston pad+ma gling pas spyan drangs pa'i gur drag gi gter chos thams cad rtsa ba'i yi ge bdun gyis lhag pa'i bcu phrag bzhi dang /

them med kyi yi ge mang po sogs kyi lung / mgon pod me 'bar ma gsang sgrub kyi yig sna kha cig ma gtogs yongs rdzogs/ snyan brgyud glegs bam phal che ba/ kha skong glegs bam nas chos sna mang po/ gyi ljang glegs bam gyi phyed tsam/ gnyan mgon chen po'i man ngag gi yi ge mang po'i lung rnams dang / gzhan yang byams pa'i smon lam/ ltung bshags sher snying bdud bzlog dang bcas pa/ bka' gdams gzhung drug gi lung / rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i bka' 'bum pod bzhi mar grags pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ rong ston chen po'i chos tshan brgya dang zhe drug gi phal cher/ rong ston rje'i rnam thar paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan gyis mdzad pa'i lung / mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog lhun grub kyi bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung / rje dkon mchog dpal ldan gyi bka' 'bum la sogs pa lung gi tshogs bgrang mi bzod pa lta bu zhig gsan nas thugs su tshud par mdzad pa yin zhing / gzhan yang bdag cag gi yongs 'dzin 'brel tshad don ldan 'di nyid kyis sdom brtson dam pa rigs sngags 'chang pa nub dgon chos rje sbyin pa grags pa las chos kyi bdud rtsi nod pa'i rnam grangs ni/ chos rgyal ma'i 'don thabs su grags pa 'jam dbyangs dang sa paṇa sbrags sgrub kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ chos rje sangs rgyas pas mdzad pa'i yig lung dang bcas pa/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo lugs kyi tshe dbang / kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi dbang ras bris la brten pa/ rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dag ldan/ shar chen gyi go sla dang bcas pa'i steng nas tshul bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i dpal kye rdo rje'i rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa'i bshad bka'/ kun tu dgos pa'i gzhung bdun/ kye rdor rgyud kyi byung tshul ngor chen gyis mdzad pa/ tshul bzhi'i rnam gzhag glo bo mkhan chen pas mdzad pa/ 'grel pa dag ldan/ shar pas mdzad pa'i dag ldan kha skong /

dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud 'debs dang / mdzes rgyan gnyis kyi lung dang bcas pa/ gnyan sgrol gyi rjes gnang / mtshan brgya'i lung bcas/ phyag rdor gtum po khyung chen gyi rjes gnang / mi g.yo ba sngon po'i rjes gnang chu bsrung dang bcas pa/ mi g.yo ba dkar po'i rjes gnang / de'i sgrub thabs dang las tshogs kyi yig lung dang bcas pa/ 'jam dbyangs smra seng gi rjes gnang / 'jam dbyangs ye shes bzang po'i rigs gtad sogs dang / gzhan yang lung gi skor la/ rje btsun gong ma lnga'i bka' 'bum nas chos sna mang po'i lung / ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi bka' 'bum phal cher gyi lung / mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub kyi bka' 'bum dkar chag nang bzhin/ bu ston rin po che'i chos 'byung chen mo/ rang gi slob ma la gdams pa'i bu ston snying thur/ rgyud sde spyi rnam rgyas pa'i lung la sogs pa mang du gsan la/ yang sa skya pa'i man ngag gser chos su grags pa'i gdams pa snyan brgyud zab mo kun gyi gter chen nyams rtogs kyi mnga' bdag grub mchog dbang phyug rab brtan zhabs kyi drung du ji ltar gsan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can nas brgyud pa'i tshe dbang lcags sdong ma/ sa skya pa'i yab chos yang dag mar me dgu par grags pa'i lha dgu'i dbang / yang phur thun mong ba'i rdzogs rim gyi man ngag zab mo rdzogs chen a ti yo ga'i khrid/ rdzogs chen a ti yo ga'i glegs bam yongs rdzogs kyi lung dang bcas pa ste snga 'gyur rnying ma'i chos tshul zab cing dkon pa mang po zhig dang / gsar ma'i skor la/ sa skya pa'i gdams pa dmar po skor gsum las/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs/ sa skya pa'i gser chos mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i man ngag zab mo thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab/ rnal 'byor ma'i lugs dkyil sgom tshul gyi yig chung zab mo/

rtsa dbu ma'i khrid yig mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i steng nas khrid lung dang bcas pa/ in+d+ra mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs/ mai tri mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs/ zhal gnyis ma/ don grub ma/ dbu bcad ma ste dpyal lugs kyi phag mo skor gsum gyi byin rlabs rnams gsan cing / yang sa skya pa'i khyad par gyi gdams pa dmar po skor gsum du grags pa las rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le'i rjes gnang thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ ku ru kul+le'i gsang sgrub thun mong ma yin pa sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa lha lnga'i byin rlabs dang / dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i rjes gnang thun mong yin min gnyis/ dbang bsdud 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i rjes gnang thun mong yin min gnyis/ jo bo nas brgyud pa'i tshogs bdag dkar po gtso 'khor bzhi pa'i rjes gnang la sogs pa gsan te/ de ltar dmar po skor gsum rjes gnang rnams sngon du song nas/ so so'i man ngag gi chos skor yongs rdzogs gsan par mdzad pa las ku ru kul+le'i chos skor la phyi sgrub/ nang sgrub/ gsang sgrub gsum du phye/ tshogs bdag bgegs kyi rgyal po'i chos skor la/ rtsa ba'i yi ge gsal byed lhan thabs kyi yi ge zhar byung tshogs bdag dkar po'i sgrub skor dang gsum/ dbang bsdud 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i man ngag gi chos skor la/ thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis te gsum po so so'i man ngag gi yig skor rnams tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtshos sde tshan du bcad phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas dkar chag mdzad pa bzhin gyi glegs bam yongs su rdzogs pa'i lung legs par nod par mdzad la/ yang dam pa de nyid kyi zhal las chos skyong gi skor gsan pa la/ gur mgon lha brgyad sbags sgrub thun mong ma yin pa dang / lha mgon bcu gnyis ma'i rjes gnang / 'khor rkyang pu tra'i rjes gnang zur bka' rnams dang / gnyan mgon chen po gdong bzhi pa'i chos skor la/

bsnyen dus kyi mgon por grags pa'i rjes gnang / sgrub dus thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang / bram ze sngags gtad kyi rjes gnang / dpal mgon gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang rnams sngon du gsan nas dpal gdong bzhi pa'i chos skor tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i dkar chag nang bzhin yongs rdzogs kyi lung / gdong bzhi pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag ha la nag po'i be'u bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung / rdzong lugs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams las brgyud pa'i zhal bzhi pa'i man ngag rje mus sred pas mdzad pa'i dkar chag nang bzhin yig skor yongs rdzogs kyi lung / dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i yi ge gsar rnying thor bu ba du ma'i lung dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug 'jigs byed dud pa'i sol ba can gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang / gsang sgrub nan chags ma lha nyi shu'i rjes gnang / 'di'i man ngag zab mo yongs rdzogs bzhugs pa'i glegs bam tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i dkar chag nang bzhin gyi lung dang bcas pa/ dur khrod bdag po'i rgyud sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs kyi yig sna mang po/ dkar bdud lcam dral gyi sgrub skor 'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims la bzhi thog bla brang gi ltag gi nyi zla phug par chos skyong rang gis dngos su gnang ba'i yig skor cha tshang sogs kyi lung dang bcas pa sogs rje btsun sa skya pa'i bka' srung gsar rnying gi zab chos mang po zhig dang / gnod sbyin chen po zangs kyi beg tse can gyi rjes gnang / chos skyong dpal mgon stag gzhon nag po gtso 'khor gyi rjes gnang sogs kyang gsan/ yang bka' gdams pa nas brgyud pa'i mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i yig skor mang po/ dbus ston pa dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi man ngag yig skor/ 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa bdun pa'i rnam bshad rgya ston gyis mdzad pa'i steng nas lung bshad/

uṣ+ṇi rwa lugs kyi yig sna du ma'i lung / 'jam dpal nag po'i rjes gnang / man ngag yongs rdzogs kyi yig lung la sogs pa snyan brgyud gtso bor gyur pa'i chos tshul rnams kyis thog drangs man ngag zab dgu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsan nas thugs rgyud yongs su tshim par mdzad pa yin no/ /yang rje btsun dam pa 'dis ni rang gi gcen 'jam pa'i dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug dang / sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal mched las kyang sa skya pa rang gi yab chos 'ga' zhig gsan te/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i dbang zab mo dang / ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo lugs kyi tshe dpag med kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba sogs sku mched gnyis ka las gsan cing / grub mchog mthu stobs dbang phyug la lung gi rigs mang po zhig gsan te/ de yang rje 'dis rje btsun sa skya pa gong ma lnga'i bka' 'bum gyi lung rnams phal cher rje mus pa chen po dang / rje nags dgon pa sbyin pa grags pa/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags sogs las gsan mod kyang / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras nas brgyud pa zhig gus zhen gyis gsan bzhed che bar yod pa bzhin/ grub pa'i dbang phyug bsod nams dbang po las legs par gsan pa mkhan chen byams pa rin chen rgyal mtshan la 'jam pa'i dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug gis gsan pa ltar/ rje 'dis thugs rtsol ba chen pos grub dbang mthu stobs dbang phyug las gong ma lnga'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung gsan pa yin la/ gzhan yang grub mchog de la slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes rabs so bzhi pa mañju shrīs bsgyur pa'i lung / mdo sdud pa'i lung / chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i gsung rab ma ṇi bka' 'bum du grags pa'i lung / rje mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi rnam thar khong rang gis mdzad pa'i lung rnams gsan pa yin no/

/de dag tu ma zad 'jam mgon bla ma 'dis rtse gdong bdag chen chos kyi rgyal po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub zhabs las tshe dpag med dze ta ri lha dgu'i dbang / yang dag mar me dgu pa'i dbang / rdo rje 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi dbang / kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil gyi lung bcas/ lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi khrid byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ chos kyi dag byed sdom gsum rab dbye'i lung bshad/ kun mkhyen chen po'i spyi ṭika gi steng nas gsan par mdzad la/ yang lo phu ba 'bum chen kun dga' dpal 'byor las kyang zab chos 'ga' zhig gsan pa yin te/ ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po nas brgyud pa'i tshe dpag med lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba mda' 'phel mar grags pa ku ru kul+le'i gsang sgrub lha lnga'i byin rlabs/ tshogs bdag dmar chen dang 'dod rgyal gyi rjes gnang / 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim rwa rtse sems 'dzin/ mtshan mo rgyu ba/ mtshan ma gyen sgreng rnams dang / rnal 'byor bzhi'i khrid/ 'jigs byed kyi man ngag zab mo yang gsang mthu zlog nag por grags pa/ bram ze sngags gtad kyi rjes gnang / gnyos mgon trag shad nag po gtso 'khor dgu'i rjes gnang rnams dang / lung gi skor la grwa pa mngon shes can nas brgyud pa'i dzam dmar gyi las tshogs kyi yig rnying yongs rdzogs kyi lung / dur khrod bdag po'i rgyud man ngag gi yig rnying 'ga' zhig gi lung rnams dang / yang rje de la gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos skor gsan pa ni/ spyir gsang sngags rnying ma la bka' gter gnyis las/ bka' ma ni sa skya pa'i yab chos yang phur sogs dang tshul mtshungs pa rdo rje 'chang nas bzung da lta'i bar du brgyud pa bar ma chad pas bka' yod la lhad med pa rnams yin zhing / gter ma ni sgrub chen bka' brgyad du yod pa las/ bskyed pa mahā yo ga ste bskyed rim gtso bor ston pa gter kha gong mar grags pa khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sprul pa mnga' bdag nyang ral gyis gter nas spyan drangs pa'i bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i skor/

lung a nu yo ga ste rdzogs rim gtso bor ston pa gter kha 'og mar grags pa nyang ral de nyid kyang slar byon pa gu ru chos dbang gis lho gter nas spyan drangs pa bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi skor/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug ston pa rig 'dzin rgod ldem gyis byang gter nas spyan drangs pa'i bka' brgyad drag po rang byung rang shar gyi skor dang / gzhan yang sprul sku bde chen gling pas spyan drangs pa'i bka' brgyad khro 'bar ma dang / pad+ma gling pas spyan drangs pa'i thugs kyi me long la sogs pa bka' brgyad kyi rigs mang du yod pa rnams ni bka' brgyad yongs su rdzogs pa'am rtsa ba yin la/ de dag las 'phros pa'i bka' brgyad bye brag pa la yang mang du yod pa'i 'phrin las phur pa'i skor la/ gu ru chos dbang gis lho gter nas spyan drangs pa phur pa yang gsang spu gri'i skor/ rat+na gling pas spyan drangs pa yang gsang bla med kyi skor/ rig 'dzin rgod ldem pas spyan drangs pa la/ bskyed pa mahā yo ga dang 'brel pa phur pa lha khra'am che mchog gi skor/ lung a nu yo ga gzhir bzhag pa'i phur pa lha nag gam drag sngags kyi skor/ rdzogs chen a ti yo ga dang 'brel ba'i phur pa lha 'dus sam dril sgrub kyi skor rnams yod pa'i nang nas/ phur pa yang gsang spu gri'i chos skor/ bi do ta ma la 'bum sde'i rgyud nas bkol ba dum bu'i rgyud rtsa ba rdo rje khros pa sogs yig sna bcu phrag gnyis dang / drug phrag gcig tsam gyi lung / gshin rje tshe bdag dang / rta mgrin gsang 'dus kyi man ngag 'ga' zhig gshin rje'i las tshogs mkha' 'gro'i za yig rnam dgu/ 'khon sbyangs an dar rdo lung mar grags pa/ rig 'dzin rgod ldem pas spyan drangs pa'i gu ru thugs sgrub kyi dpe tshan nyer gcig slob bu'i 'dod pa brtag thabs kyi man ngag phyag rdor dregs pa kun 'dul la brten pa'i char 'bebs/

sprul sku pad+ma gling pa'i gter chos gsol kha mtshon cha can gyi lag len nag po 'gro shes/ mngon spyod kyi las kun la gces pa'i yig chung / phung po ri bo che nas zhang khrom gyis bton pa'i gter chos sogs rnying ma'i gdams pa mang du gsan pa yin la/ de ltar rje btsun bla ma 'di nyid kyis yongs 'dzin mkhas shing grub pa bcu phrag gcig tu gnyis kyis lhag pa dag gus pa chen pos bsten nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i chos tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsan cing thugs su chud par mdzad pas lung dang / man ngag dang / bshad pa la sogs pa chos kyi rgya mtsho chen por gyur pa yin no/ /gsan pa de dag las kyang thar rtse nas nam mkha'i mtshan can las thor bu gsan pa rnams ni sku gzhon nu'i dus su yin pas/ gong gzhon nu rol rtsed kyi skabs su bkod zin la/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags las ni dgung lo bcu phrag gsum bzhes pa nas/ mkhan chen de nyid zhi bar gshegs kyi bar du yang yang du gsan nas/ chos tshul gang la yang mtha' chod par mdzad cing / 'jam dbyangs sku mched dang rje mus pa chen po gsum gyi phyis nas mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs 'di la bla ma rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu 'dzin cing / gsan pa yang dpag tu med pa zhig mdzad pa dang / dam pa 'dis kyang mkhan chen mtshungs pa med pa de la gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos kyi bka' drin bla na med pa stsol bar mdzad pa yin pas na/ tshul de dag ni 'og tu rgyas par 'chad pa mdongs gsol lags so/ /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ chos kun mngon rdzogs byang chub sangs rgyas kyi/ /zag med yon tan 'chi med dpal yon la/ /rang gir spyod dang thar 'dod lha'i tshogs la/ /'bad med sbyin mkhas yongs 'dzin mig stong pa/ /nyid phyir de la dad gus lhod med par/ /spyi bo'i thod bzhin bsten nas bka'i gsang ba/ /rna ba'i bdud rtsir 'os zhes rgyal ba'i gsung /

/brjed med thig le khyod thugs ngos na 'tsher/ /thub gsung zab dang yangs pa'i nor 'dzin mar/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i gser gyi rtsibs stong can/ /bskyod pa'i mdzad 'phrin 'phrul ldan 'khor los bsgyur/ /rnam gsum 'dren pa gtsor gyur yongs 'dzin bshes/ /mig bcas phyogs kyi zhal gyi bum bzang las/ /thun mong yin min gdams pa'i bcud mngar mo/ /khyod kyis dad pa'i brtson pa'i khyor ba yis/ /blangs te rnam dpyod ljags kyis tshim par myangs/ /sngon byon mkhas mang phyi yi mtsho chen du/ /ma 'khyil yan lag brgyad ldan zab dgu'i chab/ /khyod thugs nang gi chu gter du 'khyil pa/ /mthong bas bdun gyi rol mtsho'ang skyengs min nam/ /nam yang phan bde 'jo ba 'dren pa yi/ /yid bzhin mang pos khyod gtsug mdzes spud pa/ /mthong bas klu dbang zhum ste chu gter cher/ /zhugs nas slar yang rin chen 'tshol ba bzhin/ /khyod kyi lhag bsam snying stobs gzhu 'dom gyis/ /zab yang rgyud dang man ngag lung dang khrid/ /grangs med chos tshul nam mkha'i mtha' 'jal ba/ /mthong bas kun gsal dbyings su 'phags par nges/ /khyod thugs rgyal ba'i rin chen bang mdzod na/ /ma mchis rmad byung chos kyi dgos dgu'i nor/ /ma gzigs rgyal dbang spyan stong ldan pa yang / /yid bskyed bshol med zhi ba'i mngal du thim/ /de phyir bgrang yas chos tshul zab mo'i gnad/ /ring min dus nas dam pa mang po las/ /rnyed pa'i gtam bzang bdud rtsi 'phyur ba na/ /skal bzang lha bu sprin bzhin cis mi 'du/ /khyod kyi dad brtson lang tsho mthong ba'i tshe/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i spyan ldan mang pos chos/ /sgo skyel byas tshe gzhan dag zab chos grong / /stong pa min nam blo gros khyogs la 'deg /e ma 'di na zab gsal mdo rgyud man ngag chu klung bye ba brgyas/ /yongs su gang ba'i bslu med yongs 'dzin dam pa'i chos kyi rgya mtsho che/ /bstan dang 'gro ba chu skyes yongs kyi dpal du nyer 'khyil de bas na/

/khyod ni nam yang g.yo ba med cing gdung skyes rlabs mang mdzes gyur cig/ ༈ //spyi don lnga pa mtha' yas pa'i yi dam dang chos skyong gi thugs bskul ba'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin cing mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan ji ltar mnga' ba'i tshul ni/ theg pa chen po'i slob dpon dbyig gnyen zhabs kyis/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pa'i/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs pa dag gis bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum la 'bad dgos par gsungs pa dang / de yang mgon po byams pas/ gal te ma thos par yang sgom 'jug 'gyur na bstan pa don med 'gyur/ /gal te ma sgom par yang thos mthong 'gyur na sgom pa don med 'gyur/ /zhes dang / 'jam mgon sa paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos/ mkhas pa rnams kyi legs bshad rnams/ /shin tu legs par go bzhin du/ /de don nyams su mi len na/ /bstan bcos shes kyang ci zhig bya/ /zhes thos bsam sgom gsum zung 'brel gyi tshul du thos don nyams len du bstar dgos la/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang / rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ dal 'byor 'di ni rnyed pa shin tu dka'/ /skyes bu don grub thob par gyur pa la/ /gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrubs na/ /phyis 'di yang dag 'byor pa ga la 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dal 'byor gyi yon tan bco brgyad kyis mdzes pa'i mi lus dam pa 'di rnyed dka' zhing / rnyed na don chen po dang ldan par rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig tu mthun par gsungs pa 'di nyid lan gcig tsam thob pa'i skabs su/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten nas/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis ji ltar bstan pa bzhin gyi lam zab mo nyams su len dgos te/ dam pa'i chos kyi tshig 'bru thos pa tsam yang dka' ba yin na/ bslu ba med pa'i yongs 'dzin dam pa dag gis 'khrul pa med par bstan nas/ g.yeng ba med par tshul bzhin du nyams su blang rgyu yod pa ni ches dkon pa ni lta smos kyang ci dgos/

de bas na 'jam mgon sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ sangs rgyas bstan dang 'phrad dka' zhing / /dal ba 'byor pa'ang rnyed par dka'/ /bla ma bzang dang mjal dka' zhing / /zhes dang / mus chen sems dpa' chen pos/ rnyed dka'i dal 'byor thob dus/ /bshes gnyen dam pa bsten nas/ /lam bzang nyams su len pa/ /bsod nams bsags pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gang 'dod nyams su blangs chog pa ni skal pa bzang pa las kyang ches mchog tu bzang ba yin pa'i phyir na cis kyang nyams su len dgos pa'i gtan tshigs mtha' yas kyang / kun gyi snying po bsdus nas sems dpa' chen pos/ nyams su len pa'i chos la/ /blo snying brang gsum gtod cig /'di phyi bar do gsum du/ /'di yis bslu ba med pas/ /ma nor lam la 'bungs shig /ces gsungs pa'i don rnams thugs kyi klong su sim par mdzad nas/ thos pa de dag thams cad kyang / /ming rkyang tsam du ma bzhag go /zhes gsungs pa ltar gong du bkod pa bzhin gyi yongs 'dzin mang po'i zhal gyi gdams bcud ngoms par gsol ba rnams nyams bzhes kyi 'phreng bar bstar ba mdzad cing / de'i tshul yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i nyams len thams cad bsdu na sdom pa gsum gyi nyams len du 'du zhing / de las so thar byang sems sngags kyi sdom pa gsum gyi/ dang po'i yang gtso bo ni/ dge bsnyen/ dge tshul/ dge slong gi sdom pa gsum yin zhing / de dag kyang mkhan slob mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las nod par mdzad pa rnams dgos pa khyad par can gyi phyir 'bul chog mdzad pa'i dus yan chad rtsa ba bzhi dang / chang dang lnga po nas so so'i bslab bya phra mo tshun chad tshul bzhin du bsrung sdom mdzad pa la gus sbyor shin tu che ba'i sgo nas/ mtha' na chos gos lhung bzed sogs 'chang ba/ chab bzhes pa dang / dus min kha zas mi gsol ba sogs yul dus gnas skabs thams cad du bstan pa'i mig rkyen la phan pa'i kun spyod kho na mdzad par snang zhing /

byang sems kyi sdom pa brgyud pa gnyis ldan sogs kyi cho ga la brten nas legs par thob pa'i pad+ma dkar po'i 'phreng ba rnam dpyod mgul pa mdzes pa'i rgyan du bzhes pa de nyid/ lugs gnyis nas bshad pa'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi ltung ba dus kyi bsil bas ma bcom zhing / rlabs chen rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa rmad du byung ba lhur mdzad de/ chos dang mthun pa'i mdzad 'phrin che phra gang yang byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis kyi rtsis zin pa nyid nas/ rang smin par byed pa'i zab lam pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / gzhan smin par byed pa bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la sogs pa dag gi sgo nas kyang rang gzhan smin grol la 'god par mdzad ces yongs su grags la/ rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi sdom pa rgyud sde tha dad nas bshad tshul mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis/ ji ltar bskur ba'i cho ga yang so sor sna tshogs pa gsungs pa bzhin/ de dag las legs par thob pa'i sngags kyi sdom pa yang mang du yod kyang / rgyud sde kun gyi yang rtse bla med rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i dbang bzhi dang lam bzhi ste bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis bsdus pa dag gtso bo yin zhing / de dag rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las tshul bzhin du thob pa mi nyams pa'i phyir rdo rje theg pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rgyud kyi nyams bzhes khrigs su mngar ba dang / chos mthun gyi mdzad spyod gzhan yang mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ rje 'di dgung lo nyer lnga ma son gyi bar tshun chad la/ thog mar tho rangs kyi cha la babs pa na/ nyams bzhes kyi gtso bo gang yin de'i ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis bzhengs nas/ rong ston chen po nas brgyud pa'i tshe sgrub zhag bdun mar grags pa mdzad pa la/ skyabs 'gro nyer gcig gzungs thung sum brgya/ gzungs ring nyer gcig rlung sbyor nyer gcig gam bdun re dang bcas pa/ de nas rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bsrung ba thun mong ba la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig

aṅgu li bco lnga/ de nas lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig rje bla ma'i gsol 'debs brgya rtsa re/ de nas dkar gtor cha bzhi dang / dbyug gu ma la chang bu phul rjes/ kye rdor mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa/ lam dus kyi dbang rgyas par blang ba dang / dbang bzhi'i mtshams su brda chig brgyud thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len dang bcas pa la/ skyabs 'gro/ yig brgya/ uṣ+ṇi ṣa rnams nyer gcig re/ rdzogs rim gyi skabs su srog rtsol rdo rje'i bzlas pa stong rtsa re'am lnga brgya re/ gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa lan bdun/ aṣ+ṭa so gcig de nas bde mchog dril bu lugs kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams bzhes la/ skyabs 'gro dang yig brgya nyer gcig re/ rdzogs rim rim lnga'i rim pa gang rung re/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags rnams brgya rtsa re dang / 'khor gyi sngags rnams nyer gcig re/ de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams bzhes la rje dam pa'i gsung rgyun zab mo du mas brgyan pa la skyabs 'gro dang yig brgya nyer gcig re/ oṃ gsum ma brgya rtsa re/ yid bzlas rlung sbyor bdun re/ chig brgyud kyi 'pho ba la nan tan dang bcas pa/ de nas 'byung 'dul gyi sgom bzlas la/ skyabs 'gro nyer gcig sngags thung brgya/ sngags ring nyer gcig de na gur mgon gyi srung 'khor rdo rje'i brag rdzong ma la/ skyabs 'gro nyer gcig oṃ shrī mahā ka la ya sogs so gcig yi ge bdun ma dang bcu gnyis ma brgya rtsa re/ shā sa na so gcig de nas bla ma rin 'byung la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig maṇ+ḍal bdun ma tshar drug dang / so bdun ma tshar gcig phyi nang gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal tshigs bcad ma tshar re/ de nas zhal bzhi pa'i srung 'khor gur bdun ma la/ skyabs 'gro nyer gcig yi dam gyi sngags dang / gur mgon gyi yi ge bdun ma dpal mgon rang gi gzungs thung rnams brgya rtsa re/

gzungs ring so gcig oṃ aḥyur dz+nyā na sogs nyer gcig bsrung ba dang bzlog pa'i sngags brgya rtsa re/ rlung sbyor bdun re/ de nas rje nyid la dmigs rten phul nas ched du gtad pa'i tshe 'das rnams kyi don du dgongs pa'i smon lam gyi rim pa la thog mar skyabs 'gro nyer gcig tshad med bzhi/ rgyal yum dam pa lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo zhing brjes dus rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i smon lam rgyas pa tshar gcig dang / bsdus pa bcu gcig ngan song sdug bsngal sogs dang / rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sogs tshigs bcad nyer gcig re/ bkra shis kyi mtha' brten dang bcas pa/ de nas seng gdong sngon mo'i sgom bzlas la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig sngags brgya rtsa/ bzlog pa tshar dgu/ de nas sher snying gi sngags tshar bcu gcig bzlog pa tshar gsum/ de nas 'jam dbyangs nag po'i sngags dang / tshe sgrub rdzas sngags/ dug bsrung zab mo'i sngags rnams brgya rtsa re re/ de nas gtor ma brgya rtsa sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i nang bzhin mdzad/ gong gi nyams bzhes de rnams gang rigs kyi mtshams nam langs te lag ris mthong pa tsam gyi dus/ nam mkha' zas su za ba'i man ngag lan bdun re rnams mdzad cing / dbang khrid sogs chos 'chad nyan stobs che ba'i skabs dang / sgrub mchod/ rgyud 'don/ gtor bzlog sogs kyi dus rlung sbyor dang / ljags bzlas kyi grangs rnams cung zad nyung bar mdzad/ gnas skabs de dag ma gtogs dus skabs kun tu pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig la dgongs/ gtor ma brgya rtsa mdzad grub mtshams/ gsung rab dri ma med pa gang yang rung ba nas shog bu mda' tshad ma re tsam re thugs 'dzin ma chag pa mdzad rjes bzhengs te rten gyi drung du phyag dang bcas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs yan lag bdun pa tshar bdun nam gsum re/ de nas rten gyi drung der bzhugs nas bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa tshar bcu gcig gam gsum re mdzad/

de nas zhabs skor dang bcas rje nyid kyi bla ma rnams kyi gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus rnams dang / dpal mchog ma/ kun khyab ma/ gang drin ma/ dpal ldan brtan g.yo ma/ kye rdor gyi bstod pa daṇ+ḍa ka sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya/ phyogs bcu dus gsum ma sogs mdzad cing / phebs 'grul gyi skabs su ni de lta bu'i zhal 'don gyi rim pa rnams dang / gzhan yang bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams bzhes 'ga' zhig dpon slob kun gyi phebs lam gyi bar chad zhi ba'i phyir chibs thog tu mdzad do/ /de nas kha zas kyi rnal 'byor tshul bzhin mdzad rjes/ nyams bzhes kyi gtso bo'i thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor gsal 'debs pa'i ngang nas/ bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam dang / mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sogs kyis dus 'da' zhing / snga gong gi thun mtshams kyi skabs gang 'os la/ rnam rgyal 'joms kyi gzungs ring tshar gsum re/ u tsa'i sngags ring nyer gcig re/ u tsa'i sngags thung / sme brtsegs/ khyung nag rta mgrin lcags ral can rnams kyi sngags brgya rtsa re rnams bzlas pa mdzad cing / de nas phyi dro'i cha la bab pa na/ rten gyi drung du phyag dang bcas yan lag bdun pa'i tshigs bcad rnams snga dro bzhin gnang rjes/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig rje bla ma'i gsol 'debs brgya rtsa/ de nas lam zab nang ma la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig de nas bir bsrung nang ma la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig rlung sbyor bdun nam gsum/ de nas kye rdor mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa lam dus kyi dbang 'bring du blang ba/ dbang bzhi'i mtshams su brda chig brgyud thun mong ma yin pa dang bcas pa la skyabs 'gro dang yig brgya nyer gcig re/ rdzogs rim gyi skabs rlung sbyor yan lag bdun re/ gtum mo 'khor lo gnyis la brten pa lan bdun/ aṣ+ṭa so gcig de nas bde mchog nag po pa'i lugs kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len la skyabs 'gro dang yig brgya nyer gcig

rdzogs rim dpyid thig gi man ngag lan nyer gcig gam bcu gcig gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags ring tshar gsum dang / sngags thung rnams brgya rtsa re/ 'khor gyi sngags bdun tsam re/ de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams bzhes snga dro bzhin/ de nas 'byung 'dul gyi sgom bzlas kyang snga dro bzhin mdzad rjes/ bla ma yi dam lha brgyad mkha' 'gro sbrags sgrub la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig de wa pi tsu brgya/ yi ge bdun ma sum brgya/ e ka dza ṭi'i sngags nyer gcig lha mo'i ro ru brgya/ las mgon pho mo'i bod pa brgya re/ pho mo'i rbad bsad sum cu re/ rlung sbyor bdun/ de nas bla ma rin 'byung la skyabs 'gro dang maṇ+ḍal sogs snga thun bzhin/ de nas zhal bzhi pa'i tshe sgrub srung 'khor gur bdun ma dang / gshin don du smon lam yang snga thun la mdzad pa bzhin grub rjes/ dbyug gu ma'i sngags brgya rtsa re/ de nas gcod kyi nyams bzhes la skyabs 'gro rgyas bsdus tshar bdun/ sbyin gtong dkar 'gyed dmar 'gyed gsum skabs su gang babs re lan bdun nam gsum re mdzad cing / de nas phebs 'grul sogs kyi tshe phur chung gtor bsngo bskang ba dang bcas pa'i dus gtor zab rgyas 'bul ba'i skabs rnams su bskang bstod rgyas pa yab mes gong ma'i phyag len bzhin ma chag par mdzad/ yang phebs 'grul ma yin pa'i skabs 'gar phur chung gtor bsngo bskang bstod sogs snga thun dgong thun gyi thun mtshams dang / dus skabs phal cher dgong thun gyi bla ma yi dam lha brgyad mkha' 'gro sbrags sgrub dang / bla ma rin 'byung gi mtshams su mdzad cing / de nas bir bsrung grub rjes nyams bzhes kyi gtso bo gang yin de'i nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la 'jug par mdzad nas/ sang nyin ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis bzhengs pa sogs gong du bkod pa'i rim pa bzhin las cung zad kyang mi g.yo bar/ mdor na phyi'i mdzad spyod dam pa'i chos 'dul ba nas bshad pa bzhin dang /

nang gi nyams bzhes theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed kyi rtsis zin pa'i sgo nas zab mo rdo rje theg pa bla med kyi nye lam chig bsgril lta bur mdzad pa yin par rje btsun dam pa nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rje nyid dgung lo nyer gsum bzhes skabs nyin zhag phrugs re'i dge sbyor nyams len gyi rim pa rnams dang 'phral gyi kun spyod rnams chos dang mthun par spyod pa'i tshul sogs dran gso gsal 'debs kyi yi ge las bshad pa yin la/ de ltar dam pa 'di nyid dgung lo nyer lnga tshun chad thugs dam nyams bzhes kyi rim pa de bzhin du mdzad nas/ slar gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i sde bstan pa gdung rgyud dang bcas pa'i 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi khur chen po 'di snying stobs kyi phrag par khyer bar mdzad pa nas bzung / lugs gnyis kyi mdzad 'phrin rgya ches pa nas rgyun gyi nyams bzhes zhal 'don sogs cung zad kha phri tsam mi mdzad ka med du snang ba bzhin/ dgung gi lo nyer lngar phebs pa nas brtsams da lta'i bar la/ tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis bzhengs te/ de nas thog mar tshe sgrub zab mo chig brgyud ma/ der rjes bir bsrung thun mong ba/ de nas lam zab thun mong ba/ de nas dkar gtor cha bzhi dang / nor lha dbyug gu ma mched gsum la chang bu 'bul ba/ de nas lam dus rgyas pa brda chig brgyud kyi man ngag dang bcas pa/ de nas bde mchog dril bu pa'i mngon rtogs/ de nas nā ro mkha' spyod 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor dang bcas pa/ de nas 'byung 'dul gyi sgom bzlas/ de nas srung 'khor rdo rje'i brag rdzong ma/ de nas bla ma rin 'byung gi nyams bzhes/ de nas zhal bzhi pa'i tshe sgrub zab mo gur bdun ma/ de nas rje nyid la spyan dmigs rten sogs phul te ched du gtad pa'i tshe 'das rnams kyi don du dgongs pa'i smon lam/ de nas seng gdong ma'i bzlog pa/ de nas gtor ma brgya rtsa/

de nas rnam rgyal 'joms/ 'jam nag u tsa'i sngags ring thung / sme brtsegs dbang bsdud/ dug sngags zab mo rnams te/ de rnams la skyabs 'gro rlung sbyor/ gsol 'debs/ maṇ+ḍal/ sngags ring thung rnams thugs skabs dang bstun nas ci 'tshams re mdzad rjes/ sgrub mchod/ rgyud 'don/ gtor bzlog sogs kyi thugs brel med skabs gsung rab zab mo rnams nas dpe 'dzin shog lhe re tsam ma chag pa mdzad cing / de nas nyin bar gyi cha sogs bzhengs 'chang gzims bzhugs te spyod lam rnam pa bzhi dang / thos bsam 'chad nyan sogs gang mdzad kyang spros bral gyi lta ba'i gnad zab mo gdod ma'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi rtsis zin pa kho na dang / nyams bzhes kyi gtso bo'i rnal 'byor dang mi 'bral ba'i thugs 'dun drag po yang yang bskyed par mdzad cing / de nas sgrub mchod sogs kyi thugs brel zing chen po med skabs/ phyi dro'i cha la babs pa na/ rje nyid kyi gzim phug tu bzhugs te thog mar lam zab thun mong ba dang / thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ de nas bir bsrung thun mong ma yin pa/ de nas lam dus 'bring po/ brda chig brgyud kyi man ngag dang bcas pa/ de nas nā ro mkha' spyod 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor dang bcas pa/ de nas gur mgon lha brgyad sbrags sgrub/ de nas bla ma rin 'byung / de nas zhal bzhi pa'i tshe sgrub zab mo/ de nas snga dro bzhin gyi smon lam dang / de nas nor lha dbyug gu ma'i bzlas pa/ de nas phur chung gtor bsngo/ bskang gso/ de nas gcod gdan thog gcig gi nyams bzhes/ de nas bir bsrung thun mong ba/ de nas nyams bzhes kyi gtso bo'i nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la 'jug par mdzad cing / zhal 'don spros bcas kyi dge sbyor de rnams kyi skyabs 'gro/ gsol 'debs/ rlung sbyor/ maṇ+ḍal/ sngags ring thung ljags bzlas sogs kyi grangs kyang shin tu mang bar mdzad kyang / thun re bzhin 'di tsam gyi grangs ka dpe ma mi mdzad par snang la/

de nas yang nangs par ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis bzhengs pa sogs mdor na lo zla khor yug tu tshul de lta bus dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang / phyis li ma lha khang dang / rgya nag lha khang sogs gsar bzhengs mdzad zin pa nas bzung / gtsug lag khang de gnyis dang / rje nyid kyi gzim chung nang gi rten khyad par can/ dpe khang chen mo'i phyag dpe dang bcas pa rnams la bla ma so so'i gsol 'debs sogs zhal 'don grangs med mdzad pa dang bstun/ phyag dang / zhabs skor mang po'i grangs tshad ma 'di yang thugs dgyes spro chen po'i sgo nas mdzad cing / gzhan yang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam dang / byams pa'i smon lam/ bde ba can gyi smon lam kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa mi mjed ma dang / rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bdag gi dus gsum ma/ phyis su nyid kyis mdzad pa'i mngon dgar skye ba'i smon lam sogs smon lam tshigs bcad kyi rigs mang po dang gzhan yang bshags pa dang smon lam gnyis char tshang ba'i tshigs su bcad pa bla ma gzhan gyis mdzad pa dang / dam pa 'di nyid rang gis mdzad pa sogs zhal 'don thor bu mdzad pa'i rigs ni mtha' yas shing / de bzhin du gong du bkod pa ltar gyi dgongs thun gyi nyams bzhes rnams grub nas/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la ma 'jug gi bar der/ yi dam gyi lha bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rtsa sngags sogs kyi gsung bzlas chag med mdzad pa'i rnam grangs kyang / yang dag gi sngags/ rdo rje phur pa'i kī la ya/ bde mchog gi yi ge bdun ma/ kye rdor gyi snying po de wa pi tsu/ yum gyi aṃ thung / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa/ gshed dmar/ 'jigs byed/ gu ru zhi drag gnyis/ gur zhal/ 'jam dpal nag po/ seng gdong ma/ dbyug gu ma mched gsum/ ku ru kul+le/ dzaṃ dmar rnams kyi sngags brgya rtsa re ste/ de lta bus nyin mtshan khor yug 'da' ba las/ dus gnas thams cad du sku gsung thugs tha mal du bzhugs pa ni sus kyang mthong ba med la/

dus phyis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi smin grol gyis bsdus pa'i gdams ngag zab cing rgya che ba rnams gsan nas de'i bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len zab mo yang rgyun pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nyams bzhes kyi rjes su chag med du mdzad cing / nai gu skor gyi chos skor rnams kyang shin tu rgya che ba thugs ka rdzogs par gsan pa nas bzung chos drug ga'i nyams bzhes cha tshang ba gang dmigs re gcod khrid kyi nyams len gyi rjes su chag med byed pa'i lugs yin gsungs pa rje nyid kyi gsung las thos shing / mdor na bdag nyid chen po 'dis nyin zhag phrugs rer nyams su bstar ba'i mnyam bzhag gi nyams bzhes zab mo lta zhog sdig bshags/ smon lam/ gsol 'debs/ ljags bzlas/ gtor ma sogs 'phral gyi mdzad spyod rags pa tsam yang deng sang dge las la brtson pa la ches brtson par rlom pa dag gis nyin zhag du mar 'bad kyang grub par dka' bar mthong zhing / gdul bya so so'i blo dang 'tshams par chos gsung ba dang / 'bel ba'i gtam mdzad pa dang / rgya bod kyi mkhas grub dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung rab mang po gzigs rtog mdzad pa rnams la lhod pa cung zad kyang mi mnga' ba rtag 'grus su mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni/ bstan pa rin po che'i khur chen bzhes par grags pa'i klog pa ba su zhig la yang yod par mthong ba'am thos pa med do/ /tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas kun tu 'grus par mdzad pa'i stobs kyis ljags bsnyen gyi grangs kyang / dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i dus kye rdo rje'i gzhi bsnyen mthar phyin par mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang 'khor lo bde mchog rdo rje phur pa dang / 'jigs byed/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo/ 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po/ gu ru drag dmar/ 'jam dpal nag po/ seng gdong ma/ ku ru kul+le/ khyung nag tshogs bdag sogs mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsol ba'i yi dam gyi lha bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang /

rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po/ gnyan mgon chen po zhal bzhi pa sogs bstan srung mang po'i gsang sngags zab mo'i grangs dang dus kyi bsnyen pa gdan thog gcig tu nyams bzhes mdzad pa'i stobs kyis/ de dag so so la mtshan ma'i bsnyen rtags ngo mtshar can du ma byung snang ba ni 'og tu 'chad la/ yang rgyun gyi bsnyen pa mdzad pa'i grangs ni/ mgon po'i yi ge bdun ma bye ba gnyis tsam/ yi ge bcu gnyis ma dang / sha sa na 'bum phrag du ma/ dpal mgon zhal gyi sngags ring thung rnams dang / mgon po'i las mkhan gyi bod rbad rnams kyang 'bum phrag mang po dang / gzhan yang gong du bkod pa'i yi dam gyi lha rnams so so la nyung mtha' yang sngags ring thung ci rigs la bsnyen tshad 'bru 'bum ma song ba ni gtan med la/ sngags ring rnams kyang 'bum phrag mang du 'dren par mdzad pa dang / gzhan la yon bzang po gnang nas bsnyen pa byed du bcug pa yang / rnal 'byor ma'i oṃ gsum ma bye ba bcu phrag gsum/ thugs rje chen po yi ge drug pa dung phyur bcu phrag gnyis su zung gis lhag pa dang / rnam rgyal gyi gzungs ring dang / tshe gzungs sogs kyang 'bum phrag mtha' yas so/ /yang gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi sgo rum sogs bstan srung gi dbang po gur gyi mgon po la sogs pa mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i mgon khang khyad par can rnams su rje nyid 'khor rig pa 'dzin pa mang po dang bcas pas thugs dam bskang ba 'phar du mdzad pa rnams kyi tshe/ sha sa na/ zhal bzhi pa/ pu tra gsum gyi sngags bsngo da lta yan la khri phrag bzhi dang / stong phrag bdun/ chos skyong so so'i bskang ba yang khri tshar mang po/ dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang khyad par can dag tu bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brten nas maṇ+ḍal gsol 'debs/ smon lam rnams 'bum phrag gcig dang / rje nyid kyi gzim chung rten gyi drung du yang de mtshungs/ bzang po spyod pa smon lam gyi rgyal po rgyun gyi zhal 'don mdzad pa dgung lo lnga bcu yan la khri stong drug brgya/

gzhan la yon gnang nas bzang spyod 'bum ther kha re/ sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya zhal 'don mdzad pa khri phrag du ma/ gzhan la yon gnang nas sdig bshags kyi smon lam rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i tshigs bcad 'bum ther sogs mdor na rje nyid kyis zhal 'don mdzad pa dang / gzhan byed du bcug pa'i sgo nas sngags bzlas pa dang / bshags pa smon lam sogs kyi grangs zhib tu bkod na bsam gyis mi khyab cing / de bzhin du rje btsun gang gi gzim chung rten mchod/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa'i zhabs kyi sku brnyan/ sa la dbang phyug grags kyis bzhengs pa la rje btsun chen pos phyag nas mdzad pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po dang / slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo gnyis kyi bris sku la de gnyis sogs kyi phyag nas ma/ bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i sku brnyan/ de nyid kyi sdom phrug skyob pa dpal bzang pos bzhengs pa la chos rje nyid kyis phyag nas mdzad pa/ rje nyid kyi phyag tu byung nas ring bsrel byon pa de nyid dang / 'phags pa rin po che'i sku brnyan hor sku dngul las grub pa la 'phags pa nyid kyis phyag nas ma ste/ rje btsun gong ma lnga car gyi bris 'bur phyag nas ma de dag dang / gzhan yang slob dpon pad+ma'i sku tshab gter lnga'i nang tshan bye ma a krong las rang byon slob dpon nyid kyi phyag nas ma ring bsrel 'byon bzhin pa rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i bla ma gong ma mang po'i sku brnyan bla ma so so'i phyag nas brgya tshar sogs mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs pa rnams dang / li ma lha khang / rgya nag lha khang / dpe khang chos mdzod chen mo dang bcas pa'i rten rnams da lta yan chad du zhabs bskor 'bum ther gnyis lhag tsam dang / gzhan skor ba byed du gzhug pa yang mang du mdzad do/ /de ltar bdag nyid chen po 'dis ni gong du bkod pa ltar mkhas shing grub brnyes kyi yongs 'dzin mang po'i zhal gyi phyogs brgya las nye bar 'ongs pa'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi 'bab ldan ma'i rgyun bzang po zab cing yangs pa'i rnam par dpyod pa'i chu gter chen por rnam pa gcig tsam yin par brgya phrag mang po legs par 'bab cing 'khyil ba dang /

de dag gi zab don rmad du byung ba dag kyang gang gi dgongs mtsho'i chab dang ro gcig tu bsre ba'i thabs mchog mnyam par bzhag pa dang rjes las thob pa'i rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i legs byas thugs nyams su bstar ba las/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan rin po che'i 'byung khungs nyid du gyur ba'i dge mtshan rlabs kyi 'phreng ba ci yang zhig mdzes par g.yo ba nyid de/ de yang mkhas pa'i yon tan ji ltar mnga' ba'i tshul ni/ 'jam mgon sa paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos/ mkhas gang shes bya'i de kho na/ /ji bzhin rtogs pa yin par 'dod/ /ces rnam mang shes bya'i gzugs ji snyed pa blo gros gsal ba'i me long gi ngos yangs por skad cig pa'i dus sogs la 'gog med du shar bas/ 'os su gyur pa mtha' yas pa'i blo gros kyi mig la legs byas kyi gzigs mo gsal por ston nus pa de la mkhas pa zhes snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis bod rigs la/ de yang / de yul brda sprod rtog ge dang / /'tsho ba phyi nang rig ces bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mkhas par bya ba'i yul ni/ rig pa'i gnas lnga zhes dpyod ldan bzang po'i skal ba can dag la ming tsam gyis kyang yid la sim pa ster zhing rna ba'i bcud len du 'gyur ba gang dag yin pa las/ phyi rig pa'i gnas bzhi ni/ dam pa 'dis lan re zung rer gsan te/ de dang de'i gzhung lugs rnams la mkhyen pa'i spyan ras lhung pa tsam mam rtog dpyod mdzad pa tsam gyis ji bzhin du rtogs par 'gyur ba zhig yin pa las/ de dag ci rigs pa ston pa'i gsung rab ngo mtshar can 'ga' zhig snang ba yang 'og tu mkhas pa'i bgyi ba mdzad pa'i skabs las shes shing / bzo rig pa ni/ rje 'dis ri mo sogs sbyang ba'i 'bad pa gtan nas ma mdzad kyang / sku gzhon nu'i dus chos rje sa paṇ+ḍi ta dang / 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo bsod nams dbang po sogs kyi bris sku phyag bris ma rnams dang / dpal sa skya'i bla brang rdzong chung gi ldebs bris la/

sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba'i thugs dam ma ye shes bzhugs nges pa'i gur gyi mgon po'i bris sku zhig yod pa de'i sku tshab tu phyag bris mdzad pa de dang / de bri ba'i sngon du phyag sbyong la bzhengs pa bla brang rig 'dzin pho brang gi yang steng na gur mgon gyi sku gyang ris su yod pa dang / pu tra chen po'i sku brnyan ras gzhi la phyag bris mdzad nas/ nyid kyi zhabs 'bring pa chen po dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rab 'byams smra ba byams pa bsod nams 'od zer bar gtor bsngo'i rten du gnang ba sogs ni/ deng sang gi lha bris pa mkhas par grags pa sus kyang bskrun par mi nus so/ /khyad par du rig gnas lnga pa nang don rig pa la/ nang rig theg pa gsum du grags shing grub/ /ces pa ltar brjod bya theg pa gsum dang / rjod byed sde snod rin po che gsum mam dri ma med pa'i rgyud sde bzhi rnams las/ sde snod gsum po dag gi grub pa'i mtha' 'dzin pa po la/ sangs rgyas pa la bzhi pa dang / /lnga pa thub pa'i dgongs pa min/ /zhes pa ltar/ sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' khas len pa bye brag tu smra ba/ mdo sde pa/ sems tsam pa/ dbu ma pa ste bzhi po so so dang theg pa che chung gnyis kyi khyad par la/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam par gzhag pa mi 'dra ba'i tshul mtha' yas pa rnams la/ rnal 'byor pa yang blo khyad kyis/ /gong ma gong ma rnams kyis gnod/ /ces pa'i tshul gyis grub mtha' 'og ma dag las gong ma rnams rim gyis khyad par du 'phags pa sogs thun mong ba rnams mi 'gal zhing / thun mong ma yin pa ma 'dres pa'i gnad phyin ci ma log pa thugs su chud pa'i stobs kyis gdul bya la 'doms pa dang / bstan bcos su rtsom pa sogs gang la yang thogs med kyi spobs pa mnga' ba'i tshul yang / rje 'dis rgyud kyi bshad bka'/ man ngag gi zab khrid sogs kyi tshe sngon 'gro tshul bzhi'i nang nas mngon par rtogs pa spyod pa rim pa can dang /

lta ba rim pa can la/ bslab dgos pa ston pa'i skabs dang / gsung rab rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i sngon 'gro snang ba gsum gyi khrid kyi dus sogs sde snod gtso bor gyur pa'i gsung chos gnang ba rnams la bshad bya sde snod dam grub mtha' bzhi po gang yin pa de dang de nyid kyi tshig rna bar snyan cing brjid la zur thon pa dang / don go bde zhing chod che la tshig don 'brel mtshungs pa/ dka' ba'i gnas la dpyis phyin cing shin tu gsal ba'i sgo nas nyan pa po so so'i blo dang 'tshams par bstan pas/ mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal nas blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas par mdzad pa la shin tu mkhas pas na/ dam pa 'di ni deng sang sde snod 'dzin par grags pa phal mo che bzhin thal 'phreng 'phen len gyi tshul tsam la sde snod kyi gzhung bzang 'chad pa'i dga' ston du re ba'i ring lugs las ches khyad par du 'phags pa/ sde snod rgya mtsho'i klong na nye bar rtsen pa'i bslab gsum dbang gi rgyal po'i gdengs can dgos don/ bsdus don/ tshig don/ mtshams sbyar/ brgal lan lnga'i legs bshad kyi phud sgra dal bur sgrog pa'i mtshungs pa med pa'i sde snod 'chang ba'i klu'i dbang po yin par rtogs par bya zhing / de'i tshul rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i kye rdor rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa'i don 'grel khog phub rgyud 'grel sgo brgya'i lde mig dang / tshul bzhis sngon du 'gro ba dang bcas pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi tshig 'grel rgyud bshad bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed sogs su sde snod gsum gyi de kho na nyid tshul bzhin du bshad pa dag las kyang rje 'di sde snod 'chang ba'i dbang po yin par rjes su dpag par nus pa yin no/ /yang dri ma med pa'i rgyud sde bzhi la mkhas pa'i tshul ni/ spyir rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyi yab chos bde kye gsang gsum yo ga bya spyod dang bcas pa'i rgyud rgya gzhung /

'grel bshad/ dbang khrid/ man ngag zhar byung phyag len phra mo tshun chad la'ang mkhas pa'i mchog yin par mkhas shing mkhas par grags pa'i sa skyong chen po rnams dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po dang / rnam dpyod kyi lus zungs brtas shing gzur gnas kyi bzhin ras mdzes pa/ dad gus kyi 'dren byed gsal ba'i skye bo'i paṇ+ḍi ta mang po dang bcas pas gcig tu 'dzin pa zhig yin pa dang / bye brag tu bla med kyi rgyud sde sgo gsum las phye ba'i rgyud sde gsum/ ma rgyud sgo drug gnyis med rnam gnyis sogs bla med kyi rgyud sde mtha' dag la mkhas pa'i phul du byung ba'i stobs kyis/ de dag phal cher la ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i legs bshad kyi bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad cing / 'chad nyan kyi sgo nas kyang gtan la 'bebs par mdzad pas/ phyis kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang ldan pa mang po'i thugs kyi bum bzang legs bshad kyi bdud rtsis 'gengs par mdzad pa yin te/ de yang dper mtshon na rje nyid kyis zab chos mang du gsan pa'i bla ma mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa de nyid spyir mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i shes bya kun la mkhas pa'i dbang phyug chen po zhig yin mod kyang / rje btsun dam pa 'di dang ma mjal bar du pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor la gsan rgya yang ha cang mi che zhing / de bzhin du 'di skor la rnam dpyod kyi spyan ras kyang cung zad mi gsal ba zhig tu snang na yang / bdag cag gi rnam 'dren mtshungs pa med pa 'dis/ mkhan chen mkhas pa'i dbang po de la gsang ba 'dus pa'i rim lnga'i khrid sogs chos tshul mang po zhig stsol bar mdzad pa'i mthu las mkhas pa'i dbang po de nyid dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor la yang mchog tu mkhas par gyur te/ phyis su gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang bka' gsar rnying gi dogs dpyod blo gsal nyer mkho'i legs bshad ya rab mkhas pa'i gtam skyes zhes bya ba'i gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dbang bka' gsar rnying gi shan 'byed dang /

gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos kyi byung tshul dang / bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len 'gos lugs gtsang ma yid 'phrog lha'i rol mo zhes bya ba la sogs pa legs par bshad pa yang mang du rtsom par mdzad la/ de ltar mkhan chen mkhas pa'i dbang po de nyid kyi gsang ba 'dus pa la bstan bcos rtsom pa'i spobs pa dge ba can de yang 'jam mgon bla ma 'dis 'di skor gyi chos kyi dga' ston rma med par stsal pa'i legs byas las byung ba yin te/ mkhan chen nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len ston pa'i yi ge yid 'phrog lha'i rol mo las/ thub bstan yongs 'du'i chu gter rgyas pa'i gnyen/ /yongs 'dzin zla ba dkar po'i thig 'phreng gis/ /bdag blo'i ku mud 'dab brgya lan brgyar bzhad/ /lugs 'dir blo gros gsal ba'i mig bu phye/ /zhes dang / yongs 'dzin zla ba dkar po zhes pa la dpal sa skya pa zhes mchan bu 'debs par mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang mkhan chen des mdzad pa'i yi ge gnyis kyi sbyar byang du yang / de ltar dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa'i dbang bka' gsar rnying la dogs dpyod kyi yi ge 'di yang / dpal sa skya pa mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bka' drin las lam srol 'dir blo mig cung zad gsal ba dang dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis sa pho 'brug gi lo'i zla ba bdun pa'i yar tshes bcu gnyis la brgyud 'dzin mang mkhar ba blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas dgon gsar bde ba can gyi gtsug lag khang du legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chos grags bzang po'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / de ltar dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len yid 'phrog lha'i rol mo zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dpal sa skya pa mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bka'i gnang ba thob pa dang /

rang nyid kyang lugs 'dir blo mig cung zad gsal bar 'dod pas yongs 'dzin bla ma rnams kyi bran du gyur pa dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis bla ma gong ma'i chos 'byung / bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad/ rim lnga'i khrid yig rnams dang / de dag gi rgyab rten sngar smos pa rnams la gzhi brten cing / khyad par sa skya'i 'jam dbyangs bla ma nyid kyi gsung rgyun legs bshad rnams yid yul du 'jags par byas nas kha brgyan te/ sa pho 'brug gi lo'i chu stod zla ba'i yar ngo'i bcu bzhi la mang mkhar dgon gsar thub bstan bde ba can gyi gtsug lag khang du legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni/ chos grags bzang po'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /tshul de lta bu ni 'dod chags can rjes su 'dzin pa'i phyir gsungs pa pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa la mkhas pa'i tshul mdo tsam yin la/ des mtshon nas gzhan la yang shes par bya zhing / mdor na dam pa 'di ni rgyud sde spyi'i dbang / rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis/ de'i steng du dar+pan ā tsar+yas lhag por bkral ba'i dge legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum ste bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'i dbang / ngan song sbyong rgyud nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang rnams dang / bye brag la bsam gyis mi khyab kyang yang phur gyi dbang / gur drag gi dbang rigs mang po sogs rnying ma dang / gsar ma la gtso bor gyur pa bde mchog lū nag dril gsum/ kye rdor bka' bab bzhi/ gsang 'dus rigs gsum/ gshin rje gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum sogs dbang gi rigs bgrang bar dka' ba zhig gsan par mdzad cing / gsan pa de dag kyang gzhan la tshul bzhin du bskur ba la thogs pa mi mnga' zhing / de bzhin du khrid bka' mang po/ rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i byin rlabs dang rjes gnang gi rigs sogs ni don du gnyer ba byung na nam yang 'bad med du so so'i rten gzhi'i rgyud dang /

rgya gzhung che chung / bod gzhung mang po sogs dang bcas bka' bab ji ltar yod dang / so so'i byung tshul sogs chos kyi rtsa ba rtsad chod pa'i legs bshad rmad du byung ba/ dka' ba'i gnas rnams dpyis ma phyin gyi bar du 'dom nus pas/ dpyod ldan gyi gang zag rnams kyis gzhung lugs dri ma med pa'i tshig don gyi cha rtogs dka' ba'i gnas su gyur pa rnams la zhus shing brtsad pa na/ lung rigs yang dag pa dang mthun pa'i legs bshad kyi 'od brgya spros te/ gzhan dag gi ma rtogs log rtog the tshom gyi mun pa stug po drungs nas phyung ba la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa'i spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa mnga' bas/ gzhan du lo zlar nyan pa bas rje btsan 'di'i drung du go re len gyi sgo nas gsung gi zegs ma zin pa tsam yang chos kyi khong khrol ba la phan zhing blo la 'jags che bar 'ong ba ni myong bas grub cing / zhabs drung du yun ring du bsti ba'i blo gros can dag gi thugs mtshor yang gsal ba yin no/ /yang btsun pa'i yon tan ji ltar mnga' ba ni/ 'jam mgon bla ma dam pa 'di ni sku'i 'khrungs rabs mang po dag tu goms pa'i shugs kyis sku gsung thugs kyi dbang po rang bzhin gyis nye bar zhi zhing dul la brtan pas rang bzhin dang bcas pa'i na kha ma tho ba cung zad tsam gyis kyang ma gos pa'i sdom pa gsum gyis thugs rgyud legs par gtams shing / legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad phyin chad nas/ dgos pa khyad par can gyi ched du bslab pa de dag 'bul ba'i cho ga ma mdzad kyi bar du nyes byas phra mo tsam yang khyad du mi gsod cing tshul 'chos la sogs pa'i dri ma tsam yang mi dku bar/ dgag sgrub gnang gsum gyi bslab par bya ba phra zhing ches phra ba dag la'ang blang dor tshul bzhin mdzad pas nyes ltung cha tsam yang mi mnga' la/ mdor na bzhugs lugs mi mdzes pa'am bla gos bzhes tshul mi legs pa tsam yang mdzad ma myong bas sku gsung thugs shin tu btsun pa'i mchog tu gyur pa 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po rnams dang mtshungs pa zhig yin la/

yang byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis ni/ sku skye ba'i 'phreng ba mang por goms par mdzad pa'i stobs kyis 'khrungs ma thag nas rang chas su mnga' zhing / bye brag tu theg chen thun mong ba'i cho ga dbu ma lugs dang / rdo rje theg pa thun mong ma yin pa dbang gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga gnyis las/ byang sems kyi sdom pa nod par mdzad phyin chad nas/ byang sems kyi sdom pa la ltos pa'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi nyes ltung phra mo tsam gyis kyang ma gos par bslab bya mtha' dag nyams med du slob pa'i sgo nas pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i sgo nas bstan pa rin po che 'phel rgyas kyi bgyi ba dang / mtha' yas pa'i sems can la phan pa dang / bde ba'i thabs 'ba' zhig las/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi sgo nas rang don kho na'i 'khri ba mdzad pa ni ci yang mi snang bas bdag pas gzhan gces kyis thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po'i ngang tshul 'dzin pa zhig dang / khyad par du zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po rnams su zhugs te rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi sdom pa thob phyin chad rtsa ba dang yan lag gi ltung ba gang gis kyang nam yang ma gos shing / lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba dam tshig dang sdom pa nyid yin par dgongs nas mnyam rjes dang / bza' bsrung mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig gi rnam pa la nan tan du mdzad cing / de'i ring la bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum zung du 'brel ba'i sgo nas bla ma gong ma rnams kyi dus dran gyi mchod 'bul gsang sngags zab mo'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod/ dri ma med pa'i rgyud 'don bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga sogs dang / gzhan yang dpal sa skya'i bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi phyir lugs gnyis kyi mdzad 'phrin mtha' yas pa dag la lhod pa skad cig kyang mi za bar rtag 'grus su mdzad pa yin no/

/yang bzang po'i yon tan mnga' ba'i tshul ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'di ni rang nyid srid zhis bsdus pa'i phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan thams cad dang ldan zhing che dgu kun gyi bla nar bskur yang rgyags pa dang dregs pa nam yang mi mnga' zhing / mngon par khengs pa'i mdud pa thams cad bkrol te/ zhi dul 'jam des kyi rang bzhin du gnas pas/ skye bo su zhig la yang ches chod res bor gyi khengs pa'i tshig ye mi gsungs/ gzhan dag khengs nyams can gyi snyems tshig smra ba gsan na/ gang zag de bslab sbyang gi yon tan can yin na yang gzhan la tho 'tshams dang phrag dog gi rnam pa 'di bzhin yon tan yod kyang sdug pa 'dra gsungs shing thugs khrel nyams kho na dang / rang nyid de rigs cung zad kyang mi mdzad/ lta grub tha dad pa'i chos lugs 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa su zhig la yang dad gus dang dag snang 'ba' zhig gis rnam thar legs phyogs nyid las/ skyon brjod kyi rigs gtan nas mi gsungs/ zhal nas kyang sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa de nyid gang zag la dag snang sbyong / grub mtha' la brtag dpyad gyis bya ba yin/ dad gus 'di mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba gcig dgos zhes yang yang gsung ba zhig yod 'dug sa lo'i rnam thar rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i nang na de bzhin gsungs yod/ nged kyi bla ma rgyal ba mus pa chen po des kyang / rje rang gi dbon po 'ga' zhig gis/ shar chen kun dga' bkra shis la gzhan yag po yin kyang / 'jig rten pher grags tsam yod pa 'dra zhus pa la yang / a khong 'jig rten pher grags nas khyod byed pa bzhin mdzad 'dug gam/ ngor bla brang 'dzin dgos phyir/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag tshogs 'phral gyi kha 'dzin tsam mi dgos pa yin nam gsungs pa sogs shin tu bka' bkyon pa mdzad cing / gang zag dam pa su 'dra zhig la yang dad mos rang mdzad pa zhig yod/ rang re rnams kyang de ni byed dgos pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa ni yang yang thos la/
