nyid kyi yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams la ni bcos ma ma yin pa'i dad gus chen pos rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bor dgongs shing / zhal bzhugs pa'i dus su rnyed pa dang bkur bsti dang / tshigs su bcad pa la sogs pa ri mor bya ba'i sgo nas bstod pa dang bsngags pa sogs kyis kyang bsten cing / mnyes thabs du mas mnyes par mdzad pa dang / gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus nas kyang thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i thabs 'phrul du ma dang / dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul ba sogs la shin tu brtson zhing spro ba kho na mdzad pas/ sgrub mchod re grol re bzhin/ da lam gyi sgrub mchod 'di shin tu 'grig cing dag snang che ba byung / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras dang / dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul ba'i bla ma gang yin de'i mtshan nas brjod de/ bla ma 'di zhes bya ba'i thugs dgongs rdzogs yod/ skal ba bzang zhes gsungs shing / thugs dgyes nyams shin tu che ba dang / yang sgrub mchod de cung zad tshogs pa dag gi zhal 'don ma 'grig pa lta bu byung na/ thugs mi bde ba'i nyams mi bzod pa lta bu mdzad la/ gzhan yang sde snod 'dzin pa chen po rnams la bkur bsti dang bdag rkyen gzhan las che ba gnang ste/ tha na dge bshes kyi mtshan rab 'byams par ming btags pa tshun chad la skabs su bab pa'i zhe sa dang / dgyes dgyes mdzad/ rgyun du dgyes nyams dang zhal mdangs 'dzum pas/ skye bo su zhig zhabs drung du lhags na yang / bdag la dgyes par 'dug snyam pa 'byung zhing / gzhan du sems 'khrugs pa yang zhabs drung du slebs pa tsam gyis zhi mal gyis 'gro/ skye bo tha mal pa shin tu khro gtum chen po zhig yin na yang / dam pa 'dis chos sam 'jig rten gyi bka' mchid cung zad gnang ba tsam gyis khro ba zhi nas dad gus dang ldan par 'gyur ba la sogs pa bzang po'i yon tan rmad du byung ba thugs rgyud la mnga' ba'i dge mtshan bsam gyis mi khyab bo/

/don de la 'di skad smra ste/ tshul khrims chu shel dkyil 'khor nya gang zhing / /thos bsam gser ri'i spo la chibs nas kyang / /legs bshad bsil zer ga bur thigs 'phreng gis/ /don gnyer blo yi ku mud bzhad pa dang / /rmongs pa'i smag rum cha tsam 'phrog nus pa/ /chabs cig 'byung ba tshul gnas thos bsam gyi/ /mtshan mo'i mgon der bsngags mod de ltar na'ang / /thos don sgom pa'i nyin byed ma shar na/ /rang blo kun rtog mig sman drungs 'byin dang / /rtog bral chu skyes 'dab brgya rgod pa gnyis/ /lhan cig byed pa'i dpal mgon gzhan med snyam/ /zab lam nyams su bstar ba'i nyin mor byed/ /khyod thugs kun gsal dbyings su gzi 'bar ba/ /nyams bzhes khrigs kyi lhag bsam dri bzhon dang / /brtson pa'i rta bdun shugs kyis la gor drangs/ /de phyir mgon 'dis rim gnyis zab mo'i lam/ /thugs nyams bstar ba'i khur chen lta ga la/ /klog dang skor ba zhal 'don phyag sogs kyi/ /khres po'ang snying stobs phrag par 'degs nus su/ /pha rgyud lam gyi bcud kun 'dus pa'i dpyid/ /klu sgrub bud+dha dz+nyā na las 'ongs pa'i/ /rim lnga'i zab khrid sprin gyi me tog char/ /mkhas dbang thugs kyi 'dzin mar legs phab pas/ /blo gros rab gsal 'khri shing rgyas pa'i rtser/ /legs bshad gsar pa'i 'dab 'phreng me tog rgod/ /bstan 'gror phan bde'i 'bras bu g.yur du za/ /e ma sngon med ljon pa 'di bskrun no/ /khyod ni rgyal kun mkhyen gzugs 'jam dpal dang / /gnyis su med pas srid zhi'i phun tshogs kun/ /rang gir mdzad pa'i sngon mtha' mi dmigs kyang / /de slad brtson 'di rgyal ba'i rdzun min nam/ /de lta mod kyi mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi/ /bcud kyis yongs gtams mgul 'ching bla gos gyis/ /mdzes sku nyer bklubs dbu skyes sku sha yis/ /spud pas rig 'dzin bum par 'gal med de/ /rgyal rnams 'gro ba'i duḥkha bsal slad du/

/mchog dang mchog min sprul pa'i zlos gar ni/ /gdul bya'i blo gros mig bu dang 'tshams par/ /sna tshogs 'char ba'i rnam 'phrul su yis 'gog /'on kyang thun mong blo mtshor snang ba yang / /bgrang yas shes bya'i de nyid gzigs pas mkhas/ /nyes ltung phra mo tsam gyis ma gos btsun/ /zol zog dri mas dben phyir bzang po'i dpyid/ /sngon goms legs byas rin chen bzhi'i rang bzhin/ /che dgu'i ri mtsho'i dbus na mngon mtho yang / /khengs dregs rgyags pas mi g.yo zhi dang dul/ /'jam des rin chen spungs pa ri'i lhun po/ /dug gsum sbrul ngan 'grogs pa dang bral zhing / /rmad byung yon tan rin chen mngar ba'i ros/ /gang ba'i chos 'phongs re bskong rin po che/ /'byung ba'i gnas 'di sngon med chu gter yin/ /de lta'i mkhas btsun bzang 'khyil yongs 'dzin chos kyi mtsho/ /mtsho rlabs 'phreng ba rigs sras bye bas nyer mdzes zhing / /zhing 'dir gsung skyes chu bya 'bum phrag bye ba yang / /yang dag chos kyi mgrin rnga sgrogs pas brel gyur cig /gcig tu mgon 'di dad pa'i blo skad cig /skye la'ang mgon po'i byin rlabs snying dbus skye/ /de phyir mgon med duḥkhas gzir gang de/ /skyob pa'i mgon la dad bskyed kun tu skyob/ /'di la blo yi me long ngos/ /'di min 'khyog po'i ri mo gzhan/ /'di sogs kun tu 'bri mi 'tshal/ /'di ko bden rdzun brtags pas shes/ /shes ldan tshul de mthong ba'i mig /mig gcig ar+ya de wa bzhin/ /bzhin bzang mig stong pa las lhag /lhag bsam dag pas de ltar mthong / /bdag kyang deng nas thar pa'i grong khyer cher/ /ma phyin de srid skye ba'i 'phreng ba kun/ /khyed kyi gsung rab snyan cing sku'i rgyal mtshan/ /blta dang thugs rje'i dpal gyis 'tsho bar shog/ ༈ //spyi don drug pa de'i stobs kyis bla ma yi dam sogs kyis thugs rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing lung bstan gyi bdud rtsi brnyes pa sogs legs byas kyi dge mtshan ji ltar mnga' ba'i tshul ni/

de ltar bdag cag gi skyabs mgon mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan ma lus pa'i mnga' bdag chen po 'dis bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam bsgom gsum zung du 'brel ba nyid chos la gnas pa yin gyi/ de dag phyogs re ba tsam gyis min zhing / thos pa dang bsam pa la ma brten par sgom pa 'ba' zhig la 'jug pa de yang / chos la gnas pa ma yin par dgongs nas/ thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son nas bsam byung rigs pas sgro 'dogs bcad de/ zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin la bcud len mdzad pa'i phyir du gzhan dang mi mnyam pa'i brtson 'grus dang brtul zhugs drag pos nyin zhag phrugs re la gong du bkod pa ltar gyi nyams bzhes kyi rim pa dag la dus rtag tu gzhol bar mdzad pa dang thog ma med pa'i dus nas legs byas la gcig tu goms pa'i mthus bla ma dang yi dam gyi tshogs mang pos nyams dang mtshan lam sogs ci rigs par zhal gzigs te lung bstan dbugs dbyung ba dang / zab mo'i chos kyang mang du stsol bar mdzad pa yin te/ de yang rje 'di dgung lo bcu bzhi pa'i dus thugs nyams gsal ba zhig la dpal sa skya'i shar phyogs kyi ri grwa chung gong gar grags pa'i rtse mor rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan bir+wa pa nyid sku shin tu che zhing brjid chags pa phyag gnyis chos 'chad dang zhabs skyil krung / zhabs pus g.yas ri'i phag tu song nas mi mngon pa/ mdzes shing yid du 'ongs pa'i 'ja' sngon po'i 'od skor la sku rgyab brten te/ gdan sa phyogs su zhal gzigs nas bzhugs pa shin tu gsal bar gzigs shing / de lta bu'i gzigs snang khyad par can de nyid kyi bkod pa phyis su rje nyid kyis nyams gso gsar bzhengs dang 'dra ba mdzad pa'i bzhi thog bla brang gi tshoms dmar gyi gzhu ring sogs la ri mor mdzad pa 'di yin par snang zhing / de dus mtshan ltas ngo mtshar can de byung ba rjes su rje nyid dgung lo bco brgyad du phebs pa'i tshe rje btsun mus pa chen po la gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa zab mo gsan pa'i skabs thugs yul du dran nas rnal 'byor dbang phyug de nyid la thugs dad pa dang /

rang nyid la zhal gyi dkyil 'khor gzigs pa'i tshul la dga' ba/ bi rū'i zhal gyi gdams pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma las dngos su nos te gzhan dag la tshul bzhin du 'dom zhing thugs nyams su bzhes pa sogs la mchog tu spro ba gsum phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du gyur pa na/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug la bstod pa 'phags mchog mar grags pa de mdzad de/ de nyid las/ 'phags mchog yon tan du ma 'byung ba'i gnas/ /nā len+d+ra dang chos mtshungs gdan sa cher/ /rang lo brgyad gnyis gnyis kyis ma lon pa'i/ /dus der shar ri'i rtse la bir+wa'i sku/ /rab brjid skyil krung chos 'chad phyag rgya can/ /rab mdzes sngon po'i 'od la rgyab brten pa/ /rab gsal dbang po'i dwangs ma'i sgo ru shar/ /rab dga' la sogs mthar phyin de la 'dud/ /ces 'byung ba yin zhing / tshul 'di ni bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po la rnal 'byor dbang phyug gtso 'khor lnga dam chos sgo skyel gyi tshul du byon nas rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis sogs zab rgyas kyi chos tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa stsal pa na/ bla chen nyid kyang thugs rangs par gyur nas/ a la la te lhan cig spros bral las/ /zhes sogs kyi bstod pa mdzad pa dang / tshul mtshungs pas ches rmad du byung ba'i rnam par thar par snang zhing / mtshan lam de rje btsun mus chen la zhu ba gnang 'dug dus/ mus chen de nyid kyang phyag thal mo sbyar te a pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis dngos su byin gyis brlabs par gda' ba shin tu ngo mtshar che/ /zhes gsungs gin 'dug ces rje nyid kyi gsung las dngos su thos nas/ don rgyan so lnga'i dpe rgyan brgyad pa phul byung gi dpe'i dper brjod la/ brtse chen bla mas bzhi yi 'khor dang bcas/ /bi rū rab brjid mtshan dpe 'bar bar gzigs/ /khyod kyi 'jigs bral 'khor tshogs kyis dben kyang / /nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi ldan gsal bar ro/ /'di gcig kho nas khyod dang bla chen de/

/tha dad nyid du rtog gi khyad par gzhan/ /kun gsal dbyings kyi gdams skyes ge sar bzhin/ /zhes bstod pa yin no/ /gzhan yang rje nyid dgung lo nyi shur phebs pa me pho 'brug gi lo gsung ngag gi gzhung bshad sogs la thos bsam gtso bor mdzad pa'i tshe/ lo de'i rgyal zla ba'i tshes gsum gyi tho rangs rje bla ma mus pa chen po nyid mngon sum lta bur byon pa nas/ zhabs drung khyod kyis gsung ngag lam 'bras kyi dpe gzigs dgos rnams da ci tsam song gsung ba na/ de'i lan du rje 'dis bdag bya brel mang ba nas sngar phan stobs chen rang ma song lags zhus pas/ da tshegs med sngar ci song rnams la bsgrags skyong mdzad dgos gsung ba byung bas/ mnal sad pa na/ kho bo bya brel gyi dbang las dpe 'dzin skyong cung zad lhod par gyur pa la/ rje bla mas bskul ma mdzad par gor ma chag snyam du dgongs pa 'khrungs/ yang dam pa 'di nyid la bi rū pas zhal bstan pa'i lo de'i rjes tsam gyis dus gcig la mnal lam du/ mi 'ga' zhig gis rje 'di la/ sa skya pa chen po gzigs bzhed na rin chen sgang gi rgyab na yod zhu ba la/ ma mjal dogs pa'i thugs shin tu rings stabs kyis phebs dgongs pa na mnal sad pas/ sa chen dang mjal khad par ma mjal ba de shin tu phangs pa zhig byung / 'on kyang sa chen rin chen sgang gi rgyab na bzhugs zer ba de/ nged rang sa chen 'dra ba'i sa skya pa'i bstan pa 'dzin dka' ba'i skabs su zin mi chung tsam byung ba 'di dang / da lta nged rang gi skabs 'dir sa skya pa rang la gur gyi mgon po'i sku brnyan khyad par can bzhi rgya gar nas byon pa rnams kyang tshang bar bzhugs shing / gzhan yang chos skyong dang yi dam bla ma sogs kyi sku brnyan byin rlabs can bsam gyis mi khyab pa phyis nged rang gi lag tu byung ba 'di rnams dang / zang zing gi dngos spyad rin po che sna tshogs dang gos dar sogs 'bad med du 'dzom chen po byung ba 'di rnams la lta ba 'dra/

zhes phyis su rje nyid kyi zhal las dngos su thos la/ yang rje 'dis rje gong ma lnga la bstod pa pad+ma rā ga'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba skabs lnga yod pa 'di'i 'phags pa rin po che la bstod pa'i tshigs bcad dang po yan chad rtsom pa mdzad grub pa'i nub mo mtshan lam du bzhi thog bla brang gi tshoms dmar na/ rje nyid gong ma rnams dang mnyam 'grogs kyi tshul du yang bzhugs pa la gong ma rnams la dad gus chen po yang zhu ba/ de dag gis kyang rje nyid la thugs dgyes pa'i nyams dpag tu med pa mdzad pa zhig byung snang ba ni/ dam pa 'dis gong ma lnga la bstod pa de lta bu mdzad pas/ de dag gi ye shes gzigs pa'i byin rlabs stsal pa'i mtshan ma yang dag par snang bas/ gang zag dam pa rnams la bstod pa tsam gyis chos skyong 'grub pa dang / khyad par 'o skol gyi ston pas sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung la snyan ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa'i bstod pas tshogs mang po 'dum par bshad pa dang tshul mtshungs pa yin no/ /yang nyid kyi lcam rje btsun ngag dbang chos kyi nyi ma zhing gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs grub pa'i nub gcig dam pa gang gi gcen sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal nam mkhar phebs nas thugs shin tu dgyes pa'i tshul gyis rin chen sna bdun rgyan du mas spras pa cha du ma rje nyid la stob par mdzad pa na/ sku mdun du thams cad babs byung bas/ rje nyid kyang thugs dgyes nyams chen po mdzad pa'i mtshan ltas byung nas mnal sad pa na/ rje btsun ma de lha lta bur skyes pas/ nged la drin lan gyi tshul dang / snga mor rten 'brel cung zad ma 'grig pa'i rnam pas lcam du 'khrungs pa ma gtogs/ don la rje btsun ma de sku 'bring bde bar gshegs pa'i sku'i skye ba yin pa 'dra dgongs shing zhal nas kyang de ni gsungs la/ yang lan gcig mnal lam du sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa na bza' ser po bzhes pa zhig shin tu gsal bar byon pa la/

rje 'dis kyang dad mos chen po zhig mdzad pa'i ring la sa lo'i zhal nas/ nged kyis byas pa'i kye rdor rnam bshad kyi steng nas lam 'bras 'chad pa'i skabs bshad pa byed dgos gsungs pa la/ rje nyid cang mi zhu ba'i tshul du zhal gyis bzhes pa'i thugs snang zhig byung ba la mnal sad pa na/ sa los mdzad pa'i kye rdor rnam bshad ni med/ gang gi ltas yin nam dgongs pa 'khrungs/ phyis su gsung las/ snga mor nged la rmi lam de byung ba kye rdor sgrub mchod kyi skabs/ sgrub thabs sa lo'i 'di mdzad na sa lo chen po yang dgyes par 'gyur ba'i rtags su snang zhing gdan sa chen po 'dir skabs su yang de ka 'bab pa yong ba 'dug de bzhin du rnam rgyal gyi stong mchod kyang sa lo'i yi ge 'di yod phyin 'di steng nas byed pa 'os par snang yang / da cha bsgyur bkod byas na rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyang 'khrul med kyi gang zag sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam 'dren dam pa zhig yin pa nas mi legs pa 'dug ces kyang gsung ngo / /yang dam pa 'di la rgyal po ma skyes dgras sras kyi dod du bzhengs zer ba'i thub pa'i sku brnyan 'di nangs par 'bul mi 'byor rgyu'i nub mo/ sku gzugs kyi rnam pa mi 'dra ba'i thub dbang dngos yin dgongs pa zhig dang mjal nas de la dad gus chen po mdzad pa dang / 'di nyid la pad gdan phul dus sku 'di kho na li ma lha khang na bzhugs pa la rje nyid kyi phyag nas rgyas par mdzad pa zhig byung ba na/ sku 'di la mtshan grags dang mthun pa'i byin rlabs can yin nges su 'dug ces gsung zhing / yang lan gcig mnal lam du rje nyid dbu rtse'i 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba'i drung na phebs 'dug pa la/ 'jam dbyangs nyid rje 'di'i bstan pa la 'phel rgyas kyi mdzad 'phrin la thugs dgyes pa snyam mdzad pas 'jam dbyangs kyi zhal shin tu 'dzum pa'i nang nas 'bras dang nas mang po grul byung ba na/

rje nyid kyis bde ba can du skye na nas dang / mngon dgar skye na 'bras phob cig par smon lam zhus pas/ 'bras byung ba na mnal sad dus mngon dgar skye sla ba yod pa 'dra dgongs pa dang / de mthun chab tshan la phebs pa gcig gi tshe/ thub bstan dge 'phel gyi nye skor du phebs pa na/ chibs thog de kar sngar gyi mnal lam thugs la dran pa sogs rkyen 'ga' zhig la brten/ thugs snang la bde ba can las mngon dgar skye sla ba yod 'dra dgongs pa 'khrungs nas/ phyis su mngon dgar skye ba'i smon lam 'di mdzad pa yin snang bas/ smon lam gyi tshigs bcad 'di yang byin rlabs shin tu che bar 'khums shing / yang yos lo zhig gsar du shar ba'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i sa skya paṇa chen gyi lo dus kyi dus dran gyi mchod pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub mchod rje nyid kyis gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa de gnang grub pa'i tho rangs shig mnal lam du bdag nyid chen po rang sku 'khor rags bsdus shig dang bcas chos 'khor lha sa'i skor lam yin no dgongs pa zhig na zhabs skor mdzad kyin 'dug pa na/ de'i byang phyogs kyi ngos shig na skye tshang dang bcas pa'i chos rgyal lha sras mu khri btsan po'i sku phyag nas ma yin zer ba zhig 'dug pa la/ 'di sprul pa'i chos rgyal yin nges dgongs thugs dad chen pos dbu btsugs shing / phyag gis na bza' la 'jus nas smon lam btab pas/ na bza' de gos phrug sngon po 'jam po zhig 'dug cing / de nas sku de'i zhal dkyil la gzigs pas/ zhal 'dzum 'dzum gsung 'byon la khad 'dug pa la thugs spro ba chen pos/ bdag gi dge rtsa byas pa thams cad dag pa'i zhing du skye ba'i smon lam kho na btab yod pas/ bde ba can du skye'am mngon dgar skye lung bstan gnang dgos gsungs pas/ sku de'i zhal nas/ mngon dga' ru skye mngon dga' ru skye zhes nyis bstud du gsungs byung bas/ slar yang thugs dad cher g.yos nas sku de rje nyid kyi sku'i phrag gong g.yon du spyan drangs nas gtsug lag khang la zhabs skor zhig mdzad pas/

skor lam thams cad ban+dhe la lhus blangs pa'i skye bo mang pos gang 'dug cing / yang skor lam gyi byang ngos der phebs byung ba na sku 'dra skye tshang du bzhugs su gsol nas/ de dus zhabs drung na sngar rje 'di'i gsung rtsom gyi yig mkhan zhu ba'i gdong dga' ba bsam pa don chen yang drung na 'dug pa la/ nged kyis sku 'di la lung bstan mang po zhu dgos 'dug pas/ gang gsung thams cad khyod kyis sam+bho ṭa 'di la bris shig gsungs/ nyid kyi phyag nas saṃ ṭa zhig yig mkhan de la gnang grub mtshams glo bur du mnal sad byung bas/ thugs phangs pa la tshad med pa zhig byung gsungs pa 'di lta bu ni gong gi mtshan ltas dang thugs snang ngo mtshar can byung gsungs pa rnams dang sgo 'brel zhing / don la 'jam pa'i dbyangs sa skya paṇa chen nyid kyis sku'i tshe rabs mang por rjes su bzung zhing / sku'i skye ba phyi ma la yang shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du chos rje'i drung du thogs med du phebs pa la the tshom dang bral ba'i gtan tshigs yang dag par snang zhing / lha sras mu khri btsan pos lung bstan gyi tshul 'di yang rje 'di'i sku'i skyes rabs kyi 'phreng ba blon po mgar ba stong btsan de nyid lha sras kyi skye sprul yin par snga 'gyur gsang sngags rnying ma'i srol 'dzin gyi mkhas pa thams cad mgrin gcig tu sgrog cing grub pas rang snang ye shes kyi tshul du gsal bar gzigs pa'i ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul du ma'i zlos gar du gsal lo/ /gzhan yang rje btsun dam pa 'dis nai gu ma sogs kyi nyams bzhes kyang ched du gtad pa'i rgyun ring po mdzad pa ma gnang yang / de nas bshad pa'i rmi lam sbyong spel sogs kyi nyams rtogs ma lus pa thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa yin te/ de yang lan gcig rje 'di'i mnal lam du 'grig 'tshams phyogs kyi lhog pa na ring gi yul gnas 'dra ba zhig na bzhugs 'dug pa la/

de nas mtshan lam bzung nas gdan sa chen por phebs dgongs te nam mkha' la 'phur byon pa na/ nye skor de na khri shin tu mdzes shing yid du 'ongs pa zhig 'dug pa theg chen rin po che'i khri yin zer ba la dad gus chen po 'khrungs/ yang de 'phral mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i yin zer bas/ de'i steng du babs nas yun mi ring tsam zhig bzhugs par mdzad/ 'di ni sngon gyi 'khrungs rabs dang mthun pa'i thugs kyi dag snang du snang zhing / de nas yang sa skya phyogs su 'phur nas byon pas/ gdan sa chen po'i sa rtsi khra chem me ba gzigs pa na mnal sad/ yang lan cig mnal lam bzung nas ngam ring phyogs su 'phur te ngam ring gzhol gyi thad du phebs/ yang 'phur te rdzong nang gi rten rnams mjal/ yang chos sder 'phur nas byams khang du phebs pas byams pa'i zhal dkyil gser btso ma ltar shin tu dwangs pa gzigs/ byams pa dngos la yang 'di las lhag pa med dam dgongs pa 'khrungs pa dang / yang skabs shig mnal lam du rje nyid bar dor gnas dgongs pa'i ngang nas/ sku 'khor rnams la thugs shin tu brtse ba zhig 'khrungs/ de ma thag de bzhin byas na mi legs/ da lta lha bsgom pa'i skabs yin dgongs phur ba bsgoms pas/ 'tsho dmar gyi mthong ga na yar ye re ba'i che la gsal ba de'i ngang la yun ring 'byams pa'i mtshan ltas ngo mtshar ba byung ba dang / yang lan gcig mtshan lam du bzhi thog bla brang gi ja khang rnying pa'i 'gag de na bud med mdzes ma zhig 'dug pa la/ spyir rje 'di'i sku skye ba mang por mi tshangs spyod spangs pa'i dbang gis sku tshe 'dir bud med kyi rigs la chags pa'i dri ma tsam yang mi mnga' ba yin nges kyang / de dus rje nyid kyang thugs cung zad brtse ba'i nyams mdzad pa zhig snang bas/ de ma thag bud med de rje'i sku la nye bar 'khyud byung ba na/ rje nyid kyang thugs ma bde ba mi mdzad par phan tshun lhan cig par skad cig la nam mkhar 'phur te phebs song nas chos khri thang chen po'i thad kyi nam mkha'i dbyings su phebs pa na/

nga'i gdul bya rnams dor na mi legs dgongs nas phyir gzigs shig mdzad pas tshogs chen po'i khyams thams cad grwa pa kho nas khrig mer gyis khengs pa'i dbu rog ge ba 'dug pas thugs la dgyes spro dang / de rnams la lhag par brtse ba zhig kyang 'khrungs pa 'di ni sngon grub chen rdo rje dril bu pas o tri bi sha'i rgyal po grong khyer ba dang bcas pa 'dul ba'i phyir du sprul pa'i bu dang bu mo rdo rje dang dril bur byas/ phyag rgya ma rdo rje phag mo dang / rang nyid he ru ka'i gzugs kyis yum la 'khyud nas nam mkhar gshegs pa dang / slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rjes brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa la rgya gar shar phyogs bhang ga lar byon pa'i lam bar du chu chen po zhig gi rtsa ba na mdze mo zhig 'dug pa des/ slob dpon la sgrol zer ba na/ 'di khyer na mdze gos tshe/ dngos grub tshe gcig gis sgrub pa'i bar chad du 'gro dgongs nas ma bsgral bar/ slob dpon gyi 'khor ku sa li pa gcig gis bsgral bas/ de ma thag ku sa li pa he ru ka dang / mdze mo phag mor gyur nas mkha' spyod du song ba'i rnam thar dang tshul mtshungs pas shin tu mtshar ba'i gnas su snang zhing / gzhan yang phyis su rje mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la mnal lam du/ rang nyid kyi gzim lam gyi 'khris na/ mgar mo gzhon nu ma zhig gcer bu skra bshig nas 'dod pa bsten pa'i grab tu 'dug pa na/ thugs gting nas bag tsha zhing 'di 'dra byed mi nyan dgongs te la 'ur khong rang 'bros pa'i grab mdzad pas/ de tsug ma byed 'di la skyon med/ khyod kyis yun ring mo nas nga bos pa yin zer ba la/ ngas ni khyod 'bod pa lta ci/ da lam las mthong yang ma myong / sdom pa nyams nas dmyal bar skye ba las skyon che ba gang yod/ nga thongs gsungs dkrug par mdzad pas/ bud med de na re/ khyod la mi dgos na nga 'dod chags thams cad dang bral ba zhig yin zer nas nam mkhar 'phags song ba na/

rdo rje phag mo zhal gnyis ma phag zhal gyi smin mtshams dang bha ga'i nang na dga' 'khyil khor khor pa zhig tu gyur song nas/ de'i zhabs la 'jus gsol ba btab pas/ da tshe 'dir rjes su 'dzin pa'i skal ba med/ yi ge so gnyis ma 'bru 'bum sbyin sreg dang bcas pa zlos/ rang sems phag mo'i rang zhal ma yengs par skyongs/ snying rje byang sems kyis 'gro ba la phan thogs/ bar dor rjes su 'dzin pa yin no gsungs nas yal lo/ /mnal sad pa na thugs skyo snang drag po sngar yong ma myong ba zhig thugs la 'khrungs pa byung gsungs pa rje mkhyen brtse ba'i gsang ba'i rnam thar las 'byung ba dang yang mthun no/ /gzhan yang lan gcig mnal lam du yul phyogs gcig na skyes pa dang bud med rin po che dang dar gos khyad par can gyi rgyan du mas mdzes par brgyan pa dpa' bo dang dpa' mo kho na tshogs pa yin dgongs pa mang po zhig gi khrod na rje nyid kyang bzhugs 'dug pa la/ phyi rol nas bud med yid du 'ongs pa/ rgyan gyi rnam pa gzhan dag las kyang zab cing spros pa che ba zhig gis rje nyid la bud med de'i sar byon zhu ba snyam byed pa la/ nyid kyis kyang phebs pas/ bud med de 'dod pa la dga' ba'i tshul du 'dug pa la/ thugs dgongs la 'di bud med tha mal pa yin na mi rung bas/ ye shes kyi ḍāk+ki yin min brtag pa'i phyir brda zhig byed dgos dgongs pa na/ brda mdzad ma dgos par thugs la de bzhin 'khrungs pa tsam na/ bud med des brda'i lan phyin ci ma log pa bstan byung ba na/ 'di ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dngos su 'dug pas 'di dang lhan cig gnas na bde stong gi ye shes rgyud la skye shing / lus 'di ma spangs par mkha' spyod du phyin pas chog pa la the tshom mi dgos pa 'dug dgongs tsam na/ rkyen zhig gis mnal sad pas shin tu phangs pa zhig byung gsungs shing / gzhan yang 'jam mgon bla ma 'dis ni rang nyid kyi rnam 'dren dam pa gsum la nyams dang rmi lam du yang zab chos gsan cing sgro 'dogs chod par mdzad pa yin te/

de yang lan gcig rje mus pa chen po dag pa'i zhing gcig tu phebs pa las ni 'os med/ da lta bde ba can na bzhugs sam gang na bzhugs kyang rmi lam du gsal ba zhig byung na dgongs te/ skyabs gnas bslu med kun 'dus pa'i/ /bdag gi bla ma mus pa rje/ /bde ba can sogs gar bzhugs kyi/ /rmi lam gsal por bstan du gsol/ /zhes pa'i gsol 'debs phur tshugs su mdzad pas tho rangs kyi cha zhig la rje mus pa chen po nyid gsal bar byon nas gshed dmar gyi dbang gi ye shes dbab pa yan gnang zhing / gzhan yang gsung gleng mang du mdzad pa dang / de nas rje 'di'i sku rgyab tu mus chen nyid gdan drangs/ phyag gzhan la brten nas thugs dgyes nyams chen po mdzad pa zhig byung ba dang / yang bde mchog nag po pa'i ljags bsnyen gyi tshe thugs la nyams rtogs khyad par can 'khrungs nas/ de nyams dbyangs su mdzad pa ni/ rgyud kun gyi yang rtse gsang mtha'i lam/ /yid brtson pas nyams su blangs pa'i mthus/ /nang zag med bde stong rol pa la/ /phyi drug cu rtsa gnyis lha yi sku/ /dus nyin mtshan med par dag snang ngang / /phyi brtan g.yo thams cad lha'i dkyil 'khor/ /sgra gsang sngags gnyis med rang sgrar shar/ /sems 'khrul pa'i rtog 'gyu phra rags kun/ /nam byung dus dran pas so btsugs te/ /de bde stong rol par chams kyis bshig /lus 'tsho ba'i bza' btung thams cad kyang / /nang zab mo lus dkyil mchod pa'i rdzas/ /dus nyams rjes kun tu skabs 'ga' der/ /sems rang rig 'od gsal rang mdangs dang / /phyi yul snang bsres nas 'bol le bzhag /de gsal le sing nge yer re gnas/ /mdor bsdu na snang srid chos 'di kun/ /'phral dag pa rab 'byams bde stong dang / /don gshis lugs brjod bral ye 'byams che/ /lam zab mo'i gnas bsdus nyams 'di dag /rje mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' drin dang / /rang rnam dpyod blo gros mi dman pas/ /don go yul tsam la nges shes skyes/

/da myur du mnyam rjes 'dre bar shog /ces pa'i nyams dbyangs mdzad pas/ de skabs tho rangs kyi cha zhig mtshan lam du rje mus pa chen po dang mjal nas/ lam dus kyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud rim gyi byin rlabs 'dra ba zhig mdzad byung ba'i nang nas bram ze chen po/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho gsum gyi mtshan gsal por gsan pa'i mod la/ rje 'di la sku na phra mo nas 'od gsal gyi nyams shig 'char rgyu yod pa de shar te/ des rkyen byas nas mnal sad de thugs la dga' spro tshad med pa 'khrungs zhes rje nyid kyi sngar gyi nyams dbyangs de'i mjug tu bshad pa yin la/ yang sprel lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bdun gyi tho rangs mtshan ltas la/ gling ga'i bsam gtan phu'i rje mus pa'i gzim phug de yin dgongs pa gcig na sems dpa' chen po bzhugs 'dug pa la/ rje 'di'i thugs la rje'i phyag phyi ba rnams kyis/ rje la zhabs tog yang dag pa zhig mi yong ba yod pa 'dra dgongs pa na/ mi gcig nas rje rang gis zhal bkod yang yang mdzad nas dga' rab yong gi yod zer/ de mtshams sems dpa' chen po ni rje mus chen du 'dug pa'i phyag na sba snyug la nyag khram mang po gtod pa ha cang mi thung gcig dang / dar dmar gyi dar lcog zur gsum pa gcig bsnams nas/ khyod sa skya bdag po yin pas khrims lugs mthun byas na legs shing / nged grwa pa gzhan dang 'dra bas khrims lugs mthun byas kyang mi legs zhes pa 'dra zhig gsungs byung bas/ rje 'di'i thugs la gling ga'i khrims tshul bzhin skyong ba la mnyes par 'dug dgongs pa 'khrungs/ bdag gi chos 'phro rnams gnang ba zhig yong lags sam zhus pas/ da lo the ba'i lo bzhi sdod/ chos rnams los thos thub gsung ba snyam byed pa la/ yang rje 'di'i thugs la bla ma gzugs sku bsdu ba'i tshe 'pho bas gshegs tshul bstan cing / yang sku 'di bzhin du snang ba ya mtshan che dgongs nas/

rje zhing brje dus dbu gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga zang thal du song ba nas rtsa dbu ma 'dra ba zhig myug gi thon nas/ 'pho bas phebs 'dug pas 'pho ba de chig brgyud ma yin nam/ nai gu'i 'pho ba zhig yin lags zhu ba mdzad pas/ rje mus pa'i zhal nas/ chig brgyud yin nam gsang sngags kyi 'pho ba gcig yin gsungs byung ba na/ mi gcig na re/ gsal por mi gsungs zer/ rje 'dis de ma thag chig brgyud ma yin nam gsung lugs des chig brgyud mas phebs pa thag chod gsungs pa snyam byed/ de'i tshe rje mus pa'i zhabs drung rang na/ dam pa 'di'i nyer gnas kyi grwa pa zhig 'dug pa la/ bslab ston gyi tshul du/ rje mus pa'i zhal nas ja sig gcig nyos nas dge sbyor slob gnyer la rtse gcig 'bung na bde la skyid pa'i tshad yin/ gzhan mi tshe stong zad la bskyal na ha hā zer zhing / dbugs phyir ring du ring du song / nang du thung du thung du song / phyir ring mo zhig rgyus nas chad rjes/ stong nyams kho na las mi 'char/ da lta sgom na gsal stong zung 'jug 'char/ zhes gsungs pa lta bu zhig dang / gzhan yang rje'i zhal nas/ sgom na mi grol ba mi srid pa'i lung zhig 'dren par mdzad pa de la/ rje btsun dam pa 'dis tshig zur dag ma dag gi dpyad pa zhig mdzad pa'i mod la mnal sad pa na/ rmi lam ma gtogs don la rje nyid dang dngos su mjal rgyu med dgongs pa'i thugs skyo ba dang / spyir bla ma dang rmi lam du mjal ba la yang skal ba bzang / lhag par mjal lugs ya mtshan de bzhin ngo mtshar yang che dgongs pa'i thugs dga' ba gnyis zung 'brel du gyur nas/ mtshan ltas de nyid slar yi ger yang bkod par mdzad cing / 'dir yang de bzhin du bris pa yin pas kun gyi yid ches kyi gnas so/ /gzhan yang rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer drug pa chu pho khyi lo dpal sa skyar gsung ngag rin po che stsal pa'i nub gcig mtshan lam du 'jam mgon grub pa'i dbang phyug bsod nams dbang po de nyid kyis lha chen rtse'i mgon khang du chos skyong gur gyi mgon po'i dkyil 'khor du ma'i dbang bskur rnams dus gcig la stsal pa dang /

dus phyis dgung lo so gcig pa'i tshe/ 'dra 'dri srin po chos rdzong gi mgon khang bzhengs grub nas/ de'i tho rangs kyi cha zhig mtshan lam du grub mchog dbang po'i mtshan can de nyid dang mjal te/ thugs gting nas dgyes pa'i mdangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / lhag par sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i nang gi ku ru kul+le'i thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag 'di rnams yin no zhes zab chos mang du stsal cing / gzhan yang chos tshan 'ga' zhig gnang ba'i ring nas rgya gar gyi grub chen a bha ya ka ra dang sa chen dus mtshungs yin min gyi dogs dpyod mdzad pa'i gsal snang khyad par can byung nas/ mnal sad pa na grub mchog dbang po'i mtshan can de nyid mgon khang 'di bzhengs pa la thugs dgyes par 'dug dgongs nas/ rje de la thugs dad bcos ma ma yin pa 'khrungs par gyur te/ de la sogs pa mtshan lam du yang zab chos gsan pa'i tshul mang du yod cing / skyes bu dam pa rnams la ni rmi lam du gsan pa dag kyang don dang ldan par 'gyur ba yin te/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas a spyi mchod rten gyi drung du slob dpon dbyig gnyen la chos mngon pa mdzod mnal lam du gsan pas ma lus pa thugs su chud pa dang / kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges sems dpa' chen por mtshan lam du sbyong drug gsan pas ji lta ba bzhin thugs su chud de kun rig rtsod spong mdzad/ de'i mjug tu/ rmi lam ri rtser zab don rnyed pa yi/ /rtags dang mtshan ma'i nyi 'od lham mer gsal/ /zhes 'bri bar mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang 'di 'dra'i rigs bla ma gong ma rnams la mang du byung ba rnams dang tshul mtshungs pas so/ /gzhan yang rje nyid dgung lo nyer brgyad du phebs pa byi lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes drug gi tho rangs mnal lam du yab rje chos kyi rgyal po de nyid bzhi thog bla brang gi rab gsal na bzhugs khri che ba gcig gi steng / zhal nub tu gzigs nas bzhugs pa'i sku mdun na/

rgya ja sogs dngos po mang du 'dug pas/ rje 'di la spyan gyis gzigs te thugs dgyes pa'i mdangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad de/ sku mdun gyi dngos po rnams la 'di dag tho brgyab pa'i tho 'di yin no gsungs nas rje 'di la thams cad stsal ba snyam byed cing / lhag par thugs rtog na dogs pa'i gnas shin tu che ba zhig yod pa de la/ 'di ltar gyis shig pa'i bslab bya lhug stsol du gnang ba na/ rje 'dis rjes su yi rang ba'i zhu ba mang du zhus shing / slar yang dus rtag tu thugs brtse bas skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa snyam mdzad pa'i mod la mnal sad de/ de nas rgyun mi ring bar nyid kyi gcen 'jam pa'i dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug mdo khams nas phebs te/ ja gos dar/ rta dre'u/ rol spyad sogs zang zing gi dngos spyad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnang skyes stsal ba yin no/ /yang lan gcig mtshan lam du yab rje chos kyi rgyal po de nyid dang mjal ba la/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung mgur dben gnas ma la mgur dbyangs cung zad 'then ma bde ba zhig yod pa de zhus nas/ 'di la ji ltar byas na legs kyi dogs dpyod zhu ba mdzad pas/ 'di ltar byed pa yin gsungs/ yab rje nyid kyis mgur dbyangs mdzad byung ba na/ ji lta ba bzhin dgongs te/ mnal sad nas kyang yab rje chos kyi rgyal po de nyid kyi gsung shin tu snyan pa de thugs yul du gsal le ba'i ngang nas mtshan lam du yab rje ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin gyi gsung mgur 'then 'khyer de mdzad pas/ dben gnas ma la sngar gyi 'then khyer cung zad tsam ma bde ba de med par/ lhag par bde la snyan pa zhig yong gi (rtsa ba'i ma dpe las shog lhe gnyis ma tshangs ba'i rkyen gyi bris ma thub/) ba tshad pa'i ring nas mnal sad pa na/ chos skyong ma dgyes pa'i ltas yin pa 'dra/ bskang gso rgyas pa zhig mdzad dgos pa 'dug dgongs pa'i tshe/ nangs par sku gnyer gyis mgon khang gi steng gi gdung chag nas/

mdang nub rdib gzhom du song 'dug ces de'i tshul zhus pa na/ de ma thag mkhar las 'dzugs pa gnang bas/ de'i nub mnal lam du skyes pa sgang yol bag dro ba zhig zhabs drung du byung nas/ da cha 'chams mgon gyi bzhugs sa sa phag gi skyor sogs bcos yod pas/ bse 'bag phyogs gzhan du phebs pa med zhu ba byung 'dug pa ni/ chos skyong nyid kyi mgon khang gi zhig gsos dgos pa de bskul ba phul bar snang bas ngo mtshar mchog tu che bar 'khums te/ de dus mgon khang steng 'og gi nyan pa thams cad nyams gso mthil phyin pa mdzad pa'i steng 'og kun brtan brling khel ba byung ba 'di yin la/ de dus bskul ma ma byung tshe lo mang ches pa'i mgon khang steng 'og gi mdo phugs kyi thog thams cad rdib la nye ba kho na yod pa nas/ lan gcig thams cad choms rdib tu ma song bar la sus kyang bcos mi nus pa sha chags pas/ des na chos skyong rnams rje 'di la gzhan las 'go zhing 'ches pa'i ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i rnam thar du snang zhing / gzhan yang rje bla ma 'di la chos skyong rnams kyis 'phrin las sgrub cing rnam 'phrul sna tshogs bstan pa'i tshul ni/ rje nyid bde mchog pho brang du bzhugs pa'i skabs shig thugs dam bskang gtor gyi mgon po/ lha mo dang / zhal/ pu tra rnams kyi gtor rnying la me ro tsha mo'i me dbal tsam gyi drod 'bar ba byung ba/ mchod dpon ngag dbang dpal bzang gis gtor kha gso dus rig nas/ sku 'khor ba rnams la zlos pas/ de bzhin du kun gyis rig cing ha las par gyur pa dang / dus phyis bzhi thog bla brang gi yang rtse'i gzim chung thugs dam bskang gtor la yang / lo gcig mgon po/ lha mo gnyis dang / lo gcig mgon po dang nag po mchod rten gnyis/ lo gcig mgon po/ lha mo/ zhal/ nag po mchod rten rnams kyi gtor rnying la sngar gyi de 'dra ba'i drod chen po byung ba mchod dpon smon lam rin chen gyis shes nas/

zhabs drung du gnas pa rnams la smras pas/ kun gyis rtogs shing ya mtshan du gyur pa byung 'dug pa ni/ chos rgyal 'phags pas mgon po'i 'grub rtags su/ gtor ma me 'bar dngos su mthong / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de dus rje nyid kyis gtor ma rnams la me dngos su 'bar ba gzigs pa gdon mi za zhing / yang rje nyid sku gzhon nu'i skabs shig phyag g.yog byams bzang pa la do nub rang re 'bras 'jam zhig skol cig par bka' stsal pa na/ lag len gyis ma khyog par tshig ri can zhig khyer byung bas/ 'di khams la 'phog pas/ slar bskyar nas skol cig gsungs pa'i tshe/ 'di 'dra'i nam 'phyi ba la mi legs zer dang len ma zhus 'dug pa na/ rje nyid cung zad thugs 'khrugs te/ dus ngan gyi lag g.yog de tsam yang mi nus pa dgongs nas/ dam can mon bu pu tra 'di la tshabs chen ma yin pa'i rtsub 'gyur zhig ston cig gsungs pas/ de dus phyag g.yog de gzim chung gi 'gag tu nyal gyi yod 'dug pa la/ nam gung tsam la skad ngan sna tshogs ston byung bas/ nyid kyi thugs la gnyid lab 'dra yin nam dgongs pa shar/ nangs par zhabs drung du slebs byung dus mdang gi skad ngan de 'dra ci yin gsungs pas/ mdang bdag la gnyid du 'gro khar 'brog pa 'dra ba'i mi smug po ral lcog can zhig 'ong nas/ lus yang yang mgo mjug slog cing 'jigs snang gi ngang la song ba zhig byung / des lags sam zhu ba la/ de ka mdang nub nged kyi tshod ma ma skol ba'i yin mod ces gsungs pas/ med lags zer zhing song ba byung 'dug pa 'di lta bu ni chos skyong bran du 'khol ba las gzhan du ma 'das mod/ yang dus phyis bslu ba med pa'i skyabs mgon dam pa 'di nyid kyi mnal lam du nangs so pu tra khang gi sku brnyan gyi drung de na rang nyid bzhugs 'dug pa la/ sku zhogs na ban+de bong can ngo nag pa zhig kyang 'dug pas/ de la nyid kyis nged la pu tra chen po 'di bka' bab yod gsungs pas/

de na re bab bab/ khyed kyis bdud dpung kun 'joms ma la dbyangs mdzad byung tsa na/ nged rnams kyang zil che ba zhig yong gi 'dug zer mtshams mnal sad pa na/ rang gis mdzad pa'i pu tra'i bstod bskul 'di byas na las mkhan chen po mnyes rgyur 'dug dgongs nas rgyun pa'i thugs dam bskang gso'i skabs chag med du gnang ba 'di byung bar 'dug cing / yang lan gcig dmigs yul gdug pa can zhig la dmigs pa'i gtor zlog gcig glo bur du gnang ba'i skabs/ grub mchog dbang po'i mtshan can dang rje nyid kyi sgrub rnga gnyis de dus phyag rngar gnang bas/ phyag rnga de gnyis la me dngos su 'bar ba phyag g.yog skya ser gnyis kyis yun ring du mthong ba dang / yang rje nyid lha khang rtse'i mgon khang du thugs dam bskang gso zhig la phebs pa'i tshe/ ma chen dpal blo bas gsol ja zhig zhu bar phyin pa dang dus mtshungs par nub phyogs kyi bram gzugs kyi sku'i dril bu g.yer kha rnams kyis sgra sil choms su 'byin pa dang / steng nas sa bab pa lta bu'i srob sgra che ba dang bcas bram gzugs kyi sku'i mdun nas rlung 'tshub zhig se krang gi dkar khung phyogs la song ba dpon slob gnyis kas gzigs 'dug pa/ de dus kyang rje nyid kyis zhal bzhi pa'i rnam 'gyur ci yang zhig gzigs pa la the tshom mi 'dug cing / yang bde mchog mgon khang du mgon po'i gsung bsnyen sbyin sreg dang bcas pa zhig mdzad pa'i tshe/ rje mus chen mnal lam du byon nas rje nyid kyi bzhin ras la mus chen gyi phyag gis byug cing / khyed yab rje rgyal mchog rin po che'i zhal dkyil ji lta ba bzhin du 'dug pas/ rigs kyi bu la brgyud kyi lha 'go zer ba yin zhes sogs bsngags brjod du ma mdzad pa zhig byung gsungs pa ni bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyis rjes su bzung ba'i mtshan mar snang zhing / yang nyid kyis dbus phyogs la phyag phebs pa'i tshe/

sku 'khor ba tha shal zhig gis rje'i phyag rdzas la 'bags pa na/ de'i khog par chos skyong gi 'khor zhig zhugs nas lab lob mang po byas byung ba la/ nye skor ba rnams kyis byin rlabs rten gyis brdungs pa dang / dud pas bdug pa sogs byas pas kho na re/ nga de 'dras 'gro mkhan min/ sa skya nas 'ongs pa yin/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams kyi dar 'bog ma byung bar nga mi 'gro zer ba la/ de 'dra ga na yod dris pas dre'u rgya'u'i steng mgo sbrel bkal ba'i nang na yod zer ba ji lta ba bzhin 'dug pa la/ zla bo rnams kyis/ 'di nged kyis zhabs drung du phul gyi/ da song byas pa na/ da dung zhal dkyil mthong zhing zhabs dbang zhig ma byung bar mi 'gro zer ba la/ rje nyid kyis de'i sar byon pas/ yus pa'i tshul gyis rgyug gral dang bcas byung nas/ rje'i zhabs la 'jus nas spyi bor bzhag mchi ma mang du btang nas sangs song nas/ dus phyis de'i gnas tshul zhib tu dgongs pa na/ gsung las/ de 'dra ba'i las ngan byed pa kho rang la snying rje ba 'dug gsungs shing / nyes chad tsam yang ma gnang 'dug pa 'di ni mthu stobs dang thugs rje gzhan las ches che ba'i dge mtshan du snang zhing / 'di 'dra ba ni sngon yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan la/ phyag g.yog ngan pa zhig gis phyag rdzas mang po khyer ba na/ 'khor gzhan zhig la mon bu bab ste/ nga mnga' ris gung thang na la rtse nas 'ongs pa'i bha ṭa yin/ pu ṭa yin/ rkun ma bsam yas 'ja' dkar na yod pa la/ khyod tsho 'dir mgo btums nas sdod dam zer ba'i khungs ston pa yang byung ba sogs chos skyong rnams kyis go re len gyi tshul gyis 'phrin las thams cad thogs med du sgrub pa'i lo rgyus yar lung pa nyid kyi rnam thar las 'byung ba dang mthun par snang bas ngo mtshar rmad du byung bar snang zhing / yang bla brang rdzong chung gi sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba'i phyag bris ma'i mgon po yod pa'i g.yab la rdib gzhom byung ste/

mgon po'i sku skyed yan chad kyi ri mo yod pa'i gyang phyir 'gyel te zhig ral du gyur pa'i tshe/ rje nyid rig 'dzin pho brang na bzhugs pa'i mnal lam du khyi nag po chen po zhig skyed pa 'khyog pa dang bcas mi skad ston te/ nga'i skyed pa chag song zer cho nge 'don zhing rgyug pa zhig byung bas/ ci yin nam dgongs pa la/ nangs par rdzong chung 'gyel ba'i snyan zhus 'bul mi byung bas/ sku tshab gcig phyag bris mdzad dgos par dgongs nas/ da lta'i rdzong chung gi shar gyi mgon khang gsar pa phyag bris ma 'di ched gtad bzhengs par mdzad pa yin zhing / yang tshong 'dus brag kha bas bsam yas rab byung gi mkhan po spyi pa/ mkhan tshangs sogs nyid kyis bkod bzhag gnang ba'i las tshan so so/ rab byung chos sde byings dang bcas par dngos brgyud du ma'i sgo nas bsam sbyor ngan pas zhabs 'dren ci yang zhig byas pa'i tshe/ skyabs mgon dam pa 'di nyid kyis ched du gtad pas 'phrin bcol ma mdzad kyang / bla ma gong ma'i bka' bzhin chos skyong rnams kyis drag po'i 'phrin las sgrub pa'i tshul ni/ gdan sa chen po'i phur sgrub kyi smad las dang 'brel ba'i dgra bgegs grub kyi sku 'chams kyi skabs shig rje dpon slob rnams kyis gser skyems/ phur kha bsgyur ba sogs kyi cho ga rnams gnang rjes/ dpang gzugs mdzad pa'i bar la bya rog che zhing snum pa gcig gi kha na byi ba gcig khyer ba de/ 'chams rwa'i dbus kyi ling gdan gyi dbus su 'phangs byung ba/ slar yang bya rog des/ dpon slob skya ser mang po de tsam la mi 'dzems par gshog 'gyur dang bcas byi ba de la bzhung na khar khyer te/ nangs so pu tra khang gi steng du song ba skya ser kun gyis mthong bas/ de 'dra ya mtshan che/ da lo sa skya pa'i bstan dgra zhig la mi 'dod pa 'ong ba e yin zer mgrin gcig tu sgrog pa byung ba bzhin/ yun ring ma lon par brag kha ba'i mi ngo drag pa de glo bur du 'das/

de nas bzung ste kho rang 'khor bcas la rkyen ngan mang po zam ma chad pa byung nas/ da cha gtan brlag tu song ba kun gyi thugs la gsal ba bzhin dang / yang be re rgyal pos dbus gtsang gi gser lam bcad cing / dgon gnas mang po la zhabs 'dren dang / tshong 'grul ba grangs med pa sho len pa dang 'phrog 'joms byed pa sogs skye bo mtha' dag sdug bsngal la bkod pa'i tshe/ rje nyid kyis 'chams mgon gsar pa 'di gnyis zhal bkod gnang ba dang dus 'grig ste/ ngan byed de la dmigs pa'i gzungs sngags la spel tshig 'phrin bcol sogs ched du dmigs pa tsam mdzad pas/ dus ring po ma 'gyangs par rtags dang mtshan ma mngon sum du byung ba sogs 'di 'dra'i rigs can mang du yod cing / gzhan yang dgos ched khyad par can gyi tshe/ chos skyong rnams la bskang gso 'phrin bcol smin tsam re mdzad pas/ dus de thogs med du 'grub pa ni zhabs 'bring pa kun gyi thugs la yang nas yang du gsal ba de yin la/ yang gshin 'pho skye ba mkhyen pa sogs kyi yon tan mnga' ba'i tshul ni/ rje 'di la dad pa can gyi phyug po stod lung pa'i bu gcig po 'das pa'i tshe/ yus dang bcas pas bu de gar skye'i lung bstan dgos tshul zhus pas/ nyid kyi gsung las/ sa skya'i chos gzhis kyi khongs shar lho'i phyogs shig tu skye bar 'dug gsungs pa bzhin/ bsam gling du gzhung pa rgya gar gyi bur skyes te/ smra shes nas pha ngo shes shing / lus la skye ba sngon ma'i sha mtshan gsal ba sogs yid ches kyang byung 'dug pa dang / yang nangs so tsha rong pa'i bu mo dbang 'dzin gyi bu rgan pa bsod nams dbang grags 'das pa'i tshe/ rje nyid la lam ston zhus pa na/ de dus sku mtshams bcad rgya'i skabs shig yin pas/ 'di ma grol bar lam ston mi thub pa 'dug grol 'phral byed pas/ de bar skye ba ngan pa mi len pa'i skyabs 'jug nged rang gis byed pa yod gsungs pa bzhin/

slar skabs bab la lam ston mdzad pa'i nub mo ma de'i rmi lam du rang gi bu dbang grags khres po zhig khyer nas rings stabs kyis byung bas/ mas khyod kyis kha sang nas gar phyin/ da gar 'gro/ 'dir sdod dang byas pas/ bu na re/ nged kyis bzhi thog bla brang du phyin pas gong sa nas/ gser khang sku gnyer gyi zla la sdod gsungs bsdad pas/ khong gis byams par byas nas skyid po yang byung / da rdo rje lags tshang gi khang par rgyugs gsungs 'gro rgyu yin zer mtshams gnyid sad 'dug pa/ de nas yun ring ma lon par grong pa de pa tshang gi bur skyes nas lo bzhi lnga tsam bsdad 'dug pas/ smra shes pa na/ nga bsam gling nas yin/ pha ma dang spun zla nor rdzas 'di 'dra yod zer ba sogs shin tu gsal ba yid ches can byung 'dug pa/ slar de'i tshul rje nyid la zhus pa na/ nged la de 'dra'i nus pa ga la yod/ 'on kyang gshin gson rnams kyi blo gtad pas/ chos skyong gis srung skyobs mdzad pa'i rtags ni yin shas che ba 'dug gsungs shing / de bzhin rje nyid kyi sbyin bdag byang phyogs kyi 'brog rigs 'ga' la'ang de 'dra'i rigs can 'ga' re byung ba'i lo rgyus snang yang 'dir yi ges 'jigs nas ma spros la/ yang rje nyid kyi chibs dpon yul gsar ba rnam rgyal thog rgod tshang la snga mor bu tsha mang du yod pa la/ bar skabs su thams cad 'brum bus 'das nas/ bud med kyang gsar du len dgos pa la thug pa'i tshe/ de skabs rje'i ma chen rnam rgyal nyid kyis 'gyang tsam byed pa'i skabs yin pas/ lan cig snga dro gsol 'jam zhu ba la phyin pa'i tshe/ nyid kyi zhal nas/ khyod tsho'i bud med la mngal zhig yod pa 'dra bas/ de yang bur yong nyan che 'dug pas mang po 'phel ba'i rten 'brel yin/ ming la bsod nams g.yung drung gyis gsungs byung ba na/ dga' spro dang bcas de'i tshul gnyen 'dun rnams la smras pas/ ji ltar bka' bstsal pa bzhin mngal yang snang zhing /

de yang gegs med du btsas/ de nas rim gyis 'phel te/ da lta mi ngo bzang ba'i tshad 'di bzhin byung 'dug pa dang / yang lha khang dbon po ba'i bu gsum dar zer ba 'di/ ma'i mngal du chags pa kho rang sus kyang ma shes par/ nyid kyis mnal lam gyis mkhyen pa dang / nyid kyi zhabs 'bring pa chen po rab 'byams smra ba bsod nams 'od zer gyi sku skye 'di ma'i mngal du byung ba'i tshe/ nyid kyi zhabs 'bring pa dbon chen bsod nams rab brtan la snga dro zhig rje nyid kyi gsung las/ khyod tshang gi bud med la deng sang mngal zhig yod 'dra bas 'phros bzhin ma byung ngam gsungs pa la/ sngar bdag gis ma shes/ slar dri rtog byed dgos pa 'dug zhus nas rtog dpyod mdzad pas gsung dang mthun par 'dug pa bzhin gegs med du 'khrungs pa 'dis mtshon pa'i ye shes kyi spyan gyis sgrib med du gzigs pa'i tshul mtha' yas shing / sku skye 'di rang lo bzhi tsam 'gro ba'i dus pha ma dang lhan cig bskyed lhas mgon khang gi shar gyi g.yab steng na yod pa'i tshe/ bdag nyid chen po dpon slob rnams zla dus kyi thugs dam bskang gso gnang ba la phebs grub nas/ slar dpon slob rnams chibs thog tu 'khyon song skabs/ byis pa des ngag thol byung du zhabs drung dpon slob rnams phebs song / ma gi'i khrod na nged la rta nag po chen po zhig yod pa de mi 'dug zer smras 'dug pa 'di ni sngon phyag mdzod bde gshegs kyis rgyun du chibs pa mdzad pa'i rnam sras g.yang 'phel zer ba zhig yod pa de der skabs med 'dug pas/ sngon gyi skye ba dran pa'i mtshan ma ngo mtshar du snang zhing / lhag par phyag mdzod de la rje nyid kyis gnang ba'i phyag phreng bai ta brgya rtsa ma 'phreng thag bcu tshar sogs sngar gyi de ka ma nyams pa zhig yod pa de/ sku skye yin min brtag pa'i phyir sbra bu'i nang du pha ma rnams kyis skyur stabs su byas nas bzhag pa na/

byis pa des mthong 'phral lag tu blangs nas dga' dga' ci yang zhig byed kyi 'dug pa la/ de sus yin gang nas byung dris pa'i tshe/ byis pa de na re/ 'phreng ba 'di nged kyi yin/ nga la zhabs drung gis gnang ba yin zer sngon gyi gnas tshul rnams gsal bar smras byung ba na/ yang pha ma tshos 'o na khyod gang nas yong ba yin byas pas/ bkra shis brtsegs nas yin zer/ 'o na bla brang bkra shis brtsegs nas yin nam/ bzhi thog bkra shis brtsegs nas yin byas pas/ bzhi thog bkra shis brtsegs nas yin zer ba dang / yang snga dro skabs 'gar nged kyi sham thabs de ma byung / da lta khyer shog zer ba sogs phyag mdzod de nyid kyi sku skye yin nges pa'i gtan tshigs mang po byung 'dug pa 'di yang bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa 'dis sku skye ma'i mngal du zhugs ma thag pa nas thugs mkhyen gyis dgongs pa'i bka' stsal gnang tshul gong du bkod pa ltar lags pas/ dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa'i ye shes kyi spyan mnga' ba la the tshom dang yid gnyis nam yang dgos pa ma yin no/ /yang rje 'di nyid la 'byung po stobs chen dag gis gus pas 'dud cing bka' las mi 'da' ba'i tshul ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'di dbus phyogs su phebs dus byi rdzong tshogs pa'i bla brang dang 'du khang gsar pa'i phyag nas la spyan drangs nas der phyag phebs te/ 'du khang du chos sde de'i mkhan chen dang / dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs la rje nyid kyis 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ 'jam dkar/ 'byung 'dul rnams kyi rjes gnang gnang ba'i skabs/ de'i chos bdag gra phyi chos skyong bya ru mig gcig pa/ sku la bse khrab/ bse rmog gsol zhing / dar mang po'i rgyan dang bcas/ lag na ral gri dang zhags pa thogs/ 'khor rol mo ba mang pos mtha' bskor nas 'du khang du byon byung ba la/ dge 'dun tshogs pa'i dbus su khri'u shing bcas nas de'i steng du bzhugs te/ bse rmog phud/

phyag mtshan bzhag nas/ dge bshes kyis gdug 'dre 'khor bcas la chos kyi 'brel pa zhig zhu zer ba la/ rje nyid kyis bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyas pa zhig stsal cing / de dus nyid kyi thugs la 'di rang bab rdzu yin las che dgongs pa la/ de shes pa'i tshul gyis gsung chos grol 'phral hob ste bzhengs nas/ sngar gyi gri de la mdud pa dam po zhig btab ste lag pa g.yas su phyar nas/ dge bshes kyi sku tshe la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phyir tshogs chen gyis lha rgyal thengs gsum bos zer de grub pa dang / nged gdug 'dre rnams kyi gtso bo bsam yas kyi gnod sbyin tse'u dmar po la/ dge bshes kyis yag po byed dgos so zer zhing 'khor rnams kyi rol mo dang bcas kho rang gi lcog tu log song ba byung 'dug pa/ 'di lta bu ni 'jig rten gyi khams na yod pa'i gzugs med kyi dregs byed gtso bo kun kyang rje 'di nyid la gus shing 'dud pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar par snang zhing gzhan yang bslu ba med pa'i skyabs mgon 'di nyid la mnal dang 'od gsal 'dres pa'i ngang du 'byung po stobs ldan 'ga' zhig gis cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan byung ba na/ de 'phral mnal lam bzung nas 'byung po de'i gnyen po'i yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi skur bzhengs nas dam 'og tu tshud par mdzad pa'i tshul gyi lo rgyus mang po zhig gsung las dngos su thos kyang / 'dir yi ge tshegs skyung ba'i phyir ma bkod la/ yang dus phyis bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rkyen gyis lus ngan blangs par khag g.yas pa 'dra ba'i 'byung po stobs ldan gdug pa can zhig gis/ skye 'gro mang po'i srog dbugs blangs te 'khor dang yang bran gyi tshul gyi gshin 'dre mang po'i sde 'chos pa 'dra ba'i gdan sa chen po'i nye skor dang / yul ljongs mang po'i skyes pho mo grangs med dang / tha na sgo 'gram gyi phyugs bzang ba tshun chad/ skad cig la 'khyer ba sogs 'jig rten thams cad ma rung par gyur pas kun kyang 'jigs shing rngangs nas ci bya la thug pa'i tshe/

bdag nyid chen po 'dis thugs brtse ba chen pos nye bar dgongs nas/ 'byung po gdug pa can de'i 'khor du gtogs pa'i gshin 'dre ming gsal brgya phrag la nye ba zhig rje nyid dge 'dun mang po dang bcas tshogs byang gi sgo nas gnas spor mdzad/ de nas bdag nyid chen po sku rkyang gis 'byung po'i gtso bo de'i don du lam ston mdzad par bzhed nas/ gsung chog byin tshar ba dang lam ston gyi cho ga'i mtshams su phebs pa na/ 'byung po'i gtso bo de bud med zhig la khog zhugs byas nas/ ban chas tshang bar gyon zhing zhabs drung du byung nas/ phyag phul/ byin rlabs zhus nas/ gdan la 'khod de/ de na re/ paṇ+ḍi ta khyed kyis snga mo nas nged la gnas spor zhig byas na/ nged la 'di 'dra'i rgyun ring ba sdod dgos pa med/ las ngan yang mang po gsog pa med de/ yin na'ang da lam bka' drin che/ gzhan deng sang gi bla mar ming btags pa'i dkor zan 'di rnams kyis nga la spor chog byed zer ba rgod dro zer zhing so tham tham byed kyi 'dug pa la/ rje nyid kyis de 'dra'i zhe sdang ma byed/ slar yang de ka byas pas 'di las ma byung ba yin/ da nged dang mnyam du sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod sems drag pos bshags pa'i 'di rnams gyis shig gsungs nas/ bshags pa'i tshigs bcad dang lhug pa mang du mdzad pas/ des kyang mnyam 'don gyi tshul gyis byas grub mtshams/ nyid kyi gsung las/ da ni kho bos lam ston gyi cho ga bya yi/ sems rnam rtog gzhan gyi rjes su ma 'brang bar/ cho ga dang dag pa'i zhing du skye ba len pa'i 'dun pa la/ rtse gcig tu gtod cig gsungs pa'i tshe/ de na re bka' drin che/ de 'dra dka' las che na'ang / paṇ+ḍi ta rang gi bka' bzhin da lta 'phos 'gro zhing / de nas khyed rang gi mnga' zhabs su skyes pa pho lus shig blangs/ khyed rang bzhugs thog la chos sgor 'jug bsam pa yod pas/ paṇ+ḍi tas ngos 'dzin dang rjes su 'dzin dgos so zer nas/

de 'phral khog zhugs de brgyal stabs kyis sangs song ba na/ rje nyid kyis lam ston gyi cho ga smin par mdzad pas/ thugs snang yang bde bar byung bas/ da lam lus ngan de 'pho thub pa yang srid pa yod ces gsung las dngos su thos pa bzhin dus de nas bzung ste 'byung po ma rungs pa 'khor dang bcas pa de rnams kyis sems can la gnod 'tshe'i rgyun thams cad gtan med du song ba mngon du gyur pa 'di lta bu ni/ skye dgu mtha' dag la mi 'jigs pa dang srog gi sbyin pa rgya chen po stsol ba cher rlom kun gyis 'gran zla dang bral ba'i rnam thar du snang zhing / yang dus phyis rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid kyi chos gzhis gsar 'phel rma bya'i gnyer pa/ gan pa rdzong dang shab bar sdings su skyes pa gnyis rim pa bzhin 'chi khar bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rkyen gyis 'byung po 'dug pa can re rer skyes pa/ de'i rjes kyi gnyer pa de gnyer khang na yod pa na/ lan gcig nam phyed tsam na grong pa'i skye bo dar bab zhig la sngar gyi gshin 'dre de pa khog zhugs kyis rgyal sgo sogs mnan yod 'dug kyang / de dag la ma ltos par gnyer pa 'dug sar thal gyis byung nas/ mi 'os pa'i gtam sna tshogs smra ba sogs byas byung bas/ dus de tsam nas gnyer pa nad kyis thebs te sman spyad rim gro sogs gang gis kyang ma phan par/ sngar gyi 'byung po rnams la gnyer khang gi steng du btsan khang 'cho ba sogs bsten brtsis du ma zhig byed dgos byung ba de'i tshul rnams rim gyis rje nyid kyis dgongs pa na/ thugs 'khrug par gyur te gsung las/ lha 'dre tshod ma zin pha gi tsho 'don dgos rgyur 'dug gsungs nas/ thugs dam gtor ma zan ril mang po byas pa zhig bsngo bar mdzad nas/ de 'phral gdan sa dan gyi dge slong gtsang ma bsnyen song zhig la bka' gnang ste/ khyed rma byar song la gnyer kha steng gi btsan khang rnams bsgyel/ der mon chung pu tra bzhugs rgyu yin gyis la/

sa nag gtang ba'i khang pa re dang thug re tshugs la/ de'i rtsa bar bskang gso rgyas pa zhig thongs/ nged kyis dmigs pa'i gtor zan zan ril 'di rnams dang / sngags btab pa'i nas mang ba zhig khyer la/ rma bya'i gnyer khang / grong khyer/ lung pa kun la thor la/ nged kyi lab rigs la/ khyed rang gshin 'dre rnams gan pa rdzong dang / bar sdings rnams su song la nged kyi rma bya'i nye skor la gtan nas ma 'dug cig bsdad pa byung na chos skyong rnams la 'phrin las bcol nas drag pos tshar gcod byed nges pa yin no gyis/ de bzhin du grong khyer ba rnams la yang / da phyin bsten pa med pa'i mna' gam sogs mtha' 'doms par gyis/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khong dge slong pa gnyer pa dang bcas pas bka' bzhin bsgrubs pas/ de phyin chad la gshin 'dre de rnams gar song cha med du song ba lta bu'i/ gshin 'dre de dag gi sgra tsam yang mi grags par gyur pa 'dis kyang yongs 'dzin dam pa 'di nyid ni gzhal du med pa'i mthu stobs kyi mnga' bdag chen por grub pa ma yin nam/ yang lan gcig rje 'di'i gsang yum bgres pa'i phyag g.yog 'bro pa'i bu mo zhig la 'byung po stobs chen zhig yang yang khog zhugs su yong ba zhig yod pa la/ lan gcig nyin gang mtshan gang zhig ma thon pa la/ sngags 'chang rig 'dzin 'jigs bral sogs sngags nus yod nges kun gyis thabs ci byas kyang / khrel rgod byed pa sogs ji snyam du yang mi sems pa la/ rje nyid kyis thugs rje gting nas 'khrungs pa'i spyan chab g.yo bzhin pa dang bcas byon pa na/ gnas der phebs ma thag khog zhugs sangs grab kyi ngu 'bod chen po sogs byas byung ba na/ rje 'dis slar mi 'jug pa'i dam bca' gyis gsungs pa la/ de bzhin khas blangs song ba bzhin/ de phyin chad khog zhugs kyi rnam pa gtan ma byung 'dug pa 'di'ang 'byung po rnams kyang nyid kyi bka' las cung zad kyang mi 'da' ba'i rtags mtshan du snang ngo /

/yang klu gnyan sa bdag sogs kyis 'phrin las sgrub pa'i tshul ni/ rje nyid byang pa chos rgyal chen pos spyan drangs te skya bo kha gdeng na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ tho rang kyi skabs shig mnal lam du mi'i lus la sbrul mjug ring po byas pa/ ras dkar gyi stod g.yogs can gnyis zhabs drung du byung nas/ nged rnams la bza' btung ster dgos/ 'phrin las chen po sgrub zhu ba la/ sku mdun na dkar gsum bzhes spro mang du 'dug pa nas tshom tsam re gnang ba'i mod la mnal sad pa na/ nyid kyi thugs la dpyid mtsho skya mo'i klu'i rgyal po zhig yin pa 'dra dgongs shing / yang dus phyis bzhi thog tu bzhugs dus tho rangs shig rmi lam la/ mi'i lus la rna ba khyi 'dra ba shin tu che bas rgyab khebs pa zhig byung nas/ nged la sa brko dong rlog mang pas nged rnams la gnod po byung ba la/ khyed kyis phan thabs byas na phun sum tshogs pa 'ong zer ba na/ mnal sad pa'i tshe/ rje bla ma nyid kyi thugs la/ bzhi thog gi nub kyi o mo o skyong gi klu de yin pa 'dra snyam du dgongs nas/ sa phyogs der bum gter 'jug pa dang / klu khang che chung mang po zhal bkod mdzad cing / thugs dam gtor ma yang yun ring mdzad pa'i rjes tsam la/ gdan sa chen po la gzhan gyis bsam sbyor ngan pa'i gtad khram bcug pa 'don pa'i dpa' mo yid ches can zhig byung ba des kyang / paṇ+ḍi tas bzhi thog gi nub kyi klu la kho rang gi zhus pa bzhin/ bdag rkyen mdzad pa de rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa 'grig pa byung 'dug klu de'i ming la klu rgyal chos kyi dge bsnyen ma zhes bya zhing / 'khor klu phrug bye ba 'bum sde yod pa de yin zhu ba byung bas/ thams cad yid ches kyi gnas su gyur pa zhig byung ba 'di lta bu ni/ sngon rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan zhal bzhugs pa'i dus/ sa pho 'brug gi lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu'i tho rangs rje btsun rin po che'i spyan sngar/

khye'u chung shel gyi thor gtsug can la g.yu'i gtsug phud can zhig byung nas/ bla ma rin po che gsan dang / nged kyi pho brang gnas khang 'dir khyed kyis pho brang brtsigs pa 'dis/ nged klu'i rigs thams cad la gnod pa shin tu che ba zhig byung bas/ klu la la non/ la la bsnad/ la la zha/ la la gong por song / la la grum bur song / la la rengs/ la la brgyal/ da nged kyi sa spyad thams cad khyer/ klu'i pho brang gi thog tu khyod kyis lha'i gzhal yas khang bzhengs pas/ da nged la lus stobs med pas thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ nad thams cad bsal du gsol zer ba la/ rje btsun chen pos/ khye'u khyed klu'i sprul pa yin na/ khyed kyi rigs gang gi rigs yin/ ming ji skad bya ba yin/ 'khor g.yog ci tsam yod pa yin/ khyed bsnan pa rnams ji ltar gso gsungs pas/ khye'u chung gis gsol pa/ nga rigs ni bram ze'i rigs yin pas gtsang sbra shin tu che/ chos byed rnams kyi mched grogs byed cing ming gtsug na rin chen bya ba lags/ nged kyi lus kyi cha shas rnams la klu'i rigs dang 'khor g.yog yod tshul ni/ nged kyi lag pa g.yon par mkhar spe chu mig kha lho bltas na klu rgyal rigs gnas shing / nged kyi dpung pa g.yas pa la chu mig rdzing kha kha shar bltas na klu rje rigs gnas la/ nged kyi lag mthil g.yas la dga' spe'i byang logs la klu dmangs rigs gnas shing / nged kyi mjug ma sag sa chu mig la klu gdol pa'i rigs gnas la/ de rnams la yang klu rigs lnga lnga gnas shing / klu'i rgyal po re re yang yod la/ klu rgyal bdag gi snying kha dang gzugs po byin gyi steng na dpal ldan sa skya'i dgon gnas chen po 'di dag yod pas/ da nged klu rnams la phan pa'i phyir du slob dpon klu sgrub snying pos/ dge slong sa ri'i don du mdzad pa'i klu'i cho ga de/ rgyas pa zla ba re la re re mdzod/ bum gter gyi gter mang du tshud mdzod dang /

khyed rnams la bsod nams yar 'phel la 'gro yin zer nas mi snang bar song bar bshad pa dang tshul mtshungs pa 'di dag rmad du byung ba'i rnam thar du snang zhing / yang skye 'gro kun gyi skabs mgon dam pa 'di nyid kyis gdan sa 'dir skye bo'i tshogs la tshogs chen mo'i chos khrir dbang mo che zhig stsal pa'i tshe/ dbang de ma grol gyi bar la sbrul zhig chos khri chen mo'i rtsa bar khyil le 'khyil nas 'dug cing / chos nyan pa rnams gyes pa dang bstun/ sbrul de'ang lus kyi phyed tsam ke re re nub sgo phyogs su song nas chu dkyil du zhugs song ba skye bo mang pos mthong ba byung ba ni/ sngon 'phags pa rin po che dang / bzhi thog pa 'jam dbyangs chen po/ ti shrī kun blo/ bdag po ta dben kun rin pa sogs la chos khri thang dang / sag sa sogs su chos gsungs pa'i tshe/ klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen sbrul du sprul nas chos nyan par byung ba/ sa skya pa'i gdung rabs shar gling pa lo ston chos kyi 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i gdung rabs su bshad pa dang tshul mtshungs pas shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su snang mod/ yang rje nyid bde mchog tu bzhugs dus nyid kyis mdzad pa'i chab gtor klu gtor gyi yig cha'i steng nas thugs dam gtor ma thog ma rang mdzad pa'i nyin de kho na la/ gzhis kha chen po bsam 'grub rtse nas sa skyong mi'i dbang po karma phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis spyan 'dren gyi sku tshab seng ge sgang pa 'byor 'dug pa 'di ni/ sngon sa hor yon mchod du 'brel ba/ gzhi bdag klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen gyi mgo bo dpal ldan sa skya dang / mjug ma hor yul du slebs pa'i rten 'brel byung ba yig cha 'ga' zhig las bshad pa dang mtshungs par 'khum zhing / don la rje nyid kyi 'phrin las yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas pa 'di dag kyang gzhi bdag klu rgyal gyis sgrub par gor ma chag la/ yang mngon par mkhyen pa dang 'od gsal rgyun mi chad mnga' ba'i tshul ni/

rje 'di sku gzhon nu'i dus zhal lta mngon mkhyen dang 'dra ba thol byung du gsung ba zhig yod 'dug pa la/ lan gcig yab sras gzhan rnams bsam gling du lha mo mchod par phebs dus rgyal yum des/ de ring khong yab sras rnams la chibs rdab sogs mi 'ong ngam gsungs pa la/ nyid kyi zhal snga nas de 'dra mi 'ongs/ gcig gi lag pa la skyon byung dogs 'dug gsungs pa ltar byams legs zer ba'i chibs sga ba zhig rta rgyugs kyi rkyen gyis lag pa g.yas bud cing chag nas/ de nub gdan sar 'ong mi thub pa byung 'dug pa 'di 'dra'i rigs can mang du yod cing / de bzhin du 'od gsal mnga' ba'i tshul yang / rje nyid bzhi thog gzim mal na bzhugs pa'i skabs shig tho rangs kyi tshe la cung zad mnal ba'i ngang nas gzim chung mchod gral gyi rten gtso rje btsun rin po che'i sku 'dra'i zhal dkyil dang / lhag par spyan gyi dkar nag ma 'dres pa tshun chad nyin mo ltar gsal por gzigs pa dang / yang lan gcig 'od gsal gyi ngang nas rgya nag lha khang gi rten mchod gzhan rnams dang / lhag par 'jam dbyangs seng ge la chibs pa/ g.yang kris khri rgyab byas pa 'di gzhan las gsal bar gzigs shing / yang skabs gcig ja khang gi ma chen bsod nams rdo rje sdod sa'i sgam gyi dngos po phra rags thams cad 'od gsal gyi ngang nas gsal bar gzigs te/ nangs par ma chen la bka' stsal pas/ de nyid ha las par gyur pa sogs 'di 'dra'i lo rgyus kyang mang du yod cing / gzhan yang rje btsun sa skya pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa zab mo dmar po skor gsum gyi man ngag la nyams bzhes mdzad pa las/ lha de gsum gyi zhal bstan te thun mong ba'i dngos grub stsal ba'i tshul gyi mtshan ltas khyad par can mang du snang ba yin te/ lan gcig bzhi thog yang rtser/ ku ru kul+le dang tshogs bdag gi bsnyen sgrub rgyun mi thung tsam zhig mdzad pa'i tshe/ tho rangs kyi cha zhig mnal lam du khang pa gcig gi tshoms chen mo zhig nas dkar smug gis khrig mer gyis gang ba dang /

de'i steng gi gsang g.yab kyi logs la tshogs bdag gi sku pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ phyag drug tsam byas pa zhig logs bris kyi tshul du 'dug pa de'i spyan khra hrig hrig mche ba skya gzing gzing byed pa zhig byung snang zhing / de ni gtsang dus kyi skabs la lo mthong bkra shis sbug sogs dang / dus phyis lha sa gzhung yongs rdzogs/ bkra shis sgang dang bcas pa mchod yon gyi phyag nas chos gzhis su gsar du byung ba 'di la lta rgyu yin pa 'dra gsungs pa dang / yang rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid kyis/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyi chos skor yongs rdzogs gsan 'phral nas bzung / bzhi thog bla brang gi lho phyogs der rnam sras mgon khang zhig gsar du mdzad nas spyan gzigs gtor gzhi sogs dang bcas sku rkyang gis thugs dam skabs skabs su gnang ba zhig yod pa la/ lan gcig rgyus yod kyi rkun ma ngan pa zhig gis spyan gzigs snyan dar sogs thams cad khyer kyang / 'on kyang rten 'brel gyi dbang gis mkhan chen rin po ches rnam sras la bka' bsgo 'dri bar mdzad pa'i snyan dar ser po zhig dang / rje nyid la mus chen gyis gnang ba'i sog po kha rtags khyad 'phags shig der 'bul bar mdzad pa de gnyis tsam lus 'dug pa byung ba nas bzung rgyang tsam gtor gzhi 'dzugs pa gnang ma thub pa'i skabs/ mnal lam du bskul ma ngo mtshar can zhig byung bar brten/ gzhi thog gi shar gyi dkar mo nyi zla'i mgon khang dngos grub gling dang nye ba'i char rnam sras mgon khang gsar du zhal bkod gnang ste/ spyan gzigs gtor tshogs sogs zab pa dang / tshes bzhi la dus gtor gyi rgyun 'dzugs par mdzad pa nas bzung / rta bdag ku bhai ras 'phrin las sgrub pa'i tshul gyis rje nyid kyi chibs pa rnams je 'phel du gyur te/ da lta rang grangs mang zhing bzang ba rtog dpyod dang ldan pa'i skye bo kun gyi thugs la gsal zhing sgrog pa 'di yang rmad du byung ba'i rnam thar du 'khums shing /

gzhan yang bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dgyes pa'i mtshan ma ni/ rje mus chen la bla med kyi dbang gi thog ma bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang gsan pa'i nub mo mnal lam du rje rang nyid ljon shing gis mtha' bskor ba'i skyed mos tshal zhig na bzhugs pa'i mod la/ de ma thag sa skya'i lha khang chen mo'i shar phyogs seng ldeng sgo khra'i thad der/ bla ma gong ma'i phyag dril dril smyon du grags pa de dkrol bar mdzad pas/ de'i skad kyis lha khang chen mo mer gyis khengs pa snyam byed pa zhig byung gsungs pa 'di ni/ thog mar bde mchog pho brang du 'khor lo bde mchog nag po lugs kyi gsung bsnyen mdzad pa dang / dus phyis dpal sa skya'i lugs gnyis kyi phun tshogs dpal ldan 'phags pa'i rnam thar la 'gran bzod pa lta bu 'di bzhin 'byung ba'i mtshan ltas ngo mtshar can du snang zhing / yang glang lo dbu rtse rnying mar lam 'bras rgyas pa gnang ba'i tshe/ nyid kyi mnal lam du chos khri rnying ma zhig gi logs bris la rdul phyis mdzad pas gong ma lnga'i sku byin rlabs che che 'dra ba zhig gsal lam gyis byung gsungs pa dang / de bzhin du lha chen phun tshogs gling gi gnyer khang steng gi tshoms kyi logs la sngags 'chang chen po glang po che la chibs pa zhig dri mas gos 'dug pa 'khrud par mdzad pas shin tu gsal bar gyur pa cig byung gsungs pa ni/ gdan sa khyad par can 'dir yab chos kyi gtso bo gsung ngag rin po che rgyas par gsungs pas/ bstan pa'i rgyun gsal bar gyur pa la rje btsun gong ma rnams dgyes pa'i mtshan ma yang dag par snang zhing / de lo gsung chos tshugs pa'i nyin kho na la char thog ma babs pas/ sos char snga ba'i tshad thub pa dang / sa skya tshogs su chos khri chen mo'i steng nas sems bskyed chen mo gnang ba'i tshe yang / dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i lha klu gzhi bdag gi cho 'phrul gyis char 'bab lugs gzhan las ngo mtshar ba byung ba dang /

gzhan yang nam mkha' thang zhod ran pas/ de lo rang gdan sa chen po lo legs shing / de skabs kyi tsher bong che ba tsam rgan sus kyang mi dran pas ngo mtshar du 'dzin par gyur pa dang / yang bdag nyid chen po 'dis sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung rab gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dkyil chog gi mchan bu ma dag pa'i zhus dag mdzad pa'i tshe/ nyid kyi mnal lam du rje mus chen nyid na bza' gsar pa kho na dang bcas thugs dgyes nyams chen pos/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs shig gnang byung ba'i mod la/ nam mkha' nas rin po che las grub pa'i gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ ba dan sogs kyi char babs byung ba na/ rje nyid kyis kyang thugs la ya mtshan che ba la dgongs shing / phyag gis gang zin mdzad pas rin po che'i gdugs shig phyag tu bab byung bas de'i mod la mnal sad pa'i snang ba byung gsungs pa 'di ni cho ga ma dag pa dag par sgrub pa la bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha mnyes shing / dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams kyis legs so'i mchod pa phul ba'i dge mtshan du rtogs la/ yang rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs rje btsun mus pa chen po'i drung du nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs thog mar de nangs par gsan rgyu'i do nub dang / mkha' spyod ma'i 'pho ba chig brgyud de sang nyin gnang 'ong ba de gnyis kyi nub snga ma gnyis la mtshan ltas gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa re byung snang yang / thun mong du bri bar ma gnang bas 'dir 'bri bar ma nus so/ /gzhan yang bdag nyid chen po 'di gzhan snang du rgyas 'khrugs la brten pa'i sku cung zad bro 'tshal ba na/ de las dwangs par nye ba'i tshe/ nyid kyi zhabs 'bring pa chen po rab 'byams smra ba bsod nams 'od zer dang / ma chen bsod nams rdo rje gnyis zhabs drung na yod pa las/ tho rangs kyi cha zhig rje nyid sku bsnyes pa las krong gis bzhengs nas/ gsung lab mang du mdzad byung ba'i tshe/

khong gnyis 'tshab ste/ sku mi bde ba min lags sam zhus pas/ mi bde ba med/ da lta chos rgyal 'phags pa byon nas/ nged kyi phyogs bzhir phebs nas bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad re re gsung ba gsal bar byung bas/ dga' ches te phyag bya dgos snyam langs pa'i snang ba zhig byung ba yin gsung ba byung 'dug pa/ 'di lta bu ni rje btsun gong ma rang nyid kyi bstan pa srid mthar mi nub cing gnas pa'i phyir du bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa 'di dus min 'chi ba'i bar chad las bzlogs nas/ sku tshe dang mdzad pa 'phrin las thams cad mthar phyin te/ spyi dang bye brag gi bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel rgyas su mdzad pa'i rten 'brel zab mo rang 'grig tu 'gyur bar byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma khyad par can du snang zhing / yang rje nyid kyis grub pa'i mtshan ma bstan pa'i tshul yang / bde mchog pho brang du gdan chags pa'i skabs shig de'i shar phyogs kyi skor lam gyi stod kyi grog po de'i phur brag rdo dkar po chen po zhig la phyag sor drud pa'i rjes shin tu gsal ba dang / de'i mtshams nas chu khyor ba do tsam zhig nyil gyis byung ba rdo ba de'i ngos la skam pa'i shul sram me ba yod pa zhig byung ba la/ re zhig na gdan sa'i dan khrod kyi skya ser rnams kyis rim gyis rig nas/ rdo de la byin rlabs zhu ba dang / steng du dkar gong gi phung po 'bul ba sogs byas pas snyan grags ber lang nas/ slar lha sa gzhung dang / gdong ga gzhung sogs nas ched gtad mjal mi gdan sa skor chen pa bzhin mang du byung ste/ grog po de la rgya lam lta bu'i lam skya shar re ba dod pa zhig byung ba na/ sku 'khor ba rnams kyis de'i tshul rje nyid la zhus pa'i tshe/ nyid kyi gsung las/ de 'dra dgod bro/ nged kyi grub rtags lta ga la zhig ste/ rdo ba de gang na yod kyi rgyus kyang med mod/ 'on kyang deng sang gtor ma brgya rtsa 'di la brtson par byas pas/

gzugs med rnams gtor mas tshim ste/ ri bong cal sgrogs 'dra ba'i snyan grags kyi lugs de bzhin/ khong mi ma yin rnams kyis bsgrags pa ni yin tshod du 'dug gsung ba byung 'dug pa ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'di yon tan sba ba gtso bor mdzad pa kun gyi thugs la gsal ba ltar/ 'dir yang grub pa'i mtshan ma bstan pa zhal gyis ma bzhes pa tsam yin mod kyi/ don la sra ba'i brag la phyag rjes dang / skam sar chu 'don par mdzad pa'i grub pa'i rtags mtshan bstan pa la yid gnyis bya dgos pa ma yin mod/ de lta na yang zhabs drung na gnas pa rnams kyis 'di'i tshul bsnyad pa na/ rje nyid ha cang thugs dgyes rgyu med pa'i rnam pa ston pas sus kyang bdag rkyen ma nus pa'i ngang nas/ dbyar dus shā chen po bab pa'i rkyen gyis sa rdo gzhan gyi 'og tu thim nas/ da lta ni grub rtags gnang ba'i brag de dngos su gsal ba zhig ma nges la/ gzhan yang bstan pa rin po che'i rgyun srid mthar gnas pa'i phyir gdung sras myur du 'byung ba'i slad du yol mo sprul sku'i drung gi mtshan ltas lung bstan dang mthun par/ bsam gling mgon khang du dmag zor rgyal mo la gtor gzhi thog tshad ma gnyis 'dzugs par mdzad de/ dgongs bzhed kyi 'phrin bcol drag tu mdzad pa dang / de dang dus mtshungs par kha'u bskyed lhas su yang sgam gtor gsar pa gnyis mdzad de/ rje nyid dgung lo bzhi bcur phebs pa byi glang gnyis kyi ngo la gdung sras 'byon pa'i 'phrin las bcol ba mdzad pa na/ nyid kyi dgongs bzhed chos skyong rnams kyis bsgrubs te/ thugs sras dam pa 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug 'di nyid stag lo gegs med du 'khrungs pa yin zhing / de'i sngon rol tsam du bsam gling mgon khang gi rje nyid kyi bzhugs gdan gyi steng du byi bas tshang bcas pa la byi phrug kyang gegs med du mgo thon pa'i dge mtshan gyi rtags de bzhin byung ba la kun kyang ya mtshan du 'dzin pa byung zhing /

de dang mthun par rje nyid dgung lo nga lngar phebs pa lcags mo yos kyi lo 'di la yang rje dpon slob rnams kyis kha'ur rgyun gyi thugs dam bskang gso la phebs pa'i tshe/ sngar skyed lhas su 'dzugs par mdzad pa'i sgam gtor de stegs mtho zhing sgam sgo dam pas nang der byi la 'jug nus pa'i dogs pa tsam yang med pa la/ mchod dpon gyis gtor kha gso bar brtsams pa'i tshe/ chos skyong rang gi rnam 'phrul gyi rnam pas gtor ma'i rgyab nas byi ba pha ma gnyis dang / phru gu gnyis te bzhi rim gyis thon byung ba na/ gtor ma la gnod pa byas yod snyam bltas pa'i tshe/ dkar rgyan zos pa tsam ma gtogs/ gtor ma'i snying po dang mtheb kyu tshun chad/ skyon med du khrig ge 'dug pa mthong ba na/ e ma ngo mtshar che snyam dpon slob rnams la zhus pa'i tshe/ nyid kyi gsung las/ sngar bsam gling du de bzhin byung ba'i gnas tshul rnams bstsal nas/ lod rgyu rang cher med dam gsung ba byung 'dug pa bzhin/ slar ston chen mkhas pa dag gi ding chen sogs rtse sdur mdzad pas kyang / de ni mi legs pa gtan min zhing / shin tu legs pa'i dge mtshan gyi ltas yin tshul bab 'dug pa bzhin/ slar yang rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras 'di dag las sa skya pa'i gdung rigs dri ma med pa gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi la sogs pa rim gyis je mang du 'phel te/ ji srid bstan pa gnas kyi bar de srid du gdung brgyud rin po che'i rgyun yang bar ma chad par byon te spyi dang bye brag gi bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad cing / 'dzam bu gling gi sa la spyod pa'i skye dgu kun gyi skabs gcig mchod yul dam par 'gyur ba'i dge mtshan gyi ltas gsar du shar ba 'di ni 'dren mchog dam pa 'di'i rjes su slob pa dang / rang cag kun kyang dga' ba dang spro ba rgya chen pos kun tu bya dga' chen po'i dpal la spyod par 'os pa'i gnas su snang ngo /

/de ltar gong du bkod pa de rnams ni gsung las dngos su thos pa dang / rang gi rtog par chug cing nges shes skyes pa du ma dang / rigs brgya'i khyab bdag chen po 'di nyid kyis rgyun par spyan zung ut+pal gyi ze'u 'brur 'dren bzhin pa'i phyag dpe rnams kyi mjug sogs na thugs dam nyams rtogs 'khrungs tshul dang / mtshan ltas khyad par can byung tshul rnams snyel tho'i tshul du 'debs par mdzad pa'i phyag bris dngos ma du ma dang / gsung rtsom rnams kyi gseb tshegs su yang mang du gsungs pa de rnams las mdo tsam zhig btus nas bris pa yin gyi/ zhib tu shes par 'dod na/ de dag la 'dren byed bung ba zung ldan gyis legs par bltas shing / blo gros kyi pad tshal rab tu bzhad pas zhib mor dpyad de khong du chud par bya'o/ /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ mgon khyod sngon nas goms pa'i legs byas dang / /gzhan dang mnyam pa med pa'i snying stobs kyis/ /zab mo'i lam la gcig tu 'grus pa'i mthus/ /grangs med yi dam lha dang bla ma'i tshogs/ /bstan skyong sbyin bdag pho mo dang bcas pas/ /'bad dang rtsol ba'i ngal ba mi dgos par/ /grub gnyis 'jo ba'i ya mtshan ltad mo'i gar/ /nyams dang rmi lam na yang ma sgrib gsal/ /gang gis bi rū gzi 'bar gsal ba'i spyan/ /bla chen snying pos ngan pa'i zla dbang las/ /mig bcas bdun cu'i man ngag zer rnyed par/ /phrag dog nyid kyis mtshan mo'ang gzigs pa 'dra/ /dharmā pha la zlos pa snying po'i zhal/ /blta 'dod rin chen phung por spungs pa'i sgang / /lkog na gsal zhes rmad byung snyan pa'i gtam/ /snyan sgor lhung tshe dga' spro'i rnam 'phrul brel/ /phyi nas brtse chen bla ma'i rnam thar la/ /'gong pa min yang de yi rjes su 'gro/ /rin chen zhes pa'i brda las dgos dgu'i rdzas/ /ma bsdus 'du ba'i dge mtshan dus der gzigs/ /dbang po'i grangs ldan bla mar dad gus kyi/

/chu mtsho 'khyil las bstod tshig 'dab brgya pa/ /rgod pas thugs phrogs bla chen ngang mo'i tshogs/ /phun tshogs bag phebs 'dzum gyi me tog lhod/ /'jam mgon skad gnyis smra ba'i dgyes sgrogs gtam/ /gsung ngag lam gyi dga' ston 'jo ba'i tshe/ /dpyod ldan yongs la sgrogs zhes dgyes pa'i gsung / /khyod kyi sgra 'dzin yol gor bdud rtsir 'khyil/ /rmi lam sbyong spel gnad kyi gshog yangs kyis/ /kun gsal dbyings su 'dab ldan dbang po bzhin/ /lding ba'i ye shes spyan gyis sems dpa' che'i/ /zhabs stegs ngal gsor 'os kyang ring du 'phur/ /ye shes ḍāk+ki tha mal mdzes pa'i zol/ /'khyud dang tsum bha'i bde chen ye shes ros/ /rjes su bskyangs phyir lang tsho ngom mthong nas/ /mnyam sbyar lding bas grub chen dril bur 'gong / /khyod thugs dad pa'i zla dbang bsil zer gyis/ /mus chen mkhyen brtse'i ku mud bzhad pa las/ /gshed dmar dbang gi sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston dang / /rnam mang bka' mchid mtshan mo'i lam na'ang mol/ /mtshan dus grub pa'i dpa' bos nag po che'i/ /dbang bskur mdzes pa'i me tog sil ma'i phreng / /rnam dpyod dbu la reg pa'i rab dga' de/ /ma bzod bstod dbyangs nyin mor byed na mtshar/ /ma lus yon tan sbas kyang cher gsal ba'i/ /grags pa'i ba dan g.yo ba yab kyi zol/ /blo gros des pos kun tu phan 'dom la/ /g.yel ba mi mnga'i dge mtshan ci yang gsal/ /de lta'i mtshan lam ngo mtshar ltad mo'i dpyid/ /blo ldan dad pa'i mig gis blta 'dod na/ /ri mor byas pa'i me long 'di ltos dang / /rmad byung rnam bkra'i gzugs mang gsal bar mthong // ༈ //spyi don bdun pa bla ma dang chos skyong gi lung bstan bzhin yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i rgyal srid la dbang bsgyur ba'i chos kyi khrir zhabs sen dbang gi rgyal po ji ltar bkod pa'i tshul ni/ gong du bkod pa ltar rje 'di dgung lo bcu dgu pa'i dus mtshan ltas la/

nyid kyi yab rje chos kyi rgyal pos sgo rum pa'i mgon gyi snyan dar thams cad rang nyid la rtsis sprod gnang ba'i mtshan ltas dang / de dus mus chen gyi gsung las kyang rmi lam shin tu bzang / rigs kyi bu la brgyud kyi lha 'go zer ba der gda'/ byed pa mis byed kyang mdun ma lhas bsgyur ba zhig dgos pa yin/ khyed rang bsod nams che bas thams cad dbang du 'du zhing / dpal 'byor longs spyod kyang blos mi 'khyud pa tsam dang / sa skya pa'i rigs kun gyis re ltos 'chol ba zhig 'ongs zhes gsungs pa sogs dang / yab rje chos kyi rgyal pos rje nyid la gdan sa'i 'khur bzhes dang gdung spel mdzad dgos tshul dang / de yang bsam yas chos skyong gis de bzhin legs pa'i lung bstan byung tshul/ nyid kyis byams pa'i sku brnyan yab rjer phul bas/ rten 'brel bzang byams pa'i bstan pa nam shar bar gdung spel byas sdod pa'i rten 'brel yin gsungs pa sogs dngos kyis bka' stsal pa dag dang / yab rje de nyid kyis rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i rten bzhengs gnang skabs/ nged kyi rten bzhengs blo la yod pa bzhin rdzogs pa'i mjug khyed kyis bsgril dgos pa yong zhes yang yang gsungs pa dang / yab rje zhing gzhan du ma gshegs tsam pa'i gong der/ ngos ni nyer dgu'i zla bar 'dug bstan pa dang gdan sa'i 'dzin skyong las khag che ba mi 'dug pa sogs zhib cha mtha' dag ngos kyi gleng ba ltar yin pas/ sa skya zer ba'i ming yong mong la rgyas byung bas/ 'dzin skyong spel gsum la blo khur bskyed pa rang gal che che zhes gsung 'phrin du gnang ba rnams dang / 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo bsod nams dbang pos kyang / da ni gdan sa'i khur 'di khyed rang gis ma byas na mi 'thus tshul sku dngos kyis bka' stsal pa dang / de dang mthun pa'i thugs dam gsung shog kyang rim pa mang du gnang ba sogs bla ma rnams kyi lung bstan yid ches can mang du byung ba rnams gzod mngon du gyur pa yin te/

de yang rang cag gi yongs 'dzin bslu med dam pa 'di nyid dgung lo bcu phrag gnyis su bzhis lhag pa lcags pho spre'u'i lo hor lugs zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bco brgyad kyi nub mo nyid kyi gcen sems dpa' chen po sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal glo bur du zhing brjes pa la brten/ rje nyid kyi yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams kyis ji ltar lung bstan pa bzhin dus la bab ste/ gdan sa chen po'i bka' bgros la dbang ba'i chen po rnams dang / bla ma slob dpon sogs skya ser thams cad mgrin gcig pas/ gdan sa'i 'dzin skyong gnang dgos par gsol ba dang / khyad par grub mchog dbang po'i gsung gis/ da ni gdan sa'i khur 'di khyed rang gis byed dgos tshul nan gyis phebs pa dang / gzhis ka chen po bsam grub rtse nas stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba mi dbang karma phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis bstan 'gro la dgongs pa'i thugs bskyed de bzhin gnang dgos pa'i snyan 'bul nan bskyed byung bar brten/ bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid spyir sku na shin tu phra mo'i tshe yang chos kyi bag chags ches che ba'i stobs kyis bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs te/ sku tshe hril po bshad sgrub kyis dus 'da' ba zhig bzhed kyang / dus kyi dbang las bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin pa zhig rang ngos nas ngal ba lhur len ma bgyis na/ spyir bod khams kyi bde skyid dang / bstan pa yongs/ khyad par sa skya pa rang gi rtsa ba stong pa lta bu la nye bas na/ da ni kho bo'i rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi lung bstan bka' chems kyi tshul du phebs pa rnams dang mthun par/ bstan 'gro spyi dang bye brag gi phan bde'i ched dang / rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma gong ma ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnams kyi thugs dgongs chos kyi dbyings su rdzogs pa'i phyir dang / lhag par dpal sa skya'i sde bstan pa dang gdung brgyud dang bcas pa thugs khongs su bcangs te/
