bdag nyid zhi ba dang bde ba'i blo rgyang ring du dor/ theg chen thugs bskyed kyi cho ga bzang pos klubs nas/ chos dang srid kyis bsdus pa'i mdzad 'phrin rma med pa'i khur chen po lhag bsam rmad du byung ba'i phrag par 'khyer bzod pa mdzad pa yin la/ de dus rje 'di'i mtshan lam zhig la/ da lta'i rig 'dzin pho brang 'di yin dgongs pa la/ rnam pa bang rim mang po byas pa'i khang brtsegs shig la zhabs 'bring ba mang po dang bcas zhabs skor mdzad kyin rim gyis 'dzegs nas phebs kyi 'dug pa na/ lam bar de na 'bag gyon pa 'dra ba la rngam zil che ba mang po 'dus nas gar 'chams 'dra ba zhig byed pa'i khrod nas gcig na re/ chos 'khor lhun po'i rje drung byams pa rdo rje myur du gshegs 'gro ba 'dug pas/ de'i gshegs rdzong gi tshogs dbu la rje nyid phebs dgos zhu ba zhig byung nas/ de nas nangs par nyid kyis zhabs 'bring ba chen po rab 'byams smra ba bsod nams 'od zer la rmi lam 'di bzhin byung / de bzhin dgos pa'i rgyu med/ rmi lam la gtad pa med gsungs 'dug kyang / de nas mi ring bar nyid kyi gcen po rgyal sras ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal zhing gshegs pa dang sgo mtshungs par rje byams pa rdo rje ba yang sku gshegs te/ gdan sa chen po'i tshogs chen gyis kun rig gi cho ga zhus pa'i tshogs dbu la rje 'di phebs dgos pa byung zhing / de'i tshe snga dro cho ga'i brdar mkhar rnga mi yong tsam pa la/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug gi ban gtsang bla ma las chen rin chen chos 'phel grwa shar gyi skabs kyi cha lugs 'dra ba'i ban+de zhig lag na bkra shis kha btags thogs nas/ rje 'di'i gzim chung du thal te byung nas phyag 'tshal te dar de rje 'di'i phyag tu phul/ spyan 'dren la 'ong ba'i tshul byas nas phyir thon song ba na/ de ma thag mnal sad/ mkhar rnga yang bskul byung / de ni lha khang rgyal po'i bsu ba'i rnam pa yin pa 'dra zhes rje nyid gsungs so/

/de nas bdag nyid kyi gcen sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal gyi thugs dam gsal 'debs su kye rdo rje'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te sgrub cing mchod pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa brgya phrag tsam gyis bsgrubs pa dang / gzhan yang yul phyogs gzhan gyi dgon che phran mang po la mang ja zang zing gi dngos 'gyed dang bcas pa mang du stsal cing / dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi'i skabs kyi tshogs dbur 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dbang po'i mtshan can spyan 'dren par mdzad nas/ gdan sa chen po'i tshogs chen mor gzhis byes kyi dge 'dun khri khrag tu longs pa dang / skye bo'i tshogs bgrang ba las 'das pa la rnyed bkur sbyin gtong rgya chen po dang / grub mchog dbang po'i mtshan can du 'bul nod kyi dngos po dpag tu med pa dang bcas bsgrubs te/ de nas bzung lo zla'i dus dran gyi mchod 'bul du bla ma mchod chog rgyud 'don/ sgrub mchod sogs da lta'i bar du ma nyams par mdzad pa yin la/ de nas rje nyid dgung lo nyer lngar phebs pa lcags mo bya'i lo zla ba drug pa'i nang du grub mchog dbang po'i mtshan can nyid gdan sa chen po 'di nyid du rgyun mi thung tsam bzhugs dus/ thugs shin tu dgyes pa'i ngang nas/ rje 'di dang thugs yid gcig 'dres kyi legs lam las/ sngar su la yang ma gnang ba'i tshe sgrub zab mo chig brgyud ma gnyis dang / lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor zab khyad can sogs zab chos kyang mtha' dag gsan cing / gzhan yang rje 'dis 'phral dang yun gyi bslab bya gang spyi thams cad zhu ba mdzad par/ grub pa'i dbang phyug des kyang thugs mchog tu dgyes pa'i gsung gis/ spyir thugs dkyil nas bzhar ba'i bslab ston 'di phyi kun tu phan pa'i tshogs du ma dang / lhag par bstan pa'i rtsa ba gdan sa chen po'i lugs gnyis kyi 'dzin skyong spel gsum 'chug mi 'chug khyed rang la rag las pas/

gang spyi'i spang blang 'di bzhin gyis shig pa sogs lhug stsol du gnang ba na/ rje 'di'i thugs la shin tu 'jebs pa'i rang bzhin kho nar gyur pas gus zhen chabs cig tu 'khrungs shing / khyad par de'i mod la/ nga ni slob dpon pad+ma mkhyen bsam pa 'di kho na ma gtogs gzhan nyams len gang yang byed rgyu med gsungs pa gsan pa nas/ grub dbang de nyid slob dpon pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul yin par 'khrul med kyi yid ches thugs la 'khrungs te/ phyis su grub pa'i dbang phyug de'i rnam thar rje nyid kyis mdzad pa dang / nyams mgur gsol 'debs sogs kyi nang dang / gsung rtsom phal cher gyi mjug tu yang / grub pa'i slob dpon pad+ma ka ra dang / 'jam mgon dbang po'i mtshan can gnyis rnam dbyer med pa'i tshul 'di dag gsungs pa yin snang zhing / gzhan yang de dus yang dag dang / rdo rje phur pa'i smad las kyi rjes gnang yang gnang bzhed par yod pa la/ rtse gdong nas 'jam mgon dbang po'i mtshan can de nyid spyan 'dren gyi zhu gsol nan ches par brten/ rje de nyid glo bur du shar la phebs dgos shar ba'i tshe/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya mtha' dag gus pas zhu ba mdzad pa bzhin/ des kyang gang spyi'i bslab ston lhug stsol dang / zhabs dbang chos skyong rnams la bka' bsgo rgyas pa dang bcas pa zhig gnang ste/ de nas chibs thog 'khyon nas 'gyang tsam rje 'dis phebs skyel mdzad/ dpon slob gyes kar rje des chibs kha nas phyag skyer mdzad de/ zhal 'dzum pa'i ring rang re myur du mjal yong / de bar thugs bzhugs spro bar mdzod/ ces gsungs nas phebs song ba na thugs shin tu 'phrang ba zhig byung zhes rje nyid gsungs so/ /de nas grub dbang de rtse gdong du phebs nas rgyun mi ring bar chab bdugs kyi nyen byas sku khams shin tu ma bde nas/ rje 'di'i sku khams skor mi zhig gnang ba'i lan du/

khri thog pa kun dga' bsod nams kyi gsung ris rten ldan 'byor pas gnas tshul nges par byung / khams la bde bskyed mi 'dug snying po'i don sa skya pa'i bstan pa 'di rtsa brlag la mi 'gro tsam zhig byed na/ sgar pas khams su bsdad gdung spel byas/ khyed rang gis 'dir gdung spel byas mi 'jug pa zhig byas na ma byas na rang 'dug pa dgongs 'tshal/ nged 'chi kha ma tsho la de'i byus dgongs rgyu mi 'dug rten mtshon dang bcas te 'phral du dge zhes pa'i gsung ris gzigs pas/ rje khu dbon ma mjal dogs pa'i thugs ma bde ba dang / zhal dkyil dran nas skyo shas chen po'i spyan chab kyang mang du shor ba zhig byung gsungs/ de nas mi ring bar 'jam dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can de nyid gdan sa chen po'i sde bstan pa gdung rgyud dang bcas pa thugs khos su bcangs pa'i skus mi lcogs bzhin du rtse gdong nas dge sdings su phebs te/ sprel lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ ma 'gyangs par rje 'dis dge sdings su sku gdung mjal ba sogs la phebs pa'i tshes bcu gnyis kyi nyin thugs dam grol ba'i tshe/ dge sdings su phebs 'byor byung / de nyid nam mkha' dwangs pa la me tog gi char pa dang / 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang dbyibs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa nam mkha'i khyon thams cad gang ba nyi ma ma nub kyi bar du byung bas/ rje der thugs dad sngar bas kyang lhag par 'phel te/ sku gdung rin po che'i drung du dkar me zhal zas mchod yon snyan dar sogs mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pa phul/ lam zab bla ma rin 'byung la thun du bcad nas/ maṇ+ḍal/ phyag 'tshal/ gsol 'debs/ bshags pa/ smon lam sogs grangs med pa zhig nyi ma du ma'i bar du mdzad pas/ sku gdung las dri bzang 'thul ba dang / rje nyid la sku sgrib dag pa'i mtshan ma mngon gyur du byung nas/ 'dzam gling che dgu mar grags pa'i gsol 'debs bshags pa dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rnam thar mdor bsdus dang sbyar ba'i thugs rje 'khul che ba 'di yang mdzad/

sku gdung rin po che de nyid dge sdings bkra shis bsam grub tu mchod rten khang bu brtsegs pa zhig bzhengs te/ der dge 'dun bcu phrag tsam zhig mchod 'bul rgyun ma chad par 'bul ba dang bcas bzhugs su gsol/ de nas grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po de nyid kyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su dbus gtsang gi dgon gnas nyis brgya lhag tsam zhig la mang 'gyed bsngo rten tshan grangs sogs rgya dpangs shin tu che ba dang / de dang mtshungs par gdan sa chen por dge 'dun brgya phrag la nye ba tsam gyis bla med dkyil 'khor du ma zhal phye ste/ sgrub mchod zla ba gcig tsam gyi bar du bsgrubs rjes/ dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi'i tshe gdan sa chen po'i gtsug lag khang thams cad du dkar me snyan dar sogs mchod pa'i rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / bla ma slob dpon sogs zur 'bul 'os pa rnams la tshan grangs/ gzhis byes kyi dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs bgrang ba las 'das pa rnams la mang ja gdan non zab pa/ zang zing gi sbyin gtong blos mi 'khyud pa zhig sgrub par mdzad dus skya ser tshogs che bas/ sbyin gtong gi bya ba rnams nyin gcig la mi zin par gleng ba byung yang / grub dbang 'di nyid kyi thugs rje dang / rje nyid kyi dad gus kyi mthu brtas pa'i byin rlabs las/ nyi ma sngar bas yud tsam lnga tsam gyis ring bar gyur te/ bya ba thams cad nyi khongs su grub pas/ thams cad ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa zhig byung / de lta bu'i dgongs rdzogs rgya chen po bsgrubs pa rgan rabs su yang mi dran pas/ phyis kyi sa skya pa'i gdung rigs kyi mchod 'bul zhig la 'di kho na bzang zhing rgya che zhes skye bo kun mgrin gcig tu sgrog par gyur/ de nas rgyun mi ring bar bya lo zla ba lnga drug tsam nas mgo btsugs te/ bal po bzo rigs pa shin tu mkhas pa bcu phrag lhag tsam zhig la zhal bkod gnad zab che ba rnams dang /

mchod rten gyi thig gdab pa rje nyid kyis mdzad nas/ rje btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug de nyid kyi nang rten du rin chen dngul las grub pa'i rnam rgyal mchod rten rgya dpang che zhing / bzo khyad khyad par can phra rgyan rin po che du mas spras pa lta bas chog mi shes pa zhig dang / sku tshab gser zangs las grub pa'i sku tshad ma sogs rten bzhengs rgya chen po mdzad de/ sku gdung rin po che dge sdings nas spyan drangs/ dngul gdung khyad par can de nyid kyi nang rdzong gi gtso bor bzhugs/ gzhan yang gzungs dang byin rlabs kyi rigs tshad med pas sku tshab dang bcas pa phyur bur gtams pa'i gzungs rdzong tshul bzhin du phul/ rab tu gnas pas mnga' gsol te/ sku tshad ngo mtshar can de nyid dbu rtse'i lam 'bras brgyud pa'i grwar bzhugs su gsol/ dngul gdung yid bzhin nor bu de nyid ni bzhi thog bla brang gi rig 'dzin lha khang na/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i gdung rten gyi g.yas phyogs na mchod pa'i sprin spungs dpag tu med pa dang bcas bzhugs shing / gzhan yang dus rgyun gyi mchod par kye rdor rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi rgyud 'don/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i sgrub mchod/ bla ma mchod chog rnams nar mar bsgrubs pa dang / khyad par lo dus kyi mchod 'bul la dgongs te/ rdo rje bdag med ma'i sgrub dkyil gyi yig cha yang rje nyid kyis gsar du mdzad nas/ khyi lo'i dus dran gyi mchod pa'i tshe gsar du btsugs te/ da lta yang dar rgyas su yod pa sogs mdor na rang gzhan gyi lus longs spyod thams cad 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo de nyid kyi dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs pa'i thabs la rtag 'grus su mdzad pa 'dir snang zhing / de nas lo de'i nang du spyir gangs ri can gyi ljongs 'di'i bstan 'gro yongs kyi phan bde dang / khyad par dpal sa skya pa'i bstan pa dri ma med pa'i rtsa ba 'od gsal lha las babs pa'i gdung brgyud rin po che mi nyams shing spel ba'i dgos pa khyad par can gyi ched du bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa dang /

dge tshul gyi bslab pa ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsrung bar zhal gyis 'ches pa de nyid/ de las nyams pa dang / phyis blang du med pa sogs kyi nyes pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba rang nas bshad pa ltar gyi bslab pa 'bul ba'i cho ga dbu rtse rnying ma'i 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba dang / sngar rab byung gnang dus dbu'i gtsug phud phul ba'i/ chos rje sa paṇa gyi dus kyi thub dbang rdo rje gdan chung ma gnyis stabs gcig tu bzhugs pa'i drung du mchod pa rgya chen po bshams te/ chos rgyal 'phags pa'i slob ma rgya byang seng gis mdzad pa'i 'dul ba'i 'grel pa dang mthun par bslab pa 'bul chog gi gsal byed rje rang nyid kyis gsar du gnang ba de'i steng nas 'bul chog tshul bzhin du mdzad de/ yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i brtul zhugs legs par bzung / dpal ldan sa skya'i sde bstan pa gdung rgyud dang bcas pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi thugs kyi khur chen 'degs bzod par mdzad/ dus de tsam nas rje btsun sa skya pa'i lugs gnyis kyi phun sum tshogs pa chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan 'phags pa'i mdzad 'phrin la 'gran bzod pa 'di'i dbu tshugs pa yin no/ /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ bde gshegs dbyings su gzims nas rab bgrang stong / /gnyis dang brgya lnga'i mtshan mo 'das pa'i tshe/ /chos kyi nyin byed 'char zhes bka'i lung bstan/ /dmar ba'i 'od 'phreng gsal ba kha ba'i ljongs/ /gang gi bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag gcig pu dang / /mkhas grub dpyid kyi pho nya legs bshad kyi/ /ca co snyan sgrogs nor 'dzin dkar po'i tshal/ /byed por khyod nyid rnam gsum 'dren pas bsngags/ /lung bstan bdud rtsis myos pa'i blo gros che/ /stobs ldan 'chi med dbang po'i gnyis 'thung khyod/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i sna zhags ring po yis/ /chos min 'dam bu'i grong 'joms legs byas las/

/yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i khur 'di 'degs bzod na/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i mchod par 'di mchog ces/ /gangs ri'i mgon po zhi 'tsho grags pa'i mtshan/ /lhug par 'doms pa'i ljags kyi ba dan brel/ /'khor lo sdom pa yang dag bshes kyi zol/ /bud+dha dh+wa dzas mgon khyod ring min dus/ /grangs med 'gro la phan bde'i dpal 'jo ba'i/ /rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas su 'gyur zhes gsungs/ /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bos phyi rabs dus/ /skye dgu'i skyabs mgon gcig pur khyod mtho zhes/ /bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i dbyar gyi rnga chen sgras/ /skal bzang mdongs ldan snying la sim pa sbyin/ /de lta'i bka' chems dkar po'i ba dan bzhin/ /lha min nyes brgya'i g.yul las dkar phyogs lha/ /rgyal ba'i dga' ston rgyal mtshan phan bde'i gos/ /rnam bkra nor bu'i tog mdzes 'di na mtho/ /da dung srid 'di ma stong de srid du/ /legs byas dar gyi lhab lhub g.yo bzhin du/ /chos srid mi nub rtag par dge ba yi/ /rdo rje'i srog shing rab tu brtan gyur cig/ ༈ //spyi don brgyad pa de ltar sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa sogs spyir bstan pa'i bgyi ba rlabs po che ji ltar bskrun pa'i tshul ni/ de ltar rang cag rnams kyi rnam 'dren mtshungs pa ma mchis pa 'di nyid kyis/ 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo bsod nams dbang po'i nang rten dngul gdung rin po che bzhengs pa'i dus der/ rje nyid la bka' drin gzhan dang mtshungs pa med pa'i rnam 'dren dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' dang rnam dbyer med par gzigs pa'i rje btsun mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams kyi thugs dgongs zab mo chos kyi dbyings su rdzogs pa'i phyir dang / rgyal yum dam pa lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo'i dgongs rdzogs su dmigs te/

yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i nang rten du dngul gdung rin po che ngo mtshar can/ 'jam mgon dbang po'i mtshan can gyi gdung rten dang rgya dpang mnyam pa zhig dang / rje mus pa chen po'i sku tshab tu dngul gar bu lugs su byas pa/ rgyal yum dam pa'i gdung rten thog tshad tsam pa zhig la sogs pa rnams/ blo ngan zhes pa lcags mo bya'i lo zla ba drug pa'i gza' skar shis shing tshes grangs bzang ba la dbu btsugs/ nyid kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gsum gyi thugs rje las byung ba'i rnam 'phrul bal po'i rigs byed pa/ rat+na shing / dz+nyā na shing / dha lam shing / kye na shing / la dran/ ga na shing spun gsum ste brgyad dang / byang pa lha bzo ba re pa rnams kyis gus spro'i sgo nas bgyis te/ khyi lo nag pa zla ba'i khongs su gegs med du legs par grub nas/ zla ba bzhi pa sa kas nya ba'i dkar po'i phyogs gza' skar 'grub sbyor 'dzom pa'i nyin rab tu gnas pa rgyud sde nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin smin rgyas mdzad nas lha mi kun gyi bsod nams kyi zhing dam par dngul gdung yid bzhin nor bu de nyid ni/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i gdung rten gyi g.yon du bzhugs su gsol/ rje btsun mus pa'i dngul sku ngo mtshar can de nyid kyi gzim chung rten mchod kyi grwar spyan drangs te 'bral spangs su mdzad cing / rgyal yum dam pa'i gdung rten ni dbu rtse chen mor bzhugs su gsol ba 'di yin la/ de lta bu'i dngul gdung sogs kyi sku rgyu la/ zangs khal brgya dang bdun cu don gcig dngul khal bdun/ dngul chu zho bdun cu don gcig gser zho sum brgya dang lnga bcu nga gcig phra rgyan la g.yu'i rdo rje rgya gram gnyis/ g.yu'i nor bu 'bar ba gcig dang pad+ma gcig g.yu'i pad skor che chung 'dres pa dgu bcu go gcig mu tig rdog che zhing shin tu dngos gtsang ba nyis stong tsam/ g.yu'i rdo rje gnyis dang /

rdor 'dra bzhi/ gzhan g.yu che chung bsdoms pa nyis brgya tsam song ba'i phal cher gru dkar dmar dang / rgya g.yu rnying ma shas che bar snang zhing / yang bod 'dir rten byin rlabs che chung nang bzhugs la rag las par bla ma gong ma dag gsungs pa ltar/ rten la nang bzhugs nyid gtso che bar dgongs nas tshul bzhin du phul ba'i rnam grangs la/ 'jam dpal dbang po'i zhabs kyi dngul gdung dang sku brnyan gnyis kyi nang bzhugs gtso bo ni gong du bris pa ltar dang / gzhan yang sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ rgyal sras grags pa'i mtshan can/ rje mus chen gsum gyi sku gdung bungs che ba bzhugs shing / yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i nang rten dngul gdung rin po cher gzungs bzhugs kyi gtso bo yab rje de nyid kyi sku brnyan phyag nas stong tshar ma byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba gcig dang / de nyid zhal bzhugs dus rje 'di la gnang ba'i tshems ring bsrel 'byon bzhin pa gcig yab rje des rdo rje phur pa dang kye rdor gyi ljags bsnyen mdzad dus kyi dbu lo dang / zhal rgyan bub/ de nyid kyi ring bsrel che ba bdun/ de nyid kyi sku chos/ sku bem/ gsol glog rnams sku dreg can de nyid dang / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ rje mus chen gsum gyi sku gdung bungs che ba/ rje mus chen gyi sku chos/ dbu lo/ sngags 'chang chen pos sku gzan sbyar ma rnams dang / yang sku gzugs bris 'bur gyi rigs la/ slob dpon pad+ma'i sku brnyan gter ma 'khrul med gcig sngags 'chang chen po'i 'bral spangs mdzad pa'i sa lo'i sku brnyan dngos dang byin rlabs khyad par med pa gcig theg chen rin po che'i sku 'dra phyag nas ma ring bsrel 'byon bzhin pa gcig sogs 'bur sku byin rlabs can mang po dang / bris sku'i rigs la/ rje btsun chen po'i phyag bris 'khrul med kyi bris thang lam 'bras brgyud rim tshang ba ngo mtshar can gcig

sa lo'i sku brgya tshar bzhugs pa'i bris thang sngags 'chang chen po'i sku brnyan yang brgya tshar yod pa sa los phyag nas grangs med mdzad cing sngags 'chang chen pos bzhengs pa/ yang theg chen rin po che'i spur ras la sngags 'chang chen pos bzhengs pa'i sa lo'i bris sku byin rlabs can gcig rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i spur ras la sngags 'chang chen pos bzhengs pa'i sa lo dang rje dkon mchog lhun grub zhal sprod la lam 'bras nye brgyud kyis bskor ba'i bris thang / yang sa lo'i spur ras la sngags 'chang de nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i lam 'bras brgyud pa'i sku thang dgu gras gcig rje mus chen gyi bris sku phyag nas brgya tshar ma rje nyid kyis bzhengs pa gcig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bde mchog bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba bla ma dam pa'i phyag nas ma'i bris sku gcig sa lo dang sngags 'chang yab sras gsum gyis rdo rje phur pa dang kye rdor gyi ljags bsnyen mdzad dus kyi thugs dam rten phur pa dang kye rdor gyi bris sku re re/ 'jam dbyangs sku mched kyi phyag nas ma'i bde mchog dang kye rdor gyi bris sku re re sogs bris 'bur byin rlabs can bsam gyis mi khyab par bzhugs shing / rgyal yum dam pa'i nang rten la/ de nyid kyi gdung rus la sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyis phyag tsha gnang ba mang po dang / snga mor rje 'dis rgyal ba mus pa chen por phyag tsha zhus pa'i tshe/ gcig gis mang na dngul gdung nang du mi shongs shing / nyung na mi khengs pa'i skyon du 'gyur ba mngon par mkhyen nas/ brgyad las ma gnang ba phyis su gzungs rdzongs 'bul ba'i tshe de bzhin du byung ba'i phyag tsha rnams bzhugs su gsol/ yang rje nyid kyi rnam 'dren rje btsun mus chen gyi sku 'dra dngul sku ngo mtshar can de nyid kyi gzungs bzhugs kyi gtso bo la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung / slob dpon pad+ma'i gter sku bye ma a krong las grub pa de nyid las byon pa'i ring bsrel/

rje btsun chen po'i dbu thod la 'jam dbyangs kyi sku rang byon du byung ba'i dum bu/ rje btsun gyi tshems kyi dum bu/ gnam kha'u pa'i dbu thod la phyag rdor gyi sku dang a rang byon du 'khrungs pa'i dum bu/ chos rje sa paṇa/ bu ston rin po che/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rnams kyi ring bsrel/ rje mus chen de nyid kyi dbu thod kyi dum bu rnams dang / gzhan yang mus chen de'i dbu lo bubs/ sgom zhwa sku dreg chen po yod pa gcig rnams dang / gzhan yang 'phel gdung gi phye ma/ sa lo/ theg chen rin po che/ bdag chen grags blo ba/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan yab sras gsum gyi sku gdung btul ma sbyar ba'i ril bu/ rgya bod kyi mkhas grub phal cher gyi gdung dang dbu lo sbyar ba'i ril bu/ dgra bcom pa nyi ma gung pa/ bram ze mched bdun/ bse mkhar chung ba/ chos rje sa paṇa/ nyan chen pa/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge sems dpa' chen po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug bdag chen grags blo ba/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ bdag chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa/ bla ma mnyam med pa/ zhwa lu mkhyen rab chos rje/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ mkhan chen g.yag pa/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rin/ lha mchog seng ge paṇ+ḍi ta grags rdor/ rje rin chen chos 'phel rnams kyi sku gdung / sngags 'chang chen po dang / rje mus chen nyid kyi na bza'i dum bu/ chos rje sa paṇa gyi gdung thal ring bsrel/ rje btsun grags pa'i phyag 'phreng khug gi dum bu/ rje kun dga' grol mchog gi dbu zhwa'i dum bu/ rje yongs 'dzin gyi tshems kyi dum bu/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rin pa'i shangs mtshal dang chab ser ril bu/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho'i dbu thod kyi dum bu/ 'dren mchog dam pa'i phyag sen/ bram ze dri med snying po'i phyag mdzub tshigs rkang gi dum bu/ theg chen pa'i gdung thal dang sku sha stobs che ba/

slob dpon pad+ma'i tshe ril dum bu dang / gzhan yang kha che paṇa chen/ rje btsun chen po/ rgyal po 'od zer go cha/ 'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ge shar chen/ ngor chen/ sems dpa' chen po/ kun mkhyen chen po/ glo bo mkhan chen/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rin/ grub chen dpal ldan bkra shis/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rnams kyi dbu lo/ sngags 'chang chen pos rgya bod kyi mkhas grub phal cher gyi dbu lo phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas 'jim pa la sbyar ba'i dbu skra kun 'dus ril bu/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos lo gsum sogs ljags bsnyen gnang dus pher gyi dbu lo/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ sa chen/ bla ma dam pa/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rin/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ sa lo/ sngags 'chang chen po rnams kyi na bza'i dum bu sogs dang / gzhan yang bla ma gong ma mang po'i bdud rtsi ril bu stobs che ba/ sa lo'i shangs mtshal/ shangs snabs/ spur ras dum bu/ phur pa'i srung 'khor dbu thog tu phub pa la dbu dreg chen po yod pa de nyid kyi dum bu la sogs pa mdor na byin rlabs kyi rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dus pa'i gong bu lta bur bzhugs pa yin la/ de dag thams cad la thun mong du lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi brgyud pa sogs brgyud rim nyer bzhi tsam re dbu gzungs la bzhugs shing / sku gzungs la kye rdor gtso 'khor gyi sngags sogs gzungs ring mi gcig pa nyer gcig spel tshig dang bcas pa dang / pad gzungs la gur mgon lcam dral gyi sngags sogs gzungs ring nyer lnga/ tshul bzhin du bsgrubs pa'i gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa bzhugs pa ste/

de lta bu'i rten ngo mtshar can rnams la rje nyid 'khor rig pa 'dzin pa mang po dang bcas pas rab tu gnas pa rgyud sde nas bshad pa tshul bzhin du mdzad de/ dus der nam mkha' dri ma med pa la lha rnams kyi me tog gi char kha ba ltar babs/ bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan phyogs thams cad du khyab par gyur pa yin no/ /de nas sngags 'chang bla ma 'di nyid dgung lo nyer drug tu phebs pa rnga chen zhes pa chu pho khyi lo zla ba drug pa'i nang du 'phags pa phyag na ral gri'i rnam par sprul pa chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku drin las bod 'dir rab tu byung ba la snga ba/ sad mi mi bdun du grags pa byon pa'i nang tshan sba gsal snang ngam rab tu byung ba'i mtshan sba ye shes dbang por grags pa'i dbon sras kyi rgyud du 'khrungs nas/ bod khams kyi sa chen po bdag gir mdzad pa'i mi dbang karma bstan skyong dbang pos lugs gnyis kyi phun tshogs thams cad 'du ba'i bsti gnas gzhis ka bsam grub rtser spyan drangs te/ de dus mi dbang des chab srid kyi khur bzhes nas/ dam pa 'di la chos kyi bka' 'brel zhus pa'i thog ma yin pas/ mi dbang chen por rten 'brel legs tshogs la dgongs nas zang zing gi gnang skyes rgya mi chung tsam dang bcas/ rgyal rigs sna bdun gser zangs las grub pa ngo mtshar ba zhig stsal nas rten 'brel zab mo'i sgo sgrig par mdzad cing / zla ba gnyis tsam gyi bar rgyal khab chen por gdan chags/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos rdo rje phur pa'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs/ dpon slob bcu phrag lnga tsam gyis zhag du ma'i bar du dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang / mi dbang chen po drung 'khor mang po dang bcas pa rnams/ 'phrin las kyi lha rdo rje phur pa'i dbang zab mo'i sgo nas smin cing grol ba'i lam la bkod/ gzhan yang de dus rgyal khab chen po der mi dbang chen po'i rim gro sgrub pa'i phyir/

dbus gtsang gi chos grwa chen po rnams nas dge 'dun stong la nye ba re rgyun du 'du ba'i skabs yin pas/ de dag gi khrod nas lung rigs smra ba'i sde snod 'dzin pa dang / rgyud don smra ba'i rdo rje 'dzin pa brgya phrag las brgal ba la yang / rdo rje gzhon nu'i stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i dbang gi bka' drin stsal te/ rgyal khab chen po chos dkar gyi snang bas khyab par mdzad pas/ sa skyong chen po yang de nas bzung chos phyogs kho na la thugs gzhol zhing / lhag par rdo rje phur pa la gting nas dad pa zhig byung / de'i tshe sgrub mchod kyi sa 'dul dang / dgra bgegs grub kyi 'cham sogs kyi tshe/ dpon slob rnams 'cham rwar ma phebs tsam gyi snga dro char shin tu che ba babs nas/ de nyin sku 'cham gnang mi thub pa la kun blo thag chod pa zhig byung 'dug kyang / rje nyid kyis mchod g.yog par dmod nas zhig gnang nas/ steng du song la 'di mkha' la thor/ rkang gling yang drag tu bus shig par bsgos pa bzhin/ des kyang ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin byas pas/ de ma thag char chad de/ sku 'cham la phebs pas/ de nyin mtha' thams cad char mun gyis bskor ba la/ phyogs der sku 'cham ma grol gyi bar du char gtan ma byung pa na/ chos rgyal blon 'bangs sogs der 'dus thams cad rje 'dis chos skyong la bka' bsgo mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi mthu yin par nges shing / de ltar du kun mgrin gcig par gleng bar byed do/ /gzhan yang de dus rdo rje phur pa'i gtor bzlog gcig kyang gnang ba'i bsgral las kyi dus/ gang nas byung cha med par glo bur du bye'u zhig ling ga'i rtsar babs byung ba/ de ma thag brang brdabs pa'i rkyen byas pa 'dra ba zhig gis shi ba na/ dgra bgegs dngos su khugs pa'i mtshan mar kun gyis 'dzin pa zhig byung zhes kyang thos la/ de ltar rdo rje phur pa'i dbang dang tshe bka' sogs sa skyong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rang rang 'dod chos mang pos so so'i re 'dod yid bzhin du 'gengs par mdzad pas mi dbang de nyid kyang bcos ma ma yin pa'i dad gus cher brtas te/

rje nyid deng sang yang phur sgrub sogs kyi tshe sku la bzhes pa'i gsol phor shin tu dngos gtsang ba 'brug ris mang po byas pa/ bkral thags kyi rdo rje gong bcas ngo mtshar can 'di nyid sogs zang zing gi 'bul nod rgya dpang shin tu che ba dang / lhag par gdan sa chen po'i chos gzhis che phran thams cad la khral rigs gtan nas 'gel bkod mi zhu ba'i gtan tshigs kyang gus spro'i sgo nas phul/ de nas bzung ste lo grangs mang po'i bar du sa phyogs de byin chags/ rgyal po nyid kyang yangs pa'i sa la stobs kyi 'khor los dbang bsgyur zhing / chos rgyal gong ma'i ring lugs 'dzin/ rgyal khab chen po yang 'phags pa dge slong gi dge 'dun mang pos yongs su gang ste/ chos spyod bcu la gzhol zhing chos kyi gtam dir re ba/ grong khyer ba rnams kyang pha rol gyi dmag dpung sogs kyis 'tshe ba med/ lo 'bras thams cad phun sum tshogs pa smin cing rgyas pas dga' spro'i glu dbyangs byis pa tshun chad kyang 'tsher ba/ rgyal khams thams cad bde zhing skyid pa'i dpal la spyod cing gnas pa de yang bdag cag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa 'dis/ phyogs der rdo rje phur pa'i sa chog tshul bzhin du mdzad/ sa skyong chen po de la rin chen sna bdun stsal pa'i rten 'brel zab mo'i sgo bsgrigs/ gsang sngags zab mo'i chos kyi dga' ston gyis kun tshims par mdzad pa'i mthu las byung bar shes ldan gzur gnas kun mthun par mgrin pa skyong bar byed do/ /de nas yar lam gnyan lo dar ma grags kyis byin gyi brlabs shing / zhing skyong dbang phyug zhal bzhi pa'i me 'bar gyi gtsug lag khang dar lung du bskang gso rgyas pa dang / bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi 'phrin las rgyas pa'i bka' bsgo 'phrin bcol yang dag pa mdzad nas dpal sa skyar phebs te/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i dus mchod phur sgrub chen mo sngar rgyun bzhin gnang /

de nas lo de'i zla ba dgu pa'i gza' skar bzang ba la/ shar kha chos kyi rgyal po'i gdung rigs dri ma med pa 'dzin pa mi dbang bsod nams mthu stobs dbang po'i sde dang / de nyid kyi sras kyi thu bo chos kyi rje rin po che ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan la sogs pa mi chen du ma dang / gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi chos grwa phan tshun gyi mkhan chen/ brgya tshe dpon/ chos las pa sogs gnyug mar gnas pa'i bla ma slob dpon mang po/ gdan sa'i nye skor sogs kyi dgon so so'i bla ma grwa rigs dang bcas pa/ dpal sa skya'i chos grwa lho byang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad/ sgrub pa mo dang / skye bo'i rigs mang po dang bcas pa'i chos nyan sum brgya tsam 'dus pa la rje btsun sa skya pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i yab chos bdag med mkha' 'gro'i zhal bcud ma nyams pa/ 'jigs bral rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi rū pas dngos su gsol ba'i man ngag gi rgyun/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa zab mo snyan brgyud bzhi ldan gyi sgo nas/ lam 'bras glegs bam dang / pu sti dmar chung sogs rgyab chos lung gi tshogs grangs med pa dang bcas pa zla ba gsum gyi bar shin tu smin cing rgyas pa zhig stsol bar mdzad cing / gzhan yang lam zab phyi nang gnyis/ bir bsrung thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa/ brda don gsal ba/ brda chig brgyud thun mong ba sogs cha lag phal cher yang stsal cing / de dus nub gcig rje 'di'i mnal lam du gong du bkod pa'i 'jam mgon bsod nams dbang pos mgon po'i dbang du ma bskur ba'i tshul de dang / gzhan yang grub mchog dbang po'i mtshan can de nyid shin tu dgyes pa'i gsung las/ khyed la rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis dbang bskur mdzad dus kyi khyor chu'i snod 'khrul med dung chos ngo mtshar can yod pa de nged la dgos pa 'dug ces gsungs byung ba na/

rje 'di'i thugs la e ma ngo mtshar che/ dung chos de lag na yod pa'i 'phros zur tsam yang rje'i sku 'khor ba sogs su dang 'phros ma byung bar 'di bzhin gyi bka' stsal phebs pa ni thugs mkhyen gyis dgongs pa las gzhan du ma 'das so snyam du dgongs pa'i mod la mnal sad pas/ rang gi dad mos kyis ma bslus na/ rje grub thob kyi gtsug rgyan de nyid kyi thugs rje la nye ring med par 'dug dgongs pa'i yid ches kyi thugs dad ci yang zhig 'khrungs pa byung zhes rje nyid kyi gsung las thos shing / gzhan yang gsung chos kyi gnas skabs phal cher nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od dang / me tog 'bab pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang po dang / lhag par sems bskyed chen mo'i nyin nam mkha' shin tu dwangs pa la 'ja' 'od kha dog sna tshogs pas gur phub pa dang / lha'i me tog gi char kha ba ltar babs pa ni der 'dus kun gyi mig gi spyod yul du gyur to/ /de dus bya yul lo dgon pa nas 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi thugs sras spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar gyi rnam par sprul pa chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub gdan sa chen po dang sngags 'chang bla ma 'di nyid mjal bzhed yod pa bzhin/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis kyang gsung chos 'dra gsan dgongs pas sa skyar phebs/ dgos tshul gyi phebs sgo stsal pa ltar/ lo de nang du gdan sar phebs te/ dam pa de la gong du bkod pa ltar gyi gsung chos phal cher de dus gsan pa yin snang zhing / rje 'dis kyang zab chos 'ga' zhig stsal par nges la/ gzhan yang rje spyan snga ba des gdan sa chen po 'dir lan gsum phebs pa'i skabs thams cad la zab chos gsan pa kho na mdzad pas/ bdag nyid chen po 'di'i yongs 'dzin rnams kyi nang nas bka' chos gsan pa'i rnam grangs 'di mang zhing / phan tshun dag snang dang gus zhen che ba'i stobs kyis so so nas gcig shos kyi snyan pa kho na gsungs/

thugs nang yang shin tu gtsang pas 'phral yun gyi bka' mchid khag che ba kun 'chab med du lhug mol mdzad pa'i thugs yid gcig 'dres shig yin pa de'i rgyu mtshan gyis rje spyan snga ba nyid la phar zab chos gsan pa'i yongs 'dzin dang / tshur nod pa'i slob bu'i tshogs mang du yod kyang / gzhan su zhig kyang mi sems pa'i tshul gyis zhing gshegs dus kyang / lo dgon pa'i rten gyi gtso bo sngon lha sa'i jo bo rin po che'i bzo phud du bzhengs pa'i thub pa 'od zer 'gyed du grags pa dang / jo bo rje la bod du byon na bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po nus pa'i lung bstan mdzad pas lung bstan sgrol mar 'bod pa'i sku brnyan ngo mtshar can jo bo nyid kyis bod du spyan drangs pa byin rlabs kyi gzi byin 'bar ba gnyis po 'di/ sngags 'chang bla ma gang gi phyag tu phul zhig pa'i bka' chems gsung shog tu 'khod pa mdzad pa bzhin rje 'di'i drung du gegs med 'byor te/ rin po che gser gyi khri rgyab bla gab dang bcas pa la g.yu'i phra tshom gyis spud pa yid du 'ong ba gsar du bskrun nas phul te/ gzim chung rten gyi grwar bzhugs su gsol ba 'di lags so/ /de ltar bdag nyid chen po 'dis chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub la zab chos mang du nod par mdzad pa'i skabs/ dpal mgon zhal gyi rjes gnang bram ze mngal gtad gsan pa'i nub mo bdag nyid chen po 'di'i mnal lam du rje spyan snga ba dang / dam pa 'di gnyis dpal sa skya'i dbu rtse rnying ma na lhan cig bzhugs 'dug pa la/ rnal 'byor pa'i cha lugs byas pa gzugs bongs chen po mgo la ral pa'i thor cog shin tu che zhing rngam pa/ lus la rus rgyan dang g.yer kha'i sgra sil chom me ba dang bcas pas brgyan pa zhig rje gnyis kyi drung du byung ba na/ sngags 'chang bla ma 'dis rnal 'byor pa'i tshul de la/ spyan snga rin po che 'di nyid dge ba'i bshes gnyen ci dang mi 'dra ba zhig yin tshul sogs bstod bsngags mang du mdzad pas/

de na re/ de bzhin yin las che ste/ nga ni khyed rang gis spyan hur re gzigs pa de zil che ba zhig yong gi 'dug cing / khyed rang lhag bsam pa yod zer ba na mnal sad de/ dpal mgon 'di nged rang la 'go ba'i ltas su 'dug dgongs nas/ de gong thugs dam bskang gso'i tshe thugs brel 'dzings ches pa'i dus zhal gyi bskang gso zur pa chag med rang gnang ma bde ba kha re byung yang / de nas bzung ste ma chag pa kho na mdzad pa'i dgongs pa gtad nas phal cher de ka bzhin gnang thub kyang / re zhig na thugs mnyel bas chad pa zhig byung ba'i nub mo/ bzhi thog bla brang gi mkha' spyod du gzim chung mdzad pa'i skabs mnal dang 'od gsal 'dres ma zhig la/ me stag 'dra ba'i 'od dmar po zhig gis gzim chung gi nang thams cad khrig ste khengs byung ba na/ rje nyid cung zad thugs zhed nyams kyis rings stabs su gzim sgo phyogs la gzigs pas/ sngar dbu rtser byung ba'i rnal 'byor pa des gzim chung gi sgo yol gyi rgyab nas mgo nyang ste bltas byung ba na/ sku zi bun byed pa dang mnal sad cing / phyis gnas tshul de gzhan la zlo tsa na/ da dung yang zi bun rang yong gi 'dug ces rje nyid kyi gsung las dngos su thos pa bris ba la gnyan mgon chen pos bzod par mdzod cig gzhan yang rje 'di la gnyan mgon chen po 'go ba'i tshul shin tu mang ste/ lan gcig zhal gyi man ngag rdzas dang 'khor gtad pa nyid thugs nyams su bstar bzhed nas sku mtshams bcad de/ bkra shis kha btags la rje nyid kyi mtshan dang / zhal slob 'ga' zhig gi ming yang bris nas/ sku tshe ring zhing phyi ma dag pa'i zhing du skye ba'i smon lam 'phrin bcol bris pa'i mda' dar zhal gyi gtor ma la btsugs te/ man ngag de nyams bzhes smin 'grub mdzad/ slar sku mtshams grol nas skyed lhas su bskang gsor phebs pa'i tshe/ sngar gyi bkras btags de brag sgor 'jug pa gnang nas bskang gso dang 'phrin bcol smin rgyas mdzad pa grol nas sa skyar phebs dus nam mkha' shin tu dwangs pa na/

rje 'di mtshal khrag gi bsnyun gzhi'i stabs/ nyi ma'i tsha dug sku stod la 'phog mi nyan pa zhig yod pa'i khar/ de dus zla ba drug pa'i nyi ma shin tu tsha ba'i skabs yin par brten/ phebs kar kho bos bkras btags la bris pa'i don bzhin 'grub nges na/ 'di nas sa skya bar la tsha gdung med pa'i bsil po zhig dang / de min de las ldog pa zhig mdzod cig par dpal mgon nyid la dmod bor mdzad nas phebs pas/ chibs thog khel ma thag shar phyogs nas sprin chen po zhig skyes/ de je che je cher song nas dpon slob rnams phebs phyogs dang mthun par sprin dag kyang 'phel te/ phebs lam shin tu bsil ba zhig byung ba de yang rje 'di la dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa nyid kyis 'phrin las gang bcol thogs med du sgrub pa la yid gnyis cung zad kyang mi dgos pa'i mtshan ma yang dag pa'o/ /de nas sngags 'chang bla ma 'di dgung lo nyer bdun du phebs pa khrag skyug ces pa chu mo phag gi lo sngon rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis bdag med mkha' 'gro 'grub pa'i dus khyad par can sa ka zla ba'i nyer gnyis nas gnam gang gi bar la dam rdzas 'chi med ril bu'i sgrub pa mdzad de/ de dus nyin re bzhin 'ja' sprin dkar pos nam mkha'i khyon gang ba dang / nub gcig gi mtshan lam du bud med gcig gis shing tog mang po phul ba zhig byung ba ni rje 'di la rje btsun rdo rje bdag med mas rnal 'byor dbang phyug ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan mar snang zhing / 'di ni dam pa 'dis dam rdzas sgrub pa mdzad pa'i thog ma yin la/ spyir ni rje 'dis 'chi med ril bu'i sgrub pa da ltar phan pa lan grangs bco lnga tsam gnang zhing thams cad kyi tshe ril bu su zhig gis bsten pa de/ dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar gyur cig pa'i smon lam kho na mdzad pa dang / kun la ril bu 'phel che zhing / gang du sgrub pa mdzad pa'i phyogs thams cad dri bzang pos khyab pa sogs ngo mtshar ba mang du byung ba ni/

lde gu sbru ba dang ril bu bsgril ba'i zhabs 'bring byed po kun la mngon du gyur pa yin la/ de'i dbyar lha chen rig 'dzin pho brang du rdo rje 'jigs byed la gsung bsnyen zla ba gcig gi bar la shin tu smin par mdzad/ de nas phag lo'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang du nags dgon chos rje sbyin pa grags pa gdan sa pa dang bcas pa rnams sa skya'i rten khyad par can rnams mjal ba dang / bdag nyid chen po mjal bar phebs nas/ chos rje nags dgon pa de nyid spyir yang sha chang zhal la mi reg pa sogs phyi 'dul ba'i kun spyod gtsang zhing / nang rdo rje theg pa'i zab mo nyams bzhes la gcig tu gzhol ba'i gsang sngags 'chang ba chen por snang ba dang / khyad par rje mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung gi bdud rtsis thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gang ba'i sras kyi thu bo zhig yin pa sogs gang nas kyang zab chos gsan yul gyi 'os su gzigs nas/ dpal kye rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa'i bshad bka' rje mus chen nas brgyud pa de nyid sogs gong du bkod pa'i zab chos de dag gsan par mdzad nas/ rtsa rgyud de nyid kyi don 'grel khog phug rgyud 'grel sgo brgya'i lde mig ces bya ba dang / brgyud 'debs kun khyab ma'i kha skong du/ chos rje grags pa mtha' yas pa/ rje mus chen/ rje nags dgon pa/ rje nyid dang bcas par gsol 'debs kyi tshigs bcad mdzad nas/ rgyud 'don gyi tshe zhal 'don du 'dzugs pa mdzad pa las/ slar mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags las kye rdor rgyud gsum ka'i bshad rgyud gsan pa nas/ rgyud gsum car gyi bshad pa'i brgyud pa tshang ba'i brgyud 'debs kha skong 'di mdzad pa yin zhing / de dus bdag nyid chen po 'dis kyang nags dgon chos rje dpon slob tshor gur mgon lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang dang / gnyan mgon chen po'i rjes gnang sogs 'dod chos 'ga'i bka' drin yang stsol bar mdzad la/

de nas mig dmar zhes pa shing pho byi lo rje nyid dgung lo nyer brgyad du phebs pa'i tshe/ nyid kyi gcen grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug mdo khams nas yar phebs te/ rje nyid dpon slob mang pos glang dkar du phebs bsur bteg pa'i tshe/ sku mched mjal ma thag rje 'dis mjal dar phul phyag mdzad pa'i mod la/ grub mchog de nyid spyir sku mched ma mjal nas rgyun ring song ba dang / khyad par bdag nyid chen po 'di sku mched gsum gyi sku na gzhon pa rang yin na'ang / dpal sa skya'i bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi khur chen bla nar 'degs pa'i snying stobs gzhan dang mnyam pa med pa'i legs byas kyi snyan pa gsan pas thugs phrogs te/ mchog tu rjes su yid rangs pa'i dgyes spro khyad par can zhig 'khrungs par 'dug pas/ tshur yang mjal dar dang phyag mdzad song ba na/ dam pa 'dis gcen gyi sku la 'khyud nas phyag mi mdzad pa dgos tshul zhu ba gnang bas/ grub mchog mthu stobs dbang phyug gi gsung las/ skyon med/ kho bo na so rgan pa ma gtogs/ khyed kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum dang / lugs gnyis la mkhyen rab phul du byung ba 'di lta bu la kho bos char yang mi phod pas rjes su yi rang nas phyag byed pa yin/ der ma zad nged ni khyed rang la bla ma yang zhu bsam pa yod gsungs pa sogs bstod bskul mang du mdzad pa la/ rje 'dis bdag la mgo 'dren gyi phebs sgo de bzhin bka' drin shin tu che na'ang / gong sa nas phyag mdzad pa sogs skabs su ci la bab pas/ 'di rigs gtan mi gnang ba dgos tshul nan zhus mdzad pas/ khyed kyi dgongs par med tshe de ka byed gsungs/ de nas sku mched zhal 'dzoms thog mdo khams sogs kyi gsung gleng sogs mang du mdzad cing thugs yid gcig 'dres kyi ring nas sku mched lhan cig par 'cham mgon rnams dang /

chos sde phan tshun gyi grwa btsun rnams kyis phebs bsu ser 'phreng gzab ma dang bcas phebs/ de nas 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug zhabs kyis gdan sa chen po'i tshogs pa rnams la mang ja gral 'gyed dang bcas pa'i thog bdag nyid chen po 'di la rol mo dngos gtsang ba mang po dang gzhan yang ja gos dar/ rta dre'u sogs zang zing gi dngos spyad rgya dpang shin tu che ba/ sku brnyan rgya nag ma byon gtsang ba du ma dang bcas pa'i gnang skyes shin tu stobs che ba stsal cing / gtsug lag khang so so la yang snyan dar phon chen po dang / lhag par lha khang chen mo'i ka star gcig la bla bre chen po 'di nyid kyang 'bul bar mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas lo de'i nang du rje btsun sa skya pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa'i rgyan 'phreng 'chang ba skyi shag 'phrang gsum du grags pa'i nang tshan/ shag pa rnam rgyal rab brtan nas chos kyi rje rin po che kun bzang drung dang / grub mchog mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug gi zhabs 'bring ba chen po lcags bla bla ma chos rgya mtsho gnyis gtso bor gyur pa'i grub dbang de'i ban gtsang pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ tshogs pa brgya phrag tsam la bdag nyid chen po 'dis gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa zab mo stsol bar mdzad/ de dus spyan snga rin po che gdan sa chen por phebs 'byor gnyis pa'i skabs yin pas/ rje 'dis gsung ngag grol nas/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan la rje dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i bka' 'bum sogs sngar ma gsan pa'i zab chos 'ga' zhig dang / rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi bka' 'bum gyi nang nas yig sna kha cig gi lung ni sku mched gnyis char gyis gsan la/ de nas 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug dpon slob rnams kyis yul chen dang dbus sogs la 'gro don la gdan btegs te/ de'i dbyar bdag nyid chen po 'dis lha khang chen mo dang /

dbu rtse sogs na bzhugs pa'i bka' 'gyur rnams/ rje rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis mdzad pa'i dkar chag nang bzhin 'khrugs bsdebs/ ma tshang ba kha bskangs/ lha khang mthil na bzhugs pa'i shar pa ye chen po'i thugs dam bka' 'gyur 'di la rgyun du klog pa'i rten mdzad pa nas/ glegs bam thams cad la gdong dar lnga brtsegs/ steng du bla bre/ nyi ma dang rlung gi gnod pa las skyobs pa'i phyir yol ba rnams phul/ snga gong nas gdan sa na bka' 'gyur lo rer tshar re tsam las mi klog kyang / rje 'di'i rang nyid dgung lo nyer drug pa khyi'i lo nas bzung / lo ltar gyi lan grangs gsum re klog pa'i rgyun bzang po btsugs/ de dag dang dus mtshungs par lha khang chen mo'i khyams stod kyi sngar rje btsun gcen gyis bla bre 'bul bar mdzad pa de'i shar gyi ka khongs la shin tu cha che zhing dngos gtsang ba'i bla bre 'di nyid phul te/ de 'dus dge 'dun tshogs pa'i gung gral da lta'i lho'i ka bar 'dir yod pas/ de steng thad du bum gdan ljang gu dang / gos dmar po kha'u ma'i mthong sogs dngos gtsang ba rnams ched du gtad nas bsgrigs pa'i zhal bkod rje nyid kyis mdzad pa yin na'ang / rjes su grwa pa zhal grangs 'phel che bar brten/ dbus gral sngar gyi de kar byas na/ tshogs phyogs yor song ba zhig gis cung zad ma mdzes pas de spangs pa'i phyir da lta'i 'di bzhin mdzad pa yin la/ de mthun 'dus tshogs kyi sgo 'di yang gsar gtod dang / rgyun du tshogs pas lam 'bras brgyud pa'i phyag mchod mdzad par dngos su rten brgyud rim zhig byung na legs par dgongs nas lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i ras bris chen mo 'di yang phul/ de bzhin du rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor khang par byus ser po 'brug ris ma shin tu dngos gtsang ba dang / bum gdan ljang gu gcig gis thog drangs bum gdan grab gcig gis mthong byas pa'i bla bre ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba 'di yang de dus zhal bkod gnang ba yin la/

gzhan yang lha khang chen mo'i phyi'i bad 'bur rnams la sngon 'phags pa rin po che'i skabs re re la dril bu re yod par grags kyang / phyis su 'thor ches pa'i phyogs rer dril bu bzhi lnga re las med par/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis sngar gyi dril bu rnams dang tshad mnyam pa mang po gsar lugs mdzad nas dril bu skul byed kyi ras 'phan dang bcas phul te/ da lta phyogs re la nyi shu tsam re yod pa lags shing / gtsug lag khang gzhan mang po la yang zur dril mang du phul ba rnams kyang bsdoms na brgya phrag du mar longs par 'gyur ba kun la mngon du gyur to/ /de nas rje nyid dgung lo nyer dgur phebs pa khro mo zhes pa shing mo glang gi lo mdar grangs mo che nas nyams dang rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun dam pa dbang phyug rab brtan dpal sa skyar spyan drangs te/ dam pa de la sa skya pa'i gdams pa zab mo dmar po skor gsum sogs snyan brgyud gser chos gtso bor gyur pa'i bzhed chos gong du bkod pa rnams gsan cing / khyad par dpal mgon zhal gyi man ngag ha la nag po'i be'u bum du grags pa rje des sngar gzhan su la yang gnang ma phod pa'i snying nang gi khrag lta bu'i gdams pa zab mo yongs rdzogs bdag nyid chen po 'di la stsal te/ sngon dam pa kun dga' grags la/ bla chen 'phags pas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi chos skyong gi gdams pa rnams gnang nas/ ma 'ongs pa na nged rang gi rigs brgyud gcig la 'phrod pa gyis gsungs pa bzhin/ dam pas bla ma bdag nyid chen po la phul/ de nas bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bar du zhal ngo nang brgyud kho nar bzhugs pa las/ bdag chen rin po ches rdo ring kun spangs chen por gdams pa stsol dus de bzhin gyi bka' stsal mdzad kyang / sa skya pa rang gi zhal ngo la dngos su 'bul thub pa zhig ma byung yang / da lam bdag gis zhabs drung rin po che khyed la zhal gyi man ngag 'di sogs shin tu zab pa rnams 'bul thub pas/

chos bdag po la 'phrod pa yin/ bla ma gong ma rnams thugs dgyes par 'gyur zhing / rang gi bsam pa yang rdzogs par byung bas/ da ni ha la nag po'i be'u bum 'di la dkar chag gsal ba zhig kyang mdzad dgos gsungs pa sogs mchog tu dgyes pa'i bka' stsal mang po lhug stsol mdzad pa bzhin/ sngags 'chang bla ma 'dis kyang de dus dkar chag legs pa zhig mdzad nas rje de la spyan 'bebs gnang bas thugs shin tu dgyes shing / der skabs dam pa 'di la rje dbang phyug rab brtan gyis bstod pa'i tshigs bcad brtan bzhugs dang bcas pa zhig kyang phul/ rje 'dis kyang dbang phyug rab brtan par grub pa'i yon tan gtso bor brjod pa'i bstod tshig shin tu legs pa cig 'bul bar mdzad cing / gzhan yang / zang zing gi 'bul nod kyang rgya dpang che ba dang / rje'i zhabs 'bring pa glang bu nas chos rje'i drung sogs la bka' 'brel zab chos 'ga' zhig kyang stsal to/ /de lta'i skabs nas rje nyid dgung grangs sum cur phebs pa'i zad pa zhes pa me pho stag lo/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod dbang mo'i bzlas brjod bskyed rdzogs kyi lam zab mo/ khyad par gyi dus yar ngo'i mar ngo'i tshes bcu sogs la bsgrubs pa las/ phan pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'byung bar 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud gzhung dag nas 'byung ba ltar/ skal ldan mang po mkha' spyod du son pa'i phyir/ thog mar chos sde lho'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rags bsdus dang / byang nas sgrub mchod la 'byon mkhan thams cad dang bcas pa'i grwa btsun brgya phrag tu longs pa la mkha' spyod ma'i sin+dhu ra'i byin rlabs zab mo'i bka' drin stsal pa'i sgo nas rgyud snod rung du mdzad nas/ gzod rje btsun ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub yig nyid kyis mdzad pa'i steng nas nā ro mkha' spyod kyi tshes bcu'i sgrub mchod gsar 'dzugs mdzad de/

skal ldan grangs med pa'i tshogs mkha' spyod nyams dga'i grong khyer chen por yud kyis bsgrod pa'i sbas pa'i gsang sgo phyes/ lo de'i phur sgrub chen mo grol ba'i zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du dpal sa skya'i chos sde lho byang gi mkhan chen/ brgya dpon/ chos las pa dang bcas pa/ dgon gzhan gyi bla ma kha cig sogs dang / gan pa nas bdag po bsod nams mthu stobs dbang po'i sde sku mched/ gzhan yang gdan sa 'di nyid kyi grwa rigs sogs tshogs pa sum brgya tsam la sa skya pa'i yab chos rdo rje phur pa'i stod las kyi dbang dang / smad las drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub thabs bklags pa don grub kyi rnam bshad chen mo'i bshad lung / phur pa rtsa dum dkyil chog rdo rje las rim/ sgrub thabs bklags pa don grub/ dkyil chog yid 'ong blo gros kha 'byed/ rin chen do shal/ bsnyen sgrub gsal byed/ dbang gi mtshams sbyor blo gsal dga' ba skyed byed/ phur pa'i brgyud 'debs rgyas bsdus kha skong dang bcas pa sogs rdo rje phur pa'i yig skor mang po'i lung gi bka' drin dang / gzhan yang zab cing dkon pa'i rjes gnang zur bka' kho na bcu phrag gnyis su gsum gyis lhag pa rnams kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad pa yin no/ /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ chos kyi bka' drin nos pa'i bshes gnyen gang / /rgyal ba nyid las lhag ces bde gshegs gsungs/ /gang gi mkhyen pa'i cod pan du bcings te/ /kun nas kun tu de la kun gyis mchod/ /de bzhin rin chen las grub chos sku'i rten/ /rnam bkra'i rgyan spras lha rdzas gos kyis bklubs/ /mthong bas yid 'phrog chos sku mngon sum pa/ /ji snyed lha mi'i bsod nams mgron du bskrun/ /gang 'di gzhan gyis ma byas mgon khyod kyi/ /rnam gsum 'dren par dad dang gus pa las/ /ye shes gzigs pa'i byin rlabs mthu brtas pa'i/

/bi shwa karma'i sor mo'i rnam par 'phrul/ /gang tshe dam pa'i skyes bu'i byin rlabs rdzas/ /ma lus gcig bsdus rab gnas 'bad pas ci/ /rdo rje rnon po'i rnam par 'phrul pa yis/ /bskrun phyir byin rlabs phul byung ma yin nam/ /gang dag rgyal ba'i sku yi rten ma yin/ /bde gshegs sras bcas bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /rmad byung byin rlabs bcud kun bsdus pa yi/ /rin chen dgos 'dod stsol ba'i za ma tog /sba yi rigs las 'ongs pa'i sa skyong che'i/ /mkhyen pa'i snod du khyod gsung bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /'khyil bas lha dang bla mar mi phyed dad/ /brtas pa'i legs byas nyar mar ci yang 'thor/ /rin chen bdun skyes rten 'brel legs byas dang / /gzungs gsung cho gas dbyig 'dzin dpal mo'i rgyud/ /btul bas sa 'dir dbang phyug chab 'bangs kyang / /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dus ston dpal la rol/ /chu 'dzin stug po'i mun rum chu char gyis/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can mtsho ru bskyil ba'i tshe/ /bstan srung pho nyar bka' bsgos mi rkang sgras/ /sprin 'phreng mkha' la ser bus byug bzhin gdengs/ /dam ldan pho nyas gang gi bka' mtshams las/ /mi 'da'i rnam 'phrul de la ngo mtshar ci/ /mi rkang gling bu rdo rje'i me 'bar te/ /sprin gyi me tog tshang tshing bsregs de mtshar/ /dpal ldan ngan pas ḍā k+ki grub pa'i bcud/ /rgyu lam 'bras bur bcas pa'i bdud rtsi'i gtam/ /snyan brgyud rig byed sgo nas 'ong gyur pa/ /mang po'i snying la sim pa de nas byin/ /de tshe bstan la rab dga'i lha yi tshogs/ /mkha' la shis pa'i sgra ldan dbang po'i gzhu/ /mdzes pa'i gur phub me tog sil ma'i char/ /khyon kun khyab par 'bebs pa'i dge mtshan gsal/ /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo'i 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /zla dbang mtshan lam mkha' dbyings shar ba'i mod/ /dgyes pa'i gsung gi ga bur 'thig pa na/ /khyed thugs dad pa'i ku mud gsar du bzhad/

/thogs med bzang po'i zhal skyin spyan snga bas/ /grangs med chos sgo skyel la ngo mtshar ci/ /rgyal kun mthu stobs gcig bsdus gdong bzhi pa/ /khyod spyan 'bar ba mthong tshe dngangs de mtshar/ /dam tshig can gyi rgyun gyi bza' ba'i rdzas/ /myong grol 'chi med sgrub la gzhol ba'i tshe/ /bdag med mkha' 'gros grub gnyis sbyin pa'i brdar/ /mdzes mas rkang 'thung 'bras bu'i dog pa phul/ /ma he'i zhal can 'jam pa'i rdo rje yi/ /grangs med bsnyen pa'i rtser son gdams pa'i mdzod/ /bzung nas dbang dang lam gyi rin chen nor/ /dgos dgus skal bzang blo gros phyug par mdzad/ /sdom brtson sbyin pa grags pa'i zhal bum las/ /dgyes mdzad rtsa rgyud bshad bka' bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /mtha' drug tshul bzhi ku sha'i rtse 'khyud de/ /khyed kyi rnam dpyod brtson pa'i khyor bas gsol/ /grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba mthu stobs dbang / /khyod kyi phul byung mdzad pa'i lang tsho dang / /rnam dpyod mdzes pa'i bzhin ras gzigs pa'i mod/ /mchog tu dwangs pa'i rtse dga'i dpal la rol/ /'gro mgon 'phags pa'i mchog de'i rnam bkra'i 'phrul/ /skal bzang mig sgor ci yang 'char ba las/ /deng 'dir dri yi gtsang khang lha'i gzhal med/ /khyod kyi rgya chen bla bres mdzes par spud/ /rab snyan dril bu'i sgra dbyangs mi zad pas/ /kun tu tam+bu ra yi mchod pa'i rdzas/ /grangs med phul ba'i legs byas gzugs gyur na/ /stong gsum 'di yang chung ba ma yin nam/ /nyams rtogs dbang phyug byang chub sems rab brtan/ /yongs 'dzin snyan brgyud mnga' bdag thugs mtsho nas/ /sa skya'i gser chos yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /len pa'i ded dpon gang gi dad brtson la/ /yongs 'dzin klu dbang dgyes pa'i bstod bsngags kyi/ /phuṭa sgras dri za'i rgyud mang glu dbyangs ltar/ /gang gi snyan gyi ut+pal bdud rtsir khol/ /ngo mtshar yon tan du ma'i 'byor pa'i grong /

/mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su bder phyin pa'i/ /myur lam rdo rje phag mo'i bskyed rdzogs gnad/ /'khrul med gdams pa'i bdud rtsi yongs la sbyin/ /'phrin las lha mchog sa skya'i yab chos phul/ /byang chub sgrub dang drag po sgrol pa'i las/ /bshad pa'i dga' ston lung mang rjes su gnang / /bcu phrag gnyis bcas zab rgyas chos sbyin stsal/ /de nas bdag cag gi mtshungs pa med pa'i skyabs mgon sngags 'chang bla ma 'di nyid dgung lo so gcig tu phebs pa rab byung zhes pa me mo yos kyi lo mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa nyid rje btsun chen po'i sku brnyan grags pa'i mtha' can bzhis bzhengs pa'i rje btsun nyid kyi phyag nas ma sku dngos dang khyad par med pa bzhi'i nang tshan dkar shākya grags pas bzhengs te/ nag po spyod pa'i rnam par sprul pa mdze po 'od zer dpal gyi dbu thod nang bzhugs la yod pas mdze thod mar grags pa la zhabs skor 'bum ther mdzad pa dang / rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid mjal ba'i phyir/ gdan sa chen po 'dir phebs 'byor byung nas/ dpon slob zhal mjal ma thag phan tshun dag snang chen po'i ngang nas chos kyi gsung gleng kho na yun ring po mdzad pa'i mod la/ rje 'di'i thugs dgongs la sngar gyi bla ma rnams la ma gsan pa'i chos 'phro rnams mkhan chen 'di la gsan pa'i dgongs gtad yod pa bzhin/ sngar bdag gis 'jam dbyangs sku mched dang / rgyal ba mus pa chen po las ma thob pa'i zab chos du ma zhig chos kyi rje spyan snga rin po che dang / grub mchog dbang phyug rab brtan/ nags dgon pa chen po rnams las zhus pa lags kyang / da dung kye rdor rgyud gsum ga'i bshad bka' sogs thob 'dod che ba kha cig yod pa bzhin da lam rje nyid phebs pas shin tu legs byung bas/ 'dod chos rnams stsol dgos tshul gsungs pas/ mkhan chen de nyid kyang thugs dgyes pa'i gsung gis/

bdag cag gi thob chos dgongs par yod pa rnams cis kyang 'bul spro/ 'on kyang thog mar sku 'dra rin po che la skor ba 'bum ther zhig mi byed ka med lags pas/ de grub rjes chos rnams 'bul rtsis zhu dgos 'dug gsungs nas/ zhabs skor gyi ring mkhan chen dpon slob rnams kyis zur khang nyid du bzhugs/ de nas slar bzhi thog bla brang du phebs te/ thog mar grub chen dze ta ri dgra las rnam rgyal nas brgyud pa'i rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dbang / de nas kye rdor bka' bab bzhi'i dbang / gsang ba 'dus pa rigs gsum gyi dbang / gur rigs bsdus/ sam+bu ṭi rdor dbyings/ bde mchog mahā ma ya/ rnam 'joms ma ṇi badz+ra/ 'od zer can lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi dbang sogs rgyud sde bzhi po ci rigs pa'i dbang bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig dang / bde mchog dkar po'i byin rlabs sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas de nyid kyi tshe khrid zab mo/ sgyu lus dbang mo che dang / bde mchog lha lnga sogs kyi dbang sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas nai gu chos drug gi khrid sgos bka' so so dang bcas pa/ phyag chen ga'u ma'i khrid sogs zab khrid du ma/ rnam thos sras kyi rjes gnang rigs mi gcig pa lnga phrag gsum la sogs pa rjes gnang mang po ste zab chos mtha' yas pa zhig gsan/ de nas mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa de nyid re zhig nyid kyi bsti gnas mang mkhar bsam grub dgon gsar dang bla brang rdzongs sogs su phebs te thugs dam zab mo la rtse gcig gzhol ba'i skabs/ rje btsun dam pa 'dis dpal sa skya'i lugs gnyis kyi mdzad 'phrin rlabs po che rnams la nam yang g.yel ba med pa'i ring nas sku khams kyi 'phrod rten du mang mkhar gyi chab tshan la ston dpyid gnyis lan re re phebs kyin yod pa bzhin/ lo de'i zla ba gsum pa'i nang du chab la phebs thog nas mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen par zhu 'phrin snyan tshig shin tu legs pa rgyan du mas spras pa'i bsnyun gsol dang bcas sngar gyi chos 'phro rnams kyang stsol ba'i phyir myur du phebs dgos pa'i zhu gsol gnang ba'i lan du mkhan chen chos kyi rje rin po che nyid kyis bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa 'di la thugs dam gyi lan du gsung shog 'bul bar mdzad pa las 'di ltar 'byung ste//

༈ //rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen pa'i spyi gzugs dpal sa skya pa gangs ljongs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gang de'i zhabs kyi pad+mor btud de zhu ba/ deng gi dus na sku'i dkyil 'khor gzi 'od rab tu 'bar bas sa gsum gyi mun pa sel zhing / lha dang bcas pa'i che dgu yongs kyi gtsug gi nor bur zhabs sen ngal 'tsho ba'i mdzad 'phrin gyi legs byas rab tu 'bar ba'i rdo rjes/ snyigs ma lnga'i lha min gyi dpung tshogs rmeg med par byas te/ thub pa'i dbang po'i rgyal mtshan bla na ma mchis pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid mthon po rdzogs ldan gyi dpal rgyun bzhin du 'phel rgyas su mdzad pa'i skabs nas/ thugs dam dam rdzas ril bu'i gnang skyes bka' mchid zla lcam dpal mo'i mgul nas phyung ba bzhin gyi snyan tshig gi phreng ba bcud ldan gyi za ma tog dang bcas phebs pas/ sems spro ba mchog gi rtser son lags/ bdag kyang mchog gsum gyi thugs rje la re ba'i gsol 'debs sogs chos ldan gyi bya ba la brtson par gnas/ mgon khyod yang srid du mar mkhas dang grub/ /deng 'dir 'jam mgon byin rlabs 'od brgya pa/ /zab yangs thugs kyi 'khor lor rtag bzhad pas/ /lnga rig chos kun rang dbang nyid du mkhyen/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje gos dkar lcang lo'i zol/ /bstan 'gro'i don mdzad sa skya'i rje btsun khyed/ /legs byas rtsa brtan rdo rje'i khri mthon por/ /bskal brgyar dam pa'i chos ston lha brgyas bsngags/ /chos dang srid kyi dge legs 'khor los bsgyur/ /ci bsam bzhed don mtha' dag lhun gyis grub/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin bstan srung nyams dga'i zhing / /nor 'dzin skya bo'i zhing 'dir chos 'byor 'phel/ /bdag lta gcig tu bya ba'i dkar dge ni/ /mchog gsum bla mar gsol 'debs dad pa'i mthu/ /cung zad brtas pa'i mtshan ma dge ba la/ /skyo ngal spangs 'di bdag gi g.yar dam lags/ /zhes zhu yig rten bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas dkar po la rgya ldan par tshes bzang po la phul ba'i zhu yig

ces rje nyid la ched du bsngags pa'i zhu 'phrin yang 'bul bar mdzad cing / slar yang mkhan chen de nyid zla ba bzhi pa'i nang du gdan sa chen por phebs pa'i tshe/ sngags 'chang bla ma nyid kyis ngos cag sogs slob ma rags bsdus shig la dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud gsum gyi bshad bka'i sngon 'gro tshul bzhi'i skabs/ rje rtse mo'i spyi rnam dang / rje btsun chen po'i mngon par rtog pa rin po che'i ljon shing sogs kyi steng nas/ zhib gsed dang / dngos gzhi rgyud gsum gyi gzhung don gyi skabs su rtsa rgyud la rje btsun gyi dag ldan/ rdo rje gur la gur rgyan/ sam+bu ṭi la rtse mo'i gnad kyi gsal byed gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i yig cha tshad ldan du ma'i steng nas shin tu rgyas la mtha' chod pa gsan te/ sngon 'gro tshul bzhi'i skabs nas bzung / rgyud rnams la snying po bsdus pa'i zin bris kyang mdzad/ de dus rje 'dis mkhan chen de nyid gtso bor gyur pa'i zhabs 'bring pa rnams dang / gdan sa chen po'i gzhir bzhugs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po dang bcas pa rnams la dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi dbang / rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad bskor gyi dbang / las gshin gyi rjes gnang la sogs pa zab chos du ma'i bka' drin stsal pa sogs dam pa'i chos gsan pa dang / 'chad pa sogs bstan pa rin po che'i bgyi ba kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad cing / lo de'i rgyal ba mus pa chen po'i dus mchod chen mo sag pa'i ne'u gseng gi steng du cha ther phub nas mdzad pa'i tshogs dbur mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa yang phebs pas/ dus mchod kyi phyag dang mchod pa sogs chos spyod kyi sgrigs rim tshogs pa'i zhal 'don sogs dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur sogs kyi dge tshogs rmad du byung ba'i rgyun 'dzugs par mdzad pa'i legs byas rma med pa dang / gzhan yang skabs der dam pa 'di'i bka' bzhin/

mkhan chen des gdan sa'i skya ser rnams la dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed sogs tshogs chos 'ga' zhig gnang ba'i tshe/ tshogs pa rnams kyis rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rgyal ba mus pa chen po'i sku bstod rgyal ba gnyis pa ma la gdangs dang bcas mdzad pa na bstod tshig gi rtsom legs shing gdangs dbyangs snyan pa rgyud 'khul che ba de gsan pas/ mkhan chen nyid thugs shin tu dgyes shing rjes su yid rang nas rje 'di la gus pa'i thal mo sbyor zhing bstod bkur bsngags gsum ci yang mdzad pa zhig byung ba yin la/ de lta'i skabs nas mi dbang karma bstan skyong dbang pos/ 'jam mgon bla ma 'di nyid gzhis ka bsam grub rtser spyan 'dren zhus pa'i ngor/ phur sgrub grol 'phral chibs kha bsgyur/ sa skyong chen po de nyid la tshe bka' sogs 'phral sel gyi bzhed chos mang po dang / de dus rdo rje phur pa'i grwa tshang zhig gsar 'dzugs bzhed nas/ snar thang gi phur pa grwa tshang gi grwa rigs bcu phrag gsum tsam zhig logs su bsdus nas phur pa'i sgrub dkyil la sogs pa sbyangs pa byed du gzhug pa mdzad 'dug pa rnams la/ phur pa'i chos skor cha tshang ba zhig stsol dgos pa'i gsol 'debs mi dbang nyid kyis mdzad pa bzhin/ thog mar sa skyong chen po sku rkyang la phur pa'i smad las drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang shin tu smin pa stsal/ der rjes phur pa ba'i grwa pa rnams dang / mi dbang chen po'i drung 'khor drag rigs sogs chos nyan pa bsam grub rtse'i tshoms chen khrig khengs pa'i shin tu grangs mang ba la rjes gnang zab mo de nyid kyi bka' drin stsal/ de dus rje 'dis rdo rje phur pa'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar zhib tsam dang / rnying ma spyi dang / phur pa'i chos skor gyi khog phub pa'i gsung bshad ha cang rgyas pa ma yin pa'i gsung gi 'od 'phreng gis drung 'khor phur pa ba'i grwa rigs dang bcas pa'i skya ser mang po'i dad gus kyi chu skyes bzhad par mdzad/

khyad par smon dro nas dbon drung tshe dbang pa dang / glang bu nas/ bde rgyas pa sogs gsung rab kyi don la blo gros kyi mig bu gsal ba dag ni/ rje 'di'i rnam dpyod la deng sang mkhas par grags pa sus kyang 'gran mi bzod pa'i nges shes gting nas rnyed/ dad gus bcos ma ma yin pa'i bstod bsngags dbyangs su len/ tha na zhu 'phrin 'bul ba'i tshe yang / de nas bzung ste rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhabs drung du zhes zhu bar byed do/ /mi dbang chen pos kyang lo mthong bkra shis sbug sogs kyi chos gzhis 'di rnams bka' stsal ma dgos par phul/ gzhan yang da lta phur bzlog gi skabs sogs sku la bzhes bzhin pa'i gsol phod mchin kha gser ma 'di sogs zang zing gi 'bul nod rgya dpang shin tu che ba yang 'bul bar mdzad/ de dus lan gcig bdag mo rtse gdong nas khri lcam drung la bka' chos shig dgos tshul sde bdag nyid kyis zhus par brten/ rje nyid kyis bka' 'brel tsam mdzad pas/ de nas ma 'gyangs par khri lcam drung la rgyal bu 'khrungs te byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma kun la gsal bar gyur to/ /de nas ngor e wam̐ chos ldan nas shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas pas yar lam ngor la phebs dgos pa'i snyan gsol phul/ yar lam snar thang gi rten rnams zhib mjal gnang nas/ e wam̐ pas phebs bsu ser 'phreng gzab ma dang bcas phebs/ der rten khyad par can rnams la dkar me snyan dar sogs mchod pa rgya chen po phul/ bstan 'gro la phan pa'i smon lam rmad du byung ba mdzad/ der gnas kyi dge 'dun rnams la rgya ja'i btung ba/ gral 'gyed gya nom pa dang bcas pa yang stsal/ de'i tshe dgon gnas de'i rten khyad par can rnams dang / rje rdo rje 'chang gi rmad du byung ba'i mdzad 'phrin rgyun mi chad pa'i legs byas rnams la thugs dwang 'dod kyi dad gus ci yang zhig 'khrungs nas/ der bzhugs skabs ngor chen nyid la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad yi ge'i ma mo la spel ba'i legs pa zhig kyang mdzad/

shar chen de nyid dang / thar pa rtse pa nam mkha' sangs rgyas gnyis kyis thog drangs/ ngor nyid kyi bla ma grwa rigs dang bcas pa la rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs stegs mi 'jigs pa seng ge'i khri steng nas dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin ci rigs pa stsal/ de nas nyid kyi gdan sa bar pa dge sdings bkra shis bsam 'grub kyi skya ser rnams kyi phebs bsu'i bkod pa gzab pa dang bcas gnas der phebs te/ de lo sa dkar 'dab 'debs su bdag chen kun dga' legs pa'i gdan sar bla ma zhig gnang dgos tshul be re rgyal po dang gtsang pa gnyis car nas zhus pa bzhin/ der bla ma chos rgya mtsho dang / rgya kab nor bu gling gi bla mar ye shes 'od zer rdzong rta gnang ba yin pas/ khong rnams la spyi 'gro'i bka' shog rgyas pa dang / be re rgyal po sogs la sger gyi thugs dam gnang rten sogs dang bcas rdzong bkod kyi gnang skyes dgos pa kun de gong zin kyang / sgar la phyag nas zhu bar mar lam dge sdings su 'byor ba dus mtshungs nas/ sgar thams cad la phyag nas dang / khong rang bla ma gnyis la 'phral yun du phan pa'i bslab bya'i tshogs gang mang zhig mdzad cing / dge sdings bkra shis bsam grub sogs rang zhabs kyi skya ser mang pos thog drangs/ dbang zhu ba khri phrag tu longs pa la khrom dbang sogs kyi bka' drin zla med stsal/ yar gyi phebs lam dbang stod nas byang khud brgyud/ dar lung du bskang gso rgyas pa mdzad/ de nas byang khud zer ba'i dar lung gi rgyab kyi yul grong 'dir phyag dbang zhu mi mang po'i khrod na bud med rgan yol gzugs bongs che zhing ske la lba ba chen pos khengs pa zhig 'dug pa de la/ rje 'dis spyan cher gzigs/ phyag dbang nan che tsam gnang / gzhan cang mi gsungs/ de nub bskang gso grol nas rang byon du phebs pa'i tshe/ nyid kyi phyag mdzod chen po dang / bdag gnyis la/ da nangs dar lung gi rgyab kyi yul grong na 'dug pa'i bud med lba ba can de/

zhing skyong chen mo'i yum chen zhig yin pa 'dra/ de 'dra'i lba ba dkyus mar mi 'dug gsungs/ don la yum chen dngos su gzigs par snang / de nas gdan sar phebs te/ lo de'i zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du sa mchod chen mo'i sgrub mchod sogs bsu bar mdzad nas/ snga mor 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang pos 'dra 'dri rtser shing mgon yid bzhin nor bu sogs bzhugs pa'i mgon khang zhig mdzad pa/ phyis su shing mgon gdan sar phebs nas/ mgon khang der rten grags che ba med par brten/ der mgon khang srid gsum rnam rgyal mdzad bzhed nas gdan sa chen po 'dir bzhugs pa'i mgon po lcam dral 'phags pa rin po che'i thugs dam ma zhig yod pa la rtsi skyar gsol/ sprul sku ngag dbang chos bzang do dam par byas/ gzhan 'ga' zhig gis mdo lir spyan drangs/ rje nyid dpon slob ban gtsang ba dang bcas pa rnams zla ba dgu pa'i nang du dge sdings la gdan btegs/ lhun po rtse'i rtsa ba der 'bul skyel ba bungs chen po yong gi yod zhu ba'i rkang mgyogs dang mjal/ rten 'brel shin tu legs par 'grig zla ba de'i gza' skar bzang ba la sngar gyi mgon po rtse'i mgon khang du bzhugs su gsol/ snyan dar dang spyan gzigs sogs rgya mi chung tsam phul/ rab gnas mnga' gsol gzab rgyas mdzad/ dus gtor gyi rgyun yang 'dzugs pa gnang / de nas rgyun ring ma 'gyangs par rgya skabs dpon gnyer bsam bstan bzang po sogs gnyer pa khag bdun/ rta dre'u mdzo la sogs pa brgya phrag gnyis kyi rgyab bcas kyi 'bul skyel shin tu stobs che bar 'byor/ chos skyong dgyes pa'i mtshan ma yang dag par dgongs/ de nas bzung ste lo grangs du ma'i bar du dge sdings sogs shab gzhung phal cher lo legs shing / 'khrugs long dang nad yams nyung ba sogs bde 'jags kho nar gyur to/ /slar 'bul skyel ba rnams sngon la rdzong bkod gnang rjes/ rje nyid dpon slob rnams kyis zla ba bcu pa'i drug cu pa la phebs 'byor mdzad de/

de dus bzhi thog gi mkhar las skabs yin pas/ dus mdos chen mo'i ring ma gtogs bzhi thog gi mkhar las nam zin bar rig 'dzin pho brang du bzhugs/ rje nyid dgung lo so gnyis su phebs pa rnam byung zhes pa sa pho 'brug lo'i zla ba dang po'i mjug tsam la mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa gdan sa chen po'i grwa rigs rnams kyi phebs bsu ser 'phreng rgyas pa dang bcas phebs/ de dus dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang 'bro lugs/ rwa lugs/ bu lugs te brgyud pa'i khyad par gsum dang ldan pa ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun/ dbang gong ma bzhi dang bcas pa dang / dus 'khor dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs/ bdag 'jug dang bcas pa rigs ldan rnam rgyal grags bzang gis mdzad pa/ rje 'gyur med pas mdzad pa'i dus 'khor dbang bshad chen mo'i lung rnams gsan cing / gzhan yang de dus mkhas grub shangs pa du gu ba'i lugs kyi chos skor byin rlabs kyi skor la/ thog mar 'jug sgo yon tan kun 'byung gi steng nas sgyu lus dbang mo che sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas bde mchog lha lnga'i byin rlabs lus bsgrigs te/ khog phub kyi bka' gnyis/ gdams ngag dbang dang 'brel ba chos drug po'i bka' ste gzhung shing gi bka' brgyad/ phyag chen ga'u ma/ lam khyer gsum/ lus sems 'chi med bka' ste phyag chen bka' lnga/ mkha' spyod dkar dmar/ mkha' spyod gsum 'khrugs te mkha' spyod kyi bka' gsum/ bde mchog gsang sgrub/ rnam 'joms gsang sgrub/ phyag rdor dza li ma ste gsang sgrub bka' gsum/ thugs rje chen po'i rigs gtad dkar dmar/ gzhan yang lha bzhi bris sgrub kyi bka'/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi bka'/ phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i rjes gnang gtor dbang dang bcas pa/ pu ka chos drug gi byin rlabs dang / khrid kyi skor la/ phyag rgya chen mo/ chos drug lus sems 'chi med kyi khrid rnams rim pa bzhin nyams skye khrid kyi tshul du gsan nas/

rgyab chos lung gi skor la/ bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil mchog sgrub thabs/ mchod 'phreng rnams mkhas btsun pas mdzad pa sogs nai gu'i yi ge rnying pa po tir longs pa dang / nai gu'i brgyud 'debs ma tshar chen gyis mdzad pa dang / de'i gsung la mkhyen brtse bas zin bris mdzad pa'i nai gu'i khrid kyi dbu phyogs dang / phyag chen ga'u ma'i khrid yig brgyud 'debs sogs yi ge gsar ma mang po dang bcas pa'i lung la sogs pa shangs chos thams cad ma tshang ba med pa lta bur gsan par mdzad/ gzhan yang grub chen a bha ya ka ras bkral ba'i rdo rje 'phreng ba dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu zhe gnyis kyi steng du/ paṇ+ḍi ta dar+pan a tsar+ya ste 'gro ba'i me long zhes bya ba tshems lan nyi shu brjes pa/ dgung lo stong dang nyis brgya bzhugs pa des mdzad pa'i kri ma sa muts+tsha nas lhag por 'byung ba'i gza' yum/ nor rgyun ma/ rnam rgyal gyi dkyil 'khor te dge legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum bsnan pa'i bzhi bcu zhe lnga'i dbang rnams gsan/ de nas rje nyid kyis mkhan chen de la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi dbang / brgyud pa'i bka' bab bdun dang bcas pa/ dbang bka' gsar rnying gi khyad par 'byed pa'i legs bshad du ma dang bcas pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas gsang 'dus rim lnga'i dmar khrid 'gos lugs gtsang ma/ rgyab chos yig rnying du ma dang / mtha' drug rab gsal sogs bu ston gyi gsung mang po/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i sgrub dkyil gyi lung sogs gsang 'dus 'phags skor gyi chos bum pa gang byo'i tshul du stsal pas/ mkhan chen mkhas pa'i dbang po nyid rje 'di'i rmad du byung ba'i mkhyen rab dang / khyad par gsang 'dus kyi chos skor la gzhan dang mtshungs pa med pa'i 'chad tshul rma med pa gsan pas thugs phrogs te/ rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i kye rdor rgyud gsum gyi sngon 'gro tshul bzhi ston pa'i yi ge sogs su/

sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa zhes pa'i mtshan gyi dge legs gsar pa'i mnga' gsol sogs kun tu rje 'di la bstod bkur bsngags gsum kho na mdzad/ dam pa 'di'i bka' drin las gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor la blo gros kyi dkyil 'khor cha shas rdzogs te/ legs par bshad pa'i 'od 'phreng gis phan bde ku mud rgyas par byed pa'i mkhas pa'i zla dbang du gyur/ de lta'i ring nas dpon slob lhan cig par mang mkhar gyi chab la phebs/ mtha' drug rab gsal gyi lung 'phros sogs 'ga' zhig chab thog tu yang stsol bar mdzad do/ /de nas rgyun mi ring par mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa des rang gi bsti gnas bsam grub dgon gsar gyi grwa rigs thams cad la gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dbang lung cha tshang ba stsal te/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil gyi steng nas gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa'i sgrub mchod gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa da lta yang dar rgyas che'o/ /de nas gdan sa chen po'i bla brang bzhi thog gi bla ma gong ma na rim gyi gzim khang tshoms dmar steng 'og nyid kyi gzim chung ngo mtshar 'chi med rdo rje'i pho brang e wam̐ byang chub 'byung ba'i gnas steng shod/ li ma lha khang / rgya nag lha khang / dpe khang rnams/ 'og gi phyag mdzod dang bcas pa rnams kyi mkhar las rgya khyon shin tu che ba rnams phal cher grub mtshams/ de dag dang sbrel chags su lha khang chen mo'i byang shar gyi lcog btsun mo spe'ur grags pa yang rtsa ba nas slong bar mdzad/ de dag gi zhal bkod phal cher grub pa'i nub gcig rje nyid kyi mnal lam du sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras gsum dang / rje nyid bsam gling la phebs rgyu yin dgongs pa'i btsun mo'i shar rtsa 'dir/ grub mchog dbang po'i mtshan can chibs pa de hed pa'i rnam pas sngon la phebs/ de nas 'gyang cung zad byas yab rje grags pa'i mtshan can/ de nas sngags 'chang chen po'i zhabs rjes su rje nyid phebs kyin 'dug pa la/

sngags 'chang chen pos thog mar btsun mo spe'u la gzigs rjes/ rje 'di la gzigs nas zhal 'dzum shin tu che ba zhig mdzad byung bas/ nged kyis btsun mo rtsa ba nas bslangs pa 'di la/ sngags 'chang chen po thugs dgongs rdzogs po byung ba 'dra dgongs pa thugs la 'khrungs pa yang byung / de ltar dpal sa skya'i bla brang rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa gdung brgyud bzhugs pa'i bla brang bzhi thog tu grags pa'i yang rtser sngon med pa'i gtsug lag khang khyad par can li ma lha khang rdo rje'i gdan zhes bya ba dang / rgya nag lha khang ri bo rtse lnga/ dpe khang chos mdzod chen mo rnams su mtshan gsol te/ spyir sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang rnam dbyer med pa brtse chen kun dga' snying po nas bzung rim par byon pa rnams dang / khyad par snyigs ma'i dus kyi bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen yab sras rnam pa gsum po de dag gi thugs dgongs la/ gdan sa chen po 'di nyid bod kyi rdo rje gdan gnyis pa gangs can gyi skye dgu ma lus pa'i phan bde dang / bstan pa rin po che'i 'byung khungs mtshungs bral yin pa nas/ 'dir rgya gar nas byon pa'i sku gtso bor gyur pa'i li ma lha khang zhig dang / rgya nag lha khang zhig byung na dgongs pa'i thugs kyi re ba cher mdzad pa'i dgongs pa'i lhag ma lus pa lta bu'i thugs bzhed bskang ba'i phyir dang / gzhan yang khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa bud+dha dh+wa dza la sogs pa rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs pa'i phyir dang / bstan 'gro spyi dang khyad par dpal ldan sa skya pa'i sde bstan pa gdung brgyud dang bcas pa yar ngo'i zla ba'i cha shas ltar 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / 'bab ldan ma'i rgyun bzhin nam yang chad pa med cing gnas par bya ba'i phyir dang /

mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba rnams thar pa'i bde ba la 'god pa'i phyir 'bad pa dang rtsol ba chen pos nye bar bsgrubs pa rnams rje nyid dgung lo sum cu rtsa gsum du phebs pa dkar po zhes pa sa mo sbrul gyi lo gsar du shar ba'i tshe yongs su rdzogs pa zin nas/ lo de'i gza' skar shis pa la rje nyid 'khor rdo rje 'dzin pa mang po dang bcas pas dpal kye rdo rje la brten pa'i rab gnas smin rgyas su mdzad la/ de lta bu'i gtsug lag khang khyad par can li ma lha khang gi ldebs ris dang shing brtsegs sogs la thub pa'i sku brnyan mang po dang / rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ lam 'bras brgyud pa yongs rdzogs dang / sngags 'chang yab sras/ rje mus chen rnams kyi sku brnyan che ba re rnams kyi bar skabs su rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gsum dang rje nyid mi 'bral ba'i tshul gyi sku chung ngu mang po/ rten khri'i rgyab 'og gi ldebs na sgrol dkar gyi sku brnyan brgya tshar lhag tsam dang / 'bur sku'i rnam grangs ni/ rten khri star pa bdun gyi dang po'i rten gtso thub pa'i sku gzugs ka ma ru'i rdo las byung ba'i che legs/ gnyis par rdo rje gdan chung ma chos rje sa paṇa gyi dbu gtsug phul ba'i byin rlabs can 'khrul med gser gyi rgyab yol phra rgyan gyis spras pa/ gsum par thub pa rta zur mar grags pa/ bzhi par thub sku zangs tang ma che legs/ lnga par 'od dpag med/ drug par thub pa ma chags pad+ma/ bdun par 'od dpag med li dmar rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i sku brnyan li ma sogs nyis brgya dang brgyad cu gya drug mchod cha 'phags pa rin po che'i dbang bskur skabs mchod pa bshams snod dzhai k+ṣim gyi ting gser spras ma bdun tshar dang gzhan yang ma na hā dang / g.yang kri dang / byu ru dang / man dang / chu shel dang / me shel dang / mu men la sogs pa'i bdun cha dang / me tog dam spe dang / ja ma bum sogs rin po che shas che ba'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa/

gnam rgyan bum gdan gser ma gsum gyis mthong byas kyi bla bre dang / sog gos gser sgrigs btags kyi steng / se 'u'i 'brug kha sprod gling gsum gyis mthong byas kyi bla bre gnyis shin tu dngos gtsang ba/ rgya 'phan gser ma du ma dang / 'phan ring thung 'dres pa'i gos 'phan mang pos mdzes par brgyan pa dang / gzhan yang de nas da bar yan chad 'bul mi byung ba rnams dang bcas yongs bsdoms pa'i li ma sogs sku brnyan sum brgya dang bdun cu don lnga rnams bzhugs/ rgya nag lha khang gi ldebs ris sogs la 'od dpag med kyi sku mang po/ thub dbang la gnas bcus bskor ba/ bde mchog bla brgyud rnams kyi bar mtshams dag la bla ma rnam gsum dang 'bral med kyi tshul mang po/ gzhan yang chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum/ 'khon dpal po che/ thon mi/ jo 'brom rnam gnyis sogs dang / tshe dpag med kyi sku brgya tshar lhag tsam/ 'bur sku ni/ rten khri bang rim lnga pa'i dang po'i gtso bo 'jam dbyangs rtsod rgyal ma/ gnyis par 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa/ gsum par 'jam dbyangs kyi sku hor dus ma/ bzhi par thub sku dngul las bzhengs pa hor dus ma/ lnga par 'jam dbyangs seng ge la chibs pa rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i sku brnyan rgya nag ma bdun cu don gnyis/ bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad/ rjes su 'phel ba'i sku gzugs du ma/ shel dang / mu men dang / g.yang kri la sogs pa'i skyogs mang po/ me shel dang / chu shel gyis phyur bur bkang ba dang / gzhan yang rin po che'i bye brag rigs mang po sogs kyi mchod cha khyad par can bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gos ding dpon gyis mthong byas kyi bla bre dang / gos phrug sngo dkar se'u mas mthong byas kyi bla bre shin tu dngos gtsang ba dang / rgya 'phan gser ma du ma dang bcas pa/ dpe khang chos mdzod chen po na/ sa skya bka' 'bum tshar bdun/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge

sems dpa' chen po/ glo bo mkhan chen/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rin/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras gsum rnams kyi bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs/ rje nyid kyi bka' 'bum tshar gsum sogs dang / gzhan yang mdo sngags rig gnas kyi yig cha rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi gsung rab kyi glegs bam bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig bzhugs pa rnams la gdong dar lnga brtsegs kyis spras te/ skye bo su zhig gis mthong yang yid 'phrog pa dang bcas pa rnams la dkar me rgyun 'bar gsum re rgyun ma chad pa dang bcas pa yod pa 'di yin no/ /de nas rje 'di dgung lo so bzhir phebs pa rab myos zhes pa lcags pho rta'i lo/ slar yang mkhan chen mkhas pa'i dbang po der/ gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dbang ras bris la brten pa/ chag lugs/ dpyal lugs/ dha na shi la'i lugs te brgyud pa'i khyad par gsum dang ldan pa/ rdzogs rim shin tu spros med kyi zab khrid/ de dang 'brel ba'i spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs/ 'od gsal 'char ba'i byin rlabs/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs rnams dang / bi rū pas mdzad pa'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang / bskyed rim gyi gzhung gsum/ rdzogs rim gyi gzhung gsum/ las tshogs kyi gzhung gnyis/ ngor chen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i bum pa/ dkyil chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ khrid yig spros med mdzes rgyan/ klu sgrub rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs dang / rgyun gyi nyams len gyi yi ge tshar chen gyi gsung la klu sgrub rjes zin bris mdzad pa'i khog phub/ bskyed rim rnam bshad/ khrid kyi zur 'debs rnams kyi lung dang bcas pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang / las gshin lha bcu gsum ma'i rjes gnang / 'jigs byed sngags btu'i byin rlabs/ rwa khrid mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud/ lung la shis brjod/
