dbang gi brgyud 'debs/ sgrub thabs/ lhan thabs/ phyag gnyis pa'i mngon rtogs tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/ mkhyen brtse ba'i khrid kyi brgyud 'debs shis brjod/ rta ra bas mdzad pa'i dbang chog zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rnams dang / rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i dkar chag nang bzhin gyi rwa pod phal cher gyi lung / dkar chag tu ma thebs pa'i shin tu zab pa'i man ngag gi yi ge mang po'i lung / las gshin dpa' gcig las gshin dmar po khrag mdog las gshin dmar po bse bya bzhis bskor rnams kyi rjes gnang sogs 'jigs byed kyi chos skor bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan no/ /de lta'i skabs gan par bdag po mthu stobs drung dpon blon thugs 'dod ma legs pa'i thugs bsun la brten/ lo de'i zla ba bzhi pa'i nang du gan par phebs/ khong dpon blon lha gyeng sbyor gyi legs 'dom gnang yang / bdag po'i dgongs par ma 'thad nas/ blon po rnams zur 'jog dang / gzhan ma phyag phyi zhu mi skabs bab kyi bka' 'dom dang / de dus phu dmar zhabs drung yang gan par bzhugs skabs yin pas/ sku mched gnyis char du 'phral sel bka' chos dgongs bzhed bzhin stsal ngos/ phu dmar zhabs drung dang chos kyi bka' mchid kho na mdzad pa'i skabs shig mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdo phyogs kyi pod chen drug las brtsams pa'i 'bel gtam zhig yod pa 'di'i nang na/ paṇa chen rin po che la yang dpyad pa phran bu mdzad 'dug pa la/ rje'i drung nas paṇa chen gyi dgongs pa bzhin lan du yang 'gro ba'i pod chen drug gi khog phub cig mdzad na mkhas pa'i bgyi ba rma med par snang zhing / bstan pa la phan pa'i rngo thogs tshul phebs pa ltar/ rje des kyang mkhas pa dga' byed du mtshan btags pa'i legs bshad kyi grangs su 'dren 'os pa zhig mdzad/ de la 'phros nas phan tshun nas lan yang lan sogs kyi spros pa mang du mdzad pas legs bshad rgyud mar bgro ba byung /

der skabs gan pa'i mgon khang gi ru mtshon la glo bur du me 'bar yang rnga ma tshig pa sogs ni byung / rje nyid la zhus pas/ lod rgyu rang med dam gsungs/ de nas slar gdan sar phebs 'phral zla ba drug par bsam brtser phebs dgos pa shar nas/ sde srid yab yum 'khor bcas la skabs bab kyi zab chos ci mang zhig stsal/ de'i tshe rtse gdong khri rin po che yang bzhugs pa la tshe dbang zhig dang / kun mkhyen chen po'i sdom gsum spyi ṭīka gi lung sogs gsan/ de bka' 'brel thog ma yin/ der skabs mda' dpon sgos lung pas sger mjal zhus nas/ na bza' dngos gtsang 'ga' zhig phul/ byang chub bar gyi skyabs gnas zhus/ rjes su khong la bsnyun gzhi shin tu thu ba zhig byung nas/ sman spyad rim gro ci byas kyang phan par mngon pa gtan ma byung bar/ rje 'di la gnas tshul tsam phul ba na/ gsung las gtar zhig gyis shig pa'i bka' phebs pa na/ 'tsho byed dag gis/ gtar gyi 'jug ga la yod zer mi spobs kyang / khong rang rje 'di'i bka' la yid ches gdengs khel yod pa'i stobs kyis gtar zhig byas pas gzhi med du dwangs/ de nas lo ltar gyi zhal ja rtse mo khor drug re yang 'bul zhing dad gus shin tu che bar byed/ rje 'dis kyang thugs rje'i spyan ras kyis 'tsho ba'i mthus sog dmag gis bsam rtse la bskor dus/ gtsang dpung gi phyir 'thon byas skabs/ khong gis rje 'di'i sku 'gag cig lag na yod pa de gyon nas phyin pas/ gtsang pa'i dpung tshogs mang po gron/ kha cig gis 'bros snga bas thar/ khong gis dbu tshugs bskyed pas sog dmag gi dkyil du 'thum/ gri mdung mda' sogs mtshon cha'i char babs kyang / sku 'gag la skyon pa tsam yang ma byung bar rdzong nang du bde bar slebs pas/ dad mos sngar bas kyang cher 'phel/ gzhan gyis kyang ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa byung ba sogs mda' dpon 'di la byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mtshan ma'i gtam mang du yod do/

/de nas gdan sa'i phur sgrub la phyag phebs te/ der skabs rtse gdong nas bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku 'bring ba gdan sar phebs/ thub bstan mkhan chen ngag dbang bstan pa'i rdo rje yang zhabs 'bring du 'byor/ khong dpon slob rnams la rdo rje phur pa'i dbang / nag po rim bzhi'i khrid sogs bzhed chos mang po'i bka' drin stsal/ de dus mkhas dbang brtan pa'i rdo rjes rje 'di la rnam thar bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa bcu phrag lnga dang bdun yod pa zhig phul/ rje 'di la spyir bstod tshig mdzad pa po nyid kyi rnam 'dren spyan snga rin po che dbang phyug rab brtan/ gser mdog can gyi mkhan chen lcang dam chos rje/ 'brug pa'i dbu che chos rje sangs rgyas rdo rje/ dbang phyug rab brtan pa'i thugs sras chos rje glang phul/ rgyas chos kyi bla ma shes dpal bzang po sogs shin tu mang yang / ngag dbang pa'i 'di legs shing don bzang bar 'khum/ lo de'i zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du dpal sa skya'i chos sde lho byang gi grwa rigs drag bsdus sogs mang po la sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang yongs su rdzogs pa/ nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rje btsun sa skya pa rang gi gdung rabs byon tshul gyi yi ge rgyas pa'i lung sogs chos kyi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa stsal/ de nas dgung lo so lnga pa skyes bdag ces pa lcags mo lug gi lo bstan pa'i sku chags dang / rnam pa sku khrag rgyas pa la mtshal gtar 'gyangs pa'i rnam pas rgyas 'khrugs kyi bsnyun gzhi shin tu thu ba zhig sku la nyen che ba rang zhig byung bar brten/ gdan sa 'di'i chos sde lho byang sogs dgon chen mang po la mang ja/ zang zing gi 'gyed bcas rgya dpang shin tu che bas/ chibs pa yang phal cher gral 'gyed du btang ba'i der skabs chibs rwar chibs bdun tsam las ma lus pa byung zhing / de mthun na bza' zhal dkar sogs kyang shin tu mang ba gnang ba de dag gi legs byas dang /

rtsa brgyad nas 'tsho byed mkhas pa'i phul phyin mgon bsam drung gis nyer dgu gtar sogs mi 'os pa'i dus yin kyang / tsham tshom med par sku la mtshal gtar phul bas/ re zhig sku gzung chug dka' tsam byung yang / bstan 'gro'i bsod nams kyi dpal du sku la skyon par ma gyur te/ de dus nyid kyi mnal lam du dbu rtse'i 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba gser zangs kyi mdangs can 'di min pa'i/ sku gzhon sha can shin tu dwangs shing gur gum byugs pa lta bu'i ser mdangs yod pa zhig gzigs/ des rje nyid la mchog tu brtse ba'i nyams kyis sku la 'khyud pa mdzad byung ba na/ rje nyid kyis kyang shin tu gus pa'i sgo nas phar sku la 'chang zhing gsol 'debs mang du mdzad pa zhig byung / de'i nangs par nas sku gshed kyang chug khyad che ba'i ngos zla ba drug pa'i nang du sku khams sngar kho na bzhin sor chud/ de'i dga' ston dang / slad kyi yang sku'i rkyen sel la dgongs skya ser gyi skye bo khri phrag tu longs pa la sbyin gtong bla na med pa mdzad/ rje 'dis dga' ston gyi sbyin gtong mang du mdzad pa'i thog ma 'di yin no/ /de nas sngon rje btsun dam pa kun dga' grol mchog thugs dam ma gtso bsdus kyi bris sku grab cig da lta rje nyid kyi phyag na yod pa 'di gzigs res kyis/ rje dam pa de chos rgyus che zhing bstan 'dzin thams cad la ris med kyi dad pa'i sgo nas gtso bsdus 'di zhal bkod shin tu ngo mtshar ba byung 'dug dgongs shing zhal nas kyang gsungs la/ 'di lta bu'i rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par sa skya pa rang gi bstan 'dzin grags che ba dag gtso bor byas/ bde kye gsang gsum sogs mdo sngags kyi chos brgyud gtso che ba rnams kyi bla brgyud kyis bskor ba'i bris thang zhig bzhengs bzhed pa'i thugs 'dun snga mo nas yod pa bzhin/ nyid kyi dgung lo so gsum tsam nas dbu btsugs/

so bdun pa dpal gdong zhes grags pa chu mo bya lo yongs su rdzogs pa grub ste/ lo de'i chu stod zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi gza' skar bzang po 'dzoms pa'i nyin/ rje nyid dpon slob bcu phrag gsum tsam gyis kye rdo rje la brten pa'i rab tu gnas pa legs par mdzad/ de dus nam mkha' shin tu dwangs pa la me tog gi char 'bab pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas kyang mang du byung / de lta bu'i gtso bsdus kyi bris thang chen mo'i gtso bo rdo rje 'chang la dus gsum sangs rgyas/ sngags 'chang yab sras gsum/ rje mus chen/ spyan gzigs byams pa sogs kyis bskor la/ de'i g.yas dang po thub pa'i dbang po la gnas brtan bcu drug rgyal chen bzhi sogs kyis bskor ba/ gnyis pa 'phags pa klu sgrub la rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs/ gsum pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi rū pa'i sku'i rnam 'gyur drug pa sogs/ bzhi pa 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po la chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum/ 'khon dpal po che/ thon mi sam+bho ṭa sogs/ lnga pa slob dpon rtse mo la lam 'bras brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ drug pa chos rje sa paṇa la dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi brgyud pa sogs/ bdun pa bla ma bdag nyid chen po la dus mchod bla brang gdung rabs sogs/ brgyad pa theg chen rin po che la gur gyi mgon po'i rjes gnang / khrid/ man ngag rnams kyi bla brgyud sogs/ dgu pa rje rdo rje 'chang la kye rdor rgyud gsum gyi bshad bka'i bla brgyud sogs/ bcu pa sems dpa' chen po la gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i chos skor gyi brgyud pa sogs/ bcu gcig pa bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan la gshed dmar gyi chos skor gyi brgyud pa sogs/ bcu gnyis pa rdo rje gdan pa chen po la 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi dbang brgyud sogs/ bcu gsum pa 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen la rdo rje 'phreng ba kri ya dang bcas pa'i bla brgyud sogs/

bcu bzhi pa rje dkon mchog lhun grub la gur rigs bsdus dang / sam+bu ṭi rdor dbyings kyi dbang gi brgyud pa sogs/ bco lnga pa tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po la theg chen blo sbyong brgyud pa sogs/ bcu drug pa grub mchog bsod nams dbang po la yang dag gi brgyud pa sogs/ bcu bdun pa mus chen bud+dha'i mtshan can la rnal 'byor ma'i chos skor gyi brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba/ yang gtso thang gi g.yon dang po 'od dpag med la byang sems nye ba'i sras brgyad sogs/ g.yon gnyis pa slob dpon pad+ma la gu ru mtshan brgyad sogs/ gsum pa jo bo rje la bka' gdams lha bzhi/ mkhan po bo dhi satwa/ sad mi mi bdun sogs/ bzhi pa rje sa chen la kye rdor rgyu dbang zhal ngo nang brgyud sogs/ lnga pa rje btsun chen po la bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi brgyud pa sogs/ drug pa 'phags pa rin po che la gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dbang gi brgyud pa sogs/ bdun pa bla ma dam pa la kun rig sa lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa sogs/ brgyad pa mkhan chen g.yag pa la zhen pa bzhi bral gyi brgyud pa sogs/ dgu pa rong ston shes bya kun rig la tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma'i brgyud pa sogs/ bcu pa bdag chen rgya gar ba la gur drag brgyud pa sogs/ bcu gcig pa kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge la gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi dbang brgyud sogs/ bcu gnyis pa glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub la 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi chos skor brgyud pa/ bcu gsum pa sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa la dus 'khor brgyud pa sogs/ bcu bzhi pa sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po la rdo rje phur pa'i bla ma brgyud pa sogs/ bco lnga pa rje dkon mchog lhun grub la sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang brgyud sogs/ bcu drug pa sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros la dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i chos skor gyi brgyud pa sogs/

bcu bdun pa rje nyid sbyin bdag gi tshul du bzhugs pa la tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa sogs kyis bskor ba ste/ de re re la yang sngags 'chang chen po/ rje nyid kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gsum dang rje nyid mi 'bral ba mtshon byed kyi sku brnyan re re/ ston pa'i sku bzhengs bzhugs dang / phyag rgya tha dad pa ci rigs byas pa'i yongs bsdoms brgyad cu gya dgu tsam/ bde kye sogs yi dam gyi sku nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ tshe lha sum cu so dgu/ byang sems bcu gnyis/ chos skyong bco lnga/ nor lha bdun la sogs pa dang / bla ma'i sku brnyan yongs bsdoms stong ra can la nye ba tsam bzhugs pa'i bris thang de thams cad la/ gos khyad par can gyi gong gsham 'ja' ris gsum sbrags/ zhal khebs bzhi brtsegs/ bsgril shing gi tog dang / 'gel thag gi a long rnams dngul dkar 'byangs brdung / de dag la gos yug tshangs bco lnga/ dar yug bzhi bcu zhe lnga tsam/ gser ris sogs la gser zho bco lnga/ dngul nyag bco brgyad lhag tsam sogs 'bul bar mdzad la/ de lta bu'i bris thang khyad par can 'di dag ni mdo sngags kyi chos tshul mtha' dag la rnam dpyod kyi bzhin mdzes pa/ gzur gnas kyi 'dren byed gsal ba dag la dang 'dod kyi dad pa'i ltad mo ci yang zhig mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ ngag dbang chos grags 'jigs bral bi rū pas/ /grangs med dbang dang rgyud bshad gdams pa'i gter/ /sgo ru bskyal tshe brtse chen bla ma yang / /yid skyengs zhi ba'i dbyings su gzims pa snyam/ /'phags yul grub pa'i dbang phyug a bha yas/ /thugs kyi ku mud ye shes ḍāk+ki ma'i/ /lung bstan 'od kyis bye tshe bcu phrag bzhi'i/ /rmad byung dbang gi bdud rtsi'i dog pa dang / /'gro ba'i me long rnam dpyod ngos yangs su/ /rab 'byams rgyud don ri mo bkra ba'i gzugs/ /shar ba dge legs byed pa gsum gyi dbang /

/bcas pa'i zlos gar bal po'i yul na bsgyur/ /e ma de lta'i ngo mtshar ltad mo'i dpyid/ /'phags pas dka' ba'i khur khyer brtson pas rtas/ /re 'dod mig gi bcud du 'khyil ba'i rgyun/ /khyod kyi snying stobs hub bus yud kyis drangs/ /lha yi drang srong rnam mang thos kyi sras/ /gnod sbyin 'jig rten skyong ba lus ngan po'i/ /lnga phrag gsum gyi rjes gnang nor gyi bus/ /khyod thugs bang mdzod phyug pa'i legs byas ltar/ /snyeng bral grub dbang dharma pa la yi/ /pha brgyud 'o ma'i rdzing bu dkrugs pa'i bcud/ /spros med zab khrid dbang dang bcas pa'i ro/ /rnam dpyod ljags kyis myangs kyang ma tshim par/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i zhal bzang gangs ri las/ /'ongs pa'i rwa khrid 'bab ldan la li ta/ /badz+ra'i mkhyen mtshor 'khyil las dngos brgyud kyi/ /yongs 'dzin zhal bzang skyogs las khyod kyis gsol/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug nai gu'i thugs mdzod nas/ /khyung po'i mkhyen bzang sug pas legs blangs pa'i/ /chos drug yid bzhin khyod kyi rnam dpyod rtser/ /bkod de byin rlabs bka' lung lhab lhub mdzes/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i zab bcud rim lnga'i khrid/ /khyod thugs bdud rtsi'i mtsho nas lhag bsam gyi/ /yur bar nyer drangs mkhas dbang thugs zhing sar/ /bcus pa'i phan bde'i 'bras bu g.yur du za/ /rgyal dbang rigs gsum mgon pos sprul pa'i gar/ /grangs med bsgyur ba nor 'dzin dkar po 'di/ /'chi med dbang po'i rnam rgyal khang bzang la'ang / /'gran par bzod pa'i legs byas khyod kyis bskrun/ /rgyal bas rnam mang sa 'dzin rin po che'i/ /phung por byin brlabs sras bcas sangs rgyas kyi/ /snang brnyan ji snyed lnga rig paṇa chen dang / /rig byed mkhas mang kyis bskrun skye dgu'i dpal/ /de lta'i mdzes skus yongs gtams dri'i gtsang khang / /rnam mang mchod rdzas kun bzang rnam 'phrul la'ang /

/co 'dri 'di ni dbus 'gyur rdo rje'i gdan/ /nyid dang mtshungs kyi gzhan ni 'ga' dang ni/ /zur phud lnga pas byin brlabs yul gru che/ /bod chen gnas su byang sems sprul pa'i gar/ /sa la spyod 'gas 'gro ba'i bsod nams mgron/ /ngo mtshar rgyal sku legs byas grangs med bskrun/ /phyi nas bho ṭa'i bstan 'gro'i nags klung du/ /phan dang bde ba'i 'dab stong bzhad pa'i phyir/ /rgya nag lha yi khang bzang nyin mor byed/ /thugs bskyed shing rtas sa dkar mkha' dbyings drangs/ /'di ko khyod kyis ma yin rtse lnga'i ri'i/ /'jam mgon nyi mas ljongs 'dir 'phral yun dus/ /phan bde'i yon tan snang ba gsal ba'i phyir/ /rnam par 'phrul pa'i 'od stong spros par nges/ /drang srong gsung bzhin spyi bos blang 'os pa/ /mkhas mang gsung gi glegs bam yid bzhin nor/ /legs bshad dgos dgu 'byung gnas bye ba brgyas/ /phyug pa'i chos kyi bang mdzod 'di na ko /'gro 'dir bka' drin phul byung ston pa dang / /bstan la de nyid gnyis pa nā ga dzu/ /pad+ma ka ra bi rū sa skya pa/ /brgyud rim bris sku rnam bkra ngo mtshar gzugs/ /mthong ba'i mod la rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing / /grangs med cig char mig gi mngon sum pa'i/ /spyod yul nyid dam ci zhes dpyod ldan yid/ /'khyog po'i ri mo da dung zlog ma gyur/ /yang cig rtogs tshe 'di dag bris pa'i skur/ /nges te gzhan du phul byung rig byed pa'i/ /sor rtse'i 'phrul gyis ji snyed sangs rgyas zhing / /byams pa'i mig gi bdud rtsir ston mi spobs/ /de nas sngags 'chang bla ma 'di nyid dgung lo so brgyad du phebs pa dngos po zhes pa shing pho khyi'i lo grub mchog mthu stobs dbang po dpal rab na bzhugs pa spyan drangs/ de dang stabs cig spyan snga rin po che yang phebs te/ de dus grub mchog nyid kyis mkhan rin po che rin chen rgyal mtshan las sa skya bka' 'bum gyi lung gsan/

rje nyid kyis grub dbang de'i gsang yum nam mkha' sgrol ma dang rnam rab nas chos rje'i drung lcam sring gnyis/ gzhan yang gzhis byes kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po la gsung ngag rin po che'i bka' drin stsal rjes/ spyan snga rin po che la sngar ma gsan pa'i rnying ma'i zab chos 'ga' zhig sogs chos tshul mtha' yas pa gsan/ phyi lo rje nyid dgung lo so dgu pa na tshod ldan zhes pa shing mo phag gi lo gdan sa chen po'i khams phyogs kyi 'bul dpon pa sogs bla ma slob dpon grwa rigs mang po la sgrub thabs rgya mtsho nas 'byung ba'i rjes gnang ma lus pa dang / nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar chen mo'i lung sogs stsal/ de nas nyid kyi dgung lo bzhi bcu pa 'dzin byed ces pa me pho byi ba'i lo'i zla ba bcu pa'i nang du stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i mi dbang karma bstan skyong dbang po'i dus kyi rim gror lo ltar gyi bsam rtse'i nye skor gyi mgon po'i grwa rigs thams cad bsdus pa'i ser 'tshogs re gnang gi yod pa'i/ de lo'i ser 'tshogs dbur rje nyid spyan 'dren gyi zhu gsol 'bul bar rang byon nas dpal lags dpon g.yog mngags pa'i ngor/ rje nyid dpon slob ban gtsang ba bcu phrag lnga tsam gyi zhabs 'bring ba dang bcas phebs/ der skabs sngags dgon rnams kyis rang rang gi phyag len bzhin gyi gtor bzlog re so so nas gnang ba zhig 'dug pa kun zin pa'i rjes su rje dpon slob rnams kyis phur bzlog cig gnang ba'i gdab las sogs phyi'i phyag phyir/ gdan sa rang nas byon pa'i dpon slob rnams kyi steng du/ phur pa ba'i bla ma bkra shis chos 'phel ba dpon slob bco lnga tsam dang / gur pa grwa tshang gi bla ma dpal 'byor ba dpon slob bcu tsam gyis kyang byon pas zhal grangs kyang shin tu mang bar byung / de dus rtse gdong khri chen po yang rtser bzhugs pa'i skabs yin pas/

rje 'di dpon slob rnams kyi zor gtor gnang sa gzhis ka rtse'i shar gyi grong khyer bud tsam der mdzad/ zor bskul tshugs tsam nas bsam rtse'i lho'i ri ldebs nas glo bur du rlung 'tshub skya grags pa zhig langs nas je che je cher song ba dpon slob rnams bzhugs thad du song ste/ zor 'phangs pa dang mnyam du shin tu che ba'i ngang nas shar la song ba kun gyis mthong nas/ nangs par rtse gdong nas dpon slob rnams kyi gsung las/ kha sang 'tshub ma yong lugs/ 'gro lugs sogs de bzhin byung bas/ khyed dpon slob tshos gtor bzlog spyi las nus che ba'i ltas su snang ba gdon mi za bas shin tu bka' drin che gsungs pa sogs dgyes dgyes dpe med gnang / de mthun rjes su ya 'brog la sog dmag yong ba rnams kyi dpon tsho kho rang nang 'thab kyis kun gron nas/ da lta hūm̐ thal phyi zer ba'i ming tsam las mi snang / de nas khri chen gyi gsung las/ rje nyid rtse gdong du phebs dgos pa'i snyan gsol dang / sde srid nas kyang da lam phebs bzhud gnang ba cis kyang legs tshul zhus/ zhal ngo sku gzhon pa rnams kyis spyan 'dren gyi pho nya mngags pa bzhin phebs te/ bzhugs zhag gsum mdzad/ de'i ring la 'jam pa'i dbyangs byams pa bsod nams lhun grub dpal bzang po dang / de'i gcung ngag dbang bsod nams lhun grub dpal bzang po gnyis gcen dang bcas pa sku mched gsum dang / thub bstan mkhan chen ngag dbang bstan pa'i rdo rje sogs dpon slob mang po la tshe bka' sogs chos dang / zang zing gi bka' drin tshad med pa stsal/ zhal ngo rnams kyis kyang 'phral gyi bkur bsti dang / 'bul nod kyi dngos po rgya mi chung ba phul te phar byams brtse dang / tshur dad mos kyi legs byas gnyis 'gran pa bzhin du gyur/ de nas yar lam gser mdog can du phebs te/ gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dpal shākya mchog ldan gyi dngul gdung rin po che sogs chos grwa chen po de nyid kyi rten khyad par can rnams mjal/

der mang 'gyed bsnyen bkur dang / 'jam mgon sa paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs chos kyi bdud rtsis mkhan slob grwa rigs dang bcas pa kun tshims par mdzad/ de nas gzhis ka rtser phebs nyin sa skyong chen po drung 'khor gyi tshogs dang bcas pa zangs mkhar gyi byang rtsa der phebs bsur 'byor/ de nyin nam mkha' shin tu dwangs pa la 'ja' dkar po dang / me tog gi char babs pa mchod yon zhal 'dzoms nas rtser ma phebs kyi bar du byung / der rjes bsam rtser bzhugs ring mi dbang chen po sogs la zab chos stsol ba dang / rtse gdong bdag chen khri rin po cher zab chos nod pa zung 'brel du mdzad de/ lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi khrid sogs zab cing dkon pa'i chos tshul gong du bkod pa de dag phal cher de dus gsan pa yin no/ /skabs der 'jam mgon khri rin po che de nyid spyir sa skya pa rang gi zhal ngo bgres kha dang / thugs zhi zhing dul ba/ gsan rgya yang che bas slar yang zab chos 'dra gsan bzhed pa'i skabs mtshams shig la gdan sa chen por phebs dgos pa'i snyan gsol mdzad par/ rje nyid kyis kyang dam pa 'di'i rmad du byung ba'i mkhyen rab dang / phul du byung ba'i mdzad 'phrin rnams kyis thugs phrogs te/ phebs spro ba'i zhal bzhes gnang yang / phebs thub pa zhig ni ma byung / de nas sde srid kyis phur pa grwa tshang du dgongs pa gtad pa'i gur mgon lcam dral gyi 'cham sku zhig rje nyid la zhal bkod dgos lugs kyi snyan 'bul zhus pa ltar/ gdan sar phebs 'phral zhal bkod gnang / de dus gdan sar chibs kha bsgyur ba'i nyin/ dong rtse na kha bar sde srid 'khor bcas des snga bzhin phebs skyel la thegs pa'i bkra shis lhun po'i thad stod der/ mchod yon chibs bral mdzad pa'i mjug la bud med cig rje nyid la phyag dbang ma thob pa'i gdung bas skad chen pos ngu zhing brgyugs yong ba zhig dang /

de nas brgyal la bab mtshams su rje dpon slob phebs pa'i tshe/ nub phyogs nas rlung 'tshubs shin tu che ba phyug po gzhung khrigs khengs pa zhig snar thang du ma phebs kyi bar la byung bas/ de nub rje'i gsung las/ da nangs kyi bud med ngu rgyangs byed pa de dang / thal rlung 'byung lugs de bzhin dkyus mar mi 'dug rten 'brel legs rgyu yang ma byung / nged mchod yon slar zhal 'dzoms legs tshogs che ba zhig ji ltar yong gsungs/ gdan sa chen por phebs 'phral 'cham mgon bzhengs pa'i zhal bkod gnang / der skabs kyang phebs sgor 'cham mgon bzhengs bzhed 'di sogs sde srid rang nas thugs bsam rnam dag gi mdzad sgor 'dug kyang / 'cham mgon 'di grub nas/ bsam rtser phebs pa zhig ma byung dogs ka 'dug gsungs/ de bzhin gyi phebs sgo dang gong gi bka' stsal de ni/ rjes su sde srid bsam rtse nas phebs dus mchod yon mjal tsam byung yang legs tshogs kyi mjal 'dzoms ma byung ba dang / 'cham mgon yang phebs ma thub pa 'di sgrib med du ye shes kyis gzigs pa'i gsung du snang bas kun gyi yid ches kyi gnas so/ /de nas lo de'i nang du gtsang phyogs 'dir 'brum bu'i nad kyis thams cad du khyab par brten/ mi dbang bstan skyong dbang po yang 'brum 'dzem gyi gcad rgya shin tu dam pa gnang / gzhan yang bla dpon drag rigs 'brum nad ma thar pa kun 'brum 'dzem kho na byed pa dang / de mthun gdan sa chen po 'dir yang skya ser thams cad 'brum nad lhag par lci ba nas/ nad des thebs pa'i rigs la rol mo'i sgra chen po lta smos kyang ci dgos/ bon rnga tsam yang nye skor du brdungs na 'brum nad gsor mi rung ba kho nar gyur pa'i shin tu nyam thag par gyur pa'i tshe/ rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid snga gong mus su phebs dus sku la 'brum bu thor tsam byas pa'i sku 'brum 'dra ba cher yang ba zhig bzhes pa la/

'tsho byed rnams kyis kyang sku 'brum yin thag chod kyi snyan gsol zhus/ gsol sman phran bu mchod dgos pa byung ba tsho yang 'brum bu'i gnyen po kho na phul/ slar thams cad yid ches pa yong zer/ shangs kyi steng du 'bur ru che ba zhig byung ba/ 'gog ran nges med par phyung bas/ 'bur shul che ba zhig dod pa da lta yang gsal bar yod cing / de'i rgyu mtshan gyis rjes su 'brum nad gzhan la byung skabs 'dzem bag gtan ma gnang yang / des snga rje 'di la gtan nas ma byung ba rnams la dpags/ phyag phyi ba bgres bzhon thams cad kyis de gong sku 'brum bzhes grub pa thag chod kho na byed pa zhig yod na'ang / rje nyid sngon gling gar bzhes pa de 'brum bu yin min tshul gsal por bka' mi phebs kyang / de lo dbu rtser zhen pa bzhi bral gyi khrid lung gi tshogs mang po dang bcas chos sde lho byang gi grwa rigs sogs chos nyan brgya phrag tsam la stsal ba'i dus/ chos sde'i grwa pa 'brum nad las grol nas rgyun ring ma song ba/ gdong la 'brum bu'i rjes chen po yod pa rnams la phyag dbang gnang dus dang de dag gzigs pa'i tshe thugs shin tu rtsems par gnang ste/ zhal nas kyang / nged la yang 'brum nad yong las che gsungs pa la/ nyid kyi zhabs 'bring pa chen po rab 'byams smra ba bsod nams 'od zer ba dang bdag cag sogs kyis/ zhal ras la sku 'brum gyi rjes gsal po yod phyin/ snga mor bzhes grub ma grub la the tshom mi 'dug tshul zhus kyang / ji ltar yin nam ga gsungs/ thugs sbram thang nge ba zhig rgyun du mdzad kyin 'dug pa bzhin/ lo de'i hor zla bdun pa sngags 'chang chen po'i dus mchod phur sgrub chen mo'i tshes bcu gnyis sa 'dul gyi snga dro sku 'brum gyi skya nad du grags pa der 'dug kyang / snga gong bzhes grub khul de'i stobs kyis/ de bzhin yin dgongs pa 'tsho byed rnams kyi thugs la yang ma shar zhing /

zhu gsol yang ma byung bar brten/ de nyin sa 'dul gyi sku 'cham tshang ma sku khams ma bde ba'i ngang nas sngar mkhyud ltar dang / nangs par bcu gsum la ston/ bcu bzhi la tho rengs byin rlabs rgyas pa'i rgyas pa/ dbyangs tshes thogs sogs thams cad sngar mkhyud ltar mdzad pas/ de'i nangs par bco lnga'i snga dro sku byin dang / zhal ras la 'bu ru kha cig 'thon 'dug pa/ bdag gis sku bzhengs pa'i phyag phyi zhu dus mthong 'phral 'dug tshul zhus pas/ rje nyid sku 'brum yin dogs de ka gnang gin 'dug kyang / 'tsho byed sna'u pa dang / gzim chung pa gnyis car gyis sngar gyi de nyid thugs yul du 'jags che ba'i skyon gyis 'brum g.yan ga yin mdog kha/ ci ste sku 'brum yin na 'bur ru rnams skam lugs 'brum g.yan dang mi 'dra ba zhig yong zhu ba nas/ gsung chog la phebs/ de nyin sku khams cung zad bde nyams kyis gsungs dbyangs la gsung yang che tsam mdzad pa dang / ban gtsang dbu byed sangs rgyas 'phel bas/ de ring gong bzhugs gsung chen po mdzad kyin 'dug sku khams dwangs po yod 'dra zer dgyes spro mdzad/ de nas bcu drug gi nyin zhal dkyil la yang sku 'bur shin tu mang zhing / sku byin la yang mang du rang song ba zhig byung yang / 'tsho byed tshos zhu rigs ltar/ sku 'bur rnams skam lugs ji ltar yong gzigs kyin sku shin tu ma bde yang sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i dus mchod 'di khag che bas bshol ma dgos tsam byung na dgongs thugs bsran bskyed pa gnang / bcu bdun gyi nyin sku 'bur 'thon snga ba rnams skam ngo phran bu byung yang / 'tsho byed rnams kyis sku 'brum yin nges ma dgongs par/ de bar 'brum bu'i gsol sman gtan ma phul/ de nas rje nyid kyi thugs kyis mkhyen nas/ da cha 'brum bu yin thag chod nangs par bsdus pa 'ga' gsungs/ tshes bco brgyad nyin dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol mdzad/ bsdu ba gnang /

der sku rim du phur bzlog nyin gsum ma zhig dang / mgon po drug cu pa nyin gsum ma gcig grwa pa rnams sgrub tu 'jug pa gnang / de nas tshes bcu dgu nas sku 'brum thams cad skam ngo dod/ bsnyun gzhi lhu grol yang / sku 'brum bzhes grub khul des cung zad ras su shor nyams kyis spyan la shin tu nyen che ba zhig byung / 'tsho byed mgon bsam drung 'phral 'bod gnang / phebs 'phral spyan 'gugs kyi phyir sku me zhig phul song bas/ je dwangs kyi ngos nyes par ma gyur/ 'on kyang de'i stobs kyis da lta yang ljags lung sogs kyi tshe spyan cung zad mi bde ba yong gin 'dug gsungs/ de ltar rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid kyis de gong sku 'brum bzhes grub tshul 'tsho byed mkhas pa rnams kyis gsungs kyang / nyid kyi de ltar ma yin par dgongs pa'i 'brum nad la thugs skrag pa'i snang ba mdzad kyang / gsal por mi gsung ba ni rjes su sku 'brum bsnyun gzhi tshabs chen po sku 'cham/ gsung dbyangs/ rol mo sogs kyi sku babs nan tar che ba'i skabs su bzhes te/ de'i gnyen po'i rigs tha na gsol sman gcig tsam yang ma gsol bar/ gzhi med du dwangs pa de bzhin sogs rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa'i mtshan ma yang dag pa ston bzhed pa yin par gdon mi za'o/ /de'i tshe nye skor gyi skya ser thams cad/ da lo gzhan ma rnams la 'brum nad kyis thebs dus rnga re re tsam gyi sgra yang nye skor du grags mi nyan pa la/ gong bzhugs phur sgrub kyi sku 'cham dang / gsung dbyangs rol mo sogs kyi sku babs chen po de 'dra'i ngang nas sku 'brum gegs med du bzhes pa bzhin/ de nyid kyi grub rtags rang du 'dug go zhes gleng zhing / sku la ma skyon par dga' spro dang / bsnyung dus sku bab chen po byung ba rnams dran pas shin tu 'jigs par yang gyur/ tshul de phyogs kun tu rim gyis grags pas/ blo gros dang ldan pa thams cad grub rtags su nges pa rnyed pa'i ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa zhig byung ba yin la/

rje nyid kyi gsung las ni/ nged kyi snga mo 'brum pa thar pa'i khungs des/ 'brum zon gang yang ma byas par phur sgrub kyi 'cham sogs bab shin tu lci ba'i brel ba rnams spyad pa de rtogs rtsing chen por song 'dug kyang 'brum nad las gegs med du thar lugs de bzhin/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs rje byin rlabs rang du snang / gzhan ma de 'dra'i zos pa yong don mi 'dug skyabs su mchi zhes gsungs shing / spyir yang rje 'di'i dgung lo bcu gcig gi dus byas 'gyur du grub mchog bsod nams dbang por gsung ngag gsan pa'i tshe/ sngags 'chang chen po'i rnam thar gsung ba gsan pas thugs dad bcos min 'khrungs te/ der skabs byas 'gyur gyi gzim khang steng shod du phebs dus/ mi med par sngags 'chang chen po sbub grwa bsnams pa zhig dang mjal yong dgongs nas gcig pur phebs bzhud kyang mang du mdzad pa dang / de mthun sku na smin nas rgyun du sngags 'chang de nyid kyi rnam thar kho na bka' stsal cing / rtsom bzhed kyang che bar 'khrungs/ slar rnam thar 'di mdzad zin nas de 'dra'i skyes bu la rnam thar zhig dgos nges su snang ba thub pa 'di don che shos shig grub pa yin zhes gsungs shing / gzhan yang dus mdos dang phur sgrub sogs gnang res kyis sngags 'chang de nyid kyi bstan pa'i phyir ngal dub spangs te/ dwang bzhes gnang ba'i mdzad 'phrin rlabs po che rnams lta ci smos/ dus mdos zab mo dang / phur sgrub sogs kyi bca' bsgrigs 'di tsho la bsam na yang / spyi dang mi 'dra ba'i mdzad par 'dug pas/ de nyid kyi bstan pa'i rgyun 'di ma nyams tsam zhig ma byung ba'i thabs mi 'dug ces gsungs shing phyag bzhes su 'debs par mdzad/ rjes su dus 'gyur gyi tshe yang a la la/ da lta'i dus na gdan sa chen po 'dir sa skya pa rang gi bstan pa gtsang ma 'phel rgyas mi chung tsam yod pa 'di sngags 'chang chen po'i bka' drin kho nar snang /

snga sor sngags 'chang chen po 'dra zhig ma byon na/ da cha 'di tshor yang chos lugs sogs la sna tshogs yong rigs su 'dug pa rje 'di'i bka' drin bsam las 'das gda'/ zhes yang yang gsung ba dngos su thos shing / gzhan yang rje 'di nyid sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal por thugs dad gting nas g.yos pa'i tshul mang du snang yang / 'dir ma spros so/ /de nas rje nyid dgung lo zhe gcig tu phebs pa dbang phyug ces pa me mo glang gi lo gan pa nas bdag po mthu stobs drung sku mched rnams 'brum bu sogs kyi bsnyun gzhi la brten sku gshegs pa'i tshe/ gan par bshar stabs kyis phyag phebs te/ dgongs rdzogs su dgon mang po la mang 'gyed/ rtse gdong bdag chen khu dbon so so sogs bla ma mang po la bsngo zhus kyi rten gnang ba/ rje nyid kyis yun ring po'i bar du kun rig gi gsung chog dang / byang bu bsregs pa/ sku rus la phyag tsha sogs rjes kyi sgrub dgos che phra thams cad rkang len kho na mdzad/ khyad par dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi'i tshogs dbur grub mchog mthu stobs dbang phyug spyan drangs te/ rten mchod mang po dang / zang zing gi 'bul nod rgya dpang shin tu che ba phul/ rten bzhengs kyang bdag po bsod nams mthu stobs dbang po'i sder dngul gdung phal thog phyed gnyis tsam yod pa zhig dang / gcung gnyis la thun mong du de bas cung chung ba re re bzhengs/ gzhan yang lo zla'i dus mchod kyang bsgrubs pa sogs thugs rje chen pos rjes su 'dzin par mdzad do/ /de dus mi dbang karma bstan skyong dbang pos phur pa ba rnams la chog mang btsugs pa'i gur gar dang / phur pa'i 'cham sogs cho ga'i phyag len thams cad spyan 'bebs dogs dpyod zhu ba dang / lhag par gsung ngag lam 'bras shig 'phral yun du gal che bar dgongs nas bla ma grwa rigs dang bcas pa gdan sar rdzong rta gnang ste zla ba bdun tsam zhig gdan chags/

de'i bar la lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa sogs kyi chos tshul mtha' yas pa'i bka' drin stsal/ lo de'i zla ba drug pa'i nang du skye bo sbyin gtong gi dga' ston chen po'i steng / 'jam pa'i dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug la gsung bsngo zhu ba'i rten du sgrol ma'i dngul sku mda' tshad tsam zhig gis thog drangs sku gsung thugs kyi rten du ma/ zang zing gi dngos spyad dpag tu med pa dang bcas 'bul bar mdzad/ de lo mi dbang chen pos rma bya la gtogs pa'i grong grangs bdun cu tsam chos gzhis su 'bul sbyor zhus/ rje nyid dgung lo zhe gnyis pa 'bru mang po zhes pa sa pho stag lo'i zla ba dang po'i nang du mi dbang karma bstan skyong dbang po'i zhu gsol bzhin ngam ring dgun chos kyi thog mtha' mi la ched du gtad pa'i gtor bzlog cig la phebs dgos shar/ phar lam grang mo cher tshar chen gyi gser gdung sogs rten zhib mjal dang / grwa tshang la mang 'gyed kyang stsal/ chos sde chen por phebs nas mang ja du ma dang / gser 'gyed gya nom pa'i rnyed bkur dang / tshogs chen la a ra pa tsa'i rjes gnang sogs chos kyi bka' drin yang stsal/ gong dkar grwa tshang sger du mang 'gyed 'du khang zhig bzos gsar bzo lta bu bsgrubs 'dug pa la phyag nas dang / der khrom dbang zhig kyang gnang / ngam ring byams chen dang / rtse'i rten rnams kyang mjal ba mdzad/ tshur lam thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i sprul pa'i sku gang des sgro mo lung du spyan 'dren zhus/ rnyed bkur 'bul nod rgya dpang che ba phul/ thugs bag phebs kyi gsung gleng yang mang du mol/ nangs par rin chen sdings su skya ser khri phrag tu longs pa la tshe dbang gi bka' drin stsal te/ de nub gdan sa chen po'i bde mchog pho brang na rje btsun gcen bzhugs pa'i drung du phebs/ lo de'i zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes brgyad/ res gza' pa sangs dang /

skar ma she sa te/ dkar po nam gru'i 'grub sbyor bzang po 'dzoms pa'i nub mo/ nyid kyi thugs sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sku bltams/ de nas rgyun ring po'i bar du zla ba re re bzhin gyi tshes brgyad la nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis gang ba kho na dang / sku lhums su zhugs pa'i skabs rje nyid kyi mtshan ltas su dar 'phyar ba dang / dung 'bud pa dang / rol mo 'khrol ba sogs bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma byung ngo / /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ gang yang chos min 'da' nu'i bu yi mgron/ /snying stobs lto ru zhu yang ma tshims par/ /rnam mang chos tshul chu gter mtsho'u tshogs/ /brtson pa'i hub kyis gsol bzhed shing rta dang / /dad gus dri bzhon drag pos grub pa'i rje/ /mthu stobs mtshungs pa'i zla med nyin mor byed/ /'gro kun ring du dga' ba'i don grub mkhan/ /rgyal sras 'od dkar can de'ang ring nas bos/ /dri med chos kyi 'od 'phreng gsol ba dang / /zab lam bdud rtsis skal bzang bung ba'i tshogs/ /tshims pa'i legs byas mnyam du smin mdzad khyod/ /rgyal bstan chu gter mdzes pa'i me tog yin/ /yangs pa'i sa la spyod pa mig stong pa/ /bstan skyong dbang pos ma rung kla klo yi/ /'dam bu'i dpung tshogs bsrung phyir sa srung bu/ /gang khyod dad dang gus pa'i lcags kyus bsus/ /de tshe rtsub mo'i sems ldan dgra sde'i g.yul/ /ming mthar byed pa'i dge ba'i ru mtshon 'phyar/ /rang rigs grangs med nges don zab mo la/ /bsti gnas rtse gdong chos dkar snang bas gsal/ /lnga rig mkhas pa'i phul phyin shākya'i mtshan/ /mdo sngags gzhung gi sgo 'phar 'bum phye ste/ /blo gros gsal ba'i skal bzang grangs med la/ /legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston 'jo ba'i sa/ /gser mdog can zhes yangs pa'i chos grwa che'i/ /byin rlabs gzi byin 'bar ba'i rten ci snyed/

/legs mchod phan bde rgyas pa'i gsol 'debs dang / /'dus tshogs chos kyi sbyin pas tshims par mdzad/ /bstan pa ri bor 'gongs pa'i sa'i bdag po/ /'dus byas mtha' bzhi'i ngang tshul ngom pa'i tshul/ /rgyal ba'i sras la'ang lkog tu gyur pa'i don/ /ye shes me long ngos su ma sgrib gsal/ /mi sdug 'brum bu'i nad kyis skye bo'i srog /skad cig nyid la brtse med 'phrog pa'i gtam/ /thos pa tsam na'ang kun gyi snying 'dar tshe/ /rdo rje'i sku chen brnyes pa'i mtshan ma bstan/ /'jam pa'i mgon khyod ye shes ral gri'i mes/ /'brum nad tshang tshing sreg 'di spyan ras gzigs/ /kun dga' snying pos sme ba nag po'i me/ /thugs rje'i chu yis gzhil la 'gran min nam/ /skye ba'i 'phreng ba kun tu sa skya par/ /gus dang sri zhu'i skal can shar kha ba'i/ /mi dbang mched gsum thar pa'i grong du spos/ /e ma tshul der sems yod su mi dad/ /ngag dbang lha rigs chu shel las grub bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis nya gang zhing / /chos kyi dbang phyug phan bde bdud rtsi'i 'od kyis snyigs dus bstan pa'i smag rum 'phrog /rab snyan grags pa'i bsil zer stong 'phro skal bzang chu srin rgyal mtshan can gyi gtsug /mdzes byed 'jam mgon zla gzhon bstan 'gro'i dpal yon bzang po deng 'dir shar/ /e ma gangs ljongs skye bo gnyis skyes tshogs/ /dga' dang spro ba'i 'dren byed yar gtod dang / /gtan du phan bde'i bdud rtsi ster ba'i lha/ /'jam gsar 'od dkar can de 'di min nam/ /de nas rje 'di dgung lo zhe gsum pa/ myos ldan zhes pa sa mo yos lo rtsang pa nas lhor dpung 'jug mdzad/ 'brug pa'i yon bdag thams cad kyi khang par me rgyag sogs dang / zhabs drung nyid kyang lcags ri zer ba'i dben dgon kho na la 'khra btsan mdzad dgos shar ba sogs thugs nyams shin tu dma' ba byung skabs/ rje 'di dpon slob rnams kyis zla ba dang po'i tshe phag ri bar bshar stabs su phebs/

de nas bsam rtser sde srid dang / mda' dpon dgos lung pa spa gro na yod pa la dpung bsdu dgos pa'i bka' nan chen po stsal par brten/ /rtsang dpung tshur bsdus/ rtsang 'brug so so nas log 'gal mi mdzad pa'i dbu rtsi bzhes ngos/ legs spel gyi bka' 'dum yang dag par mdzad/ de dus phag rir zla ba gcig tsam gyi bzhugs gnas grub thob thang stong rgyal pos btab pa'i bsam grub lha khang du mdzad/ der sngon grub chen nyid kyi phyag bzo 'khrul med kyi mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang mda' gang pa zhig grub chen gyi sku 'dra nad gcod mar grags pa sogs rten byin rlabs can 'ga' zhig 'dug pa rnams la phyag dang zhabs skor/ gsol 'debs kho nas grub chen de la rkyen gyis mi 'phrog pa'i thugs dad 'khrungs te/ gsol 'debs kyi tshigs su bcad pa tshan pa gnyis dang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched gnyis la yang mtshan spel gyi gsol 'debs don bzang zhing tshig sdebs legs pa re re yang mdzad/ phag ri'i lho bod kyi mtshams khad mtho shing / kha ba chen po nyin mtshan sbrel nas 'bab pa'i gnas yid du 'ongs rgyu rang zhig mi 'dug pas/ de dus kha ba chen po byung res kyis jo mo lha ri gnas pa'i gangs chen po zhig 'dug pa de phyogs su gtor ma re phul/ jo mo la 'phrin bcol re mdzad pas myur du chad 'gro ba byung bas/ der gnas kun deng sang dpyid dus 'dir rgyun pa yin na kha ba rgyun chad med pa babs pas/ khang pa'i phyir 'gro sa mi rnyed pa lta bu'i phag ri nang rtse skor zer ba'i kha ba 'di la de snga sus kyang byed thabs yong gin med kyang / da lo sa skya bdag po'i byin rlabs su 'dug re dga' zer ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa byung / de nas tshur lam la phyi dang / gad shing lung / gan pa/ lhog pa/ na ring sogs su khrom dbang dang thugs rje chen po'i sgom lung re gnang ste/ thams cad la yi ge drug pa ji tsam 'dren gyi dam bca' re bzhes pas/

dung phyur bzla ba'i dam bca' 'bul ba shin tu mang ba dang / 'ga' zhig gis nyin rer khri phrag re/ phal cher gyis stong dang / tha mas kyang brgya phrag re tsam khas len mi byed pa ni gtan nas ma byung / tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas kyang 'gro ba mang po'i sems kyi zhing sa la thar pa'i sa bon rma med pa 'debs par mdzad do/ /gdan sar phebs nas mi ring bar bde mchog pho brang gi zhig gsos kyi dbu btsugs/ de yang gtsug lag khang mgon khang dang bcas pa la/ thog mar arga'i cho ga tshul bzhin du mdzad rjes/ sngar gyi 'gram rnying las kyang zab ring tsam brus nas rtsig 'gram shin tu brling bar byas te/ zla ba bzhi'i ring la ma lus pa zin pa'i mgon khang gi ldebs ris la mgon po brgyud pa sogs dang / steng gi gtsug lag khang la 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi bla ma brgyud rim gyi sku'i nyams gso dang / logs bris su lam 'bras brgyud pa dag pa'i zhing mchog bde ba can gyi bkod pa yid du 'ong ba rnams mdzad de/ sa mo yos lo zla ba lnga pa'i gza' skar bzang po 'dzom pa'i nyin gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol tu cha ther phub ste/ rab tu gnas pa rgyud sde nas ji skad 'byung ba bzhin mdzad/ de lta'i ring nas rigs ldan pad+ma dkar po nyid mi bdag gi rnam rol tu shar ba'i byang phyogs kyi sa chen po chos bzhin du skyong bar rigs ldan rnam rgyal grags pa bzang po zhes mtshan gyi dge legs tsam gyis kyang dpyod ldan gyi yid la sim pa sbyin nus pa/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ chos rje rgyal ba pa la sogs pa mkhas grub mang po las gsan pa'i rtser son cing / rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i pha mthar phyin pas/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis bstan pa rin po che gsal bar nus la/ khyad par legs bshad rtsom pa'i tshul la snyeng pa dang bral ba/ gzhan yang dus kyi 'khor lo'i gzhal yas khang blos bslangs bkod pa ngo mtshar can gser dngul las grub pa bzhengs pa sogs rmad du byung ba'i mdzad 'phrin mtha' yas pas rgyal bstan bla nar 'degs bzod pa'i skyes chen de nyid kyi sku gdung lhun sdings su dngul gdung dang bcas bzhugs pa la/

phyis su mchod 'bul lta ci/ sku gdung nyid kyang srang dbar gyi khyi zas su 'gyur bar nye ba na/ rje 'dis rigs ldan chen po'i sku gdung gdan sa chen por spyan drangs te/ bla brang nyi lder bzhugs su gsol ba'i tshe/ sku dpung g.yas phyogs kyi ngos thams cad la drod chen po byung ba na/ sngon yang gser gdung gi bum ldir la bde drod rang 'bar du yod tshul rnam thar las 'byung ba la yid ches khyad par can 'khrungs nas/ snyan dar mang po/ mchod pa'i rgyun sogs kyang 'dzugs par mdzad/ de lta'i skabs shig mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ gdung brgyud rin po che ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug mjal ba'i phyir gdan sa chen por phebs te/ de gong rje 'di la gdung brgyud 'byon pa'i ched du gsol 'debs/ 'phrin bcol sogs do gal shin tu che ba mdzad kyin yod par/ re ba'i 'bras bu mngon du gyur pas thugs dgyes spro dpag tu med pa dang / slar gsung mkhyen pa na mjal bzhed thun mong ma yin pa mdzad/ de dus rje 'dis 'jigs byed rwa lugs lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang sogs gsan cing / spyir mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen par snga phyir chos gsan pa'i rnam grangs la gong du bkod pa de rnams dang / gzhan yang mang du gsan pa'i tshul rnams ni rje nyid kyi gsan yig na gsal lo/ /de nas rgyun mi ring bar rje nyid dgung lo zhe bzhi pa dpa' bo zhes pa lcags pho 'brug gi lo la/ rtse gdong nas bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang bsod nams lhun grub yum sras gnyis gdan sa chen po mjal ba dang / rje nyid la gsung chos 'ga' zhig gsan pa'i phyir phebs 'byor byung ba la/ mgon po'i dbang lnga dang / sa lo'i bka' 'bum sogs bdag chen nyid kyi thugs bzhed dang mthun pa'i zab chos ci rigs pa stsal/ zang zing gi gnang skyes kyang tshad med pas thugs rangs par mdzad/ de nas rje nyid dgung lo zhe lnga pa khyu mchog ces pa lcags mo sbrul lo/

gu shrī rgyal po'i dmag dpung chen po bod du slebs te bsam rtse la bskor rgyag byas/ dbus gtsang 'dir 'khrugs long shin tu che ba byung skabs/ rtsang sog mdun chings kyi phyir/ rje dpon slob rnams kyis shar la chibs kha bsgyur/ de skabs sog rigs rnams kyis stag la sogs la drag zhan ci 'dra zhig byung yang zos mi bde ba kho na byed pa na/ rje nyid kyi snyan pa tsam thos pas mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa gu shrī bla mar grags pas rang gi gnyer pa sogs rje 'di'i phebs lam gyi phyag phyir mngags pas gegs med par ngor du phebs/ der re zhig bzhugs nas rtsang sog so sor bka' 'doms gang mang zhig gnang yang / phan tshun dgongs dbyings mtho stabs gsan shes gdengs khel zhig mi snang ba nas/ slar gdan sar phebs/ de lo bstan 'gro spyi sger don la dgongs/ sbyin gtong dga' ston gsum pa mdzad de/ chu pho rta lo'i zla ba gsum pa'i nang du slar yang shar la gdan btegs te/ mi dbang karma bstan skyong dbang por 'phral yun gyi bslab ston lhug 'dom gnang / mi dbang chen pos kyang / theg chen rin po che'i thugs dam ma sher shing las grub pa'i gur mgon gyi sku brnyan/ 'phags pa rin po che'i thugs dam 'khrul med mgon po'i sku brnyan si'u ma thog tshad tsam shin tu ngo mtshar ba/ rgya sbug zhing skyong lha dga' sogs phul/ 'di phyi kun tu thugs rjes 'dzin dgos pa'i snyan gsol phul/ de gong sog dmag mang po gdan sa brgyud nas la stod lho phyogs la byung skabs/ gdan sa chen po'i gzhi bdag klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen zhes bya ba sngon gyi dus klu'i rgyal po sog ma med du grags pa gnas pa'i ne'u gsing rdzing chung dang bcas pa sprul pa'i lha khang chen mo'i byang rtsar yod pa'i seg pa zhes bya ba'i khar sgar bsdad pas/ gzhi bdag klu rgyal 'khor bcas la grib kyis sbags pa'i mtshan ltas byung nas/

de sel ba'i ched du chab klu'i gtor ma dang khrus gsol sogs mang du mdzad/ sog po rnams chos skyong gi 'khu ldog dang / klu rnams la sbags grib shor ches par brten/ nor bu rin chen bya ba'i sog dmag stod na yod pa rnams kyis phal cher gron chen du btang nas/ thor tsam zhig lus pa rnams/ mar lam gdan sa ma brgyud par lho 'grims byas nas 'gro dgos pa byung / sbrul lo nas bzung lo gsum gyi ring / dbus gtsang gi ljongs 'dir mu ge chen pos nyams thag par gyur pa'i tshe/ skye 'gro rnams kyi bde thabs la dgongs/ gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi gtsug lag khang thams cad du re mos kyis rje nyid nyin re bzhin phebs nas gsol 'debs dang / maṇ+ḍal stong tshar sogs smin rgyas kho na dang / 'dren pa gong ma so so'i dus dran gyi bla ma mchod pa'i gsung chog rnams kyang / zhabs phyir ban gtsang ba dang bcas gtsug lag khang so sor gnang nas/ thams cad du bla mchod tshar re re yang nges par thub pa mdzad/ sgo rum sogs mgon khang rnams su yang bstan 'gro la phan bde 'byung ba'i 'phrin 'chol dang / thugs dam bskang ba/ sngags bsngo stong tshar sogs rtag 'grus kho nas dus 'da' ba gnang / rje nyid dgung lo zhe drug tu phebs pa chu pho rta'i lo de la/ ngam ring mkhan chen klu sgrub dar rgyas pas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ mkhan chen dpon slob rnams dang / chos rje lho byang gi grwa rigs thog cig la lo de'i zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa zab mo'i bka' drin stsal te/ zla ba gnyis tsam gyi ring la zin par mdzad/ mkhan chen nyid sogs drag bsdus la cha lag kyang stsal pa yin no/ /sbrul rta lug gsum gyi lo 'di rnams la/ gdan sa chen po'i phu kha'u sogs su yang mi grib can 'gro 'dug mang bar brten/ phru ma sgrub sde'i bdud 'dul mchod rten gyi shar 'gram du sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i sgrub chu zhig yod pa de skam nas/

de nang gi gsher ba tsam yang med par gyur pa'i tshe/ phru ma'i sku gnyer gyis gnas tshul rje 'di la zhus pas/ skyed lhas su thugs dam bskang gsor phebs/ zhor la phru mar phebs te/ sngar gyi chu khung de nang la dmod nas mang du 'thor ba gnang bas/ de'i nangs par chu sngar bzhin du brdol 'dug pa mthong ba na/ sku gnyer yang dad pa'i rba rlabs gting nas g.yo bar gyur te/ de bzhin gyi gnas tshul 'phral 'bul zhus/ de dus gsung las/ de bzhin 'byung ba gtso bor sngags 'chang chen po rang gi byin rlabs los yin/ de dus skyed lhas su dpal mgon chen por 'phrin bcol yid gtad tsam byed rgyu byung bas/ de'i mthu yang yin pa 'dra phebs pa ni/ rje nyid kyi zhal las dngos su thos so/ /de nas rje nyid dgung lo zhe bdun pa nyi ma zhes pa chu mo lug lo'i skabs shig nyer gcig gi bla mchod 'bum thang du mdzad pa'i tshe/ sa chen dang slob dpon rtse mo'i phyi rten sku 'bum gnyis las dbang gi chu rgyun dwangs la mang ba nyi ma gnyis kyi bar du babs pas/ rje 'di mchod rten 'di dag byin rlabs che bar sngar las kyang thugs yid ches shing thugs dad che bar gyur/ de mthun sprel lo nas lo yang shin tu legs shing mi rnams bde bas 'tsho ba 'di byung snang zhing / de nas ma 'gyangs par 'bum thang la zhig gsos shig kyang gnang bas/ rje btsun chen po'i phyi rten las khrus chu 'byung ba snga mo nas chad cing / sa chen dang / slob dpon rin po che'i phyi rten gnyis la yang cho 'phrul sogs dus chen rnams la cung zad re ma gtogs rgyun du 'byung ba zhig de snga med kyang / de dus zhig gsos grub 'phral nas zla ba du ma'i bar du nyin re bzhin khrus chu ting re tsam re mchod rten gsum rtsa nas 'bab cing / de nas bzung ste da lta'i bar nyi ma gcig gnyis ma gtogs phal cher rgyun mi chad par 'byon pa shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su snang zhing /

de bzhin du 'phags pa rin po che'i phyi rten gter 'bum gyi gtsug lag khang gi lho skya yongs rdzogs dang / steng gi gser thog gi shing rnams gsar du rtsa ba nas spod pa mdzad cing / zangs leb gser byug ma rnams phal cher mdog 'don dang / gling gnyis tsam gsar pa spo ba sogs kyi nyams gso dang bstun/ nang gi logs bris la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mang po'i sku dang / 'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod snang ba mtha' yas kyi sku brgya phrag lnga lhag tsam sogs bri bar mdzad cing / gzhan yang dar 'phan/ ting bdun cha/ rol mo sogs mchod cha mang po dang bcas pa'i nyams gso gsar bzhengs lta bu mdzad pa'i skabs der/ rje nyid nyin gcig las grwa'i gseb tu zhal bkod cig la phebs pa'i tshe/ gter 'bum la byin rlabs zhu bar mdzad pa na/ de ma thag mchod rten gyi bum bzang las byung ba 'dra ba'i dri bzang khyad par zhig thul gyis byung nas/ 'bum thang gi steng 'og thams cad khyab nas kun kyang ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa zhig byung 'dug pa 'di ni dpal ldan 'phags pa dgyes pa'i mtshan ma'am/ yang na dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i lha dag gnas der mchod pa la lhags pa'i rtags mtshan du gor ma chags shing / gzhan yang de skabs sgo rum du sku mtshams bdun phrag gcig gnang dus/ bse 'bag gi zhal dkyil yang 'phral 'phral la 'gyur ldog byed pa zhig dang / sku bongs kyang cher song ba lta bu'i gzigs snang byung gsungs pa tsam las/ gsal por bka' mi stsol yang / 'di skabs gzigs snang ngo mtshar can gzhan yang mang du byung snang zhing / 'di lo mchod yon nas lha la gzhung du gtogs pa'i chos gzhis 'di rnams gus spros 'bul sbyor zhus pa yin no/ /de'i phyi lo nyid kyi dgung grangs zhe brgyad pa nyi sgrol zhes pa shing pho sprel lo'i hor lugs zla ba bcu pa'i nang du hor yul nas sa la gnas pa'i dbang phyug chen po'i rnam par sprul pa mi'i dbang po go dan rgyal po'i rigs rgyud du khas 'che zhing /

bod chen po'i sa la spyod pa'i brgya byin stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba nor kha che zhes bya ba'i sras sba kha tho zhes mtshan du chags pa dang / sku tshe 'dir bka' tho/ pho nya sogs kyi 'brel ba yang med mod kyi/ 'on kyang sngon gyi smon lam dang / rje nyid kyi snyan pa dkar phyogs kyi lhas kun tu bsgrags pa'i dbyangs rna ba'i bcud du gyur pas/ yid rang dbang med par phrogs pa'i stobs las/ 'dren byed don yod par bya ba'i phyir/ dam pa 'di nyid kyi sku'i dkyil 'khor mig gis lta ba dang / gsung gi bdud rtsi sgra 'dzin gyi bcud dang yid kyi gsos su re ba'i dbang gis spyan 'dren gyi pho nya chu mo lug lo'i dbyar zla 'bring po'i yar tshes lnga la mngags pa rnams nye bar 'byor te/ rgyal pos zhu 'phrin 'di ltar phul ba yin/ ༈ /dpal sa skya pa chen po'i drung du/ da'i chings zhes pa'i yul dang rgya cher brtse zhing kun dang mthun pa'i dam pa mchog gi rgyal pos zhu yig 'bul 'bras/ nga sngon gyi rgyal po rnams kyi bka' bzhag bzhin gzhung dang bstan pa spel bar bsam nas/ 'gro ba mngon par 'dren thub pa'i mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i bla ma spyan 'dren pa'i phyir bang phyin pa btang yod/ bang phyin pa'i ming ni/ phyi gan dge slong / pa ron dge slong / grags pa dge slong / nam phyi dge slong / na ma gan dge slong / bsam gtan dge slong / kun dga' chos rgyal dge slong rnams yin/ gzhan tshig don rnams bang phyin pa'i ngag nas gsal/ zhu yig rten mtshon dngul gyi ka to ra gcig dngul gyi mdong mo gcig ma na ho'i phor chung gcig shel gyi phor chung gcig shel dkar gyi phor chung gsum/ shel dkar gyi dam spe gcig gser brgyab pa'i khrab gcig gser brgyab pa'i rmog gcig sag thag brkos ma gcig mda' gzhu dang bcas pa/ gser brgyab pa'i sga srab brkos ma gcig gser gyi sga skor brgyab pa'i shel gyi ske rags gcig

shang lang brkos ma gcig kha thi yug gcig phul/ dam pa'i yon tan mnga' ba'i gdan sa lo brgyad pa'i chu mo lug gi lo'i dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes lnga la/ zhes pa'i zhu yig dang / zhu 'phrin nang na 'khod pa'i zhu gsol gyi rten de dag ma yin pa'i gos dar/ gser dngul/ mu tig bzhes spyad sogs zang zing gi dngos spyad blos dpag par dka' ba zhig dang / pho nya ba rnams kyi gtso bo se chen bla mar grags pa rgyal po de rang gi ti shrīr bkur ba zhig yin 'dug pa des kyang 'bul tshan rgya chen po phul zhing / de dag dang lhan cig rgyal po'i mi bzang zang zing gi 'byor pa chen po 'ga' zhig gis 'bul nod rgya che zhing grangs mang ba rgyal po nyid la 'gran bzod pa gus pa chen pos phul/ rje nyid kyis kyang 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i yongs bsngo rgyas 'debs dang / chos dang longs spyod dam rdzas kyi gnang skyes gya nom pas so sor tshims par mdzad/ lhag par se chen bla mar bod pa de rgyal po rang gi ti shrī yin pa dang / dbang gis phyug pa 'ga'i gzhan dbang las/ phyi ltar spom yor mdzad pa zhig 'dug kyang / dam pa 'di'i sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa rma med pa mthong bas yid kyi brtan pa 'phrogs te/ dad gus kyi thal mo spyi bor sbyor zhing / de skabs nyin re bzhin sku zhabs su 'byor ba'i mjal res bzhin rje 'di'i sku'i gzi mdangs mthong snang mi 'dra ba re re byung bar brten/ dam pa 'di nyid la bstod bkur bsngags gsum lhur len pa zhig byung ba yin la/ tshul 'di ni sngon bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta la hor rgyal po go dan gyis/ rgyal po nged kyi lung / sa paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan la go bar byed pa'i gtam/ nged pha ma dang gnam sa'i drin lan 'jal ba'i phyir/ lam gyi blang dor ma nor ba ston shes pa'i bla ma gcig dgos pa/ brtag pa byas pas khyod du 'dug pa/ lam gyi dka' tshegs la ma lta bar yong dgos/

zhes sogs spyan 'dren gyi zhu gsol phul ba dang mtshungs shing / gdan sa chen po 'di'i lugs gnyis kyi 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi mdzad 'phrin rgya chen po'i dbang las phebs stabs ma bde ba ma gtogs/ ci ste phyag bzhes thub tshe chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas byang phyogs hor gyi rgyal khams chen po chos dkar snang bas khyab par mdzad pa dang tshul mtshungs pa zhig 'byung ba la yid gnyis mi dgos pa zhig go /de gong gdan sa chen po'i chos grwa phan tshun la yang rnyed bkur zhu mi shin tu dkon pa zhig gi skabs/ rje 'di'i mtshan lam du ja mchod 'di bzhin mdzad na legs pa'i ltas gsal bar byung nas/ ngo mtshar phun tshogs ma'i tshigs bcad snga ma rnams mnal lam du ka rtsom gnang ba de nangs par yang thugs la gsal bar 'dug pa bzhin tshogs su 'dzugs par mdzad pas/ de nas ma 'gyangs par rgyal po'i 'bul skyel ba 'di yang 'byor te/ dge 'dun rnams la rnyed bkur mtha' dag gong 'phel du gyur pa zhig byung ba ni/ der yod kun gyi dgongs mtshor gsal ba yin no/ /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ bstan dang 'gro ba'i don du sku srog kyang / /gtong la mi zhum rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyi/ /ngang tshul yin phyir lho phyogs mun yul der/ /chen po 'bangs su bcad pa'i duḥkha bsal/ /grub pa'i sa la dbang phyug thang stong pa'i/ /zhal skyin byin rlabs grags pa'i gzi can dang / /phyag gi rnam 'phrul gyis bskrun chos sku'i rten/ /phyag mchod skor bas bkur bsti ri mor mdzad/ /de tshe rnam 'dren zung gi yon tan la/ /rab bsngags dad gus sbrang rtsis myos pa'i dbyangs/ /mgul gyi bung bas gyer bas dbyangs can lha'i/ /bai ḍūr rgyud mangs sgra yang skyengs su bcug /grangs med skye dgu'i zhing sar thar pa yi/ /sa bon yi ge drug pa'i bzlas brjod kyis/ /legs par btab tshe kun kyang po ta lar/ /phyag na pad+mo'i drung du mnyam du chas/

/mi thub zla ba bsod nams mkha' spyod rtser/ /bgrod pa'i them skas chu mig dri'i gtsang khang / /bde mchog lha yi gzhal yas khang chen por/ /bsgyur ba'i dge mtshan srid pa'i thor lcog mdzes/ /rigs ldan sprul pa'i gar mkhan mdzes sku'i gdung / /rin chen sa le sbram dang bong ba'i tshogs/ /mnyam pa'i ngang tshul ma bzod mchod pa dang / /bkur bstis rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i rgyan du bkod/ /kye ma dri med lung dang rtogs pa yi/ /bstan pa nyin mor byed pa'i gzi byin dang / /phan bde zla ba'i bsil 'od ngan spyod kyi/ /gdong pas za ba'i rtsod dus gza' g.yan shar/ /de tshe bde gshegs sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ /ye shes ngo bo gzhan snang sku gzugs zol/ /grangs med phyag dang snang srid maṇ+ḍal du/ /bkod de nyer mchod dge ba'i smon lam mdzad/ /rgyal kun mthu stobs 'phrin las gcig bsdus dngos/ /dam ldan srung ma'i thugs dam zab mo bskangs/ /skye dgu'i nyam nga'i duḥkha zhi ba dang / /bstan dang phan bde rgyas pa'i 'phrin las gzhol/ /de las ljongs 'dir 'dzin ma'i bcud 'phel zhing / /phun tshogs 'bras bu'i dpal la longs su spyod/ /dga' bdes myos pa'i glu gar rtse 'jos brel/ /de lta'i bka' drin rtogs na dad gus 'phel/ /byang phyogs yangs pa'i sa la bder spyod pa/ /da'i chings skyid pa'i yul nas mi'i dbang pos/ /khyod kyi grags dkar phyogs kyi rna ba'i rgyan/ /thos pas yid 'phrogs spyan 'dres pho nya mngags/ /rin chen dngul gyi yol go du ma dang / /ngo mtshar shel gyi spyad dngos rnam bkra'i skyes/ /grangs med ja gos dar sogs 'bul nod kyis/ /rmugs 'dzin dbang po'i mdzod la'ang co 'drir byas/ /gang sngon 'jam mgon gnyis pa sa lo tsā'i/ /snyan grags bdud rtsi rnar lhung rgyal ba'i sras/ /mi bdag rnam rol go dan yid gsos te/ /snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'bod la phrag dog gam/ /de nas rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid dgung gi grangs zhe dgur phebs pa sa skyong zhes pa shing mo bya'i lo rdo rje 'phreng ba kri ya'i kha skong dang bcas pa/

sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis/ kye rdor bka' bab bzhi/ gur mgon gyi dkyil 'khor lnga sogs dkyil thang thog tshad ma nyi shu rtsa gcig po 'di legs par grub nas/ lo de'i zla tshes shis pa la rab tu gnas pa smin rgyas su mdzad cing / dkyil thang 'di dag la dkyil 'khor bdun cu don gsum/ de dag so so'i dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa dang bcas pa/ lha mgron du gong ma lnga/ sngags 'chang yab sras gsum/ rje mus chen/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags rnams kyi sku brnyan nyer gcig re/ thub pa'i sku gzugs brgya phrag gnyis dang bdun cu don gcig 'od dpag med kyi sku nyis brgya dang sum cu so bdun/ gnas bcu tshar bcu gcig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku brnyan dgu bcu go bdun/ bde ba can gyi zhing bkod brgya dang drug cu re bdun/ tshe dpag med dmar po nyer lnga/ gzhan tshe lha'i rigs bcu bzhi rnams bzhugs pas lha grangs kyang shin tu mang zhing / bris thang thams cad la gong gsham dang 'ja' ris jus dmar ser sngo gsum/ sman rtse sogs dar gyi zhal khebs gsum brtsegs bsgril shing gi tog thams cad tsan dan dmar po 'ba' zhig gis byas pas rgyu tshogs rmad du byung ba dang / ri mo yang gzhan las ches zhib cha che zhing legs pa sogs mchog tu ngo mtshar ba dad ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing dam par bzhugs pa lags so/ /de nas dam pa 'di nyid dgung grangs lnga bcur son pa mi zad ces pa me pho khyi lo bsam yas nas chos skyong chen pos lo 'di nang du dge bshes la sku dogs che bas rgyab rten ma nyung tsam dgos pa yod do gsungs pa'i zhu 'phrin phul ba bzhin/ lo de'i mgo zla ba bya lo hor zla bcu gcig pa tshes 'phral gdan sa chen po'i dgun chos gnang nas grol ba'i nub mo/ sngar gyi bsnyun ro rgyas 'khrugs kyi bsnyun gzhi de shin tu thu ba zhig langs pas sku khams cher ma bde ba nas/ 'tsho byed mgon bsam drung gis mtshal gtar nyis bstud dang /

gzhan yang gsol sman sogs kyi sku'i 'phrod bsten ci yang zhig 'bul ba mdzad/ de mthun sher snying 'bum ther sogs sku'i rkyen bzlog gi rigs mang po dang / lhag par chos skyong chen po'i gsung bzhin/ dbus gtsang gi dgon che grwa sum cu so grangs shig la mang 'gyed gnang / slar dgon bdun bcu tsam la mang 'gyed dang bcas pas yongs bsdoms de lo dgon che grwa rang brgya phrag lhag tsam la mang 'gyed gya nom pa gnang ba sogs sku'i rim gro shin tu stobs che ba bsgrubs pa'i legs lam la brten/ sku 'khrugs kyi bsnyun gzhi de las grol yang / bsil sman mang tsam dang / mtshal gtar nyis bstud gnang ba sogs bsil spyad stobs che ba'i rkyen gyis rtsa dkar gyi bsnyun gzhi gsar skyes kyi rnam pas phyag dpung bde rgyu med tsam zhig 'gyang tsam byung nas/ lo de'i hor zla dang po'i nang du sngar gyi bsnyun gzhi des sku la nyes skyon ma byung ba'i dga' ston dang / sku'i rkyen sel thun mong du skye bor sbyin gtong rgya chen po zhig gnang ba'i tshogs dbur rje nyid phebs te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub chen por yongs bsngo'i rgyas 'debs yang dag pa gnang / de nas bsam yas chos skyong chen pos/ rje nyid la zhus pa bzhin dpal rab tu grub mchog mthu stobs dbang phyug zhabs drung du yang / da lo rgyud pa 'od zer can la yang sku dog chen po yod pas/ bcad rgya yun ring po dang / dgon mang por rgya ja'i 'dur skol sogs rgyab rten mi nyung tsam dgos pa yod tshul zhu ba mdzad 'dug kyang / grub mchog des sku mtshams bdun phrag gcig tsam zhig dang / dgon gnyis gsum la mang ja re las sku rim rgya chen po ma gnang / zhal nas kyang / nged kyi rim gro stobs chen byas na gdan sar 'gyur ba yong / de byung tshe a mes lags kyi sku la skyon byung tshe/ ngas gdan sa'i khur chen 'di mi theg de bas na nga shi yang mi skyon gsungs/

phyag phyi ba rnams kyis sku rim mdzad dgos lugs zhus kyang / gsan shes ye ma mdzad pa yin zhes phyis su khong phyag phyi ba rnams gsung ba thos pa bzhin/ lo de'i hor zla lnga pa 'jam mgon bsod nams dbang po'i dus dran tshes bcu gnyis kyi nub mo grub mchog mthu stobs dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po glo bur du zhi bar gshegs nas/ gnas tshul 'bul mi zla ba de'i tshes nyi shu la gdan sar 'byor/ de gong sku mched phan tshun gnyis thad nas mjal bzhed che ba yod pa bzhin/ gcen gyis grub nyams kyis gur shi rgyal po mchod yon la 'phros ma btang bar gdan sar sku mched mjal bar tab tob tu phebs rtsis gnang 'dug kyang / rje 'di'i gdan sa chen po'i khur chen 'di la lugs gnyis char gyi sgo nas mdzad bkod ci yang zhig dgos kyi gnang ba nas/ 'jig rten lugs kyi 'phral gyi mdzad lugs gang ci rnams dbus gtsang gi rje bo gang yin de la dri ba skabs su yang bab cing / ma dris na btsan cha mgo khur byung dogs dang / sku mched mjal 'phrad tsam mi grol ba yang mi srid dgongs/ mchod yon du ji ltar legs kyi phebs sgo gnang bar/ skor cig snga khyad med tshul byung nas 'then pa las ni 'os ma byung / der skabs mjal ma thub pa'i ngang nas gcen zhi bar gshegs pa nas/ rje 'di thugs las shin tu che bas sku gdung gi phyag phyi zhu ba sogs la dpal rab tu phebs rtsis thag chod mdzad dus/ gdan sa'i dmag las sogs mi sde'i che bgres rnams dang / chos sde'i che bgres sogs lha sde mi sde gnyis char nas/ 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug bstan pa'i sku chags kyis zhabs pad ma brtan par mchod 'bul dang gsol 'debs zhu ba las/ da cha gzhan mdzad thabs ni med/ de bas rje nyid dbus phyogs la gsung brtag sogs kyang ma mdzad par stabs 'gros 'di bzhin spyir yang mi 'gab cing / lhag par gdung rgyud 'di yang sku na phra ba nas/

da lam phebs pa mi legs tshul nan gyis zhus pa dang / slar sgo rum du gsung brtag cig kyang mdzad par bzang chug ma byung bar brten/ rje nyid phebs rtsis de bshol ba gnang / dpal rab tu dpon sa tshe brtan bu khrid dpon g.yog ban gtsang ba rnams dang bcas par gang spyi'i bslab ston gnang bar bdag la 'gro dgos tshul phebs pa bzhin/ bka' dang len zhus/ dpal rab tu 'byor dus sku gdung rin po che sgam zhig gi nang na bzhugs pa la/ ban gtsang ba rnams kyis bla ma mchod chog tshar gnyis tsam re mdzad kyin 'dug de las gzhan sgrub mchod kyi dgongs gtad ni mdzad mi 'dug kyang / bdag cag tu rje 'di nyid nas phebs sgo la/ rab kye rdor sgrub mchod ras bris rdul tshon ci rigs/ de min kun rig ras bris rgyun mi thung tsam zhig mchod 'bul du cis kyang byed dgos/ kun rig byed pa 'di la don ma go ba tshos bla ma'i mchod 'bul mi 'os tshul byed pa zhig yong gin snang bas/ khong rnams kyang blo la med shas kha na'ang / don la sgrub mchod ci 'dra zhig byed kyang / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo mchod yul gyi bla ma tha mi dad par byas nas mchod pa 'bul ba yin pas/ kun rig byed na yang bde bar gshegs pa de nyid dang gtso bor rnam par snang mdzad dbyer med pa la mchod pa 'bul ba sogs byed pa yin/ des na kun rig mi 'os pa gtan nas ma yin pas/ kun rig tsam zhig rgyang tsam byas/ de nas der yang ser 'tshogs kyi mchod 'bul 'khos dang bstun pa'i bgyid lugs dang / dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi gdan sa chen po 'dir zhal ngo gong ma rnams la sngar nas ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin nged rang gis mdzad cing / slar rten bzhengs shig kyang mdzad dgos pa gzhir bcas kyang / der ma thub dogs pas 'di ka rang nas rkang len byed pa/ de mthun rten bzhengs kyi rgyur phan pa zangs spyad sogs phran bu bsring rgyu byung na bsring lugs kyis/

ma byung yang 'gal ba med pas/ khyed rang rnams blo mthun ngos dgongs rdzogs kyi 'brel ba chod bstun rgyal po mchod yul du bslab ston zhu lugs go ma log pa dgos tshul sogs 'phral phugs kyi bslab cha zhib rgyas bka' ngag dang bka' tho gnyis ka phebs yod pa bzhin/ khong rnams la zhus lugs byas/ de nas sku gdung ston bzhu 'bul lam/ yar spyan 'dren ci rigs mdzad rtsis kyi mchod rten khang bu brtsegs pa zhig gi nang du bzhugs su gsol/ ban gtsang ba rnams kyis kun rig ras bris la brten pa'i sgrub mchod zla ba phyed tsam zhig dang / de'i ring la sku gdung gi drung du ban gtsang ba drag pa bzhi bzhis sgrub mchod kyi bar gseng la bla ma mchod chog ma chag par mdzad/ de dag grub mtshams gra nang gi chos sde che ba rnams dang / gong dkar chos sde/ byed rtsing tshogs pa rnams la deng der mchod 'bul gyi rnyed bkur zhus/ gra nang gi dgon chung ba nyi shu tsam yong gi 'dug pa tsho'i grwa btsun/ gser khung phu mda'i mi dmangs sogs skya ser stong du longs pa tsam la mang ja dang / zang zing gi 'gyed rgya mi chung ba gnang / der rjes ngor/ gser mdog can/ thub bstan gong 'og bya rgod gshong sogs la mang ja 'gyed bcas sogs dpal rab rang nas mdzad/ de nas slar gdan sa chen po 'dir dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi/ rje 'di nyid kyi thugs sras ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i yum rin po che'i gshegs rdzongs dang stabs cig zhal ngo gong ma rnams kyi mchod 'bul ji lta ba bzhin gyi thang ston gdan sa chen po 'di nyid rang nas 'dres med sgrub par mdzad/ de bzhin du dpal rab nas rten bzhengs la phan pa'i gser zangs sogs dngos spyad gang yang 'bul rgyu ma byung yang / rje 'di nyid kyis rang gi gcen grub mchog mthu stobs dbang phyug de nyid kyi sku brnyan sku tshad tsam gser zangs las grub pa zhig dang /

dngul gdung rin po che phal thog phyed gnyis tsam pa shin tu bzo khyad legs pa gcig rje 'di nyid kyi thugs sras gdung brgyud rin po che'i rgyal yum gyi dgongs rdzogs su 'od dpag med kyi sku 'dra mda' tshad tsam zhig dang bcas bzhengs/ de dag dang mnyam du lam 'bras brgyud pa'i sku brnyan ma tshang ba 'ga' zhig yar rgyab pa'i lcam drung gis rje 'di la phul ba de dag gi kha skong dgos pa rnams kyang zhal bkod gnang ste/ rje nyid dgung lo nga gcig tu phebs pa thams cad 'dul zhes pa me mo phag gi lo la legs par grub/ sku gdung hril po spyan 'dren zhus pa'i dngul gdung nang bzhugs mdzad par bzhed kyang / mchod yon nas phebs sgo byung ba yin zer/ dpal rab tu sku gdung bzhu 'bul grub nas/ gdung rus rnams phal cher gdan sar phul ba rnams la/ gdung 'bul tshul bzhin mdzad/ de thams cad 'jim pa la bsres/ rje nyid kyis phyag tsha gnang nas/ gser sku sku tshad dang dngul gdung gnyis kyi nang du bzhugs su gsol/ lo de nyid kyi zla ba lnga pa'i gza' tshes bzang ba la rje nyid dpon slob sum cu tsam gyis kye rdor la brten pa'i rab tu gnas pa tshul bzhin du mdzad de/ sku tshab de nyid dbu rtse dang / dngul gdung rin po che 'jam mgon bsod nams dbang po'i sku gdung hril po bzhugs pa'i mchod rten gyi g.yas su bzhugs su gsol ba lags so/ /gzhan yang rje btsun gcen gyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su lo re bzhin zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu gnyis sogs la/ rje mus pa chen po'i dus dran gyi sgrub mchod dang sbrel nas/ bde gsang gnyis kyi sgrub mchod ci rigs dang / zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes bcu gnyis la rgyud 'don dang / bla mchod nar mar mdzad pa sogs grub mchog de nyid kyi dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs pa'i thabs la yang shin tu 'grus par mdzad do/ /grub dbang de nyid kyang rje btsun dam pa 'di la thugs shin tu brtse zhing /

dam pa 'dis kyang dad zhen che bar brten 'jam mgon mthu stobs dbang phyug de nyid kyi mchod 'bul dngos gzhi'i nyin/ rje 'di khri thog tu phebs nas gsung bsngo sogs nam grub kyi bar la gdan sa chen po 'dir nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis khyab pa sogs ngo mtshar ba kho na byung bas/ de la brten nas skye bo thams cad kyis/ de ring bde gshegs sgar chen rin po che yang nam mkhar phebs nas rje 'dis gzigs pa yin 'dug zer ba'i snyan grags kyang kun tu khyab par gyur/ spyir yang grub mchog 'di nyid sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi rnam 'phrul yin par yang grags shing / grub pa brnyes pa'i snyan grags kyang che bas/ skye bo mang po ma bsdus par 'du ba dang / zang zing gi 'bul nod sogs ni 'bad med du char ltar 'bab pa sogs ngo mtshar ba mang zhing / dpal rab tu rten bzhengs kyi rigs kyang rdo rje 'chang gi sku brnyan gser zangs las grub pa thog tshad ma zhig dang / dngul las grub pa'i mgon po'i bla brgyud mtho gang tsam pa grab cig gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi lder sku brgyad dang / grub dbang nyid kyi lder sku/ gur lcam dral dang dpal mgon bram gzugs kyi 'cham sku gsum sogs 'bur sku mang po dang / bris sku yang / rgyal ba'i 'khrungs rabs/ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bris thang / grub dbang nyid kyi rnam thar thang ga sogs bris thang grab cig kyang du ma bzhengs par mdzad pa las/ rje de nyid zhing gshegs rjes/ dpon sa tshe brtan bu khrid dang / ban gtsang ba rnams thugs 'dod ma gcig pa'i skyon gyis rjes su dpal rab gzhung bzhes dang / dpon sa'i drung dang ban gtsang ba tshor sa skal re re so sor byung skabs/ gnyis dbar gcig shor gyi dpes rdo rje 'chang gi sku brnyan de grwa thang pa dang / gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi lder sku rgyal gling tshogs par stsal/ 'cham mgon gsum dang /

grub dbang de rang gi lder sku rnams ban gtsang ba rnams kyis khong rang rnams 'byon pa'i sngon du dpal sde'i gong tsam gyi yul grong der thugs rtsol gyis skyel ba mdzad kyang / khong rang rnams yul chen du nam byon bar/ sku brnyan rnams sngar gyi der rgyun ring tsam lus pa/ bsam yas nas chos skyong chen po'i thugs kyis ma bzod de/ zhabs drung thal phyi sku mched la sku brnyan de rnams bsam yas su gdan 'dren dgos tshul phebs pas/ de ma thag spyan 'dren mi btang nas rab byung bar gnang / dgon khang gsar bzhengs mdzad de bsam yas dbu rtse'i mdun ngos na bzhugs/ gzhan ma rol spyad/ mchod cha/ 'cham chas sogs ban gtsang ba rnams kyis bdag gir byas/ dpon sa'i drung rang gi sku rgyan sogs gzhan ma phal cher ni dpon sa nyid kyis thugs tshags mdzad nas/ gong dkar chos sder dngos spyad mang du phul te zla rer dus ja re 'dzugs par mdzad/ snga sor grub mchog de nyid khams la phebs dus yab rje chos kyi rgyal pos gnang ba'i 'phags pa rin po che'i thugs dam ma'i mgon po shel spyan mar grags pa dang / mgon po brgyud pa'i bris thang grab/ snga mo zhig grub mchog de la rje 'dis phul ba'i sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag nas ma lam zab bla ma brgyud pa grab gcig yod pa de sogs rten byin rlabs can 'ga' zhig dang / rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bris thang grab/ grub mchog de nyid kyi rnam thar bris thang / grub mchog de nyid la chos kyi rje kun dga' bzang pos phul ba'i lam 'bras brgyud pa'i bris thang grab/ 'jam mgon bsod nams dbang po'i thugs dam ma'i mgon thang lnga grab/ de nyid kyi phyag sbug tshangs dbyangs bde chen chos 'khor mar grags pa/ bde gshegs sgar chen nyid kyi phyag sbug bka' brgyud ma sogs rol mo drag rigs cha lnga tsam zhig rje de nyid kyi phyag dril dril smyon du grags pa sogs phyag dril khyad par can kha cig sogs phyi 'khyar mi 'os pa phal cher/

dpon sa tshe brtan bu khrid dang / grub mchog mthu stobs dbang phyug nyid kyi zhabs 'bring pa gzim dpon rab brtan gnyis kyis rkang len mdzad nas rje 'di'i phyag tu 'bul thub pa mdzad de/ mgon po shel spyan ma ni rje 'di nyid kyi gzim chung gi chos skyong gi rten rnams kyi grwar bzhugs su gsol ba 'di lags so/ /de nas lo de'i hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshe lhor phebs/ de yang snga mo nyid nas gnas 'brug thugs 'khang che zhing / lha 'brug kyang thugs nang ma dag pa'i rtsa bar brten/ rtsang pa'i skabs kyang lho nang du dpung 'jug yang yang mdzad pas lha gnas gnyis kyi rgyab bzhengs gnang ba'i lan du 'brug pa nas lha gnas sogs lho nang nas phud pa'i tshe/ rgyal po mchod yon du dbu gtad zhus pa bzhin/ khong rnams kyi dbu 'don gyi phyir 'brug par dpung 'jug thengs gnyis mdzad pa'i snga ma'i tshe yang / gzhung gi mtshan byus legs rgyu rang med pa'i 'dul chung ba dang / 'brong rtse pa sogs nang so rnam pa mang po 'brug pas bzung ste dam btsir gyis shin tu duḥkha bar gyur pa'i tshe/ rje 'di nas 'brug par mi sna bka' tham dang bcas pa stsal nas/ de rnams tshur yong chog pa mdzad pas/ khong rang rnams dmyal ba nas thar ba lta bu'i dgyes spro byed pa zhig byung la/ rting ma lo de nyid kyi hor zla bcu pa'i nang du 'jug bkod gnang ba/ dpung kha mang zhing shin tu stobs che ba nas/ dam pa 'di'i thugs dgongs la spyir yang 'khrugs long 'di rigs sems can gyi phan bde 'joms byed rang zhig yong gin 'dug pa dang / bye brag lho nang 'di sa btsan zhing sa dug gi nyes dmigs kyang che ba nas/ mchod yon gzhung 'di mtshan byus kyang legs po yong dka' ba dang / lhag par 'brug pa nas dpung chen 'di bzhin tshud phyin 'gyel 'bubs che ba las 'os med/ des na spyir sems can gyi bde thabs dang / gsan bzhes gnang na dge 'brug gnyis car du brling ba 'dra dgongs/

lo de'i hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nang du lhor dge 'brug chings 'doms kyi ched du chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur ba gnang / phag rir gur shi rgyal po'i sras chung ba dang / dge ldan pho brang nas phyag mdzod chen mo mchod yon zhal 'dzoms/ dpung pa tror chug pa bsdu dgos lugs sogs kyi phebs sgo gang yang zhig stsal kyang / 'brug pa nas spang bzhes yin lugs mdzad na/ 'di ka nas kyang phebs nang bzhin byed zhu ba las dpung bsdu bkod ma gnang bar brten/ slar pa tro nang du dpon slob rnams kyis kyang phebs te/ 'brug par yang khye nyen bkod pa'i bka' 'doms dang / bod dmag gi gtso bo rnams la yang phebs sgo zhib tu gnang yang / so so nas gsan shes ma mdzad pa'i chings 'doms yin lugs zhig ma byung ba'i ring nas/ bod dmag rnams gsang stabs su bsdu ba mdzad pa rta pa rkang thang yang 'gyogs bul gyi stabs/ rta pa'i rigs phal cher pa tro'i stod du 'byor/ rkang thang thams cad pa tro'i phyed tsam du slebs skabs/ lho'i dpung rjes 'ded du shed rtsol gyis btegs pas/ bod dmag rkang thang stong tsam zhig gi rjes non te/ thams cad gron can du gtong rtsis kho na 'dug pa la/ rje btsun dam pa 'dis lho'i dmag dpon 'brug pa'i dbu che chos rje la sngon par/ 'di pa nged kyi ngo la gtong dgos tshul phebs pas/ lho dmag gzhan rnams ni/ spyir yang lho nang 'di phal cher chos kyi sgra tsam yang mi grag pa'i blang dor gyi gnas la dud 'gro ltar rmongs pas gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa la srin po ltar rngam pa dang / khyad par dpung 'jug mang ba'i stobs pa'i thams cad khro nyams byed cing / bod mi gsod pa la cher rngam pa yod 'dug kyang / chos rje la sngon pas rje nyid kyis bka' stsal spyi bor bkod de/ da lam khyed tsho rnams srog las thar ba sa skya bdag chen gyi bka' drin yin pa shes par gyis zer zhing / de na yod pa'i bod dmag thams cad kyi go mtshon phrogs/

srog la ma skyon par btang bas/ thams cad kyis rje nyid la bstod bkur kho na byed pa dang / rjes su rang rang gi yul du slebs nas kyang / nged rnams ma shi bar 'dir 'byor ba 'di bzhin sa skya bdag chen gyi sku drin yin/ bla ma zer ba de sa skya pa yin mod ces sogs kyi bsngags brjod gsong por smra bar byed do/ /tshul 'di ni 'gro mgon 'phags pas rgya'i mi yur chen mo rgyun bcad pa dang mtshungs pas shin tu ngo mtshar che bar 'khums so/ /de dus nyid kyi phyag mdzod chen mo gong sa'i sku dog 'gyur ba'i rnam pas sku ma 'tsho ba zhig byung bar/ rje nyid kyi 'pho ba gsal 'debs dang / mkha' spyod du skye ba'i smon lam shin tu smin pa dang / mtshan byang bzhu ba'i gsung chog sogs thugs rje chen pos rjes su 'dzin par mdzad/ gzhan yang der skabs rje nyid sku zhabs na yod pa'i ban gtsang ba rnams dang bcas pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i sgrub mchod phyag mdzod gshegs pa nas bzung gdan sar ma phebs kyi bar du nyin re bzhin ma chag pa gnang bas/ de'i gsung chog brgya tshar lhag pa dang / de dag dang stabs mtshungs gdan sa chen po 'di ka'i bla ma slob dpon/ ka bcu rab 'byams/ bsnyen song mang po sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen brgya phrag tsam gyis kun rig gi cho ga stong tshar/ gdan sa'i gtsug lag khang che ba so sor dge 'dun bdun tsam res kyis bde ba can gyi zhing du skye ba'i smon lam 'bum ther/ chos rje lho byang gi tshogs chen gyis bzang spyod 'bum ther sogs blos dpag par dka' ba'i dge tshogs rgya chen po bsgrubs pa'i bsnyen bkur thams cad rje nyid kyis sgrub pa gnang / rjes su phyag mdzod de nyid kyi sku phung yang rje nyid kyis bzhu rtsis mdzad par/ gsung brtag ma chug nas/ gdan sa'i brgya tsho dpon gyis me chog mdzad/ sku rus rnams la rje nyid kyis phyag tsha tshul bzhin du gnang ste/

mchod rten khang bu brtsegs pa zhig mkhan rin po che rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi mchod rten khang brtsegs dang mnyam du bde mchog gi bla ma gong ma'i mchod rten rnams kyi dbus su bzhengs te/ de'i nang du bzhugs su gsol zhing / zla ba byung res kyi nyer lnga la chos sde lho byang gnyis car du 'jam thal gnyer khang nas gnang thog bzang spyod la sogs smon lam dang / ban gtsang ba rnams kyis sman bla'i mchod chog re/ rje mus chen dus mchod kyi tshe/ tshogs chen la mang ja nas 'gyed/ phur sgrub kyi nyer lnga'i nyin sgrub mchod pa rnams la mang ja gsol ba'i thog 'bras mar bzhu'i rnyed bkur sogs dang / gzhan yang rin chen gling sogs dgon mang por bzang spyod 'bum ther 'don pa'i yon du gser srang du ma gnang ba dang / 'od dpag med kyi sku brnyan gser zangs las grub pa mi tshad tsam pa bzhengs te lha khang mthil na bzhugs pa sogs mdor na rten bzhengs mdzad pa/ gzhan la bka' chos stsal pa/ bstan bcos rtsom pa/ mchog dman gyi gang zag la zang zing gi rnyed bkur mdzad pa sogs legs byas kyi mdzad 'phrin thams cad phyag mdzod zhing gshegs de nyid kyi ched du dmigs shing yongs su bsngo bar mdzad pa ni/ da lta kun gyi dgongs mtshor gsal ba 'di lags shing / tshul de lta bu'i mthu dang / lhag par nyid kyi thugs rje chen po'i skyabs 'og nas skad cig tsam yang 'dor ba mi mnga' ba'i dbang las/ dus der mkha' spyod chen por 'khrungs pa gdon mi za yang / gzhan ngor zhing gshegs de nyid rang gi sku tshe snga ma'i rigs brgyud du skye srid bzung ste/ slar yang nyid kyi sku'i sri zhu bar mngon du phyogs pa 'di ni ches ngo mtshar ba'i gnas so/ /don 'di ni bsam yas nas 'phrin las kyi mgon po gnod sbyin chen pos kyang ji lta ba bzhin du lung bstan pa yin te/ phyag mdzod de nyid zhing gshegs nas ring po ma lon par/

de nyid rang gi sngar gyi rigs rgyud kyi gnyen 'dun du gtogs pa/ 'byor pa ha cang mi che zhing ha cang mi chung ba zhig tu skye ba blangs nas/ dge bshes rang gi nye skor du gnas pa zhig 'byung ba yod do gsungs pa'i zhu 'phrin rje nyid la phul zhing / de nas phyi lo phyag mdzod sku'i skye ba 'di 'khrungs ma thag chos skyong chen por snga sor gyi lung bstan gyi don de 'di yin min dogs gcod kyi bka' tho stsal bar/ chos skyong chen pos de ka 'khrul med yin tshul mdzad 'dug pa dang / de bzhin du rje nyid kyis sgo rum ye shes mgon po'i drung du gsung brtag gnang bas kyang / de dang mthun par babs snang bas kun gyi yid ches pa'i gnas so/ /de dus kyi skabs shig rje nyid kyi mnal lam du bde mchog pho brang gi ri sul 'di na yar zhabs 'bring pa du ma dang bcas phebs song ba na/ de dag gi khrod na phyag mdzod zhing gshegs de mi snang bas/ rab 'byams pa gar song zhes gsungs pa na/ nyid kyi zhabs 'bring ba zhig gis/ drung ram lags ni shar phyogs pha gi nas nye lam brgyud de phebs par 'dug lags zhu bas/ rje nyid kyi thugs la ri rtse de na bzhugs gnas shin tu nyams dga' ba zhig yod dgongs shing / de lta na nged rang 'di ka nas brgyud nas phyin pas ri rtse ya gir rab 'byams pa dang rtse 'dzoms yong bar 'dug dgongs dgyes spro chen po'i ngang nas 'dzegs phebs te/ da lta rang rab 'byams pa dang 'phrad 'ong dgongs pa na mnal sad pa na/ shin tu phangs pa zhig byung zhes rje nyid kyi gsung las dngos su thos pa lags/ tshul 'di ni rje btsun rin po cher dgung lo zhe dgu bzhes pa'i dus mnal lam du ri chen po gcig gi rtsa ba na khang pa chen po gcig gi 'og khang na mi mang po ku co chen pos zi be re ba/ steng khang na'ang mi mang po'i gseb na rje btsun rang 'dug pa gzhan du gshegs bzhed pa na/

sa chen yab sras kyis khyod la lam bstan gyi gsungs nas bzhi pa'i lam bstan/ de nas rje btsun gyis mi de rnams la srid pa'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu 'gro ba yod na nga'i phyi la shog lam rgyus nga la yod pa yin gsungs pas/ phal cher rje btsun gyi phyi nar byung / bag tsam de nyid du phung nge lus/ de nas lam mangs ba gcig gi 'og na g.yang sa chen po gcig 'dug pa la/ byang ngos kyi brag them zhig la 'dzegs nas/ 'di na yar shog gsungs pas brgya tsam phyi nas byung / kha cig nub phyogs su song / mang po zhig mi thar zer der phung nge lus/ phyag rgya chen po bya ba gcig rbab la lhung / rje btsun dpon slob rnams thon pa'i byang ngos na ri sul gnyis 'dug pa'i shar phyogs na ri thang nyeg gcig 'dug pa la/ 'di na lam gnyis 'dug pa'i byang gi 'di bla chen gyis byang chub sems dpa' sha stag btang ba'i lam yin/ shar gyi 'di zhu yas btang ba'i lam yin/ khyed rang byang lam la 'gro 'dod yod na song / ngas de la mi thar bas shar lam 'dir 'gro/ yong 'dod pa rnams kyang shog gsungs pas/ byang lam la 'gro mi ma byung / de nas rje btsun gyis brag them gcig 'dug pa la 'dzegs byon pas/ sum cu lhag tsam gyis thar pa la bzhi pa'i lam bstan yar shog gsungs te/ na bza' ther ma rkyang pa yang nge ba gcig gsol te/ dga' ston rdor grags dang / gzhan bzhi tsam dang bcas 'di'i steng na sa phyogs shin tu nyams dga' ba zhig yod dgongs phebs pas thang nyeg der phebs pa dang mnal sad/ ces rje btsun gyi rnam thar mnal lam ma las mtshan ltas kyis mtshon pa'i rje btsun nyid la bzod pa thob pa sogs kyi slob ma byung tshul dang bcas gsungs pa dang mtshungs par snang bas ches rmad du byung ba'i mtshan ltas so/ /gzhan yang rje 'di nyid kyi phyag mdzod zhing gshegs de thugs rje'i spyan ras kyis kun tu 'tsho ba'i stobs kyis mkha' spyod brnyes pa'i mtshan ma yongs la gsal ba zhig byung na dgongs pa'i dus/
