gzhan nyams rtogs dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa po mang po la nyid kyi dmod nas re stsal/ thugs kyis dmod re yang 'dor ba mdzad nas phyag mdzod de gang na 'khrungs yod kyi rmi lam ltas bsgug tu 'jug pa gnang ba'i tshe/ kha ba lhas kyi dpon slob kyi mnal lam du bud med mkha' 'gro'i rtags can zhig byung nas/ mkha' spyod zer ba'i sgra lhang lhang ba gnyis dang / rig 'dzin zer ba'i sgra mi che tsam gnyis grags pa zhig dang / rje 'di'i zhabs 'bring ba dge slong gtsang ma zhig la/ phyag mdzod de nyid mkha' spyod du da lta thegs song zer zhing / 'od kyi lam zhig la bar snang la ye re byon pa'i mnal lam dang / de bzhin du gzhan zhig la yang rmi ltas ya mtshan can mang du byung snang ba sogs ni/ phyag mdzod zhing gshegs de nyid dus der mkha' spyod du thugs rje chen po'i phyag gis 'dren par mdzad pa'i mtshan mar nges so/ /lhag par rje nyid lho rong nas sa skyar phebs pa'i nangs pa de kho na la/ sgo rum ye shes mgon po'i drung du phyag mdzod zhing gshegs de bde ba can dang / mkha' spyod gnyis 'grub ma 'grub/ sku'i skye ba lnga drug gam gsum la sogs pa las nyon gyi skye ba len dgos mi dgos te/ tshan pa brgyad gsung brtag mdzad pas/ mkha' spyod dang bde ba can 'grub zer ba'i zan ril gnyis sku pang du dus gcig la babs byung ba na/ rje nyid kyi dgongs pa la/ sngar nged rang la rmi lam byung ba dang mthun par/ bde ba can nam mkha' spyod gang rigs su skyes nas gtan gyi bde ba la 'khod pa la the tshom mi 'dug snyam de nub nas thugs bde 'bol gyis song ba zhig byung gsungs pa rje nyid kyi gsung las thos pas/ 'di lta bu ni bla ma'i thugs rje dang slob ma'i dad pa 'dzoms na/ rang re kun kyang de 'dra'i skal ba bzang po dang rjes su mthun par 'di phyi'i don chen po bde blag tu 'grub pa la yid gnyis mi dgos par snang bas/

kun kyang dga' ba sgom zhing gsol ba 'debs pa la brtson par rigs so/ /de nas rnam 'dren dam pa 'di nyid dgung lo nga gnyis su phebs pa kun 'dzin zhes pa sa pho byi lo'i hor zla gnyis pa'i nang du lho nang nas gdan sa chen por phebs te/ dus mdos chen mo 'gyangs pa zla ba de'i mjug la gnang / de'i gnam gang la bskang gso brgya tshar dang / gsum pa'i tshes gcig la mgon po mnga' gsol dang / lo gsar gyi dga' ston sogs sngar rgyun bzhin mdzad rjes/ chos sde lho byang gi grwa rigs sogs chos nyan brgya phrag tsam la sman bla mched bdun gyi rjes gnang / mdo brgyad brgya pa/ zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa'i mdo chog dang / de'i 'grel pa nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lung bcas/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i rjes gnang / rnam rgyal gyi rjes gnang sogs so so'i yig lung dang bcas pa sogs kyi gsung chos kyi bka' drin zla phyed tsam gyi bar la stsal/ de nas lo de'i ston rgyal rtse nas zhabs drung du bla ma rin po che ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan drung dpon slob gsum dang / ngam ring mkhan rin po che klu sgrub dar rgyas pa dpon slob/ gdong kha'i dbu byed dang / grwa pa 'ga' zhig sogs phyogs nas byon pa mang po dang / de nyid kyi thugs sras ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / gzhan yang gdan sa 'di nyid kyi bla rigs rnams dang / chos sde lho byang gi grwa pa bgres thog brgya tsam sogs chos gsan brgya phrag lhag tsam zhig la/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos kye rdor rgyud gsum gyi bshad bka' dang / dag ljon spyi gsum sogs rgyud kyi yig skor bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lung bka'/ sa skya pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bstan srung rdo rje gur gyi mgon po'i srung 'khor rdo rje brag rdzong ma'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi khrid bka' dang / rtsa gsum 'khor lo la brten pa'i rdzogs rim zab mo/

nang khrid thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa/ gsang khrid du grags pa/ mgon pod me 'bar ma tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i dkar chag nang bzhin gyi lung / snyan brgyud glegs bam gyi lung dkar chag nang bzhin sogs lung gi rigs mang po zhig dang bcas zla ba gcig gi bar du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad/ de yang rgyud bshad dang brag rdzong ma'i khrid sogs phal cher thams cad la gnang nas/ zab mo'i yang rtse nang khrid dang / snyan brgyud glegs bam gyi lung sogs shin tu zab pa 'di rnams chos skyong gnyan pa'i stobs kyis bla ma gong ma rnams bcu phrag las lhag pa mi gnang ba'i bka' rgya dang / phyag len dam par mdzad pa zhig yod pa bzhin/ dam pa 'dis kyang spyir gsang khrid mdzad na nyes skyon yod med dang / de yang grangs mi nyung tsam la stsal bas/ chos skyong mi dgyes pa 'byung mi 'byung sogs kyi gsung brtag cig gnang ba legs tshul gzhan gyis zhus kyang / rje nyid kyis bla ma dkon mchog chos skyong dang bcas pa la thugs gtad kyi mtshan ltas gzigs par/ de nub nyid kyi rnam 'dren dam pa 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo bsod nams dbang po de nyid sku gzi mdangs 'bar zhing zhabs gnyis la rtsid pa'i zhabs zon sngon zhal bzhugs pa'i skabs la lar bzhes kyin yod pa bzhin gsol ba'i zhabs gnyis ka rje bla ma 'di nyid kyi dbu thog tu bzhag ste/ bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan nas smos te bka' bsgo byin rlabs shin tu smin rgyas stsal pa'i mnal lam gsal bar shar te/ nangs par da lam mgon po'i gsang khrid 'di 'dir 'dus thams cad la byas kyang chos skyong gi 'tshub sogs mi 'byung bar rmi ltas de nyid kyis gdengs khel du mtshon par 'dug kyang / slad mar chos skyong gi chos skor 'di rnams gzhan gyis bab chol du ston pa'i dper byas dogs yod pas/ da lam lnga bcu tsam la byed dgos pa 'dug gsungs nas rdzogs par stsal cing /

lo de'i hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nang du thugs sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi bla dpon rnams dang / chos 'khor lhun po nas rje'i drung / rtse chen nas mi dbang lcam sring / 'di ka'i chos sde lho byang gi grwa rigs sogs skya ser brgya phrag du ma la/ gu ru drag dmar nyang lugs kyi dbang bskur zab mo legs par stsal te/ de dus nub gcig mnal lam du lha chen rig 'dzin pho brang gi gzim khang rab gsal 'og ma'i lho rtsar mun thebs se pa zhig la/ bar do na bzhugs pa'i thugs snang dang bcas zhabs drung na nyid kyi yab rje grags pa'i mtshan can gyi zhabs 'bring ba chen po chos rje lha 'byor drung dang / nyid kyi mchod dpon smon lam rin chen gnyis 'dug pa la khyed rnams la 'jigs skrag gi snang ba mi 'dug gam gsungs pa la/ khong gnyis kyis mi 'dug tshul zhus par/ 'o na de nga'i mthu yin mod gsung ba snyam mdzad pa'i mod la/ gzim khang de'i byang gi ldebs ris la sa bir zhal sprod yod pa'i/ sa chen gyi sku de la gang nas shar med pa'i 'od chen po cig skya gsal te byung ba de las/ 'od dkar po zhig rje dpon slob phyogs la skya nar gyis byung ba/ de'i steng rje nyid phebs te/ thugs dga' bde che zhing de nyid bla ma'i bka' drin yin tshul gyi nyams dbyangs shig mdzad kyin 'dug pa'i tshig 'ga' zhig nangs par yang thugs dran gsos pa byung ba rjes su bsnyel 'dug gsungs pa 'di lta bu ni/ gang zag so skye rnal 'byor lam pa zhig yin kyang / rmi lam dang bar do'i rnal 'byor la gdeng thob pa'i mkha' spyod rig 'dzin gyi grong du yud kyis chas pa'i mtshan ma yang dag par snang bas shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su snang zhing / de nas sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa chen po 'di nyid dgung grangs bcu phrag lnga dang gsum gyi pad dkar gsar du bzhad pa skal ldan grangs med rkang drug pa'i tshogs kyi snying gi dga' ston gyi dpyid du 'gal ba zhes pa sa mo glang gi lo 'jam mgon bla ma nyid kyi thugs kyi ye shes las gnyis su med pa'i gdung sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug gtso bor gyur pa'i gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi bla dpon/

grwa btsun sogs dang / gzhan yang mdar grang mo che nas ngam ring mkhan chen klu sgrub dar rgyas dang / chos 'khor lhun po nas rje'i drung gdan sa pa/ bzang ldan chos sde'i grwa tshang rngod dgon pa sogs kyi slob dpon pa dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ rtse chen nas mi'i dbang po rnam rgyal rdo rje lcam sring / gling kha bde ba can/ lung chung sogs mus phyogs kyi grwa pa mang po dang / gser mdog can/ thub bstan rnam rgyal sogs kyi grwa pa kha re/ gdong kha/ lu pa sogs gzhis byes kyi chos nyan sum brgya lhag tsam la/ gdan sa chen po'i gtsug lag khang dbu rtse rnying mar 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba'i drung ga la ba der/ rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyi yab chos/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rdo rje bdag med ma'i thugs bcud/ 'jigs bral rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi zhal gdams/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa zab mo tshogs bshad kyi zab khrid zhib cing 'gril la mtha' chod pa/ zab mo slob bshad lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi lung khrid dang bcas legs par stsal te/ rgyab chos lung gi tshogs bsam par dka' ba zhig gnang ba yin la/ de yang lung gi rnam grangs la/ thog mar sngon 'gro snang gsum gyi khrid rjes su 'brel bar/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam par thar ba/ rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i bla ma rgya bod kyi lo rgyus/ dmar gyis mdzad pa'i zhib mo rnam dag sa chen gyi rnam thar dang rtse mo'i rnam thar tshangs spyod ma dang / khyod nyid ma mchan ma rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ rje btsun gyi rnam thar mnal lam ma dang de'i rnam thar sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ sa paṇa gyi rnam thar 'phags pas mdzad pa dang lho pas mdzad pa/ 'phags pa'i rnam thar shar chen gyis mdzad pa dang byang gzhon gyis mdzad pa/ tshogs nyan gyi rnam thar bar ston gyis mdzad pa/ nyan chen pa'i rnam thar dkar brag pas mdzad pa/ zhang pa'i rnam thar dpal ldan pas mdzad pa/ brag phug pa'i rnam thar ri khrod pas mdzad pa/

bla ma dam pa'i rnam thar dpal ldan pa dang karma byams chos pas mdzad pa/ ri khrod pa'i rnam thar dpal ldan pas mdzad pa/ dkar po brag pa'i rnam thar khong rang gis mdzad pa/ dpal ldan pa'i rnam thar mus chen gyis mdzad pa/ grub chen dang shar chen pa gnyis kyi rnam thar rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ rdo rje 'chang gi rnam thar kha skong dang bcas pa mus chen gyis mdzad pa/ mus chen gyi rnam thar rtsa 'grel kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa/ kun mkhyen gyi rnam thar sangs rin pas mdzad pa/ yongs 'dzin gyi rnam thar mus chen sangs rin dang / rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa gnyis/ sangs rin pa'i rnam thar sa los mdzad pa/ sa lo'i rnam thar dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa/ dkon mchog lhun grub kyi rnam thar dkon mchog dpal ldan pas mdzad pa/ sngags 'chang chen po'i rnam thar nyid kyis mdzad pa/ dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i rnam thar byams pa rab brtan pas mdzad pa/ 'jam dbyangs sku mched dang rje mus chen gyi rnam thar nyid kyis mdzad pa/ bdag chen blo gros pa'i rnam thar dang rdo ring kun spangs pa'i rnam thar tshar chen gyis mdzad pa sogs sngon chad lam 'bras pa sus kyang stabs gcig tu ma gnang ba'i lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa so so'i rnam thar shin tu mang ba dang / gzhan yang dpal ldan bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i khrid yig sbas don gsal ba/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rin pas mdzad pa'i dngos grub 'byung gter/ dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i mdzes rgyan gnyis/ mkhas pa'i dbang po klu sgrub rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i slob bshad kyi khrid yig cha tshang ba sogs khrid yig mang po'i lung dang / bla ma sa skya pa chen pos rdo rje'i tshig gi rnam 'grel bcu gcig mdzad pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rigs sras rje btsun sku mched dang / thugs sras gnyan phul byung ba'i don du mdzad pa'i gzhung bshad sras don mar grags pa dang / 'jam mgon sa paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i gsung bris pa dmar chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i gzhung bshad dmar ma/

dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i man ngag gi gter mdzod sogs gzhung bshad du ma dang / lam 'bras glegs bam dang / pod dmar ma dkar chag nang bzhin gyi lung / ngo mtshar snang ba/ bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyi 'od/ klu sgrub rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i slob bshad chos 'byung / nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lam 'bras chos 'byung rgyas pa dang / bsdus pa tshigs bcad ma/ bar ston zin bris sogs gsung ngag byung tshul gyi yi ge mang po/ bla ma dam pa'i pod nag ma lhag ma rnams kyi lung / rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i bskyed rim gnad kyi zla zer/ kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i man ngag rnam bshad/ nyid kyis mdzad pa'i kye rdor sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad mchan mang po/ kun mkhyen chen po'i lus dkyil bde chen bcud kyi snying po sogs phyi nang bskyed rim rnam bshad du ma dang / rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i rtsa ltung 'khrul spong / nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rtsa ltung 'khrul spong gi rnam bshad/ ngor rdzong grub mtha'i rnam 'byed/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i gsung ngag gi dri ba'i rang lan sogs dang / gzhan yang gsung ngag skor gyi yig phran mang po'i lung dang bcas pa'i lung gi rigs mtha' yas pa zhig gi bka' drin dang / lam sbas bshad ma gtogs gsung ngag gi cha lag yongs su rdzogs pa/ gzhan don sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa dang / rje sa chen gyi gsung las/ gsang sngags spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /dam pa'i gsung bzhin sgrub 'dod cing / /dngos grub myur du thob 'dod na/ /thog mar bla ma'i mdzad spyod gsang / /rjes gnang man ngag bskyed rdzogs gsang / /bla mas btags pa'i gsang mtshan gsang / /dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam gsang / /mkha' 'gros lung bstan mtshan ma gsang / /bdud rtsi lnga yi dam tshig gsang / /nyams las byung ba'i drod rtags gsang / /byin rlabs zhugs pa'i dus tshod gsang / /grol byed lhan skyes ye shes gsang /

/rtog med spyod pa shugs byung gsang / /zhes pa ltar/ gsang ba bcu'i rgyas btab dang bcas zla ba gsum gyi bar du chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor bar mdzad pa yin no/ /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ rdo rje 'phreng ba kri ya lha'i zhing khams/ /gnyis kyis lhag pa'i sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu/ /dgyes rdor rnam bzhi nag po chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis bcu bde can zhing khams bkod/ /bcu phrag drug gis lhag pa'i brgya phrag dang / /grangs med lha dang bla ma'i snang brnyan tshogs/ /ngo mtshar ri mor bris te ye shes lha/ /dgug gzhug rab tu gnas pa'i dge legs bstar/ /bdud rigs chu 'dzin mdzes sku nyi ma'i gzi/ /'phrog pas brel yang legs byas bser bu yi/ /ring bus skye 'gro'i bsod nams yangs pa'i mkhar/ /mdzad pa'i 'od 'phreng stong 'bar a la la/ /grub pa'i rtsibs stong ldan pa'i 'khor los sgyur/ /mthu stobs rin chen bdun gyi dbang phyug rje'i/ /rab mdzes sku brnyan rmad byung chos sku'i rten/ /nyer bskrun mchod sprin rgya mtshos rtag par mchod/ /blang dor tshul la dud cing 'gro ba'i mi/ /gzhan srog za la srin po'i ngang tshul can/ /chos min mun du 'thib pa mon gyi yul/ /der ni mi zad duḥkha mngon 'bar ba/ /na rag dmyal ba'i me lces nyam thag pa'i/ /grangs med 'gro la mi 'jigs skyabs kyi sbyin/ /mnyam pa med pa'i bka' drin ris med stsal/ /bstod bkur bsngags pa'i ca co de na 'phel/ /skye ba kun tu gang gi 'phrin las pa/ /legs smon rdo rje'i zhabs pas dam bcing zhing / /brtse ba'i spyan ras kyis 'tsho rig pa 'dzin/ /pu ṇ+ya raṣ+mi 'phrog byed drang srong zol/ /yongs 'dzin mkha' lding dbang po'i thugs rje dang / /rlabs chen dge tshogs 'dab gshog gis btegs te/ /mkha' spyod 'chi med grong du yud kyis bskyal/ /tshul de bsam na dad pa'i chu gter g.yo/

/rin chen bde gshegs bdun dang 'jam pa'i dpal/ /byin gyis rlob pa'i rjes gnang lung bcas dang / /zab las yang zab nag po chen po yi/ /man ngag zab dgu'i bcud dang rgyud kyi don/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i bdud rtsi'i skal ba can/ /mang po'i re ba'i shel gyi yol go bkang / /bdag med mkha' 'gro'i zhal gdams mngar mo'i ro/ /'jigs bral bi rū'i rnam dpyod bum pa cher/ /rtag par 'khyil ba'i gur kum gtsang ma'i chu/ /khyod kyi thugs bskyed ku sha'i chun po yis/ /blangs te bsags pa'i las can bye ba brgya'i/ /mi shes dri ma bkru ba'i cho ga yis/ /gnyis ldan dag pa'i chos dbyings dpal la bkod/ /e ma de lta'i mdzad 'phrin ngo mtshar gtam/ /thos pa tsam yang dkar ba'i las spyad na/ /dad gus lang tsho bdo rnams smos ci 'tshal/ /dri med mkhyen brtse'i rtsa ba rab brtan cing / /dmigs med brtse ba'i lo 'dab 'bum phrag rgod/ /zag med nus pa'i 'bras bu g.yur za ldan/ /yongs 'dzin dpag bsam dbang pos slar yang skyobs/ /de nas rje nyid dgung grangs 'dul ba pa ltar na nga bzhir phebs pa rnam 'gyur zhes pa lcags pho stag gi lo gsar du tshes pa'i hor lugs zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nang du bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i sku brnyan gser zangs las grub pa sku tshad che zhing ngo mtshar ba/ da lta lha khang mthil na bzhugs pa 'di legs par grub/ zla ba de'i yar tshes bcu bzhi gza' tshes shis pa'i nyin/ rje nyid dpon slob bcu phrag gsum tsam gyis dgyes pa rdo rje la brten pa'i rab tu gnas pa rgyud sde nas gsungs pa ltar tshul bzhin du lha khang mthil nyid du mdzad/ de'i tho rengs bla brang bzhi thog nas lha khang chen mor rab gnas kyi gsung chog la ma phebs tsam pa'i tshe mtshan lam du rje nyid lha khang chen mo'i nang du phebs 'dug pa la/ zhabs drung na gnas pa gzhan ma zhig gis theg chen chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' bkra shis kyi phyag nas 'khrul med yin snyam pa'i bris thang ha cang mi che ba/

gong gsham gyi rgyab sha dang bsdoms thag dar dmar rnying mas byas pa bsgril ba zhig phyag tu phul byung ba'i gong shing gi 'og tsam na dar skud ser pos tshems ris 'dra ba'i yi ge ser sram pa zhig 'dug pa gzigs pas/ 'di 'bri khung pa'i lag tu ma shor ba khar rje che zer ba snang / bsgril bshig pa'i nang na sa chen yab sras gsum gyi sku brnyan shin tu mtshar ba/ gtso bo de'i phyag g.yas na shing 'bras mang po g.yur du za ba'i shing lo gcig bsnams/ gong gsham gyi ngos de na gur gum gyi khu ba 'dra ba'i chu ser po 'dzag la khad pa zhig 'dug pa la/ 'di rnam rgyal gyi gzungs chu yin pa 'dug gsung ba zhig byung snang ba ni/ snga mo'i dus lha khang chen mo 'di gzhan gyis bdag pas/ sa skya pa rang gi zhal ngo yun ring po'i bar du dbang rgyu med pa zhig byung 'dug pa/ theg chen rin po che'i phyag tu 'byor te/ da lta'i bar du sa skya pa rang gis bdag gir mdzad pa 'di la gces spras chen po byas pa'i phan yon gyi dge mtshan yin pa 'dra/ gzungs chu yin zer ba de yang rnam rgyal gyi gzungs 'bum phrag 'don du bcug pa'i phan yon du snang zhes rje nyid rab gnas gnang ba'i dus der gsung ba las dngos su thos pa lags/ de nas lo de'i zla ba dang po'i nang du bcom mda' dgon gyi mkhan po dkon mchog 'phel ba dang / dgon de'i slob dpon byams pa rgyal mtshan dpon slob rnams gsung ngag rin po che dang / chos skyong skor gyi chos skor rnams zhu ba'i gdan sa chen po 'dir 'byor te/ de lta'i 'dod chos rnams zhu gsol phul bar/ rje 'di nyid kyis thugs rjes 'dzin par zhal gyis bzhes kyang / de dus khams 'gros pa rnams kyi mgo mi bcom mda' dpon slob rnams yin 'dug par brten/ mgron po rnams khams phyogs su 'gro dus gtugs pas/ gsung ngag yongs rdzogs zhu long ma byung bar/ khong dpon slob rnams la kye rdor rgyu dbang /

khrid yig sbas don gsal ba/ pod dmar ma'i lung sogs sger du stsal/ gzhan ma gzhir bzhugs kyi bla ma grwa rigs mang po dang bcas par rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog gis mdzad pa'i khrid brgya'i skor yongs su rdzogs par stsal cing / khong dpon slob rnams kyis kyang / rta dre'u/ ja gos dar sogs 'bul nod rgya chen po phul te/ slar yang lo de'i hor zla gnyis pa'i tshe/ bzang ldan nas zhabs drung bla ma rin chen kun dga' dpal 'bar dpon slob rnams zab chos 'dra zhu bar phebs pa la/ gzhis byes kyi chos nyan mang po dang lhan cig tu grol mchog zhabs kyi thugs bcud/ khrid brgya gtso bor gyur pa'i chos tshul mang du stsal te thugs kyi re ba yongs su 'gengs par mdzad/ de nas sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa chen po 'di nyid dgung gi bgrang gzhi bcu phrag lngar lngas lhag pa bong bu zhes pa lcags mo yos kyi lo gsar du tshes pa'i tshe/ nyid kyi thugs sras dam pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po mi 'jigs pa seng ge brgyad kyis btegs pa'i khri 'phang du zhabs zung dbang gi rgyal po nye bar bkod de/ ris med pa'i gdul bya'i tshogs mang po la dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin stsol ba'i sgo dang por 'byed par bzhed nas/ sngon 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po sku mched dang / bdag nyid chen po sku mched gsum khri phebs kyi skabs su yang mdzad kyin yod 'dug pa bzhin/ lha sar rgyal po mchod yon du da lo rigs sras khrir bkod kyi bkod pa gnang rgyu yin tshul gyi bka' tham dang / gzhan ma sa skya pa rang gi dbus rtsang gi dgon yon bdag so sor de lo'i dam rdzas gsar sgrub kyi gnang skyes dang bcas thugs dam mi sna ched du mngags te/ khri phebs yin tshul gyi bka' dril snyan par bsgrags/ dus rgyun gyi tshe dus mdos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nang du gnang ba yin kyang /

khri ston dang bstun pa'i bcu gnyis pa'i mjug tshun bsrings te/ phyogs kyi khri ston zhu mi thams cad 'dus pa zla ba de'i mjug las mkhan dang / ru 'dren gyi 'cham rgyas pa sogs dus mdos zab spros sngar las kyang lhag par mdzad rjes/ hor lugs zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig la/ snye mo nas khri lcam drung / rgyal byang zhabs drung bla ma khu dbon/ lha sa nas mchod yon gyi khri ston zhu mi wa kha bi lung nang so/ rtse gdong nas mchod dpon drung / bkris lhun po'i sku tshab/ ngor nas mgron gnyer bzang po lags rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i sde dpon dang / dgon so so'i bla ma las 'dzin sogs khri ston zhu ba'i skye bo brgya phrag brgal ba byon pa rnams dang / gzhir bzhugs mang po dang bcas pa'i bzhi thog bla brang gi tshoms chen khrig khengs pa la lo gsar gyi dga' ston bzhugs gral zab par stsal cing / de nas tshes gnyis nas bcu gcig gi bar la khri ston zhu ba'i rgyal byang gi zhabs drung bla ma khu dpon/ ngam ring mkhan chen klu sgrub dar rgyas pa/ skyed tshal 'og dwags po grwa tshang / gur pa grwa tshang / kha ba lhas/ rgyas chos/ ya ma bde ldan sogs kyi bla ma rnams dang / rta nag sgrol ma sogs dgon pa'i zhal bdag mdzad pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rab tu mang po zhig byon pa sogs la/ gsung ngag lta bu chos tshul rgya che ba rnams ni de dus mi rdzogs shing / bsdus pa'i rigs re gnyis tsam gyis khong rnams bzhed pa mi khengs pas/ de dus phal cher 'gro don mdzad 'os 'ba' zhig tu snang bas/ bstan pa'i rgyun la phan che bar dgongs nas/ zab la rgya che chung ci rigs pa'i mdo sngags kyi zab khrid tshad ldan lhad med phal che ba 'dus pa/ khrid bka' so so'i snying po'i don dril bas/ 'chad pa dang nyams len gang byed kyang / spros par bzhed na spro rgyu yod pa/ bsdus par 'dod na bsdu bde ba/ brgyud pa rnam par dag pa bar ma chad pa las legs par brgyud de 'ongs shing /

so sos thugs nyams su bstar ba'i zab chos/ grub pa'i dbang phyug nag po spyod pa'i rdo rje nyid zlos te byon pa/ 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dpal ldan kun dga' grol mchog blo gsal rgya mtsho'i sde'i gsung gi bdud rtsi dri ma med pa khrid brgya yongs rdzogs kyi bka' drin stsal bar mdzad pa yin te/ de yang sa skya pa'i yab chos zhen pa bzhi bral dang / sum pa lo tsā ba'i snyan brgyud skyid sdug lam khyer sogs khrid bka' 'ga' zhig nyams skye khrid dang / lhag ma lung khrid dang bcas pa/ khrid brgya'i brgyud 'debs/ khrid brgya'i mtshan sdom/ khrid brgya'i sa 'grel/ khrid brgya'i lo rgyus/ khrid brgya'i spyi chings rnams te rje grol mchog zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i khrid brgya'i skor cha tshang dang / gzhan yang zab cing dkon pa'i rjes gnang mang po dang bcas pa'i spyi sgos so so'i thugs kyi re ba yongs su rdzogs par mdzad/ de nas tshes bcu gsum/ bcu bzhi/ bco lnga gsum la gzhis byes kyi dge 'dun stong du longs pa la/ nyin re bzhin rgya ja'i rnyed bkur gsum re dang / skye bo gzhan nas lhags pa dang / gzhir gnas bsdoms pa'i skya ser khri phrag nye ba la nas mar gyi 'gyed gya nom pa dang bcas stsal pa'i thog 'jam mgon bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhabs 'bring pa'i tshogs dang bcas tshogs chen por phebs te/ dge 'dun rnams kyis gsung sgrogs/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sogs gang spyi'i bca' sgrigs thams cad snga mor bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid sku mched gsum khri phebs kyi skabs bzhin mdzad/ nyi ma dang po la gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi bla ma slob dpon/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'dus pa rgya mtsho lta bu dang / gzhan nas 'byor pa'i mi chen mang po dang bcas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dus pa rnams la/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa'i rgyal ba'i sras kyi lam bzang gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos chen po thub pa'i dgongs pa rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi nang nas/

bsam gtan gyi phar phyin bshad pa yan chad/ gnyis pa la sngar 'phros nas phar phyin drug gi grangs yan chad/ gsum pa la de 'phros te yongs su rdzogs par/ sku'i cha byad yid du 'ong zhing gzi byin che ba/ gsung snyan cing 'jebs pa/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshul dang mtshungs par/ 'gal zlos ma 'brel ba'i skyon bral zhing / dag gsal snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis legs par stsal pas/ 'dus pa'i tshogs thams cad shin tu ngo mtshar zhing / sku na gzhon pa 'di lta bu la sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rmad du byung ba dang / lhag par spyan 'dus tshogs la gzigs pa'i ring nas gsung chos thogs med du 'jo ba 'di bzhin ci las kyang ya mtshan che bar 'dug go /zhes zer ba dang / gsung gi sgra yang zhabs drung na gnas pa rnams kyis ji ltar thos pa bzhin/ zhabs drung bla ma sogs khro khang gi shar gyi khri chung na bzhugs pa rnams dang / 'cham khang gi 'phyong rtse na 'khod pa rnams kyis kyang de ltar du gsan te/ gsung dpang mtho zhing snyan la gsal ba 'di bzhin du 'byung ba/ nye ring kun la snyoms pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs su grags pa der snang bas ches ngo mtshar bar 'dug ces kyang gleng bar byed cing / 'di lo dgun dpyid zla ba lnga drug gi ring nyin re bzhin nam mkha' sprin gyis 'grib pa dang / rlung 'tshub dang / grang ngad gshed che ba rang zhig byung ba yin kyang / gsung chos kyi nyin gsum la nam mkha' dwangs pa la/ 'ja' sprin dkar pos yongs su khyab cing / rlung po yang gtan med pa'i shin tu dro ba dang / gsung chos grol ba'i nangs par nas sngar bzhin grang reg che ba byung ba ni/ de dus gdan sa chen po 'dir lhags pa kun gyi dgongs dbyings su gsal bar gyur to/ /de nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug zhabs kyi gsung chos kyi bar gseng la/ khri ston gyi 'bul skyes rnams rim pa ltar bstabs pa dang /

nyin gsum pa'i tshe/ gsung chos zab mo stsal pa'i dge tshogs dang / zang zing gi sbyin 'gyed bla na med pa bskrun pa'i legs byas rnams 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i bsngo ba rin po ches rgyas 'debs pa'i phyir bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid kyang phebs te yab sras lhan cig tu chos kyi rje sa paṇ+ḍi ta'i chos kyi khri chen po ga la ba der rgyal ba nyin mo'i mgon dang / rgyal sras mtshan mo'i mgon gyi tshul du zhabs zung mngon par rtsen pa'i dge legs mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtse'i bar du gsal ba'i skabs/ thugs sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gsung chos 'doms pa zin nas/ legs so'i 'bul nod rnams 'bul ba dang / gtsug lag khang so sor snyan dar/ zhal zas/ dkar me rnams rgya dpang che ba dang / gzhan rnams gzhag 'os pa tshor gos dar ras sogs gang 'tshams kyi rnam par gzhag pa snga sor las zab par gnang rjes/ rje nyid kyis yon bshad rgyas pa dang bcas gsung bsngo'i rgyas 'debs bla na med pa mdzad la/ de dus 'bul nod kyi rnam grangs kyang / 'bras spungs nas dge lugs kyi bstan pa'i srog shing chen po rje dge 'dun grub nyid za hor gyi rigs kyi thig le dri ma med par zlos te byon pa thams cad mkhyen pa chen po sprul pa'i sku nyid nas zhal dkar karma gam dkar ser po/ phyag dril theg chen ma dngos gtsang ba/ bkras thags kyi mthong byas bla bre che legs/ gos yug tshangs gsum sogs dgu tshan zung dang / rgyal po dang phyag mdzod zhabs drung nas/ gos dar dang / rta dre'u sogs kyi dgu tshan re re sogs rgya dpang shin tu che ba dang / gzhan yang bkris lhun po/ rtse gdong / ngor e wam̐ chos ldan/ gser mdog can/ thub bstan gong 'og sogs nas 'bul nod kyi tshan grangs stobs che zhing gya nom pa kho na dang / gzhir bzhugs rnams kyis rang rang gi mnga' thang 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i legs so zhu gsol gyi 'bul rten shin tu che bas/

snga mor bdag nyid chen po sku mched gsum khri phebs skabs rang khri ston gyi 'bul nod rgya che bar grags pa de dus las kyang / da lam rgya dpang che bar byung zhes rje nyid gsung zhing / rgan rabs rnams kyang de bzhin du mgrin gcig tu gleng bar byed do/ /de ltar nyid kyi thugs sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po nyid/ bdag nyid chen po rang gi rgyal tshab kyi tshul du mnga' gsol te/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'khor ba ji srid par mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi tog mngon par mtho ba'i dge mtshan mthong zhing thos pas/ sa skya'i chos dang srid kyi chab 'bangs su gtogs pa thams cad mdongs ldan gyi tshogs dbyar skyes kyi sgra thos pa ltar/ dga' ba'i glu len/ skyid pa'i gar bsgyur/ dad gus 'dab gshog rgyas pa'i thal mo'i me tog 'dzum zhing / mchog tu yid rang ba dang spro ba'i bstod bkur bsngags gsum gyi sgo nas 'jam mgon yab sras kyi yon tan brjod pa lhur byed pa zhig byung ba yin la/ de nas lo de'i hor zla gsum pa'i nang du gdung sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ mdar grang mo che nas mkhan rin po che/ chos 'khor lhun po'i rje'i drung / lo phu gdan sa pa 'khyog pa chos rje/ gzhir bzhugs kyi bla ma slob dpon/ ka rab 'byams pa sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen bslab pa rin po ches thugs rgyud phyug pa brgya phrag lhag pa sogs la sgrub thabs kun las btus brgya rtsar grags pa/ ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa de nyid dang / yar lung lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur pa'i kun las btus pa rgya mtshor grags pa ste/ rjes su gnang ba'i bka' srol chen po gnyis kyi rjes gnang ma lus pa/ so so'i rgya gzhung gnyis/ bod gzhung dang bcas pa/ nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung rabs byon tshul gyi yi ge rgyas pa'i lung rnams stsal/

de dus dar rtse mdo nas rje btsun sa skya pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa'i dpal mnga' ba sa yam gnyer pa dpal ye kha gdan sa chen po dang / rje nyid kyi zhal dkyil lta bar 'byor te/ ja gos dar gyi 'bul nod rgya chen po phul/ rdo rje phur pa'i stod las kyi dbang / kye rdor rgyu dbang / chos skyong gi rjes gnang sogs zab la dkon pa du ma dang / sgrub thabs kun las btus gnyis po'i bka' drin sogs chos kyi bdud rtsis rgyud bum gtams par gyur pa dang / slar yang dad pa'i dbang po cher brtas pas yid drangs te/ gdan sa chen po'i rten gsum ngo mtshar can rnams la dkar me ru ba'i gzhi 'dzugs par zhus/ de nas de gong stag lo mdar grang mo cher tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po blo gsal rgya mtsho dang / de nyid kyi thugs sras grub pa'i dbang phyug rta ra ba bsod nams chos 'phel gnyis kyi sku gdung la zhugs rang bzhes kyi rnam pas rkyen chen po med par mes bzhu shor bar brten/ grang chen dpon slob rnams kyis tshar chen yab sras gnyis po de'i gdung rus rnams ma nyams par nyid kyi phyag tu phul/ rten bzhengs sogs gang spyi'i bslab ston mtha' dag zhus pa bzhin/ khong rang dpon slob rnams kyis phyag phyi zhus te/ gdung 'dul dang / rje nyid kyis phyag tsha gnang / tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i sngar gyi gser gdung gi dod du dngul gdung shin tu ngo mtshar ba zhig dang / mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags dang / rje ta ra ba thun mong gi dgongs rdzogs su mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sku brnyan zhig bzhengs te/ gdung tsha rnams de dag tu bzhugs su gsol bar bzhed nas/ dngul gdung gi zhal bkod btsugs te/ yos lo zla ba drug pa'i nang du legs par zin nas/ zla ba de'i tshes bcu drug gza' tshes bzang ba'i nyin/ grang chen nas mkhan chen dpon slob rnams kyang phebs/ rje nyid dpon slob bcu phrag phyed dang gsum tsam gyis dgyes pa rdo rje la brten pa'i rab tu gnas pas byin gyis brlabs par mdzad de/

tshes bcu dgu'i nyin khong rang dpon slob rnams kyis grang mo cher spyan 'dren par mdzad/ der skabs yar lung bkra shis rtse chos sde nas rje btsun dbang phyug rab brtan gyi thugs sras dbon rin po ches/ gdung sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs khri phebs kyi legs so'i 'bul skyes de gong 'bul ma thub pa dngul gdung sogs gzungs 'bul thog 'byor pas/ nyid kyi gsung las/ rje dbon drung deng sang tshar lugs kyi bstan 'dzin mtshungs bral yin pas/ khong tshos khri ston gyi 'bul nod/ da lam tshar chen gyi dngul gdung rab gnas dang sgo mtshungs 'di bzhin/ ming sgra'i stabs sogs nas spyir yang rten 'brel legs shing / khyad par dngul gdung la gzungs bzhugs rab gnas dang stabs 'grigs pa 'di ya mtshan che/ snga mor sku gdung rnams kyis me bzhes pa'i gnas tshul 'byor skabs kyi rmi lam tsho dang / da lam gyi 'di sogs la dpags na/ tshar chen de nyid thugs dbyings nas dgyes pa'i mtshan mar the tshom mi dgos pa 'dra zhes rje nyid gsungs pa las dngos su thos pa lags/ de dus kyi mtshan ltas ni/ sku gdung gnyis kyis zhugs me bzhes tsam gyi gong der rje 'di'i mtshan lam du/ nyid kyi yab rje chos kyi rgyal po grags pa'i mtshan can nyid yin nam dgongs pa'i bla ma zhig 'phral du sku zhi bar gshegs rgyu yin khul gyi sku bsnyun pa'i tshul mdzad pa dang / de'i sku gdung gi phyag phyi sogs rje nyid kyis mdzad rgyu yin dgongs pa zhig dang / sku gdung gnyis kyis me bzhes kyi gnas tshul nangs par 'byor rgyu'i de nub mnal lam du rje nyid bzhi thog gi gzim chung gi da lta'i gzim mal 'di na bzhugs 'dug pa la/ sku mdun gyi ka gdong der dzo ki sma ra can ras gos gyon pa zhig gi lag pa gnyis na rgya gar gyi phug ron re re bzung nas rje 'di nyid la/ 'di dag bzhes dgos tshul zhu ba la/ cung zad thugs 'dzem nyams kyis ma bzhes pa na/

dzo ki des phug ron gnyis po ka ba la gzer song ba na/ gnyis car gshog pa theb be sder mos ka ba la 'chang nas bsdad song ba dang / dzo ki de'i gzhogs na ban+de gzugs bongs che ba zhig ngo gnong tsam byas cang mi zhu bar 'dug pa zhig byung nas/ de nub ci yin nam rmi lam dkyus mar mi 'dug dgongs/ nangs par grang mo che nas gnas tshul 'bul mi 'byor bas/ mnal ltas gnyis car 'di la lta ba 'dra dgongs shing / rjes su tshar chen yab sras kyi gdung rus ma nyams pa phyag tu 'byor ba dang / phyag tsha gnang ba/ rten bzhengs pa sogs gang 'tshams thams cad dam pa 'di nyid kyis phyag bzhes rkang len mdzad dus/ dzo ki de tshar chen yab sras gnyis por chos skyong rnams shin tu 'go bas sku gdung gnyis la yang chos skyong 'bral med du 'khor ba'i tshul/ mnal lam snga ma de sku gdung gnyis po de'i zhabs tog 'di bzhin byed pa'i ltas dang / phug ron gtad pa de gdung rus gnyis char 'byor ba 'di dang / ban+de ngo cung zad nag pa de rje tshar chen la gnod sbyin beg tse ba shin tu 'go bas/ sku gdung glo bur du bzhus pa de la cung ma dga' ba'i rtags yin par 'dug dgongs shing / zhal nas kyang gsungs pa dngos su thos pa bris pa yin pas kun gyis yid ches pa'i gnas so/ /tshul 'dis ni rje nyid thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i skye sprul yin tshul bsam yas chos skyong chen pos mdongs gsol du phul ba de nyid kyang gsal ba yin te/ rje klu sgrub rgya mtsho de nyid/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs sras brgyud 'dzin gyi gtso bo gcig yin pas/ rje tshar chen de nyid kyi sku gdung gi phyag phyi sogs rje klu sgrub nyid kyis mdzad 'os pa ltar/ rje nyid kyi mtshan lam du gsal bas so snyam du sems so/ /de ltar tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i dngul gdung rin po che dang / mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyi sku brnyan rnams la phyag nas gnang ba'i skabs der/

rje nyid kyi lcam rje btsun ngag dbang chos kyi nyi ma'i dgongs rdzogs su slob dpon rin po che pad+ma sam+bha wa'i rnam thar bris thang bdun gras/ gong gsham zhal khebs sogs dngos gtsang zhing / ri mo'i bkod pa gzhan las phul du byung ba 'di nyid dang / lha khang chen mo'i khyams stod kyi shar ldebs kyi nang ngos la thub pa'i dbang po dang / gong ma lnga/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras gsum/ rje btsun mus pa chen po/ rgyal dbang tshe dpag med rnams kyi sku gzugs brgya tshar bzhugs pa'i rgyang ris 'di rnams kyi phyag nas stabs cig gnang / ldebs ris 'di stag lo'i ston dbu btsugs nas/ dgun tshun la thub dbang / gong ma lnga brgya tshar yan chad las ma grub par/ 'phros dpyid mdzad rtsis kyis ri mo mtshams bshol dus/ sngar zin pa rnams la phyag nas bsdus pa zhig mdzad par mthil du phebs skabs/ mthil du sku gnyer gyis mjal dar sman rtse kha gang phul ba/ rje nyid kyis zhabs 'bring ba rnams la dar 'di thub dbang la phul dang gsungs 'dug par/ mchod dpon smon lam rin chen dang / chos rje kun dga' blo gros pa gnyis kyis thub dbang gi sku'i thad der dar de grim 'dug pa/ dar sne gnyis thub dbang gi sku'i g.yas g.yon du mtho dman cung zad dang bcas pa bzung ba ltar chags te/ yun ring po'i bar du de bzhin du gnas/ rjes su dar steng du bye'u phar 'phur tshur 'phur gyi rkyen gyis babs 'dug pa la/ slar 'phan chung byas dril gdangs la gzer te phul ba 'di yin snang bas/ ngo mtshar lhag par che zhing / de nas bzung thub pa dar len mar kun la grags so/ /gzhan yang lo 'di la khyams stod byang ngos kyi skya ldebs la/ nub phyogs su byams mgon brgya phrag la nye ba dang dbus kyi steng du bla ma sa skya pa chen po la/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan bi rū pa zhal gzigs kyi bkod pa/ gong ma gzhan bzhi'i sku brnyan sogs kyi 'og tu 'jam mgon bla ma nyid kyi 'khrungs rabs/

'jam pa'i rdo rje nas rje nyid kyi bar te/ mkhas grub kyi skye bo bcu phrag gnyis kyi sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i zlos gar skal bzang gdul bya'i blo mig dag pa'i snang ngor ji ltar brtse ba'i tshul gyi snang brnyan so so ri mor bri ba'i bkod pa/ nyid kyi zhabs 'bring ba chen po rje dbon bsod nams rab brtan pas mdzad pa dang / shar phyogs su rje btsun sgrol ma nyer gcig gi sku gzugs rnams legs par bzhengs pa'i zhal bkod bla na med pa mdzad/ khyams stod nang byang phyogs kyi gyang ngos la/ nyid kyi mchod dpon smon lam rin chen gyis rje btsun dam pa nyid kyi 'khrungs rabs rnams dang / dge 'dun tshogs pa'i gung gral gyi dbus thad na snga mor ras gzhi la gsung ngag bla brgyud bris pa'i yol thang de'i sar ka khongs bcad nas lam 'bras bla brgyud shin tu ngo mtshar ba dang / dge 'dun 'du ba'i sgo nyis sral che ba'i lho phyogs kyi gyang ngos la/ thub dbang gnas bcu/ rgyal chen bzhi/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum/ mgon po tshe dpag med kyi sku grangs mang ba zhig 'bri bar bzhed pa'i deng sang ri mo'i las kyi skabs na yod pa 'di lags shing / gtsug lag khang chen po 'dir byams mgon dang / sgrol ma/ lam 'bras bla brgyud sogs 'bri ba'i thugs bzhed cher mdzad pa'i dgongs gzhi yang / mang ja sogs kyi skabs dge 'dun tshogs pa rnams kyis lam 'bras phyag mchod rgyun du mdzad pa dang / cho 'phrul zla ba'i nang du smon lam gyi skabs byams pa'i smon lam grangs med dang / sgrol ma 'bum ther sogs la sgrol ma nyer gcig gi bstod pa dang / gnas brtan phyag mchod sogs zhal 'don rtag tu mdzad pa rnams la de dang de'i rten re byung na phan yon che bar dgongs pa'i thugs bskyed rmad du byung bar snang zhing / gsung las kyang de bzhin gyi bka' stsal yang yang phebs pa thos pa yin no/

/don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ rgyal kun thugs rje gcig bsdus phyag na pad/ /sa ston ri pa 'phags pa blo gros kyi/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol rtsed lha khang che/ /gces par 'dzin pa'i rnam 'phrul rmad byung la/ /lha dang bla ma dgyes pa'i 'dzum 'phreng 'od/ /nyin mo'i sgo ngar yang gzigs e ma mtshar/ /gang gi snyan pas dad dang 'byor can shes/ /ring bos rnam mang chos kyis tshims par mdzad/ /de nas ya mtshan che ba'i ltad mo ni/ /gangs ljongs skyid pa'i dga' tshal yangs pa yi/ /skye dgu ku mud tshogs kyi bsags rgyab mthus/ /lugs zung cha shas yongs gang 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /zla ba gzhon nu 'jigs med gdong lnga pa/ /'bum gyis btegs pa'i khri 'phang kun gsal ngos/ /gsar du tshes pa'i mkhyen brtse'i 'dzum 'od las/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi'i chu gter 'khyil ba mthong / /a ho/ de tshe kun gsal ri dwags mig can ma/ /rab dkar 'ja' gos kyis bklubs mdzes pa'i mdangs/ /sngo bsangs lang tsho ngom bzhin lha rdzas kyi/ /me tog bsil ma'i mchod sprin char du 'bebs/ /rnam thos sras dang rmugs 'dzin dbang po sogs/ /nor sbyin bye ba'i dpal 'byor ji snyed tshogs/ /'bul nod rdzas su 'jig rten byed po yis/ /sprul lta'i phun tshogs yongs 'du de tshe mthong / /'jam dpal rdo rje yab sras nyi zla'i dkyil/ /mthong bas gti mug mun tshogs gsal ba dang / /gus spro'i snang ba rab tu 'byams pa yi/ /dge ba'i ba dan chabs cig dus der mthong / /sku gsung thugs kyi rmad byung yon tan tshogs/ /sgrog pa lhur byed bstod bkur bsngags pa yi/ /mgrin pa'i rgyud mang gyen du bsgrengs pa'i sgras/ /sa gsum rna bar bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho khol/ /rgyal bstan yongs kyi bdag po sa skya pa'i/ /chos dang srid du gtogs pa'i skye bo'i tshogs/ /kun kyang dga' bdes myos pa'i glu dbyangs 'tsher/ /skyid pa'i zlos gar rtse 'jo'i dpal la rol/

/dus der bslab gsum lus rgyas lung rigs kyi/ /sna zhags ring ba'i bde chen gnyis 'thung tshogs/ /kun la chos dang zang zing gtsang ma'i chab/ /brtson pa'i sna zhags brgyud de ngoms par blud/ /slar yang grub gnyis ster bya'i lha yi tshogs/ /sgrub pa'i 'khrul med cho ga'i chu klung brgya/ /gcig bsdus paṇa grub thugs mtshor 'khyil ba'i bcud/ /bka' srol gnyis kyis mang po'i blo bum bkang / /snyan brgyud gdams pa nor bus thugs mdzod gtams/ /mang du thos pa'i chos sbyin ris med 'jo/ /mthu dang nus pas dregs byed kun 'dar ba'i/ /blo gsal rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i rgyan gyur rje/ /sras dang bcas pa'i sku gdung yid bzhin nor/ /bdag gir 'os zhes gnyan mgon dzo ki'i zol/ /gang la gtod pa'i mtshan lam ri mo bzhin/ /rin chen dngul gyi thugs rten ngo mtshar bskrun/ /mgon khyod klu sgrub mkhas pa'i ded dpon du/ /gyur tshe blo gsal klu yi dbang po las/ /gdams pa rin chen blangs nas rang gzhan don/ /smin pa'i tshul yang de tshe sgrib med gsal/ /ston dang lha dang bla ma'i sku'i snang brnyan/ /grangs med ri mor bris pa'i legs byas mdangs/ /dbang po'i gzhu 'gog de las thub pa che/ /rab dgyes dar gyi cod pan dam du bzung // ༈ //spyi don dgu pa bye brag tu mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam pa gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i rmad du byung ba'i mdzad 'phrin gyi sgo nas bstan pa rin po che ji ltar gsal bar mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ de ltar bdag cag rnams kyi mtshungs pa med pa'i gtan gyi skyabs mgon dam pa 'di nyid kyis bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum sogs lhod pa mi za ba'i mkhas pa dang grub pa'i sa la rtsen pa rnams dang / mkhas grub kyi yon tan rin po che la dbang gis phyug pa ma yin kyang / zang zing gi dngos rdzas nam mkha' mdzod la dbang bsgyur ba'i skye bo bstan pa bstan 'dzin du bcas pa dad pa dang gus pa'i sgo mtha' yas pa'i rnyed pa dang bkur bstis phu dud du bgyi bar mdongs gsol du yod pa/

yangs pa'i rgyal khams chen po la dbang bsgyur ba'i mi'i rje bor gyur pa dang / de las cig shos pa rang dbang ba'i bsod nams dang 'byor pa'i dpal yon can/ dge ba'i sems nyid chu shel ltar dwangs pa/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che spyi dang / bye brag 'dzin cing skyong ba'i skyes bu spyi dang thun mong ba'i bgyi ba rlabs po che ji ltar bskrun pa'i tshul che long tsam bsnyad nas/ de las kyang bgrang yas shes bya'i gnas la mkhas pa'i skyes chen dag gi thun mong ma yin pa'i mdzad 'phrin ni/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum du yongs su grags shing grub la/ de yang rgyu mkhas btsun bzang po gsum dang mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa med na/ 'bras bu 'chad pa dang / rtsod pa dang / rtsom pa'i bgyi ba rnam par dag pa 'byung ba'i gnas med cing / khyad par shes bya'i kun gsal yangs par/ mkhyen rab kyi dkyil 'khor ma smin na/ tshul dang tshul min gyi snang mun dbyer mi phyed cing / mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas kyang brtse ba'i shing rtas ma drangs na/ legs par bshad pa'i mdangs don gnyer mig sgor mi gsal la/ thugs rje'i rta bdun gyis legs par bskul yang nus mthu mngon par 'bar ba'i gzi byin mi ldan na/ gdul bya'i sgrib pa'i tshang tshing bsreg par mi nus pa las/ bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa 'di ni yon tan de dag thams cad kyis thugs rgyud yongs su gtams pa ste/ de'i tshul yang gong du cha tsam bstan pa las rjes su dpag par nus shing / rmad du byung ba'i yon tan de rnams dang ldan pa las ni mkhas pa'i mdzad 'phrin gsum gyi sgo nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde thams cad 'bad med du lhun grub tu 'byung ba ni/ theg pa chen po'i rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos las/ thog ma dbus mtha' med pa yi/ /rang bzhin yin phyir 'dus ma byas/ /zhi ba chos kyi sku can phyir/ /lhun gyis grub ces bya bar brjod/

/so so rang shes mthong ba'i phyir/ /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa/ /de ltar rnam gsum rtogs phyir mkhyen/ /lam ston phyir na thugs brtse ba/ /nus pa ye shes thugs rje yis/ /sdug bsngal nyon mongs spong phyir ro/ /dang po gsum gyis rang don te/ /phyi ma gsum gyis gzhan don yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ de bas na bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che mi nub cing yun du gnas pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo ni/ dam pa'i chos 'chad nyan gyis gtan la 'bebs pa nyid yin par bshad kyang / lnga brgya pa tha ma la nye ba'i dus 'dir 'chad nyan gyis bgyi ba lhur len pa ches nyung zhing / 'chad par rlom pa 'ga' zhig ni brgyud pa rnam par dag pa las 'ongs pa'i bka' srol bzang po las phyir phyogs te rnyed pa dang grags pa'i phyir rang bzo dang / gzu lum du ston sgom byed pa dang / chen po la la ni/ dag ma dag gi rnam dbye cha tsam shes bzhin du/ rang nyid la gzhan gyi phyogs 'dzin spangs te/ bstan pa la ris med kyi gzur gnas su 'dzin cing sgrog pa zhig 'byung re ba'i kun slong gis 'chad pa'i tshul yang mang mod kyi/ rab dbye las/ mkhas rnams 'di la mi dgyes kyang / /dus kyi shugs kyis bzlog ma nus/ /zhes bka' stsal pa der snang bas/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis ni dri ma med pa'i chos kyi rjes su 'jug par 'dod kyang / de'i rnam dbye tshul bzhin du ma shes par dad pa'i rjes su 'brangs te ngal ba don med du gyur pa rnams la thugs brtse bas rjes su gzung ba'i slad dang / dri ma med pa'i chos zab cing rgya che ba rnams kyi rgyun mi nyams shing dar rgyas su 'gyur bar bzhed pas nyid kyi bka' drin mtshungs bral gyi 'dren pa rnam gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i yongs 'dzin du ma'i zhal bum las 'ongs pa'i phyi nang rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i chos tshul zab mo'i bdud rtsi rnams brtson pa gnyis kyi snyim pas yang yang gsol zhing /

blo gros ro 'dzin gyis dgyes par myangs pas lung rtogs yon tan gyi rdo rje gsum gyi dbang po brtas par gyur te/ 'phags yul nas mdo sngags gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i lam srol yongs su rdzogs pa du ma zhig brgyud pa'i 'phreng ba zam ma chad pa las 'ongs pa/ 'khrul pa mi mnga' ba'i rje btsun sa skya pa gong ma lnga sogs mkhas grub kyi skyes bu du mas thugs nyams su bstar zhing / 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab pa'i rgyun dri ma med pa'i dbang bka'/ gzhung bshad/ lung khrid/ man ngag gi bka' la sogs pa zab cing rgya che ba'i chos kyi tshul mtha' yas pas phyogs dang ris su ma bcad pa'i gdul bya blo gsal zhing don du gnyer ba'i dad 'dun can gzhal du med pa/ sbyin pa rnam pa bzhi dang / snyan par smra ba la sogs pas mtshams sbyar te lhun grub rgyun mi chad pa'i rnam par thar pas smin cing grol ba'i lam la 'god par mdzad pa yin te/ de dag gi rnam grangs kyang rje nyid dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gcig bzhes skabs/ gsung ngag zab mo'i dga' ston gyi thog ma gling kha bde ba can du stsol bar mdzad pa nas bzung / da lta yan la gsung ngag tshogs bshad tshar dgu/ zab mo slob bshad tshar gsum/ lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi khrid/ 'khor lo bde mchog nag po lugs kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ nag po rim bzhi lan grangs du ma/ nag po spyod pa'i rdo rje grol mchog zhabs kyi bka' srol khrid brgya tshar lnga/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos dri ma med pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gyi snying po zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gsung khrid lan grangs mang po/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rtsa dbu ma'i khrid/ gsang ba 'dus pa 'gos lugs kyi smar khrid/ gshed dmar spros med kyi khrid/ bde mchog dkar po'i khrid/ de'i tshe khrid/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe khrid/ thugs rje chen po'i smar khrid tshem bu lugs/ skyer sgang lugs/

rgyal po lugs/ sum pa lo tsā ba'i snyan brgyud kyi khrid/ skyid sdug lam khyer gyi khrid/ ma gcig lab sgron nas brgyud pa'i gcod khrid/ gur gyi mgon po'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi khrid lan grangs du ma ste mdo sngags kyi zab khrid dpag tu med pa dang / kye rdor bka' bab bzhi'i dbang / zhal ngo nang brgyud kyi kye rdor rgyu dus kyi dbang dang / lam dus kyi dbang grangs med pa/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i dbang / bde mchog lū nag dril gsum ga'i dbang lan grangs du ma/ nag po lugs kyi dbang / phur pa sa lugs kyi dbang / gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dbang rnams bgrang bar mi bzod pa tsam dang / gur rigs bsdus kyi dbang / 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad bskor gyi dbang / rwa lugs bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sa lugs kyi dbang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / yang dag mar me dgu pa'i dbang / gu ru drag dmar nyang lugs kyi dbang la sogs pa bla med gsar rnying gi dbang bskur gyi rigs bgrang ba las 'das pa dang / gzhan yang sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis sogs rnal 'byor rgyud skor gyi dbang mang po/ tshe dpag med lha dgu/ gzungs grwa lnga/ 'chi med rnga sgra/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu sogs bya spyod kyi dbang du ma dang / gur gyi mgon po lha lnga ma/ lha bcu gsum ma/ bcu bdun ma/ lha brgyad ma'i dbang sogs mdor na smin byed dbang gi rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / rdo rje phur pa smad las drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang lan grangs du ma dang / rjes gnang gi bka' srol chen po sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang / rgya mtshor grags pa gnyis kyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa/ so so'i rgya gzhung bod gzhung gi lung dang bcas pa tshar gsum/ rjes gnang zur bka' ni rje nyid kyis brgya phrag las brgal ba gsan cing / gsan pa thams cad kyang so so dang 'brel ba'i rgyab chos kyi lung dang bcas pa tshar gnyis gsum tsam ma stsal ba med la/

gzhan yang rje btsun bdag med ma dang / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs sogs rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i byin rlabs kyi rigs mang po dang / dgyes pa rdo rje rtsa rkyang gi bshad bka' dang / rgyud gsum ga lhan cig tu legs par bshad pa'i bka' lan du ma/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i lam po che theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed 'bog pa'i cho ga thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa'i rgyal sras lam bzang gi gzhung bshad dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa ston pa'i gzhung mang po'i bka' lung sogs lung gi rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste/ mdor na nyid kyi gsan yig nang ltar gsan pa phal cher stsol bar mdzad cing / de snga stsal ma zin pa yang slar nges par stsol bzhed yod pa/ rdo rje 'phreng ba kri ya dang bcas pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo/ gsang 'dus spyan gzigs/ 'jam rdor sogs kyi dbang dang / 'khor lo bde mchog lū dril gyi bskyed rdzogs dang / rgyud kyi bshad bka'/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud kyi bshad bka' sogs mang po zhig gi bka' drin stsol ba'i thugs 'dun me 'bar ba la shing bsnan pa lta bu mnga' zhing / de lta bu'i chos tshul de dag gang 'chad kyang / thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs legs par bcad cing / sgom pas thugs nyams su myong ba'i sgo nas stsol ba kho na dang / 'chad tshul yang / blo chen rnams la zab rgya che/ /blo chung bzung bde go sla ba/ /de las ldog na mkhas rmongs kyi/ /slob ma dga' ba bskyed mi nus/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdo sngags gang 'chad kyang / gdul bya rang gi khams dang / bsam pa dang / bag la nyal gyi rim pa dang mthun par ston par mdzad cing / khyad par gsang sngags zab mo'i chos tshul rnams ni/ nyams su blangs pa'i mtha'/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtha'/ mtha' gcig chad dam snyam/ grub pa'i mtha' ste mtha' bzhi'i bdag nyid can dang /

dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa nyams pa/ gdams ngag gi sarga ma log pa/ mos gus kyi bsam pa tshim pa ste snyan brgyud bzhi sogs kyi sgo nas go rim ma 'chol bar bkri bar mdzad la/ thugs kyi lhag bsam yang dbyig gnyen gyis/ chos sbyin nyon mongs can min pas/ /mdo sogs ji bzhin yang dag ston/ /zhes dang / bslab btus las/ chos dang sbyin pa zang zing med/ /bsod nams 'phel ba'i rgyu yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rnyed pa dang grags pa bsgrub pa'i kun slong rnams rgyang ring du spangs te/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don kho na la dgongs nas gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi lugs gnyis kyi mdzad 'phrin rgya che zhing grangs mang ba nas/ rgyun du sku dal bar bzhugs pa'i skabs mi srid cing / lhag par bla ma gong ma'i dus dran gyi sgrub mchod dang gsung chos thug pa'i skabs/ nyin reng po gsung chog gi dbang du song nas/ chos thun gang dgos mtshan la stsal te/ sku ngal dub kyi tshogs khyad du gsod par mdzad pa ni/ sku 'khor ba sogs phyogs 'di'i skye bo kun gyi mkhyen mtshor gsal ba ltar ro/ /de mthun gsang sngags kyi zab chos bka' nub pa rnams la thugs kyis phangs sems chen po dang / chad du nye ba dag kyang rgyun chad dogs mi bzod pa lta bu mdzad cing / zhal nas kyang / chos 'di dang 'di'i bka' nub pa de phangs po rang yin 'dug da dung dbang dang rgyud bshad sogs rgya che ba'i rigs rnams rgyun ma nyams tsam byung na snyam spel gang thub byed bsam yang / dus dbang gis rgyun ring ma byung dogs pa ka yong gi snang zhes yang yang gsung ba thos la/ de ltar mdo rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa'i zab chos gang 'chad kyang sla bcos dang / mi 'os pa'i rigs 'dre/ rung mthun dang / rang bzo sogs kyi dri ma mtha' dag dang bral ba/ rang rang la skabs su babs pa'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa sbyar 'os pa rnams ma lus shing /

mi 'os pa cung zad kyang ma lhag par chos de dang de'i brgyud pa'i rtsa ba 'di nas brgyud/ rten gzhi'i rgyud 'di yin/ rgya gzhung dang bod gzhung 'di snyed cig mchis pas/ de rnams bab bsgrigs nas bla mas kyang bshad/ slob mas kyang don gnyer chen po'i sgo nas mnyan te chos kyi bab go bar byas na 'chad nyan rnal ma zhig 'ong ba yin gsungs shing / de bzhin phyag len la thebs par mdzad pa yin no/ /yang rtsod pa'i sgo nas bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ spyir rtsod pa la 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mkhas mjug las/ 'chad pa'i skabs kyi rtsod pa dang / /rtsod pa'i skabs kyi rtsod pa gnyis/ /gsungs pa'i phyi ma'i dbang du mdzad nas/ /'bel ba'i gtam la sbyor dngos rjes/ /zhes sbyor dngos rjes gsum du bshad cing / sbyor ba rtsod pa'i lam sbyangs phyir/ /rgol ba gnyis dang dpang po dag /nges par byas nas rtsod pa 'jug /ces sbyor ba'i skabs su rgol phyir rgol dpang po gsum tshogs pa dang / rgol ba gnyis po rang rang gi grub mtha' bzung nas rtsod pa ni/ sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyi lugs/ /zhes dngos gzhi'i tshe rang rang gi grub pa'i mtha' nges par bzung ste/ sgrub byed dang / sun 'byin brjod pa dang / dpang pos rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ /rtsod pa'i ngag rnams bsdus te bsgrags/ /zhes mjug gi tshe dpang pos rgol phyir rgol gnyis so so'i ngag rnams bsdus te brjod pa sogs gsungs te/ tshul de lta bu'i rtsod pa ni/ sngon gyi dus su rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du shin tu mang ba byung yang / bod 'dir ni bstan pa snga dar gyi skabs rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku ring la/ blon po ka ma la shī la dang rgya nag dge slong brtsad pa dang / bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta dang 'phrog byed dga' bo rtsod pa mdzad pa'i tshul sogs 'ga' shas las dus phyis de rigs mang po ma byung snang ba bzhin/

rje 'dis kyang tshul de lta bu lhur bzhes dgos pa ma shar la/ rtsod pa dang po 'chad pa'i skabs kyi rtsod pa la ni/ rgol phyir rgol dpang po gsum gyi rnam gzhag dngos su dgos pa'i nges pa mi snang zhing / 'di'i ngos 'dzin yang / mkhas pa rnams kyi bstan bcos sogs su brgal lan gyi rnam gzhag gsungs pa rnams dang / de bzhin du slob dpon gyis slob ma la gzhung 'chad pa'i tshe/ rtogs dka' ba rnams brgal ba dang lan gyi sgo nas zhib tu 'chad pa'i brgal ba sogs la bshad pa yin pas/ des na dam pa 'dis 'chad pa'i skabs kyi rtsod pa'i sgo nas bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ rje 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa'i kye rdor rnam bshad chen mor/ kye rdor yab kyi mngon rtogs tshul bco lnga ngos 'dzin tshul mi 'dra ba sna tshogs snang ba la/ mi 'thad pa'i cha rnams dpyis phyin par bkag nas/ rang lugs rje btsun chen po'i dgongs pa dang mthun par bstan pa sogs de nyid kyi dbu zhabs bar gsum na brgal lan gyi rnam gzhag mang du 'god par mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang kye rdor rtsa rgyud kyi tshig 'grel chen mo/ rtsa ltung rnam bshad/ ngor rdzong grub mtha'i rnam 'byed/ gsung ngag chos 'byung chen mo/ 'jigs byed chos 'byung sogs 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos mang por rtsod pa'i tshul mang du gsungs pa rnams las rjes su dpag ste/ sngags 'chang bla ma 'di nyid dngos stobs kyi rigs pa smra ba la yang thugs kyi spobs pa thogs pa med pa'i rigs pa'i dbang phyug tu nges pa rnyed par 'gyur ba gdon mi za'o/ /de ltar rtsod pa'i sgo nas bstan pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che la byi dor legs par bgyis te/ phan pa dang bde ba'i dus ston zla med pa 'jo bar mdzad nas/ mkhas pas mdzad pa'i srol lam gsum pa rtsom pa nyin mor byed pa'i 'od 'phreng gis bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas par mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ tshig rgyan gyi bstan bcos me long las/

snyan ngag dam pa'i rgyan ldan ni/ /bskal pa'i bar du gnas par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rtsom pa po tshad ldan gyis bskrun pa'i bstan bcos rnams ni/ ma 'ongs pa ji srid bstan pa gnas kyi bar de srid du rgyun ma nyams par gnas pas bstan pa yun ring du mi nub pa'i rgyu dang / mkhas pas yan lag sbyar ba yi/ /ngag dang ngag gi 'dod 'jor bshad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bla ma dang rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan brjod pa dang / rgyal ba'i bka' dri ma med pa dag gi dgongs don gsal ba'i phyir dgos sogs chos lnga ldan las brtsams te/ 'phags yul gyi gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rnams la grags pa ltar/ sdeb sbyor gyi gtsug lag dang mthun par brtsams na/ rtsom pa kho na la brten nas lhag pa'i lhas zhal ston pa dang / chos kyi gnas lugs mngon sum du mthong ba la sogs pa rang don phun sum tshogs pa 'grub cing / don du gnyer ba gzhan dag yul mchog la ma dad pa dad pa dang / dad pa rnams phyir zhing 'phel bar 'gyur ba mdo rgyud bstan bcos dang bcas pa'i don bde blag tu rtogs nas/ gzhan la yang tshul bzhin du ston nus pa'i spobs pa dge ba sogs gzhan don 'bad med du 'byung ba'i 'dod 'jor yang bshad cing / yang sdom gsum rab dbye las/ mkhas rnams dga' ba'i sdeb sbyor ni/ /blun po rnams kyis go dka' bas/ /tshig gi sbyor ba spangs nas kyang / /kun gyis go bar bya phyir bshad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sgra dang / sdeb sbyor dang / snyan ngag dang / ming gi mngon brjod/ tshig gi rgyan la sogs pa rnams ni/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i skye bo dag gi 'jug ngogs yin kyang / de las gzhan don gnyer blo dman pa dag la phan pa'i rngo mi thogs pas/ mkhas grub thun mong ba'i blo gros kyi dpyad byar 'os pa'i chos ni/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir phan yon gyi sgos gzhan las khyad par du 'phags par 'khums la/

de ltar na bstan pa rin po che rgyun ring du chags pa'i slad dang / don gnyer yongs la phan pa'i thugs bskyed zla med pas nye bar drangs te/ legs par brtsams pa'i bstan bcos tshig don 'brel chags shing / kun gyi blo yul du 'jabs par 'char ba'i rtsom pa ni/ thub pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i rgyu tshogs zla med pa ste/ de lta bu'i phan 'bras phul du byung ba thams cad kyang / bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa 'di'i rmad du byung ba'i lhag bsam dang / dri ma med pa'i mkhyen rab zung gi chu gter chen pos nye bar bskrun pa'i legs bshad phan bde pad+mo'i gnyen du gyur pa 'di dag la legs par gnas te/ de yang bstan bcos gang dang ci mdzad kyang thog mar mchod yul khyad par can la mchod brjod dang / mjug tu bka' drin rjes dran gyi 'dud pa'i tshul du mchod yul gang yin de'i yon tan brjod phul che zhing / tha snyad kyi gtsug lag dang mthun pa'i sdebs legs tshig gi 'phreng ba mtshar du dngar mdzad pa ste/ dper brjod na/ nyid kyi gsan yig zab rgyas chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed kyi sarga dang po'i mjug tu/ de wā su ra mu ku ṭaṃ gi ri a gra/ pā da ra dza su r+ya a da r+sha dza ba/ hi ta su khaḥ ra smi a k+ṣaṃ ha sa shrīḥ si d+dhi shwa ra pu n+ye i n+d+ra na maḥ lha dang lha min gtsug rgyan sa 'dzin rtser/ /zhabs rdul nyi ma'i me long ngal 'tsho ba/ /phan bde'i 'od zer 'bum phrag bzhad pa'i dpal/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug bsod nams dbang por 'dud/ /ces dang / de bzhin du sarga thams cad kyi dbur bla ma de dang de la phyag 'tshal ba dang / zhabs su yang gus 'dud kyi tshigs bcad skad gnyis zung ldan du sbyar nas gsungs pa rnams kyis mtshon nus pas na/ phal cher ni mkhas pa la 'os pa'i legs bshad kyi dga' ston 'ba' zhig tu snang zhing / yang dam pa'i chos don du gnyer yang / rang stobs kyis ji lta ba bzhin ma rtogs pa'i blo dman pa dag la thugs brtse ba'i phan pa kho na lhur mdzad pa'i gsung rab kyi tshogs kyang mang du snang ba ste/

de bas na mkhas pa dang / cig shos kyi skye bo thams cad la 'phral yun gyi mngon par 'dod pa'i don bde blag nyid du ster ba'i gsung rtsom ji ltar mdzad pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs kyang cha tsam brjod na/ 'di la mdo sngags thun mong ba'i skor/ thun mong ma yin pa bye brag pa'i skor/ zhar byung tha snyad rig gnas dang thor bu ba'i skor gsum las/ dang po la/ bstod tshogs dang / gsung mgur zhal gdams sogs kyi skor/ gsan yig dang rnam thar sogs kyi skor gnyis kyi/ dang po bstod tshogs la/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams la bstod pa pad+ma rā ga'i 'phreng ba/ 'di skabs lngar bcad pa'i don bzang zhing tshig sdebs legs pa zhig snang la/ gzhan yang gong bstod tshan pa gsum/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug la bstod pa gnyis/ sa chen la bstod pa mtshan spel shin tu legs pa gcig rje btsun la gsol 'debs skad gnyis sbyar ba/ sa paṇa la bstod pa dngos grub mchog stsol 'dod don kun 'grub 'di gsung rtsom rnams kyi thog ma yin/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched la so sor gsol 'debs kyi tshigs bcad tshan pa lnga lnga/ rje mus chen la gsol 'debs kyi tshigs bcad tshan pa bcu phrag gcig dang / brtan bzhugs bsam don kun 'grub/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la thun mong du gsol 'debs tshan pa gnyis/ grub mchog mthu stobs dbang phyug spyan snga rin po che/ nags dgon pa chen po/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags rnams la gsol 'debs tshigs bcad gsum re/ bdag bstod skul byed dga' bskyed dang / brtan bzhugs tshan pa gsum/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po la bstod pa gnyis/ 'phel gdung la gsol 'debs/ rgyan drug mchod gnyis la so so'i rnam thar bzhin bstod pa sarga bzhi pa dang / ngor chen rdo rje 'chang dang kun mkhyen chen po la bstod pa re re/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho la gsol 'debs gnyis/

rgyal sras thogs med la gsol 'debs/ skyid grong jo bo la gsol 'debs/ slob dpon pad+ma dang gnas brtan bcu drug la bstod pa re re/ 'bar rwa lugs kyi tshe khrid kyi brgyud 'debs/ lam zab brgyud 'debs/ phur pa'i brgyud 'debs kha skong sogs brgyud 'debs mang po'i kha skong gi tshigs bcad tshan pa du ma/ 'jam dbyangs/ dbyangs can ma/ dmar po skor gsum la bstod pa tshan pa re re/ thub bstan lha chen gyi mchod rol la bsngags pa dang / der bla re dang rnga chen phul ba'i tshigs bcad/ lha sa'i jo bo sogs rten mang po la snyan shal mdzes byed phul ba'i tshigs bcad mang po/ rgyal yum dam pa'i ched du mdzad pa'i smon lam sogs bshags smon gyi tshigs bcad du ma dang / gzhan yang gsung ngag bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar gsol 'debs la sogs pa shin tu grangs mang ba zhig mdzad cing / gsung mgur gyi skor la/ legs bshad yid kyi gdung sel/ nyams dbyangs mthong ba don ldan sogs tshig don bzang zhing legs la sems thog tu 'bab pa'i tshigs bcad tshan pa bcu phrag lnga lhag tsam dang / dge sbyor gsal 'debs kyi yi ge gnyis/ zhal gdams dang gsung 'phrin gyi skor la/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags la zhu yig bdag po mthu stobs drung la gnang ba'i bka' shog sogs bla ma dang mi chen mang po la gnang ba'i bka'i 'phrin yig du ma/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas par gdams yig karma 'jigs bral rdo rje la gdams yig sogs zhal gdams kyi tshigs su bcad pa mang po dang / gnyis pa gsan yig dang rnam thar sogs kyi skor la/ rje nyid kyi gsan yig zab rgyas chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed/ sa skya pa'i gdung rabs byon tshul ngo mtshar rin po che'i bang mdzod dgos 'dod kun 'byung / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po dang / 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i rnam thar rgyas 'bring gnyis gnyis/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyi rnam thar byin rlabs char 'bebs/

sngags 'chang yab sras gsum ga'i rnam thar bsdus pa/ kun mkhyen chen po/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ rgyal tshab dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar/ rje mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum rnams mdzad la/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa bye brag pa'i skor la/ mdo lugs gtso che ba dang / rdo rje theg pa gtso che ba'i skor gnyis las/ dang po la/ dge bsnyen/ dge tshul sgrub tshul gyi yi ge gaṇ+ḍi'i rnam gzhag bka' gdams kyi chos 'byung gnyis/ bka' gdams lha bzhi'i khrid yig thig le bcu drug gi dbang tshom/ gcod khrid nyams su blang tshul/ ston pas cho 'phrul bstan tshul sogs dang / gzhan yang bde ba can gyi zhing la bsngags pa dang / zhing de'i smon lam phan yon gyi lung sbyor sogs 'di skor gyi yig 'phreng mang po/ sman bla mchod chog gi rnam bshad/ dpag bsam 'khri shing gi don 'grel/ mdo sngags thun mong ba'i stong thun bstan pa rgya mtsho'i sgo 'byed rnams so/ /gnyis pa rdo rje theg pa gtso bor gyur pa la/ gsang sngags gsar rnying gnyis kyi/ dang po la rnying ma'i spyi rnam dang / phur pa yang gsang byung tshul/ rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad dang / gtor bzlog dgra bgegs kun 'joms kyi rnam bshad/ phur pa'i dbyangs rol brjed tho dang / 'cham dpe snang ba 'gyur thub kyi bsdus don sogs 'di skor gyi phyag len phra mo'i yig sna du ma dang / gnyis pa gsar ma'i skor la/ rgyud sde 'og ma dang bla med kyi skor gnyis/ dang po la tshe chog 'chi med dpal ster/ tshe mdo'i rnam bshad/ tshe sgrub bdud las rnam rgyal sogs tshe sgrub pa'i nyams len gyi yi ge du ma/ yo ga'i skor la/ kun rig gi bsnyen pa dang sbyin sreg bya tshul/ sbyong rgyud kyi don 'grel/ yo ga'i chos 'byung chen mo/ rab gnas cho ga don gnyis lhun grub/

rab gnas rnam bshad bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed la sogs pa mang du bzhugs shing / gnyis pa bla med kyi skor la/ pha rgyud/ ma rgyud/ gnyis med skor gsum gyi dang po la gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos 'byung / gsang 'dus sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud kyi rnam bshad sogs gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor gyi yig sna mtha' yas shing / ma rgyud gshin rje gshed skor la/ 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs bsdus pa gtor chog dang bcas pa/ 'jigs byed sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad/ yang gsang mthu bzlog nag po nyams su len tshul/ gshed dmar sgrub thabs dang / spros med brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ gshin rje gshed skor gyi chos 'byung sogs mang po dang / gnyis pa ma rgyud kyi skor la/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i sgrub thabs/ lū nag dril gsum gyi sgrub thabs rnam bshad/ bde mchog chos 'byung / rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub tshul dang / sbyin sreg gi yi ge rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab sgom tshul la sogs pa 'di nyid kyi man ngag zab mo'i yi ge du ma dang / bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi khog phub bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed la sogs pa bde mchog skor gyi yig sna bsam gyis mi khyab cing / gsum pa gnyis med kyi skor la/ rgya che ba dang zab pa gnyis med gnyis kyi dang po la/ dus 'khor bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/ dus 'khor chos 'byung chen mo/ dus 'khor bstan rtsis kyi yi ge sogs dang / gnyis pa zab pa gnyis med kyi skor la/ rgyud man ngag thun mong ba'i skor dang gsum las/ dang po la kye rdor chos skor 'chad pa'i sngon 'gro'i spyi bshad/ brtag gnyis kyi don 'grel khog phub rgyud 'grel sgo brgya'i lde mig dang / tshig 'grel rgyud bshad bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ tshul gsum gsal rgyan dang ljon shing mdzes rgyan gnyis kyi don 'grel khog phub/

rgyud gnyis ga'i bshad bka' zin bris/ bdag med bstod pa rin chen 'phreng ba'i don 'grel dang mchan bshad/ gnyis pa man ngag gi skor la/ kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi chos skor la slob tshul/ gsung ngag chos 'byung rgyas bsdus gnyis/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi don 'grel/ khrid yig mdzes rgyan gnyis kyi sa bcad/ rje mus chen gyi dris lan/ 'khrul 'khor gyi yi ge rlung gi rnam bshad/ lam zab nang ma bya tshul/ rtsa sngags rnam bshad/ lam sbas bshad kyi khrid yig brda don gsal ba/ brda' chig brgyud/ mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang / sgrub pa lung sbyin rnams kyi phyag len yi ge lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi khrid yig bdag med ma'i sgrub dkyil/ dbang gi mtshams sbyor/ kye rdor rnam bshad zin bris/ rdo rje lus kyi sbas bshad/ kye rdor yab yum gnyis ka'i bskyed rim rnam bshad chen mo sogs 'di skor gyi yig sna mtha' yas shing / thun mong ba'i skor la/ ngor rdzong grub mtha'i rnam 'byed/ chos skyong gi skor la/ drug cu pa'i dris lan/ chos skyong skor gyi chos 'byung chen mo sogs dang / gzhan yang rjes gnang dang / sbyin sreg gi yi ge bskang ba/ bstod pa/ 'phrin las 'chol ba/ drag bskul gyi yi ge la sogs pa chos skyong skor gyi yig rigs shin tu mang ba zhig bzhugs la/ gsum pa de dag la thun mong du dgos pa'i chos skor la/ bla ma lnga bcu pa'i rnam bshad/ bdud rtsi ril bu sgrub tshul gyi yi ge rdor dril/ bgrang 'phreng / dgang blugs/ bum pa rnams kyi rnam bshad/ za ba'i dam tshig gi rnam bshad/ rtsa ltung 'khrul spong gi rnam bshad/ yul chen gyi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus/ sdom gsum bsdus don/ gzhal yas khang gi rnam bshad la sogs pa du ma snang la/ gnyis pa zhar byung tha snyad rig gnas dang thor bu'i skor la/ brda gsar rnying gi shan 'byed/ legs sbyar klog tshul/ dag yig rgyas bsdus gnyis/ don rgyan dang /

sgra rgyan gyi dper brjod rnams mdzad cing / thor bu ba la/ kye rdor lam dus/ lam zab/ bir bsrung / rnal 'byor ma sogs kyi gnad bsdus yi ge sogs du ma dang / gzhan yang bde mchog nag po pa/ dkar po/ sgrol dkar sogs mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ster ba'i lha du ma'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa mang po dang / gdon sgrol gyi cho ga chab gtor klu gtor gyi yi ge gzhan yang dris lan dang / dkar chag gi yi ge la sogs pa thor bu bgrang bar mi bzod pa zhig mdzad de/ 'di dag ni rags pa tsam bkod pa yin gyi/ zhib par bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid kyi dgung lo lnga bcu nga gsum yan chad kyi gsung 'bum rnams bdag cag gis dkar chag tu bris pa las rtogs par bya'o/ /de ltar 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa rin po che ches cher gsal bar mdzad pa la skad cig kyang g.yel ba med pa'i ring nas bla ma gong ma so so'i dus mchod du rgyud sde dri ma med pa nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub ste mchod pa'i chog rigs sngar yod dang gsar bskrun du ma/ bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin spyi sger gyi rkyen sel du dmigs pa'i gtor bzlog la sogs pa gong ma'i phyag srol rma med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / gtsug lag khang so so'i nyams gso/ gsar bzhengs sogs bstan pa rin po che 'phel rgyas kyi thabs las gzhan du nam yang mi g.yo bar phyag bzhes su btab pas/ lugs gnyis kyi mnga' thang thams cad dbyar mtsho dang bsil zer byed pa yar ngo'i 'phel ba ltar gyur pa 'di lags te/ sgrub mchod gsar bskrun gyi rigs kyang / rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor/ mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod de/ 'di dag gi sgrub thabs dang dkyil chog kyang rje nyid kyis gsar rtsom dang bcas sgrub par mdzad cing /

gzhan yang rje nyid la thugs dam skyabs 'jug zhu ba'i phyir spyan dmigs rten phul ba'i tshe 'das rnams dang / gdan sa chen po'i 'dzin skyong gi phyir sems can rkyen lam du 'gro ba mang du snang ba rnams kyi ched dang / khyad par nyid kyi rgyal yum dam pa lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su gtad pa'i ngan song sbyong rgyud nas bshad pa'i bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad ras bris kyi sgrub mchod dang / gzhan yang sa skya pa'i yab chos thun mong ma yin pa chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ hor gyi mi bdag go dan mi zad pa'i nad kyi duḥkha ba las bskyabs par mdzad pa'i phyag bzhes rmad du byung ba 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i gdon sgrol gyi chog rgyun sogs gsar du spel bar mdzad pa mtha' yas la/ sngar rgyun gyi bde kye gsang gsum phur pa sogs kyi sgrub mchod rnams la yang tshig rigs phan tshun 'dres pa sogs phyag len 'dra min cung zad snang ba dag sgrub dkyil gyi yi ge so so'i dgongs pa bzhin ma 'dres par shin tu dag par mdzad de/ dper mtshon na sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i dkyil chog gi sta gon gyi skabs/ yi ge pas ma dag pa rgyun 'byams su song ba zhig yod pa de yang / rdo rje 'chang gi dkyil chog ye shes rgya mtsho dang mthun par bsgyur te cho ga 'khrul med gyi legs byas bstar ba 'dis mtshon cing / gzhan yang slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i zhal dngos kyi bdud rtsi thob pa sad mi mi bdun gyi nang nas mkhyen rab mchog tu yangs pa 'khon klu dbang bsrung ba dang / rigs sngags kyi nus mthu mthar son pa rdo rje rin chen nas brtsams/ 'khon ston rim par byon pa rnams rdo rje phur pa la nyams bzhes gtso bor mdzad pas lha'i gnang ba thob cing / byin rlabs kyi nus mthu mthar phyin pa kho na byung ba dang / gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po nas gong ma rim par byon pa rnams kyang gsang sngags gsar 'gyur la thugs dad cing bshad sgrub gtso bor mdzad kyang /

rdo rje phur pa la yi dam gyi lha dang / dkar bdud lcam dral la bka' bsrung du mdzad pa sha stag byon cing / khyad par 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' bkra shis/ grub pa'i dbang phyug rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa dam pa mang pos thugs gces spras chen po'i sgo nas rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod shin tu dar rgyas su mdzad pa'i rgyun de nyid/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis dkyil chog yid 'ong blo gros kha 'byed/ dbang gi mtshams sbyor blo gsal dga' ba skyed byed/ drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang gi yi ge blo dman dga' ba skyed byed/ 'cham dpe snang ba 'gyur thub sogs phyag len gsal byed kyi yig rigs kyang mang du mdzad nas lugs 'di'i bstan pa thabs 'phrul sna tshogs pas 'phel rgyas su mdzad pa dang / de bzhin du 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo bsod nams dbang po dang / rgyal sras sbas pa'i sangs rgyas grags pa'i mtshan can mched kyis kyang / rdo rje phur pa'i dbyangs yig tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi nga ro/ chos skyong gi bskang bstod kyi dbyangs yig gnyis ka'i thun mong ba'i rol yig dang bcas pa gsar du bskrun nas sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i phyag bzhes nyams med du mdzad pa sogs gzigs pa dri ma med pa'i spyan ldan mang pos mdzad pa'i rgyun lam bzang bsrong ba dang / dgongs pa'i dbyings bzang po bskang ba'i slad du bdag nyid chen po 'dis kyang / rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad 'phrin las kyi pad+mo rab tu rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ smad las bzlog gzhung gi rnam bshad bdud sde 'joms pa'i me chen 'phrin las kyi 'od zer kun tu 'phro ba zhes bya ba mdzad de/ lugs 'di'i lam gyi srog bzung zhing lung bshad kyi bka' drin yang stsal/

'cham dpe snang ba 'gyur thub kyi bsdus don 'phrin las kun khyab sogs phyag len gyi yig sna yang mang du mdzad cing / khyad par dbyangs rol gyi rnam gzhag rnams rgyas par ston pa'i bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa'i rol mo'i bstan bcos nyid la/ sngon chad sus kyang 'grel pa med pa la/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis/ mkhyen rab gzhan las phul du byung ba'i snga rabs mkhas pa'i blo ngor ma shar ba'i legs par bshad pa rig pa'i gnas lnga las bzo rig pa'i bye brag rol mo'i bstan bcos kyi rnam par bshad pa 'jam dbyangs bla ma dgyes pa'i snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs blo gsal yid 'phrog 'phrin las yongs khyab ces bya ba mdzad de/ lugs 'di'i phyag len nyams su bstar ba rnams la dri ma med pa'i khungs dang 'brel zhing / rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam du 'gyur tshul sogs kyi rnam dbye zhib cing rgyas par bstan te/ sngon med kyi legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston bla na med pa stsol bar mdzad pa yin te/ bstan bcos de nyid kyi sbyar byang tshigs bcad las kyang / 'dir smras pa/ sa gsum snang byed mkhyen rab 'od zer gyis/ /skya seng bu ltar gzhan sde kun 'joms pa'i/ /ma rig las 'khon 'od gsal lha yi rigs/ /nges don 'jam dbyangs brgyud par bcas la 'dud/ /rig gnas kun mkhyen mkhyen bzang paṇ+ḍi ta/ /skyon med khrims gnas gnas brtan btsun pa'i mchog /'chad rtsod rtsom mkhas mkhas mang gtsug gi rgyan/ /gang gis legs gsungs gsung rab dri med kyi/ /rnam bshad 'di ni dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /shākya'i dge bsnyen sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin/ /ngag dbang kun bsod grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po'i ming can gang des legs par sbyar/ /kun mkhyen gnyis pa sa skya paṇa chen gyi/ /gsung rab ngo mtshar rol mo'i bstan bcos 'di/ /mgon po de nyid slob ma'i tshogs dang bcas/ /zhing 'dir bzhugs dus 'gro la rab grags mod/

/de dag 'das rjes rol mo'i bstan bcos kyang / /lhan cig mi mngon dbyings su bzhugs pa ltar/ /bstan bcos 'di yi mtshan tsam 'dzin pa yang / /re re tsam las gzhung don rtogs pa su/ /de phyir 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /skal bzang kho bo'i zab yangs blo gros las/ /legs par byung ba'i sngon med legs bshad 'di/ /deng dus dpyod ldan yod na blang bar rigs/ /tshig 'phreng bstar la brgyus pa'i rtog ge ba/ /rang gis ma rtogs gzhan la'ang mi 'dri bar/ /gong ma'i gsung la dogs slong ltar byas nas/ /skyon brjod byed pa'i tshul dang 'di mi 'dra/ /phyogs 'dzin dug chus shes rgyud bslad pa dang / /na tshod rgan pas bzang por rlom pa dang / /phyogs re shes pas kun la khyad gsod sogs/ /skal ngan blun po rnams la 'di mi mkho/ /'khrul zad sa skya'i rje btsun phyag len mchog /rig pa'i gnas chen lnga las bzo rig gi /nang tshan dbyangs rol rnam gzhag tshul bzhin du/ /shes 'dod skal bzang rnams kyis 'di longs shig /ces gsungs pa yin la/ de ltar rdo rje phur pa dang chos skyong skor gyi dbyangs rol gar 'cham sogs cho ga'i cha lag phra mo tshun chad la thugs byang chub pa'i rtser son pa'i stobs dang / de dag gi rgyun mi nyams pa'i phyir gsung chog gi phyag phyi zhu mi/ ban gtsang ba sogs la dbyangs rol gar 'cham sogs rje nyid kyis mdzub khrid kyi tshul du yang yang ston par mdzad pas/ phur pa'i sgrub mchod sogs dang / gzhan yang bde kye gsang gsum/ yo ga bya spyod dang bcas pa'i chog bsgrigs kyi rigs gang la yang da lta rang grwa bzang bar yongs su grags shing / tha na rol mo sbug sil bskul mkhan rnams kyang / deng sang gi bskul mkhan rnams mkhas par brten/ gas chag gi skyon 'byung ba yang nyung ba nas/ bgres po 'ga' zhig snga mor rol mo bzang ba mang po chag pa byung yang / da lta gtan mi 'byung ba 'di bzhin gtso bor gong ma'i sku bsod kyi dpal yon los yin/

de steng du rje nyid kyis rol mo 'khrol lugs kyi gnad phra mo kun kyang / pha mas bu tsha la slob pa ltar/ dge 'dun don gnyer rnams la re re nas phyag khrid nan tan gnang ba'i bka' drin la brten/ rol mo 'khrol mkhan rnams kyis kyang 'khrol mkhas pa'i phan yon du snang bas a re mtshar/ zhes gleng ba yang thos la/ mdor na rdo rje phur pa'i dbyangs rol gar 'cham/ chos skyong gi bskang bstod/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod gzhan sogs phal cher la byang 'dren yang rje nyid kyis mdzad de/ cho ga'i rigs thams cad kyi zhal 'don tshun rkang bzhes kho nas rnam par dag pa bskrun par mdzad pa ni/ da lta'i skye bo phal cher la mngon du gyur pa nyid do/ /de bas na mdzad pa'i 'phrin las phra mo 'di tsam gyis kyang / dam pa 'di nyid deng sang gi rdo rje slob dpon chen por grags pa yongs las rmad du byung mod/ 'on kyang bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan ji snyed pa la dpags na byis pa mtshar bskyed du zad do/ /de lta bu'i yang dag pa'i legs byas kyi mthu dang / rje nyid da lta'i skabs kha drag dang phyogs zhen gyis ma bslad pa'i gzur gnas dad 'dun can mtha' dag gi skyabs mgon gcig pu bar gyur pa nyid kyis/ phyogs phyogs kyi chos dang 'jig rten gyi gtso bor gyur pa la sogs pa'i skye bo kun kyang bdag nyid chen po'i zhal dkyil blta ba dang / rten gsum khyad par can rnams rnyed pa dang bkur bsti mtha' yas pas mchod pas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po gsog pa'i slad du rdzogs ldan gyi sprin bzhin du 'dus te/ rang rang gi dpal 'byor las grub pa'i longs spyod kyi dngos po bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ bla ma'i sku brnyan byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma can dang / glegs bam sogs gus pas bstob par byed cing / thams cad la chos dang zang zing gi bka' drin zla med pas skyid pa'i phan bde'i 'bras bu yongs su rgyas par mdzad la/

rnyed pa'i dngos rdzas rnams kyang 'ga' zhig ni/ dkon mchog gi rten bzhengs pa dang / bla ma gong ma'i dus mchod sogs kyi gzhi rten dang / phal cher ni dge 'dun gyi zhabs tog dang / lan dang rnam smin la re ba med pa'i gtong ba'i sgo mtha' yas pas/ sbyin yul mtha' dag pa'i re ba yid bzhin du bskong bar mdzad/ gser dngul dang byu ru/ g.yu sogs dngos po khyad par ba dag las ni/ bla ma dang rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i sku gzugs gdung rten sogs dang / sku rten byin rlabs can dag gi bzhugs khang la sogs pa sgrub pa'i cha rkyen du mdzad de/ de dag so so'i rnam grangs kyang / gdan sa chen po 'di nyid na ngo mtshar ba'i rten gzhi gtso bor gyur pa'i rten gsum bgrang ba las 'das pa bzhugs pa rnams la dkar me'i 'phreng ba/ zhal zas/ snyan shal mdzes byed/ gtsug lag khang gi nang du bla bre/ 'phan/ rol spyad/ ting sogs dang / phyir dril bu/ steng du rgyal mtshan dang / 'gan ji ra sogs mchod pa'i rnam grangs dpag tu med pa dang / mgon khang so sor bskang rgyun gyi dam rdzas/ gtor tshogs ri rab dang mnyam pa/ sna tshogs pa'i spyan gzigs/ steng du ru mtshon chen po grangs mang ba 'bul bar mdzad pa sogs mtha' yas shing / bla ma so so'i dus mchod kyang / rje sa skya pa chen po yab sras/ chos rje khu dbon/ bla ma dam pa/ sa lo chen po/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras/ rje btsun mus pa chen po/ grub mchog mthu stobs dbang phyug sku mched sogs kyi mchod 'bul du dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod/ bla ma mchod chog rgyud 'don rnams bstar chags su gnang ba dang / gzhan yang de dag gi zla dus dang / lo dus thog mang ja gdan bzhes rgya chen po/ bla ma so so'i dus mchod kyi ser 'phreng mchod rdzas/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan/ ba dan/ rten kheb/ phye phur sogs gos dar bzang zhing khog legs pa las gsar du bskrun par mdzad cing /
