phyogs kyi dgon mang por lo ltar gyi mang 'gyed du ma dang / 'di ka'i chos grwa phan tshun du rgya ja'i rnyed bkur dang / zang zing gi dngos 'gyed nar ma/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog lo rer tshar du ma klog pa dang / rnam rgyal gyi gzungs 'bum ther zhal 'don/ zla rer rnam rgyal gyi stong khrus/ gtor ma brgya rtsa lo re'i nang du 'bum ther lhag tsam dang / 'bum yongs rdzogs lan re ma chad par klog pa sogs dkon mchog spyi dang / dge 'dun gyi rnyed bkur gyi grangs bsam brjod las 'das pa dang / skya ser khri phrag tu longs pa la mar nas/ dngos spyad gzhan dang bcas pa'i 'gyed rgya chen po dang / dkon mchog gi rten rnams la dkar me zhal zas/ snyan dar gyi mchod sprin dang bcas pa'i dga' ston gyi sbyin gtong chen po da lta phan la lan grangs drug mdzad la/ rten gsar bzhengs kyi rnam grangs kyang 'jam dbyangs sku mched kyi dngul gyi mchod rten thog tshad dang de nyis 'gyur gyis che ba ci rigs pa ste yongs bsdoms brgyad/ rgyal dbang 'od dpag med kyi sku brnyan du ma/ bla chen sa skya pa'i sku brnyan che ba/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i sku brnyan che chung gnyis rnams dang / gzhan yang lam 'bras brgyud pa'i kha skong du ma gser zangs las grub pa/ rgyal ba mus pa chen po'i sku brnyan dngul gar bu lugs las bskrun pa/ de dag so so la lha dang mi'i rin po che du ma'i phra tshom du bkod pa mthong ba tsam gyis yid 'phrog pa dang / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ rje mus chen/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ rje nyid kyi sku brnyan sogs sman sku byin rlabs kyi rten khyad par can sna tshogs kyis phyur bur gtams pa mang po/ gur mgon lcam dral gyi 'cham sku cha gnyis te/ sman bzang po dang / dar gos sogs kyi 'jim pa las byas pa'i 'bur sku dpag tu med pa bskrun cing /

bris sku'i rigs la gtso bsdus chen mo/ slob dpon pad+ma'i 'khrungs rabs/ rdo rje 'phreng ba sogs gong du bkod pa ltar gyi dkyil thang rnams dang / sngags 'chang chen po'i sngags thang chen mo dang gras mnyam pa'i sngags thang nyer bdun sogs grab gcig du ma dang / gzhan yang dgyes pa rdo rje/ rdo rje phur pa/ rnam rgyal ma/ tshe sbyin dpal mo/ tshe dpag med sogs yi dam gyi lha mang po dang / dmar po skor gsum/ rnam thos sras/ dbyug gu ma mched gsum sogs nor sbyin du ma/ gur lha brgyad/ gnyan mgon dur khrod bdag po/ dkar bdud sogs kyi zhal thang ste bris sku kha 'khyar mang po/ nyid kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gsum dang / sngags 'chang chen po sogs sku brnyan brgya tshar bkod pa'i bris thang / pir 'dzin gyi ri mo mkhan mkhas pas zab bris bgyis pa'i tshad dang mtshan nyid ldan zhing / gos dar gyi gong kheb/ dngul dang tsan+dan ci rigs pa'i bsgril shing gi tog dang bcas pa shin tu ngo mtshar ba bskrun zin pa mtha' yas shing / slad mar yang rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang / bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa/ yi dam gyi lha mang po/ chos skyong nor lha dang bcas pa'i bris 'bur/ dkyil thang la sogs pa dus 'khor yug tu bzo'i rig byed mkhas pa lnga phrag tsam res rtag 'grus su bzhengs bzhin pa 'dir snang la/ gzhan yang jo bo rje'i thugs dam rten thub pa 'od zer 'gyed du grags pa dang lung bstan sgrol ma/ slob dpon pad+ma'i sku tshab gter lnga'i nang tshan bye ma a krong las rang 'khrungs kyi sku brnyan ring bsrel 'byon bzhin pa dang / rgyal ba'i 'phel gdung sil ma'i thum bu rnams la gser zangs las grub pa'i bzhugs khang g.yu dang / byi ru/ mu tig sogs rin po che du ma'i phra tshom rmad du byung bas mdzes par spud pa/ mthong ba tsam gyis yid dbang med du 'phrog cing / lta bas chog mi shes pa re re so sor bskrun par mdzad pa dang /

'jam mgon sa skya paṇa chen gyi zhal dkyil de nyid kyi sdom phrug skyob pa dpal bzang pos bzhengs pa la/ chos rje nyid kyi phyag nas dang / dbu lo bub nang bzhugs su yod pa/ ring bsrel 'phel bzhin pa dang / rje mus pa chen po'i dbu thod dum bu bzhugs pa'i shel gyi mchod rten sogs bla ma'i rten mang po dang / 'phags pa rin po che'i thugs dam rten rdo rje 'jigs byed/ shing mgon/ rdo mgon/ mgon po shel spyan ma/ theg chen rin po che'i thugs dam ma sher shing gi mgon po/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi thugs dam ma zhal bzhi yongs rdzogs kyi sku brnyan sogs yi dam dang / chos skyong gi sku rten byin rlabs can du ma la bzhugs khang gser shog gis legs par brgyan pa re re ste/ tha na rten gyi bzhugs khang dang / bzhugs khri gsar du bskrun pa yang brjod yul las 'das so/ /yang gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs kyi rnam grangs ni/ gong du bkod pa ltar/ li ma lha khang sogs mang po dang / gyang ris mdzad pa'i rnam grangs kyang / bde mchog pho brang steng shod kyi ldebs ris/ rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la rnam rgyal gyi zhal gzigs pa'i gnas shāka bzang rtse'i logs bris/ dbu rtse chen mo'i khyams kyi lho shar gnyis kyi ldebs ris/ lha khang chen mo'i khyams stod dang / khyams smad kyi ldebs ris la sogs pa gtsug lag khang dang gzim khang tha dad du ri mo'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / gzhan yang rgyal ba'i bka' dang / bla ma gong ma'i bka' 'bum/ rgya bod kyi gzhung lugs ji snyed cig dbyar dgun ston dpyid med par yi ge mkhan du ma rgyun ma chad par 'bri ba sogs bstan pa rin po che'i bgyi ba che phran blos dpag par mi nus pa zhig gis dus 'da' bar mdzad pa ni/ da lta'i skye bo phal mo che'i mig dang / yid kyi yul na sgrib med du snang ba 'di lags so/ /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/

mkhyen rab cha shas lang tsho ma smin na/ /chos tshul bdud rtsi'i 'od can bzhin mi mdzes/ /brtse ba'i shing rta 'dren pa'i mthu med na/ /nus pa'i ga bur bsil zer mi zegs na/ /duḥkha'i tsha gdung sel ba'i mthu bral mod/ /gang zhig mkhyen pa'i cha shas nya rgyas pa'i/ /thugs rje'i shing rtas gdul bya'i blo gros mkhar/ /nye bar drangs las chos tshul bdud rtsi'i 'od/ /rab bsil skye dgu'i gdung bcil ri bong can/ /'di ni mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan tshogs/ /ma lus 'dus pa'i dam chos bdud rtsi'i gter/ /de phyir legs bshad tsha ba'i rdul phreng gis/ /rmongs pa'i tshang tshing ma lus sreg na yang / /rnam dpyod pad tshal yangs mor rgyas byed pa/ /gang khyod sngon med bstan pa'i nyin mor byed/ /zab yangs lung rigs rtsod pa'i nga ro yis/ /smra ngan wa skyes snying rtsa 'dar byed kyang / /skal bzang ri dwags bde ba'i dbugs 'byin khyod/ /thub bstan gangs ri mdzes pa'i gdong lnga pa/ /bdud rigs snying la zug rngu'i dug ldan yang / /blo chen blo yi mgul rgyan dri ma med/ /rtsom pa nor bu'i do shal zla med pa/ /ster khyod legs bshad rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas/ /srid skyon 'dam gyis ma gos yon tan dri/ /bsung zhim mngar ba'i yongs 'dzin pad+mo khyod/ /ring na gnas kyang skal ldan bung ba'i tshogs/ /ma bsdus pa yang ngang gis legs 'du na/ /sbyin dang snyan par smra bas bsags rgyab can/ /grangs med bsdu ba'i zol 'di ci zhig gu/ /mthong ba tsam gyis thar pa'i dpal ster na/ /don spyod don mthun chos kyi ngal bas ci/ /ring mo zhig nas mngon sangs rgyas mod kyang / /byang chub ched du rlabs chen tshogs gnyis 'phrul/ /sna tshogs bskrun pa'i zol sbyor rgyal ba yi/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i rol rtsed 'di ngo mtshar/ /rmad byung rnam mang mdzad 'phrin lo 'dab rgod/ /phan bde'i me tog 'bras bu g.yur du za/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rtsa brtan bstan 'gro yi/

/rtsa lag dpag bsam dbang por khyod gcig mtho/ /de lta'i mdzad pa rmad byung bgrang yas la/ /gangs ljongs 'di na 'gran pa'i zla ma dmigs/ /'phags pa'i yul na bstan pa'i sgron me mnal/ /de phyir rang nyid las gzhan dpe zla su// ༈ //spyi don bcu pa phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa rin po che yun du gnas shing mi nyams pa'i phyir/ dri ma med pa'i gdung dang chos sras kyis bsdus pa'i bstan 'dzin ji ltar spel ba'i tshul ni/ de ltar bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi mdzad pa'i rgyun lam rma med pa mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam pa gsum las/ 'chad pa gtso bor gyur pa'i sgo nas bdag nyid chen po 'di'i gsung gi bdud rtsi ngoms par gsol ba dang / bka'i 'grel pa tsam gyis kyang rjes su bzung bas dad pa dang blo gros kyi dbang po rab tu rgyas pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi zhal slob bgrang ba'i yul las 'das pa zhig snang mod kyi/ thams cad zhib tu bgrang bar ga la spobs/ che long tsam zhig brjod na/ deng sang gangs ri can gyi ljongs na 'khod pa'i skye dgu thams cad kyi tshangs pa'i yul sar zhabs kyi rdul 'phreng mngon par bkod nas bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' bdag tu bzhugs pa/ rje btsun dam pa gang gi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gdung sras kyi rnam rol tu mngon par gsal ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rtse gdong nas nyid kyi dbon 'jam pa'i dbyangs byams pa bsod nams lhun grub bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ bdag chen ngag dbang bsod nams lhun grub bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sku mched/ lung rtogs kyi yon tan rin po ches thugs rgyud yongs su gtams shing / khyad par mkhyen rab kyi gzigs pa nam mkha' ltar yangs pas sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i zab don mtha' dag 'dod dgur stsol ba'i dpal yon can mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa dang /

byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems yid bzhin gyi nor bu du mas thugs rgyud phyug pa'i rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal dang grub pa'i dbang po spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar nyid zlos te byon pa zab rgyas chos kyi spyan ldan spyan snga rin po che kun dga' don grub ste phan tshun chos kyi bka' drin rjes su nos pa'i dam pa gnyis/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i zhabs stegs mi 'jigs pa'i khrir zhabs zung mngon par rtsen pa shar pa 'jam dbyangs chen po'i gdung rigs su sku 'khrungs shing 'jam des kyi mdzad 'phrin rma med pas e wam̐ chos ldan gyi chos grwa chen po 'dzin skyong spel ba la mtshungs pa med pa shar pa chos rje shes rab 'byung gnas khu dbon gnyis/ shar kha chos kyi rgyal po'i gdung rigs dri ma med par sku 'khrungs shing / dpal 'khor bde chen gyi chos grwa chen po'i mkhan po/ rim gnyis kyi nyams rtogs rmad du byung ba'i rtser son pa chos kyi rje 'phags pa tshul khrims pa dang / de nyid kyi dbon sde snod rgya mtsho'i klong yangs su 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i phuṭa sgra snyan par sgrog cing / mkhyen rtogs kyi yon tan rin po che rnam dpyod kyi gtsug na spud pa chos kyi rje mi pham bdud 'joms dpa' bo/ brgyud 'dzin blo gros rgyal mtshan sogs dam pa mang pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas dgon gsar bde ba can gyi khrir zhabs zung bkod pa/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i bzhed gzhung gsung ngag lam sogs snyan brgyud zab mo'i nyams bzhes la skad cig kyang mi g.yel zhing / gzhan la yang ji bzhin du 'jo ba la bsnyengs pa dang bral ba rje rin po che ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa/ bzang ldan chos sde'i gdan seng ge'i khrir mngon par rtsen zhing gsung rab mang po'i don la blo gros kyi 'jug pa gsal ba chos kyi rje kun dga' dpal 'bar ba/ 'a zha rgyal brgyud dri ma med par 'khrungs shing grub pa'i khyu mchog dbang phyug rab brtan gyi thugs sras snyan brgyud chos kyi grwa yangs pa bkra shis chos sde'i gdan sa pa mkhyen rab kyi mnga' bdag rje dbon rin po che bsod nams mchog ldan dang /

snyan brgyud zab mo'i gter mdzod glang phu nas chos kyi rje 'jam dbyangs chos skyong bzang po/ dpal ngam ring dga' ldan byams pa gling gi chos grwa chen po'i mkhan po tshul khrims rgyal po dang / de nyid kyi mkhan po da lta tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po sogs sa skya pa'i snyan brgyud kyi bdag po du ma'i gdan sa mdar grang mo che'i khri 'bangs su nye bar bsti zhing sde snod gsum gyi de nyid rigs lam nas 'dren pa dang / snying po'i zab lam 'doms pa la spobs pa dge ba mchog dang ldan pa klu sgrub dar rgyas pa/ e wam̐ chos ldan gyi gdan sa paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang pa'i rje dbon chos rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas pa dang / de nyid kyi dbon po thar rtse'i zur 'chad pa sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub pa dbon po sogs ngor gyi bla rigs mang po/ thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi gdan sa pa dngos stobs kyi rigs pa smra ba'i khyu mchog mkhan rin po che bzod pa rgya mtsho/ sde snod rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son cing dngos stobs kyi rigs pa smra ba la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa kong ston don grub dpal bzang / mdo sngags kyi lus stobs rdzogs shing / brda sprod rig pa'i mche sder rno ba/ snyan tshig gi gad rgyangs snyan par sgrog pa'i smra ba'i seng ge ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rje/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg pa la bslab sbyangs mthar phyin pa bkra shis chos 'phel ba/ gzhung lugs du ma la rnam dpyod kyi 'jug pa gsal zhing zhi dul gyi dpal mnga' ba bsod nams blo gros pa sogs mang po dang / chos grwa de nyid kyi khams pa grwa tshang gi slob dpon drung gnas chos dkar rnam rgyal/ snga ris grwa tshang gi slob dpon bsod nams rgya mtsho dang / bsod nams dar rgyas pa sogs gzhung lugs kyi don la spobs pa dge ba can du ma dang / chos grwa chen po gser mdog can gyi mkhan po yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag lcang 'dam chos rje shākya bstan 'dzin pa dang /

rdo rje lhun grub pa/ yon tan grags pa/ kun dga' bkra shis sogs dang / da lta'i slob dpon rnam gnyis/ brag dmar chos sde'i mkhan po sde snod 'dzin pa chen po 'jam dbyangs phun tshogs/ thub bstan yangs pa can gyi klog pa ba rnams kyi gtsug rgyan smra ba'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs chos bzang pa dang / de'i gdan sa pa sangs rgyas rin chen/ lung dang rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag dkon mchog bzang po/ bsod nams chos 'phel ba sogs mkhan po'i go sar bzhugs pa dang / grwa tshang gnyis kyi slob dpon sangs rgyas bsod nams dang / bsod nams mtha' yas pa sogs yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen bslab pa gsum gyis rgyud phyug cing lung rigs thogs med du 'jo ba kha shas dang / gnyan yod bya gshongs kyi mkhan po skyid gshongs pa chen po blo gros rnam rgyal gyi rje dbon grags pa rnam rgyal gdan sa pa dang bcas pa dang / yo ga chos sdings kyi mkhan po mang thos bstan pa'i 'od zer ba dang / da lta lo phu gdan sar nye bar bsti zhing mdo sngags kyi chos tshul du ma la mkhyen pa'i spyan ras yangs pa 'khyog pa chos kyi rje byams pa rgyal mtshan/ lung rigs kyi ljags rtse bde ba da lta chos grwa de nyid kyi rgyan du gdan chags pa don grub bzang po sogs dang / gzhan yang ngam ring chos sde'i grwa tshang so so'i slob dpon lung rigs la byang ba mang po/ zhe dgon bla ma dkon mchog lhun grub gdan sa pa dang bcas pa/ gling kha bde ba can gyi zur 'chad chos dpal 'byor ba dang / ya ma bde ldan nas/ rdzong dga' ldan gyi gdan sa pa/ da lta gling kha bde ba can gyi zur chos su gdan chags pa dgyes rdor rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa'i zab don smra ba la mtshungs pa med pa'i ngag dbang dpal ldan pa dang / chos kyi rje dkon mchog rin po che pa sogs mkhas grub mang po'i bsti gnas dam pa sle lung chos sde sogs dgon gnas mang po'i 'dzin skyong la mi g.yel zhing /

rig grol gyi yon tan du ma dang ldan pa sle lung mkhan po rje dbon sangs rgyas rab brtan pa dang / bka' pha rol tu phyin pa'i zab bcud ye shes kyi ḍāk+ki lab kyi sgron ma'i zhal gdams bdud rtsi'i ros yid kyi dbang po bde bar myos pas stong nyid phaṭ sgra drag po'i dbyangs kyis 'byung po ma lus pa'i snying dngangs par byed pa'i nyams rtogs can chos rje dgra lha ba dang / gzhan yang ya ma gdan sa pa bsnyen sgrub mthar son gyi rdo rje 'dzin pa chos rgyal mtshan sogs mus nang gi sa lugs su gtogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi chos grwa phan tshun mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan du gyur pa tshangs spyod gtsang ma'i dri bsung phyogs brgyar 'thul zhing / zhi zhing dul ba'i dpal mnga' ba mkhan chen rin chen blo gros/ gzhung lugs du ma'i mkha' dbyings su rtsen zhing mkhyen rab tsha zer 'bar bas rmongs pa'i 'khri shing sreg par byed pa'i bshes gnyen byams pa phun tshogs rin chen/ mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i don la dbang 'byor zhing sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i chab len gyi dre'u rbab tu lhungs te 'das pa de nyid thugs rjes nye bar drangs pa'i dbang las/ bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog gi snang brnyan du shar bas dre'u sku skyer grags pa mkhan rin po che byams pa rin chen rgyal mtshan sogs dang / gzhan yang gdan sa chen po'i rgya tsho dpon dang / chos las pa sogs gzhung lugs rab 'byams la rnam dpyod kyi 'od snang dkar ba rab tu mang po dang / chos 'khor lhun po'i gdan sa pa mang du thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa chos kyi rje tshul khrims grags pa dang / ye shes dpal 'byor/ byams pa rab dga'/ byams pa grags pa/ sangs rgyas shes rab rnams gdan sa pa dang bcas pa dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i nyams bzhes la gcig tu gzhol ba rgyas chos kyi slob dpon mkhas btsun chos rje dang /

sde snod rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son cing tha snyad kyi rig gnas mtha' dag 'chad pa dang rtsom pa la blo gros kyi snang ba thob pa ye shes dpal bzang rgya mtsho ba/ 'gro mgon dam pa sangs rgyas kyi ring lugs dri ma med pa zhi byed kyi gdams pa zab mo 'chad cing nyams su len pa 'od gsal gyi snang ba rab tu 'byams pa kha ba lhas kyi bla ma rin chen chos 'phel ba/ ḍa ḍi ki chos rdzong gi slob dpon rigs sngags 'chang ba tshul khrims bzang po gdan sa pa du ma dang bcas pa/ gangs can gyi khrod 'dir sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pa dpal ldan dwags po bka' brgyud kyi ring lugs rma med pa 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas gsal bar byed po lnga rig mkhas dbang sangs rgyas rdo rje ba/ ras chung snyan brgyud kyi bstan 'dzin dbang phyug gling gi gdan sa ba sogs chos lugs gzhan gyi zhal 'dzin zhing / mkhas pa dang grub pa'i yon tan ci rigs pas mdzes pa'i skyes bu dam pa yang bsam gyis mi khyab cing / rigs ldan pad+ma dkar po'i rnam par sprul pa mi dbang rnam rgyal grags bzang sogs rigs ldan gyi sprul pa rgyun ma chad par byon pa'i rgyal rgyud du 'khrungs shing / lugs gnyis kyi mdzad 'phrin rma med pas bstan pa rin po che spyi dang / khyad par rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa sgo du ma'i sgo nas 'dzin cing skyong ba'i khur gyis mi ngal ba'i chos rgyal chen po nam mkha' tshe dbang phun tshogs dbang gi rgyal po dang / lugs gnyis kyi 'dun sa shel dkar rgyal rtse nas shar kha gdung rigs dgra 'dul rdo rje dang / sku tshe dpag tu med pa nas smon lam bzang pos mtshams sbyar ba'i dbang las sku tshe 'dir sa skya pa'i bstan pa rin po che la srid zhu kho na lhur len cing / khyad par rje nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa chen po'i shugs 'chang ba bdag po bsod nams mthu stobs dbang po'i sde dang /

de'i gcung mi dbang phun sum tshogs pa'i mtshan can/ rigs rus cho 'brang phun sum tshogs shing stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba bsam rtse nas mi dbang karma phun tshogs rnam rgyal dang / de'i sras bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa dang bde ba'i lhag bsam gyi zla ba tshes shing / rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad 'phrin gyi bsil zer 'phro ba'i sa skyong karma bstan skyong dbang po/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsis gzhung rin po che'i bang mdzod la dbang phyug pa'i mkhyen ldan brtse chen mi dbang rnam rgyal rdo rje/ 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo grol mchog zhabs kyi thugs sras lnga rig mkhas dbang smon gro nas dpon drung tshe dbang sogs gtsug lag gnyis ldan gyi sgo nas sa chos bzhin du skyong ba'i mi bdag gi tshogs kyang ches mang ba zhig dang / gzhan yang snga 'gyur bstan pa'i gsal byed grub dbang yul mo ba sogs grub brnyes bcu gsum du skye ba'i zlos gar bsgyur ba'i tshul sngon gnas rjes su dran pa'i yul mo sprul pa'i sku sku mched/ rigs sngags 'chang ba sgrol ma ba dang / slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi thob pa 'bro dkon mchog 'byung gnas kyi rigs kyi thig le 'dzin pa sngags 'chang rig 'dzin 'jigs bral la sogs pa rigs sngags kyi mthu grub pa'i skyes bu'i tshogs kyang mang du snang la/ gzhan yang shrī rdo rje gdan pa chen po kun dga' rnam rgyal dpal bzang po'i ye shes kyi rnam par 'phrul pa las nye bar bskrun pa chos grwa dbu ru rdo rje'i gdan gyi grwa tshang rin chen sgang gi slob dpon mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan mnga' ba gser gling chos rje dang / nam mkha' mdzod pa rnam mkhyen grong pa/ thod dkar ba sogs bla ma slob dpon che bgres du ma/ rwa ba smad kyi slob dpon dkon mchog dpal 'byor/ dwags po grwa tshang gi slob dpon dngos stobs kyi rigs pa smra mkhas blo gros brtan pa/

bsam yas rab byung gi gdan sa pa rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan skyong skyid shag 'phrang gsum du grags pa'i nang gi shag pa rnam rgyal rab brtan pa mkhyen yangs kun dga' bzang po sogs du ma/ bzhad ri skyed tshal gyi slob dpon gzhung lugs du ma la thugs gsal zhing nang don la gzhol ba chos kyi rje rin chen bsod nams la sogs pa dbus 'gyur chos kyi 'dun sar 'khod pa'i bshes gnyen du ma dang / bcom 'da' dgon gyi mkhan po gsung rab rgya mtsho'i don la mkhyen pa gsal ba chos kyi rje dkon mchog chos 'phel ba dang / dgon gnas de nyid kyi zur chos pa byams pa rgyal mtshan pa dang / gzhan yang rgya skabs nor bu gling sogs mdo khams kyi 'gro ba mang po'i 'dren pa du ma/ dpal gyi 'dun sa dar rtse mdo nas sa yam chos rje kun dga' lhun grub pa dang / lcags la bla ma chos rgya mtsho sogs bstan pa la bya ba bgyid nus pa mang po dang / mnga' ris phyogs su thub bstan yangs can gyi slob dpon tsha spo rab 'byams par grags pa'i rje dbon chos rje pa dang / sgo mang mkhan po/ srid gsum gdan sa pa sogs te/ 'di dag ni rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams par gsung gi bdud rtsi rgya cher nos te dad pa'i dbang po mchog tu brtas pas/ rje nyid rigs kyi cod pan dam par bzung nas sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su slob par 'dod pa gtso bor gyur pa dag smos pa yin gyi/ bka'i 'brel pa re tsam gyis kyang 'brel tshad don ldan du byas pa ni bgrang bar ga la spobs/ mdor na lung rtogs kyi yon tan gzhan ma mchis kyang / rje nyid kyi bka' drin 'khor thabs med pa rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas gsol 'debs dang / bka' stsal spyi bo'i cod pan du bsten te/ ji ltar stsal pa las nam du yang mi g.yo zhing / rang 'khos 'tshams par bzhed pa'i don sgrub pa la lhod pa mi za bar rloms pa bdag cag la sogs pas mtha' brgyan pa'i zhal slob nam mkha'i skar phran lta bus stod mnga' ris skor gsum/

bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang drug sogs thams cad yongs su khyab ste/ spyi dang bye brag gi bstan pa rin po che 'phel rgyas su mdzad pa lags so/ /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ yongs 'dzin chos kyi klu dbang du ma yi/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa las/ /zab rgyas dam chos sprin gyi me tog bcud/ /khyod thugs 'dzin mar yang yang babs pa las/ /zag med ye shes bskal pa'i me 'od kyis/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho kun skem yang / /mang thos lung dang ji lta ji snyed kun/ /ji bzhin rtogs pa'i yon tan chu gter 'khyil/ /chos tshul legs bshad 'dzum rlabs 'bum g.yo yang / /dri med ting 'dzin zab klong g.yo ba med/ /skal bzang bung ba sprin bzhin nyer 'du yang / /mkhas grub skye bo'i chu klung phyogs brgyar spro/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde'i me tog ni/ /kun tu smin pa'i legs byas 'di mthong tshe/ /gang sku mtshan dpes rab mdzes zla shel dkyil/ /lha ru mi blta thar 'dod gnyis skyes gang / /gang gsung yid bzhin nor bu'i 'phreng mdzes rnams/ /rnam dpyod mgul ba'i rgyan du mi len su/ /su dag gang thugs dgos 'dod ma lus kun/ /kun tu stsol ba'i nor bur mi 'dzin blun/ /de lta na yang sngon goms ngan pa'i mthus/ /'gro mgon yan lag brgyad ldan chu gter las/ /blo ngan ba tshwa'i khron pa mchog 'dzin pa/ /mang mod 'gro ba'i las mthu btsan pa'i brda/ /de bas blo ldan dad 'dun dpal yon can/ /kun kyang tshur spyon mgon 'di'i zhabs zung nor/ /dbang gi rgyal po gtsug gi rtse mor mchod/ /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus ngang gis 'jo// ༈ //spyi don bcu gcig pa de la brten nas mdzad pa'i 'phrin las lhun gyis grub cing rgyun mi chad pa'i dge mtshan ji ltar mnga' ba'i tshul ni/ de bas na bdag nyid chen po 'dis tshogs pa rgya chen po 'dus pa dag la sa skya pa'i yab chos gsung ngag rin po che'i thog drangs chos tshul ji snyed pa'i bka'i 'khor lo lan gcig ma yin par yang nas yang du bskor bar mdzad pa dang /

rang rang gi blo dang 'tshams pa'i 'dod chos don du gnyer ba grangs mang nyung ci rigs pa rnams la yang ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin/ dbang khrid lung man ngag rjes gnang sogs dus nges med du rgyun ma chad par stsol bar mdzad pas/ nyid kyi rigs dang gsung las 'khrungs pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu'i tshogs dbus gtsang khams gsum thams cad khyab cing / de dag gi slob ma yang slob dang bcas pa rnams kyis bshad sgrub kyi rgyun khyad par can yongs su bskyangs te spel ba'i mthu dang / 'jam mgon bla ma nyid kyi sku'i mchod sdong gzhom med rtag brtan rdo rje'i khri 'phang du ji snyed bskal pa chen po'i bar de srid du g.yo ba med par mngon par rtsen pa'i legs byas las/ srid mtha'i bar du gang gi 'phrin las kyi 'khor lo rma med pa lhun gyis grub cing rgyun mi chad pa ni nges pa ste/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos las/ gdul bya'i khams dang gdul bya'i thabs dang ni/ /gdul bya'i khams kyi gdul bya'i bya ba dang / /de yi yul dang dus su gshegs pa la/ /khyab bdag rtag tu lhun gyis grub par 'jug /ces rgyal ba'i 'phrin las ni 'bad rtsol dang rnam rtog med par lhun gyis grub pa dang / gzhan gyi dbang gis nges 'byung dang / /bdag dang sems can mtshungs gzigs dang / /mdzad pa yongs su ma rdzogs phyir/ /'khor ba ji srid rgyun mi chad/ /ces 'khor ba ji srid kyi bar du rgyun mi chad par gsungs pa dang tshul mtshungs la/ de yang de nyid las/ gang zhig brgya byin rnga dang sprin bzhin dang / /tshangs nyi rin chen yid bzhin nor rgyal bzhin/ /sgra snyan nam mkha' sa bzhin srid pa'i bar/ /'bad med gzhan don byed de rnal 'byor rig /ces dang / rin chen lha dbang snang bzhin ston pa ste/ /legs par 'doms mdzad lha yi rnga dang 'dra/ /khyab bdag mkhyen dang brtse chen sprin tshogs ni/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba srid rtse'i bar du khyab/

/tshangs bzhin zag med gnas las ma bskyod par/ /sprul pa rnam pa du ma rab tu ston/ /nyi bzhin ye shes snang ba rab spro gang / /rnam dag rin chen yid bzhin nor 'dra'i thugs/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi gsung de brag cha bzhin du yi ge med/ /sku ni nam mkha' lta bur khyab dang gzugs med rtag pa nyid/ /sa bzhin 'gro ba'i dkar po'i chos kyi sman rnams ma lus pa'i/ /rnam pa kun tu gzhir gyur pa ni sangs rgyas sa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku'i ngo bo ni bai ḍūr+ya'i sa gzhi dag pa la lha'i dbang po'i sku'i gzugs brnyan snang ba dang / snang ba de yang don yod pa dang mtshungs pa dang / gsung gi ngo bo nyid lha'i rnga bo ches dam pa'i chos legs par 'doms pa dang 'dra zhing / thugs kyi mkhyen pa dang brtse ba ni/ dmyal ba nas srid rtse'i bar gyi 'gro ba mtha' yas pa la khyab pa sprin gyi tshogs dang mtshungs pa dang / sku dang gsung gi mdzad pa ni/ chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin du sprul pa sna tshogs ston pa tshangs pa chen po dang mtshungs pa dang / thugs kyi mdzad pa ni/ shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa thams cad la ye shes kyi snang ba rab tu spro ba nyi ma dang 'dra ba dang / thugs kyi gsang ba ni 'bad rtsol dang rnam rtog med par gzhan don lhun grub tu 'byung ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang mtshungs pa dang / gsung gi gsang ba ni brjod par snang yang brjod pa'i yi ge med par brag cha dang mtshungs pa dang / sku'i gsang ba ni kun rdzob pa'i gzugs su med kyang skal ldan la rtag tu snang ba nam mkha' dang 'dra ba dang / thugs rje ni 'gro ba ma lus pa'i dkar po dge ba'i chos kyi sman thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa sa gzhi dang mtshungs pas na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las ni lhun gyis grub cing rgyun mi 'chad par gsungs la/ de bzhin du/ bdag nyid chen po 'di ni yang dag par na rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor bzhugs shing /

gang gi rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad 'phrin gyi tshogs rnams kyang / rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kyi rang bzhin las gzhan du ma mchis pas na 'khor ba ji srid pa de srid du rgyun mi chad cing lhun grub tu 'byung ba ni/ mdzad pa po la skyo dub mi mnga' zhing / /mdzad yul 'gro la mu mtha' med pa'i phyir/ /mdzad dus nam mkha' gnas pa de srid du/ /mdzad tshul du mas 'gro don rtag mdzad de/ /sku yi rnam 'phrul ston pa lha dbang bzhin/ /gsung gis gdams ngag 'doms pa lha yi rnga/ /mkhyen brtse'i sprin las 'dod dgu'i char chen 'bebs/ /tshangs bzhin grangs med sprul pas 'gro don mdzad/ /ye shes snang ba nyi ma'i 'od ltar spro/ /dgos 'dod 'byung ba mi rtog nor bu'i thugs/ /gsung dbyangs sgra snyan lta bus dam chos ston/ /mkha' khyab sku ni 'dus byas gzugs dang bral/ /thugs rje'i sa 'dzin 'gro ba'i dge legs gzhi/ /rtag par 'byung ba rgyal ba'i 'phrin las so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ de lta bu'i lhun grub rgyun mi chad pa'i tshul rnams slar yang 'phro bsrings te brjod par sha chags pa lags so/ /'dir smras pa/ gang la brten na srid dang zhi ba yi/ /dpal kun bde blag nyid du 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /rdo rje slob dpon nyid yin de bas na/ /de yi yon tan bsngags lce don dang ldan/ /de las bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis kyi/ /'bras bu mi zad 'phel ba'i dpal yon gyis/ /rang gzhan gtan bde'i don gnyis lhun gyis grub/ /de phyir tshul 'dir 'bad gang rgyal bas bsngags/ /de lta mod kyi dam pa'i yon tan mkha'i/ /mtha' gru 'jal tshe stobs bcu'i dpal mnga' ba/ /mkha' lding dbang po'i tshogs kyang ngal 'gyur na/ /nyam chung byis blo phye ma leb kyis ci/ /'on kyang mdzad 'phrin cha shas tsan+dan dri/ /dad 'dun ma la ya rlung gis bskyod pa'i/ /bsil ba reg tshe 'gro blo'i tsha gdung kun/ /yongs sel cha tsam bsnyad pa'i bgyi ba'ang rmad/

/ka ye bdag dang thar pa'i lam yangs por/ /mnyam du chas pa'i don mthun grogs po dag /yongs 'dzin rtogs brjod gru chen 'di longs dang / /rmad byung yon tan rgya mtsho ngang gis mthong / /de las 'di ko phan bde 'jo ba'i dpyid/ /yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal por nges pa rnyed/ /de tshe dad dang gus pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser/ /legs mchod rang gzhan dgos 'dod ma lus stsol/ /dad dang brtson pa sor mo'i 'dab 'phreng gis/ /rtogs brjod rgyud mang bskul ba'i rnam 'phrul la/ /phrag dog lang tsho dar ba'i yid can yang / /rna ba'i ut+pal ngoms pa mi rigs sam/ /yongs 'dzin chu skyes dkar po'i zhabs 'bring mtshor/ /yun du bsti ba'i skal bzang bh+raḥm ra/ /zab don sbrang rtsi 'thung ba'i mgrin pa nas/ /rtogs brjod glu dbyangs brdol ba'i rol mo 'dis/ /sgra 'dzin ku mud zum rnams 'dren pa'i gtsor/ /dad pa'i sa bon sngon goms log lta'i mes/ /thal bar byas sam min na smra por yid/ /'gran 'dod 'khyog por drangs las gzhan du ci/ /sngon nas goms pa'i rnam dpyod lang tsho bdo/ /dad dang gus pa'i lhag bsam rgyan gyis spras/ /dam pa'i rnam thar yid bzhin nor bu'i 'phreng / /tshig 'jam srad bur brgyus na rjes yid rang / /e ma rgyal kun yab gcig 'jam pa'i dpal/ /gzhan ngor rab dkar bla gos gsar pas bklubs/ /dbu skyes lcang los rab mdzes mi yi zol/ /rigs sngags 'chang ba'i nor bu ke ta ka /gang khyod mthong thos dran pa tsam gyis kyang / /snying dbus chu mtsho'i rnyog pa kun sel na/ /yon tan rgya cher bsngags pa'i byi dor gyis/ /gsol btab bgyi bar 'bungs na lta ci zhig /mtshan dpes rab mdzes mgon po gang gi sku/ /mig gi bdud rtsi gsung dbyangs rna ba'i bcud/ /thugs ni yid la sim pa ster ba'i dpyid/ /de phyir mthong thos dran pa'ang skal ba bzang / /bdag kyang deng nas skye ba'i 'phreng ba kun/ /khyed sku 'dab brgya'i phung po blta byed cing /

/dri med gsung gi bdud rtsi legs 'thungs te/ /zag med thugs dang gnyis su med par smon/ /tshur mthong blo gros srin 'bu'i 'od snang gis/ /dam pa'i yon tan mkha' dbyings gsal mthus dben/ /de phyir tshul 'di bsnyad las nongs pa'i tshogs/ /cir snang thog med sdig dang bcas te bshags/ /rje btsun bla ma'i rnam thar rgya mtsho las/ /chu thigs tsam zhig dad gus lhag bsam dang / /brtson pa'i ku shas blangs pa'i dge tshogs rgyun/ /gur gum spos chus bdag sogs mtha' yas pa'i/ /'gro blo'i sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa'i dri/ /ma lus bkrus te gnyis ldan dag pa'i dri/ /mngon du byed pa'i rgyu tshogs rma med par/ /'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i blos bsngo'o/ /zhes khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rtogs pa brjod pa ngo mtshar yon tan rin po che 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang nyid rje btsun bla ma gang gi rgyun gyi zhabs 'bring par 'khod pa'i skabs/ gling ga zur 'chad pa rje ngag dbang dpal ldan pa dang / zhe dgon gdan sa pa dkon mchog lhun grub gnyis kyis dam pa 'di'i rnam thar ha cang rgyas pa ma yin pa re bkod 'dug pa mthong ba'i tshe rjes su yi rang dang / dang 'dod dung ba skyes shing / 'on kyang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos rdo ring kun spangs pa'i rtogs brjod las/ phal tshig sbrang chags tho tsher 'god byed pa'i/ /blun rmongs dag gi snying la mi 'bab kyang / /zla dbang dge dbang dpa' bo'i gzhung lugs bzhin/ /mkhas pa'i dga' ston rtogs brjod 'di smras so/ /zhes pa dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog lhun grub kyis sa lo'i rnam thar las/ yid bzhin nor bu spangs nas mching bu la/ /mkhas kun dgyes pa'i rgyan bzang bya'o zhes/ /ltar snang mtshar du dngar ba'i skal chung po/

/de dag brdzun tshig sbyor dang 'di mi 'dra/ /zhes gsungs zhing / smra ba'i dbang phyug chos rnam rgyal gyis kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar las/ rtogs brjod yid bzhin nor bu grong tshig gi /bras ma'i srad bu la rgyu rigs min pas/ /tshig rgyan gser sbyangs btso ma'i srad bu la/ /'os par brgyus nas skal bzang mgrin par sbyin/ /zhes gsungs 'dug pa ltar/ yul khyad par can gyi yon tan snyan tshig gis brjod rigs pa kho nar snang ba las/ bdag cag lta bu blo dman zhing / khyad par snyan ngag gi rig byed la blo gros mig dman char du babs pa nas/ rtsom pa'i rlom pa byas kyang mkhas pa dgyes pa zhig ci la yong du 'dug snyam pa'i blo zhum par gyur cing / rjes su thub bstan lha khang gi mkhan po'i go sar 'phos nas snyan ngag gi skor la thos bsam dang / rtsom rgyugs kyi rnam grangs shig kyang byas pas tshigs bcad thar thor tsam shes par brten/ rje bla ma'i bka' drin dran pa'i gsal 'debs dang / gzhan la yang bskul ba'i brdar mdor bsdus tsam zhig 'bri ba'i spobs pa cung zad skyes shing / rje nyid kyi bka'i gnang ba yang thob ste/ gang gi bka' 'bangs kyi mtha' chung du gyur kyang / zhabs 'bring dang sri zhu yun ring du bgyid pa'i skal ba bzang po thob cing / gzhal du med pa'i bka' drin kho nas nye bar 'tsho ba shākya'i bha dan+ta mai tri dh+ya na sa ka ras/ dam pa 'di'i sngon gyi 'khrungs rabs rnams ni dpal 'phrin las kyi mgon po gnod sbyin tse'u dmar pos bka' tshig snga phyi'i rgyab rten du slob dpon pad+ma'i lung bstan 'khrul med du ma dang / gzhan yang bla ma gong ma so so'i rnam thar du gsal ba rnams kyang bkod/ da lta'i gzhon nu'i rol rtsed kyi mdzad pa rnams rnam thar gzhan dang rje nyid kyi gsung mgur sogs la brten/ dgung lo bcu bdun nas nyer lnga'i bar gyi mdzad 'phrin phal cher nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rje mus chen bud+dha'i mtshan can gyi rnam thar sarga gsum pa nyid la gzhi byas/

de nas bzhi bcu zhe lnga'i bar gyi ngo mtshar ba dag rang nyid kyi bgrang gzhi nyer bdun nas zhe bzhi'i bar dam pa gang gi zhabs 'bring 'bral med du zhus pa nas blo la nges par yod cing / zhe lnga nas da lta dgung lo lnga bcu nga lnga steng na bzhugs pa yan chad kyi rnam par thar pa rang blor gsal ba dang / mi gsal ba rnams rje nyid la dogs gcod zhus nas/ sngon dang / da lta ba'i thun mong ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa gnyis ka tshang bar sgro bskur gyi skyon spangs te bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha chen gyi bla chen 'phags pa dang / theg chen chos kyi rgyal po sogs rje btsun gong ma du ma'i bsti gnas lha khang bla brang du lcags mo yos lo tha skar zla ba'i ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos chos kyi 'khor lo thog ma bskor ba'i dus dran dkar phyogs kyi tshes bzhi'i nyin legs par grub pa'i yi ge pa ni rje nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan zhing tshangs spyod kyi rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba byams pa rdo rje rin chen gyis bgyis pa'o/ /'dis bdag cag rnams kyi rgyud la bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //ka l+ya na bar+dhan+tu// //shu bha mastu sar+b+ba dza ga taṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 340 mai tri dh+ya na sa ka ra/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rtogs brjod/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 339
